tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyis gnod sbyin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs klag chog ma tsan+ti ma ṇi'i char rgyun bzhugs/ /
༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyis gnod sbyin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs klag chog ma tsan+ti ma ṇi'i char rgyun bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (ka)

༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyis gnod sbyin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs klag chog ma tsan+ti ma ṇi'i char rgyun bzhugs// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor yongs bzhengs pa// gsung ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang bla ma dang*// dbyer med gsung gi dbang phyug khro bo'i rgyal// dbang chen a la gh+ri war gus btud nas// pad+ma'i thugs bcud dgongs yang zab kyis// cha lag gnod sbyin nor lha bsgrub pa'i thabs// phyi nang gsang gsum 'don cha'i rim pa rnams// 'jug bdor bkod la bka' yi gnang ba rtsol// 'dir rgyal dbang rat+na'i zab gter las bzhes pa dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi lo lag gdon sbyin sgrubs thabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'don cha dkyus su bkod par/ dang po phyi sgrub chu sbyin ni/ rang gi mdun du zangs mkhas gzheng gi nang rnam sras dang*/ dzi dko gnyis kyi 'bur sku rin po che'i rigs rab gnas can 'byor na rab/ ma 'byor tshe bris sku bkram la/ mchod pa sogs spyi ltar bshams shing*/ bdag bskyed rtsa gsum gyi gzhung bsnyen pa dang bcas pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs mthar/ mdun gyi rten a mri tas bsangs (2) swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad nyi zla ba'i gdan che chung gnyis las che ba'i stong du bho/ chung ba'i khar yig las 'od zer myogs bcur 'phros sems can thams cad dbul 'phongs ser sna'i sdug bsngal sbyangs/ tshul 'dus pa bon so so la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las stan che ba'i khar rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog gser gtso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rat+na'i bo con 'phyar ba/ g.yon e'u le nor skyug 'dzin cing*/ sku la gser khrab dang*/ zhabs la sag lham gsol zhing dar sna tshogs kyi gos dang rat+na'i rgyan 'phreng du mas klubs shing rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ gdan gcig bshos kyi stong du byang sems 'dzas bha la sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rat+na'i ga'u dang*/

g.yon ne'u le'i kha nas rin chen zar tshags su 'dzags ba snams shing*/ rang dang rin chen du mas brgyan pas sems dkyil gyi bzhugs pa'i gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po thugs kar hūṃ sngon so rnams las 'od zer 'phros byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi gnas nas bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: dam ye dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyi dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri khā ra ar+ghi wā sra tā ts+tsha swā hā shasta'i bar sbyar ba'i mchod de bzhin gshogs pa thams cad dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btags pas rigs lngas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yang lud pa las rgyal so la mi bskyod dang*/ ji ltar rnam snang gi rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ chu sbyin ni/ rlan gyi mi 'jigs pa'i sku na dngos dang*/ de min me long gzugs brnyen 'char bcug te 'bul/ rang yi dam du gsas ba'i lag g.yon zla dkyil gyi dbus su aḥyig dpar pos mtshan pa las chu 'di nyid 'chi med lha'i bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan gyi mdun bskyed lha gnyis kyi spyir bor phul bas sku 'i nang thams cad khengs pa'i lha gnyis dgyes pa'i skad dang ne'u btsir nas rin chen chu rgyun rat+na dang chos dang nor gyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yid la gang 'dod pa bar bdag dang mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad dbus 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal las grol ba mdzad bzhin par gyur par dmigs nas/ lag g.yas chu sbyong zhing*/ g.yon mchog sbyin gyi rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha bhūḥbhai ma ṇaḥ/ a nu rat+na rwa dz+wa tsa ra ku ru hūṃ swā hā: ār+ya dzam+bha la hrīḥm hā sid+dhi pha la ho/ zhes gsang sngags bzlas pa'i chu 'bul zhing brgya rtsa ro'i mtshams du dmigs pa gsal btab/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ bhai bh+ra ma ṇa ā r+ya

(3) dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghi srā tits+tsha swā hā: shasta'i bar sbyar/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras ni nor mang zhings/ gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjed pa'i sku/ sprin bral nyi ma stong gi gzi mdangs can/ 'dod gdu char ltar 'bebs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gtor mnga' zhing*/ gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la/ dngos grub mchog rtsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 'od gsol ni/ khyod la chu sbyin 'bul ba'i mthu byin gyi/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun/ dbul 'phongs ser sna'i sdug bsngal rab zhi nas/ 'dod dgu mi zad gtor ma spyod par shog /zhes yi ge brgya pas chad lhag gso/ badz+ra muṃ ye shes sa gshogs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur/ chu de nyid rang gi bza' btung dang*/ sgrub khang phyogs bzhir gtor zhing sbyin dmigs bya de ltar phyi sgrub chu sbyin bsnyen pa tshad ldan skabs thun bzhi drug gang 'os su bcad cing*/ thun rer mdzug mchod bstod 'dod gsol nongs bshags dang*/ thun mgor mngon rtogs nas skyar zhing bsnyen pa 'bul phrag gam dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ma mthongs bar du 'bad cing rgyun du nyams su len pa la dkyus nyid kyi 'grub bo/ ༈ gnyis pa nang sgrub gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ rin chen 'bru sman dar zab rkang 'gro'i spru dang rnga rngog sna mtshon cha bza' btung gi bya brag du ma las grub pa'i gtor ma dpe'u ris ltar dkar gyi dmar gyi rgyan dang ldan pa mañji sogs kyi khar bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon du tsaka le sogs yod na 'jug cing mtha' bskor du gong gi gtor rjas rnams dang mchod pa bcas bshams/ chu gtsang la a mri ta dang rin chon sna lnga'i phyi la sbyar ba sogs nyer brtogs bya/ sngar bzhin bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang 'os mthar/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad nyi zla ba'i gdan che chung gnyis las che ba'i steng du bhai dang chung ba'i khar dzi yig las nas/

de nyid la thim par gyur bar phyi grub ltar song rjes/ gtor ma byin brlabs pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃlas rin po che'i snod nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gsal ba yig 'bru gsum gyi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs sprel sbyar ba'i yi ge gsum yang de nyid la tim pas zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum dang*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum gyi byin brlabs/ rang ltar gsal bi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed lha'i thugs kar 'phogs de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa mchaud cing sems can thams cad kyi dbul 'phongs dang ser sna'i sdug bsngal zhi nas bde skyid 'dod yon ci 'dod kyi dpal la sbyor/ 'od zer slar 'dus bdag gi gsang sngags (4) bzlas zhing gtor ma 'dod yon yon lnga phul ba'i mthus lha gnyis rab tu dgyis pa'i phyag gi na gu la btsir bas sna tshogs pa'i rat+na'i rgyun stong gsum gang bar skyug /lha gnyis kyi thugs las 'od rgyur par migs nas/ ā+oṃ pad+ma kro dha hūṃ: bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā: sarba lo ka hring hring:ma hā ba la ba ling ta khā hiḥ rat+na si d+dhi hūṃ/ ar+ya 'dzam+bha la da ye hūṃ: sarba lo ka hring hring : rat+na si d+dhi hūṃ : zhes bzlas pa la 'bad cing brgya rtsa rau 'i mtshams su chu gtsang*/ a mṛ ta rin po che sna lnga sbyar ba sbran/ thun mtsham su mchod gtor gtor gso zhi phyi sgrub ltar gyi mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ khyod la gter ma phul ba'i mthu phyin gyis/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can sogs dang yig brgyas nongs sa bshags/ de ltar phyi tshe gcig gis dngos grub thob par gsungs kyang rtags dang sbyar ba gal che zhing*/ gzhung du sngags tshar bzhi dang 'dod gsol sbyar lugs kyang bsnyen sa spyir btang la mi bde ba'i go rib cung zad bsgrigs nas bkod cing*/

rgyud 'khyir byed tshe gzhung kho nas 'grub la/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma mthong nas mdun bskyed ye shes pa gshogs/ dam tshig pa bstim zhing gtor rdzas rnams mdzod phung tu sba'o/ ༈ gsum pa gsang sgrub ga'u dongs ni/ bca' thams lag len gyi rim pa gzhung nas gsungs pa bzhin chad lhag gi skyon bral zhing ma 'khrug ma 'dzings pa tshad ldan mkhas pa'i phyag rgyun ltar grur rjes/ bsgrub pa po'imadun du ma rdal ba yi rnams snga dang spos kyi byug pi khar me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i stong du 'brusabakang ba'i zangs gzhon sogs kyi snod du bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma sogs ji ltar dgos pa rnams 'du bar byas nas/ rang rtsa ba gsum gyi bskyed rin gsol bzhin pas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdud gyi ga'u dmigs pa'i rten rin po che'i gzhal mas/ mdzes shing yid 'phraugs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma'i dbus su skad cig gi mkha' la khyung chen lding ba bzhin ya gab la rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog chu shel gyi ldun po ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ g.yas rin po che'i bo cen 'phrir zhing*/ g.yon ne'u len nor skyug 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ sku la gser phyag zhabs la pag ldam dar gos rat+na'i rgyan 'phrong du mas mdzes shing pad nyi zla ba'i dbus su dung seng dkar po la chibs pa/ 'ong tu bka' sgrub blon po'i tshul du byang sems dzam+bha la sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba zhag gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin chen be con dang (5) g.yon kha ṭ+wī ga bsnams ti spyan stong du gzigs pa zhal gdangs shing ljags 'drin ba ral pa gyon du phyogs shong*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol zhing 'brug pa zhon par gsal ba'i gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su rnam sras ba bhai dang*/

dzam+bha lar ji mig dpo pos mtshan zhing*/ zung gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po gsal ba'i sa bon dang yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rin rab lhun po'i byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi zhing nas bskyod pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam ye dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyi dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa swa ri wā ra ar+ghai sra tīts+tsha swā hāḥ shasta'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag lham yar mud pa las rgyas po la mi bskyod pa dang*/ ji ltar rnam snang gi rgyas gdab/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ bai bh+rā ma ṇa ār+ya dzam+bha la sa sā ri wā ra ar+ghai sra tits+tsha swā hāḥ shasta'i bar sbyor bas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rin rab byang gi phyogs na gnas mdzad pa: sku mdog dpar po gangs ri ltar brjed cings/ be con ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin dpal/ snang ba dba' sdu rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod/ mi zad gtor 'dzin bcom ldan zla ba'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con kha ṭ+wi 'dzin/ 'brug chen la chibs dbul ba sel ba'i mgon/ nor gyi dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshol 'atod/ bstod par 'os sa thams cad la/ sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ mdun bskyed lha gnyis kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sngags 'phreng mdog mdun g.yas bskor du 'khor ba la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros sa bon dang sngags 'phreng la phogs pa'i rkyen gyis de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rgyal ba thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal zhing 'on zer slar 'dus/

bdag gis sngags bzlas pa dang chab gcig par par lha gnyis kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phrong kyang rang sgra sgrogs shing 'khor bas/ lha gnyis bar tu dgyis pa'i phyag gis gu btsir bas nor bu ci 'dod skyug cing*/ lha gnyis kyi sngags 'phring dang ska las kyi 'od zer bar mi chad pa spros te bdag la thim pas rgyun la dgos 'don sna tshogs pa'i nor bu dang laungs spyod dpal 'byor/ mkho dgu du ma'i char chen po phab ste ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ parma kro dha hūṃ: bhai bh+ra ma ṇa a nu tsa ra rat+na rwa dz+wa ku ru hūṃ hūṃ: oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha da ye hūṃ hūṃ: zhes skyon drug spangs bzlas/ thun bzhi'o (6) drug la gong du yod pa'i mchod bstod mjug tu nang sgrub ltar gter ma byin rlabs byas nas/ oṃ bhai bh+ra ma ṇa ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra i dam bha ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'dun ni gsum gyis mjug mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bar dang khyod la gtor ma 'bul ba'i mthu byin gyis/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can la lus kun/ dbul 'phogs ser sna'i sdug bsngar bar zhi nas 'dod dgu mi zad gter la spyod par shog zhes don gsol yi ge brgyas gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ de ltu'u zhag bdun nyer gcig zla gcig sogs 'bad pa'i gzhung du gsal ba'i rtags nges pa brtan po kha yar thob pa'i tshe/ slar gong sngags nyid la mi nor chos g.yu sogs gzhung dang yig chung du gsungs pa so so gang 'dod kyi ling mthar/ phyi shi ni swā hā: yig 'bru lnga pa 'di btags pa gang 'grub pa'i rtags nges pa brtan po kha yar thob pa'i tshe/ slar gong sngags nyid la mi nor chos ga'u sogs gzhung dang yig chung du gsungs pa so so gang 'od kyi ming mthar/ mi shi ni swā hāḥ yi 'bru lnga pa 'di btags pa gang 'grub bzlas rjes brtan bzhugs dang bcas gzhung bzhin nongs bshags bsngo smon shis brjod sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par byas/

gzhan yang gdu bcangs lugs dang*/ phan yon dam tshig rig pa rnams zhug nyid du shis par byos shig /de ltar dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi 'chod shog smug po'i chos sde las gnod sbyin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thams 'don cha dkyus su bkod pa 'di yang rjes btsun pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i bden chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dam pas bka'i gnang ba thos pa la brten 'dul 'dzin phyi ma lugs kyi me khams byi ba'i log gsar du tshes pa'i dmar phyogs ḍāk+ki 'du ba'i dus tshes la bkra shis tshugs su spel ba sarba maṅgalam/ (khā) ༄༅// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang mo'i sgo nas bsnyen sgrub 'jigs pa kun grol zhis bya ba bzhugs so// rjes btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang mo'i sgo nas bsnyen sgrub 'jigs pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba/ bla ma lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ mar gad lhun po lta bur 'jo sgog sku/ mtshan dpe 'argyan can 'phags ma legs sbyin ma'i/ zhabs kyi pad+mor rab btud gang de yi/ sgrub thabs mos ldan re ba skang phyir bri/ 'dir 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang me'i sgo nas sgrub thams kyi las rim la gsum/ sngon 'gro tshogs 'bags kyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi lus lhar bskyod nas mchod cing bsnyen pa dang*/ rjes 'jug bsdu zhing dge ba bsngo ba'i las rim mo/ de la dang so rwa la bzhi la sogs pa'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes dge bar sgrub khang byi der logs par byas la/ mdun du stogs bzang po'i khar bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs bar gnas dang ldan pa'i mdun du gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i mchod gtor zar gong lta bu parmas bskor ba dang*/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis

(7) nyer spyod lnga bcas tsar du bshis/ rang nyid stan bde bar 'phags ma'i skur phyogs pa'i mdun du dkar gtor dhor dril sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du byas la thog mar skyabs 'gro ni/ mchog gsum kun 'dus rgyal kun yum/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs dpa la/ bdag sogs mkhas mnyam lus can kun/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ ma gyur sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i/ 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/ 'phags ma'i go 'phang thog slad du/ bdag gi li ni nyer 'bad bya/ zhes lan gsum/ dkar gtor chus bran la/ oṃ swā bhag+na ta kri hūṃ: oṃ swa bha wa sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod mangs shing rgya che ba'i du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma drangs shing thog pa med cing zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskye pa nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par gyur*/ oṃ ā ka ro sogs gsum/ bcom ldan 'das sogs de bzhin gshogs sa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ nam maḥsarba ta thā ga ta wa lo ki ti oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ gang zhi mtshan lo rguya ba yi nas gdon khyed rang gi gnas su deng bar brjod/ hūṃ bzhi 'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa rnams bgogs mthar byed kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi nad du oṃ āḥhūṃ gi tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa ngo bo stong pa byed las dbangaca po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa bde ba khyed par can bskyed pa nam mkha'i dam dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra mar+ghaṃ āḥhū: sa rgyam/ suṣ+pi rgyu saṃ/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi rgyaṃ/ shasta'i bar byin gyi brlab/ bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ skad cig gi pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid 'phags ma sgrom mar gsal ba'i thu kar zla ba'i gdan la gnas pi tāṃ yig in+d+ra'i mdog ltu las 'od 'phrong phyogs mtshams stong 'og thams cad du spros du spralos pa las rdo rje gur dang*/

de'i nang du bla bres dang phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rdo rje'i dra ba chen po/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su rdo rje mda'i dra ba/ phyi rol rdo rje rwa ba de ba'i phyi lo ye shes kyi me dpung du bu gcig tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo kun nas yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ ār+ya ta re badz+ra rak+sha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang 'phags ma'i skra gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tāṃ yig marku ta'i mdog lta bu 'od zer stong gsum 'jig rten (8) gyi khams su 'phros pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ār+ya tā ri sa pā ri wā badz+ra pa ma dzaḥ gong gi wā ra'i mthar pad+ma ka ma la ye swaṃ/ wā ra'i mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shastī bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyi bstod/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ rje btsun 'phags ma dang sogs lan gsum gyis tshogs bsags/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying khar thim par gyur/ gnyis pa bdag gi rnal 'byor bskom pa ni/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa chen po bdag med par gyur/ stong pa de'i ngang las saṃ las byung ba'i skyes sna tshogs 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dbus su ze'u 'bru'i stong du āḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i bla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su tāṃ las ut+pā la sngon po tāṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros khams gsum sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen pos brgyad dang bcu drug las grol te bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phag la bkod tshul 'dus de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma 'phags mi sgrol ma sku mdog rin po che mar gad kyi lhun po brtsegs pa lta bu 'od zer phyogs kun tu 'phro ba bzhin rang 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/

dbu skra thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i lhag ma rgyal tu sil bur 'chang ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can lang tsho rgyas shing sgog pa'i nyams can mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzangaca po brgyad bcus mdzes pa/ phyag gnyis ga'as mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar g.yo ba sku la dbang po'i gnam ru khengs pa 'phrogs pa'i lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyi mdzes par 'chang ba rin thang gzhal du med pa rin so che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan do shal se mo do dang skra rags dpung rgyan phyag gdub log pags la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes pa zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo klung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas dang khyad par du yang po ṭa la nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ so ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas/ tāṃ yig ljang gu las 'khrungs shing*/ tāṃ yiga'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ 'phags ma 'khor bcas byon pa legs/ bdag can bsod nams bar ldan/ bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du/ ji srid 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol/ pad+ma ka ma la (9) ye s+t+waṃ: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa dang bsgoms pa'i dam tshig pa rnams so sor chu la chu bzhag pa ltar thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyis 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod nas/ oṃ parba ta thā ga ta a bh-i ṣiñca tu maṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams nas/

oṃ parba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan bdang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ ār+ya ta re sa pā ri khya ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sra tits+tsha swā hāḥ shasta'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags pa sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ segs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ma'i bstod la/ bsnyen dmig ni/ thugs kar bla ba'i stong du tī ljang gu 'od 'bar ba'i mthar oṃ tā re tu t+tā re tu re swā hā'i sngags kyi g.yon bskor du 'khor ba las 'od 'phros bla ma yid dam dpal bo mkhro'i tshogs dang*/ drang srong rigs pa 'dzin pa'i tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang byi rlabs rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa'i lha mi'i ded dpon rnams kyi tshe dang dpal 'byor rtan g.yo snod kyi 'jig rten khams kyi tshe bcud la sogs pa'i nus sa 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i bcud dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer mar gad lta bur bsdus te rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'phring la thim/ yang 'od 'phros 'gro drug gi sems can rnams la phog de thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod nas 'gro ba'i don byas te slar rang gi thug ka'i sa bon dang sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ bho dhi tsit+tī 'phreng ba sngon du longs ma spyad pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa'i dri bzang ba byung lngas byugs la thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ru tsi ra sogs kyi sogs kyi sngags 'di 'i thug 'og thams cad la bya'o/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re ru re swā hā: rnam g.yeng dang gnyid la sogs skyon drug spangs nas rtse gcig gi bzla bar bya'o/ thun mthar ma gtor chu bran la/ bgegs mthar byed kyis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gter ma dwangs shing thog pa med pa zag med 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ: oṃ āraya tā ri sa sa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod*/ 'khor ba las sgrol ma'i bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya tshar gsum brjod/ gzhan gyi spyod lam la 'jug go/ gsum sa mjug bsdu ba ni/ oṃ ār+ya tā ri sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ (10) nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ lha dang lha min dang*/ bstod par 'os pas bstod/ smon lam ni rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can sogs dang*/ bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byaur yongs su ma mnyes sogs dang*/ mjung tu yig brgya lan bdun brjod cing*/ dmigs med kyi rgyas btab/ bkra shis ni/ bcom ldan gser mdog sogs dang zhan yang bkris bsngo smon rgyas par rbayas la byin chags par bya'o/ de ltar sgrol ljang sgrub thabs 'di bzhan sngon chad rje dharmāki rtis mdzad pa'i sgrub thams nor 'phring gi le'u bcu gcig pa sgrol ljang sgrub thabs de nyid cung zad rgyas par bris pa/ 'dir yang bla ma sgru rgyud tshang gi grwa rigs dge slong dkon mchog nor bus bskul ngor/ 'bri ban chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprel zla'i dpar phyogs rgyal ba dang sor thub bstan yang ri sgra gyi chos grwa chen po'i gzims chung parma 'od du sbyir ba'o/ (ga) ༄༅// bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung bsdus dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ rang nyid skad cig rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i/ spyi bor seng khri pad+ma nyi zla yi/ brtsegs pa'i gdan gsum gsal ba'i dubs ma las rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong du 'bar ba dang*/ dbyer med 'jig rten gsum mgon rat+na shri/ g.yas su gangs can mgon dngos pad+ma'i zhabs/ g.yon dathum ma'ad bsnun sgyu 'phrul dharma'i mtshan/ gsum ka thang gos sha 'gags rnam gsum mdzes/ bka' rtags dbang gi mdog can sgom zhu gsol/ mtshan dpe rab brjid rdo rje skyil klung bzhugs/

phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'khor phyag rgya mdzad/ kun 'dus bla ma yab sras rnam gsum gyi/ sku las 'od zer sna tshogs rab 'phro ba/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyi yongs bskor gsal/ bdag lus zhing rul mnyam sprul phyag 'tshal zhing*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mchos mcho/ sgo gsum mi dge'i nyes tshogs ci bgyis bshags/ dus gsum dge tshogs (11) tan cha tsam med par dam pa de rnams kyi gral du bsgrigs par nyes ltung gi rgyu las ma mchis kyang ngo ma ldog par 'bri ban dha rmā s+ya dhā dzas rjong gsar tshugs kyi gzims chung phun tshogs 'khyil par sbyor ba'o// bla ma'i snal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung gi ldan thabs bzhugs/ phyogs dus rgyal kun ma lus gcig bsdus/ yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po lta bu/ dran mchog rje btsun rnam pa gsum la/ gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyi gzigs shig /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i dam 'byor thob cing*/ rgyu 'bras mi bslu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ shes kyang sdong zad byol nyog spyod mkhan/ snying med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shig 'jug dka' rgyal bstan rin chen sgor zhugs/ so thar byang sems sdom pa mnos kyangs/ bsrung sems med cing phyogs dang ris can/ snying med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shig /smin byed dbang bskur grangs med thob kyang*// rgyud la ma skyes dam tshig rim pa// yal bar bor ba'i smyon spyod lta bu// snying med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shing*// rang lus gdod nas bskyed pa'i rim pa// yongs grub ma rtogs dug lnga'i rang bzhin a 'thas dhos bcas can du bsgom mkhan/ snying med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shig /dbu ma phyag rgya rdzogs chen la sogs/ kha 'dzin rnam grangs shin tu mang yang*/ sna gcig tsam la bstan pa ma thob snying med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shig /mchog mthun dngos grub ma lus thams cad/ skyabs gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid la/

ltos kyi re dgos mnyam 'grogs du sems/ snying med bdag la thugs rje gzigs shig 'khor gsum yongs dag dge tshogs ji snyid/ sems can don du bsngo bar bya rgyur/ rang bde don gnyer kho nar thal bas/ snying med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shig /re zhing ldos pa'i mgon skyabs gcig su/ mtshungs med drin can bla ma gsum las/ namayang gzhan du ma mchis pas na/ thugs rjes gzigs la yal bar ma 'dor/ 'di phyi gtan gyi dpung gnyen khyed kyis/ skal ldan rjes mjug snying rul bdag la/ byin rlabs dbang bzhi myur du rtsel cig /gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa sbyong la/ sku bzhir smin par mdzad du gsol lo/ bya ma mkhyen no/ zhes mos gus kyi gdung ba drag po ma skyes bar du brjod/ 'di bzhin bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung gi dge 'bras ci mchis byang chub cher sor bsngo zhes pa'i mjug der sbyar/ kun 'dus bla ma yab sras rnam gsum nas gzhung ltar 'don/ de ltar bla ma rgyang 'bod zhig dgos zhes mo 'khor rgyan gyi dub mdzad lhun grub kyi ngor snga ser a grags bla mas bskul ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung la lhan thabs kyi tshul du bgyis pa yang 'bri (12) ban bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis so/ (nga) ༄༅// klu bsangs mdor bsdus phan bde'i gru char zhes bya ba bzhug so/ gang sngon thugs bskyed chu gter las thon pa'i/ yid bzhin dod dgu'i gdeng can tshogs rnams kyis/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs skyobs dbul ba sel mdzad pa/ bcom ldan klu dbang rgyal der mgos phyag 'tshal/ bston 'gro bdag gzhan dgayos pa sgrub slad du/ lhag bsam bzang po'i lha lam yangs pa'i ngogs/ klu bsangs nam mkha'i glang po rab dkrigs te/ legs byas phan bde'i gru char 'di na 'bebs/ 'dir rnal 'byor pa gang zhig bstan 'gro'i don du char 'bebs dang*/ gzhan yang dgos pa du ma bsgrub pa'i phyir klu la bsangs mchod bya bar spro na/

dug rigs ma yin pa'i shing sna tshogs tshad kyi bsangs dud la/ dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman dri bzang po'i bsur dang phye mar mda' dar ngan so bcas bsham/ rang nyid ldan 'di bar skyayabs 'gro dzad med bzhir blo sbyongs nas/ rang nyid skad cig pa zlī gdan stong du/ a'uṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po ni/ sku mdog dkar so mgrin pa yan cha sngon/ mtshan dpes bar brgyan phyag gnyis thugs ka ru/ klu rnams ngan song grol ba'i phyag rgya mdzad/ na bza' shaṃ (13) thabs chos gos ngur smrig gsol/ sku la 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro bzhin gsal/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las yi ge ri 'phros te/ bsangs thab chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang*/ ngud sprin dri zhil ngad ldan 'ja' 'od 'khrugs/ nam mkha' sa bzhi bar snang kun gang zhing*/ dung pa'i gseba' nas 'dod yon lnga la sogs/ klu dang sa bdag gnyan rigs thams cad kyi/ rang rang mkho dgu'i longs spyod nad gdon pa/ sdug bsngal sel ba'i byad ma tshang med/ dpag yas nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par gyur/ rgyas par sngags drug phyag drug dang*/ bsda na 'bru gsum nam mkha' mdzod tshar gsum gyi byin brlabs/ bsangs mgron bskyed pa ni/ slar yang 'phags pa klu dbang thugs ka nas/ hūṃ las bhuṃ yig so po 'phros pa'i mdun/ rin chen sa gzhi skyed mos tshal chen mo/ stong gsum stong chen 'jig rten khams lta bu/ rang tu yangs shing rgya cho'i mtha' bskor du/rin chen bo'i 'phreng bas yongs 'khor zhing*/ dpag bsam shing dang ne'u sing ljongs kyis mdzes/ mtshams su rab dwangs khrus kyi rjing bu dang*/ bya dang ri dwags yid 'ong rgyu zhing gnas/ de dag dbus su rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ rgya mtsho chen po nga dwangs rgya che zhing*/ rin chen thems skal phyogs phyogs mdzes pa'i nang*/ nor bu'i rigs byed rnam pa sna tshogs bldams/ sbal sbrul nya dang chu srin ru sbal sogs/

dal 'gro'i gar mkhan du ma rgyu zhi rtse mtsho ngogs chu skyes sna tshogs 'dab stong g.yo/ mtsho mthar klu yi ljon shing nags tshal ni/ rgya khyon tshad las 'das pas yongs bskor zhing*/ mtsho dbus dkar 'dab brgya ze'u 'bru bcas/ de stong klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa sku mdog dkar po sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil/ dang dang rin chen rgyan 'chang thal mo sbyor/ gtsug rgyan nor bu 'od 'bar mdzes par gsal/ phyogs mtshams 'dab mar klu chen brgyad po ni/ rang rang sku mdog rgyan bcas gdong ka ldan de mdar rgyar rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs gdol ba'i rigs la sogs pa rnams/ rang rang rgyal po btsun mo sras blon 'bangs/ 'khor g.yog chung mar bcas pa gsal ba'i mthar/ sa bdag pa ri lha mo bstan ma dang*/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen mo la sogs pa/ sa bdag gtso bo gnyan gyi sde dpon rnams/ yongs bskor gzhan yang stong gsum 'jig rten gyi/ klu dang sa bdag gnyan rigs gyur to cog/ mngon su char sprin dkrigs pa lta bur gyur/ mgrin spyan 'dren pa ni/ kye mi mdzed 'jig rten 'dzam gling na/ rgya mtsho dang ni chu bo dang*/ chu bran mtsho'u lu ma dang*/ ri bdun ri rab sa dho dang*/ rtsi shing gnas tshal 'bab

(14) chu la/ gnas pa'i klu sa gnyan la sogs/ bsangs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ klu yi rgyal po pa ru ṇa/ mtha' yas pad+ma 'dren gshogs su gsol/ rgyal rigs rje rigs bral ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs gdol pa sa la sogs pa/ rang rang btsun sras blon 'bangs 'khor/ bsangs la spyon 'dren*/ sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang*/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po sogs/ sa bdag rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor rnams/ bsangs la spyan 'dren dang*/ gnyan gyi sde dpon chen po dang*/ ma chu shing sa nam mkha'i gnyan/ kha don sna tshogs gnyan gyi rigs/ bsangs la spyon 'dren/ gzhan yang ci shing nags tshal dang*/ chu mig lu ma srang sdeng dang*/ pha wong gar gor khron chu sogs/ gnas pa'i klu dang sa bdag gnyan/ ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ bsangs la spyan 'dren/ de ring yid 'ongs gnas mchog 'dir/ rtsi shing dpar mngar sman dud dang*/ 'dod yon spyan gzigs mda' dar sogs/ klu dang sa bdag gnyen 'khor bcas/ gsung ba'i shugs kyi spyan 'dren na/ ma lus 'khor bcas gshogs su gsol/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa wā ra bas ma dzaḥ dbyer med bsdim pa ni/ kyai s+thong gsum 'jig rten khams rnams yongs gang ba'i/ klu dang sa bdag gnyan sogs 'khor bcas rnams/ de ring bskyed pa'i mgron la gnyis med par/ thim zhing bde ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ nā ga rā dza pā ri wār dzaḥhūṃḥbai hoḥs ma ya tiṣ+wa lhan/ bsangs kyi 'byung khungs bstan pa ni/ kyai bsangs kyi rgyu ni ji ltar srid/ sngon tshe bskal ba'i dang po la/ mnga' bdag khri srid lde'u btsan gyi/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gnyis pa/ dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe/ za hor mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/ spyan drangs sa 'dul mdzad pa'i dus/ rgyal po'i phyag g.yas 'jor la ni/ rtsi snam phyugs nas brkos pa'i tshe/ sa ni kha dog lnga ldan byung/ ya mtshan ltas ni bzang gyur pa'i/ rgyal pos dbur byugs zhal du gsol/ de nas ār+ya pa lo'i gling*/

tsher phung gcod pa'i klus ma bzod/de skyon pa bdag klu gnyan dang*/ bod khams lha 'dre'i ram zlar bcas/ ri klung sa dho phyogs phyogs bskyal/ gdug rtsub che 'phrul mang byung ba'i/ rgyal po'i thugs chad yid rmaungs gyur/ gtsug lag bshol la thug pa'i tshe/ sngon gyi las stobs smon lam gyi/ slob dpon pad+ma spyon drangs nas ngal mchis phu'i brag dmar ge'i gong du/ rdo rje phun pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ klu gnyan lha srin dbang du bsdus/ srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ shing sna lnga yi lo ma brtsegs/ ye shes lnga ri rang me ra nga thabs (15) shes dkar dmar bsur su kyes/ ye shes 'jig rten klu gnyan sogs/ mgron rnams dgyis tshim gdug pa zhi/ char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs legs/ rje 'bangs mnga' thang gung la reg/ de ring srid pa de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag bcag gi/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel ba dang*/ yon mchod 'ded don sgrub ched du/ bsangs kyi mchod pa 'di spros pas/ klu dang pa bdag gnyan sogs kyi/ gdug rtsub zhi nas bsam pa'i don yid bzhin lhun gyi 'grub pa dang*/ bkra shis bde lages mdzad du gsol/ bsangs dngos ni/ kyai gling bzhi'i mchog gyur lhe rgyala'adzam gling 'dir/ spros kyi ri bo gnam du zangs po zangs/ spros chu yan lag brgyad ldan sha ra ra/ tsan dan nags tshal dri zhim thu lu lu/ gur gum spang re me tog mdangs kyang mdzes/ phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ tsan dan shug pa da li stag pa dang*/ mkhan pa spos dang a ga ru la sogs/ rtsi shing sna tshogs dkar dmar sman du dngas/ phye mar mda' dar mkhor dgu'i 'dod mon gyis/ klu chen kha ru ṇa la sogs pa yi/ klu yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa bsangs shar phyogs klu chen mtha' yas 'khor bcas bsangs/ lho phyogs klu chen pad+ma 'khor bcas bsangs/ nub phyogs klu chen 'jog po 'khor bcas bsangs/ byang phyogs klu chen nor rgyas byang shar klu chen pad chen 'khor bcas/

sho lho'i klu chen dung skyong 'khor= lho nub klu chen karko ṭa 'khor bcas= nub byang klu chen rigs ldan 'khor= chu la dbang ba rgyal rigs 'khor = sa la dbang ba'i rje rigs 'khor bcas= me la dbang ba'i bram ze 'khor= rlung la dbang ba'i dmangs gdol 'khor= gzhan yang 'jig rten khasams kyi klu rigs rnams/ rgyal po bun sras blon po 'khor bcas= sa yi lha mo bstan ma la sogs pa/ ba bdag rigs bzhi rang rang rgyal po dang*/ rgyal mo blon po 'khor dang bcas pa/ me chu sa shing nam mkha' las gyur pas/ gnyan rigs lnga la sogs pa 'khor bcas bsangs/ gzhan yang g.ya' gangs nags tshal mtsho dang ljing*/ chu mig shing brag sa dho tsher ma can/ khron chu lus ma srang stong 'bab chu dang*/ pha wong gar gor shing sna na bun sogs/ 'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par yalpaphayogs 'dir/ gnas pa'i klu dang sa gnyan 'khor bcas bsangs/ khyar par mkhar khang rwa ba gru bzhi dang*/ rdo leb ka ba sogs la gnas pa yi/ klu dang ba bdag gnyan sogs 'khor bcas bsangs/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ mi shes gti mug las gyur 'gal 'khrul rnams/ de ring 'bangs mchod 'di yis dag gyur cig /rtsogs grib zas grib gos grib dam me grib dang*/ gnol grib ro grib mi gtsang grib rigs kun/ bsangs kyi cho ga zab mos dag gyur cig /smon lam (16) 'dod gsol ni/ kyai /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// klu la bsangs mchod phul ba'i mthus// byings 'thib nad rnams sel gyur cig /sman dang dri bzang phul ba'i mthus// klu yi nad brgya sol bar shog /rtsi shing sna tshogs phul ba yis// gnas khang dag dang ldan gyur cig /dkar gsum 'o ma'i mchod pa yis// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor ldan gyur cig /mngar gsum mchod pa phul ba'i mthus// logs spyod nam mkha' mdzaud ldan shog /gzhan yang dngos bshis yid sprul te// dpang med blo las 'das pa yis// mchod pa ji snyed phun ba'i mthus// mkhor dgu'i longs spyod ldan gyur cig

klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams kyis/ rang rang nad dang ldug bsngal dang*// gnod 'tshe myur du zhi gyur nas// ngan song las thar chos spyod nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas dang*// mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus la// klu gnyan sa bdag gdug sems kyi// bzung ba thong la bcings pa 'khrol// bsdams pa glaud la mnan pa 'khyogs// 'gras pa 'dums la 'khon pa sbyangs// klu yi nad gdon kun bral nas// 'dzam gling spyi dang yul phyogs 'dir// char chu lo 'bras rtsi shing bcud// longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas rnams// tse ring nad med bde ldan shog /de nas dma' dar g.yab cing g.yang 'gugs pa ni/ kyai phe brang yid 'ongs ring chen dang*// nor bu ba gam brtsigs pa'i gnas// 'dod dgu'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i// klu rgyal phyugs g.yang 'dir 'gugs so// gzhan yang brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi// tshe dpal gzi brjed stobs 'byor dang*// dgos dgu snyan grags phun tshogs kun// thams cad de ring g.yang du len// phra khayang rgya mtshe bzhin du bskyil// dge legs dpal gyi phyug par mdzod// ces g.yang len/ klu bsangs rkyang pa la/ nā ra rā tsa sa pā ri wā ra gats+tshaḥbarjod cing so gol tog /shis brjod bang smon gyi mtha' brgyan/ klu gtor dang 'brel na gshegs gsol sogs mjug bsdu byed mi dgos par klu gtor dang sbrol nas btang ba yin no// skye ma snyigs ma las kyi cher snyigs dus skabs 'dir/ phal cher mi dge 'i spyod pa la gzhol bas/ de rkyen lhu klu gzhi bdag phros pa yis/ sad ser than pas lo 'bras kun bcoms nas/ sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir tshe/ ma bzod tshad med shar ri'i phrag gong nas/ phan sems bsil sbyin bdang po'i 'od ris kyis/ 'bras drug rtsi shing ku mud bzhad gyur cig /'di bris dge bas gangs rjongs kyi dgos spyi dgos su/

char chung dus 'bebs lo 'bras rtags legs shings/ mi phyags nad yams mu ge'i sdug bsngal las/ grol nas rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /de ltar klu gtor sbyin pa'i lang tsho'i cha lag tu klu bsangs 'di ltar dgos zhes/ skyabs mgon dam pa'i (17) sku'i rigs las nye bar mthong pa gzigs dpon yon tan 'byung gnas kyis lnga lo ngo lu ma chu mig tu 'char 'bebs la bskyod skyabs bskul ma byung yang rnam g.yon gi lus par slar 'bru mang lor bskyer bskyar bskur byung ba ltar 'bri ban snyoms las pa dha rma s+ya dh+wa dzas bskul ba po nyid kyi zin bris la bzo bcos byas te chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkhro 'du ba'i dus chen la sbyar ba yi ge sa ni mang yul rigs las no no dkon mchog bstan pa'o// (ca) ༄༅// 'dus pa mdo'i dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhus so/ khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// rgyal tsab rigs lnga rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon// dam pa'i rigs can rnam lnga rgyal po dzaḥ u pa rwa dza rnams la gsol ba 'debs// in+ḍa shu ti nā ka su tra dngas/ gu h+ya su tri ku ku rwa dza'i zhabs// ro lang bde ba rdo rje bzhad pa dang*/ sra bhasti rnams la gsol= shākya seng ge rda na rak+sha ta// rdo rje hūṃ mdzad s+thi ra ma ti// bde ba gsal mdzad dha rma bo dhi dang*// mkhan po chos rgyal skyong la/ bal po nor 'dzin bru sha che btsan skyes/ gnubs chen yab sras ye shes rgyal mtsho dang*// blo gros byang chub tho dkar nam mkha' lte// zur chen mes dbon rnams la= yang khyeng sgro phug pa dang mgar ston pa/ bsreg dang glan ston dhor 'od brtson 'grub seng*/ bsod rgyal lha 'bum chos seng sangs rgyas dpal// bsod nis mgon po rnams la/ sgrol chen yab sras nam mkha' rdo rje dngas// sha mi la rgu ba dang blo gros rgyal// gzhan phan 'phrin las lhun grub yongs mtshan// 'gyur med rdo rje zhes la=

yang na sgrol chen chen zur ham shāka 'byung tshe dbang rgyal/ legs dpal rin chen rgyal mtshan legs ldan rje/ gnyags ban nyang stong pad+ma 'phrin las dang*/ 'gyar med rdo rje zhes so/ 'gyur tshul gnyis so gang gi tshe yang mjug tu/ skad gnyis smra ba dharma shrī dang*/ rat+na bi dza ya dang gu ṇa'i mtshan/ parma mchog grub klong chen 'od zer zhabs/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje gzi 'bar rtsal/ gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bzhi rtsol/ sems kyi chos nyid dbyings ye gnyis med par/ ye nas ma 'dres yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor gsum/ ji bzhin byed sa rkyen dang bya bral gyi/ rnal 'byor lam bzhin mthar ru phyin par shog /ces pa 'dus pa moda'i dbang brgyud gsol 'debs smin gling yi ge la kha 'gengs phran bu yang dharma s+ya dh+wa dzas so// (cha) ༄༅// lha 'tshan dgra lha'i rgyal po kun khyab rdo rje lag lan las bzhi'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ phyogs 'dus dral kun gcig 'dus thod 'phring rtsel/ mthun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor mi yi tshul// bzung nas rnam mang 'gro 'dul 'phrin las can// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun bla mar 'dud// chos rgyal tshangs pa lha mi me tog gis// yang srid paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi// gter byon bstan bsrung gnod sbyin tsi dmar bas// rten rdzas bca' thabs zab mo gab sbas rnams/ 'di nyid bstan 'dod dam ldan slob ma'i ngor// bla ma'i zhal lung man ngag ma nor ba// yi ger spol la mthu chen dpa' bo yis// bka' yi gnang ba rtsol la grogs mdzod cig /de la 'dir rig 'dzin chen po paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi gter byon lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po kun khyab rdo rje drag po/ (18) rtsal zhes mthu stobs 'gran pa'i zla dang bla ba'i chos skyong 'di nyid brton sgrub 'dod pa rnams thog mar bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du slob ma dam tshig ldan pas 'di yi srog gtad dang rgyud sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung legs par thob pa dang*/

khyad par spru gri dmar po snying gi rgyud las/ lta spyod ldan pa'i sngags pa yi: rta mgrin dbang gi bsnyen sa bya: zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang chen rta mchog sogs yi dam khri bo'i rigs kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i sngags nyams su len pa la don gsum ste/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sgo nas bla rdo rten rdzas bcang ba/ bsgrub pa'i yo byad bca' bshom/ bsgrub pa dngos gzhi bcas so/ dang po la bzhi las/ gter gzhung du/ phyi gsol kha la brten nas dam can sprin lta 'du ba dang: nang sba lcags la brten nas dam can khyi ltar 'breng ba dang: gsang ba bla rdo la brten nas dam can phru ltar chags pa dang: de kho na nyid mdung zhags dmar po la tshakli rab gnas can btags pa 'dzag gtor ma'i khong par 'byor na rgya shog gtsang mar gser dngul mtshal rgya snag gang 'byor gyi badz+ra gu ru dang*/ oṃ pad+ma tsan+dha ma hā kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hūṃ phaṭaḥ gong gnon dbang chen gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ rak+sha rak+sha snying la hūṃ hūṃ: shu la ghṛ wa tri shu la hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ gatsho 'khor gyi sngags bcas thams cad sbrol mthar/ gnod sbyin chen po kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa khyod rnams kyi sangs rgyas gnyis pa rigs 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal dang*/ mchos sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal/ rgyal dbang gnam lcags me 'bar sogs rin 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i spyan sngar phyi bar brgyud 'dzin skyong ba'i khas blangs dam bca' ma 'dor bar bsgrub pa'i rten 'di la brten par bzhugs nas sngags 'chang bdag gi rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las gang bcol thogs pa med pa yin bzhin du grub par mdzad du gsol/ sogs 'dod gsol gang 'dod rgyas par bris la mgo nas bsgril the dar skud kyi bcings/ zangs lcags kyi sbu gu'i snyug sbug sogs kyi nang du 'asbru sman dar zab rin po cho sogs kyi bkang ba'i dbus su mgo zhabs ma 'dzol ba bcug nas gtor ma'i khong du sba ba rten gtor ram sgrub gtor ltu ste/

yang bskang gtor ltu'i skabs bla ma yi dam gyi sngags dor ba'i srog sngags sam nam (19) mkha' mdzod kyi sngags bsham/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid gnon sbyin tsi'u dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ dgyes par bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sogs 'dod gsol ji dgos pa sbyor zhing*/ gzhan yang las gang sgrub kyi 'dod gsol rigs pas 'khrul shes par bya'o/ rten sgrub kyi gtor ma mi byed tshe mda' dar sku tsaka nang gzungs rnam pa dor na mchod gtor rgyas pa'i lugs su 'gyur ro/ rten gtor rgyas par 'jug tshe gong gi rten gtor de nyid mañji'i khar bzhag la/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor gru gsum che ba gcig la chung ba drug gi bskor zhing gtso 'khor rnams kyi mtshams su theb kyu gang mang bskor ba dang*/ mthun gtor gru gsum theb kyus bskor ba rnams la lug gro dmar gyi sha snying daram pos legs par brgyan pa bshams/ 'byor na gzhung ltar gser phor dang*/ ma 'byor tshe dngul khor dpar yos sogs kyi snod du chang phud bzang por gser gyi sbrags pa'i gser skyoms/ g.yus sbrag pa'i g.yu skyoms/ dbug dang ma bral ba'i sems can gson khrag la/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i snying khrag dang*/ chang phud kyi sbran pa'i khrag skyoms/ gzhan yang rgya ja sogs skyoms kyi bya brag ci 'byor dang*/ gtor ma'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka rdzas ldan/ dbang lnga'i me tog /lug gro dmar dang

(20) ba mtha' la'ang gang rung mi gtsang bas ma gos pa tshigs pa bdun nam gsum pa gang yig mgo mjug ma ldog pa'i mtshan ma can gyi skod par gshor brus pa'i ji ltar 'tsham pa khong stong 'tshol bsgrims rgyu yod pa bya/ der 'jug rgyu'i srog 'khor ni/ nga dar dmar ur ma/ 'bring rgya shog dmar po/ mtha' ma'ang shog bu bzang po ci bde bar sngon nas ji 'tsham pa gras te slar mtshon cha gtad mi gdos par tsan dan dmar po'i chos shor ba'i gzhi 'jam mnyon dang ldan pa la/ mtshal lam/ rgya skyog gang rung la skyes pa dar ma grir shi ba'i khra dang dug sna sbyar ba/ bsgrub pa po kha dkris spang kheb sems gtsang sbra dang ldan pa kun spyod bag yod bas bri bar byas ste/ spu gri snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ ras sam gro ga shog bu la: mtshal dang rgya skyaug dug khrag gis/ 'khor lo rim gsum rtsibs brgyad bri/ lte bar 'bra lnga go char ldan: rtsibs la gtum po'i yi ge brgyad: tha ma sku gsum go cha dang: dam tshig gnad kyi snying po bri/ seng ldeng phur par rnye mgrin sngags/ dar dpar dril la lus la bcangs: zhes gsungs pa ltar rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dang bsdun nas bris tshul ji ltar 'dzi pa'i 'khor lo mu 'khyud rim pa gsum bskor ba'i lte bar 'bru lnga'i go cha ni/ dbus su triḥ tri'i g.yas g.yon du hūṃ re/ tri'i 'og tu phaṭ+wadza bcas rgya bod gang rung gi yi ge dang*/ mu 'khyud dang por tri'i stong thad nas mgo bzang ba'i badz+ra gu ru'i mthar/ gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rgyal bdang pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal/ rje btsun gnam lcags me 'bar sogs rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bca' ma g.yel bar rten 'di la gnyis su med par bzhugs nas zhi rgyal dbang rga gi 'phrin las sogs 'dod gsol ji ltar 'dod pa yig mgo phyir bstan du yig mjug yig mgo dang kha sprod dam 'dod gsol mang na yig mjug rdzogs pa bya/

mu 'khyud gnyis par rtsibs brgyad bkod pa'i rgyab kyi rtsibs nas mgo bzung g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin/ oṃ pad+ma/ tsan dan ma hā/ kro dha/ aya/ ghṛ wa/ hu lu*/ hu lu/ hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ rnams bris/ mu 'khyud gsum par oṃ thad nas yig mgo dan bstan gyi/ oṃ kā ya badz+ra tsa ra thang: waka badz+ra tsa ra thang: tsit+ta badz+ra tsa ra thang: sa ma ya rak+sha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ oṃ rak+sha rak+sha snying la hūṃ hūṃ/ shu la ghṛ wa tri shu la hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ gdon sbyin chen po rel pa skya bdun 'khor dang bcas pa n+mas rten 'di la brten par bzhugs nas bdag bsgrub pa po'i lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs la 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs sogs 'dod gsol rgyal pa rigs pas dpyad de bri tshul gong gi mu 'khyud dang mtshungs/ rgyud nas 'di las (21) ma gsungs pa'i 'di ltar ti phyag bzhes su sku lnga'i srog 'khor dang rigs 'gros kyi slar yang gong gi de phyir mu 'khyud gsum bsnan pa'i dang por dbyangs gsal rten snying mjug gnod sbyin dgra lha'i rgyal po kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa parten 'di la brtan par bzhugs sogs 'dod gsol gang rgyas yig mgo phyir bstan dang de phyir mu 'khyud la rdo rje'i 'phring ba/ de phyir me ri g.yas bskor du yod pa bcas phyi ma mu 'khyud gsum so bsnanam yin gang mos su bya zhing*/ de dag chad lhag bris 'asrub yig spung sdeb nor yi ge 'brel ba sogs med pa sprul dag blo bde ba bri/ chu tshon gtsang ma'i lte ba dmar po/ mu 'khyud ljang*/ rtsibs sngo/ rtsibs mtshan ser po/ mu 'khyud sngon so dang*/ de phyir mu 'khyud gsam bsnan pa yin na dbyangs gsal mu 'khyud dmar ser/ rdo ra ser po/ gzhi ma sngon po/ me ri dpar po bcas bsgyur/ yi ge rnams la dri bzang dang chos smon byug rdo ba wang long bu che chub 'tsham par mtshal gyi ngos re la tri re dang*/

ngos gcig la tri gnyis te khyon tri khyon tri bdun bris pa dang*/ seng lding gi phun pa sor bzhi pa 'chang bzung gong 'og rgya mdud dpal dang ldan par/ 'chang bzang la 'bru gsum dang*/ dbal la 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi sngags bris pa/ pha wang log bu dang phun pa'i sngags rnams brtan pa'i phyir bsra brtsi sogs kyi mnan cing*/ sbyangs khrus rab gnas sngon du 'gro ba'i pha wang long bu ring bsril byin rten khyad par can dang mnyam du dar dmar gyi khud du bsgril ba 'khor le'i lte ba'i dri'i steng du bzhag la lte ba ma chag par lteb nas/ seng ldong phur par dkris la dar dmar gyi dril nas sba lcags shor gyi nang*/ chos sman dri bzangs phur ma dang bcas te bcug cing bachol bsgrigs nas mi mngon par bya zhing mgo bor zangs kyi a long la dar mtshon sna lnga'i lcags 'bris btags/ sbyangs khrus sngon 'gro ba'i mchod gtor bzang po dang bcas gsol kha gzhung bsrang ba'i gnod sbyin chain po bskyed bstim yang yang byas la dben par bzhugs su gsol/ gsol mchod ma chad par bya zhing ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyi mchod/ dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i mis ma mthong bar bya zhing*/ gar 'gror bcang na ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub/ des ni dam can khyi ltar 'bring ba'i man ngag go /gsum sa gsang ba bla dho la brten pa ni/ gter gzhung nyid las rang gi sgrub khang gi nub phyogs su: btsan gnas pa'i sa nas blangs pa'i sa dmar po dang: chu mi kha lhor blta ba'i mdog dpadaram po'i chus 'jim pa sbrus te: rin chen sna lnga'i phyi ma dang spos dri zhi'i pos gdab cing : shug pa'i skyor pa'i srog shing la brten pa'i btsan mkhar mda' gang rtse la ru matsan dmar po dang bcas pa'i srog shing la gsang rgyud ltar gyi bla rdo sngags 'khor dar dmar ram: gri khrag dang mtshal (22) dang tsan dan dmar po'i chus sbyor bas bris: rdo pha wang log lu dang gser pa phyug gi thig po dang :

g.yu mi med rnams la mtshal gyi tri bdun bris pa dar sna lngas dril ba sba: de la dam can dgug bzhigs mchod bstod byas te/ srog snying mang du bzlas zhing rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas te grub na khyi phru ba la chags pa ltar pho brang dang gtsug lag khang dang yul phyogs skyong bar byed do: zhes gsungs pas/ rang btsan yul zangs thang dmar po dngos kyi pa'i ma byar tshe bsam yas dpe har lcog gsar rnyeng*/ rtsi dpar mang sogs gno+ed sbyin 'di nyid gnas nges pa'i sa dmar po dang*/ gnas chen gyi sa sna sogs la rin chen sna lnga'i dh+ra phye/ bzang drug snam spos dri zhim por/ dam rdzas khyad 'phags bachasares par/ chu mig kha lhor blta ba mdog dmar ba'i sbrus te btsan mkhar da' gang sa mthong rgyun ltar bcos la/ mtshal dang tsag dmar*/ gri khrag sbyar ba'i kha dog dmar por bsgyur cing bsra rtsis bsnan/ gang bzung ni/ srog shing shug pa'i skyor pa gang rigs rtsa rtse ma nor bar gru bzhi'i rnam pe mo rim gyi phra bar/ gri khrag mtshal dang tsan dan dmar po'i chus sbyor ba'i/ badz+ra gu ru/ rta mgrin sngags/ oṃ kā ya sogs dang oṃ dak+sha rak+sha sogs gong ltar 'dod bcas bris par dri bzang dang chos sman byug /gong du sba lcags skabs bshad pa bzhin srog 'khor lta bar dho pha wang long ba mtshal gyi tri bdun bris pa dar da du bsgril ba lte ba ma chag lter cing ldeng srog phuno gang bshad bzhinal dkris pa dang lhan du/ gser pa phyung ma'i thig po dang*/ g.yu mig med gtsang mar mtshal gyi tri bdun bris pa rnams dar tshon sna lnga'i bsgril la srog shing rked par dar sna lngas legs par bsdams la gtso gyur gyi/ spro na bstod char chos sku'i ring bsrol bla gzungang rgyud sde'i gzungs dang sku bal ring bsrel logs byin rten/ smad char gnod sbyin bang mdzod sogs gzungs 'bul spyi ltar byas chog cing ma grub kyang chad skyon mi 'byung*/

gang byed kyang nang khongs bar mtshams dang seng bsrub med pa bstod char gnas chen rnams nas byung ba'i shing sna sman spos smad char rin chen 'bru dar shing dar shing 'bras sogs gang 'byor gyi legs par bkang*/ zhabs bka' bsra 'khrigs kyi slar srog chags mi zhugangs pa'i lag tshag dam par bya/ mkhar gyi rtse mor dar dmar gyi ru mtshon gyi ru mtshon gri lcags kyi so can che ba gcig dang chung ba drug brngam brjid dang ldan par bkod la sgrub khang gi nub phyogs sam sa yul dang bsdun par slar bsgul bskyed mi dgos ba bzhugs su gsol sbyangs khrus sngon du 'gro bas de nyid gnod sbyin chen po gatsho 'khor du bskyed la gsol kha gzhung srang gi mthar srog sngags brgya sto ci 'grub bzlas rjes mchod cing bstod pa dang bcas gnod sbyin chen po 'od du zhu nas bsdim zhing rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad kyi me tog 'thor la brten bzhugs (23) bya'o/ des ni dam can phru ltar chags pa'i man ngag go /bzhi sa yang gsang mdung zhags dmar po la brten pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ brag dmar po la skyes pa'i snyug ma'i: thang shing ngam: spa lngags 'dom gang pa gcig la gri lcags kyi mde'i dang mdzug mde bcas la: zangs ma'i gzer gyi bsdams: de gri khrag dang mtshal gyi daram por byas la bsra rtsi bzang pos gdab: de'i nang du srog sngags rgyud las byung ba gri khrag mtshal gyis bras: bdag la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo chi la phog cig /sa ma ya: zhes pa dang mdung gi stong du rta mgrin sngags dang : mdung mad du 'bod sbad bsad gsum dang : mdung lcags kyi nang du dho pha wang gi logs la tri bras pa'i bla dho 'khor los gril mi spags kyi bsdums la: dar dmar po'i ba dan la srog 'khor bris te: de'i stong du rta mgrin gyi sku dang : 'og tu dam can gyi sku sdo brgyad kyi bskor ba la:

mnga' gsol grub pa thob pa'am: dpal rta mgrin la bsnyin pa bye ba them pa gcig sbyas: de dang dpa' bo g.yul du shi ba'i skra las byas pa'i zhags pa khrag dang mtshal gyi phyugs pa la/ rang gnas lhan cig tu byas te: bskal gso la 'bad cing gar 'dug gi sar khyer na: g.yul thams cad las rnam par rgyas bar 'gyur zhing*/ pha rol gyi sde pham par byed do: zhes gsungs pa'i gong gi sba lcags kyi gnas dang mthun par skye ba'i snyig ma'am/ sba lcags sam/ lag len du thang shing byed pa shos che ba'i 'dom gang pa ca rtse ma nor bar gri lcags las grub pa'i mdung po spro na rtser me ris mtshan pa mdung rting dang bcas gnyis ka'i sbubs su gzungs shong ba/ mdung gi stong dang skod par gshor brus pa'i khong stong 'chol bsgrigs rgyu yod pa bya zhing*/ mdung gi so sting bsdai byed zangs ma'i gzor sogs nyer rdog dang*/ mdung shing dongs mtshal gri khrag bsros pa'i dmar po bsgyur te bsra rtsi bzang pos bsnan/ mdung stod char badz+ra gu ru/ dbang chen mkhra'i sngags bcas rtsa gsum srog sngags mthar 'dod gsol gang dgos bris par dri bzang chos smon gyi byug pa'i shog dril dang*/ mdung gi skod badz+ra gu ru'i gshadam du oṃ kā sogs sko go cha dang*/ oṃ rak+sha rak+sha sogs gtso 'khor srog sngags mthar 'dod gsol bcas rdzas gong bzhin phyug shi shog dril dang*/ mdung gi rting lcags sbubs su rta mgrin sngags dang*/ oṃ rak+sha rak+sha sogs sbrel ba'i mdzug tu/ mu sha mu sha dzaḥ tsirta tsirta sod/ lcob ti thibs sod/ snying khrag dun dun/ btsan dzad la ya srog sha la ya/ sha tram srog la ya/ sha tram dbugs la ya/ myur dril bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ ya tri ya tri thum thum rbad tsa tri tsa tri rbad rtsa la yaṃ tsa la yaṃ rbad /dza la ya dza la ya rbad/ yi yaṃ raṃ raṃ laṃ laṃ khaṃ khaṃ/ yi yaṃ raṃ raṃ laṃ laṃ khaṃ khaṃ/ tri ya tri sha la dza ya (24) snying la thun bh+yo bh+yoḥ

laṃ laṃ srog rtsa rtsa la khrag thibs/ khaṃ kham snying rtsa la thug rim/ ri ri sha la rbad/ yi yi nri srog bring mā ra ya rbad/ oṃ kā ya badz+ra tsa ra thang*/ tsirti badz+ra tsa ra thang*/ sa mā ya rak+sha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gnod sbyin chen po sogs 'dod gsol sbyar ba rdzas gong ba rjas gong bzhin phyug pa'i shog dril bcas de dag rnams dbu nas dril zhing po sor dar dmar gyi tshal bya/ mdung so'i lcags sbub su sngar bshad pa'i srog 'khor mi spags kyi dril babacas gong gsal khag bzhi gnas so sor mgo zhabs ma 'dzom ba dri bzang sman spong kyi phur dang bcas bcug cing*/ 'chol mi mngon par bsgrigs/ mdung gi so rting zangs ser gyi legs par bsdim la slar 'gyur sdog mi 'gro ba'i lag tsham dam par bya/ de la dar gos dmar sos pa dan bzang por dkyil du gser gyi srog 'khor sngar bzhin bris pa'i stod char rta mgrin gyin sku dang*/ gshing gnon sbyin chen po'i sku sde brgyad kyi bskor ba chu mtshon gyi mdzes pa btags/ sbod thugs dmar po sogs kyi brjod par bya zhing*/ dpal bo ga'ul du bsad pa'i skra las byas pa'i zhags pa mtshal dang khrag gi phyugs pa lcags kyu a long dang ldan pa mdung gi mgul thug gi 'og tu btags/ de la sbyangs khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i btsan mkhar skabs bshad pa ltar rab gnas yid chos par bgyis te bskong gso la 'bad cing rang nyid gar 'gro'i par 'khyer na phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ de na dgri bgegs cham la 'bebs pa'i thabs so/ de lta bu'i phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang bcas pa'i rten rnams bsgrub pa las sbyor sogs dang ma 'brel bar chos skyong 'di nyid 'go zhing 'phṛn las bsgrub pa'i phyir rang bzhin brten skabs/ rnam 'phyor pa rang gi sgrub kham/ mgon khang lta bur bcas shing gsol mchod la brtson na rnam bzhi'i 'phris las bde blag nyid du 'grub nges par gdon mi za zhing gzhan yang bris sku mtshan nyid tshang bar bskyed bsdim dang*/

spros pa'i yan lag tu mngon rtogs ltar sku bsob rngams brjid dang ldan thugs kar bla r+ho srog 'khor mtshan nyid tshang bcug cing bkyed bsdim nan tan byang zhing*/ nye logs su mthunardzas bskang rdzas 'di nyid kyi rgyud gzhung ltar ci 'grub bshim sa rin 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes su 'byung ba'i byas chos cing*/ de ltar rten rnams bcug nas gsol mchod ma chag pa gal che zhing*/ de lta bus bsgrub pa por bkra shis shing snying nye ba dang*/ bachub chubang zhi las bcol mtshan che ba 'phrin las bzhi gang sgrub kyang gdeng 'khol bslu med kho na nyid du 'gyur ro/ spru gri dmar po snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las btsan bdud rol pa skya bdun yang : rang las byung zhing sprul par snang : gnyis med don dam gcig rdzogs: rang gi sems su shes par bya: zhes gsungs pas: gnod sbyin chen po rang sems gdod ma'i mgon po nyid: (25) las logs su med par thag chod pa'i dad gdong dang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang*/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rgyud le'u drug pa nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams ma nyams par bsrung ba ni rten rdzas kyi gtso bo yin pas blang dor shes par byas dgos shing*/ yang de nyid las/ dam tshig ma bsrung byin brlabs brdung : lha bsten ma byas rang la bzlaug /ces gsungs so/ gzhan yang mda' bya rgod ma dang*/ bse ba'i gnam ru/ skyer pa'i nyag phran mthun rjas/ sking sogs ngan sngags cog brdung nag po'i rten rdzas rnams bsgrub pa las sbyor dus las rang bzhin rten 'dzug skabs ma dgos pa'i de dang de'i skabs su 'byung ngo*/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i yo byad bca' shoms dang*/ gsum pa bsgrub pa dngos gzhi bcas 'di nyid kyi rgyud sgrub gzhun rnams dang rig 'dzin chen po dharma ki rtis mdzad pa'i zin bris shin tu gsang ba las rtogs par byas dgos so/ de ltar lha bcan dgra lha'i rgyal po zhes/

mthu stobs drag rtsal thog dada' las gyur des/ phyi nang gsang rten bla dho srog 'khor sogs/ rgyud gzhung mnang ngag gab sbas zab mo rnams/ gsal bkod yi ge'i skya rengs kyis drangs nas/ lag len nyin mo'i snang ba 'di shar bas/ mi shes mun tshogs drung pa dang*/ bdun sde'i ba mo bcom pa cig car byas/ tshul 'dis snying po'i bstan pa yang zla ltar/ 'phel zhing de 'dzin skyes bu zhabs brtan nas/ 'gro kun bde skyid dpal spyod bsgrub pa pos/ rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thog med 'grub gyur cig /de ltar chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po'i rten rdzas bca' pa shākya'i dge sbyor bstan 'dzin 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi shing khams phun 'gro'i lor yal ga'i dwags can gyi zla bar 'bri rdzong bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims chu tshe dang dga' 'khyil du mgyogs par bris pa'i ge ge sa ni bskul ba po nyid kyi bgyis pa'o/ shu bhaṃ//

(ja) ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgo nas sgrib sbyongs ril gyi sbyin bsregs bzhugs so// ya la ri na mo/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhing gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas shin tu spros med sgrib sbyong tel gyi sbyin bsreg bya bar/ me 'khrol dang til mdun du bsags la/ oṃ kā la ru sa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa kyi bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun hūṃ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlul po rgyal khru gang*/ zab tu khru phyed pa mchu kha khyer dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ gshen rjes pho mo ma he chu glang parma nyi ma'i gdan la/= skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal gshen rje'i gshed sku mdog chu shel ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar*/ dbus sku dang mthun pa phyag rgyug g.yas gsum 'khor lo rang gri rdo rje g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtun shing sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chos brgyan pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ gi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa dang dbang gi (26) lha spyan drangs/ badz+ra puṣ+pa sogs kyi mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam ye dbyer med du gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur chu lhag ma mi bskyed pas dub rgyan par gyur par bsam/ hoṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+gham sogs kyi mchod/ hūṃ gtum cher bar 'bar gshin rje 'joms mdzad lha/ nyi ma 'bul las lhag pa'i gzi brjed 'bar/ gdug pa'i mtshor cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ rab brjed gshin rje gshod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces dang*/ rang tha mas pa'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yam gnas sa las rlung g.yos lte bar gtum po'i me sbar/ snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon yi ge pī nag so gnas pa la/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar gyi sdig sgrib nyams pa'i tshogs 'dul pa de nyid mes ded nas sna sgor thon sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par til la thim par gyur pas bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsil byin rlabs/

oṃ a kro to ka ya mānata ka sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru swā hāḥ zhes bdun nyer gcig brgya ma zin tsam 'bul/ mang na bdun ro'i mtshams dang*/ nyu na rdzogs matsams su/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung thams cad shan+ting ku ru swā hāḥ zhes pa'i 'dod gsol re sbyar/ oṃ ya māt+na ka ar+gham sogs sngar bzhin mchod/ mche ba gtsags shing sogs kyi bstod/ yig brgyas kha bkang*/ thab dang me lha mi dmigs par gyur/ badz+ra muṃḥ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di yang dge sbyong gu ṇa kā ra'i ngor 'bri ban 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// (27) (nya) ༄༅//ngal sos dge ba'i sgor mdor bsdus 'dod dgu char 'bebs bzhugs so// dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi sgor bsangs mdor bsdus bya ba ni/ bsangs rdzas kyi yo byad rnams 'du bar bya ste skyabs sems sngon du 'gro rjes rdzas rnams rtong par sbyangs la/ rang nyid gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs srog hūṃ yig las raṃ yaṃ kham gsum 'phros pas bsangs rdzas kyi nyes skyon rnams bsrogs gter bskrus/ slar yang oṃḥ hūṃ rnams 'phros pas 'dod yon zag med kun bzang dgos klong dang mnyam pa ngal sos dge ba 'gor bcas dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ha bh+yo sogs lan gsum/ oṃ sarba birgyā sogs lan gsum/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa kham/ hūṃ la bsos rgyas po 'khor bcas kun/ rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ dngos yid mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ mchod cing bstod nas phyag kyang 'tshal/ sarba pu dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ kyai de ring rma byung dus dge bar/ lha khyod (28) dgyes pa'i mchod sprin spro/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin shing gi mchog /lha shing shug pa la lu dang*/ tsan dan dpar dmar a ka ru/ phun mong du ru ka dang ni/

dpar dmar dar zab la sogs pa/ dz+wa la pak+ner bsrogs pa yi/ dung sprin 'dza' 'od 'khrugs pa las/ dung pa'i gsel nasi sprul pa ni/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med par/ gzugs sgra dri re regs byas sogs/ phyi nang gsang ba mchod pa'i tshogs// ma tshang med pa'i bsangs mchod 'di/ mi 'jig seng ge'i khri sdengs su/ gser gyi ri ltar 'gyis bag can/ dpal ldan nor mang kun gyi rje/ dang sos dge ba stobs chen bsangs/ btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi sogs// las byade mdung dmar bcas pa bsangs// 'brog gnas rta bdag brgyad la sogs// klu chen rgyal po 'khor bcas bsangs/ khyed kyi bka' nyan gsung bstod pa'i// gnod sbyin bye ba'i sde tshogs bsangs/ gzhan yang khyed 'khor btogs pa yi// thams cad ma lus bsangs kyi mchod// rnam mang thos sras 'khor bcas la// bsangs mchod mad pa 'di phul bas// grib dang mi gatshang la sogs pa/ sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba kun// thams cad byang zhing dag gyur nas// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ kyai phyi nang gsang ba rma byung gi/ mchod sprin 'dod yon gang mchis rnams// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis// sprul cing bsgyur ba'i phul ba yis// ngal bsol dge ba 'khor bcas kyi/ dub 'phags gnyan po dgung du bstod/ lha khyed mi dang ma 'bral zhig /mkha' dang nyi zla 'grogs pa bzhin// lha khyod mi dang ma 'bral=chu dang nya mo 'grogs pa bzhin// lha khyod mi dang ma= gsangs dang seng ge 'grogs pa bzhin/ lha khyod mi dang ma 'bral= rgya sdag nags dang 'grogs pa bzhin/ lha khyod mi dang ma 'bral= brag dang rgod po 'grogs pa bzhin/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i bcud rnams kun/ bdag gi g.yang du char bzhin phob/ rnam 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ yi la gang bsam 'dod dgu'i/ ma lus thogs med khyod kyi sgrub/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ bstan 'dzin sku tshe mdzad 'phrin sprol/ zhi rgyas dbang dang grag po yi/

gang byas las rnams ma lus kun/ lhun gyasi grub pa'i 'phris mdzod/ badz+ra muṃḥ bsangs mgron pa gshogs/ yi ge brgya bas lhag chad bso/ rjes bkra shis kyi (29) mtha' b.ragayan par bya'o/ zhes pa rnams thos sras kyi sgor bsangs mdor bsdus zhig zhes kong ban yon tan 'byung ldan gyi nan tan chen pos bskul ngor 'bri ban 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rang lo bcu gnyis par shing khams phyi ba'i lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dpar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum par res gza' bcu gnyis 'od 'phro rgyu skra rgyal dang dga' mar brtson pa'i skyabs pho brang bkra shis tshugs su bgyis pa'o// (30) (ta) ༄༅// bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas shin tu spros med las bzhi'i sbyin bsregs 'phrin las 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma 'jal dpal rdo rje nyid/ ma rungs dpung la cher khros pa/ khro rgyal dus dgra'i dbang po la// 'du do bka' yi gnang ba rtsol// 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas shin tu spros med las bzhi sbyin bsreg bya bar 'dod na/ ri khrod mtshams khang ltur thab nang me la yang rung zhing*/ min kyang rang gi mdun du me 'khrel dang*/ khyad par drag po la drag shing gi med hom 'byor na rang med kyang gong ltar rbayas pas 'grub cing*/ rdzas ni zhi ba la rgya bod gang rung gi til/ rgyas pa la 'bru zas rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma dar ras sogs kyi dum bu dang*/ dbang la me thog dmar po rnyed na rab ma 'byor tshe 'bru la tshon gyi khya bsgyur zhing*/ chang klum dang 'bri mog sin+dhu ra rgya skog shing thog dmar po sogs gang 'dzom gyi phya ma dang*/ drag po la yungs dpar gtsang ma bcas las mthun gyi snod dam gang 'grub du bsags la/ o kā la ru pa ya ma rā hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung pa'i zhi ba la/ zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dpar po rgyar khru gang*/

zab tu khru khyed pa mur ran khyer dang bcas la mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dubs su rgyas pa la/ rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser po rgyan khru do zab tu gang pa mu ran khyor dang bcas pa mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus so/ dbang la/ dbang gi thab nga zla gim dpar po rgyar khru gang pa zabs su de'i phyed dang ldan pa mu ran kha khyor dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dubs su/ drag po la/ drag po'i thab khung gru gsum nag po rgyar por mo nyi shu zabs su de'i phyade pa mun ran kha khyer dang bcas pa mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dubs su/ mthun long*/ gshen rje pho mo ma he chu glang pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'dzam dpal gshin rje gshod zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ zhes ba la/ sku mdog dang rtsu zhal dkar la zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams su ldan/ zhas yangs sngo/ g.yan dmar/ rgyas pa la/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ser po tshig zhingar rangs pa'i nyams can zhal g.yos dkar/ g.yon dpar ba/ dbang la/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar po rtse zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon sngo/ drag po la/ sku mdong dang rtsuzhal mthing nags brngams zhi 'jigs pa'i nyams can/ gsas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ thun mong*/ phyag drag g.yas gsum 'khor lo rang gri rdo rje/ g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtunashing sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chos brgyad kyi brgyan cing gar gus ye shes kyi me klong la 'gying ba dam ye gnyis su med pa'i kur gsal bar gyur zhes gsal btab la/ zhes ba la/ rang tha mal pa'i rkang pa'i 'og yam gnas sa las rlung g.yos/ lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar/ snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon yi ge pām gan po gnas pa la/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar gyi sdig sgrib dab tshig nyams chag nyes ltung gi tshogs 'dul ba/ de nyid mes ded nas sna sgor mthon sdig pa dwa can gyi rnam par til ma lim/ zhal du phul bas dgyes bzhin gsol bas sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar gyur bas bsam/

oṃ ha kro te ka la man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ parba pā pam ha na shin+taṃ ku ru swā hāḥ /zhes pa'i bdun nam nyer gcig brgya man phul la/ bdun re'i mtshams su/ bdag gi tshe rabs thog thog med nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nad gdon dam tshigs nyams chag nyes ltung thams cad shan+tiṃ kar ru swā hāḥ zhes pa'i dod gsol ri sbyar/ rgyas pa la/ bsrog rdzas 'bru gsum dang a kā rol byin gyis rlobs la/ bsrogs rdzas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud (31) dang ldan pa zhal du phul bas mnyes te mi zad rin chen nor gyi char dbab cing*/ tshe bsod dpal thams cad dbyar mtsho dang yar zla bzhin rgyas par gyur pas bsams la/ a kro bcu gcig mthar dz+wa la raṃ raṃ rat+na sid+dhi hūṃ/ btags pa brgya tsa man ci 'grub 'brul/ bdun re'i mtshims 'dod gsol ni/ bdag gangi tshe dang bson nams dpal 'byor mnga'ar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med ma pa 'phris 'khor 'das snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus nas bdag la 'dud par gyur par bsam/ a kro bcu gcig mthar lo ka sarba shi ku ru hriḥ/ sbyar ba rgya man ci 'grub dang*/ bdun re'i mtshams 'dod gsol ni/ bdag gi dbang du khams gsum srid gsum lha drug ldan dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ theg pa rim dgu rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i yi dam rgyas ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang khyad par du bcol ldan 'das dpal 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus sa med pa rnams dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma sogs chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po gang dag ji snyed phod pa thams cad skad cig nyed la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig badz+ra ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ

zhes gsum bdan dgu sogs gal skabs dang bsdun sa bya/ yungs 'bru re re bzhin phul la/ bsrog rdzas spungs 'bru dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba zhal du ba zhal du phul bas dgyes pa'i rkan sgra dang bcas gsol bas rkang mthil skye lhag ge song lus gang thal ba'i rdul du brlag cing sems nyid chos skur thim par gyur par bsam/ a kro bcu gcig mthar/ gnon byed dgra bgegs dz+wa la rim mā rim mā ra ya phaṭaḥ zhes sbyar ba rgya man ji ltar 'os sa bya/ bdun re'i mtshams 'dod gsol ni bdag cag la gdon cing 'tshe ba'i dgra 'gegs 'byung po dam srid byangad phur smod gtor la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ zhes pa sbyar/ las thun mong la/ oṃ mañju shrī ya man+ta ka ar+ghaṃ sra tīts+tsha swā hāḥshap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing sogs sh+lo kos bstod/ lhag pa'i lha mchog nas ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro bar gyis 'dod don gsol/ yig brgyas kha bskang*/ me lha 'o dung zhu nas thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim (32) de yang rang nyid ma thim pas dbag gzhan lhar gdod nas dbyer med cing dmigs bsam kun bral bde ba chen po'i ngang du bzhag go/ ces bsdu/ 'di ltar rnam par bgom bzlas sogs bang smon shing brjod kyi rgyas btab/ de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed tu spros med las bzhi'i sabayor bsgreg 'di yang snga sor dge slong gu ṇa'i ngor sgrib sbyong til sagyi sbyin bsreg zhig bris pa'i rkyen gyis mi 'gyur bde chen gling gi mtshams gras pa thang dgon dge slong dkon mchog mthar phyin gyi bskur ngor 'bri gung pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'i ge ge gnyis par spol ba po gam bcar rat+na dā na'o// (33) (tha) ༄༅// tshogs chen 'dus pa'i rgyun 'khyir mdar bsdus 'og mig bgrod pa'i thim skal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ shan+ta kro dha de wa na maḥ

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dpal grol byed thugs rje'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ rnam pa gcig las sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i sku dgrangs yas zhi khro'i 'gor lo yongs shar ba/ tshogs chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams la/ 'dud do khrag 'thung dpal bos dngos grub rtsol/ 'dir lam 'di la mos pa can rnams kyi rgyun khyer nyams su len bde ba'i mdo mthun mong pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams a nu rang lugs lus dkyil du 'god pa'i lung chung zhi thung khro thung la brten nas 'dri ba la/ sngo 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la bson kyi khyad par dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la lus dubal sogs lhagapa'i bdun rnams dag gi don dran pas/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ dngos byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i mtshod pa bzhes (34) su gsol/ dngos grub chung bo gcod pa'i gegasanyes byas ma lu bshags par bgyi/ sbyogs bcu 'khyor gsum dag pa'i chos/ ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ dag pa'i mthar bzhi dri ma med/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs byang chub sems dpal la/ dag pa gsum gyi las 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ lan gsum dang chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa'i rang rtsal las/ badz+ra ma hāṃ shrī he ru ka/ rang nyid zhes sdang rdo rje sku mdong mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i shings kyi hū ring dang byang chub kyi sems sbrin las khro'i tshogs me mtshan dang bcas pa spros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ tshul 'dus te bsrung ba'i 'gor los bcings par gyur/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bla ma rig 'dzin zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa mkha' khyab tu sad pas mos la spyan sngar bshags sdom gyi bsam pa drag pos/

yig brgya ci nus dang*/ spro na ye shes sku mchog bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi zhi lung khro lung gnyis las dang po/ dbyings ye ji bzhin pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ye shes rang bzhin lhun gyi grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis dbyer med pa'i sras bde ba chen po rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor las sngags kyi sgra gdangs kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du sad par gyur pa ni/ bh+ruṃ bi shwa bi d+dhe dz+nya na tsakra/ nam mkha' thams cad yum lngī mkha' klong 'byung lnga'i dkyil 'khor brten pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi rta babs brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad nyi zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsirta oṃ/ a a a badz+ri bha dra sa mān+ta aḥ gdan gyi stong du bdag nyid dpal kul tu bzang po sku mdog mthing ga zhi zhing 'dzum pa mtshan dpares brgyad pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can rdo rje skyil klung gis bzhugs pa'i dpang du yul kun bzang sngon mo phyag gnyis yab la 'khyud cing pad+ma'i kyil krung gis 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi gos lnga dang rat+na'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras te 'od zare bya ba drug phrag 'phro ba'i klong na bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'o/ rang gzhi lus kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kur 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar hūṃ dang mūṃ las mi bskyed pa yab yum sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu/ rtsibs shar du oṃ dang lāṃ las rnam snang yab yum dkar po 'khor lo dang dril

(35) bu lhor swī dang māṃ las rin 'byung yab yum ser po rin po che dang dril bu/ nub tu ī dang sāṃ las snang mtha' yab yum dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu/ byang du hā dang tī las don sgrub yab yum ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ g.yas phyagag dbang po'i rtsa bzhi la/ k+shiṃ hūṃ mig la sa snying dang sgog mo/ jiṃ hriḥ rna bar phyag dhor dang glu ma/ traṃ traṃḥsna la ni snying dang 'phring ma/ hriṃ āṃ lce la spyan ras gzigs dang gar ma/ g.yon phyags dbang po la/ mai dzaḥ mig la byamasapa dang spos ma/ thilhiṃ hūṃ rna bar sgrib sel dang me tog ma/ hūṃ baṃ sna la kun bzang dang mar me ma/ muṃ hoḥ lce la 'dzam dpal dang dri chab ma/ snying kha'i 'khor lo'i mdun rgyab tu/ hūṃ a byed pa po dang bya ba mo/ dpral bar krīṃ las/ lha yi thub pa/ lce steng hūṃ truṃ lha min/ snying khar sruṃ las mi/ lte bar braṃ las byol song*/ gsang bar k+shaṃ las yi dwags/ rkang mthil ye las dmyal ba'i thub pa rnams dang*/ lag g.yas su hūṃ dza las gshin rje dang lcags kyu ma/ lag g.yonapar hūṃ hūṃ las stobs chen dang zhags thog ma/ rkang g.yon hūṃ bai las rta mgrin dang lcags sgrogs ma/ rkang g.yas hūṃ hoḥlas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang dril bu ma rnams su gyur/ na mo hūṃ de ltar dkyil 'khor lo thams cad dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ dbang bskur ni/ rigs lnga'i rgya spyi bo'i gnas lngar bzhag cing*/ oṃ ma tā shub n+ya badz+ra swa bhā ba arma konya ni/ a r+sha sra t+ya bek+sha ṇa/ zhes brjod pas/ spyi bor rigs lnga yab yum rjes chags kyi zhu ba'i chu rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas rigs lngas bdu brgyan par gyur/ byin rlabs ni/ rdo rje'i rgya gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ oṃ parba thā ga ta ma hā ka ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma konya taṃ wakra/ tsit+ta gnas gsum du zla ba/ pad+ma nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūṃ/

'od zare 'bro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang*/ 'do dbag med mi bskyed pas rgyas btab par gyur/ bde gshegs bzhugs shing rnam grol dgyes pa bskyed/ e h+ye hi a na ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ o: zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brten par byas te/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang dbyer med du bzhugs par gyur/ de nas dbyings las ye shes sam lha rol ba'i tshul gyis phyag mchod byas par mos la/ o sarba ta thā ga ta sa twa bhan+dha nāṃ ka ro mi/ a ti pu hoḥ pra titsh+tsha hoḥ phyag dang oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs dang*/ oṃ (36) ā ha ra ā hā ra sarba bad+yī dha ra pu dzi ti na maḥs mān+ta bud+dha na ma ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swa hāḥ oṃ shri badz+ra rā ga dhu pe dhu/ puṣ+pe pu/ o le ke hrīḥ gan+dhe gan/ zhes kun bzang zhabs gsal bzhi bsnol dang/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dngos grub blang*/ ma hā ba ling ta pra tīts+tsha khā hi/ sman gtor dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma konyahaṃḥ sbyor mchod dang bo dhi tsit+ta s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ bsgral mchod dang*/ ma hā pu dza hā+oḥ 'dod yon bcas phul la/ na mo hūṃ/ dbyings kun rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ thugs rje'i dbang gis skur bzhengs pa*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs dag /rang snang lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ smon lam dang 'dod gsol ni/ hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rigs lnga rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang bcas pa thams cad gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnal 'byor gyi mchod pa dam pa rigs pa'i khyed par las byung ba phyi nas gsang ga gsum gyi tshul du phul bas sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gnyes pa chen pos khyab par gyur cig /de'i byin rlabs kyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi gral thob par gyur cig

/bdag cag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad skongs te dongs grub kyi snod du gyar nas yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sar sangs rgyas te 'khor ba kar dag par gyur cig /a la lahoḥ zhes dang bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ bcad gtubs sdug bsngal lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur yangs/ grib ma phogs pa'i sdug bsngal shing tu mi bzod pa'i/ sku yi phyogs tsam mthong ba'i mod la 'tsho ba dang*/ gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa'i nyi ma stong phrag gi/ 'dod bzhin 'jig rten khams 'dir rtag tu 'byung ba dang*/ lus ngag sems la tshe 'dir rdo rje rab snang ste/ re smon thams cad dus 'di nyid du rtsal du gsol/ no ma hūṃ de nas dzapā bzla ba ni/ gzhi lus kyi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar bla ba la oṃ yig sngon po bzla bya'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ so so'i sku las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba rnams mchod sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te rang bzhin lha sngags 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo gnas pa mngon du byas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med du gyur/ 'od zare de rnams slar 'dus rang la thim khams gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor dus sad par mos la/ lus kyi bsgul bskyed ci byas dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ ngag gi bzlas brjod chos nyid kyi sgra gdangs/ sems kyi na rten dbyings gis dbyer med rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems su rtogs par (37) byas te/ oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na bo dho tsit+ta ma hā su kha hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes spyi 'dzab kho na bzla zhing*/ spro na sgrub thams rgyas pa ltar zhi ba'i bskyed sngags rnams kyang ci nus bzlas mthar/ hūṃ rgyu 'bras 'artsol ba'i sdug bsngal tsir snang yang*/ bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi 'dzab bsnyen byas pa'i mthus/
