thams cad kun tu bzang po'i don rtogs nas/ dongs grub rnag gsum lhug gyi grub par shog na mo hūṃ/ gnyis pa la/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems rang byung gi ye shes ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su gsal ba las/ sngags kyi sgra gdangs kyi rten pa'i dkyil 'khor du pad par gyur pa ni/ e yaṃ ra suṃ kiṃ raṃ/ bh+ruṃ bi shwa b-i shu d+dhe bhañja na tsakra/ pūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la de wa teṣ+ṭha naṃ ti ra baṃ/ rang gi sems dbugs khrag sha rus drod rnams ye shes kyi rtsal snang dur khrod rdzas kyi ngo bo yum lnga'i mkhas klong 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la brten pa'i dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rdo rje brag chen pad nyi zla ba brtsegs pa'i stong du dbang phyug byol song gi gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ a kra ma hā bh+rī ru ka hūṃ/ ka ta ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ gdan gyi sting du bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka sku mdog mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum thod khrag zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyis rol ba/ yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug sngon mo g.yas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon thod khrag stob pa/ gnyis ka gar gyi nyams dgu dang dur khrod rol ba'i brgyad cing*/ ye shes me'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan khri nas dbu'i gtsug tor man chad la rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa/ tsit+ta'i rtsa dgu'i bcud he ru ka dang*/ rtse dgu kro dhi dgur gsal ba ni 'khor lo'i lte bar hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje khrag 'thung yab yum/ shar ltar hūṃ hūṃ las sangs rgyas khrag 'thung yab yum/ lhol nub tu hūṃ hūṃ las pa nu he ru ka yab yum/

nabyang du hūṃ hūṃ las gu ya he ru ka yab yum/ byang shar du hūṃ hūṃ las yak+sha he ru ka yab yum/ thams cad khro bo'i gar dug dang ra khrod chas kyi brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyi dregs pa khyo shugs dang*/ rigs lnga'i khra 'thung gi byol song gdugs pa zung re brjes pa'o/ dbang rten gyi rtsa zung bzhi'i rtsa nang du gnas ma brgyad ni/ mig gnyis (38) su ha ha las g.yas g.yon du kau rī dang suk+ka pī/ rna ba g.yas g.yon du ha ha be ti li dang gha sma rī/ snang g.yas g.yon du ha ha tsau ri dang sma sha/ rtse'i g.yas g.yon du ha ha sra mo hā tsanadan lī/ dbang rten rtsī phyi rol tu yul ma brgyad ni/ mig g.yas du he he las seng gdong dang rgod gdong ma/ rna ba g.yas g.yon du he he wa gdong kaṅka'i gdong ma/ sna g.yas g.yon du he he stag stong dang khā gdong ma lce'i g.yas g.yon du he he khyi gdong 'ug gdong ma/ yan lang mthil bzhir sgo ma bzhi ni/ lag g.yas g.yon du phaṭa phaṭa rte gdong dang phag gdong ma/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon du phaṭa phaṭa sprol gdong ma/ lungs kyi phyogs mtshams su 'bar ma brgyad ni/ snying gar a nyi zer can ma/ g.yas kyi nu ma a me khyer klog 'phring ma/ phrag par a skra mda' 'phen/ sogs par a srin mo ral gri can/ sog phrag tu a klu mo lce 'bebs ma/ g.yon phyogs sog par a gnod sbyin khyung thog ma/ phrag par a ba lang sna/ nu mar a mig 'byin snying bsrogs ma/ sog 'og g.yas g.yon rtsibs ma dang po gnyis gnyis ri bzhi la g.yang ba'i yum ni/ dzaḥgayas kyi dang por g.yas 'debs ma hūṃ g.yon dang por tshe 'phel ma/ baṃ g.yon 'og mar dbang bsdung ma/ hoḥgayas 'og mar rmongs byed ma dang*/ rgal tshig nyer brgyad la bhoḥ re las dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa gsal ba'o/ na mo hūṃ/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su bkra lam gyi gsal bar gyur/

dbang bskur byin rlabs zhi ba ltar dang*/ badz+ra pa mā dzaḥ rung lu ru lu hūṃ zhes snyan gsan dbabs/ oṃ thugs rje'i lcags kyus sogs shaulpaka'i mthar/ e h+ye ti bhā he ru ka ha ra li dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ zhes drangs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bstim/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brten bzhugs rjes/ dam tshig gi 'khor la nas bstod pa'i mgo bar zhi ba ltar la/ khyad par gtor sngags mjung tu ma hā rak+ta sra tīts+tsha khā ti rak+ta 'bul sngags sbyor/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃbadag med phyogs bral don dam thugs chud cing*/ byangs dang snying rjes dgra zin ma mnga' yang*/ gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ 'jigs phyid khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ smon lam 'dod gsol ni/ hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid che mchog ho ru ka sogs khro mo bsam gyi mi khyab pa thams cad gsan cing dgongs su gsol bdag can rnal 'byor gyi mchod pa dam pa zhes pa nas na mo hū bar dang*/ 'dzab dmigs kyang*/ gzhi lus kyi ye shes segs dpa'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ yig sngon por bzla bya'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las (39) zhes bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs zhi ba dang 'dra/ bzla bya'i sngags gong ltar spyi 'dzab kho nas 'grub kyang*/ spro na sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i bskyid sngags rnams ci 'grub byung ni legs/ mthar hūṃ rgyu 'bras nas/ na mo hūṃ bar dang*/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la zhi khro gang byed kyang thun mong du/ nyer bsdu ni/ hūṃ zhes brjed pas rang gi snying gi 'od kyis phog pas dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang la thim/ de gzhi lus kyi lha yab yum la thim/ yum yab la/ yab kyi lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyang gnas de nyid du 'od du zhu nas gzhi lus kyi lha dang bcas pa ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting 'dzin sems dpa' thugs srog gi yi ge la/

de yang nā da'i bar du rim gyi bsdus nas mi dmigs par gyur pa la mnyam gzhag bya/ de'i ngang las chu las nya ldang ba ltar rang nyid zhi ba la kun tu bzang po dang*/ khro bor he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur langs la/ go bgo lus bsrung ni/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par hā/ snying gar hūṃ rnams kyis mtshan par bsams la/ badz+ra ka wa tsi rak+sha haṃ zhes lus rdo rje'i go chas bzhu lugs su bcing pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer mi phyed par bsam zh-ing bang shis kyi mtha' brgyad/ snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rang bzhin du shes pas spyod lam thams cad don yod par spyad do/ de ltar 'dus pa mo'i rgyun bsnyen 'khyer bde/ ba zhi dgos zhes a grags bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskur ngor/ smani gling yi chan nas tshigs bsdu phran bu byas te bkod pa yang 'bri ban rdo rje gzi 'bar rtsalal gyi bris pa 'gal 'khrul mchis na mkhyin ldan rnams kyis bcos par 'tshal lo// (40) (da) ༄༅// zur ri brag dkar gyi gnas bsrang dge bsnyin chen po'i gsol mchod 'phrin las glog myur zhes pa bzhugs so// rmad byung thugs bskyed 'chi med lam yangs por/ 'gro ngor mtshan dpe'i sku mchog rte bdun dbang*/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs gzi 'od bar 'bar bas/ lus can pad tshal skyong mdzad rigs matsor dad/ sngon byon dam pa gong mas zhabs bcag pa'i/ dbur stod klu shod brag dpar gdon gnas kyi/ gnas gasrung dge bsnyen chen po'i g.yos mchod ni/ las rim 'phrin las glog myur 'dir 'god bya/ 'dir rnal 'byor pa gang zhing gnas po jo bo brag dkar gyi gsol mchod bya bar 'dod na/ dge bsnyen 'di nyid kyi rten 'khar gyi mdun nam gnas yang yang rung bar/ stebs bu khebs ldan khar rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du gtor ma dkar zlam yid 'ong ba gcig la sde b.ragayad bshes bus mtha' bskor ba'i mdun du g.yag lugs gsum dang*/

'chang bkrad/ mtheb kyu lnga brtsegs gsum bcas dang*/ mdun du gser skyems bzang bca' btung ba'i tshogs dang sman raka mchod pa bcas spyi ltar gtsang sbra (41) dang ldan par bsham/ sdan bde bar 'khod la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pyi ltar sngod du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs su rdzogs shing snang sradi zali gyi gnon pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod la badz+ra gu ru ci nus bzla/ mchod gtor rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snong yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sman raka gtor ma phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas 'dod yon sum tshogs pa zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gnas bsrung 'kho bcas dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyi mi khyab par gyur pas bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+tī bar gyis mchod pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā ba ling+ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ zhes lag gsum gyis sman raka gtor ma byin brlabs/ de nas dngos gzhi mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du phyi ltar brag ri dung seng gnam mchongasalta bu'i rtser na bun lang long 'khrig pa rab du rtsi shing sna tshogs mdzes pa/ rtsa bar spang ljongs me tog gi tshom bus rnams par bkra ba/ bya dang gan gzan ri dwags

(42) badz+ra pa ma ya dza/ zhes spyan drangs/ kyai rin chen dung gi khang bzang nyams re dga'/ gtor mchod gser skyems 'dod yon bag re dro/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor yon mchod dam re gtsang*/ gnas srung dge bsnyen 'khor bcas brjed re che/ dang zab rat+na'i khri gdan yangs pa'i dbus/ ji sradi mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ hoḥ sngon tshe rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka'/ bar du pad+ma thod 'phring lung*/ tha mar che mchog 'dus rtsal sogs/ spyan sngar dge bsnyen 'khor bcas kyis/ khas blangs dam bca' ma bsnyil bar/ dgon gnas bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ sngags 'chang bdag gi las rnams bsgrubs/ bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' bar/ rtag tu khyod nyid gsol mchod bgyi/ gal te dam las 'gal gyur na/ gnam lcags rdo rjes mgo snying bkas/ mnar med lhung gyur gdon mi za/ sa ma ya mṛ ta na rak+kan/ ces gtor mar bdud rtsi bran cing*/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag khar bdud rtsi byin pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas dam la bzhag kyai brag dkar dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos mar me/ dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ bza' bca' btung ba mgo dgu'i longs spyod sogs/ dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams bskang ste/ gnas so dge bsnyin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ dgyes par bzhes la bcom ba'i 'phrin las bsgrubs/ oṃ yu sa si ka sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ sa rgyaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu po/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe nai wi rgyaṃ/ shap+ta/ rdu pa/ shap+ta gan+dhe rā se/ par+she sra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ zhes mchod/ kyaiḥ dge bsnyen chen po mthu rtsal can/ cho bo brag dkar 'khor bcas rnams/ gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*/ phyi rten 'bod rdzas g.yab dar dgar/ nyer spyod 'od yon rnam lnga dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum sman rak+ta/ dam rdzas gtor ma gser skyems bcas/ nang rten dkor mdzod rten gtor dang*/ dar zab gos dang bse khrab rmog

/stag ral gzig shubs mda' mdung gri/ gsang rten dgyes pa'i mdza' sdug grogs/ gyi ling sngon po rlung gshog can/ g.yag lug ra dkar la sogs pa/ spyan gzigs ma tshang med pa yi/ nam mkha'i khams kun yongs bkang steng*/ gnas bsrung dge bsnyen chen po dang*/ ru 'dren klu btsan mtsho sman bdud/ sgo bsrung la sogs drag shul can/ ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ bskang ngo gsol lo thugs dam bskang*/ khyed rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' bsgos ltar/ snying po'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ rnal 'byor rkyen sol tshe dpal spol/ bcol ba'i lasakun thogs med mdzod/ ca sa bskang nas/ haḥ dge bsnyen 'khor bcas dbag la (43) dgongs/ bdag cag ma rig dbang gis ni/ mchod gtor dus 'das 'byer tshogs chung*/ 'bag btsog gis sgrib chad lhag sogs/ nor 'khrul ci mchis bzod mdzad nas/ dgyes rangs tshangs pa'i dongs grub rtsol/ zhes yig brgya brjod cing bshags/ gtor mar sman raka sbran cing*/ oṃ yu sa ka sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma bsngos hoḥ dge bsnyen chen po 'khor klu btsun mtsho sman sgo bsrung dang bcas pa la dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon dang ldan pa 'di 'bul gyis bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung*/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong*/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dgon gnas dang bcas pa'i 'khal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ bcom ba'i 'phrin las thogs pa thogs pa med pa yin bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ kyaiḥ dge bsnyen chen po bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog ni/ sa 'dzin dung gi 'phrog byed lha laṃ la/ legs par 'phyo 'dre'i rtse mor chu 'dzin 'thibs/ sprin gyi gzegs ma zim bu'i rgyun 'bab cing*/ nor 'dzin margad zhun mas byugs 'dra'i ljongs/ rnam bkra chu skyes tshom bu nyer bkram zhing*/

bya gcan ri dwags tshogs rnam bag phab rgyu/ bkod mdzes spang rdzongs logs pa rka bro brdung*/ de 'dri'i dbus su lha yi gzhal yas khang*/ rin chen dung las grub pa'i bkod mdzes shing*/ 'chi med mkhar gyi khengs sa 'phrog pa'i dbus/ baiḍūr+ya las grub pa'i khri stong du/ gnas bsrung lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ni/ zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i skur bzhengs tshe/ sku mdog chu shel lha po ltar brjed cing*/ stong zla'i mdangs 'phrog dar gyi ber chen gsol/ phyag g.yas ba dan dkar po srid rtser 'byir/ rnam 'byor snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab par mdzad/ dpal dbyor longs spyod ci bsam 'grub pa'i phyir/ phyag g.yon yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'bar bsnams/ yang gcig drag po'i las la skur bzhengs tshe/ rab 'jigs nam mkha'i mdog can gtum rngam can/ stag dong g.yas la gzig shub g.yon du 'chang*/ phyag nyis rak+shi ral gris gnod byed gzer/ rta sngon chibs shing batshan dmag 'bul sdes bskor/ bya khyi sngon po lding zhing rgya ba nas rgyug thog ser 'beb cing cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ mchod cing bstod do dgra bo myur du sgrol/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren sting mo klu btsan ni/ mun pa'i mdog can bra nag rting dkar chibs/ sku dar gan gos zu g.yang lhug g.yol/ sbrul gyi thod bcings btsan zhags dmar po thogs/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren ri ring bon po'i chas/ sku la dar dkar ras kyi nang bzang gsol/ phyag na rna shang rol mo brjed ldan bsnams/ las bzhi'i 'phril las grub pa'i/ (44) mthu bo che/ slad kyi rjes 'brangs li dmar btsan rgod ni/ sku mdog dmar po mdung dmar zhags pa bsnams/ dbang mdog shugs ldan la chigs stong khams nyul*/ rol du nor bsrung dmar po rgyug cing ngar/ sngon gyi shulpamatshon dug lung klu btsan ni/ sku mdog sngon po zhags nag spu gri 'dzin/ na bza' smug po 'khor gsum rkod la mdzes/

rta sngon chibs shing khyi sngon rgyab tu rol/ gtan grogs tshu ru lung gi matso sman ma nga*/ bzhani bzang mtshar sdug bar mdzes kun yid 'phrog /nam bzang pañca li ka zla zhun mdog rgod rkyang chibs shing nor bu 'bar ba bsnams/ skyo grogs butsan mo sman chu'i na chung ma/ dar dkar na bzang gser g.yu'i rgyan 'phreng bachang*/ sku mdog dmar po sman gyi bum pa bsnams/ sman mo'i tshogs bskor sha ba yu mo chigs/ yang sprul sgo bsrung sha ba dge bsnyen ni/ sku mdog smug po sgrul na thod du bcings/ dngul khrab gsol zhing mdung dar dmar po 'phyar/ btsan dmag 'bul sde'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ gzhan yang bka' 'khor lha klu btsan bdud sogs/ cha lugs ma nges sna tshogs stong khams rgyu/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mchod cing bstod bstod do 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ ces gatsho 'khor thams cad la bstod cing gtor mar sman kar bran phyir spags la/ kyaiḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma thog 'phreng sogs/ brgyud par bcas pas bka' bsgas pa'i/ dge bsnyen bag dkar 'khor 'das dgongs/ khyon ni gnas bsrung dam tshig can/ dbag ni chos kyi brgyud 'dzin te/ sngon gyi dam bca' rjes dgongs la/ sman raka spyan gzigs mtha' yasapa/ ma tshang med pa 'phul bzhes la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ de 'dzin zhabs brten 'dul sde spel/ char chung dus 'bebs 'bras drug smin/ nang yams 'khrug rtsod pad ser sogs/ mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ bde skyid rdzogs ldan la sapayod cing*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal rnams kun/ yang ngo'i zla ltar 'phel rgyas mdzod/ khyad par dgon gnas 'di nyid dang*/ rnam 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ bsrung skyob mol tshe g.yel med dang*/ tshe dpal snyan grags bar rgyas shing*/ gzhis byes mi nor 'khor bcas la/ nad gdon bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ dgra chag chom rkun la sogs sa/ mi thun phyogs rnams bzlog pa dngas/

sngags 'chang bsam don myur sgrub cing*/ 'phril nal rnam bzhi'i las rnags kun/ ma gel thogs med 'grub pa dang*/ bkris dbe logs rgyas par mdzod/ ces brjod cing gtor ma gtsang par 'bul zhig gshogs su gsol yig brgyas chad lhag gso dge ba byang chub bang zhing shes brjod kyi mtha' brgyan no/ de ltar brag dkar gnas bsrung dgaye bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod gsar bsgrigs zhig dgos zhes (45) chos 'khor byams gling bla ma dkon mchog bstan 'dzin blo gsal bar rgyas kyis bkris lha rdzas kyi skyes dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor 'bri gung pa shākya'i btsun pa dharma dh+wa dzas gang dran bdud tsi la grub par bgyis pa'o// (na) rdo rje phun pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i las byang bdud sde'i g.yul rgyal phan bde'i gru char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ gdod nas lhun grub spros bral bde chen ngang*/ gtum ched khro rgyal gar dgu'i rab 'gying bas/ bdud dpung phyer 'thag dkar phyogs rgyal rngacher/ sgrogs pa'i 'phril las lha yis dngos grub rtsol/ nges gsang phunam ma'i lam bzang go la'i ngog /phul byung rtags mtshan mngon gyur grub pa'i 'od/ rgya bal gangs ljongs log 'dren nga sangs ma/ 'joms mdzad pad+ma ka ras kun tu skyongs/ gang des ma 'ongs gdul bya la dgongs nas/ byin brlab gtad rgya lung bstan yang 'gro'i zhabs/ slar sprul gtor 'byin rat+na gling pa nas/ rim brgyud bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rnams rgyal/ ldan lha'i gter byon 'phrin las phun pa'i khrigs/ gsar rnying bka' gter dgongs don ji bzhin par/ las byang snying por bkod la bla ma lhas/ byin brlab gnang ba'i dpal yon 'dir rtsol cig /de la 'dir dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i las byang gi rim pa klag chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ sngon (46) 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/

dang po sngon 'gro la mthun mong dang khyad par gnyis sa thun mong rnams dbang sgrub kyi skabs su 'byung zhing*/ 'dir khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la dgu las/ 'di nyid kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ yid mthun gyi gnas su phun pa'i rten bshams pa'i mdun du sman gtor rak+ta mchod pa'i bye brag rnams mthong brgyud ltar bshams la stan bde bar 'khod nas/ sngon 'gro'i sdom la skyabs 'gro dang*/ gtor ma bka' bsgo bsrung mtshams bcad/ bar+ha bsgo phyag bshags pa dang*/ dam can byin dbab mchod brlab bcas/ dang po la bzhi las skyabs yul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi skyabs yul mtha' dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig pur rdzogs par mos la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ dpal chen phun pa'i dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha/ mchog gsum dpa' bo mkhro bstan bsrung la/ byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho chen gyi/ bldul rba klong 'khrug las bsgral ba'i phyir bdag gi dpal chen phun pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ nyams su blangs nas byang chub mchog thob bgyi/ lan gsum/ bdun rnam dag ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum bzhugs la phyag lo/ mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ gnyis med yid kyi skyabs su mchi/ dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i/ dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la/ dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/

lan gsum/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ oṃ swā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhin nu sku mdog mthing nag (47) zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas phar bu dang g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa ye shes kyi me dpung bar tu 'bar ba'i klong na khro gtum rngags pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ ces sgom gtor ma gsum chu chang bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyed par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par bsams/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a rgya nut+pan+na twat+ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la= de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'jal klas la= de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la= na maḥsarba tathā ga ta dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te oṃ pam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum/ gtor ma dang po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang pa 'di nyid gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ yul nyer bzhi gnas so gnyis dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang mkhro phyogs skyong gi tshogs la 'bul lo/ bzhes nas 'dir bsgrub pa chen po dbu nas mjug gi bar du nang gi dngos grub phyi ma gtang*/ phyi'i bar chad nang du ma btang*/ 'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad zhi zhing 'phril las thams cad 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod gtor ma gnyis pa 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams thams cad kyi bdag po lha klu batshan bdud gza' skar pa bdag mthu stobs dang ldan pa rnams dang*/

khyad po sgrub gnas chen po 'di'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas thams cad la 'bul lo/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpal chen rdo rje phun pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa la ko long dang ru nga phrag dog gi bsam pa spong la zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /gnyis pa la/ kro dha ra dza hūṃ dzaḥ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po'i thugs ka nas khro chung dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs thams cad gtor ma len pa'i slad du mdun du skad cig gis bkug /sarba bhū ta kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gtor ma gsum pa 'od yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di/ bgegs rigs lan chags 'byung po rdo rje thog pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang*/ sngags nyan pa dang*/ phyag rgya lta ba la mi dbang ba thams cad la sbyin no/ gtor ma 'di khyer la gnas 'dir ma 'dug par gzhan du song zhig /sarba bhū ta gats+tshaḥ zhes brjod/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūṃ nyon cig bgogs dang log 'dren tshogs: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang zhig 'da' (48) byed pa: stobs chen khro bo chen po yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru 'khos: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du deng : ā+oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ: ghṛ h+na ghṛ h+na hūṃ: ghṛ h+na sa ya ghṛ h+na pa ya hūṃ: ā na ya ho bha ga wān brgya'i rā tsa ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ gu gul gyi bdug pa dang bcas bskrad/ gsum pa mtshams gcod pa la gnyis las dang po ni/ hūṃ nga ni rang byung khro rgyal chen po ste: sku gsung thugs las 'od zer bar 'phros shings: stong 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha'i gur chen 'bar: sus kyang 'dab ba'i skabs med bar tu gtams: stong 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i gur chen te: rdo rje 'bar bas ma lus 'joms par byed: stong 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor lo'i gur chen ste: 'khor lo 'bar bas ma lus gcod par byed:stong 'og phyags mtshams ral gri 'bar bas gtams:

ral gri 'bar bas thams cad gtubs par byed: stong 'og phyagos mtshams dbyug tho 'bar bas gtams: dbyug tho 'bar bas ma lus brdung bar byed/ stong 'og phyogs mtshams rgya graṃ 'bar bas gtams: rgya graṃ 'bar bas ma lus bsrung bar byed: oṃ badz+ra rak+sha rak+sha hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsakra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kha la sha ru pa sha hūṃ phaṭa: ā+oṃ badz+ra karma sa twa ha ha hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra nan nan tsaṇ+ḍa ro sha na khad kha hūṃ phaṭa: gnyis pa= phyogs mtshes zer ba'ang 'dug khro bo bcu'i mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūṃ stong gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: hūṃ chen kā ra zhal gsum khyag drug pa: lha yi gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyi lanan: stong gi phyogs kyi dgra dang bgogs bzlog cig /shar gyi phyogs nas mtshams mchod khro ba'i rgyal: rnam par rgyal ba zhal gsum= dri za'i gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i= shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra= shar lho mtshams nas mtshams gcod= me lhī gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i= shar lho mtshams kyi= lho yi phyogs nas mtshams gcod= gshin rje gshod po zhalag gsum= gshin rje'i gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i= lho yi phyogs kyi dgra= lho nub mtshams nas mtshams gcod= mi ga'o mgon po zhal gsum= srin po'i gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i= nub byang mtshams nas mtshams gcod= gzhan gyi mi thub zhal= rlung lha'i gdon tshogs zhabs= nub byang mtshams kyi= byang gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod= bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gsum= gzhon sbyin gdon tshogs zhabs= byang gi phyogs kyi dgra= byang shar mtshams nas mtshams gcod= khams gsum rnam rgyal zhal gsum= begs kyi gdon tshogs zhabs= byang shar mtshams kyi= 'og gi phyogs nas mtshams macod khro po'i rgyal: stogs chen rgyal po zhal gsum

(49) phyag drug pa: sa bdag gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis gnan: 'og gi khyogs kyi dgra dang bgegs bzlog cig /o badz+ra kro ta hūṃ kā ra/ bi dza ya nī la daṇ+ḍa/ ya mānata ka/ ar+ya a tsha la/ h+ya gh+ri wa/ a pa rā tsit+ta/ a mṛ kuṇ+ḍa li/ trai lo kya bi dza ya/ ma hā bā la hūṃ: bar chad 'byung po garje garje/ ha na ha na/ sa tsa sa tsa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ khro chen 'bar bas me yi thog pare 'bebs: stong 'og phyogs mtshams gar dgu'i tshul gyis bsrung: kan kyang khyogs bcur phur 'drel zhing 'debs/ bsrung dang mtshams kyi 'phris grub par mdzod: hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta bi shwa tsakra ma dha la ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa/ bzhi pa badha sgo dbye ba ba ni/ hūṃ snang srid thams cad rdo rje phun pa'i lha: thabs kyi sprod pas 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: rnam dag gsang ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rang gsal ma 'gag chos dbyings sgo dbye'o/ bhū ma dha la e srid we sha ya phaṭaḥ lnga pa badha' phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ thabs kyi sprod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rje gang 'dul baḥ sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad phyir: rang byung ye shes ngang du badha' phyag 'tshalaḥ he ru ka sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ sri te dza hoḥ drug pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho dgongs/ bdag ni ma rim rmongs shing gti mug pasaḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chig nyams chag sogs/ gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing bshags par bgyiḥ ghu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ka ni sarba pa ma yā shud+dhe aḥ o badza satā sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa ci nus dang*/ spro na ye shes sku mchog kyang bya'o/ bdun pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūṃ dam tshig 'du 'bras med pa'i gzungs thag la: rigs srog gis bsdus pa'i lu gu brgyud: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir:

rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngang : bdag dang dbyer med gcig tu ma 'grub bar: skye ji srid bar du mi btang ngo : karma he ru ka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ti hūṃ: brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/ sbyar ba'i spos bsreg rol mo dang bcas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing hū/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor: sradi pa rdo rje phun pa grub pa'i lha: rdo rje gzhon zhu'i dkyil 'khor ma lus rnams: thugs rje chen pos sgrib bkol mi mdzad cing: dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dam tshig can: thugs rje chen po'i 'phril las rlabs po che: bla med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen dpag tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wan pa ma ho: sa ma ya s+t+wi: hūṃ rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i dbyings nyid nas: dbang bskur byin chen dbab pa'i dus la babs/ sngon gyi thugs dam bcom ldan rdo rje'i bdag: rdo (50) rje'i dbang bskur dam tshig zla na med: skyabs las mi gel g.yar dam gcig pa'i lha: rgyal ba ma lus rnams kyi byin gyis rlob: gu ru dho wa ḍāk+ka ni: kī li ki la ya: sa ma ya hūṃ: sa ma ya dza: dgu sa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlasab la bzhi las dang po mchod pa ni/ o badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ sā bhā khas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las dung chen gyi snod yangs shing rgyal che ba'i nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i nyer spyod lnga la sogs sapa byi nang gsang ba'i mtshod pa rnams rang bzhin stong pa rnams mchod rdzas byed las zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyed par can bskyed nus pa nikha'i mtha' nga mnyam par gyur/ bla ma' mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dpag med rnams/ dbe gshegs rgyal ba ma lus bskang ba'i rdzas: kun gzang mchod pa'i sprin bzhin gnas gyur cig

/ū+oṃ bho dhi rtsit+ta ga na gu h+ya sa ma ya ta na sarba sdu dza da hoḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pa āḥhū: oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūṃḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi rgyaṃ ā ཿhūṃ: ā+oṃ badz+ra shasta āḥhūṃ: gnyis pa sman byin gyis brlabs pa ni bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rung ri las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gi las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum ma gnas pa'i ā las kā pa la dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang du rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon bcu yongs su gyur pa las sha lnga dang dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i kha gcod la nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ā li kā lis mtshan pa'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga sa khong gseng can gyi rtse mor a yig dkar po gsal bar gyur/ sngags bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis 'og gi rlung g.yos mo sbra thod pa dros rdzas khol rlangs pa rdo rje'i khong gseng nas 'thon pa'i phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa mchod/ slar 'du pa dang lhan cig ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te a dkar po la thim/ de nyid yongs du gyur pa las rdo rje nyi zla dbyangs gsal dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas thod pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā sañca a mṛ ta hūṃ trīḥthā: lan bdun/ gsum pa gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i 'og tu rlung me thod pa'i sgyed po gsum gyi stong du a las bhad+dha 'bad ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ las gtor ma sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la oṃ gyis nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag par byas/ āḥ yis bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag tu med par bsgyur/ hūṃ gis mchod pa'i gnas su bstab pas/ dpal gyi gtor ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar pa ni/

'dod yon mchaud pa'i lha mo bsam gyi mi khyab pa spros pas dpal chen lha tshogs dgyes skong dam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā ma ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta bha la bha te ghu h+ya ho shrī sa ma ya hūṃ: lan bdun bzhi pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rak+ta'i (51) snod dmar gyi dung chen mkha' dbyings dang mnyam pa'i stong gi nam mkhar lha mo ghi rte ma dmar mo gsal ba'i/ de'i mga' gsang nas ri yig dmar nag thod pa'i nang du babs pa las 'od zer kun tu 'phros pas khams gsum gyi rak+ta'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas/ slar yig la thims la thim pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po rba rlabs 'khrugasapar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hrī thāḥ lan bdun gyi byin rlabs pas sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o/ dongs gzhi'i las rim nyi shu las/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung brtsegs dang*/ gzhal yas lha dang dbang bskur ba/ spyan badren bzhugs gsol phyag mchod dang*/ sman gtor rak+ta 'dod don gsol: bsgrol sbyor bstod pa 'dzab bskul dang*/ 'dzab bzlas dang bcas dngos bzhi'i sdom/ de la ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyi dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ rdo rje khrog pas zhes sdang gcod/ mtshon cha sngon po 'bar ba yi: nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig pa ra shar: srog gi gor ru shar ba dang: srog gi go ru shar ba dang : snying gi go ru bsgom par bya: ā+oṃ badz+ra shu n+ya ta dz+nya swa na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma konya haṃ: hūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ si ha ra ṇa hūṃ: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yi te/ phun po rdo rjes gtams byas nas: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje gzhon zhu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rje grub par mdzod: srid pa rdo rje phun pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta r+harmā dharatu swa bha wa shu d+dhonya hoḥ gsum pa rgyu'i ti 'dzin ni/ hūṃ chos dbyings skye med ngang nyid las: chos rnams rang byung rten 'brel te: thams cad rgyu las ma byung med: rgyu yi ge hū du gsal/ tsit+ta badz+ra pa ma ting dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: nang 'dzin par byed pa'i sems dang*/ phyi bzung bar da pa'i yul gnyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa de'i ngang las sgra brag cha tsam gyi sad pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nyi ma 'bum du gcig la shar ba tsam gyi 'od kyis bkang*/ 'od zer de dag tshul 'dus pa las rang gi rims pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūṃ sngon po 'od zare kha don lnga ldan 'phro bar gyur/ bzhi pa dbang chen ya lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ slar yang hūṃ yig de las 'od zareya 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad la phog lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim pas 'od dang gzi brjid dpag tu med par gyur/ de las e mthing skye zhing 'og phyogs su 'chad pa las 'od zare 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las yum kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klu+ong nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum rtse mo thur du bstan pa/ de'i stong du yaṃ sngon skya zhig 'chad pa'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las yum dam tshig sgrol ma'i mga' klong rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gaṃ ljang gu/ de'i stong du ra dmar nag 'chad pa'i 'odazare 'bro 'du las yum mā ma ka'i mkha' klong rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rgya khyon dpag tu med pa/ de'i stong du sum ser po 'chad de gnas pa'i 'od zare 'phro 'du las/ (52) yum sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' klong pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi ser po rgya khyon tshad las 'das pa/ de'i stong du keṃ dkar po 'chad pa'i 'od zare 'phro 'du las gong rus kyi ri rab dpag tshad brgyad khri dang ldan pa/

de'i stong du rim dmar nag 'chad pa'i 'or 'phro 'du las yum gos dkar mo'i mkha' klong phyogs mtshams thams cad me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar nam rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrug par gyur/e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ: yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ: ra s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ: suṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ si ha ra hūṃ: keṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ si ha ra ṇa hūṃ: raṃ s+pha ra ṇa hūṃ: lnga pa snod dag pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ rgyu'i hūṃ las yi ge bh+ruṃ'aphro pa me ri 'bar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi klong du 'chad pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rte babs dang bcas pa/ 'og gzhi rdo rje'i brag las byas pa/ bhan+dha skam rlon gyi phag thabs su brtsigs pa rak+tas spyin thabs su sbyar ba mi mgo rlon pas kha bad byas pa/ sbrul sngo dmar gyi chun 'phyang*/ thod skam gyi dra ba/ thod tshal gyi dra phyed rin po ches spel mar brgyan pa/ zhing gi rgyal mtshan/ zhing phran gyi phan gdugs/ rak+tī zhal chu 'bab pa tsit+ta'i bo long 'phyang ba/ skyu chen brgyad kyi ka gdan la/ lha brgyad kyi ka ba/ gza' brgyad kyi ka gzhu/ rgyu skar gyi dral lcaṃ la/ ru tri'i pags thog phub pa/ nyi zla'i skar khung gsal ba/ pho brang de'i stong du bum pi bre chos 'khor gdugs rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo bzhir rus sbal gyi ma thom/ sbrul nag gi skyes bu/ nam mkha' lding gi ya them/ chu shing ni gyi ya phug gha ru ṇa'i lding khang*/ zhing spags gyi sgo kheb/ thams cad gnam lcags kyi gzer gyis gtams pa/ stag spyang don de mang po rgyu ba/ kaṅka dur byas mang po lding ba/ rta babs sgo gang rgyan dgus mdzes shing*/ 'dod khyams la lha mo du mas mchod sprin stob pa/ rin po che pha gu ser pos spras shing*/ sdu shu'i khor yug tu dri med shel gyi mchod rten mdzes pas bskor ba/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas kyi phyi rol du ngur khrod chen po brgyad/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol ye shes kyi me kha dog sna tshogs 'bar zhing rdo rje brag chen gyi rwa bas kun nas gtams pa/ de dag kyang ye shes lnga'i las grub pa phyi nang sgrib med kun tu gsal ba rang byung lhun grub chen po gyur pa'i gzhal yas gang gi nang du mu khyud rim pa gsum thod pa'i phreng ba can gru chad bar 'khyis dang bcas pa'i lta ba gru gsum mthing nag zla gaṃ gsum dmar ba'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dang ldan pa'o/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ bhi sha bhi shud+dhe e dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+ruṃ: ru tra ru tri ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la: saṃ parma maṇ+ḍa la: hūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ: zhes brjod pas dbus kyi gru gsum mthing gi steng du ru tra bdud bzhi nyi zla sarma'i gdan dang*/ rtsibs bzhi la zhing gi gdan re re/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu (53) la sa zla nyi ma'i stong du phyogs skyong pho mo gan rkyal kha sbub tu gnas pa/ sgo bzhir zhing gi gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ drug pa bcud dag pa brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa la gsum las dang po bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ rgyu'i yi ge hūṃ sngon po nam mkhar gnas pa de gzhal yas khang dbus kyi gdan thog tu babs pa las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba ranams la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ byin brlab 'od zare gyi tshul du 'dus nas hūṃ la thim rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga par gyur/ de las kyang 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ badz+ra kī lā ya sarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ bdag nyid chen po rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa sku mdog mthing nag baiḍūrma ltar gsal ba g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/

g.yon zhal dmar la gshe ba/ dbus zhal mthing la brngam pa/ dbu la he ru ka lnga dang thod skam lnga lngas mtshan pa/ dbu skra ral pa kham nag spyi bor 'khyim ba la/ lā+e brgan mthing gas spra pas/ spyan dgu dmar zlum 'khrug pa/ mche ba zla tshes su gtsigs pa zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smra ra ser po las me dang dza'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ dasral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu bhan+dha'i dbyibs su brgyan sa/ mkhur tshos las rak+ta'i thig le kha ṭ+wi ga'i tshul du byug pa/ og mar zhag gi zer ris rdo rje rtse lnga'i rnam par bshal ba/ snyan gong ga'as g.yon nyi zlas brgyan pa/ sbrul rgyal rigs dkar pos dbu brgyan/ rje rigs ser pos snyan brgyan/ bla zer dmar pos phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/ gdol pa nag pos ser kha/ sbrul rigs lnga'i chun pos ska rags bcings sa/ phyag g.yas kyang dang sos rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ bar pas rdo rje rtse lnga gdongs pa/ g.yon dang po'i sdig mdzu' gyi rtse nas me 'bar ba/ bar gas kha ṭ+wi ga rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis ri rab gyi phur bu thugs kar bsgril ba/ glang chen gyi kong rlon/ zhing chen gyi g.yas gzhi/ sdag spags kyi shar thabs/ ba su ta'i zhags pa/ thod pa skam rlon ra ri tshar gsum gyi do shal la sogs pa dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i gshegs pas nag mkha' khebs pa/ g.yas kyi dang ru la rdo rje rtse dgu me 'bar ba/ g.yon gyi dang ru la rin po che me 'bar ba/ mjug ma rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ mthe'u chung spru bran dang bcas pa la rdo rje phyed pa'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gyad gyi dor stabs bgrad pa ye shes bskal ba'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ rnams par rol pa'i gar dgu dang rnam brjed pub cu rtse drug gi nyams dang ldan pa'o/ thugs rin po che zur brgyad mtshong gur phub pa lta bu'i nang du nyi zla'i gdan la/
ye shes sems dpa' mthing ga mtshon gang zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril badril ba'i thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor srin ma

(54) phyed pa'i stong rdo rje mthing nag nas 'bral tsam gyi lte bar nyi zla dal yungs 'bru tsam pa'i dbus hūṃ sngon spris pa tsham gyi mthar kī mthar dgus bklag thabs su bskor ba/ ye shes semasadapa'i sgo bsrung rta 'grin dmar po yul dang bcas pa pad+ma dang bhan+dha 'dzin pa/ de'i mdun du yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sku mdog mthing skye zhab gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ut+pa la dang bcas pa'i yab kyi mgul na 'khyud pa/ g.yon dung dmar gtso bo la stob pa/ gzigs gi sham thabs dang rgyan drug pe ral khar spras pa/ zhabs g.yas yab dang lhan gcig tu brkyang zhing g.yon yab kyi sku la 'khrol te bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhi'i rtsebs la zhing gi stong du/ dpal chen yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba byas pa'i byang sems hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ shar du badz+ra kī la ya zhal gsum phyag drug/ zhagal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ga /phyag g.yas gnyis na rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa mtha' gnyis ri bar phur sa 'dre ba/ lho ru rat+na la ya zhal gsum phyag drug /zhal g.yas dmar g.yon sngo dbus ser ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis ni rin po che dang dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis thod khrag dang zhags sa/ mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril ba/ nub tu sarma kī la ya zhal gsum phyag drug /zhal g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis sarma dang lar gri/ g.yon gnyis bhan+dha lcags sgrog /mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril ba/ byang du karma kī la ya zhal gsum phyag drug /zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rgya graṃ dang thong byug /g.yon gnyis me dpung dril bu/ mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dral ba/ bzhi ka'ang sgra kham nag gi thor tshugs dang rigs lngas dbu brgyan sa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad lcags phur zul gsum me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro khro zhing gtum pa'i skur gyur/ gnyis sa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/

gtso bo yab yum thabs dang shes rab mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub sems kyi hūṃ mthing zung stong 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la babs te 'phro 'dus 'od du zhu ba las rang byung khro bo'i rgyal po bcur gyur pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūṃ kā ra hūṃ: gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭ+wa: stong phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i gdon la khro bo hūṃ kā sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrod pa/ zhal g.yas ser g.yon dmar dbus sku dang mthun pa/ phyag drug dang po gtis kyi mda' gzhu/ bar bas phur pa dang lcags kyu/ mtha' ma gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ yum rdo rje sgra 'byin ma sngo skya dang 'khril ba/ g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod phag dang rmigs bu'i mog can gtso bo'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta baṃ dza ya hūṃ: ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+wa: shar du dri za bsnol ba'i gdan la khro bo rnam par rgyal ba dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon ljang dubs sku dang mdun pa/ phyag dang po gtis rdo rje dang bhan dmar 'dzin pa/ bar (55) pas 'khor lo dang dril bu/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ yum rdo rje snyoms ma dkar mos 'khril ba/ g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod stag dang bya rgod mgo can gatsho ba'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ: da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ shar lho me lha bsnol ba'i gdan la khro bo dbyug pa sngono pa mthil nag zhal gsum khyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar bus sku dang mthun pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang bhan dmar 'dzin pa/ bar pas me dpung dang dbyug tho/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'drel ba/ yum rdo rje sder mo sngon skyas 'khril ba/ g.yas ge+on du sprul pa za gsod g.yag dang bya rog gi mog can gtsau'i mdog mthun gnas pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mānata ka hū: sa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭ+wa: lho phyogs su gshin rje bsnol ba'i gdan la khro bo gshin rje'i gshed sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrod pa/

zhag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar bdus sku dang mthun pa/ phyag dang po gtis rdo rje bhan dmar/ bar bas be con dang dgra sta/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'drel ba/ yum dur khrod ma sngon mos 'phril ba/ g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod sha ba dang 'ug pa'i mog can gtso bo'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ: bhan+dha bhan+dha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ lho nub tu srin po bsnol ba'i gdan la khro bo mi g.yo mgon po ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon smug dbus dang mthun/ pha dang po gnyis rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin pa/ bar pas zhags pa dang spu gri/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'dren ba/ yum rdo rje gtan+pakhung ljang mos 'khril ba/ g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod gzig dang khā ta'i mgo can gtso ba'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya gh+ri wa hūṃ: hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ nub byang rlung lha bsnol ba'i gdon la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar skye zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dmar bus sku dang mthun (56) pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dung khrag /bar pas ral gri zhags pa/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ yum rdo rje rlung 'byin ljang ser gyis 'khrol ba/ g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod seng ge dang pha wang gi mgo can gatsho bo'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūṃ: bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ byang shar dbang ldan bsnol ba'i gdan la khro bo khams gsam rnam rgyal ser na zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrod pa/ zhag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus sku dang mthun pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba/ bar pas dgra sta dang zhags pa/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'drel ba/ yum rdo rje gsod byed ser nag gis 'khril ba g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod dom dang sre mong gi mgo can gatsho bo'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/

oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la hūṃ: s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ 'og phyogs sa bdag bsnol ba'i gdan la khro bo stobs po che sngon po zhel gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bkrad pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dubs sku dang mthun pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje bhan dmar/ bar pas mda' gzhu/ mtha' gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ yum rdo rje skyed byed la sngo skyas 'khril ba/ g.yas g.yon du sprul pa za gsod drod dang byi ba'i mgo can gatsho bo'i mdog mthun du gnas pa'o/ khro bo bcu so de dag kyang zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi bzhi gatshigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa phyogs bcur gdong zhing*/ dungar khrod 'arab ba'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ yum rnams g.yas dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ g.yon dung dmar yab la stob pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi skod nas 'khril ba/ g.yas yab dang mnyam par gshibs pa/ rgyan cha lugs yab dang 'dra ba las khyad par gzig sham can gnyen 'khril sdom sgogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ me dpung gi klaung na bzhugs pa/ spru ba'i phra men rnams kyang g.yas rang rnags kyi phur bu gdong zhing*/ g.yon bhan+dha dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyi spras pa'o/ sago bzhi'i zhing gi gdan la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bzhi 'phros pa las shar sgor/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī yang bhin+dha ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ rdo rje khro mo pu shud kyi mgo can dkar mo g.yas zhi ba'i dngul phur dang*/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhon sgor oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya na ma sa man+ta hring hring hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ rdo rje khro mo skye ga'i mog can ser mo g.yas rgyas pa'i gser phun dang g.yon zhabs pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya su ru su ru sra su ru sra su ru sra ru phaṭ+waḥ

rdo rje khro mo srin bya'i mgo can dmar mo g.yas dbang gi zangs phur dang*/ g.yon lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ rdo rje khro mo khra'i mog can ljang ser g.yas drag po'i lcags phur dang g.yon dril (57) bu 'dzin pa bzhi ka'ang dur khrod kyi chos dang ldan pa rang rigs mthun mthun gyi las la brngams pa'o/ ka taṃ ka ye : dza ye bhi dza ye: a tsi te: a pa ra tsi to: ma ra sa na: sra mar ta na ye hūṃ phaṭa: dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams mu ran khor yug rnams su sras sprul bka' sdod bdag nyid shwa na sa bdag ma gzhi bse lcags dung gi skyes bu dang phyug nyer brgyad la sogs pa phur bsrung dam can rgya tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rgyan cha lugs sna tshogs pa so so'i 'khor dang bcas pa nyi ma dang 'od zare gyi tshul du gatsho 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ gsum pa phur bu rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la phur bu bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ bdang bskur gsum las dang po bskyed pa ni/ bsdu na phur bu bskyed pa mi 'od par/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs byin brlab pa dang bdang bskur ba'i mdzug muṃ maṃ maṃ si te zhes brjod nas/ hū phyogs bcu sogs bzhugs gsol bzhag pa'i bdag nyid dpal chen po'i gnas gsum du nas dkyus bzhin gyir ba dgos pa skyabs bskun bya'o/ bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i phyag g.yas la las zla ba dang*/ g.yon ma las nyi mar gsal ba'i/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma tsham gyi stong du oṃ āḥ swā hā: g.yon gyi ser mo lnga nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma tsham gyi stong du muṃ laṃ maṃ saṃ taṃ gsal ba'i yiga'abru bcu 'od du zhu ba las phyag mtshan du gyur/ phyag mtshan de dag gnas 'gyar ba rigs lnga yab yum bcur gyur*/ sras mchog phur sa lag tu blangs la/ o ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma konya hi:

phur bu mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las rigs lnga yab yum gyi gsang ba'i badhas bskul te sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+wi: zhes thal mo sbyar nas/ badz+ra a dz+nyā li/ yab yum sbyor ba mdzad nas byang chub sems kyi 'od zer yi ge hūṃ du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ dzaḥ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī lā ya sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa zhal bgrad cing mtshe ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas phur bu dang*/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ sku smad gnam lcags kyi phun bu zur gsum rno ngar dang ldan sa mgar gyi sol mal nas phyugs pa ltar me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ rgya mdud gong mar hūṃ kar yab yum/ bar gyi lcug gzhon brgyad ma khro bo yab yum brgyad/ rgya mdud 'og ma'i nang du stobs po che yum kun kyang khra thabs dang bcas pa/ de'i ngos bzhi la sgo ma/ chu shin gyi 'og tu skye bu bzhi/ dbal la phur bsrung bcu gnyis te dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i bdag dang sras mchog khro ba'i tshogs kyis ba spru'i bu ga thams cad khro chung mtshon cha thogs pa ki la 'i sngags sgra sgrogs par bar mtshams mde par gtags par gyur gnyis pa sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kan gyi rang bzhin sku: ngang nyi rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyings bdag bskyed cig: oṃ bud+dha kī li kī lā ya kā ya badz+ra nam: dz+wa la dz+wa la: pra dz+wa la sra dz+wa la: pu tra pu tra sarba na sangs na ye (58) hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung : ngang nyid rdo rje = 'bar ba'i khrau= gsung gi dbyings su bdag= oṃ pad+ma kī li kī lā ya badz+ra nai: sarba duṇ+ṭan hri sho dha na ye hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sangs kun gyi rang bzhin thugs: ngang nyid rdo rje= 'bar ba'i= thugs kyi dbyings su bdag bskyed cig: oṃ badz+ra ki li kī lā ya tsit+ta badz+ra ni: se ta li maṇ+ḍa la ma gu ta la pra ta la hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ

sangs rgyas sha ri sa ma yaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa: bdang dang dngos grub 'dir rtsol cig: hū?ṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ sam ha ra ṇa hūṃ: ā+oṃ hūṃ swā āṃ hā: mu+i laṃ maṃ saṃ taṃ: hūṃ phrogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thugs kyi sras/ ye shes sku mchog badz+ra kī la ya: gru gsum mthing 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: chos dbyings yum gyi mkha' la bzhugs su gsul/ sa ma ya teṣ+ṣa lhan/ e'i stong nyi zla dgra bgegs kyi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ phun bskor lan gsum byas la bzhugs su gsol/ bdun pa bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nas dkyil 'khor gnyis la dbang bskur ba dang dkyil 'khor gnyis kyis khams gsum gyi sems can la srog ye shes su bsgyur ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing gas mtshan pa las phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la gnyis pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sku gsung thugs kyi bcud bsdus te dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi lha rnams kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum 'phros pas ye shes kyi snying po sku gsung thugs byin gyi brlabs/ dkyil 'khror gnyis kyi lha rnams las 'bru gsum 'bro gsum 'phros khams gsum sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ a su nri tri sri du drug tu gyur/ sa bon drug po 'od du zhu nas oṃ āḥhū gsum du gyur sa ye shes po'i srog dbang bskur te bdag nyid rtsa ba'i gnas gsum du thim pas byin brlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur par bsam/ brgyad pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren pa ni/ de ltar lha tshogs kyi dasril bar ā+oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar poḥ thugs kar hūṃ mthing nag gi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros dbyings rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku las gzugs sku khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs nas/

mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams gzhal yas khang me ri dang bcas pa byon nas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la gnyis med du bzhugs par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sarba sa ma yā dzaḥ a we sha ya a āḥ snyan gsan gsol ba btab la/ sbyar dang rang byug gi spos bsrog rol mo dang bcas/ ====rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: rdo rje gzhon shu 'khor dang bcas pa yang : chos kyi dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus rtsol ba'i phyir/ ye shes khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dang : kī la yi dngo grub rtsol ba'am khyir: (59) ye shes khro tshogs 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ dgu pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ khra dralam lus 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang: dam tshig dang ni ye shes dbyer med par 'o ma dang ni chu bzhag ji bzhin du: gnyis med brten pa men por bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bcu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūṃ ===gdug pa bsgral ba dang : nga rgyal zhen pa gzhol pa'i phyir: rdo rje srin po'i tshogs bcas la: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pu hoḥsri ti dza ha: bcu gcig pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ====dkyil 'khor rdo rje phur pa'i lha: dongs grub rtsol phyir phyi nag gsang ba yi: gus pas mchod pa'i sprin tshogs 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spros mar me dri zhal zas: sil snyan la sogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang : gzugs sgra dri re rog bya chos la sogs/ 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa dpag med dang : thabs dang shes rab bde tshen byang chub sems: bla med gsangs ba mchog gi phyal rgyar bcas: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dngas/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can la:

rnal 'byor bdag cag gus pas 'bul lags na: dgyes pas dgongs te dngos grub rtsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shastang sū dza hoḥ ma hā sarba pañca pu dza hoḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ghu t+ya sa ma ya su dza hoḥ badz+ra ra hoḥ ra ga ya mi: ghu h+ya sa ma ya s+t+wi:bcu gnyis pa sman mchod 'bul ba la gnyis las dang po ni: hūṃ go da nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yis dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyu drug sems can kun sgrol phyir: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: thams cad rnal 'byor bdud rtsi che: byang chub sems ni rdo rje che: sha chen mchod pa rin po che: pad+ma me tog yang dag ldan: rdo rje'i chu ste las kyi mchog: zas mchog yi dri chen po: ga sur shel gyi spos phor dri: rin chen me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od: ma lus 'dus pa'i thig le che: gcig tu dpa' bo'i ri rnams dang: gnyis su med par mnyam sbyar nas: 'chi med bdud rtsi ra sa ya: rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod pa'i rdzas: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang: byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag cag gus pas 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus bdag la rtsol: ī āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha la kha raṃ khā hi: sku gsum bka' brgyud rgya bor rig 'dzin dang : rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogasal: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgos dbang dang dgos grub rtsol/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha ri khā hiḥ bsdu sha bsham gyi mthing gan gru gsum 'dir sbyar te rgyud mtshan bzhag kyang chog kun bzang ho ru ka dang rdo rje 'chang*/ sra bha hasti padha 'byung gnas la/ rnam dag= thugs rjes= ā+oṃ= ye shes mtsho rgyal lo chen bai hiḥ bsdu na bsham gyi mthing nag gru gsum 'dir sbyar te brgyud mtshan bzhag kyang chog

/kun bzang he ru ka dang ho dang rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje chos dang las kyi dbang mo che/ sra bha hasti bu pad+ma 'byung gnas la: rnam dag= thags rjes=ā+oṃ= ye shes mtsho rgya lo chen bai ro'i zhabs/ lang 'gro lo tsā gter chen rat+na gling*/ tshe dbang grags pa ngag dbang mtshan can la: rnam= thugs rje=oṃ= ngag dbang nor bu la ṇi yongs grags dang*/ dbang chen lhun grub bud+dha lak+sha'i

(60) zhabs/ pad+ma dbang drag rā ka a s+ye la/ rnam dag= thugs rjes= ā+oṃ= kun bzang shes rab badz+ra maṅga la/ pad+ma rig 'dzid karma dri med dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos 'dzin pa chos dpal bzang po la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi'i=thugs rjes= ā+oṃ= rigs brgyi khyab bdag pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ rdo rje phur ba'i dbang lung man ngag gis/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thims cad la/ rnam dag bdud=thugs rjes= ā+oṃ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ dpal chen mngon rdzogs rdo rje gzhon nu dang : gsang ba'i yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la: rnam dag= thugs rjes= ā+oṃ= mthing nag 'arab ba 'khor lo'i rtsibs stongs su: thugs kyi sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi la: rnam dag=thugs rjes=ā+oṃ= stong 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil 'khor du: khro bcu yab sprul pa'i khra thabs la: rnam dag= thugs rjes=ā+oṃ=gzhal yas chen po mnyam pa'i sgo bzhi nas: pho brang bsrung ba'i sgo ma bzhi rnams la/ rnam dag: thugs rjes:ā+oṃ dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i mu khor yug tu: she na sa bdag bdag nyid re ma ti: bse lcags dung sogs skyes bu'i 'khor rnams dang : phur pa'i bsrung mar zhal bzhes thams cad: rnam dag=thugs rjes=ā+oṃ=zhes mthob srin nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor sogs dmigs pa gzhung gsal ba'i bdud rtsi thig gtor 'bul/ gnyis pa sman bshad bya zhing dngos grub len pa ni/ lha yi dam tshig rdo rje parmo la: rdo rje can gyi gsal bar hūṃ sgom ste: thabs dang shes bar 'brel pa'i phyag rgya yis: phan dang nus par ldan pa'i sman lnga la: dang du ma blangs rtogs pas spong len bgyis: lta spyod gzhung dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: mu tig dkar po dri med thig le dang : tsan dan smu po rma med pad+ma'i mkhar: gnyis med bde chen bde ba'i mchog la gnas: bse phor bkris mtshan ldan nang du 'khyil: bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyu ni byang chub sems:

bdud rtsi'i ngang ni mnyam pa nyid du gnas: bdud rtsi'i las ni rnam rtog bag chags sbyongs: bdud rtsi'i don ni skye shi gnyis med ngang : rgyal ba mchod nas dngos grub blang ba ni: g.yon pa'i mtshan 'dzin rdo rje'i thal lo las: mthe bong dang ni srin lag rtse sbyor te: bris pa bzhin du zla dkyil 'bru lnga bkod: lce yi dam tshig rdo rje pad+mo la: rdo rje can gyi gsal bar lhu bsgom ste: zos nas bla med byang chub myur thob shog: bdud rtsi lce stong dang gnas gsum thig lo byang zhing*/ kā sid+dhi īḥ wak+ka sad+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ: zhes dngos grub blang*/ bcu gsum sa gtor ma ma 'bul ba ni: hūṃ khams gsum rnam dag bhan+dha'i dkyil 'khor du: snang srid thams cad gtor ma'i phung por gsal: 'dod yon sna tshogs lha mos rab brgyan te: dam rdzas bha ling rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul: gtso dang 'khor bcas rdo rje phur pa'i lha: sho na sa bdag bdag nyid skyes bu sogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phul 'byung ba'i dus la babs: bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes su gsol: ma (61) hā bha ling ta la raṃ khā hi: bcu bzhi sa rak+ta tshar gsum gyi mchod pa la: dang po phyi ltar ni/ hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgogs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zungs shing rgyob shig rnam par chings: rtogs shig grogs dang phral bar gyis: rigs par khug la smrar chug cig: phob cig rnam par gzir bar bgyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang :bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par gyis: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: pho nyar bka' bsgo ba'i phyir 'bul/ gnyis pa nang ltar ni bram bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs: sngon chad tshul bzhin dam bcas pa'i: mngon spyod 'phril las myur du mdzod: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā: dam can gdan la dbab sa te dgrogs myur du bsgrol ba'i 'phril las bcol:

gsum pa gsang ba ltar ni ===sdang sems ldan pa rnams: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: bka' las 'dab byed sdig can rnams: rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas: lha yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur: thal ba rdul bzhis brlag par mdzod: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: khā thaṃ khā thaṃ: ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+wa: bco lnga pa 'dod don gsol ba ni: hūṃ srid pa phur bu bsgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub bla ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : kī lā ya yi dngos grub rtsol: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī ya sarba sid+dhi pha la hūṃ ā: bcu drug pa bsgral mchod ni ====chen po'i dus la babs: she na sa bdag bdag nyid sogs: sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs: mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: bdag rin rig 'dzin bsgrub pa po: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa yi: dngos grub rab chad byed pa'i bgegs: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam gyi ni 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag du bshig nas skyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod: ma traṃ ru tra sra bhan tsakra hūṃ phaṭa: ti hūṃ e s+pha ra phaṭ+wa: bcu 'dun sbyor mchod ni/ ====rdo rje chos dbyings las: ye shes rol ba'i gsang ba rung: thabs dang shes rang sbyor ba las: 'khor lo lnga yi dkyil 'khor: byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'dur gsal: bde chen mchod pa chen por bzhes: pad+ma yo gi ni: mu tra sra we sha ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: kun dha li en dza ling hoḥ bco brgyad bstod pa ni: ===dam tshag thugs dam chen po'i dus la babs:

mthing nag grub gsum (62) 'bar pa'i gzhal yas nas: mi gnas ye shes rdo rje gzhon nu ni: 'bar ba'i khro rgyal ma bcos rdzogs pa'i sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i tshul: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs shes bar yum dang sbyor: 'jigs byed chen po khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ni: thugs rje'i rang bzhin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad zhabs bzhi bgrad: bdud bzhi gdan du bting bas dpa' dpa' 'dra: rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pas sgog sgog 'dre: sku che yan lags rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra: zhal g.yas dkar la 'dzum pas bzhad bzhad 'dra: zhal g.yas dkar 'dzum pas bzhad bzhad 'dra: g.yon zhal dmar la gdangs bas gshe gshe 'dra: zhal dubs mthing la rngams pas khro khro 'dra: dug gsum zhal du gsol bas rngam rngam 'dra: rgyu drug thugs rje sgrol bas snying rje che: de 'dra'i khro rgyal chen po 'jigs sku yang : chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra: 'bar ba'i gar gu ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag drug g.yas g.yon mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams: rdo rje rtse dugs sa dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms: rdo rje rtse lngos rgyud lnga gnas su 'dren: ye shes me dpung 'khor ba'i bag chags bsreg: kha ṭ+waṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: ri bar phur pas khams gsum dbang du sdud: phyag gi yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: thal chen khrag dang zhag gi zo res brgyan: glang chen stag spags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol: thod sasbrul la sogs 'jigs pa'i sku la brgyan: kham nag ral pa srid gsum rtse mor 'bar: mthing nag 'bar ba'i ral ba'i ral pa'i chun 'phyang la: mthing nag le brgan dar gyi cen pan 'phur: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa g.yas g.yan gdengs: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs la 'tshal bstod: dbu la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga bzhugs: thugs ye shes 'bar ba'i srog dang bcas:

sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs rdzogs nas: khams gsum ma lus thams cad dbang du sdud: khro chung mtshon thogs mang po skar ltar 'phro: lhag pa'i lha rnams rdzogs la= dza= kham dbang phyug sku la nyer gnas shing : gsang ba'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku dog ut+pal mdog: dgyes bzhi zhabs gnyis yab kyi skod ma 'khril: phyag g.yas ut+pal yab kyi mgulpanas 'khyud: g.yon pas dung dmar gtso ba'i zhal du stob: rgyal rnams kun gyi sku la rdzogs par brgyan: gtso mo yum chen sku la phyag 'tshal: dzā: sprul pa chen po khyed kyi dus la babs: phyag brnyan chen po khyed kyi dus la babs: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs pa'i khro rgyal ma lus bzhugs pa ni: kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug gtum la rngam: sku smad lcags phur zur gsum med dbal 'phro: phyogs skyong dregs po khyed kyi dus la babs: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs pa'i khro rgyal ma lus bzhugs pa ni: kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug gtum la rngaṃ: sku smad lcags phur zung gsum me dpal 'phro: phyogs skyong dregs pa pho mo thams cad gzin: dbu skra thor tshugs srid gsum rtse la 'bar: mi sdug khro gnyer sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs: log par lta ba rtsad nasagacod sgrol: mcho ba zangs yag skye shi rtsad nas gcod: thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'bar ba'i phyag (63) mtshan bsnams: byams pa'i 'od zer rngam pa'i 'brug sgra sgraug: drag po'i thog 'bebs sngon gyi thugs dam ni: dregs pa'i bdud 'dul bgegs rnams brlab par mdzad: bsgrub pa po la dbang bskur byin chen phob: khyod kyi dam tshig thugs dam dus la babs: dur khro chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du mdzes: brjod med mi gnas khro chen 'bar ba'i sku: sgra las 'das pa drag po hūṃ sgra'i gsung : bsam dang bral ba sgrol snying rje'i thugs:

sgu gsum thugs yon rdzogs la= hūṃ ====nas thogs chen 'bebs mdzad pa: hūṃ dkar sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug rang rtags phyag mtshal bsnams: lha yi gdon tshogs 'dzoms la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ shar gyi phyogs nas dgra nas bgegs gzir mdzad pa: rnam rgyal bsnyems ma ltag dang bya rgod mgo: zhal gsum khyag drug rang rtags= gshin rje'i gdon tshogs 'joms la= hūṃ ===mtshams nas dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad pa: mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ti'i mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug rang = srin po'i gdon tshogs 'joms la: ===kyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs mching mdzad pa: rta mgrin gtum mo byi langs shud mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug rang = klu yi gdon tshigs= hūṃ nub byang mtshams nas dgregs 'gugs mdzad pa: 'dod rgyal mda' bsnyems spyang gi khro yi mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug= rlung lha'i gdon tshogs= hūṃ byang gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gnon mdzad pa: bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seng ge pha wang mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug= gnod sbyin gdon tshogs= hūṃ byang shar mtshams nas dgra bgegs stob mdzad pa: khams gsum gsod byed dom dang sro mong mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug= bgegs kyi gdon tshogs= hūṃ 'og gi phrogs nas dgra bgegs spor mdzad pa: stobs chen skyed byaid dred dang byi ba'i mgo: zhal gsum phyag drug= sa bad gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: kun kyang mthing nag 'bar ba chen po la: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med yum dang 'khril: phyag 'tshan sna tshogs mtshon lo 'dzin: kun kyang thugs kar phun pa 'drel zhing 'debs: zhal gdangs rjags 'drel rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: dbu sgra 'khyil zhing ag tshogs me ltar 'bar: sbrul rigs lnga dang thod rlon 'phreng bas brgyan: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdongs: dpa'i bo'i sku la stag sham brjid par gsol: gsol g.yon dpung par sprul pa khra thabs bgyed:

mgo brnyan phyag mtshan rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: lhag pa'i lha rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ===pa'i dam tshig thugs dam dus la babs: (64) mthing nag glu gsum e yi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs pa'i dpal chen mngon spyod kī li yā: mthing nag khros pa zhal gsum phyag drug: sta re rdo rje rgya graṃ phur pa 'drel: gcer bu gos med sbrul dang thod pas brgyan: khyod kyi lte ba man chad cha rnams ni: lcags phur zur gsum me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: mi khyed rdo rje ut+pal mdogs 'dra zhing : tshe srog len phyir tse mo a ru gsal: dub la rigs lnga thugs srog hūṃ du 'bar: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs ag tshoms me ltar 'bar: snyan nas 'brug sgrog spyan nas 'od 'phro zhing : shangs nas rlungs tshub zhal nas thog ser 'bebs: ma g.yos che mchog sku gsung thugs dam ngang: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la yā: srid par 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad kun: thabs kyi sgrol ba'i skal dang mi ldan yang : shugs kyi bsgal ba'i 'phrin las mdzad slad du: dbyer med sku gsung thugs su sgrol mdzad pa'i: sras mchog kī la yā la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gugs 'ching sdom dheg mdzad pa'i sgo ma bzhi: ma mo bcu gnyis bse lcags dung la sogs: thogs med 'phril las sgrub par mdzad pa yi: phur bsrung bka' bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcu dgu pa 'dzab khang dbye ba ni: hūṃ thug dam chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas: dngos grub chen po 'byung ba'i phyir: bsnyen sgrub 'dzab kyi thugs dam bskul: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing gnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom: nyi shu sa 'dzab bzla ba la gnyis dang po la lha nyer bar bsnyen pa/ ngan sngags nye bar bsnyen pa'o/ dang po ni bdag dang sras mchog gnyis kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ mthing nag gi mthar kī li ya'i sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od 'phros bdag gi sna bug g.yas pa nas mthon:

sras mchog gi sna bug g.yon par zhugs shing 'khor: yang bdag gi thugs kar 'khor ba sngags 'phreng 'gal me ltar bskor: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal nas kī la ya'i sngags sgra ldim gyi sgrogs shing stong khams thams cad khro ba'i sprul pas gang*/ de rnags kyis kyang sngags kyi sgra bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar 'di ri ri sgros par gyur pas bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā yangs sarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par bstas la skyon lnga spangs te bzlas pa la 'bad/ gnyis pa dam can nyer bar bsnyen pa ni: bdag dang sras mchog gnyis kyi thugs ka nas dam can 'dus pa'i sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzlas pas sngags kyi 'od zer s+ph+yogs bcur 'phros pas dam can rnams rang rang gi gnas nas rang dbang med par 'dus ci 'gyi'i bka' nyan gus 'dud du gnas par dmigs pas las la rngags 'khrug khros pa'i tshul gyis song nas dmigs bya gang yin lcags kyus bzung zhing mtshon chas (65) btab sha khrag rol zhing ming gi lhag mar btang bar gyur par bsam: ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ka taṃ yeḥ dza ye bi dza ye: a tsi te a pa ra tsi te: ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye: sarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces bzlas dam can nye bsnyen khyad par ba sogs gzhal las shes so: bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig chod 'dus pa'i drag sngags spru gri'i sngags ni: ū+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dzaḥhūṃ ā: ma rag mo yag mo: kā la ru pa: snying rtsa la laṃ yaṃ: snying rtsa khrol khrol: srog rtsa la tshum tshum: tsit+ta srog dung dung : snying khrag shad dzaḥ thum ril li li: snying rtseg rtseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha dhi ma ma: karma shri traṃ ka ra ye: ma ra sa ni: sra mar ta na ye hūṃ phaṭ+wa: zhes skabs su gang babs sbyar: gsum pa ngan sngags nye bar bsnyen pa ni:

dug phur nag po las byung ba'i las drug skabs su shes dgos pa yang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal rgyun mthong brgyud bzhin sbyor shes par bya'o/ gnyis pa skabs su babs tshe stong tshigs kyi mchod bstod kyang gzhug bzhin bya: rjes kyi rim pa la gsum las: tshogs mchod lhag ma thugs dam bskul: chad mod thun zur bro brdung dang : dngos sgrub gtong rag bzod gsol bsdu: rgyun spyod smon lam shis brjod bcas: dang po tshogs mchod 'bul ba la bdun gyis dang tshogs kyi yod ci 'byer ba dkyil 'khor nye logs zhi ngam gcan gzan pags pa'i stong bza' ba sogs g.yas dang*/ btung ba sogs g.yon du gshis la/ las kyi rdo rje bla ma dang dkyil 'khor las phyag byas te gsol ba btab ni: haḥ ===med dbyings las rang bzhin lhun grub pa'i/ gru gsum gathing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sprul 'khor bcas/ rang bzhan gnas nas gsan cing dgongs su gsul/ bsod nams ye shes shes tshogs chen sprol ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha dang mchod lcam dgyes bskongs phyir/ tshogs kyi yo byed bsham zhing 'bul lags na/ bzhes par ci gnang der 'dir bka' rtsol cig zhe gsol slob dpon gyis hoḥrdo rje gzhon zhu'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ rdo rje'i mchod dang lcam dral rnams/ tshogs bsogs sgrib sbyangs don slad du/ tshogs rdzas byin brlab 'bul bar bya/ zhes gnang ba sbyin gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sarba trab s+yaṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ tshogs kyi stong du raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gsal ba las me rlung chus dang dongs min gyi bag chags tshogs kyi rnam rtog ngan pa thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi stong du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba la oṃḥhūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/
ā+oṃ gyi 'od kyis rdzas rnams kun/ zhu nas du ma ro gcig 'dres/ āḥlas 'od 'phros ye shes kyi/ bdud rtsi ro bcud

(66) ldan par gyur/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis 'dod yon drug/ zad med chu gtor chen sor gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum yig 'bru gsum kyang zhu ba las/ ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir rgyur/ gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūṃ/ srid pa phur bu bsgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : kī la ya yi dngos grub rtsol: bzhi pa tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ dbal chan rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhir bcas: khro bcu za gsod pho nya'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: gha na tsakra sarba sdu tsa khā hi: lnga sa bar bas bshags pa byas ba ni/ ===bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: dam tshag chen po'i dus la babs: bdag cag ma rig lus ngag yid: bag med nyes pa'i skyon gyur te: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang : sras dang khro bo khro mor bcas: shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma: skyes bu ging dang dge bsnyen bcas: khyod rnams thugs dang ci 'gal ba: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: bshags pa gzhan yang spro na bya zhing yi ge brgya sa ci nus bzlas: drug pa tshogs tha ma'i bsgrol bstab ni rgyas bsdus gnyis las 'dir bsdus pa ste/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phur bsrung dam can pho nya'i tshogs la phog thugs rgyud bskul bas sprul pa'i kho nya nam mkha' gang bar 'phros te dmigs byas gang yid dbang med bkur nas ling gar bsdim par bsams shing*/ dgug gzhu byas la tshe khrus dgos pa dang ldan pas/ hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs:

sprul pa chen po dus la babs: phyag bsnyen chen po'i dus la babs: shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs: bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la= khyed kyi dam tshig dus la babs: mthu rtsal 'byung bi dus la babs: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rigs 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgraral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang :bsdul nyams su myong bar mdzes: sras mchog phur pa 'drel zhing : hūṃ chos chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: phur sa rol pa'i dungar khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: phur pa yongs rdzogs drag po'i 'phril las mdzod: hūṃ len rdo rje gzhon nu che: nga ni badz+ra kī la ya: nga ni khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dpal: sras dang sprul sa bye ba 'bul: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho rol bcasas: phur pa'i lha tshogs dus (67) la babs: g.yas kyi phyag nas phur pa sgril: gson gyi phyag na lcags kyu bsnams: dgra bgegs nyamasasha pa 'dir khug la: lcags kyu bzung la phur pas thob: rdzul phran bzhani du brlag par mdzod: o laṃ hūṃ laṃ stam+bha ya nan: mo ha ya bha ga wan: shi tri bhi tri: badz+ra hūṃ kā ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa : badz+ra kī li kī lā ya:dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sarba big nan: badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: badz+ra hūṃ kā ra a āḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lī ya: ma rag mo yag mo: kā la ru pa: snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: snying rtsa la khril khril: srog rtsa la chuṃ chuṃ: tsit+ta srog la dung dung : snying khrag shad dza: thum ril li li: snying rtseg rtseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha dhi ma ma karma shri traṃ ka ra ye:

ma ra sa ni: sra mar ta na ye hūṃ phaṭ+wa: 'grogs dam srid mā ra ya rmad sod: spro na khra bcu'i sngags kyang brjod la bsgral lo/ ling ro gtor mar bran la hūṃ/ phyis shig phyes shog khro rgyal zhal phyes shig: gnam sa gdangs sa tsam gyi zhal phyes shig: gangs ri ri gyi rno dbal tshegs gtsigs la: ljags ni klog dmar bar snang khams su skyong : mnyam nyid hoṃ khung 'bar ba'i zhal du bstas:'gag med rol pa chen po'i mgrin par bsdim: zhal du bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi: kha thaṃ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: phaṭ+waḥphaṭ+waḥphaṭ+waḥ badz+ra yak+sha kro ta khā hi khā hi: ha ha ha: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa phaṭ+waḥ bdun pa bskang ba bya ba ni/ mchod pa gso zhing sman raka sbran la/ hūṃ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha/ sras dang khro bcu khra thabs dang*/ sgo skyong phur bsrung bka' sdod tshogs/ thugs dam gnyan po bdag gis bskang*/ thugs dam bskang pa'i dam rdzas ni/ lha rdzas me tog bdug spos sogs/ phyi yi mchod rdzas tshar du dngar/ dang po mo tog gsumar chen sogs/ rang byung nang mchod brjed par bres/ sman kar bdud rtsi rgya mtshor bskyil/ sha rus bshos bu lhun por spungs/ mnyam sbyor dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed/ de yang stong nyid gzod ma'i klong*/ bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskangs/ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni/ sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med/ bsrung bzlog bsad sogs 'phris kyi/ drag po'i mthun rdzas kun tshogs pas/ thugs dam bskong dang dgra bo'i gshod/ mngon spyod 'phrin las kun 'grub pa/ skang rten sgrub rbad bskul ba'i rdzas/ ma tshang med pa thams cad kyis/ mkhar ltar khyab pa'i sku mnga' ba/ rin 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs dam=

snang srid phur bu gdab pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs=/ khasam gsum 'khor ba rgyas 'debs phyir/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs= mi dge bcu po tshar gcod phyir/ khro rgyal pha bcu'i thugs=/ dge bcu phar phyin bcu spyod phyir/ khro (68) mo bcu yid=/ phyogs bcur sprul pa bgyed pa'i phyir/ phra thabs nyi shu'i thugs=/ gdug pa'i dgra bgogs tshar bcod phyir/ sras mchog nyer gcig=/ 'phril las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sgo ma bzhi yi thugs=/ bstan pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod phyir/ phur bsrung bcu gnyis=/ las rnams myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bse lcags dung skyes thugs=/ mthu rtsal dmag dpung bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i=/ khrag nad rim nad bzlog pa'i phyir/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad=/ phyi nang 'khrul rtsod bzlog pa'i phyir/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig=/ dal yis skyen kha bzlog pa'i phyir/ bstan ma bcu cus= zab gtor bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ ldan lha mchod gsum=/ dgra la cho 'khrul 'bebs pa'i phyir/ dregs pa lnga bsdus=/ snang srid gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ snying skrung btsan po'i=/ chos kyi dkyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul phyir/ thugs rje khros te 'ong ba'i lha/ rdo rje gzhon nu dkyil 'khor pa'i/ thugs dam gnyan po bdag gis bskang*/ nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags/ mchog dang mthun mong dngos gru rtsol/ mngon spyod drag po'i 'phris mdzod/ ces bskang zhing bshags par bya'o/ gnyis pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsdus/ gtsung lhag dang bcas dpal gyi pha babs bzhag /bdud rtsi'i kha phru lag gnyis pad+ma sprub pa'i phyag rgyas bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u tsi ta ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ hoḥ dpal chen po rdo rje gzhin nu'i dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam can bsrung ma mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/

dpal chen po'i pha babs blang ba dang*/ 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir yud tsam zhig gis 'dir gshegs shig /rkang shug rol mo zhig gi g.yab mo dang bcas/ hūṃ dpal chen karma he ka'i: dpal bka' nyan lhag sdud tshogs: she na sa bdag re ma ti: bse lcags dung gi skyes bu'i tshogs: gde bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang : ma yis bstan ma bcu gnyis dang : dbang phyug chen mo nyer brgyad sogs: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad cing : sha khra srog la dbang yang mdzad: mkha' la rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'gro: rnam 'byor dam ldan grogs mdzad cing : ma nges rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan: dam nyams rnams kyi gnyer por che: legs nyes dam tshig rjes kyang gcod: khyed rnams dpal gyi pho nye ste: sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig can: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma long: dang po phud kyi mi mchod du: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang : khro tshogs dkyil 'khor phud la dgyes: tha la lhag mas mi mchod du: dam can khyod rnams lahag la dgyes: lhag ma kha chus mi bran du: khyed dang rnal 'byor g.yar dam gcig: tha ma gcig tu mi bsre ru: chos rnams ye nas sems su gcig: sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin: bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces phyir ro du steg gtsang (69) ma'i khar phul/ gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba las/ rig 'dzin rgyud bskul ni/ hūṃ ====mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi dus la babs/ phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rgya gar tsan dan nags tshal la/ ji ltar rtams brtan bsnyen laṃ ci/ phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzed cig /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra yis/ rgya gar chu bo gang la/ ji ltar = bal po shī la bañju yis/ maṇ+ḍa la yi mkhar gong du/ ji ltar= phur bu= mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ ni mkha'i pho rog nag po la/ ji ltar=
