phur bu = chos rgyal rat+na gling pa yis/ yang gsang dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ ji ltar= phur bu= gzhan yang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs/ rang rang bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog tu/ ji ltar= phur bu= ma gel 'phris rigs 'dzin rnams/ dpal chen bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i tshe/ mthu rtsal nus pa'i dpung bskyed la/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la babs/ dngos grub rtsol ba'i dus la babs/ byi gyis rlobs pa'i dus la babs/ phur bu bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskul ba ni gtor mar sman raka bran/ zhing spags kyi g.yab mo/ rnga dung rolo ma'i sgra dang bcas/ hūṃ chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal: chos dbyings rnam dag 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum: thabs shes sku las sprul pa'i khro bo bcu: rang bzhin dbyings las shar ba'i khro mo bcu: sprul pa las la mngags pa'i khro thabs tshogs: za gsod mcho ba rtags kyi gshegs sa can/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i sgo ma bzhi: gsod pa'i las mdzad phur bsrung bcu gnyis dang*/ bse lcags dung gi skyes bu la sogs te: phul ba'i bsrung mar zhal bzhes dam can tshogs: khyed kyi thugs rje'i thugs dam dus la babs: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bskul/ 'dir las byang rtsa ba'i sa khong 'dzin phyir de tsam gyis mthus la/ dam can bskul rgyas pa las dmigs bsal de dang de'i skabs su sbyor shes par bya'o/ bzhi pa bka'i chad mdo rgyas bsdus kyi gtor ma skyong ba ni/ gtor ma spags la sman raka bran zhing 'di skad gyer/ hūṃ sngon*/bstod bskul bgrub na bya tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min chos dbyings chen po'i pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: chos kyi dbyings nas kī la'i sgra sgrags tshe: ma mo mkha' 'gro bka' yi las mkhan dang : chos kyi bsrung ma dam can rgya mtsho yis: rang rtags srog gi snying po sngon du phul:

rang rang gzugs mchog mngon sum bstan nas kyang : dam tshig can la dngos grub rtsol ba dang : rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: sha khra dmar gyi gtor ma blangs nas kyang: bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis (70) grub pa dang : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: de 'og bar gyi dus tshigs gnyis pa la: bal yul yang le shod kyi dben gnas su: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng dang : mkhas pa chen po bi ma mi tra dang : ba su dha ra shākya dho ba sogs: bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rigs pa 'dzin rnams kyis: rdo rje phur ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs: phur pa'i bsrung dam bcas thams cad kyis: srog snying phul nas rang rtags mngon du bstan: rang rang gzugs mchog mngaun su=/ dam tshig can la dngos grub=/ rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar=/ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma=/ bcom ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par=/ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las=/ 'phris rnam bzhi lhun=/ rnal 'byor bcom ba'i 'phrin las=/ de 'og bar gyi dus tshogs gsum pa la: mon kha re ring seng ge rdzong gsum du: slob dpon chen po parma 'byung gnas dang : ye shes mtsho rgyal nam mkha'i snying po dang : rlung chen dpal seng rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis: lhag pa'i lha mchog phur pa zhal phye tshe: sho na sa bdag bdag nyid re ma ti: bse lcags ging dang phur bsrung thams cad kyis: rang rtags srog gi snying po mngon du phul: rang rang gzugs mchog=/ dam tshig can la=/ rnal 'byor tshe srog=/ sha khra dmar gyi=/ bcol ba'i 'phris=/ sngon tshe zhal bzhes=/ 'phris rnam bzhi=/ rnal 'byar bcol ba'i=/ de 'og dus tshigs bzhi la snyigs ma'i dus: rang snang chos nyid dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: tshe dbang rigs 'dzin brnyes pa'i pad+ma dang : smon lam las pad 'gro 'dul gling pa yis:

yang gsang bla med phun pa'izhal phyi tshe: bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skyong zhal bzhes pa'i: dam can bsrung ma bka' yi pho nya'i tshogs: mthu dang rtsal ldan pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis: rang rtags srog gi=/ rang rang gzugs mchog=/ dam tshag can la=/ rnal 'byor tshe srog=/ sha khrag dpar gyis=/ bcom ba'i 'phris las=/ sngon tshe zhal bzhes= /'phris rnam bzhi=/ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phril grub par mdzod: ces gtsang par 'bul la 'phris bcol: de nas bstan ma'i gnas su gtor ma skyong ba ni/ gtor snod bdud rtsis bshal zhing sman raka gtor mar bran la/ bh+yoḥ slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: sangs bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba bstan ma'i tshogs: gnon sbyin dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: kong btsun de mo g.yu bun khyung btsun ma: dmag gi rgyal mo zla 'od byang rgyal ma: bsen mo gser thang ma dang shan ting dpal: ra lo sman dang klu mo gzi 'bar sogs: khyed rnams sngon gyi bka' nyan dam can ma: bas yulpakha la shed kyi sa mtshams dang: bod yul rang gnas bden rtse so so ru: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phrong dang : slob ma mthu chen rlungs chen dpal seng gis: dkyil 'khor mtha' ru zhing chen chen gdan la bzhag: dbang bskur dam btags lce la bdud rtsi bzhag: dbang

(71) rtags cod pan re re spyi bor bzhag: lag tu rdo rje phur pa gtad nas kyang : gsang sngags rdo rje phur pa'i bsrung mar bskor: ma 'ong thar pa thob par lung yang bstan: dpon g.yog mang po sman phran 'bul dang bcas: dar gyi cod pan dar dbyings su ru ru: rgyan dang sel snyan mang po si li li: bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la brtsen: da dung khyed rnams 'jig rten ma 'das pas: ji srid thar pa'i lam mchog ma thob bar: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di long la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phril mdzod: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ: badz+ra li la ma kha kha khā hi khā hi: gtor ma gshegasashing bstan ma rnams bu smad g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs dang bcas dgyes bzhin gsol nas 'phros ci bcol byed pas bsam mo/ lnga pa zor 'phang ba ni/ drag las sogs kyi tshe dgos pa skabs bsdun gyis/ gtor mar dgug gzhug bya zhing dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i rang bzhin/ gtor ma'i stod cha lhar gsal ba la dmag lto'i tshul du 'bul zhing*/ hūṃ ==ni rdo rje gzhon nu che: 'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur zhing : nga las che batshan batshan su yang med: stong 'og phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi: sde brgyad lha klu gzhi bdag rnams: gtor chen mtshon cha'i zor 'phros pas: lus sems de na brlog par mchis: zor lam phyes la sku gzur cig: brnag pa'i dgra bgegs ma gtogs pa: thams cad kun la zor mi 'phen: kun kyang grogs mdzod dmag dpung bskyed: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyir: nyams pa'i dam nyams dgrogs 'di: rul phran bzhan du brlag par mdzod: ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan e dza bh+yo hūṃ: drag sngags brjod cing 'phangs pas dpal chen po'i sprul pa khro ba khro mo phur bsrung las byed pho nya rnams kyis dmag dpung nam mkha' gang ba'i lag na zer nad dug mtshon cha'i rang bzhin dgra bo'i yul mkhar la gnam lcags thog ltar brgyab pas mi nor bran g.yog yul mkhar dang bcas rdul du brlag nas dgra bo'i sha khra la brngam zas bgyis te ming gi lhag mar song bar bsam mo/

gtor snod bdud rtsis bshal la mchod/ drug pa rta bra bya ba ni gtor gzhogs ri rab 'og tu dgra bgegs dam sri bkug la dpal chen lha tshogs bro brdungs pas dgra bgegs mnan cing rdul du brlag te bskal par mi ldan bar bsam la sprau na las bzhi'i bro brdung bya gdos kyang*/ bsdu na 'di ltar/ hūṃ nga ni dpal chen ho ru ka: bcom ldan rde rje gzhon nu'i sku: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang rol: phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal yab yum bcas: phyag brnyan phra thabs sgo ma dang : sprul pa yang sprul dpag med bskor: gtum chen dus mtha' me ltar 'bar: ye shes tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrug: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: sku la dur khro chas rnams rdzogs: rdo rje'i gshog pa phyagos bcur gdengs: hūṃ gi 'brug sgra de ri ri: phaṭa kyi sgra skad chem se chem: (72) khro bo'i gar stab shigs se shig: rdo rje'i 'gros stabs lams se lam: gas su bskor te dgra la brdung : dgra ni dum bur gtub pa'i bro: g.yon du bskor te gtegs la brdung: bdud bgegs phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: g.yas g.yon thabs shes sri la brdung : dam srid thal bar brlug pa'i bro: bdud sde dpung dang dregs pa'i tshogs: gzhob rgod pas brjis pa bzhin: thal ba rdul du brlag par bya: bskal pa'i mthar tu stam bha yā: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags sham du/ ā+oṃ laṃ hūṃ laṃ stam bha ya: rak+sha mā ra ya nan: zhes brjod la khros pa'i rngams stabs kyis bro brdung ngo*/ bdun pa dngos grub bskul zhing blang ba ni: hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod: deng sang skya dang po shar: rdo rje srin po'i nam yang langs: lhag pa'i lhag khrod dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs yon 'phril las dang : mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub rtsel: thugs mchog dpal gyi be'u nas:

ye shes gsal ba'i nyi ma shar: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: lung ngag yid la sid+dhi hoḥ badz+ra ku mā ra kī li kī lā ya kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta d+dhi hūṃ: sarba sid+dhi hriḥ zhag grangs sbrel tshe nub mtha' ma la gtor rjas bdud rtsi sogs dngos grub tu blong ngo : brgyad pa gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni: hūṃ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: me tog bdug spos me dri zhal zas: sgra snyan la sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi/ kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dag gis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shasta sdu dza heḥ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ srid gsum gdug pa bsgral ba dang*/ nga rgyal zhen pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ rdo rje srin po'i tshogs bcas la/ rtse gcig kā ling dang yig brgya lan gsum brjod cing snying thag pa nas bshags/ bcu nyer bsdu bya ba ni hūṃ 'phrin las phur pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ bdag rmongs nongs pa ci mchis pa/ ye shes lha la 'dzin rtogs med/ 'khor du gtogs rnams bzod par gsol/ ā li kā dang yig brgya lan gsum brjod cing snying thag pa nas bshags/ bcu pa nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ gzhal yas khang mtha' nas rim bzhin 'khor kyi lha dang bcas pa gatsho bo la bsdu/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la/ ye shes sems dpa' yang thugs ka'i hūṃ la/ hūṃ yang gyen rdzogs su zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ de yang spros med chos kyi dbyings su bsdu'o/ de'i ngang ci gnas bzhag pas rtag pa'i mtha' bsal/ bcu gcig sa spyod lam ni chad pa'i mtha' bsal phyir/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ slar yang chu las nya ldang ba bzhin dpal chen po'i skur lam gyi gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: nyer gcig bzlas pas sku gsung thugs gso/ bco brgyad bzlas pas gzas pa so gso/

brgya rtsa brgyad kyis phur bu gso ba'o/ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ka pa tsa hūṃ: badz+ra tsakra tig na karma kā lā (73) ya dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa: rang lus rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lugs su gyon cing : mtshon cha lnga'i gur dang me dpung gi klung na gnas pas bar chad gang gis kyang glags mi brnyed par bsam zhing rtag chad phyogs bral rnam dag chos dbyings thig le nyag gcig tu rdzogs par bskyang ngo*/ bcu gnyis pa smon lam ni ===chos nyid kyi bden pa'o: gsang sngags kyi byin brlabs so: sangs rgyas kyi mthu'o: a bhi tsar+ya'i dus la babs pa'i brnag pa bde kho na'o: zhes dang*/ hoḥ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can kun/ bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ srid dang zhi las rnam grol mya ngan 'das/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang thob par shog/ bcu gsum pa shis brjod ni/ thu rje chen pos sgo gsum byin gyis brlab/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkris shog mthu stobs nus pas dngos grub char ltar 'bebs phur pa 'phrin las lha tshogs bkris shog rno myur rtsal rtsal gyis dgra bgegs thal bar rlog phur skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi bkris shog yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po ltar/ bsam don lhun gyi 'grub pa'i bkris shog gzhan yang rigs mthun shis brjod kyi phyogs kun tu me tog sil mas phyag pas bya'o/ smra pa gangs ljongs rgyal bstan nyin mor byed pa la/ gdug can nam mkha'i glang pos 'grib nye'i tshe/ gtor byed phur bu'i rlung dmar 'di brtsams pas/ 'gro kun bde skyid pad+mo 'dzum par shog /rgyud sde'i yang snying pad+ma'i gong khug ma/ khra brag rgyas btab yang gsang bla med chos/ dus babs rat+na gling pas spyan drangs pa'i/ 'phros phur pa'i yang snying 'di rmad byung*/ gang 'di'i las byang khrogs su sdib pa 'dir/ logs cha gang mchis rje btsun bla ma'i drin/ 'gal dang nor 'khrul gyur pa rang blo'i skyon/

tshe rabs sgrob pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig par/ bla ma lhag pa'i lha drung mthol zhing bshags/ dge 'dis khyab bdag bla ma zhabs pad brtan/ gsang chen theg mchog bstan pa rab rgyas shing*/ 'gro kun bde skyid dpal la spyod pa dang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang thob par shog /de ltar chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul rat+na glong pa'i gtor byen rdo rje phur yang gsang bla med kyi las byang khrigs su steb pa zhig dgos zhes 'brong dung bla ma dkon mchog byang chub bzang pos rje bla ma mchog la rjags bsgrigs gsol ba btab pa/ bdag la bgyis shig pa'i bka'i gnang ba rtsal ba dang du blangs te/ sngon 'gro'i skor rje dharma kirtis mdzad pa'i bde 'dus las byang nas blangs phur pa'i las byang gzhung dang sra khrid ga sprad pa'i lha bskyed skor go bde phyir tshogs lhug dang gzhung don ma 'phyugs pa'i khog tshigs sbyor cung zad bsrings pa sogs brjod bder btang*/ rigs mthun gzhan nas kha bskong dgos pas kyang bkang ste khrigs chags su bkod pa yang*/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang phyag bdag bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs med 'phris phyogs (74) las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i bkrin gyi 'tsho ba shākya'i dge sbyong bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ ming gzhan rig 'dzin mthu stobs 'od zer du 'bod pas 'bri chos phyug klung gi pho brang mi 'gur rdo rje spo'i re'i mig tshe dbang dga' 'khyil du sbyor ba'i yi ge pa ni no no dkon mchog bstan pas bgyis pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ (pa) ༄༅// dpal chen rdo rje gzho nu'i phur bsrung dam can gter bdag dang bcas pa'i mchod byang bsdus sa 'phrin las glog gi 'phring ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir phur bsrung dam can gter bsrung rnams kyi gsol mchod shin tu bsdus bya bar 'dod na/ lcags zangs bhan+dha sogs kyi snod gang yang rung bar dmar gtor zur gsum rtse mo bco lnga par/

'khor gru gsum bcu gsum gatsho bo'i sum gcig slob pas bskor zhing*/ mdun du zur gsum g.yon gcus/ g.yas su mkhar thab stong dmar gtor gtso 'khor lnga pa ra mgos mtshan pa/ rgyab tu bshos bu zur gsum pa/ g.yon du mkhar thab stong bdud bshos nag po/ btsan bshos dmar po/ klu bshos dkar zluṃ sbrul dkris can dang de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su mtheb rgyu grangs ci 'byor ba dang*/ bachang bu bdun gyi bskor ba la 'bru sman rin po che dkar mngar sha khrag gi brgyan pa/ gser skyems sman raka mchod pa dang bcas ba 'du bar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha'i snod du hūṃ yag zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma'i ngo bo dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la rnam pa 'dod yon gyi rol pa cir yang 'char ba zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyam mtsho cher por gyur pas bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin rlabs la/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros gtor mgron (75) dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum khro bcu khra byag za gsod sgo ma las byed phur bsrung dam can rgya mtsho gtor bsrung gi tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs spos rol dang bcas nam mkha' gang bar byon pas bsam/ hūṃ dpal len rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi dang*/ khro bcu za gsod sgo ma bcas bka' yi bsrung mar dam bcas shing*/ dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i g.yar dam can/ sho na sa bdag bdag nyid ma/ bse lcags dung gi skyos bu bzhi/ dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ ma tshogs dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ khyad par dregs pa lnga bsdus dang*/ lhang lha mchod gsum snying skalung sogs/ gtor bdag bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ ma lus 'khor bcas gshogs su gsol/ badz+ra pa ma ya dzaḥhūṃḥ khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas/ phur bsrung dam can gter bdag sogs/

sgrub cing mchod pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan hūṃḥ rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs dang*/ phur bsrung dam can gtor bdag la/ me tog bdag spos mar med dang*/ dri chab zhal zas rol mos bcas/ sman raka gtor tshogs dpag med dang*/ phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin/ dngos bshams yid bsrul la sogs pa/ kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ bzhes la rtsa ba yal lag gi/ dam tshig nyams chag mthol zhing bshags/ sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ dngos grub ma lus bdag la rtsol/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shasta sdu dza hoḥ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba sdu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi gtor mar sman raka bran la/ hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu yab dang yum/ sras mchog rigs bzhi khro chen yab yum bcu/ sprul pa'i phra thabs za gsod nyi shu dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i sgo ma rnam bzhir bcas/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhais la/ bsrung skyob tshe dbang mchog gi dngos grub rtsol/ dzabhoḥ dpa' chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ bka' yi bsrung mar dam bcas shing*/ dkyil 'khor bar khyabs skyong mdzad pa'i/ mthu rtsal can rnams gnas 'dir byon/ ====kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad ma/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma/ lcags kyi khyi mo ral pa can/ dpal gyi bka' nyan sho na bzhi/ dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phris mdzod/ bh+yoḥsrid pa'i rgyal mo re ma ti/ che zhes dpal ldan re ma 'du/ dpal dpal lha mo re ma dzaḥ srog gcod ljang nag re ma dzu/ bdag nyid chen mchod bzhi yang*/ dam rdzas gtor ma= rnal 'byor bcol==== (76) rje ya 'byin mthu mo che/ rdo rje de 'byin drag rtsal can/ rdo rje bse 'byin rdzu 'phrul ldan/ rdo rje phag 'byin gdug rtsub can/ sa bdag chen mo mchod bzhi yang*/ dam rdzas gtor ma= rnal 'byor ba'i= dzaḥdung gi skyes bu mi zad pa/

lcags kyi skyes bu mi sdug pa/ bse yi skyes bu rab 'jigs pa/ ki nag po me dbal 'jigs/ bse lcags dung gsum skyes bu bzhi/ dam rdzas gtor ma= rnal 'byor bcol= hūṃ dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i/ bka' yi pho nyan dang bcas pa'i/ dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang : bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mjod/ bh+yoḥ da la gyi bka' nyan las byed ma/ ma tshogs dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ sngon tshe ji ltar bro bor ltar/ dam bca' bsnyel du mi rung bas/ dam rdzas mchod gtor= 'phrin las thogs med grub par mdzod/ khyad par dregs pa lnga 'dus pa/ dka' po nor snyegs bdud mon pa/ btsan dang the'u rang sde dpon sogs/ 'than dang cho 'phrul gtong ba'i bdag /dam rdzas mchod= kha 'dzin sdong grogs male tshe mdzes/ rigs 'dzin pad+ma pam+bha wa'i/ zab gtor gnyer kha bsrung kha mdzad pa'i/ mthu chen lhang lha mched gsum ni/ bdud btsan klu sogs dregs pa'i 'khor/ dam rdzas mchod= zab chos bstan sa 'phel rgyas mdzod/ bzhengs shig snying klung btsan po bzhengs/ nga srid gsal ler ston mdzad pa'i/ sra bdag chen mo sra la byen mo bdag chen 'dir gshegs la/ dam rdzas mchom= mngon shes gsal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ dpal chen rdo rje phur ba yi/ bka' skyong bsrung ma dam tshig chan/ zab gtor bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can/ ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa yang*/ dam rdzas= rnal 'byor 'phrin las thogs med bsgrub/ hoḥ bka' bsrung gtor bdag 'khor bcas la/ 'phrin las gtan po bcol ba ni/ bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyis/ bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ khyod cag bdag dang dam tshig 'brel/ brten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring*/ mthun 'dod yon 'di na mchis/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis khyod 'bod na/ sdang byed dgra bo cham la phob/ gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs rdul du brlog/ bsam pa sgrub la re ba bskong*/ gzhis byes kun tu mel tshe mdzod/

mi nor phyugs gsum khyed kyis bsrung*/ chags che nyams nga mi mthun rkyen/ pha rol rbad 'dre rbod gtong dang*/ rmi lam rtags mtshan ngan pa sogs/ thams cad byad ma'i stong du bzlog /khyad par zab chos 'chad nyan dang*/ bsgom sgrub spel ba'i rnal 'byor la/ rtag bsrung skyob mi g.yel zhing*/ theg

(77) mchog bstan pa rin chen 'di/ phyogs brgyar spel brgyar spel ba'i 'phris mdzod/ 'phris bcol la gtor ma gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul/ zhes pa phur bsrung dam can gter bdag gi gsol mchod shin tu bsdus pa 'di yang bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs nye bar mkho ba'i las byang gi cha lag tu shākya pya bhik+ṣu shā sa na dhā ra sbyar ba dag bar gyur cig/ bkris/ zhus dag/ ltang lha'i yang gsang dril sgrub kyi dge bsnyen mched gsum gyi batshan de kha rang yin pas bdon cha tshig+pagasal ba bstod do/ (pa) chad pa mgon po kun bzang ha ru ka/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rab 'byims rgyud sde'i bsdud po rdo rje chos/ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'dzoms par shog /mkhasa'agrī gatsho mo las kyi dbang mo che/ yo ga'i bka' babs slob dpon sra ha ti/ snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod 'phring la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par= duspagasum rgyal ba'i yum mchog mkhar chen bza'/ 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen bai re'i zhabs/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug lang 'gro par/ gsol ba 'debs ngas bdud= zab mo gtor gyi sgo 'byed rat+na gling*/ rigs dang chos kyi brgyud 'dzin tshe dbang grags/ gang de'i rjes bzung ngag bdang grags pa la/ gsol ba 'debs so= zla med rgyal sras wagin+d+ra yi mtshan/ nor bu yongs grags dbang chen lhun grub zhabs/ rgyal ba'i myu gu sangs rgyas phun tshogs la/ gsol ba 'debs so= lam 'di'i srol 'dzin pad+ma dbang grags zhabs/ (78) gu rus byin brlabs karma chags med dang*/ grub pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang shes rab la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung= gdams pa'i rgyun 'dzin rdo rje bkra shis dang*/ grub la mnga' brnyais pad+ma rigs 'dzin zhabs/ mkhyen pa gnyis ldan karma dri med la/ gsol ba 'debs= rdo rje 'dzin pa dharma shrī bha dra/ rigs brgya'i khyab dag pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan dang/

bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ gsol ba 'debs so= rngam brdzid 'jigs ru drag po'i gzhal yas su/ dpal chen yab yum sras bzhi khro bo bcu/ yum bcas khra thabs phur skyong dam can la/ gsol ba 'debs so= de ltar gsol ba btab pas skye kun tu/ yongs rdzogs dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes bzung ste/ thog chen mthun mong mthun mong ma yin pa'i/ lam gyis sgo gsum mchog tu smin par shog /phung khyams skye mchod dman po 'tshid pa yi/ bag chags 'khrul pa'i bdud dpung sde dang bcas/ bde gshegs bdud 'dul khro be'i ting 'dzin gyis/ rnam dag dbyings su rmeg med 'joms par shog /nang bcud lha dang phyi snod gzhal yas khangs/ 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rnam par rol pa yis/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kun gyi/ rang bzhin sgro btags tsam du shes par shog rdo rje pad+mar mnyam par zhugs pa'i mthus/ 'byung ldog bcu drug dga' ba'i lang 'tsho'i dpyid/ mchog tu 'gyur ma med pa'i stong nyid dang*/ dbyer med bde ba'i dbyings su brtsen shog /btags pa'i chos kun skye med stong pa nyid/ gdod nyid nas 'og gsal bde chen las/ g.yo ba med pa'i rang rig mngon gyur nas/ khreg chod lta ba'i gdong tshad thob par shog /'gagamed rang rtsal 'od dang thig le dang*/ lu gu rgyud dang zhi khro'i snang gzungs bcas/ 'pho med chos nyid stong par nyer thim nas/ lhun grub snang bzhi'i rtogs pa mthar phyin shog /mtha' bral chos dbyings zab mo'i brub khung du/ gzung 'dzin tshad ma'i dgra bgegs kun bsdus te/ 'khrul med ye shes phur bu'i dpal bsnun nas/ 'dzin med sgyu ma'i dbyings su sgrol bar shog/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*/ snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pas/ dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /de ltar dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang rang ro'i chos sras kyi thu bor gyur pa gu ru ma hā sa mastas mdzad pa la kha bgegs kyi tshul du bris pa yang 'bri ban bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis so/

sarba maṅgalaṃ// (79) (pha) ༄༅// dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgo nas gtor bzlog gi las rim gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo shrī mahā badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ mkha' khrab spros bral gdod ma'i klong du kun tu bzang po chos kyi sku/ 'og min zhing gi gatsho ber bzhings sa rdo rje 'chang dbang logs spyod rdzogs/ bdud 'dul rnam gnon khrag 'thung dpa' bo rdo rje gzhon nu sprul pa'i gar/ sku gsum ngo bo rje btsun bla ma bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ chos kyi dbyings las ma rungs gdul ka'i 'gror/ tshad med snying rjes rab khros khro bo'i rgyal/ sgeg dpal drag shul rngags pa'i gzi brjed kyis/ bdud dpung 'joms mdzad dpal chen phur bus skyongs/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zab don bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ thugs kyi yol gor legs gtams mkhar chen gza'i/ yang zab gong khug khra brag rgyas btab chos/ 'gro 'dul rat+na gling bas spyan drangs pa/ 'phrin las drag po badz+ra kī lā ya'i*/ dmar chen gtor bzlogs gnam lcags thog gi mdas/ bdud dpung phyer 'thag las gzhung 'dir 'og do/ de la 'dir chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul rat+na gling pa khro mo brag nas spyan drangs (80) pa'i rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgo nas gtor bzlog bya bar 'dod na/ 'di nyid kyi dbang chen pos rgyud yongs su smin cing lung lag len la mkhas shing bsnyen sgrub nus pa 'thon pa'i sngags pas nyams su len par bya zhing*/ dgos chen ni gzhung las/ ltas ngan mi mthun chags che nyams nga dang : dal yams dus 'khrugs lha 'dre'i g.yos chen zug: sbod gtong rbad 'dre pha rol phur kha dang : mdor na mi mthun rkyen rnams gang babs kyang : ltas nang ma lus bzlog phyir gtor bzlog bstan: ces gsungs pa 'di la don rnam pa gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba nyer bsdogs su bya ba dang*/

gnyis pa 'phris dngos bzhi gyer ba dang*/ mjug las kyi mtha' brtul ba rnams so/ dang po la/ gang du bya ba'i gnas khang der/ las dkyil stegs bu ji ltar 'os pa'i khar dug khrag gi chag chag 'debs pa'i stong du ma ṭi gyi khog par mu khyud rim pa bzhis bskor ba'i su chos 'byung grwa mdun bstan mthing nag mu ran sngon po/ zla gaṃ dmar po: de mthar thod rwa dkar po rtsibs bcu sngon po/ rtsibs mchan ser po/ ma ṭaṃ sngo skye bris pa'aṃ/ ma 'grub tshe gang yang ralung ba'i g.yang gzhi gan rkyal gyi khar 'bru nag gi tshom bu dbus che ba gcig la mtha' bskor du bcus bskor bas kyang rung la/ de'i dubs su ma mañji'i khar lcags snod du 'bru gan gi ngar phye khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i dpal bshogs chen po phur rtse gyen bslang 'drab ba gcig la 'khor rang 'dra gtso bo'i sum cha gcig gi char sleb pa'i bshos phran bcus bskor zhing*/ mtshams rnams su ong skyu bcad kha phyir bstan ci mang dang de dag dug khrag gis byug cing*/ yungs kar gang bu/ mtsho/ rtsing bsnol rgyu ldingasha dung sogs drag brgyan rnams brjid can gyi rtser/ bag zan la srid pa'i bya khyung nag po khro zhal rdo rje'i mchu can/ gnam lcags kyi rwa sder me'i gshog pa spyi bor nor bu'i brgyan dang snod gcig tu phur bsrung gi gtor ma grub gsum che ba gcig la 'khor rang 'dra bco lnga dang ong skyu ci mang gis bskor zhing*/ mtshe yungs rtsang dmar sha khra gis brgyan cing 'phar spyang wa khyi nal bu (81) rta lug bya sogs nag po'i sha khrag /mar khu khrag zhag 'o ma/ stag gzig ras mo sogs srung ma'i mthun rdzas kyis bskor ba gtor chen g.yas ngos bkod/ zangs lcags rdzas gsar sogs kyi snod du/ nas nag sran nag bra nag rnams kyi rjen phyi'i zan mi mgo tsam byas pa cha gsum du bogs pa gcig la srin mo'i gzugs mi mo khrag gi ral pa can lag g.yas su dmar gtor/

g.yon du kong zer khyir bar bya/ zan cha gcig la mi mo khrag ral can bcu gsum byas pa gtso bo la bskor/ cha gcig kong zer bcu gsum byas pa gong gi gzugs sam gathor ma bcu gsum dang yel mar bskor/ sha khrag snying sna/ rin po che/ sman phud/ nya'i mkhris pa rnams bran pa gtor chen g.yon ngos sam gang bder bkod/ gtor chen gyi mthar bskor du mi bsad pa'i mda'aṃ/ dul pa'i shing la mda' mde'u phur gzugs gri lcags sam la byas pa bzhir/ khra'i sgro bskyen par gu gul byug la rnam par rgyas ba/ 'ug sgro dug grag gis byugs pa gshin rje/ bya rog gi sgro can sha chen byug pa rta mgrin/ srin bya'i sgro can tshil chen byug pa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rnams sgom zhing gde'u rnams sras mchog tu bskyed pa gnas phyogs rigs mthun gyis bkod/ thod ngan du bong*/ spyang tsher re lcags/ thar nu/ spyang dug dha du ra sogs dug sna tshogs tshad chang dang sbyar ba dug zor/ 'phung dur gyi sa sna tshogs la kong bu zur gsum rgya spangs sor bzhi pa phyir ro sol gyi nag po/ nang gri khrag btsag gis dmar por byug pa'i khar nyung dkar nag gi gang bu btsug pa nyung zor/ mi'i phyugs bsad pa'i rbab dho la dug khrag gis bh+yoḥbazlog rbad bris pa dho zer/ 'phung dur gyi pa sna tshogs la kong bu bcos pa'i zur gsum du mi rta khyi sog khrag sna tshogs dzad blugag pa khrag zer te de rnams bzhi'i re re'i gang byed kyang rung la/ shar lhor dug zor te rim bzhin mtshams g.yas bskor gyis bkod cing*/ mchog chen gyi gzhu dang*/ tshon skud kyi skud mo yang bshams/ gtor chen gyi mdun nas g.yas bskor du khrag chen gyi arga sogs drog mchod tshang ba dang*/ brub khung du spros na 'khor ling dug phur nag po'i gzhung ltar raṃ/ gtor bzlog rkyang par med kyang rung ste 'bru nag gi ngar phyi dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i nya bo ser bcu dbang po dad po dang cing rid pa lcags sgrog gis bcings sa gcig gi 'byor na che chung bcu bcug pa bzlog dkyil gyi lho natu bkod pa'i stong mañji'i khar e gdan sogs gang rung la/

rgyas par phur cha yongs rdzogs yod na dang*/ ma 'byor tshe gatsho sras gnyis mthus kyi gcig/ khro bcu la gcig khro bcu la gcig/ yum phur gcig /las phurag gcig rnams su bsdu zhing*/ de yang ma 'byor na sras phung dang las phur gnyis su bsdu'o/ dbye rdzas sam gu gul rgod/ bya 'ug gi dang sgro/ yungs kar/ shi skra dang tshon (82) sna'i skud pa/ dug sna tshogs khrag dang sbyar ba/ thod ngan du yungs dkar nag ke tshe shang mtsho/ til lcags zangs rbab rdo'i phye ma rnams khrag gis sbol ba'i thun rdzas/ gri mo'i co dngo ba'i gtun khung grub gsum dang*/ gri bo'i a dhog gri rkang gi yu ba byas pa'i gtun bu/ mi bsad kyi sgrol gri sogs gdab las kyi yo byad tshang ba dang*/ las dkyil 'khyi rgyabaṃ gang bder dam tshog gi bris sku sogs bkram pa'i mdun du stogs bu khebs ldan gyi khar yi mad 'di nyid kyi dpal gtor rang 'dra bcus bskor ba'i mtshams su mthob kyu sogs brgyan ldan dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma mkhasa' gro dang*/ chos srug gi gtor ma gang dgos/ khyed par phur bsrung gtor bsrung rnams kyi gtor ma sogs mthong brgyud ltar/ sman raka mchod pa logs kyi yo byad/ phyogs skyong gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma chad bstan na 'der dgos pa'i ye byad thams cad ma tshang ba med pa leg par bsags la bkod logs shing dwang spro bar bya'o/ gnyis pa 'phrin las dngos gzhi'i rim pa la gnyis las/ dang po brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i las byang gi skyabs sems nas bzung/ 'dzab bsnyen gyi bar gsal ba gsum dang ldan sapa gyer tshi gcig gi bdag dang dkyil 'khor gtor ma rnams 'don sgom gsal thobs par bya ste/ dper na me log gnyis la rang gi bzhin ras bstan na me log gnyis ka'i nang du bzhin ras rai lam laṃ 'char ba ltar gsal rdzogs ma 'dres par bskyod la bzlas pa rnams de dang de'i skabs kyi dmigs phyed par bya zhing*/

chos srungs spyi sgos kyi bskang gso dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa gsum bskang ba sogs rgyas par byas la/ tshogs la longs mi spyad par bzhag gong*/ gnyis pa la/ thug dam bskul ba/ gser skyems/ brub khung bskyed pa/ 'gug gzhug /bsgral las dngos/ bzlog gzhu+i rnams so/ thog mar thugs dam bskul ba la gsum las/ dang po rig 'dzin bskul ba ni/ rang nyid ku mā ra'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams chos kyi dbyings nas mngon spyod kyi las la bzhengs par mos la/ hūṃ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi dus la babs/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rgya gar tsan dan nags tshal la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnye laṃ ci/ phur bu bsgrubs pa'i grogs mdzod cig /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra yi/ gaṅga lha yi chu bo la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnye laṃ ci/ phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod gcig /bal so shri la mañju yis/ man+da la yi mkhar gong la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyin laṃ ci/ phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs= mkhar chen ye shes mtsho gyal gyis/ gung gi pho rog nag po la/ ji ltar brtags brtan bsnye laṃ= phur bu= chos rgyal rat+na kling pa yis/ yang gsang dkyil (83) 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ ji ltar rtags= phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs= gzhan yang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs/ rang rang bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog tu/ ji ltar rtags bstan= phur bu= ma g.yel ma g.yel rigs 'dzin rnams/ dpal chen bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i tshe/ mthu rtsal nus pa'i dpung bskyed la/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la babs/ dongs grub rtsol ba'i dus la babs: byin gyis rlob pa'i dus la babs/ phur bu bsgrub pa'i 'phris mdzod/ zhes bskul/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dam can bcas spyir bskul ba ni/ bdud rtsi sbreng zhing rak+ta 'phyar/

zhing spags g.yab cing/ hūṃ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal/ chos dbyings rnam dag 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum/ thabs shes sku las sprul pa'i khro bo bcu: rang bzhin dbyings las shar ba'i khro mo bcu: sprul pa las la mngags pa'i phra thabs tshogs: za gsod mche gshogs rdo rje'i gshogs pa can/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i sgo ma bzhi: gsod pa'i las mdzad phur bsrung bcu gnyis dang : bse lcags dug gi skyes bu la sogs te: phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes dam can tshogs: khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: dzaḥ dpal chen khyo rgyal rnams kyi bka' nyan zhing : bstan pa'i ru tra bsgrol bar dam bcas pa'i: phur pa'i las mkhan srung ma bcu gnyis dang : brnag pa'i las la ma g.yel dam can rnams: gsang sngags gnyan gyi srung ma mthu mo che: dpal gyi bka' nyan sho na mchod bzhi ni: lcags kyi spyang mo 'jigs pa'i mgo dgu ma: gser gyi 'phar ba myur ba'i lce brgyad ma: zangs kyi wa mo mgyogs pa'i rkang gsum ma: g.yu yi khyi mo zugs pa'i sgra sgrogs ma: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: rdo rje phur pa'i 'phris dus la babs: rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra byung na: las mkhan dmar nag dgra bgegs sgrol la shog: dzaḥdagra bo'i srog gcod re ti mchod bzhi ni: 'jigs byed mthing nag rdo rje ri ma tī: gsod byed ser nag rdo rje re ma ta: za byed dmar nag rdo rje re ma dza: srog gcod ljang nag rdo rje ri ma dzu: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: rdo rje phur pa'i 'phrir las dus la babs: rnam 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra byung na: las dmar nag mthu rtsal ma chung zhig: dzaḥsrog gcod nag mo bso yi bu mo bzhi: bdud kyi bu mo ya byin mthu mo che: gza' yi bu mo de byig drag rtsal can/ btsan gy-i bu lom bse byin rdzu 'phrul can:

kyu yi bu mo phag mo phag byin gdug rtsub can: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ rdo rje phur pa'i 'phrir pa'i 'phris dus la babs: rnam 'byor bdag la ma nyes dgra byung na: gdug rtsub can rnams las la da rgyugs shig: ma mo rnams kyi ming po ging chen rnams: 'dzin ging dparam po 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu thogs: 'ching gi nag po 'ching ba'i zhags pa thogs: sgrol ging dkar po sher gyi spu gri 'phyir: za ging sngon po dug gi mche ba can/ mgyog cig rgyug pa'i glaug dmar gdug pa'i tshogs: las byed drag shul can gyi dus la babs: khyod kyi mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: phur pa'i srung ma dam can las mkhan rnams:thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo ma g.yel cig: bh+yo: nyi ma rtsa bzhi'i dur khrod gnas kyi bdag: dpal gyi bka' nyan dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : dbang phyug nyer brgyad mthu dang rdzu 'phrul can: rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong ba'i dam can tshogs: dgra bgegs srog dbugs len pa'i las mags ma: dpal chen las mkhan tshogs kyi dus la babs: bdag ni phur pa bsgrub pa'i rig 'dzin te: khyed rnams phur pa'i srung ma dam tshig can: sngon tshe spalo dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: thugs dam dus la babs so 'phris mdzod: ces bskul la khro gtum rngams pa'i tshul gyis drag po'i las mdzad par bsams/ gsum pa phur srung dam can bskul ba ni: rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po dza yig gi rnam pa dpag med 'phros shing : lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas rang dbang med par bkun nas ci bgyis kyi las bsgrub par bsam la: bh+yoḥ sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' bzhin du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma yi: bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma: zangs kyi dza mo rkang gsum la: gser gyi 'khar ba lce brgyad ma: g.yu yi khyi mo ral pa can: nga ro 'brug ltar za zhing zug: kha rlungs srin ltar 'thul zhing 'thibs:

mig ni nyi zer bzhin du 'tsher: ban ni glog las 'khyug cing drag: spru ni mtshon cha'i rtse bas rno: de 'dra'i bzhon pa brjod tshul la: 'jigs pa'i mi mo bzang mo zhon: g.yas pa rdo rje thod 'phreng 'dren: g.yon pa lcags kyi phur bu 'drel: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: mu kha mchod bzhi'i dus la babs: dam nyams dgra bos bdag la badhos: brnag pa'i las la mthu ma chung : khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs: ma g.yel ma 'phang thugs dam can: ma tham ma tham badz+ra: su ru su ru badz+ra: mu ru mu ru badz+ra: dgra bgegs gdon byed 'byung po mā ya hū ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ bh+yoḥ byings byed ma la gnas bcas shing : rlung nag 'tshub ma'i sna 'dren ma: dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti: sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la: mi spags rlon pa sku la gsol: phyag g.yas spu gri 'bar ba bsnams: g.yon pa 'debs da phur pa 'gri la: dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs su chibs: 'dir byen thugs dam dus la babs: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: rdo rje phur pa'i bka'

(84) bsrung ma: mngon spyod las la mthu ma chung: dza bar snang khams su rten bcas shing : 'brug dang glog gi sna 'dren ma: dpal ldan lha mo re ma dza: sku mdog dmar na 'bar ba la: brtsod dmar la'u sku la gsol: khram baṃ lcags kyu g.yas na bsnams: sgrol byed phur pa g.yon na 'gril: chibs su chu glang sngon po chibs: 'dir byen thugs dam dus la babam: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: rdo rje phur ba'i 'phril las mdzod: rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa ster: bsrung ma ma g.yel ra mda' bzlog: dza: ri rab stong na rten bcas shing : sa dang ser pa'i sna 'dren ma: dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti: sku mdog ser nag 'bar ba la: rma bya'i thul pa sku la gsol: phyag g.yas gser gyi zer ba bsnams: g.yon pas 'debs byed phur pa 'gril: chibs su gser sha yu mo chibs: 'dir byen thugs dam du la babs: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: rdo rje phur pa'i bka' bsrung ma: ma g.yel ma 'phang las mdzod cig: dza: sa yi gling la rten bcas shing : kha ba bu yug sna 'dren ma: dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzu: sku mdog ljang nag 'bar ba la: chu dar thul pa sku la gsol: g.yas pa'i phyag na khram baṃ bsnams: g.yon pa 'debs byad phur pa sgril: chibs su rnga mo gwa pa chibs: 'dir byon thugs dam dus la babs: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: phur pa bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: dam nyams dgra yi bde ma ster: dam can bsrung ma ra mdar bzlog: hūṃ ma ma sa shi ku ru ma ti nya ka ra: yi dan dha dhi ma ma shri traṃ ka ra ye: dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭ+wa: dzaḥ bal yul ya byin yul la brten/ mar khu'i mtsho la mnga' yang mdzad: rdo rje ya byin mthu rtsal can: sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la: mthing nag ber chen sku la gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams: phyag g.yon 'debs byed phur ba sgril: bdud rta napa po chibs su chibs: 'dir byen nag mo las mkhan ma:

sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: 'dir byen bcol ba'i 'phril las mdzod: dzaḥrong gi de byin yul la brten: zhag gi mtsho ma mnga' yang mdzad/ rdo rje de byin rtsal mo che/ sku mdog ser nag 'bar ba la: dar nag ber chen sku la gsol: phyag g.yas gser gyi zhags pa bsnams: g.yon pas 'debs byed phur pa 'gril:chibs su gza' rta ser po chibs: srog dbugs len pa'i mthu mo tshe: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: brnag pa'i las la mthu ma chung : bcol ba'i 'phris grub par mdzod: dzaḥmang yul bse byin yul la brten: khrag gi mtsho la mnga' yang mdzad: rdo rje bse byin chen mo ni: sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la: b.re chen dmar nag sku la gsol: phyag g.yas btsan zhabs 'bar ba 'debs: g.yon (85) pa seng ldeng phur pa 'gril: chibs su batshan rta dmar po chibs: 'dir phyon dgra bo'i srog len ma: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhi nang du: phur pa bsgrub pa'i dam can ma: bcom ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: dza snye nam phag byin ya la brten: 'o ma'i mtsho la mnga' yang mdzad: rdo rje phag byin mthu mo che: bar chen sngon nag sku la gsol: g.yu zhags mchog phur g.yas na bsnams: gnam lcags phur pa g.yon na 'gril: g.yu rte sngon po chibs su chibs: 'dir byon thugs dam dus la babs: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra byung na: bsrung ma myur du dgra la bh+yo: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka'i bzhin du: thugs dam ma g.yel 'phrin las mdzod: ka taṃ ka ye: dza ye baṃ dza ye: a dzi te : a pa ra dzi te: ma ra sa ni: sra mar ta na ye: dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya la hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces drag tu bskul zhing gtor mar sman kar sbreng*/ rkang gi gzur bus rak+ta phyogs bcur 'thor: zhing gi g.yab mo g.yab de nas bse lcags dung gi skyes bu bzhi las la bskul ba ni/ hūṃ ye yi skyes bu gdug pa can: sku dog dmar nag 'bar ba la: skal la brgan bse khrab gsol: phyag g.yas zangs gra dmar po 'phyar:

g.yon pas seng ldong phur sa sgril: chibs su batshan rta dmar po chibs: bse yi ging chen kyis bskor: (86) 'dir byon thugs dam dus la babs: bcol ba'i 'phris grub par mdzod: hūṃ lcags kyi skyes bu ni: sku mdog sngo nag brjed pa la: dar nag b.re chen sku la gsol: phyag g.yas ral gri klad la bskor: g.yon pas lcags kyi phur pa sgril: chibs su spyang gi sngon po chibs: lcags kyi ging chen tshogs kyis bskor: 'dir byon thugs dam dus la babs: bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ hūṃ dung gi skyos bu chen po ni: sku mdog dpar ser brjed pa la: dar dkar 'dzol ber sgu la gsol: phyag g.yas shel gri zangs yag 'phyar: g.yon pa dugi phur pa sgril: chibs su seng gi dkar mo chibs: 'khor du shel ging tshogs kyis bskor: 'dir byon thugs dam dus la babs: bcom ba'i 'phris grub par mdzod: hūṃ byang phyogs ta ki nag po 'jigs: sku mdog sngon nag 'bar ba la: sku da dar nag ral ga g.yos: g.yas pas bdud kyi khraṃ baṃ 'phyir: g.yon pas bdud zhags nag po 'debs: 'khor du bdud po 'bul gyis bskor: 'dir byon thugs dam dus la babs: bcom ba'i 'bris grub par mdzod: hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub kyi: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs: mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la babs: bshan pa pho mo'i dus la babs: sgrol ging tshogs kyi dus la babs: dgra srog gcod pa'i dus la babs: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs: gang (87) brgya byin dkar mo in+d+ri gdengs: khyung gi mgo can dus la babs: rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: phu byug mgo can dus la= rdo rje ser mo khrag chen 'thung : dom gyi mgo can dus la babs: bdud rtsi dmar mo pad bum 'dzin: chu srin mgo can dus la babs: zla ba dkar mo pun dha 'dzin: sdig pa'-i go can dus la babs: be con mthing nag dbyug to 'phyar:

phra yi mgo can dus la babs: srin mo dmar mo dung khrag 'thung : wa yi mgo can dus la babs: za ba ljang nag bha su 'dren: stag gi mgo can dus la babs: ra gdong sngon mo zhags pa thogs: ra yi mgo can dus la babs: dga' ba dmar mo ka tar 'chang : bya rgod mgo can dus la babs: stobs chen dkar mo mthong gshol 'dzin: rta yi mgo can dus la= spyi spyod sngon mo spru gris gcod: byi la'i mgo can dus la babs: 'dod pa dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs: khyi yi mgo can dus la= nor bsrung dmar mo bum pa 'dzin: pu shud mgo can dus la babs: rlung lha sngon mo ba dan 'phyar: sha wa'i mgo can dus la babs: bum sna sngo nag lcags sgrog sdom: spre'u'i mgo can dus la= gsan byid ljang nag ral gri 'phyir: spyang mo'i mgo can dus la= me mo dmar mo sreg shing 'dzin: skyen bu'i mgo can dus la= phag gdong nag mo mche zhags bsnams: phag gi mgo can dus la = dga' byed dmar mo zhing chung za: khra (88) yi mgo can dus la babs: sna chen dkar mo thod khrag 'thung : ba glang mgo can dus la babs: chu lha sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin: bya rol mgo can dus la= gsus 'dzin ser nag dril bu 'dzin: skye ka'i mgo can dus la babs: khyed rnams dpal gyi pho nya ste: dbang phyug ma dang srin mo'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' la gnas: legs nyes kun gyis stangs 'dzin cing : dam tshig can gyi rjes gcod ma: 'dir byon rgyan gyi mchod gtor bzhes: mngag cig bskul ba nga yis byed: bcol ba'i 'phrin las khyed kyis mdzod: badz+ra ma nu rak+sha si bh+yo: sra ma ni bh+yo: ro'u tri ma bh+yo: ba na bhi bh+yi: ku ma ri bh+yo: in+d+ra ma bh+yo: ka la ma bh+yo: badz+ra bhi ku la ma bh+yo: a mṛ ta bh+yo: so'u me bh+yo: dan dha ha bho: rak+sha si bh+yo: bhag sha si bh+yo: tsa ka la ma bh+yo: badz+ra ra tri ma bh+yo: ru tro ma bh+yo: e ka tsa ra ma bh+yo: ma na ha ra ma bh+yo:

sid+dhi ka bh+yo: bha ya bhe bh+yo: ku ma la bh+yo: badz+ra ma ra na bh+yo: ag ne ye bh+yo: bha ra hi bh+yo: tsa mun tri bh+yo: u dha ma bh+yo: ba ru ni bh+yo: laṃ so dha ra bh+yo: dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya thun bh+yo: zhes bskul lo gnyis sa gares skyems gzung dpang bya ba ni: chad pa ma nyes ma yo'i: gzung dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhu: zhal lce snang srid 'dres chod: stong gi lha yang mi 'gugs so: stong na gnas pa'i lha rnams kun: mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la: do nub gzung dpang grogs mdzod cigaḥ bar gyi btsan bsrung mi 'gugs so: b.rag gyi btsan bsrung thams cad kyang : mchod sbyin gser skyabs 'di bzhes la: do nub gzu dbang grogs mdzod cig: bon gyi lha gsal mi 'gugs so: 'go ba'i lha lnga mi 'gugs so: lha gsas lha lnga thams cad kyang : mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di= do nub gzung dpang grogs mdzod cig: yul lha gzhi bdag mi 'gugs so: lhag srin sde brgyad mi 'gugs so: gzhi bdag sde brgyad thams cad kyang : mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di= do nub gzu dpang grogs mdzod= dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' byung nas: dam nyams las kyi tharam thug la: khyed rang ma nyes lha srin rnams: lus nang sems rtog ma chags par: bag zon byas la rang sar dngos: dam nyams 'dis nyes ngas ma lan: ma nyes ma yo yi shes lha: dam can rgya mtsho ra mda' ldog: srid pa'i lha 'dre grogs la 'chos: bdag la bsdos pa'i dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshegs: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dmad: dge ba bcu yi bsod nams bcag: yi dge'i las bcu dang du blangs: rdo rje slob dpon (89) sku la bsdos: mchod dang lngas dral yongs la brnyan: mtshams med lnga yi 'a bu smin: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'di yis pas: myur du sgrol ba'i 'phris mdzod: drin lan gtang rag khyed la gtong : bcom ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod:

zhes gsol/ gsum pa brub khung bskyed pa ni/ nya bo'i khebs phye phaṭa rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas e mthing nag chad pa mdun du 'bros pa las nya bo'i snod e las drag po chos kyi dbyings gshin rje'i zhing khams dbyibs grub gsum bang rim dgu dang ldan pa/ phyin nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ 'og tu 'odad chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khol ba/ nang du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ logs la nga rgyal gyi brag ri gzings pa/ steng du phagra donag gi sprin nag 'khrims pa/ gshin rje'i bshan pa rnams kyi bshas ra/ bdud po mi zan rnams kyi rkos ra/ btsan rgod khro gtum rnams kyi 'du ra/ gza' rgod gdug pa n+mas kyi lam srang*/ klu bdud gdug pa rnams kyi bang mdzod/ sha za 'dre mo rnams kyi thags ra/ lha srin sde brgyad sprin ldan gtibs shing glog ltar 'gyur ba/ las ngan thams cad smin par byed pa'i btsun khang mthong bas skyi g.ya' zhing thos pas 'jigs par byed pa de'i nang du: nṛ tri las dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra/ dkon mchog gi spyi dgra /rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra /mchod dang lcam dral gyi sdang dgra: rnam 'byor bdag gis sgos dgra/ dmigs pa'i yul du gyur pa yi la brnags pa'i dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba kha dog sngo zhing nyams rid pa hi skye bag rlul gyi sbags pa/ mig shi mig tu lta zhing kha nas 'o dod 'og pa/ lag g.yas brang brdung zhi g.yon skra 'bal ba/ rkang pa lcags sgrog gis bcings shing gan rkyal khrad mo mgo bo rang nyid la bstan la pa ba kha dug nas khrag 'dzags pa mogan skyesabs lha bsrung kyis spangs shing gsod byed bshan pa'i tshogs kyi mtha' bskor ba zhig tu gyur par bsam la/ bzhi pa bden stobs brjod cing 'gug pa ni/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho brgyud pa drug dang ldan pa/

ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun= gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin n+mas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyed par du yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ thugs kyi sras mchog rigs lnga*/ yang sprul nyi shu rtsa gcig bdud 'dul khro bo pha bcu ma bcu/ za byed kyi sprul pa bcu/ gsod byed kyi 'phra men ma bcu/ dkyil 'khor sgos skyong rnam bzhi/ bka' yi bstan bsrung shwa na ma mchod bzhi/ sa bdag ma mchod bzhi/ bdag nyid ma (90) mched bzhi/ bse lcags dung gsum skyes bu bcu gnyis/ bka' skyong dbang phyug nyer brgyad/ dam ldan dge bsnyen nyer gcig /bstan bsrung bstan ma bcu gnyis/ mthu chen ldang lha mched gsum dregs pa lnga bsdus/ snying skrung btsan po sogs dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs chos skyong bstan bsrung ma can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag cing rgyu 'bras mi chol mi bslung ba'i bden pa dang*/ ting 'dzin sngags rgod rdzas dang sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi nuspapa bla na med pas/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sangs ragayas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshegs pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bsda ba/ mchod dang lcaṃ dral la 'tshe ba/ rgyu 'bras bslung med khyed du gsod pa/ rnal 'byor pa bdag la do bsdo ba/ phod 'dzug pa/ ya kha sgrog pa/ khams ma nyes pa smra ba/ lag gis ma sbyin pa brku ba/ mi nga la lha med zer ba/ lha khyod la mthu med zer ba/ mthu bu lon bzhin du bsnyags pa/ yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs sdig can gang yin pa de dag gi dbugs bla srog rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa skad cig rang bdang med par*/ gla khyis ded pa'aṃ/

sbur ma rlung gis khyer ba ltar drag po'i rten gzugs liṅga 'di la da lta nyid du khug cig /a mu ka sarba rni tri badz+ra aṅku dza: badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: zhes bden stobs 'gugs gzhugs lan gsum bdun dgu sogs skabs bsdun gyi bya/ lnga pa bsgal ba dongs la drug/ rgyud las/ dang po lha phral gnyis pas dbab/ gsum pas byad gzhug bzhi pas smyo/ lnga pas rul brlag drug pas bstab/ ces dang re la phoṃ nya 'phyong sngags dang*/ dmod rdzas ting 'dzin las rdzogs bya/ zhes don tshan drug la nang tshan drug po se drug gis bsgral ba yin te/ dang po lha dang dbya ba ni/ hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs: phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la= shwa na mu khyi dus la= bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la babab: sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la babs: mthu tsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rigs 'dzin bdag can rnams la ni: gdon cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tsho ba ba rnams: rtogs shing grogs dang bral bar gyis/ oṃ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya dgra bgegs a sa ya ra tri ta na ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di 'og ba'i lha sogs mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha bsrung dang bral bar gyur cig /gu gul na po sogs dbye rdzas kyi dud pas bdug cing*/ thal mo rgya sprad pa'i bya 'ug gi sgos liṅg+ra dbye tshul bya/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dang rdo rje logs pa 'gong so 'khor bcas kyis dgra bo bsrung skyob byed pa'i lha rnams

(91) sran phung la dho brgyab pa ltar bskrad par bsam/ gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa ni/ ūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sprul pa chen po'i= phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la= shwa na= bdag nyid= sa bdag chen= khyed kyi= mthu rtsal= byang chub mchog tu= dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob= rig 'dzin bdag cag= gnod cing gdug pa'i= bdud dang bar du= dongs grub = phobs shig rnam par gzir bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: dgra bgegs dzaḥhūṃ ā we sha ya: ā we sha ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dam nyams pa'i dgra begs kyi rnam par shes pa blang dang bcas pa liṅga 'di la khug nas thim par gyur cig: yungs kar gyis brabacing*/ thal mo kha sprub la 'bebs tshul dang*/ dam gsum gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul dang*/ klu chen 'dzog po 'khor dang bcas pa lcags kyu thogs pa mang pos dgra bo rang dbang med par bkug nas liṅga la bsdim mo/ gsum pa rgyad du bzhugs pa ni/ hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs: phyag brnyen chen po'i= shwa na mu kha'i= sa bdag= khyed kyi dam tshags= mthu rtsal byang chub mchog= dus gsum rgyal ba'i= rigs 'dzin bdag cag= rin 'dzin bdag cag= gnod cing gdug pa'i= bdud dang bar du gcod= dngos grub khrog cing = bzung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po dzaḥhūṃ hoḥ shi tri ā na ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di yan lag gru gu thul du cings shig bsdoms shig: tshen skud sna lnga dang shin skras bgyig tshul bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul thams cad dang*/ srog bdag ging gi tshogs kyis lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog thogs pas dgra bo ri dwags rgyas tshud pa ltar thum rig gyis bcings par bsam/ bzhi pa smyo ru gzhugs pa ni hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ sprul pa chen po'i:

phyag brnyan= shwa na mu khu'i= bdag nyid tshen= sa bdag chen= khyed kyi= mthu rtsal= shuṃ ba= dus gsum= rigs 'dzin bdang cag= gnod cing gdugs pa'i= bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i= dongs grub 'phrog cing = rings par khug la smog chug cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: dgrogs dz+wa la sa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di smyo ru chug 'bog tu chug dran pa nyams par gyur cig: smo 'bru dang*/ dug sna tshogs kyis brab/ lag gnyis mkhrig ma sprad por mo rnams gzings shing bskor/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul dang*/ the'u rang 'gong po dang bcas pas dgra bgegs smo dug char ltar phab/ smo bskrangs dran med mu cor smra bar bsams/ lnga rul tu rlags pa'i khongs 'dir gdab las 'byung ste/ spro na phur pa byug bdug brab gsum gyin rlabs dbang bskur sogs rgyas (92) pa sgrub khog nas 'byung ba bzhin bya ste/ mi rta khyi dang gcan gzan gyi khrag re lcags/ spyang 'tsher/ ri sho/ bse zho/ btsan dug byar ba phur brtser byug cing gu gus tshe chen sbyar ba'i dud pa bdug hūṃ/ gu gul byin bskyed dgra bgegs bdug pa sgrol: yungs dkar dpar bskyed rak+tas gzi mdangs bskyed: mi bzad khro rgyal 'dus pa'i stobs dang ldan: gzi brjed dpal dang nus par ldan gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī shi kī lā ya: su ru su ru srang su ru sra ru: a taṣ+ṭha lugs lugs: ha la ha la dgra bgaigs 'byung po'i tsirta phyogs mā la ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra kī brjod kī li kī lā ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: ma gu ta la bhi sha taṃ bha ra tsa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ 'grogs 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭ+waḥ rak+ta phur rtser byugs la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: rak+ta dz+wa la man+dha la rak+sha rak+sha: 'grogs pa shi kar ru mā ra ya phaṭ+wa: ces brjod pas rjas dud sprin 'khrigs pa lhu gsale nas khro chung thog ltar babs pas bar chad dgrogs thal bar brlag rnam shes dbang du bsdus par bsam mo:

bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i phyag mthil g.yas a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ g.yon ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ g.yas g.yon por mo bcu la zla nyi sran tsham gyi stong du/ ā+oṃ āḥ hūṃ swā hā: muṃ laṃ maṃ saṃ taṃ rnam 'od du zhu ba phyag mtshan lnga gnas 'gyur nas rigs lnga yab yum bcu ru gsal bar gyur/ ā+oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma konya haṃ/ phur bu mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las yab yum rjes chags kyi badhas bskul bas/ sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+wi: phur pa thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ badz+ra a dz+nyā li/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems yi ge hūṃ du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ dzaḥ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sra mchog kī lā ya sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas phur bu dang*/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa sku smad gnam lcags kyis phur bu me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba rgya mdud gong 'og la khro bo gnyis lcum gzhog khro bo brgyad kun kyang yab yum khra thabs dang bcas pa/ rgya mdud 'og ma'i ngos bzhir sgo ma/ chu srin gyi 'og tu skyes bu bzhi/ dbal la dam can bcu gnyis te dkyil 'khor yongs su rjogs par gsal ba'i bdag dang sras mchog khro ba'i tshogs kyi spru khro chung mtshon cha thogs pa kī li ya'i sngags sgrog pas gtams par gyur zhes phur pa sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs dbang bskur ba'i tshe dbang nyid gatsho bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas bdag dang phur pa la thim pas stod nas phyin rlabs kyi 'brug sgra ldir/ rked pa nas ye shes kyi glog 'khyug/ chu srin dang dbal nas thog dang mo'i tshwa tshwa 'bro bar bsgom/ ser mo rgyab tu bsnol gung mo gnyis sgrong ba chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag ragayas phur bu bzung la/

hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun (93) gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyings su bdag bskyed cig: ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya badz+ra patwa dza ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod pas 'od zare 'phro 'dus rgyal bi byin rlabs thams cad phur pa'i spyi bor thims pas sradi gsum sgrol nus par bsal/ ser mo bsnol ba'i bar du phur bu 'drel zhing*/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung : ngang nyid rdo rje= 'bar ba'i khro bo= gsung gi dbyings = oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya wak+ka badz+ra hūṃ āḥ 'od zor spro bsdu gong bzhin gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus/ ljags rdo rje rgya gram kyi lte bar zla stong āḥ dmar po'i mthar kī la 'bru dgus bskor bas khams gsum sgrol nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par bsam/ phur bu thal mo rtings par 'dril zhing*/ hūṃ/ kun gyi ye shes thugs: ngang nyid= 'bar ba'i= thugs kyi dbyings su= ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya tsit+ta badz+ra hri da ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ 'od zer 'phro 'dus thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad phur pa la thim/ thugs rin po che mar gad las grub pa lta bu'i dubs su nyi zla'i stong du ye shes sems dpar rdor sems kyi thugs rin chen zur brgyad kyi dbus rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ la kī ra yas bskor bar bsam/ phur pa ye shes lngar byin rlabs pa ni: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba'i: sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir rtsol zhig: phur pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rgyal ba thams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phris las kyi byin rlabs ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā: yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs gnas gsum dang mgo bo'i gnas lngar thim pas yig 'bru lnga las he ru ka rigs lngar gyur te ye shes lnga'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas bsam/

ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā swa bhā wa at+ma konya haṃ: hā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a dar sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma konya haṃ: zhes byug bdu brdog gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur sgrub khog nas bsdus te bkod par skabs bsdun bya/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu phur sa sras mchog yak+sha kro ta/ liṅga dgrogs dongs te gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas bsras mchog phur pa lag tu thogs la/ hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sprul pa= phyag brnyan= shwa na= bdag nyid chen= sa bdag= khyed kyi thugs dam= mthu rtsal= byang chub mchog= dus gsum= gnod cing gdug= bdud dang bar du gcod=dongs grub 'phrog= khro bo khro mo'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag radul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ oṃ laṃ hūṃ laṃ sta m+bha (94) ya nan: mo ha ya bha ga wan: bhi tri shi tri badz+ra hūṃ ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa: badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ hoḥ sarba bhig nan: badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ badz+ra hūṃ kā ra hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ hūṃ kā ra hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ phur bskor bya zhing*/ ha'uṃ/ chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa/ phur pa yongs rdzogs drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod: hūṃ/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu che: nga ni badz+ra kī la ya: nga ni khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dpal: sras dang sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' bsdod rab 'jigs phor nyar bcas: phur pa'i lha tshogs dus la babs: g.yas kyi phyag na phur sa sgril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyu bsnams: dgra bgogs nyams pa 'dir khug la/ lcags kyus bzung la phur pas thob: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dza hūṃ āḥ

ma rag mo yag mo: kā la ru pa: snying rtsa la laṃ laṃ: srog rtsa la laṃ laṃ: snying rtsa la khril khril: srog rtsa la chum chum: tsit+ta sri+og la dudang dung : snying khrag shad dzaḥ thum ri li li: snying rtseg rtseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha dhi ma ma: karma shri traṃ ka ra ye: ma ra sa ni: sra mar ta na ye hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dgrogs dam sri mā ra ya rbad sod: zhes bzla/ de nas tshe khrul kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag dang phyogs bcu khro bo sras mchog sto dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi gnas gsum du āḥdakar po ri ri gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad spyan drangs a dkar po'i rnam par dkyil 'khor gsum la thim/ sgo gsum shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyang sa/ gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma grol nas sku gsung thugs bde chen byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ phur pa snying khar ma rol tsam du bzung la/ zlar yang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zare a'i rang bzhin can gyis rgyal ba mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshul 'dus gzas po'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas a'i 'od zare gyi bag chags ngan pa'i sgrob pa sbyangs par gyur*/ zhes khrul lung dang*/ spru gri 'i sngags bzla zhing phur pa snying khar btab la/ bzas po'i snying nang du tshe ba rgya 'dra ba'i dkyil na khrag gi sbal sa byi'u lan ma'i mgo tsam gyi nang na a 'od kyi thig le'i dubs su kun gzhi nṛ dud kha'i gzugs su gnas pa de la phur pha btab pas tshe'i rgya ral nas/ a nṛ thig ler bcas pa phur rtse'i hūṃ gi tsen gyis blangs te phur rtser dkar yer gyis byung ba phur pa bdag gi snying khar gtugs pas bdag gi snying kha'i a nri la thim pas tshe yi bsnan mar gyur te bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan par gyur par bsam pa ni tshe lung ngo*/ gnas spra la don gsum gyi dang po ni/ phur pa'i dbal nas bzung zhing klad la bskor bas/

khams gsum thams cad phur pa'i 'od kyi gang*/ slar tshul 'dus gzi brjed kyis stong khams gang bar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ (95) badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: nyer gcig bzlas pas phur bu gso/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum phur pas gang ba la phog /gnyes mchod phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa thams cad bdag la 'dus par gyur par bsams la/ kī la ya brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas bdag gso ba'o/ gsum pa ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ brjod pas/ bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugasaka nas 'od zer ba thag gzings pa ltar 'phros pa'i sna la dgra'i rnam shes a dkar po gsal ba de 'od zare gyi rta la bskyon nas/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gsum gyis/ 'og min du rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su bsdim pas thugs kar thim te dbu ma nas brgyud/ gsang ba nas yum gyi mkhas thugs kyi sras su gyur pa bsam la/ kī lā ya brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa ni dgra gso ba'o/ da ni gdab pa'i cho ga la thog mar khro bo bcu'i phur sa rnams rim par gdab ste/ hūṃ dam tshig= sprul pa= phyag brnyen= shwa na= bdag nyid chen= ba bdag chen= kyod kyi dam= mthu rtsal= byang chub= dus gsum rgyal ba'i= rig 'dzin bdag= gnod cing = bdud dang bar= dngos grub phrog= gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lha'i 'on te bdud kyang rung : nga la sdang bar byed pa yi: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byes: rnam rgyal ba dpral bar gdab la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: ha na ha na badz+ra: dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: thog ma' kun la 'gro bas/ dbyug sngon dpung gson/ da ha da ha badz+ra: gshin rje lte bar/ sa tsa pa tsa badz+ra: mi g.yod dpye g.yon/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra: rta mgrin mgrin par/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra: 'dod rgyal dbyam g.yas/ su ru su ru badz+ra: stobs chen gsang bar/ ka ti ka ye: khams gsum rnam rgyal dpung g.yas/ dza ye bi sha ye: bdud rtsi 'khyil pa snying khar/

a tsi te a sa ra tsi te: zhes las sngags kyis rim par gdab/ yum phur rnams bdag pa ni/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen/ sprul pa chen= phyag brnyan= shwa na mu= bdag nyid chen= sa bdag chen= khyod kyi dam= mthu rtsal= byang chub mchog tu= dus gsum rgyal= rigs 'dzin bdag/ rig 'dzin bdag /gnod cing gdug bdud dang bar du/ dongs grubabar chad byed pa'i bgogs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: bzung zhing rgyob cig rnam par chings/ rtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis: rings par khug la smras chug cig /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par gyis/ zhes bsnyen pa'i phur pa lte bar gdab la/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī ya hūṃ: pa ra big tan dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: thog mtha' kun la sbyar bas s+thor mo snying khar btab la (96) tshin+dha tshin+dha/ dur khrod ma dpung g.yas dang*/ gtun gung dpung g.yon gdab la/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ gtum mo mig g.yas dang*/ mda' bsnyems meg g.yon du btab la/ gh+ri ha na gh+ri ha na rlung 'byin ma gsang bar btab la/ ha na ha na/ gsod byed ma mgor btab la/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ sgra 'byin ma spyi bor btab la/ sarba a na ya/ skyod byed ya rkyang mthil du btab la/ ta thā ya ta thā ya/ zhes dang khra thabs nyi shu phur ba gdab pa ni/ hūṃ/ dam tshig= sprul pa/ phyag brnyan= shwa na= bdag nyid= sa bdag= khyod kyi= mthu rtsal= hūṃ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ klad pa tshal sa brgya ru khos: nyon cig dgra bgegs log 'dren tshogs/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya dgra bgrogs gnod byed gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ sa tsa sa tsa/ bhan dha bhan dha/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa/ thog mtha' 'ar ba'i/ de n+mas kyi g.yas gon du gdab/

hūṃ/ phyag brten chen po'i du la babs/ pu shud srin khro yi mgo: skya ka la sogs sgo ba bzhi: 'dzin 'ching sdom babadhog thal bar rlog: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la babs: gongan spyod drag po'i 'phris mdzo/: o badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: bhan dha ya bh+na dha yi bing bing bing hūṃ phaṭ+wa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: nam maḥs man+ta hring dgra dgrogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā yā: su ru su ru su sra su ru sra su ru hūṃ phaṭ+wa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya mā ra ya mā ra ya dgrogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dam can bcu gnyis lhun tshig bcu gnyis dang*/ dbang mo nyer brgyad yan lag mthil bzhir gdab la/ hūṃ/ byan dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams dang : mu ran khor yug la rngam zas byed: khyed rnams dpal gyi pho nya ste: rbad cing bsgrub ba nga yi byed: nyams pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phris mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ: ma ma shi ku ru: ma ti nya ka ra i dan ti/ ma ma karma shrīṃ ka ra ye hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ zhes btab thun rdzas kyis brab cing ral gris gtub bo/ rdul du brlag pa'i tho ba thogs la

(97) hūṃ dam tshig= sprul pa/ phyag brnyan= bdag nyid= sa bdag= mthu rtsal= byang chub= dus gsum= rig 'dzig= gnod cing = bdud dang bar= dngos grub 'phrog cing = lus ngag rdul phran bzhid du rlog: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas/ lha yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: thum rim ta ya ta tha ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: oṃ gha gha gha ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ: badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī li kī yā ya: badz+ra da rod lan dz+nyā pa ya nyi kā wāka tsit+ta badz+ra nan: kī li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dam nyams pa'i dgra dgegs chad pa rdul du rlag par gyur cig: gru sogs tho bas/ dpye mig gtun khung du'aṃ/ rdo rje'i thog chad pa bas gtun khung gru gsum du brdung ngo*/ se mo rtse sprad pa nang du bsnol/ mtho bog gyen du bsgrong*/ lag mthil lte sbyar gyis tshul kyang bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs sprul rol bdud 'khor dang bcas pas ri rab kyi tho bas rul du brlag par bsam: drug pa zhal du bstan pa ni: hūṃ dam tshig chen sprul pa= phyag brnyan= sa bdag= khyed kyi= mthu rtsal= hūṃ bdag ni rnal 'byor bsgrub sa po/ byang chub mchog= dus gsum= rig 'dzin bdag= gnod cing = bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral nas kyang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khra rus: zhal du bstab po kha ri khā hi: badz+ra pak+sha kro ta khā hi: ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: dgra bgegs gnod byed bhin+dha ya bhin+dha ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dam nyams pa'i dgregs kyi sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa lhag ma med par rol zhig: hoṃ gzar du ling ro tshogs lhag bcas bcug la lag gnyis mkhrig ma sbyor: ser mo rnams rtse sprad pa kha phye la stob bya zhing*/

dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du re ma tis stob rog byas te dgyes pa'i skan sgra ha ha dang bcas rol bar bsam mo/ slar yangs/ hūṃ phyes shig khyes shog khyo rgyal zhal phyes shig: gnam sa gdangs pa tsal gyis zhal phyes shig: tshems ni gang rim tsam gyi rna dbal bar tu gtsigs: ljags ni glog dmar bar nang khams su skyong : mnyam nyid hoṃ khung 'bar ba'izhal du bstan: 'gags med rol sa chen po'i mgrin par bsdim: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sa pā ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa la khā hiḥ (98) ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: mahā geṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: khā thaṃ khā thaṃ khā thaṃ: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa: ā+oṃ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha khā hi khā hi: ha ha ha: zhes lha rnams dgyes te bzhad/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes dngos grub rtsal/ phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa: kyis dgra bgegs dbyings su bsgral bar bsams la/ ling ro 'bul zhing phyed tsam lhag mar bzhag /cung 'ad las kyi mtha' bsdus lha mo'i zhal du bstab pa ni/ bdag nyid tshen mo'i dus la babs: mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la babs: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: bhin+dha ya dgra gegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi: 'byung ba lnga la khā hi: khams chen bco brgyad la khā hi: skye mched bcu gnyis la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes stob/ drug pa bzlog pa'i 'phrin las dngos la drug las/ dngo pa ling ro lhag ma 'bul zhi sman raka sbran la lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzlog bsgyur gyi 'phris thogs med mdzad par mos la/ hūṃ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma bcos rdzogs pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu ni: dbu gsum phyag drug mthing nag zhabs bzhi bgrad: zhal g.yas dpar po gyen du gzigs pa ni:

stong gi lha rnams ma lus dbang du sdud: lha yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: zhal g.yon mad po thur du gzigs pa ni: 'og gi klu rnams ma lus dbang du sdud: klu yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: zhal dbus mthing nag khyogs bcur gzigs pa ni/ s+ph+yogs skyong sde brgyad thams cad dbang du sdud: sde brgyad dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba ni: sradi gsum ma lus dbang du sdud par byed: snang srid g.yo 'gul sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams pa yis: sa dgu'i rtog pa rtsad nas gcod par byed: chos kyi bden pas sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga gdongs pa yis: rgyud lnga'i sems can gnas nas 'dren par byed: nyon mongs dug lnga sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: phyag g.yon ye shes me dpung 'bar ba yis: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i bag chags bsregs par byed: ma rig 'khrul 'khor sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: bar pa kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa ni: khams gsum 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod par byed: khams gsum g.yo 'khrug sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: mtha' gnyis re rab phur pa sgril ba ni: khams gsum srid gsum g.yo zhig 'gul bar byed: snang srid dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: zhabs bzhi don stab thur du bgrad pa ni: dregs pa thams cad zali gyi gnon par byed: rung tra'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: rdo rje gshog pas nam mkha' khebs sa ni: gza' dang rgyu skar dbang du sdud par (99) byed: mi mthun gdug rtsab ba'i dgra la bzlog: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs pa ni: ma mo mkhro dbang du sdud par byed: snang srid ma mo'i cho 'phrul dgra la bzlog: yum chen khro mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: snang sradi 'khor 'das ma lus skyes pa'i yum: snang srid 'khrul 'khor sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: chad pa gi phyogs nas khro chen hūṃ kā ra:

dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: tshangs pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog cig la bsgyur: shar gyi phyogs nas khro chen rnam par rgyal: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: dri za'i dmag tshogs bzlog cig dgra la bsgyur: shar lho'i mtshams nas khro chen dbyug sngon rgyal: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khra 'di rol la: me lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog cig dgra la bsgyur: lho yi phyogs nas khro chen gshin rje'i gshod: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bzlog cig dgra la bsgyur: lho nub mtshanams nas khro chen mi g.yo mgon: dam nyams dgra bo'i= srin po'i dmag tshogs bzlog cig dgra la bsgyur: nub kyi phyogs khro chen rta mgrin rgyal: dam nyams dgra= klu yi gdon tshogs bzlog= nub byang mtshams nas khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal*/ dam nyams dgra= rlung lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog= byang gyi phyogs nas khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: dam nyams dgra bo'i= gnod sbyin dmag tshogs bzlog= byang shar mtshags nas khro chen khams gsum rgyal: dam nyams dgra= dbang ldan dmag tshogs: 'og gi phyogs nas khro chen stobs po che: dam nyams dgra= sa bdag gdon tshogs= stong phyogs khro mo rdo rje sgra 'byin mas: dam nyis dgra bo'i klad khrag 'di rol la: stong gi phyogs kyi dgregs sgrol zhing bzlog: shar gyi khro mo rdo rje bsnyems ma yis: dam nyams dgra bo'i klad khrag= shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhig bzlog: shar lho'i khro mo rdo rje sder mo yis: dam nyams dgra bo'i klad khrag= shar lho mtshis kyi dgegs= lho phyogs khro mo dur khrod bdag mo yis: dam nyams dgra bo'i klad khrag= lho yi phyogs kyi dgrogs sgrol= lho nub khro mo rdo rje gtun khung mas: dam nyams dgra bo'i klad khrag= byang shar khro mo rdo rje gsod ma: dam nyams= byang gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs= 'og phyogs khro mo rdo rje bskul byed mas:

dam nyams dgra bo'i= 'og gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog: rdo rje phra men phag gi mgo bo can: kla khrag thogs nas za zhi rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro ba'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phris (100) stong gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men stag gi mgo bo can: ti ra baṃ chen za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon ma thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: 'phrin las shar gyi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men g.yag gi mgo bo can: rgyu ma thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cing yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro ba'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: 'phrin las shar lho'i dgra bgegs: rdo rje phra men sha ba'i mgo bo can: zhi chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cing yang bsgyur bi mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las: 'phrin las lha yi dgrogs= rdo rje phra men gzig gi mgo bo can: tsit+ta thogs nas za zhig rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro ba'i bka' bzhin= 'phrin las lho nub dgrogs bzlog tu= rdo rje phra men byi la'i mgo bo can: klad khrag thogs nas za zhing : cing yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha= khro ba'i= 'phrin las nu kyi dgra bgegs= rdo rje phra men seng ge'i mgo bo can: zhing chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: zhing chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha= khro ba'i bka' bzhin= 'phrin las byang gi dgra bgegs= rdo rje phra men dom gyi mgo bo can: gli snying thogs nas za zhing rgyug= cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon= khro bo'i bka' bzhin= 'phrin las byang shar dgrogs= rdo rje phra men dred kyi mgo bo can: yang lag thogs nas= phro ba'i bka' bzhin= 'phrin las 'og gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol:

bh+yo: bya rgod mgo can can mgyogs pa'i gzugs: skad cig nyid la dgra bgegs sgral: shar kyi dgra bgegs bzlog cig bsgyur: bya rog mgo can rig pa'i rgyal: dgra bgegs bla srog thabs kyi 'gugs: shar lho'i dgogs bzlog cig bsgyur: bya rog mgo can rig pa'i rgyal: dgra bgegs bla srog thabs kyis 'gugs: shar lhe'i dgregs bzlog cig bsgyur: 'ug pa'i mgo can shes bar can: nyams pa'i dgra bgegs thabs kyi sgrol: lho yi dgra bgegs bzlogs bzlogs cig bsgyur: khwa ta'i mog can dus la babs: rdzul stobs kyis dgra bgegs sgrol: kha wang mgo can thabs la mkhas: dgra bgegs bla tshe 'gugs la brtson: byag gi dgregs= sro mong mgo can yang rtsal can: dgra srog khug nas mchor mi 'gyur: byag shar dgra bgegs= rmigs bu'i mgo can mkhas la skyed: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la brtson: stong gi dgra bgegs= byi ba'i mgo can las la brtson: dgra bgegs bla srog sbar gyis 'dzin: (101) 'og gi dgre bgegs bzlog cig bsgyur: bh+yu+o: shar gyi sgom ma pu shud mgo: dgra bo'i snying nas lcags kyus bzung : shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog: lho yi sgo ma skye ka'i mgo: dgra bo zhabs pas 'ching bar byed: lho yid dgra bgegs bzlog cig bsgyur : nub kyi sgo ma srin bya'i mgo: dgregs lcags sgrog sdom par byed: nub kyi dgra bgegs bsgyur zhing bzlog: byang gi sgo ma khra yi mgo: dgrogs dril bus smyos shing 'phul: byag gi dgra bgegs bzlog cig bsgyur: shar gyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la yas: dam nyams dgra bgegs lcags kyus 'debs shing bzung : shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad zhi bas bzlog: lho yi sra mchog rat+na kī lā yas: dam nyams dgra bgegs zhabs pas 'ching zhing 'debs: lho yi dgregs thams cad rgyas pas bzlog: nus kyi sras mchog parma kī lā yas: dam nyams dgra bgegs lcags sgrog 'bar bas sdoms:

nu kyi dgra bgegs thams cad dbang gis bzlog: byang gi sras mchog parma kī lā pas: dam nyams dgra bgegs dril bus smyos shing phul: byang gyi dgregs thams cad drag pos bzlog: hūṃ zhan ni sraud kyi dam can pho nya mo: lcags kyi spyang mo mibazang brngags pa la: 'jigs pa'i ma mo lcags kyi mgo can zhon: lag na lcags kyi phur pa dgra la 'debs: sho na mu khyed kyi dus la babs: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: gser gyi 'phar ba 'jigs pa'i lce brgyad ma: de la ma mo gser gyi mgo can zhen: phyag g.yas gser gyi phur pa dgra snying 'debs: si ma lu kha chen mo'i dus la babs: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog pa'i 'phril las mdzod: zangs kyi kha mo rgyug pa'i rkang gsum ma: 'jigs pa'i ma mo zangs kyi mgo can zhon: zangs phur sgril bo'i snying la 'debs: shwa na mu kha chen mo'i dus la babs: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: g.yu yi khyi mo mi bzad ral pa can: gson byed ma mo g.yu yi mgo nang zhon: g.yu yi phur sa sgril zhing dgra snying 'debs: rab 'jigs si la mu kha'i dus la babs: dgra bgregs sgrol zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: hūṃ ni ni gung gi las byed dam can ma: srid pa'i ma mo ral pas stong khams khyab: phyag na phur pa 'gril zhing 'debs: chags su drel rta rkang gsum mgyogs la chibs: 'jigs byed re ma ti yi dus= ltas ngan sna tshogs sding ba'i dgra= ser nag brjid pa rma byi rma bya'i thul pa can: gser gyi zor bas lo thog phyags mas 'debs: chibs gser sha yu mo mgyogs ma chibs: za byed re ma ti dus la babs: chags che nyal nga sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: dmar nag sku la brtsod dmar la'u gsol: khram baṃ lcags kyus dgegs thal bar rlog: chibs su 'jigs pa'i chu glang sngon po chibs: 'phung byed re ma yi dus la babs: rma lam mtshan ltas ngan dgra la bzlog:

ljang nag sku la dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na khram baṃ nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: chims su ltas ngan rnga mong gwa pa (102) chibs: las mkhan re ma ju yi dus la babs: rigs nad dal yams sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: hūṃ nam ni ro rangs dus kyi las mkhan ma: mthing nag ral pa lcags kyi phur pas khebs: phyag na gnam lcags phur pa 'gril zhing 'debs: srid pa'i bdud rtag nag po chibs su= rdo rje ya ya phyin chen mo'i dus la babs: srid ma mgo'i khram dam dgra la bzlog: ser mo gser phur ral bas bar snang khyab: khyag na gser phur zhags pas 'ching zhing 'debs: gza' rtam dmar 'bar chibs su chibs: rdo rje de byin 'jigs pa'i dus la babs: ltas ngan 'phung thabs sna tshogs dgra la bzlog: dmar mo bse byin bse yi ral pa can: lcags kyus bzung nas seng ldeng phur pa 'debs: klog dmar shugs can 'jigs pa'i rta la chims: rdo rje phag byin mthu rtsal dus la babs: ltas ngan ye 'phrog snang ba'i dgra la bzlog: hūṃ shar phyogs srin po'i skyes bu ni: dkar po phyag na phur pa 'gril: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: rbod gtong rbad 'dre dgra la bzlog: lha phyogs gshin rje'i skyes bu ni: nag po phyag na phur pa 'gril: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: phur kha zer kha dgra la bzlog: nub s+ph+yogs 'dud kyi skyes bu ni: dmar po phyag na phur pa 'gril: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: chags che nyam nga dgra la bzlog: byang phyogs gnod sbyin skyes bu ni: sngon po phyag na phur pa 'gril: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: dam kha yams nad dgra la bzlog: hūṃ shar bdud dkar po mche ba chan: phyag na dung gi phra pa 'gril: shar gyi skyes bu'i dus la babs: ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra la bzlog: lho bdud sngon po ral pa can: phyag na g.yu yi phur pa 'gril: lho yi skyes bu'i dus la babs: ye 'greg sum brgya dgra la bzlog: nub 'dud nag po zhags pa can:

phyag na zhags pa phur pa 'gril: nub gyi skyes bu'i dus la babs: glo bur dgu bcu dgra la bzlog: byang bdud ljang nag ral gri can: phyag na ral gri phur pa 'gril: byang phyogs skyes bu'i dus la babs: dus min 'chi ba dgra la bzlog: hūṃ sra ma ra tsa srin po'i ging : dkar po phyag na phur pa 'gril: shar gyi ging chen dus la babs: ma mo'i dam yams dgra la bzlog: ya ma ra tsa gshin n+dzi'i ging : ser po phyag na phur pa 'gril: lho yi ging chen dus la: gshin rje'i khram kha dgra la= dha sha d+gh+ri ba bdud kyi ging : dmar po phyag na phur pa= nub kyi ging chen= klu yi gting ring dgra= yak+ṣa gh+ri wa gnod sbyin ging : sngon po
