(103) phyag na phur pa 'gril: byang gi ging chen= gzang yi ki kang dgra la= hūṃ dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig ni: sha khrag srog la longs spyod cing : dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la brtson: lha 'dre'i g.yos chen dgra la= smug nag g.yag gi mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyug bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol: bzlog cig bsgyur ba'i dus la babs: dmar ser sbrul gyi mgo bo can: phyag na spru gri bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra ba'o+i snying la rol: bzlog cig= sngon nag chu sridan mgo bo can: phyag na baṃ bhan+dha bsnams: dag nyams dgro ba'i snying la rol: bzlog cig= sngo nang chu srin mgo bo can: phyag na baṃ chen bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyis dgra bo'i dbugs la rol: bzlog cig: sngo skye sdig pa'i mgo bo can: phyag na glo snying bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgro ba'i srog la rol: bzlog cig= ser nag khri yi mgo bo chan phyag na be con dung dmar bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i glong snying rol/ bzlog cig bsgyur ba'i= mthing nag stang gi mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyung bh+na dha bsnams: dgra bo'i rgyu khrag long la rol: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i= mdar nag bya rgod mgo bo can: phyag na lcags sgrog bhan dha bsnams: phyag na rdo rje bhan dmar bsnams: dgro bo'i skye mchod bcud gnyis rol: bzlog cig bsgyur= namar nag khyi yi mgo bo can: phyag na tsit+ta bh+na dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad rol: bzlog cig= dkar dmar pu shud mgo bo can: phyag na pad+ma bh+na dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i yan lag lnga la rol: bzlog cig= ljang por sha ba'i mgo bo can: phyag na zhing chen bhan dmar bsnams/ dgra bo'i snying khra rtsa la rol: bzlog cig= dmar nag khwa ta'i mgo bo can: phyag na rnge'u chung bhan dmar bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo la rol: bzlog cig= ljang nag srin bya'i mgo bo can bo can: phyag na rgyu zhags bhan dha bsnams:

'phung thab sna tshogs dgra la thong : bzlog cig bsgyur= dmar ser phag gi mgo bo can: phyag na sbrul zhags dung dmar bsnabs: 'je rigs bco brgyad dgra la phob: bzlog cig= ser nag kang ka'i mgo bo can: phyag na rgyu zhags bhan dmar bsnams: sbyo ba'i nad lnga dgra la phob: ljang nag ba glung mgo bo can: srin bya'i mgo bo can: phyag na rgyu zhag bhan dmar bsnams: phyag na rgyu zhags bhan dha bsnams: 'phung thab sna tshogs dgra la thong : bslog cig bsgyur= dmar ser phag gi mgo bo can: phyag nas sprul zhags dang dmar bsnams: mje rigs bco brgyud dgra la phob: bzlog cig= ser nag kang ka'i mgo bo can: phyag na rgyu zhags bhan dmar bsnams: smyo ba'i nad lnga dgra la phob: bslog cig= ljang nag ba glang mgo bo can: phyag na zhing ba (104) bhan dmar bsnams: mtshon 'khrul lceb gri dgra la mthong : bzlog cig = nga skye bya rog mog bo can: phyag na zangs gri bh+na dmar bsnams: sngo skyas bya rog mgo bo can: phyag na zangs gri bhan dmar bsnams: dus 'khrug mtshon cha dgra la thong : bzlog cig bsgyur ba'i= sngo nag sre mong mgo bo can: phyag na 'khor lo bhan dmar bsnams: yams nad sna tshogs dgra la thong : bzlog= dmar dmar rta yi mgo bo can: phyag na mthong gshol bhan dmar bsnams: dam yis dmag 'khrug dgra la thong : bzlog cig= dkar ser byi ba'i mgo bo can: phyag na spru gri bh+na dmar bsnams: dam yams rigs nad dgra la thong : bzlog cig= ser mo skye ka'i mgo bo can: phyag na dril bu bhan dmar bsnams: khra nad rgyu gzer dgra la phob: bzlog cig= nag mo khu byug mgo bo can: phyag na lcags kyu bhun dmar bsnams: dal yams sna tshogs dgra la phob: bzlog= sngon mo ra yi mgo bo can: phyag na zhags pa dung dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod: bzlog cig= dmar po spro'u'i mgo bo can: phyag na lcags sgrog bhan dmar bsnams:

ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la thong : bzlog cig: ljang nag skye ka'i mgo bo can: phyag na dril bu bhan dmar= gtad khram sel nad dgra la bzlog: bzlog= dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad pa'i: ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan sngar ru: bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes shing : dgra bgegs sgrol bar dam bcas pa'i: khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel bar: brnag pa'i las la mthu ma chung : gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: brnag pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol: bzlog cig bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig: pha rol rbod gtong rbad 'dre bzlog: chags che nyams nga thams cad bzlog: lhas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig= ye 'brog sum brgya drug bcu bzlog: glo bur dug bcu rtsa gcig= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i rnams bzlog: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams: rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa= rbod gtong rbad 'dri thams cad bzlog: byang zor gtod kha thams cad= lha 'dre'i dam kha bab pa= gnam la bya rgod sder 'dzings= sa la gcan gzan mche 'dzings bzlog: yul du wa spyang du ba= 'ug pa ha ha rgod pa bzlog: srin byas ro phyungs zer ba= srod la khyil byas 'bod pa= nam gung 'og rtag 'tsher ba= tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba= stong nas gza' skra dam kha= 'go nas klu nas yi gting ring = bar nas sde brgyad g.yos pa= bzlog cig dmar chen gtor mas: bsgyur ro ma nyams dgra la= ces bzlog khazhung drag tu btang btang = gnyis pa rtsang bzlog bya ba ni gtor chen lcags ri'i rtsa nga phung la dbigs te/ hū rtsom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kī: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen lcags ri la: sprul (105) pa'i pho nya mang po mngags pa'i rten: dmar na ga rtsang phung zhur gsum pa: bsnol thabs srin mo 'gros su btsugs pa ni: nyon mongs gdugs pa ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags: sprul pa'i phyags brnyen rtags kyi phyag rgya gsal: gdug pa'i rtsing phur zhur gsum rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:

yang gyi rtse mos chos nyid dbyings su 'bigs: mar gyi rtse mos rgyud drug gnas su zug rked pa rgya mdud khams gsum don dang ldan: stod kyi rtse mo zur gsum gdug pa'i me stag 'bar: smad kyi rtse las gdug pa'i me 'od 'phro: rked pa rgya mdud mtshon cha'i gur du phub: yang gyi rtse mos ri gyi thog ser 'bebs: mar gyi rtse las mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub: rked pa rgya mdud lha yi pho brang bcas: dmar nas rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs: bcang phur rngam stabs khrobs se khrab: rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur sha za 'anyigs se 'jib: rtsang phur khrog 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur rus 'cha' chems so chem: las mkhan po rnams kyi thugs dam dus la babs: bar chod sol la rkyen rnams bzlog: dgregs byad ma rul du rlog: bzlog cig dgra bgegs dmar dpung bzlog: sa ma ya byang dang rigs sngags bzlog: hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgal he ru kas: 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kun cig nyid la zhi mdzad de: thugs rje zhi ba'i 'phron las kyis: gnod byed dgra bgegs byas ma yi: rigs sngags rbod gtong zhi bar mdzod: shar phyogs gtoram chen lcags ri la: btsugs pas thams cad zhi bar 'gyur: zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: gnod yed dgra bgegs bar chod dang : rig sngags rbod gtong byad stobs rnams: zhi mdzad bcom ldan he ru kas zhi bar mdzod: ā+oṃ badz+ra shu+i he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: zhi bar gyur cig shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhi mdzad rno dpal bcang phurang gyis: yang gyi rtse la dung gi seng nge 'gying : sprul pa'i seng ges tham mkha' gang : g.yu ral sngon po spron ldan gtibs: seng ge'i ngar skad lhubs se lhab: mar gyi rtse las chu srin mche ba gcig: sprul pa'i chu srin bsam mi khyab: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs skan sgra brdob: rked pa rgya mdud me 'brug rlung 'khrug rgyug: sprul pa 'brug gis bar snang gang :

'brug sgra chom chom glog mo 'gyur: zhi byed rtsang phur srin 'gros su btsugs: rtsang phur rngam stabs khrabs se khrab: rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur sha za 'jigs se 'jib: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsa phur rgyus 'cha' chems se chems: las mkhan pho ny+paranams kyi thugs dam dus la babs5 bar chod sems la rkyen rnams bzlog: 'grogs byad ma rul gu rlog: bzlog cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog: gsod cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung gsod: bzlog cig rigs sngags byad stoms bzlog: sa ma ya byad ma rigs sngags bh+yo bh+yoḥbazlog bzlog: hūṃ/ chad pa dpal chen khro rgyal hu ru kas: 'jig rten khasam ni thams cad kun: skad cig nyid la rgyas mdzod cig: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i 'phrin las kyis: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: tshe dang bsod nis rgyas par mdzod: rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med: gser ram ser po'i shing rnams la: rgyas pa'i rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs: rked pa rgya mdud grub bzhi gzhal yangs khang : he ru ka yi skor bsgoms te: dgra bgegs byang ma'i sha za la: lho phyogs gtor chen lcags ri la: btsugs pas thams cad rgyas par 'gyur: rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: rgyas mdzad hu ru kas rgyas par mdzod: ū+oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭ+wa: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa thams cad rgyas par gyur cig: puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas mdzad rna dbal rtsang phur gyis: yar gyi rtsa la mtshal dpar po mtshong : stag mchong 'dzum mdangs shig se shig: mar gyi rtse phag rgod mche ba gtsigs: phag rgod ngural sgra 'ur ru ru: rkod pa rga mdud dre me rabal gsigs: dri mo'i ral pa yongs se yongs: rgyal mdzad rtsang phur srani mo 'gros btsugs: rtsang phur rngam stabs khrabs se khrob: rtsang phur gar gar stabs khrims se khrig:

rtsang phur sha za 'jibs se 'jib: bcang phur khrag 'thung ru ru: rtsang phur ru 'cha' chems se chem: las mkhan kho nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus ba babs: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: bar chod sel la rkyen rnams bzlog 'gregs byad ma rul du rlog: bzlog cig dgregs dmag dpung bzlog: bsod cig dgregs byad ma gsod: bzlog cig rigs sngags byad stebs bzlog: sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kas: 'jigs rten khams ni thams cad kun: skad cig la dbang du sdud: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog: rgyal blon rje 'bangs 'bru bcud sogs: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud: dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med: zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams la: dbang gi rtsang phur zur gsum rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: rkod pa rgya mdud zla gi gzhal yas khang : rgyal blon rje 'bangs 'bru 'acud sogs: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud: dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med: zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams la: dbang gi rtsang phur zur gsum rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: rkod pa rgya mdud zla gi gzhal yas khang : he ru ka yi skur bsgom pas: dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha la za: nub phyogs gtor chen lcags ri la: btsugs pas thams cad dbang du sdud: dbang du ma 'das gang yang med: tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rnams: bdang mdzad ha ru ka dpal gyi dbang du sdud: oṃ (106) pad+ma shrī he ru ka ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: rgyal blon rje 'bangs 'bru bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus shig: sa shaṃ ku ru ye swā ha: dbang mdzad rno dbal rtsang phur gyis: yang gyi rtse la gser gyi gzig mo ngur: gzigs chen nyer sgra 'ur ru ru: mar gyi rtse la dom nag mche ba gtsigs: dom chen ba thabs se thab: rkod pa rgya mdud g.yu yi spyang mo ngur: g.yu spyang ngu 'bod lhangs se lhang : dbang gi phur sri mo 'gros su btsugs: rtsang phur rnam stabs khrabs se khrab:

rtsang phur gar stabs khrims khrig: cang phur sha za 'jigs se 'jib: rtsang zur rus 'chang chems chen: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi thubs dam dus la babs: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon dbang gi: bar ched rkyen rnams bzlog tu gsol: dgra bgegs rbayad ma rdul du rlol du rlog: gsod cig dgra bo byad ma gsod: bzlog cig rags sngags byad stobs bzlog: sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kas: 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kun: skad cig nyid la brlags par mdzod: sdig can dgra bo rgya ma 'di: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phris kyis: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phril kyis: thams cad ma lus brlagar par byed: brlag par ma gyur gang yang med: brlag par ma gyur gang yang med: lcags gsam drag po'i shing rnams la: drag po'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: rked sa rgya mdud zur gsum gzhal yangs khang : he ru ka yi skur bsgom pas: ā+oṃ karma shri he ka hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dgregs byad ma brlags par mardzod: mā ra ya phaṭ+wa: drag po las kyi rtsang phur 'di: gser mig 'khyis la 'khyil li li: gdug pa drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: yang gyi rtse la bya glag mang po 'dzum: bya glag 'dzum chung cungs se cung : mar gyi rtse la lcags kyi pho rol 'gyed: pho ros 'gyed khrabs khrab: rged pa rgya mdud gser gyi 'ug pa 'khun: 'ug pa hūṃ sgra dir ri ri: gser m-ig 'khyil sa 'khyil li li: gdug pa drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: mar gyi rtse la lcags kyi bor rogs 'gyed: pho rog 'gyed sgra khrabs se khrab: rtsang phur gar stabs khrigs se khrig: rtsang phur sha za 'jigs se 'jib: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur rus 'cha' chems se chom: rtsang phur rno dbal zangs se zangs: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la babs: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: bar chod sel la rkyen rnams bzlog: dgrogs byad ma rdul du rlog:

bzlog cig dgrogs dmag dpung bzlog: gsod cig dgra bgegs byad ma gsod : rigs sngags byed stabs 'di dus la babs: sa ma bh+yo bh+yo: bzlog bzlog: gdug rtsub drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: yar gyi rtse mo gdug la rtsub: mar gyi rtsa mo dbal dang ldan: rked pa rgya mdud bh+ruṃ las grub: zur gsum sku gsung thugs su grub: ngos gsum rigs gsum ngo bor brdungs: rked pa rgya mdud gzhal yang khang du brdungs: yang gyi rtse mo ngar dang ldan: mar gyi rtse mo dbal dang ldan: gdug bcum drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: byang ma gsod pa'i mtshon rang brdungs: dbang drag rtsang phur yang rtse la: lcags kyi ser ba khral la la: dbang drag rtsang phur yang rtse la: lcags kyi ser ba khral la la: dbang drag brtsang phur mar rtse la: mtshal gyi khu 'phang shar ra ra: rked pa rgya mdud zur gsum la: khrag gi char sel le li: rno dbal zur gsum yang rtse la: g.yu yum dud 'thul 'phyur ru ru: rno dbal zur gsum mar rtse na: rtsang phur yang gyi rtse mo na: las mkhan tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs: rtsang phug mar gyi rtse mo na: ma mo mkhro'i tshogs kyi sa gzhi gang : rtsang phur rgyu rgya mdud zur gsum la: hūṃ phaṭ+wa 'brug sgras stong gsum khengs: dmar nag rtsang phur srin mo 'gros su btsugs: rtsang phur rngam stabs khrabs se khrab: rtsang phur gar stabs khris se khrig: rtsang phur sha za 'jibs se 'jibs: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur ru 'cha' chems se cheṃ: las mkhan mo nya rnams kyi thugs dam dus la babs: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: bar chod sol la rkyen rnams bzlog: 'grogs byad ma rlung du rlog: bzlog cig dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlogs: gcod cig dgra bgegs byad ma gsod: rigs sngags rbod gtong thams cad bzlog: sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo: de ltar mnga' gsol mchod pa yis: da ni bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: bzlog cig mgon po'i mthu byed bzlogs:

gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog: mgon po'i sbyin bsreg byed pa bzlog: ma mo'i thun zor 'phon pa bzlog: yungs kar khro bo'i rbab zor bzlog: byad ma lha dang bcas pa bzlog: ban+dhe yongs kyi sngags zare bzlog: dge slong 'char ka'i par su bzlog: klu bdud nag pa'i gtad khrims bzlog: zhang zhung btso dmar 'phen pa bzlog: bon po yongs kyi ltar byed bzlog: mu staigs ngan sngags thams cad bzlog: ma mo'i ngan sngags dmod pa bzlog: rgya gar chos kyi mthu byad bzlog: drangs srong dmod pa 'dor ba bzlog: phra men ma yi ngan byed bzlog: sum pas glang dmar rmo ba bzlogs: bod kyi rbod bya gtong byed bzlog: bram zer ngan sngags dmon pa bzlog: dri zas myos shing 'thibs sa bzlog: rgyal pos smau 'bogs gtong ba bzlog: srin mos shid kha gtongs ba= klu yi byed du bcugs pa= bdud kyis khram la btab pa= btsan gyi zhags pa 'phen pa= gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debs pa bzlog: 'byung pos myul le byed pa= tshe zer yungs zer 'phen pa bzlog: the'u rang srid la brku ba= glo bur ye 'breg byed pa= 'byung pos god 'dre byed pa= pas se rags srid la bkru ba bzlog: pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre bzlog: ma tshan nang gi stong 'dre bzlog: bdud btsan yongs kyi yungs zer= ma mo yongs kyi rims nad: nad dang tshog gyi drung bu bzlog: rigs nad gag lhogs gzer gsum= mi nad yongs dku thams cad= yangs kyi bdud du g.yos sa bzlog: mas kyi sri ru langs pa= phang khu'i srin can langs pa= ma sru'i sgab 'dre byung ba= byis pa'i chung srid langs pa= gson pos bdud dug g.yos pa= gshin gyi ngur srin thams cad= rus la tshigs nang slong ba bzlog: gnag la mchil ngan 'thab pa= rta na nor nad thams cad= lo dgra btsa' dang sad ser= ye 'bres sum brgya drug cu bzlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: skog chen sum brgya drug cu=

ltas ngan nyis khri chig stong = bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= phyi yi bar chad khyi ru gzhil: nang gi bar chad nang du gzhil: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su gzhil: sa ma ya: bh+yo bh+yo/ bzlog bzlog sgyur cig: ces drag tu btang : gsum pa khyung pa khyung bzlog bye ba ni: dpal chen ku mā ra'i dbu gtsug tu khyung 'bar bas brgyan pa las khyung mang po 'phros ltas ngan thams cad gshog pas badhabs rwa yis brdung mchung brkos nas bzlos nas bzlog par bsgom la/ hūṃ khrod rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu che: dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku: dur khrod cas kyis sku la brgyan: phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams: khro chung nyer gcig sku las sprul: sangs rgyas thams cad pa'i sku: sprul pa'i khyung chen stobs po che: dbu yi steng na brjod par brgyan: lcags kyi rwa dang mchu sder can: g.yu yi gshogs pa dmar zlum 'bar: khro bo'i spyan gyi sdang mig gzing : khyung gi ral ral pa sprugs pa las: yul gyi ma mo bcum bskyed: nag mga' smug nag 'thigs pa'i byad: dred mo ral 'dzings ltar ngan bzlog: stag seng 'dzings ba'i ltas ngan bzlog: gshog ru 'bar ba gsum la byad: dbyig gi nor bu'i ltas ngan bzlog: g.yas kyi gshog ru lnga pa la: ta kṛta khro bo bcu gsum shar: ri rab mo chen 'ched pa'i byad: lci ba'i zas kyi ltas ngan bzlog: g.yon gyi gshog ru dang po la: srog rtsa'i ma mo bdun du shar: rgya mtsho dug sbrul 'khyil ba'i byad: me

(107) tog bcud nyams ltar ngan bzlog: g.yon gyi gshog ru gnyis pa la: ye ka drag po spun drug sprul: mkha' la stag mo 'phyo ba'i byad: rji bas bskyed pa'i ltas ngan bzlog: g.yon gyi gshog ru gsum pa la: srin mo 'bar ma bdun du shar: mkhan la bya rgod sder 'dzings byad: gter gyi bcud nyams ltas ngan bzlog: g.yon gyi gshog ru zhe+i pa la: gdong mo bzhi dang rgyal mo bzhi: g.yu sha rwa bcu 'dzing ba'i byad: song ge du 'bod ltas ngan= g.yon gyi gshog ru lnga pa la: nyi shu rtsa brgyad sprul pa byung : rno dbal ngar gyi ltar ngan dang : rma bya g.yeng ba'i ltas ngan: g.yu sgong sngon bcu 'jigs ba'i byad: seng ge ngu 'bod ltas ngan= g.yon gyi gshog ru lnga la: nyi shu rtsa brgyad sprul pa byung : rno dpal ngar gyi ltas ngan dang : rma byas g.yong ba'i ltas ngan= g.yu sgong sngon po yang ba dang : lcags kyi ser ba 'bab pa dang : shel dkar snod dug g.yos dang : zangs sgong dmar po 'drel ba dang : mi bzad 'bar ba klud la bskor: nyi ma sprin gyi 'khrogs pa dang : 'tshub ma mang po'i mig ltas dang : seng ge gangs kyi stongs nas lhung : shes gyi sgo nga yang ba dang : sprin chen yang ba'i rtags bstan dang : dbang po'i bcud chen zags pa dang : dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi: ltas ngan bcu gsum slor la bzlogs: phyug gi 'jung gi 'jug sgro brgyad po la: rgyal mo bzhi dang gdong mo bzhi: sprul pa 'od kyi phripa 'od kyi phreng ba shar: se sgong khra bo'i zur bstan te: lcug phran zer gyis 'debs sa dang : gza' skar 'khrugs pa'i byad byung ba: zer brgyad rtsa la sbud pa chags: de yi ltaras ngan slar la bzlog: hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ki'i: khyung gi ltas ngan bzlog pa ni: rwa yi rwa can ltas ngan bzlog: mchu yi mchu can ltas ngan bzlog: gshog pas gshog can ltas ngan= gdong pas gdong can ltas ngan bzlog: hūṃ khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃ sgra can:

sku la zangs khrab 'od kyis mdzes: khyag na mdung dmar chems se chem: ba dan rtse gsum g.yam mos 'debs: g.yas nas bskor bas lha srin sdud: g.yon nas bskor bas klu na sdud: klad la bskor bas bdud dpung 'joms: srog dbugs dbang byed drod la khyab: ltas ngan dmigs kyi drel du gsol: ltas ngan dmigs kyi gzhig tu gsol: ltas ngan dmigs kyis bsgral du gsol: bh+yo bzlog bsgyur ro: khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭ+wa: zhes brjod bzhi pa bh+yos gdab cing ltas ngan bzlog pa ni: nas brabs dar nag g.yab thal mo badha'i la 'di skad do/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: dngo pa bh+yo yis mi gdab tu: ma mo'i las kha bh+yo la thug: bar du bh+yo yis mi gdab tu: snang srid lta 'dre bh+yo yis bzlog: tha ma bh+yo yis mi gdab tu:nad dang ltas ngan bh+yo yis bzlog: bh+yo/ ltas ngan kun gyis pha smos pa: gdam la bya dkar mche ba can: bya la mtshe ba yongs mi srid: ltas ngan dang po pha ru byung : ltas ngan kun gyi ma smos pa: sa la byi dkar gshog pa can: byi bar gshog pa yong mi srid: ltas ngan dang po ma ru byung : de nyid srid cing sprul pa las: lhan ngan brgyad cu byung ba ni: gnam gyi ma bdud ltas ngan du: nyi zla shi ba'i (108) ltas ngan byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: bar snang stong pa'i ltas ngan ni: srog bdag rgyal po'i ltas ngan te: bya dang rgod kyi ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor= gsangs ma de ni dkar gong nas: lha bdud ma mu'i ltas ngan te: dbyings dang mtha' yi ltas ngan babs: de yang chen gtor mas= spang la de ni snang gong nas: sman dang gza' yi ltas ngan te: sha ba dog ba'i ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor= brag dmar de ni dmar gong nas: brag btsun gnyan gyi ltas ngan te: gla ba 'ug pa'i ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas: nag ma de ni mu gong nas: ma bdud gnyan gyi ltas ngan te: dom dang drod kyi ltas ngan babs:

de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: g.ya' ma de ni sngo gong nas: dmu dang bdud kyi ltas ngan te: 'bring bu g.yag gi ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: gnam nas ltas ngan byung ba ni: gza' skar gnyan gyi ltas ngan te: rgod po sder 'dzings ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas= rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum nas: sa bdag klu yi ltas ngan te: sbal sbrul nya yi ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas: sa las ltas ngan 'byung ba ni: sa bdag gnyan gyi ltas ngan te: lus la mdze shu g.yan pa byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: dung dang mchad pa grog po nas: 'dre mo nag po'i ltas ngan te: srin bya khu yis 'debs pa byung : de yang dmar chen gtor= brag dang nags kyi shing gseb nas: 'dri srin phri mo'i ltas ngan te: gong srog glu chung len pa byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas= phu nas ltas na byung ba ni: bdud dang gnyan gyi ltas ngan te: shwa pho rwa 'dzings ltas ngan byung : de yang dmar chen gtor= mda' nas ltas ngan byung ba ni: klu srin 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan te: nya mo mngal 'jings ltas ngan byung : de yang dmar che= dur+panas ltas ngan byung ba ni: dur 'dre dur sri'i ltas ngan te: dur na wa brgyal wa ro sbral: de yang dmar chen gtor mas= rta la ltas nang byung ba ni: drug gsum gdong gas z-i mi byung = de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: phyugs la ltas ngan byung ba ni: 'bri la be'u mtshe ma byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas= lug la ltas ngan byung ba ni: ro sgal rkod sgor nag po byung : de yang dmar chen gtor= ra la ltas ngan byung ba ni: zangs ldan spru rtags dmar por byung : de yang dmar chen gtor= khyi la ltas ngan byung ba ni: tshi ba byung dang tho rengs ngu: de yang dmar chen gtor= byis pa chung gi ltas ngan ni: sro mong kha na byi ro khyir: de yang dmar chen gtor mas= bya la ltas ngan byung ba ni: rgyal 'gong 'dre yi ltas ngan to:

srid la de pho 'tshor ba byung : de yang dmar chen gtor= byis pa chung gi ltas ngan ni: sre mong kha na byi ro khyer: da yang dmar chen gtor mas= bya la ltas ngan byung ba ni: rgyal 'gong 'dre yi ltas ngan te: srod la de pho 'tsher ba byung : de yang dmar chen gtor mas: pho rol dug pa sdare 'dzings byed: dme 'khon bdud kyi ltas ngan babs: de yang dmar chen gtor mas: bya la ltas ngan byung ba ni: rgyal 'gong 'dri yi ltas ngan te: srid la de pho 'tshor ba byung : de yang dmar chen= (109) 'ja' khyi lha yi ltas ngan yin: seng ge ngu 'bod gshin rje'i ltas: de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: dom drod stag gzigs 'thab pa dang : pha sprun nang dme byed pa ni: srid pa ma mo'i ltas nang yin: de yang dmar chen gtor mas= dai nga dmar chen gtor mas: sha rkyang btsan gyi ltas ngan yin: sbrul nag 'khyil ba klu yi ltas: dom nag bdud kyi ltas ngan yin: gla ba sman gyi ltas ngan yin: dai nga dmar chen gtor= bya rgod rgyal po'i ltas ngan yin: khrung khrung dro mo'i ltas nang yin: spyang ki dge bsnyen ltas ngan yin: bya rgod sdir 'dzings byed pa sogs: bdud kyi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog: ltas nang brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog: ye 'brog sum brgya drug chu bzlog: dus mi 'chi ba bco brgyad bzlog: glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig bzlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog: gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa= lus la nad du gtong ba bzlog: tshe la bar du gcod pa= skog ngan sri ngan thams cad bzlog: mo ngan gtsug lag ngan pa bzlog: kha badha la nye ngan pa bzlog: bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub pa bzlog: 'dun ngan gros ngan gshom pa bzlog: mi rung ltas ngan thams cad ni: bh+yo bh+yo stang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo za ba'i 'dre la bh+yo:

bh+yo bh+yo 'phung ba'i sri la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog dgra la bzlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: zhes bh+yos gdab cing ltas ngan bzlog go: bzlog pa spru gri'i sngags ni: ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: bdud pra ma ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza li rbad nan: ra tsa dun ming shag rbad nan: shig shig dum dum rbad nan: tshal pa tshamal pa rbad nan: khrom khrom bh+yo rbad nas: bdun nam nyer gcig tsi bzla/ na mo sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gsum gyi bka': bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ste bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs: ting 'dzin 'phro 'du sngags rgod rdzas kyis sbyor ba'i nus mthu: chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos chan rdu 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pas: bdag can rgyu sbyor bcor dang bcas par sngon gyi las: 'phril gyi rkyen pha rol gyi rbod gtong rigs sngags kyi sbyor bas mnan bsrig gtad cing gzir ba bsam ngan sbyor rtsub chags nyams nga rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad byad ma rang gshod rang la zug ste phyir bzlog par gyur cig /med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /lnga pa zer 'phang ni/ bh+yo bzlog byed padal chen phur pa'i lha/ bh+yo bzlog drag po'i dus la babs: mthing nag grug gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ bdud bdag 'jigs byed chen po dang*/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ gnyis su med par byin rlabs las: gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bcu byung*/ gro bo khro mo'i byin rlabs las: sprul pa'i mgo brnyen rnams byung ba/ da ni (110) zor gyi las mdzod cig: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la/ phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs sngags dang*/ sde brgyad drogs pa'i ngan sngags dang*/ sna srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang*/ drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang*/ ban bon 'dus pa'i btso zor dang*/

gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i mthun: klu la gtad mnan po nya'i zer/ mdo bsgrub hom dang sdeb gshor brubs: byor gto log dang mi kha ngan/ lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skogs/ than dang ltas ngan ye 'brog logs: bkra mi shis pa'i dongs po kun/ dam nyams dgra bo'i stong du bzlog /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar gcod bdud la bh+yo/ zhes thun gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo*/ drug pa srin mo lam bstan pa'i phyir srin mo nyer spyan drangs shing bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ lam ma'i gzugs sogs la sman kar sbran/ dar nag g.yab*/ sha chen gyi dud pa dang*/ rkang shugs rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas/ hūṃ bh+yo/ shar na bzhugs pa'i mo mo bdun/ gnas ni rgya mtsho'i gting gnas/ srin mo smug na da tshur byin/ gnas ni rgya mtsho'i gling na gnas/ tshangs dmar ser da tshur byin/ gnas ni rin chen brag la gnas/ lha chen dpar ljang da tshung da tshur byon/ gnas ni grub nag yul na gnas/ nag mo dmar nag da tshur byon/ gnas ni rgya nag yul du gnas/ gtog 'dod sngon mo dar tshul byon/ gnas ni thor chog yul du gnas/ gzhon nu mdar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni ri bo ta lar gnas/ brgya byin dkar mo da tshul byon/ hūṃ bh+ro/ lho na gnas pa'i ma mo bdun/ gnas ni rgya gar yul na gnas/ rdo rje ser mo dang tshul byon/ gnas ni ge bar yul na gnas/ bdud rtsi dmar mo da tshur byon/ gnas ni brag na yul na gnas/ stobs chen dkar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni bas lug gting nag gnas/ bo con nag mo da tshul byon/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ nub na bzhugs pa'i ma mo bdun/ gnas ni laṅka'i yul na gnas/ dga' ba dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni klu 'brug yul na gnas/ stobs chen dkar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni gyi mtsho'i kha na gnas/ rdo rje ser mo da tshur byon/ gnas ni tho dkar yul na gnas/

'dod pa dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni lho sprin nang na gnas/ nor bsrung dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni klu yul nang na gnas/ rlung lha sngon po da tshul byon/ gnas ni o rgyan yul na gnas/ rdo rje dmar mo da tshul byon: hūṃ bh+yoḥ byang na bzhugs pa'i ma mo bdun/ gnas ni gan rje'i yul na gnas/ gsod byed dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni gung thang rtse na gnas/ srin mo dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni laho nub yul na gnas/ stobs chen dkar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni bal yul gting na gnas/ bo con nag mo da tshul byon/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ nub ba bzhugs pa'i ma mo bdun/ gnas ni laṅka'i yul na gnas/ dbag ba dmar mo da tshul byon/ dganas ni klu 'brug yul na gnas/ stobs chen dkar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni rgya mtsho'i kha na gnas/ rdo rje ser mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni tho dkar yul na gnas/ 'dod pa dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni lho sprin nang na gnas nor bsrung dmar mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni klu yul nang na gnas/ rlung lha sngon so da tshul byon/ gnas ni o rgyon yul na gnas/ rdo rje dmar mo da tshul byon/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ byang na bzhugs pa'i ma mo bdun/ gnas ni gan rje'i yul na gnas/ gsod byed dmar mo (111) da tshul byon/ gnas ni gung thang rtse ba gnas/ mi mo dmar ser da tshul byin/ gnas ni sa shod kha na gnas/ phag mo nag mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni byang kha'i phug na gnas/ sun 'dzin ser mo da tshul byon/ gnas ni byang sring kha na gnas/ dga' byed dmar mo da tshur byon/ gnas ni hor gyi yul na gnas/ sna cha dkar mo da tshur byon/ gnas ni ta zig yul na gnas/ chu lha sngon mo da tshur byon/ kyai srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad po/ don gyi gnas la nges me da kyang*/ kun rdzob rang rang gnas mchog nas/ 'bod do ma 'gor gnas 'dir gshegs/ sngags pas dudang dung bos pa'i tshe/ srino ma 'khor bcas de la 'dud/ ma bas byams shing srid bas gdung*/

las su srid gsum 'dzam gling na/ dam tshig bsrung ba'i stong grogs mdzod/ dam nyams rnams kyi gshed ma byed/ khams gsum srid gsum 'jig rten nas/ srin mo'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren gyi/ skad cig yud kyis gshegs su gsol/ kyai srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad po/ rang rang 'khor g.yog bran dang bcas/ las thabs grub pa dang mo'i tshogs/ sha za srin mo nyer brgyad rnams/ rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor mdzes pa 'dir/ zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar mo bdun/ za 'og zhing rkyang gdan ston du/ shar phyogs gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ rgyal ba'i las mdzad ser mo bdun/ zo ga zhing rkyang gdan steng du/ lho phyogs gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ dbang gi las mdzad dmar mo bdun/ za 'og zhing rkyang gdan stongs su/ nub phyogs gnasu suja bzhugs su gsol/ drag po'i las mdzad ljang mo bdun/ zo 'og zhing rkyang gdan stong du/ byang phyogs gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ hūṃ phaṭaḥ srin mo dbang phyug nyer brgyad la/ dkyel pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dgrigs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ nang grol dbang po phung khams dang*/ skye mchod sman raka gtor ma sogs/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod par 'bul/ dgyes par rol cig kha ram khā hi/ 'phris rnams bzhi grub par mdzod/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya dkar mo bdun/ 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug zhi mdzad ma/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar gyi srung ma che/ rnal 'byor dbang mo rnams la bdag bstod do/ rin chen rigs kyi pho nya ser mo bdun/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags rgyas mdzad ma/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho yi srung ma che/ rnal 'byor dbang mo rnams la bdang bstod do/ pad+ma rigs kyi pho nya dmar mo bdun/ mos bzhis khams gsum dbang du bsdus mdzad ma/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i nub gyi bsrung ma che/ rnal 'byor dbang mo rnams la bdag bstod do/ las kyi rigs kyi pho nya ljang mo bdun/
'gugs 'ching gsod gnon drag po'i las mdzad ma/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i byang gi bsrung ma che/

(112) rnal 'byor dbang mo rnams la bdag bstod do/ zhes bstod/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo ma ma ru lu ma/ rasing in+d+ri/ hring hring a we sha ya/ sra bhe sha ya kha thun bh+yo ta pa la mu li swa/ ru ru ru ru hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ traka rak+ṣa mu tra ru lu ru lu hūṃ phaṭ+wa: namo ma re ma ti ra tri ru tri re ma tri bh+yo/ zhes bzla/ de nas tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma btang zhing mjug chog dkyus ltar bya'o/ gsum pa mjug las kyi mtha' brtul ba bcu gcig las/ dang po sgo dbye ba ni sgrub khang gi stong du gsare skyems dang zor rdzas rnams bshams la/ dkar gtor byin rlabs spyi ltar byas nas yul lha gzhi bdag la bsngo/ gser skyems phyogs bzhir 'bul zhing*/ hūṃ shar gyi phyogs kyi sgo ma ni/ khro mo rdo rje lcags kyu ma: thugs rje'i thabs kyi lde mig dang : rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phyi: shar gyi sgo mas sgo phye zhig: dzaḥ badz+ra sra ba sha ya phaṭ+waḥ hūṃ lho yi phyogs kyi sgo ma ni: khro mo rdo rje zhabs pa ma: thugs rje'i thabs kyi lde mig dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis/ lho phyogs gsare sgo ser po phye: lho yi sgo mas sgo phyi zhig: hūṃ badz+ra sra be sha yang phaṭ+waḥ hūṃ nug kyi phyogs kyi sgo ma ni/ khro mo rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ thugs rje'i thabs kyi lde mig dang : rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag rgya yis/ nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar mo phyi: nub kyi sgo mas sgo phyi zhig: bi badz+ra sra ba she ya phaṭ+waḥ hūṃ byang gi phyogs kyi sgo ma ni: khro mo rdo rje dril bu ma: thugs rje'i thabs kyi lde mig dang : rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: byang phyogs g.yu sgo sngon po phye: byang gi sgo mas sgo phyi zhig: hoḥbadz+ra sra we sha ma phaṭ+wa: zhes 'bul/ gnyis pa gser skyems ni/ ringan chen sman 'bru'i phud skyems rim par 'bul la/ kyai bdag ni ma nyes ma yo'i:

gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs: stong gi lha yang sku gzur cig: 'og na gnas pa'i klu rnams kun/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de nub zer lam gnyan po phyi: bon gyi lha 'dre thams cad kyang : mchod sbyin gser= do nub zor lam= dus gsum g+r+yal ba'i bka' byung nas/ dam nyams las kyi mthar thug la: khyod rang ma nyes lha srin rnams: lus ngan sems rtogs ma chags par: bag zon byis ma rang sar dnges: dam (113) nyams 'dis nyes ngas ma lan/ ma nyes ma yo ye shes lha: dam can rgya mtsho rang mda' ldog: srid pa'i lha 'dra grogs la 'chos: bdag la bsdos pa'i dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshegs: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dam: dge ba bcu yi bson nams bcag: mi dge'i la bcu dang du blangs: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mchod dang lcam dral yongs la brnyas: mtshams med lnga yi 'bras bu smin: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'di yin pas: myur du sgrol ba'i 'phris mdzod/ drin lan gtang rag khyed la gtong : bcom ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ zhes dang*/ gsum pa zer bskul bya ba ni: hūṃ nga ni rdo rje gzhen nu che: nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi gatsho: nga ni khams gsum snying rje'i bdag: nga ni gshin rje kun gyi gshed: nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab: nga las che btsan su yang med: bka' bsdod pho nya yongs rdzogs rnams: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyir: dmag sna dgra bo'i yul du drongs: dam can dmag dpung nyi li li: mtshon rtse phur rtse rongs rong : gtor zor r+b+ba tu nyil li li: mtsho nyung mda' shar ra ra: dug thug khrag rlangs 'khyil li li: srung ma rngam stabs khyugs se khyug: gi rnams bshud pa dir ri ri: ma mo'i hab sgra lhabs se lhab: thams cad ru mtshon lhubs se lhub: dgrogs snying la gtor zare gyob: nyams pa'i lnga phung rul du rlog: zhes drag tu bsgul la zer 'phang dngos ni/

mda' zer thogs la: hūṃ dug can 'tsher ma'i shing dag la/ ltas ngan 'byung po'i sgro yis brgyan/ gnam lcags phur bu'i mde'u btsug /dug dang mtshon char byin rlabs sa/ log 'dren dgra bgegs stong du bh+yo/ srog rtsa chod lu rul du rlug /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ drag po'i 'phril las bsgrub par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī phā ya sogs spru gri'i sngags bzla zhing khro sgro shar/ 'ug sgro lho bya rog sgra nub srin sgra can byang ngam yang na thebs phyogs su 'phang : dug zer thobs la/ hūṃ mtshan ngan thod pa'i snod nang du/ dug chen ha la sna tshogs pa/ myos byed mchog dang sbyar ba yis/ smo 'bog rengs byed dug zer 'di/ log 'dreg dgra bgegs= srog rtsa chod la= byang kha bzlog pa'i= drag po'i 'phrin las= ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā sogs kyis 'phang*/ yungs zor thogs la/ hūṃ dme yugs nyams grib can dag gis/ nus pa nyams par ma byas pa'i/ legs btab yungs kar gang bzang 'di/ log 'dren= srog rtsa= byang kha= drag po'i= ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs kyis 'phang*/ rdo zor thogs la hūṃ 'phung shul dungar khrod khrod la sogs pa'i/ 'jigs su rung ba'i dho nag po/ drag po'i rdzas kyi ngar btag pa/ log 'dren= srog rtsa chod la= byang kha= drag po'i 'phrin las= ā+oṃ badz+ra kī lī lā sogs kyi 'phangs/ khrag zor thogs la hūṃ gru gsum pa yi kong ba'i nang*/ dmar nag khrag gi (114) mtsho bskyil bar/ ha la nag po'i ra btags pa/ log 'dren= srog rtsa= drag po'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sogs kyi spru gri'i sngags dang bcas 'phang ngo*/ bzhi pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ sgrub khang du 'ong nas/ gtor chen zhal phyir gyu/ sha zan sman raka sbran dgug gzhug gsum maṃ gcig gi mthar gtor ma'i smad cha dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa 'dod yon gyi phung sor ltas la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra sa pā ri wa ra mahā pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rakata ma hā ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi

zhes lan gsum gyi gshegs skyems su phul la/ rig 'dzin rgyud brgyud bskul dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyi bskul/ phur srung bstod bskul bcas las byang dang dpe tshan zur pa rnams 'don/ lnga pa chad mdo'i tha tshig brjod pa ni/ sha zan sman raka sbran nas las byang dkyus ltar btang zhing ru dar dkar gtor sogs kyi sna drangs nas gtor ma rnams 'khyer ba'i rgya ba tu bsgrub pa po rnams chas su zhugs te rkang gling rol mo'i bye rga sogs brngam stabs kyi gom pa bdun cu'i par song la gtor ma stogs kyi stong du bsham mo/ drug pa srin mo za lam bstan pa ni 'bru nag gi mchan gyis brab cing*/ bh+yo bzug byed ma cig spyan 'dren no/ bsgyur byed ma cig spyan 'dren no/ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na/ 'jigs rnyen 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin/ ye shes grub kyang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje mos btab ltas nang bh+yon bzlog cig /so so'i rigs dang ming srid lci dral tshul: bha kar mo spyan gcig rdo rje rigs kyi lcam/ nyid kyi ming po shar phyogs bka' bsgyur la/ rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa yi/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khram baṃ btab po re/ bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/ bsgyur ro gshin rje'i cho 'phrul dgra= bh+yo gar gyi dbang phyug pad+ma rigs kyi lcam/ nyid kyi ming po klu yi bka' bsgyur la/ rnal 'byor bdag gi= sa bdag klu yi byad du chud do ri/ bzlog gi dmar= bsgyur ro klu yi cho 'phrul= bhā gar gyi bdang phyug las kyi rigs kyi lcam/ nyid kyi ming so gnod sbyin bka' bsgyur la/ rnam 'byor bdag gi= rnal 'byor bdag gi= gnod sbyin gdug pa'i gdon gyis zin to ro/ bzlog go dmar chen= bsgyur ro gnod sbyin cho 'phrul dgra= bh+yo/ dbyings phyug dbang ldan mkha' 'gro ma/ kong btsun phyi yi tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la/

rnal 'byor bdag gi= phyi yi dgra snying thams cad thebs so re/ bzlog go= bsgyur ro mi snying glo 'phrig dgra= bh+yo sngags (115) srung e ka tsa ti ral gcig ma/ bdud po rkos rje drang dkar bka' bsgyur la/ rnal 'byor bdag gi= bdud kyi rgyal po khram nag brkyang ngo re/ bzlog go dmar= bsgyur ro bdud kyi khram kha dgra la= bh+yo e ka tsa nag mo glog ma spyin/ bdud po re ti mgo nyag bka'= rnal 'byor= nag po bdud kyi byan sos brkus so re/ bzlog go= bsgyur ro bdud kyi cho 'phrul= bh+yo dkar mo chen mo nyi zla'i thod 'phring can/ nyid kyi mang po lcam lha'i bka'= rnal 'byar bdag gi/ rgyal po dkar pos dmangs su bebs so re/ bzlog go dmar chen= bsgyur ro dkar po'i cho 'phrul= bh+yo ma mo e ka dza ti thal mdog ma/ grong gi nyi zla'i thod 'phring can/ nyid kyi mang po lngam lha'i bka'/ rnal 'byor bdag gi= 'byung po the'u rang yul du phebs so re/ bzlog go= bsgyur ro 'byung po'i cho 'phrul/ bh+yo sa bdag chen mo bdag mo ral gcig ma/ sa yi the'u rang gan po'i bka'= rnam 'byor bdag gi= the'u rang rnams kyi cho 'phrul she ra re/ bzlog go dmar chen= bh+ya gnam la she'u re sman zhes bya ba/ skar skya gza' bdud rnams kyi bka'= rnal 'byor= brtsan gyi rgyal po'i skye babs sho ra ro/ bzlog go dmar chen= bsgyur ro btsan gyi cho 'phrul dgra= bh+yo nya chen 'dzigs pa pa khrag gi ral gcig ma/ klu srin pho mo yengs kyi bka' bsgyur la/ rnal 'byor bdag gi= klu srani rnams kyi cho 'phrul sho ra ro/ bzlog go dmar chen= bsgyur re klu srani cho 'phrul= bh+yo lha mo nag mo las kyi ma mo che/ mdor na bag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ snang sradi ma mo'i khri sna dgra la bsgyur= bh+yo gzhan yang bzlog cig bsgyur ba ni/ lha chen drag po'i gdu rtsab bzlog /lha ma yin gyi 'gyu thabs bzlog

/skem byed lcags kyus zin pa bzlog /drang srong rnams kyi dmod pa= ma mo'i thug sngags byung ba/ phra men ma yi nye 'byod= sa dbag klu yi gdu byad= pho nye'i rbod gtong byung ba= phur pa'i dbal kha 'phen sa= yungs kar zor kha 'phen pa= mu stegs bon po'i byad zor= ban+de'i hoṃ spor ngan sngags= zhang zhug bon po'i gatsho dmar= su pa'i glung dang lings/ mi nyag pa yi 'bog le'u= khyu po'i btsan dang ngan thabs bzlog glang la thog sha bgyed pa= yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa= mas kyi sri ru ldang ba= lhag pa'i bdud du babs pa= dparal ba'i gshed du 'khor ba= pho sri mo srid chung sri= dam sradi dbul srid 'phung srid god sri= pha mes dur srid btsan sri= bdud kyi than phyag brnyen= lo skag gying shang gshod bzhi= sa la zhag rtsis bdebs pa= gnam la zla grangs bdebs pa= gza' skar lo skag zla skag= dus tshed rtsis te 'es pa= gnam gyi dal kha pa yi nad kha= thog babs dal babs thams cad= byas nyes lana' grib thams cad= g.yas nas pho brgya mda' bdar= mgon nas mo brgya dug (116) g.yos= mdun na rtsang bzhin btod pa= rgyalab na khyi bzhin 'brang ba/ mo ngan log par rdog pa= rmi ldas mtshan ma ngan pa= srod la bya pho mtsher ba= tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba= 'ug la legs la rgod pa= srani bya logs la brgyal ba= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig= pha tshan gang gi brgya badre= ma tshan ngan gi stong 'dre= ma bu'i byung 'dre thams cad= pho bdud dmal kha g.yas su= mo bdud dal kha g.yon du= spri bdud dal kha mkha' la= phas kyi 'khung 'dre rbad pa= tshul kyi sno 'dre rbad pa= lus la nad kha gtong ba= tshe bar chad byed pa/ lkog nas 'bu bzhin g.yengs ba= ngo la til rungs byed pa= lus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba= ngos la sprel ltar 'dzig pa= mi kha bra mchu thams cad= chag che nyams nga thams cad= lo skag zla skag thams cad= za ma bdun zur thams cad= rbod gtorang rbad 'dre thams cad= rmi lam ngan pa thams cad=

ltas ngan mtshan ma ngan = pho bh+yo g.yas su bh+yo g.yas su bh+yo mo bh+yo g.yon du bh+yo/ yul gyi mi la bh+yo/ khyim 'dzis pa su bh+yo/ sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ za ba'i 'dre la bh+yo/ 'phung ba'i srid la bh+yo/ sbyor ba ngan pa gtong ba yi/ sdang dgra gnod bgegs ma lus kun/ dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ gzhig dang dpang dang dam bcas nas/ rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzed/ tshal pa tshal pa/ dum bu dum bu/ rdul phan rdul phran/ phye ma phye ma bzlog bzlog /bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes gyer/ bdun pa bstan ma bskyang ba ni/ gtor ma n+mas la sha zan sman rak+ṣa sbran/ dgug gzhug drag po gsum bya zhing bstan ma'i gnas su gtor ma skyong ba las byang ltar bya/ brgyad pa gtor ma 'phang ba la/ gtor ma'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dag la bsdus nas gtor zare khro bo'i dmag tshogs nam mkha' gang ba nad mtshon dug gi tshwa tshwa 'phro bas gnod byed dgegs kyi stong du nad dug mtshon cha'i char babs rnam shes mar me 'chi kha ma lta bu thum gyis bsad/ gzugs phung rdul pharna du bshig nam longs spyod dbang thang gnas gzhis thams cad rjes shul tsaṃ yang med par bcom par bsam la/ hūṃ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu sogs las byang ltar dang*/ drag sngags brjod bzhin pas gtor ma thebs phyogs su 'phang*/ thal mo brdab/ 'khor ling yod na mer 'asreg/ gtor gzhong bshal chus bstan ma spog chog gi tshul du mchod do/ dgu la gathor mnan ni sa la chos 'byung rim gsum dubs su nri tri bris pa'i khar gtor gzhong rnams sprub la gtor gzhong 'og tu dgregs thams cad bkug /bcu pa 'byung ba'i dgra gshed ni/ gtor gzhing spub shul du me sbra la gtor gzhong chus bshal ba/ dgug gzhug dang bcas me dgra chus bas/ bcu gcig pa rte bro bya ba ni/ bsgrub pa po rnams lu gu rgyud du sbrel te/

hūṃ/ dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgyal mdud rtse zlum po: ngos la zhi ba'i lha bkod do: btab (117) pas 'jigs brgyad zhi bar 'gyur: ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya shan+tang kar ru ye swā hā: baṃ gyi tshigs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ā+oṃ las de bzhin 'khor dang bcas: rmugs par gyur pa'i sems can rnams: zhi bar gyur dbyings su rol: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ zhi mdzad lha ma phyag 'tshal bstod: stong gi lha yang zhi gyur cig: 'og gi klu yang zhi gyur cig: sdang ba'i dgra yang zhi gyur cig: gnod pa'i bgegs kyang zhi 'gyur cig: nang dang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: ces bro ra zlug por brdung ngo : gser ram ser pa'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgyal mdud rtse zur bzhi: ngos la rgyas pa'i lha bkod de/ btab pas tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas: swā rat+na kī li kī lā ya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā cig: ma yi tshogs kyi da la ru: swā las rin chen 'khor dang bcas/ nga rgyal dregs pa'i sems can rnams: rgyas par gyur la dbyings su rol: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod rgyas mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal lo: tshe dang bson nams rgyas gyur cig: dpal dang ye shes rgyas gyur cig: bkrag dang gzi brjid rgyas gyur cig: gdul bya 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig: bro ra grub bzhir brdung ngo hūṃ zang sam dmar po'i shi rnams la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam: ngos la dbang gi lha bkod de: btab pas snang srid dbang du sdud: a pad+ma kī li kī lā ya: sa shang ku ru ye swā hā: ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: āṃ ཿ las pad+ma 'khor dang bcas: chags par gyur pa'i sems can rnams: dbang du ma gyur gang yang med: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod: dbang badzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang bsdus shig: khams gsum srid gsum dbang bsdus shig: yamos pa rnam bzhi dbang bsdus shig: bro ra zla gi du brdung ngo chad pa

lcags sam nag po'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum: ngos la drag po'i lha bkod do: btab pas dgregs brlags par 'gyur: hā karma kī li kī ya mā ra ya phaṭ+wa: ye yi tshogs kyi da la ru: hā las don grub 'khor dang bcas: phrag dog gyur pa'i sengs chan rnams rdul= bro ra zur gsum du brdung ngos hūṃ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: sogs las byang bro brdung kyang lang ba 'don gtor snong kha gyen la 'bru sna blug: zer rjes gcod pa'i bsrung gyi migs gnad dang bcas nang du log la tshe gzungs bzla zhing tshe 'gugs: nang gtor ltar gsal ba la gtor zan cung zad dngos grub tu rol zhing mchod bzod gsol nas bkris bar las byang dkyis la 'dzug cig/ 'dir gtor bzlog rgyang pa dkyus su bris pa yis mod: dmigs gnas sogs zhib pa gzhung du gsal zhing 'dir yi gais ngal ba la 'dzem

(118) nas ma bris/ gzhan yang las tshogs med kha bcu gnyis nas gsungs pa'i las phran gang bsgrub par 'dod kyang gzhung 'di ltar la de dang de'i bcas sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ smras pa rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i thugs bcud yang zab gnad/ mang ngag mthar thug ldang lhar rgyas btab pa/ rat+nas spyan drangs khro rgyal thams cad kyi/ stobs 'dus rdo rje phur ba'i spu gri mchog/ gang gi las mtha' dmar chen gtor bzlog gi: chog sgrigs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog gi mdas/ ma rung log 'dren dgra gdon brtsegs pa'i brag /phye mar 'thag byed 'di brtsams dge ba'i mthus/ rgyal bstan pyi dang 'od gsal rdo rje'i bstan/ khyad par lam bzang 'di nyid phyogs dus kun/ dar rgyal nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zare brgyar/ 'bar bas nag phyogs bdud mun bcom pa dang*/ lhan cig 'gro kun pad+mo ke pa ra/ bde skyid 'dab stong bzhad dang bdud dgra'i dpung*/ sras mchog kī la ya lis bsgral ba dang*/ bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dgra tshogs ma lus kun/ ring rig ye she phur bus sgrol gyur cig: de ltar chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul rat+na gling pas ldang phrag mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgo nas gtor bzlog gi las rigs gnas lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog mda' zhes bya ba 'di nyid 'brong dur bla ma dkon mchog byang chub bzang pos rje btsun bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs med 'phrin las chad pa rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zheso nga mtshar mtshan gyis sa gsum ge ba gang dar ljags bsgrigs gsol ba btab pa/ rje nyid nas tshul 'di ltar bu khyod kyis bris shig pa'i bka'i snang ba rtsal bar brten: 'di nyid kyi smad las dug phur dang*/ gtor bzlog khro rgyal stobs 'dus sogs gter gzhug gi yi ge rnams la zhib par dpyad/ gzhung nas za lam khyung gi ltas ngan bzlag pa:

zor las sogs bka' brgyad gzhung nas 'dir blang ngo : gsungs pa bzhin kha skong dgos pa rnams myang gtor bka' brgyad bde 'dus dang*/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pas mi 'gal bar brgyan karma ā ra ga'i phur pa'i bzlog mdos sbra ga ma'i yig cha sogs la yang bsdun te dkyus su bkod pa yang rje bla ma mchog gi bka' drin gyi 'tsho ba stan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi 'bru mang zhes pa sa stag lor dpal 'bri gung gi pho phrag mi 'gyur rdo rje'i spo'i re'u mig phun tshogs 'khyil par sbra ba'i yi ge pa ni mang yul gyi rigs las no no dkon mchog bstan pas bgyis pa 'di la 'gal 'khrul gang mchis bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu phur slang dam can rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags la mkhyin pa'i spyan ldan rnams kyi bcos par yang 'tshal lo/ sarba maṅgalam/ (119) rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen chog sgrigs dongs grub rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng du 'dzab stong tshigs gi tshad kyang gatsho bo la stong*/ khro bo bcu la so sor brgya re/ sras rnams la lnga bcu re/ 'khor dam sogs la nyer gcig re bzla zhes gsungs pa'i sngags rnams byang ba klug chog tu phyug nas bkod par gtso bor oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba big+nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa: hūṃ kā rar oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūṃ kā ra hūṃḥ garja garja hūṃ phaṭ+wa: rnam par rgyal bar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dzā ya hūṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dbyug sngon la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ: da ha da hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ gshin rjer oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hū: sa tsam pa tsa hūṃ phaṭ+wa: mi g.yo bar oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūṃḥbhan+dha bhan+dha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ rta mgrin la oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya ghṛ wa hūṃ:hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭ+wa: 'dod pa'i rgyal por oṃ kro ta a pa ra tsi ta hūṃ: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ bdud rtsi 'khyil par oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ:

tshin+dha tsin+dha hūṃ phaṭ+wa: khams gsum rnam rgyal la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūṃ: bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭ+wa: stobs po cher/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la hūṃ: s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭ+wa ces dang*/ sras mchog la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: sgo ma bzhi'i sngags/ o badz+ra kī li kī la ya bhin+dha ya bhi n+dha ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya na ma sa man+ta hring hring phaṭ+wa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya su ru su ru sra su ru sra su ru hūṃ phaṭ+wa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs srung ma dang bcas gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ka ti ka ye: dza ye bi dza a tsi te a pa ra tsi te: ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye: sarba big+nan bai hūṃ phaṭ+wa: yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gcig tu dril ba'i bzlas pa ni/ o badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba big+nan baṃ phaṭ+wa: dza:hūṃ āḥ ma rag mo yag mo: kā la ru sa: snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: snying rtsa la khril khril: srog rtsa la tshuṃ tshuṃ tsit+ta srog la dud dung : snying khra shad dza: thuṃ ri li li: snying rtseg rtseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha dhi ma ma: karma shrī traṃ ka ra ye: ma ra sa ni: sra mar ta na ye hūṃ phaṭ+wa: zhes bzla zhing stong tshig gis mchod pa yang bya'o// (120) (ba) ༄༅// rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i dbang chogs 'phrin las kyi gtor mdzod chen mo chu 'babs su bstod bkod pa rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ mchog tu mi 'gyur gdod nas yongs dag dri bral segs nyid chos sku'i gdangs/ 'gags med lhun 'grubakhra 'thung rnam rol dho rje gzhon nu longs spyod rdzogs: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje sgyu 'phrul pad+ma thod 'phring sprul pa'i gar/

sku gsum ngo bo rje btsun bla ma bde chen 'khor lor rtag tu bsten/ pad+ma'i thugs bcud mkha' chen bzang gdams pa/ khra brag rgyas btab bla med 'phrin las kyis*/ zab gtor sgo 'byed gter chen 'gro 'dul gling*/ sras slob brgyud par bcas la mgos phyag 'tshal/ gang gang gtor byon yang gsang bla med kyis/ dbang chog 'phril las gtor mdzod rdo rje'i tshigs/ gang dkrug rtogs dka'i snyigs dus gsang 'dzin kun/ dpe mthong klag pa'i rang gzhan gnyis 'phung mthong*/ de lta'i nyes 'gogs phyir du chu 'babs su/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung gis brgyan nas/ bkod la rgyal (121) kun 'phrin las 'khor lo cher/ yongs shar dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ khyed par bka' sdod mthu ldan phur bsrung sogs/ gtor bdag dam can rgya mtsho 'i tshogs rnams kyis/ zab don dkril la bka' yi gnang ba dang*/ theg mchog chos da'i ri ring lugs rgyas par mdzod/ de la 'dir chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul ran+da gling pas ldang lung khro mo brag nas spyan drangs pas phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i dbang chog 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba gtare gzhug rdo rje'i gsung tshig zab cing rlub pa dag phal cher ma rtogs rang bzos bslad te cho ga nyams pas rang gzhan sgrob gsog gi rgyur mthong bas/ de dag gi nyes 'gogs cing rang mnyam blo gros brtul po rnams po rnams la phan pa'i blos chu 'babs su rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung bzhin 'god par bya ste/ de la 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug sgo'i thog ma dang la ma brten par mi 'grub ste/ phur sa gsang ba'i snying po 'phril las kyi rgyud las/ dbang gi bdag nyid he ru ka: rnal 'byor bla med sgrub pa yi: gsang sngags sgo ni dbang yin pas: bdang gis smon par ma byas na: gnyan pa lag skya med pa ltar: gru'i pha rol bgrid mi nus: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs byas nas:

gsang bdam pa bsgrub pa'i phyir: bdang gi rim pa bstan du gsol: zhes gsungs so de bas na go 'phang dam par bkri ba so yang yongs grub chen po'i bskyed rim la goms pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dag gi spyod yul yin la/ min na'ang 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum sngon du song nas gzhan rgyud smani grol gyis nus thob cing cho ga'i bya la mags pa'i slob ma rjes su 'dzin par bya ste/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni dbang chog rang gzhung las/ rdo rje phur pa'i rtsanya ba ti to'i rgyud dang 'brel ba: drag po gnam lcags thog gi spru gri: yang gsang bla med snying po 'dus pa'i dbang 'di la gsum ste/ dang po dang gi rjong ston pa: gnyis pa ji ltar bskur ba'i rim pa dang : gsum pa dbang gi zab rgya dang rjes skyong ba bstan pa'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyi don gsum las dang po sgrub gzhi dbang gi rjong chen bstan pa ni/ phur sum tshogs pa lngas (122) gzhi bzung ba sogs te bsgrub pa chen mo dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur gyi tshe kho bos bgyis pa'i sgrub chen chog sgrigs dongs grub rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng kyus bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i lha bum ste gon gyi mjug slob ma ste gon sbyor zhing sgrub chen zhag grangs ji ltar byed pa'i mthar dngos grub bla ba'i mjug der dngos gzhi dbang bskur dang*/ mjug bsdu ba sogs sgrub chen mthar chags bya bas 'grub par 'gyur la/ 'on te sgrub chen dang ma 'brel ba'i dbang rkyang bskur ba'i tshe skabs don dang 'brel ba'i 'dor len bya dgos te/ de yang sgrub chen chog bsgrigs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phring gi dbu nas spyi don dang po grub pa'i gzhi bzung ba/ gnyis pa gsol gdabs/ gsum pa pa'i tshog ga rtags blangs sbyangs bzung rnams kyus bzhin bya ba dang gsod nams gang 'byor byas kyang legs shing ma grub kyang dbang rkyang la 'gal ba chung*/

spyi don gnyis pa'i nang tshan brgyad yod pa'i dang po mtshams gcod la phyi mtshams rgyal thog rab mtshams dam srid mnan cing sgo byang gdags pa/ ma ṭi bsgral zhing nang dang gsang ba'i mtshams gcod pa rnams dbang rkyang dongs sta nyan gnyis ma lta bu ma grub kyang 'gal ba chung bas dor/ gtis pa lhag gnas la/ dang po lha dang gnyis su pa bum pa lhag gnas gzhung ltar byas te buram pa 'od zhu dang phrin bcom sogs grub rjes bcas rnams yol bas sgrib la bzhag/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon bya ba ni/ sngon gtor gu gul spungs thun/ maṇ+ḍa la/ dri'i chu las dkyil pad+ma 'dab brgyad dubs su 'khor lo shar nas g.yas bskor gyi phyogs bzhir rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram mtshams bzhi mdzes chon gyi byug pa'i ras bris stong du tshom bu dgu bkod pa'am yang na khru gang grub bzhi ba'i maṇ+ḍal dri bzangs ba byung gi sbags pa'i tshom bu dgu bkod pa/ dri bzang gi po shing sor bcu gnyis rtse mor rgya mdud me tog gi cod pan btags shing rtsa ba phur dbyibs phra bar byas pa/ 'khyir chu dung zhal dri bzang chus bkang ba/ dpung skud sna lnga slob ma'i lul tshad gsum lteb du bsgril ba gatsho bo'i bsnyen pas rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bathab pa/ ku sha'i chun po che chung sogs mgo ba'i yo byed rnams 'du byas la/ snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma zung du ma gyur pa'i grangs ldan rnams las chus khrul bya/ gral khrul bya/ gral du 'khod/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin cing bskrad/ gu gul bdug cing*/ thug gyi brab/ bsrung 'khor bsgoms/ las kyi rdo rje'i me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyi ngos 'byung bskyed pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos bzhi sogs spyi bye brag gi chos rgyal par bshad la slob ma rnams blo bcos shing*/ sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug/ slob mas (123) 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa 'di skad zhu/

hūṃ gsang ba'i dkyi 'khor bla na med: dngos grub chen po 'byung ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: he ru ka dpal las kyi bdag: khyod kyi bdag nyid smani par mdzod: srid pa'i rdo rje bdag la rtsol: zhes lag gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyi lan sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa: nyams na khro bo chen po yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: ma nyams na ni dngos grub mchog: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong bas: dngos grub ma lus thob pa dang : 'phrin las rnam bzhi khyod kyi 'grub : zhes brjod de nas skyebs sems yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gatsho bo gnyis su med pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i mthar skor du rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor la sprin phung gtibs pa lta bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i lan lag bdun pa mas tshig don thugs la gzhol ba'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ dpal chen phur pa'i dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha/ mchog gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan bsrung la/ byang chub ma thob rab du skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum*/ sems bskyed pa ni/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho chen gyi/ sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrug las bsgral ba'i phyir/ bdag gi dpal chen phur pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ nyams su blangs nas byang chub mchog thob bgyi/ lan gsum/ bdun rnam dag ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ dngos grub che bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos*/

ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sem bskyed do/ bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la/ dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ lan gsum/ de ltar dbang thob bya dkyil 'khor gyi bya bar brten nas thob na'ang*/ dbang 'dzin pa de dam tshig dang sdom pa kho na la brten nas 'dzin pa yin las smin byed sdom ldon du bsgrub pa'i chod du rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang*/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshags spyad dang mi spongs dang du blangs/ shes dang bsgrub pa lnga lnga'o/ zhes pa ltar yangan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs te/ spyi dang byag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa yongs su bzung bar bya'o/ snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod*/ dkyil (124) 'khor gtso bo he ru ka: kun kyang bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bde gshegs rnams kyi gnos pa yis: sangs rgyas lnga yi sdom pa ni: bdag gis rab tu bzung ba'i phyir: rnal 'byor bdang phyug sku gsung thugs: zag med brten par bzhugs pa yi: sangs rgyas khrag 'thung sdom pa bzung : rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyar ba: rdo rje dpal gyi sdom pa bzung : dam tshig ldan pa'i sbyor nas ni: sbyin pa don dang tsha bzhin la: rin chen rgyas pa'i he ru ka: sdom pa yang dag bdag gis bzung : 'dod chags rdo rje dri ma med: zag med bde ba ye shes la: gsang chen rdo rje rnag dag chos: pad+ma bcom ldan sdom pa bzung : rnal 'byor rnams kyi dam tshag ni: 'dab bar dka' las mi 'gal bar: bsrung ba las kyi sdom pa rnams: las kyi he ru ka yi tshul: bdag gis yang dag rab tu bzung : rdo rje spyi'i dam tshags ni: sku gsung thugs kyi sdom pa bzung : khyad par dam tshag nyi shu lnga: mi 'bril brten yang yang dag bzung : nges par lta spyod ldan pa yis: de lta'i dam tshag bdag tu bzung :

'gro ba kun gyi don dag tu: rdo rje dam tshig ldan par ni: rdo rje can bdag legs par bzung : zhes lan gsum: de ltar bzung ba'i sdom pa dang dam tshig gis bcas mtshams mtha' dag srog la babs kyang mi gtong ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ho: dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon khyed: ston pa'i sgron me dngos su gsal: mi phyed rdo rje dam tshag mchog: ji ltar brjod pa bdag gis bsrung: zhes lan gsum dang*/ de nas lhar bskyed cing gnas gsum byin brlabs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phogs pas rnam smin gyi phung po sbyangs te 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje gnon nu'i skur gyur par bam la/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri chus slob ma'i spyi mgrin snying ga rnams su thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i/ rig bzhin spyi bor zla ba la gnasapa'i oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po rnams gal bar gyur/ mas yang snying mgrin dpral bar byug cing*/ hūṃ/ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas yig 'bru gsum las 'od zare dkar dmar mthing gsum rigs gyis 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ khyod rang rnams kyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum la thim pas rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ gnas gsum du rdo rje reg cing*/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ zhes brjod pa'i sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar slob ma'i sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin

(125) du gyur ma thag pa de la mchod par 'os te/ nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod par bya'o/ de nas so shing dor ba ni/ las dkyil ras srin tshol bu gang yin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs su gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ chu gnyer spyod byang chub shing gi rang bzhin mtshan nyid tshang ba dre bzang pos sbags rtser chod pan can dngos grub kyi ltas brtags pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur te khyod rang rnams kyi thal mo'i bar du bzung zhing rtse mo sos nem 'chos te mig stong du blta zhing sdig sgrib thams can sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin phyir phag ba'i mos dang*/ rang gi dngos grub dzi ltar thob pa'i mtshan ma'ang gsal bar bltan du gsol snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūṃ ye shes rdo rje mchog gi ni: rtag dang mtshan ma brtag pa'i phyir : bsgrub pa'i so shinga'adi dor bas: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yis: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : dngos grub bzang po rtsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha: zhes kha shar du bltas te thal mo phye nas ltos med du dor ro/ de ltar dor ba'i ltas ni/ me tog bcings pa nyid rtse mo yin pas de rang la brtan na mchog gi dngos grub ste rab/ stong dang 'og tu rigs 'dzin dang pa 'og ste 'bring*/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi dang*/ mtshags bzhir phran tshegs te tha ma'i dngos grub 'grub cing dri'i dkyil 'khor las pyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med do/ ces lung bltan/ rmo lam gsal slad du khyod blud pa ni/ dung zhal gyi dre chu la 'khyil pa lan bdun bzlas nas/ slob ma'i lag g.yas su byin zhing lan gsum btung pa'i lhag ma dpung pa g.yon gyi phyogs nas rgyab tu dor 'jug la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shu dha rmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsha a pya sho dha sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūṃ zhes chu sbyin/

de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa yang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dang khyed par ngag sgrib byang*/ gnas skabs su do nub rmi lam gsal ba dang*/ mthar thug sku gsung thugs kyi dag pa gsum mngon du byed pa'i rten 'brel lo/ bar chad bsrung phyir bsrung skud gdags pa ni/ bsrung skud las chus bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu kha don lnga ldan rdo rje mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa la snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyi lta gon lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi skud pa spyan drangs te thim pas rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas la mchil phu btab slob mar gtad la/ hūṃ (126) ye shes lnga ldan srad bu 'di: mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum dang ldan: khyod kyi dpung par bcings pa yi: bar chad bdud las rgyal bar shog: zhes brjod cing*/ slob ma'i khams dkar dmar gyi bar chad bsrung ched du skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su nyams bskor du bcings shing rdo rje mdud pa btab te las chus mnan pa'i stong du rdo rje rgya graṃ du bzhag la oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ dang*/ hūṃ rdo rje 'bar ba chen po ste: cis kyang mi shig rgyas btab po: zhes rgyas btab/ de yang 'om gang gi lus kyi gdon bgegs bsrung ba dang*/ gsum ltebs kyi sgo gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa dang*/ kha dog lngas ye she lnga dang mdud pa gsum btab pa sku gsung thugs dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel/ nyis bskor du dkris pa ni nyin mtshan phyi nang gi bar chad bsrung zhing mthar thugs sangs rgyas pa'i tshe bdud sde'i dpung las rgyal ba'i rtags mngon du gyur pa'o/ rmi li mi 'khrug pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha las chus bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kun sha che ba hūṃ dang chung dhi las byung ba'i ku sha'i chun po rtsa rtse ma nyams sa slob ma rnams kyi rmi las mi 'khrug cing gsal ba'i nus pa can du gyur ces brjod cing*/

sa bon gnyis lan bdun bzlas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra ka pa tsi shu d+dha haṃ: zhes bzla zhing sbyin pa ni/ kyai sngon gyi ston pa shākya thub: rtsa mchog la ni gdan sbyas te: byang chub mngon du mdzad pa ltar: khyod kyang rten 'brel bzang por 'gyur: zhes pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣaṇa baṃḥzhes ku sha che ba g.yes dang chung ba g.yon du bzung ste bsnol mar gtad/ slob mas lag ma bsnol mar thal mo bkan pas len no/ de ltar kun sha gtad pas gnas skabs rmi las mi 'khrug cing bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ mthar thugs rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du ku sha'i gdan la sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir chos zab mo bshad nas sprod ba bskyed pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u duṃ wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni lam 'byung ngo*/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ de las kyang ni dkon pa ste/ gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ myang ngan mi 'da' byed par nus*/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ sngon du sdig pa byas pa dag /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ grags pa mtha' yangs sngags spyod pas/ tshul la gnas na smon ci dgos/ skyob pa gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs te/ de yang 'jig rten na dkon pa'i dngos po gang zhe na kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ de 'byung bar dka' ba'i dpe ni/ yu dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin te/ de yang sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ban tshe u dum wa ra gcig byon la/ de ni sangs rgyas rgyal rigs su 'byon (127) na dkar po dang bram ze'i rigs la ser po 'byung zhing*/ sangs rgyas nyid dang po thugs bskyed pa na rgyu'i sa bon 'byung*/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na kha 'bus/

bltams pa na kha 'byed/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na cher rgyas/ dka' thug mdzad pa na cung rid/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe me tog de skam par 'gyur te/ de bas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'jig rten du 'byung ba dkon te/ bstan pa rmad byung ma'i stong thun du/ sngon sangs rgyas byung gi rgyal po dang*/ da lta shākya thub pa/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstan pa gsum la ma gtaugs gsang sngags mi 'byung bas bsdus don du sangs rgyas bstan pa rmad byung bsam yas la/ khyad par 'phags pa'i bstan pa rnam gsum byon: zhes gsum zhing*/ de ltar dkon pa tsam du ma zad dkon pa rnyed nas phag yon chen po dang ldan te/ c-i'i phyir na*/ thabs mang la dka' ba med pa gang gis mnyam pa med pa'i sems can gyi don mya ngan mi 'da' ba ste rgyun mi chad par byed nus cing*/ bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i 'phrul gsang chen po dang bur grol ba'i lam yin te*/ de ltar bskal pa bye ba grangs med du mar bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis dag par 'gyur na yon tan mtha' yas par grags pas gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa'i tshul la zhugs zhing gnas na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas pa dang bsgoms pa sogs byas nas nyams su blangs na tshe gcig lus gcig la thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub sogs bla na med pa'i 'phang la sbyor ba'i phyir/ de bas na rigs kyi bu rnams kyi bu rnams de rangs rnyed pa chen po rnyed pa'i rten 'brel mngon du gyur pas spro bar gyis shig ces spro ba bskyed/ rmi lam brtags pa dngos ni/ bu khyod kun sha'i sngas gdan la/ mi smra dge ba'i sems skyis nyol/ rmi lam mtshan ma gang mdon la/ mi smra dge ba'i sems kyis nyol/ rmal lam mtshan ma gang mthong ba/ nang par nga la smra bar gyis/

'o khyed rnams la sngar gtad pa'i ku sha chung ba rtse g.yas su bstan pa sngas dang*/ che ba rtse sngas la bstan pa gdan du byas la gcig la gcig ma reg par glo g.yas phag ste seng ge'i nyal stabs kyi bla ma dang dkyil 'or phyogs sam byang du mgo bstan la nyon mongs pa'i sems spangs zhing*/ nang par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba'i spro ba dang bcas lha dang bla ma la gus pa sogs dge ba'i sems kyis nyol shig /mtshan la bzhir byas pa'i dang po gsum la nges pa med cing cha par rmi lam gang rmis pa bzang na lung bstan dang*/ nang na bsrung thabs byar yod pas sangs drang por nga la smros shig /zhes gdams/ dbang 'phro can yin pa'i gtang rags gi maṇ+ḍal mi dgos shing*/ des slob ma ste gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub cing lam brtags pa'i bzang ngan gyi ltas dang*/ dngos gzhi (128) dbang bskur ba'i rim pa slad nas 'byung zhing*/ de yan chod kyi dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar zhu/ bson nams 'di yi sogs dge ba bsngos la slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*/ de nas yol ba gsal ma mchod kha gsol/ sgru chen chog sgrigs bzhin/ mchod bstod dang*/ sta gon la gnas sa/ gsol ba gdab pa/ hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu segs lan gsum gyi snyan gsan dbab cing*/ de rnams kyis legs so zhes bya sbyin par bsams/ las gzhung gis tshogs mchod nas rigs par brgyad pa gtang rags gi mchod bstod mgor/ rdo rje khu tshul gan rkyel gyi mthe'u chung sbrel zhing mdzub mo rtse sprad pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ badzod tiṣ+ṭha sta gon gyi lha rnams stong gi bar snang la 'od lnga'i dra bar bzhugs par gyur sogs gzhung ltar dkyil 'khor nam mkhar dgod/ gtang rags mchod bstod nas dkyus bzhin rdzogs par gyer/ tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu zhing bum pa mchod pa dang bcas dben par bzhugs so/ nang par slob ma rnams bos la rmi lam dris/

de yang myang gtor 'gro 'dul las/ rmi lasam na nyi ma shar ba dang : thang la nyal ba la sogs pa: zhes bshad pas mtshon rdo rje slob dpond gyi dgongs pas dpag shes par byas la/ dge na spro ba bskyed cing dga' spro'i bdud ma zhugs pa dang*/ ngan na tshogs gtor sbyin bsreg la sogs pas kun rdzob tu bzlog cing*/ don dam par rnam snang mngon byang las/ yang na dngos nyams rmi lam dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer bzhin shes nas/ blo dang ldan pas rmi lam rnams/ snying po med pa shes par bya/ zhes pa ltar dge mi dge'i rtogs pa 'od gsal gtug ma'i shes rab brjod du med pa'i ngang du zil gyi non par bya'o/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa la nang tshan bzhi las/ rul tshon ba brten pa'i tshe/ dang po thig gdab pa dang*/ gnyis pa tshon bkye ba rnams sgrub chen sgribs kyus bzhin bya ba dang*/ rangal bris la bsten pa'i tshe thig tshon dor nas sngar gyi tshom bu'i shul du ras bris tshad ldan bkram/ gsum pa phur pa dgod pa nang tshan bzhi bus pa sogs dkyus bzhin bya zhing*/ bzhi pa rgyan rdzas dgram pa gnyis kyi dngo 'god pa chog sgribs bzhin/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dbang gtor/ tsakli rnams/ hūṃ dur khrod gsang ba nas yongs rdzogs bkod: bar gyi 'god cing gzhan yang mchod gtor sgrub rdzas mchod sogs dbang rkyang dang sgrub chen 'brel min gyi dbye bas legs par bkod zin pa dang*/ gnyis pa gzhal yas don bstod dkyus ltar dang*/ bzhi pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa nang tshan bdun rnams dbang rkyang la dor zhing*/ lnga pa lha (129) brkos la gdab pa dang byin 'bebs gnyis kyus ltar bya/ drug pa sgrub mchod ni/ nang tshan gsum las/ dang po dbang rkyang la/ brgyud 'debs nas bzung sngon 'gro dgu dang*/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas bzlas pa'i bar las rim nyi shu'i las byang gzhung bsrangs te bskyed rdzogs la goms pa bstan pas bdag mdun bum gsum 'jug la gcig gis rung la der bdun 'dzab ci 'grub bzla zhing*/

slar gzungs thag btang te bum par dmigs pas bzlas pa dang*/ mos pa'i spyod pa rnams ni so sor cho ga tha dad pas dmigs rnam phyed pa nyid legs shing mthar stong tshig mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya/ bka' srung gtor srung gi gtor chog dang*/ rjes kyi las rim bcu gsum las dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa bskang ba yan grub par byas nas lhag ma bdud rtse bran la dkyil 'khor byang shar du bzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug du 'jug pa'i sngon du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ hūṃ chos dbyings ska ba med pa'i ngang nyid las/ skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin sras dang bcas: sprul pa'i khro tshogs yab yum sras bcas kyi: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor bdag cag la: dbyings nas skur bzhengs byin chen dbab tu gsol: thugs rje chen po'i dbang chen bskur du gsol: rdo rje phur pa ye shes mchog gi ngang : bskal pa sngon nam bdag dang dbyar dam gcig: dus 'dari bdag dang dbyer med bsgrub pa'i phyir: rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam can: rig sa srog gi bsdus pa'i lu gu brgyud: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir: snying po byang chub mchog na ma thob bar: rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis dam bcas te: skye ba ji srid bar du mi btang ngo: zhes snyan gsan sngan du 'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad pas dbang bskur bar bsam la don dbang gi bdag 'jug blangs pa'am: de tsam ma 'grub tshe hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams: sogs las byang ltar brjod cing dbang bzhi ting 'dzin gyis blangs pa'i bdag 'jug go chod pa yang mdzad srol yin/ gnyis pa rab chad bzlog pa/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtags pa dang*/ bdun pa dngos grub len pa nang tshan gsum gyi dang po dang gsum pa dbang rkyang la dor zhing 'dir gnyis pa'i skabs su babs pa'o/

spyi don gnyis pa dbang ji ltar bskur ba'i rim pa ni/ sta gon zin pa'i slob ma rnams sgrub khang sgor bos la/ spros pa la mos na sgo ba ging chen zhu lan 'dod pa gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas rjes sgo dbye zhing*/ me 'phyong dang*/ las bum gyis khrus bya/ khro 'bag ging chas su zhugs pas dho thun gyi badhog cing nang du btang la phyag bya zhing dral du 'khod/ slob dopan gyi bgegs pa gtor ma byin zhing bka' bsgo/ drag sngags dang yungs thun gyi brab cing*/ gu gul gyis bdug /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom (130) las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkram bsdu bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon pa kun bzang ha ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i chod du 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas nod nyams su blangs te sems can gyi don rgya chen po bgyid snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab te gsan tshal/ de la thog mar chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams gal che bar gda' ste/ de yang skyes rabs las/ rang tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rab tu bskyed/ dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ gus pa bskyed cing rtse gcig btud/ rang tu dad la dri med yid/ nad mas sman pa'i tshag mnyan bzhin/ rig gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces bya ba dang*/ gu ru pad+ma'i man ngag las/ mi gi dbang pos chos smra'i zhal du blta/ rnam pa'i dbang pos ma yangs gsung la nyan/ yid kyi dbang pos tshig bzung don la brtags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gus par nyan dgos shing*/ da'i mi mthun phyogs snod kyi skyon gsum dang dri ma drug spang dgos te/ lam rim las/ bcud chen 'dzag dang 'bo dang ni/ mi chags ma rungs byed pa dang*/ zhes gsungs te/ snod kha sbub pa la bcud bzang po chags pa'i go skabs med pa lhu sems gzhan du yongs pa dang*/

snod zhabs dhol du bcud blug kyang rang sar zag ste mi gnas sa lta bu nyan yang tshig don yid la bzung ba dang*/ snod dug can du bcud bzang po blug kyang dug dang 'dres pas bzang mi rung ba ltar bla ma dang chos la log par rtog cing*/ mnyam 'grogs dang thos pa'i rgyal sogs chos nyon mongs pa'i gros su song ba ste snod kyi skyon gsum/ de bzhin du rnams bshad rigs pa las/ nga rgya dang ni ma dad dngas/ don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*/ phyi rol rnam g.yengs nang du bsdus/ skye ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ chos thob pa'i khong bas nga lhag snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ 'chad nyan gyi nus pa bdag la'ang yod snyam pa'i ma dad pa/ phyi bshol le lo'i dbang gi don du mi gnyer ba/ tshogs drug tha mas du gol nas rnam par g.yengs ba/ nyan pa'i tshe gnyed rmug tu gyur pa dang*/ ci mi snyan pas bsam gnyan gyi ngang du yid bsdud pa/ chos thun phun ring ring ba dang ma go ba'i skye bar gyur pa rnams kyi gnyen por/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ rtog pa thams legs par bsdus nas ni/ shin tu bams pa bzang po ldan pas nyon/ brjod ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin mi brlab/ ces dang*/ mdo las/ dge slong dag legs par rab tu nyon la yid la bzung zhig dang*/ ngas khyod la bstan par bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sgo gsum legs par bsdams te 'du shes bzhi

(131) dang pho rol phyin pa drug bsten ste/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bdag nyid la dan pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ nan tan gsum nyams su len kha la nad len pa la nad nyi bar 'tsho ba'i 'dus bskyed bar bya'o/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ zhes dang chos spyod mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las/ me tog stan sogs rab dbul zhing*/ sa phyogs spyod lam sdom pa dang*/ srog chags kun la 'tsho mi byed/ bla ma la ni gsol ba 'debs/ me ngas bla ma'i gdams ngag nyon/ rtogs sel phrir na skyon tshig 'dri/ sgrol ma yan lag drug dang ldan/ ces gsungs pa rnams kyi don legs par dpyad de gsan par zhu/ 'dir gsan par bya ba'i chos ni 'o skol gyi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po mnga' ba de nyid kyis/ sen thams cad kyi bsam pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ skal ba'i khyed par dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhi ba chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa zhig ston par mdzad pa de thams cad theg par rim pa dgur 'dus shing*/ dai nga bsdu na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su 'dus te/ kun byed rgyal po las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ mtshan nyid rgyud yi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'o/ zhes pa ltar rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir 'bras bu lam byed la mos pa'i gdul bya dbang rnon rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir gsungs pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg payin te/ tshul gsum sgrol ma las/ don gcig na'ang ma rmongs dang*/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de la gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gsang sngags gsar rnyeng gnyis las/ rong zol chos kyi bzang po'i zhal nas gsar ma las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshe ba drug yod ces gsungs/

drug gang zhe na/ yon bdag gnas dang lo pan dang*/ zhu rten chos kyi che bas 'phags/ zhes pa ltar/ che ba drug gi gsar ma las khyad par du gyur pa rnying ma yin/ de la phyi nang gnyis las phyi bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum las 'phags pa/ 'dir nang brgyud rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa/ de la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang ste bka' srol po gsum du yod pa las/ gtso bor brgyud thag nye zhing*/ khungs btsun pa dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dus dang mtshams par mngon du snang ba'i phyir zab lam nu ba pa med pas khyad par du 'phags pa gter gyis phyogs su gtogs pa yin la/ de yang nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ lo rgyus don gyi ma bshad na/ gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ yid mi chos pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ ces gsums pa'i yid ches zhing khungs btsun pa'i 'thad pa 'jug phyir brgyud pa'i lo rgyus cung zad gleng (132) na/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'og min gyi gnas gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du bcom ldan 'das 'phrin las kyi bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu la rigs bzhi'i sangs rgyas dang sprul pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gsang ba'i dbag pos zhus pa'i ngor bi rgya rto ma la sogs par phur pas rtsa ba dang bshad pa yan lag gi rgyud sde mtha' yas par gsungs te/ gsang ba'i bdag po dang mkhro ma rnams kyis glegs baṃ du bris nas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal dang*/ mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa la sogs par gtor du sbas so/ de nas phur pa 'phrin las kyi rigs 'dzin sra bha sha sti'i mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa nas g.yu'i sgrom bu zhig gter nas thon pa las phur pa'i rgyud mang po byon no/ yang dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis byin rlabs gcig tu bsdus pa u rgyan gyi yul dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling gi me tog pad+ma'i sbubs su rigs 'dzin gyi slob dpon pad+mar 'byung gnas su sprul pa las/
