u rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhis spyan drangs te rang gi sras su mnga' gsol/ rgyal srin chos bzhin du bskyangs/ mthar 'dod pa'i yon tan la zhes pa spong ba'i phyir rgyal srid spangs pa sogs mtshan don tha dad pa'i sgo nas mdzad pa gtso che ba rnam grangs brgyad du bstan/ du khrad brgyad du brtul shugs kyi spyod pa bskyangs/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi nor 'dzin ma lus pa zhabs kyis bcag shing*/ rgyal po la sogs pa nga rgyal gyi dregs pas rgyag pa dang*/ phyi rol la sogs te ltar spyod phyin ci log gi g.yang par ltung ba dang*/ bar ma'i 'gro ba las dang nyan mongs pa'i rnam par dkrig pa mtha' dag 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i brtul shugs rlabs po ches yang dag pa'i lam la gzud par mdzad pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge gtis pa de nyid/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dug shing gi sdong po'i rtsa ba na nus mo me 'bar ba'i gsel nas lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dug mi dgu pa gcig gis ngas sems can skyabs med pa'i skyabs/ mgon med pa'i mgon bya'o zer ba gzigs pas/ phyir nang de brkos pa'i 'og nas phur pa'i rgyud mang po byung ngo*/ de nas slob dpon pad+mas rigs 'dzin chen po sras bha ha sti la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bskur bar zhus pas/ sra bha hastis ngas khyod la phur pa'i dbang bskur ba'i skal ba mi ldan pas/ 'di nas rgya rag shar phyogs dur khrod po pa'i gling na bye brag gi pho brang thod pa brtsegs pa'i mkhar na mkhro ma bde ba'i 'gor lo braya ba bzhugs pas de la zhus zhes lung bstan pa bzhin/ der byon pas dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yangs khang sgru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gdan la mkhro ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭ+wam dang thod khrag bsnams pa khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa 'khor ma mo mkha' 'gro bye bas bskor ba/ kī la ya'i sgra drag tu sgrogs pa dang mjal bas phur pa'i dbang bskur bar

(133) zhus pas/ mkhro mas/ slob dpon hūṃ yig gcig tu bsgyur nas zhal du mid/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ thugs ka /gsang gnas rnams su zhal re re bzhag ste/ bdang bzhi rdzogs par bskur bas mkhas gsang nas byung zhing*/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos thams cad ma lus par gnang*/ skye 'chi med pa tshe la dbang ba'i rigs 'dzin dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i rin 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgya chen pa'i rigs 'dzin gyi dngos grub la mnga' brnyen par gyur te/ slar yang sra bha hasti'i spyan sngar byon nas rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud tshar bco brgyad gsan cing 'phrin las phur pa'i bka' ma lus pa'i dbag nyid du gyur/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag bug tu byon nas/ dpal yang dag mar me dgu'i dkyi 'khor bzhengs nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ klu gyong po dang*/ gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ bar snang khams kyi glog ma p+sarin gsum gyi yid ma mi bzod pa'i tshor ba skyes te/ than pa chen pos rtsi shing lo thog chu mig 'an chad bskams/ mu ge chen pos mi phyug thams cad kha dag nyan byung bas/ slob dpon gyi de dag gi bar chad yin par dgongs te/ bal so shī la dang*/ bal po kun zhi gnyis la gser phye bre gang dang*/ gser srang brgya la byas pa'i sa ṭa gcig bskur nas/ rgya gar chos skyong ba'i rgyal po la phul nas rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde bzhugs tshad bskur ba'i 'phrin brjangs pa'i/ pho nyas rgyal por gsol bas/ rgyal pos bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du paṇ+ḍi ta rnams pa de ska bsgom pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta stong lnga brgya rnams bka' gros nas rdo rje phur pa'i chos mi khur theg tshad gnyis brjangs pa'i/ yang she kyi phug par phob pa tsam gyi nam mkha' la sprin 'dus/ zhal phyes pa tsam gyi char babs/ chu m-ig skam pa rnams rgyas/ rtsi shing nags tshal lo thog thams cad sngo lhubs kyis skyes shing rgyas so/ de nas slob dpon gyi rdo rje phur pa'i chos de rnams dpag bsam gyi shing la dpe blangs te/

bi rgyarten ma la sogs pa rtse ba lta bu'i rgyud bzhi/ rgyud phyi ma bzhi/ phyi ma'i phyi ma bzhi/ khro bo bcu'i rgyud dai yal ga lta bu'i rgyud bcu/ sho na dkar nag sogs lo ma ltu'i rgyud gsum/ rnal 'byor bla ma sogs me teg lta bu'i rgyud bzhi/ rdo rje rtse mo sogs 'bras bu ltu'i rgyud bzhi/ phyi rgyu sku gsung thugs kyi rgyu gsum ste rgyud gsum ste sum cu rtsa drug gi bzhi bcu zhe brgyad du phyi ba'i rgyud sde le lag dang bcas pa mdzad/ de dag bang chen pa'i phrag par bzung*/ slob dpon nyid kyang gshegs pas dpon slob gsum tshad ba tsha shod du nub gcig gzims pa'i nam phyed mnal thum thum yod pa la cho 'phrul chen po byung*/ gzigs pas mdun na ne gu drung drung pa gcig 'dug /ting 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bsdams lhung bzod du bcug /nang pas chu mig byang chub ris su gro btab pa'i tshe kha phyi bas/ lha'i bu mo mdzes sdug 'od 'bar ba bzhi 'dug pa khyod (134) bzhi su yin gsungs pas/ ngod bzhi yul tsha ba shod kyi rgyal khams la dbang byed pa'i sa bdag bse'i bu mo bzhi yin zer/ slob dpon gyi dam la btags shing rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'chad nyan bsgom sgrub byed pa'i srung mar brkes/ gsang mtshan/ rdo rje ya byin/ rdo rje se byin/ rdo rje phag byin ces btags shing phug bsrung bse'i lha mo mched bzhir grags po/ de nas slob dpon bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la phyag dpe ma rnams gtad/ slob dpon nyid kyi brtsams pa rnams gzigs su brim pas/ paṇ+ḍa ta rnams mnyes nas phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal zhing*/ phyin chad kyang gsang sngags kyi 'brel pa sgrub thabs brtsams shig pa'i bskul ma mdzad cing mngon par bstod do/ bod kyi spyan 'dren pa'ang lhags par mkhyen nas slar bal yul yang me shod kyi brag phug tu byon/

slob dpon chen po nyi dang*/ paṇa chen bi mā mi tri/ bal po shī la mañju gsum gyis rdo rje phur pa'i bsgrub pa mdzad pas/ nub dang po la lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu/ gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad/ zangs kyi kha mo rkang gsum/ g.yu yi khyi mo ral pa can rnams la chibs pa'i bud med phur pa thogs pa bzhi byung ba dam la btags nas phur bsrung sho na mchod bzhi ming btags/ nub gnyis pa la sngar gyi bse'i lha mo bzhi byung*/ nub gsum sa la lha mo ri ma ti mchod bzhi byung ba rnams dam la btags nas rdo rje phur pa'i smin grol nyams su len pa rnams kyi srung mar brkos so/ de'i tshe phur pa rnams dkyil 'khor stong du 'khrab cing byung bas/ slob dpon gyis gdab pa'i drod tshad la ma babs gsungs nas phur pa rnams sgro bar bcug nas bsgrubs pas/ sgro ba nam mkha' la 'phar zhing sgro ba las chom 'ur gyi sgra raṃ raṃ byung bas/ slob dpon gyis da ni gdab pa'i drod tshad la babs gsungs nas phur pa rnams bton te slob dpon pad+ma'i rgya gar gyis ri ma la ya'i tsan dan nags tshal me shor ba la btab pas me shi tsan dan kyang sngo lhub kyis skyes/ paṇa chen bi mā la'i chu bo gaṅga dang pak+ṣu dus gcig 'brub pa la btab zhas zhag dgu gyen la bzlog bal po shī la mañju'i maṇ+ḍa yi ri la brag srin po mi rkun gnas pa la btab pas brag srin thul zhing brag mkhar gong thams cad tsam du mthor nas zhig par gyur/ de'i tsho slob dpon gsum kas rdo rje gzhon nu gzhal dngos su mjal/ dam can sde gsum gyi phyir rabs phur pa'i chos 'chad nyan bsgoms bsgrub byed pa rnams bu bzhin du skyong bar khas blangs so/ slob dpon rnams gsum gyi dgongs bsdur nas mdzad pa'i chos rnams la phur pa rnams gsum skor zhes bya bar grags so/ de'i tshe bod yul mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa chos rgyal khri song lde'i btsan gyi dpal gyibasam yis bzhengs pa'i tshe/

brtsig tu ma btub nas za (135) hor gyi mkhan po bo dho sa two'i zhal nas/ da lta bal yul yang lo shod kyi phug par pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes mthu stobs nus pa'i dbang phyug zhig bzhugs pa de spyon 'dren dgos gsungs pas/ rgyal pos pho nya baljangs nas spyan drangs sa las mtha' 'khob bo yul gdongs dmar mun pa'i gling du bstan pa'i sgron me sbra ba'i slad du byon te/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i me lce rnon po lha srin gdug pa'i tshang tshing bsrogs te ming gi lhag mar byas/ mgur lha dge bsnyen rnams dka' rtags phyag rgya gnyen po'i zil 'og tu spo bkongs nas bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer du du brkos shing brag dmar bsam yas su byon/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas bsam yas kyi sa 'dul phur 'cham dang bcas pa mdzad/ bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags/ gtsug lag nyen mo mis brtsigs pa las/ mtshan mo lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho bar gyur pas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes mtshan gsol/ de ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa 'gro ba'i chos sdong gcig tu bzhengs nas bar gnas dang mnga' gsol mdzad/ pachen bi mā la sogs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhugs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rnams dang*/ bai ro tsā na sogs te dag pa chen po lag nags pa'i lo tsā ba mang so lung bstan cing mod sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba'i zhal bkod mdzad/ sa gzhi dang gangs brag thams cad dben ri sgrub gnasasu byin gyis brlabs/ mnga' bdag rgyal po'i dgongs pa mtha' ru skyol zhing bod 'bangs la bka' drin 'gran zla med par mdzad/ de ltar rdo rje phur pa slob dpon chen po'i zhabs la brgyud de/ phur pa rgyal po lugs dang*/ jo mo lugs lcam lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' babs kyi ngos pa tha dad mod/ de dag las dang po ni/ mnga' bdag rgyal po rje 'bangs blaun po dngabacas pa rnams la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gnang zhing*/

rje 'bangs rnams kyi brag dmar mgrin bzang du rdo rje phur pa'i bsgrub pa btsug pa'i tshe phur pa 'khrab pa dang*/ me 'bar ba/ 'od 'phrug pa/ lding ba sogs byung ste/ der mnga' bdag rgyal pos bsam yas has po ri la phur pa btab pa me 'bar nas rtse shing nags tshalal thams cad bsregs/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mkhar tshu'i brag la btab pas mkhar chu lcags phur can grags/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi ri la dzad pas 'dril ba tsam gyis me 'bar/ rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi gtsang po la btab pas nyi ma khyed kyi bar gyen du 'khyil bas 'bab ma nus shud bu dpal gyi seng ges dgun has po ri la btab pas rtsi shing nags tshal sngo lhun grub kyi song*/ shākya sra bhas skyi she+od brag zangs yag dmar por btab pas brag mkhar bas mtho ba rnams hril gyi ral/ jo mo mkhar chen bzas nam mkha'i bya rog la btab pas thang la lhung*/ pha ming la na tsha rgod par yod pas/ pha ming gi za 'dre la kī la ya gsungs pas/ phur pa phyag nas 'phur te so/ phyis nang 'atsal ba'i khang ltag za 'dre gnas pa'i skyor phung (136) gcig la zug nas khrag sham me 'dug pa kun gyi mthong*/ pha ming za 'dre thul nas dar rgyas su gyur te phur pa jo mo'i dbon rgyud rnams kyi bcangs pas mkhar chen 'dre 'dul gyi brgyud par grags gzhan yang slob dpon chen po'i dngos slob mkhon klu'i dbang po dang*/ 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug sogs phur pa'i grub thob bka' babs mang du byung kyang*/ bka' babs kyi gtso bo ni mgar chen bzang yin/ de nas slob dpon gyi dpal gyi daphang phyugs la tsan dan gyi phur pa khye'u lo brgyad tsam zhig gnang nas/ gtsang gi byango ngas srin mo gdug pa can gcig ma thul bar yod pas thul cig gsungs nas/ slob dpon srin yul du 'byon par dgongs te/ bod kyi sgrub gnas thams cad dang rgya bal rgya nag kong rtse'i ri yan la rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas rdo rje phur pa'i chos dang phur pa thun rdzas sogs gtor chu du ba sbas te/

de'i gcig ni gter bdag minag pa zhig gis bton nas 'gro don mi 'byung*/ gzhan thams cad dus skabs so sor 'gro don chen po 'byung ba lung bstan cing gsungs las/ yid gnyis med par 'di ma mos byed cing : bsgrub pa sna gcig tsam zhing byas pa na: yid la ci 'dod 'grub par ma gyur na: u rgyan nga yi phyi rab 'gro ba bslus: zhes ta tshig gsungs so/ mdor na slob dpon rin po che dang ye shes mtsho rgya gnyis kyi yi dam gatsho bo rdo rje phur pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ de nas slob dpon srin po'i kha gnon du byon pa na/ lha sras mu tig btsad po sogs bod kyi rgyal blon thams cad kyi mang yul gyi bar du bskyel ma mdzad cing so sor chos dang zhal gdams mang du gnas/ de skabs jo mo mkhar chen bza' dang*/ cog ro bza' dpal gyi mchod gnas ma dang*/ g.yog a tsā ra sa le gsum gyi bdag cag rnams kyi dbang po dang bsdun pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i thugs kyi bcud phyug ba'i chos shig zhu zhugs pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang nga la zhu'am lha la zhu gsungs pas/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi dbang slob dpon la zhu zhus pa'i dbang gnang zhing slob dpon nyid kyi mgul khakha nas shog dril bton te rdo rje phur pa'i skor 'di bas zab pa yod ri zhes dbugs dbyung mdzad nas rtsal cing khyod kyi a tsa ra sa le la yang shod cig gsungs nas slob dpon nyid rnga yab gli du gshegs nas srin po'i kha gnon du bzhugs so/ de nas jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi mon kha ne ring seng ge rjong gsum du rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phur pa'i lha tshogs zhal dngos su mdzal/ grub rtags brag la phur pa'i dgams ngag gnang bas grub pa thob pa mang du byung bas phur pa jo mo lugs su grags shing zab pa yin/ lcag lugs ni

(137) cog ro bza'i bsam pa la/ slob dpon da rung gang zag gi tshul du yang 'dug/ nga rang dang 'brel pa yod pa yin pas/ lha la zhus nas lhag snyam nas dbang lha la zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor thugs kar bsdus pas mo dbang skal chad*/ slar jo mo mtsho rgyal la rjes su gnang nas jo mos cog ro bza' la gdams pa las brgyud pa dang*/ sa le'i bla ma'i dgongs sa dang sbyar bar zhus pas/ rten 'brel gyi dbang las yang phur bdud rtse lcam lugs mizab par grags/ gzhan yang sna nam mkha' rong lugs lha nag/ lha khra sogs/ ngo bo gcig la man ngag gi ldog cha dang*/ bka' babs kyi khyad par sogs mtha' yas shing*/ dpal gyi dbang phyug gi sngar slob dpon gyi bka' lung bzhin gtsang byang ngos su rdo rje phur pa bsgrub pas srin mo dngos su btul ba'i tshe lho nub rnga yab nas 'od chen pos lung pa bran pa ltar gyur pas/ bo bran dpal gyi dbang phyug tu grags shing*/ phur bsrung re ma ting dngos su zhal gzigs pa sogs dang*/ khong gi brgyud pa la gtor ma bsham pa tsam gyi dgra la mthu 'gro ba'i nus pa khyed can gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa 'byung ngo*/ khyad par 'khon klu'i dbang po nas bzung sa chen kun dga' snying po yan yang phur gyi grub pa thob pa rab ma chad pa byon zhings skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo 'dul bar gshegs pa'i tshe skyid grong la byon pa na/ grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phyag rub dang gnas khang gcig tu 'dzom/ 'dar phyag zhal 'chos pas/ oṃ badz+ra kyi li gyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa: zhes 'grangs pas pa paṇa bzhad cing sngags ma dag par 'dug kī li kī la ya zer gsungs pas/ der 'dar phyir thugs yus nas nga sngar yang kyi li kyi las song*/ da yang kyi li kyi las 'gro zer nas sku skod nas phur pa phyung ba brag la brgya pas tham tham 'dam la btab pa ltar song ngo*/ paṇ+ḍi tas bod mos pas 'grub zer ba de bden par 'dug gsungs grub thob tu shes nas/

nga mu stegs pa la rtsed du 'gro ba'i de'i rim gror 'byen dgos gsungs/ rung gsungs nas lhan du byon/ sa padang 'phrog byed dga' bo gnyis nyi ma bcu gsum gyi bar du rtsod pa'i g.yul ngo la zhugs pa na/ mthar pa paṇa rgyal yang*/ grub rtags 'gran zer 'phrog byed dga' bos ral pa rgyab du bskyur/ lags pa shagos pa ltar bskyong te nam mkha' la 'phur bas sa paṇa thabs ma rnyed par badz+ra kyi li kyi lu rgyug shog ces 'dar 'phyar bos pa'i rnam 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i mu stegs kyi grib ma la/ o badz+ra kyi li kyi lā kyi lā ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: ces phur pa btab pas/ bya la rdo btab pa bzhin mu stegs pa sa la lhung bar gyur te/ 'dis mus srad du byon nas gtsug lag khang gi rten gtsor mtshan ma rjas kyi phur pa 'di bzhugs shing phyis gyir ba'i lo rgyus sogs gzhan du shes la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas shangs bsregs shing nas slob dpon pad+ma dngos kyi phyag dpe'i (138) rgya dpe zhig rnyed pa las phur pa rtse thung gi rgyud bsgyur/ bla chen 'phags pa dang*/ bson nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa sa skya zhabs drung na rim thams cad rdo rje phur pa thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad cing chos dang rigs brgyud gnyis gnyis ka zam ma chad pa chos grwa rnams su sgrub mchod phur 'cham sogs da ltī bar dar rgyas che ba rnams phur pa bka' ma'i lugs dang*/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dang rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pa sogs kyis gter kha du ma nas byon sa rnams gter ma yin cing*/ gnyis pa ni/ da lan gyi skabs su babs pa zab la dar srol che ba rat+na lugs kyi phur pa 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ slob dpon rin po che'i bka' rtsis them byang las/ pad+ma bdag gi thugs kyi yang bcud ste: da lta'i dus na rje 'brangs nyer lnga dang : thugs sras dgu la sogs pa smin par byas: da lta spol zhing ston pa'i dus min pas: chos 'di'i bka' babs dbag po yin pa'i phyir:

grogs kyi dam pa mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad: ces dang*/ da lta spol dus ma babs pas: dang lung ldang lha'i brag la sbos: ma 'ongs lnga bcu kha ral dus: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad nas kyang : 'gro don bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog: zhes gtad rgya lung bstan smon lam bcas mdzad pa bzhin/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi klong gsal rigs pa brjod ngas bral ba'i gzungs kyi bzung zhing*/ mkhas pa'i mchog bai ri tsa na'i dha na ko gling pa'i yi ger bokad cing dwags po ldang lung khra mo brag gi po to 'og mar gter du sbas/ dge bsnyen ldang lhang gnyer du gtad nas ma 'ongs lnga bcu kha ral gyi dus su gtaur bdag skal ldan las can dang 'phrad nas 'gro don rlabs chen 'byung ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam mtshams sgyor dang bcas rgyas btab pa las/ lnga bcu kha ral gyi dus na gter ston chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul rat+na gling pa zhes yongs grags rtsod bral gyi skyes bu dam pa de nyid ni mnga' bdag nyang gi thugs gather gyi lung bstan gtad rgyal las/ lo ni lnga bcu khā ral dus: nyi ma shar lha'i phyogs dag tu: chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling: 'phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes sa: mtsho rgyal khyod kyi sprul pa'am: byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes bu 'byung : zhes dang*/ gter kha 'og ma'i sku gsum bsgrub pa'i lung byang las/ 'di nas bying phyogs shing sgo'i mtshams: ri bo khyung chen 'dra ba'i bar: lug lo pad+ma dbang chen rtsal: bskyed rdzogs don la mkhas pa 'byung : zhes dang*/ gu ru jo rtse'i gtor lung las/ mon bu pyi ṛng sgra yi lā wa can: ri bo khyung chen lding ba'i zhol du 'byung : zhes gter kha mang po nas lung gis zin pa bzhin: gnyal gyi phyogs su kher lo tsā ba 'khor lo rgyal mtshan yi rigs su sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas mkhyen ral shin tu zhing dgung la bdun gyi stong slob dpon rin po che zhal dngos su mja'/ dgung lo bcom lnga la gter gyi kha byang

(139) phyag tu son pa bzhin zab mo'i gter kha mang por dbang bsgyur ba gter ston rin chen dpal bzang zhes lang 'gro lo tsā dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi skye ba 'di nyid ni/ rang gter bstan pa spyi lung las lnga bcu kha ral dus kyi tha ma la: da ltī lo tsa lang 'gro dkon mchog 'di: smon lam dbang gi skye ba 'ga' brgyud nas: de dus ri mo khyung chen 'dre'i lher: lcags khams lug lo pad+ma'i rigs can 'byung : khyung chen ri dang mkhar chu'i zab gter 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang zhig po gling pa yin: gung thang ge ri rdzong gsum gter kha 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang rat+na gling par grags: bsam yas gnam skas bum thang gter kha 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang 'gro 'dul gling par grags: stobs ldan skye bu shes rab blo gros can: don gyi rtegs ldan gdul bya'i bka' babs pa: 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma'i rigs can de: bu mchog de yis don gnyis spyod par 'gyur: zhes gter gnas po po'i bdang gis gter ston cig la gling sa gsum gyi mtshan du lung gis zin cing : rten 'brel ma 'grigs pas bar chad kyi bdang du song nas sprul sku tshul dhor ltar gling pa so so'i mtshan can gyi skye ba rim par brgyud dgos rgyu la/ lung bstan bka' rgya chung ba las/ blo gros don ldan skyes bu de: so bdun skeg la ma 'das na: gter kha nyi shu rtsa lnga dbang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin tshe 'phrong rnams grol te sku tshe mthar phyin zhing gter kha nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes/ dongs nyams rmi lam du u rgyan rin po che lan nyu shi rtsa lnga mjalazhing smin gralol gyi gdams pa dpag med thob/ 'gro don tshad bzung mi mnga' bas gter ston gyi gyal po rat+na gling pas dwags po ldang lung khra mo brag nas 'brug lo 'brug zla'i nya'i dus tshe bzang por dge bsnyen ldang lha'i mthun rkyen 'phrid las bsgrub ste spyan drangs pa dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po 'di nyid chos kyi bdag po rtogs pa ldan pa rigs kyi sras lnga thugs kyi sras bcu phrag nyag gsum sogs skal ldan skyes ba rnams la gnang ba'i 'gro don rlabs po chos dar zhing rgyal par mdzad de/

de ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu 'di yi ngo bo ni sngags spyi la phyag na rdo rje/ bya rgyud du rdo rje rnam 'joms dngo nga bo gcig cing*/ gsang sngags rdo rje tog par zhugs pa thams cad kyis bar cad sel bar dam bcas pa'i lha yin pas: lha gang bsgrub kyang 'di srung ma'i tshul du bsten na bar chad mi 'byung zhing gyal 'gong dam sri gdug sa 'dul ba'i mchog dam pa yin te/ sna ni rdo rje ba du 'joms kyi zhus pa'i gsol 'debs las/ bal yul yang le shed kyi bra phug tu: yang dag bde chen snying po bsgrub pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gnas der thob: ces gsungs (140) pa dang*/ khyed par phur pa 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi bdag nyid yin pas/ slob dpon chen po phur pa mkhan po 'akris: phur pa mkhan po dpal che: phur pa mkhan po tshe ring : phur pa mkhan po nor phyug: phur pa mkhan po 'khor rgyas: phur pa mkhan po da 'phel: phur pa mkhan po mthu che: phur pa mkhan po mtha' btsan: zhes yon tan brgyad dang ldan par gsungs so/ de ltar gter ston chen po rigs 'dzin ran+da gling pa nas rtsi ba'i bla ma'i bar du dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ gdams ngag la lhad ma zhugs/ byin brlabs kyi drod ma yal/ dngos grub kyi pha 'bab ma chad/ mthu rtsal gyi dbal ma sdug /nyams log gis sel gyis ma sbags pa ste yid chos bskyed pa'i phyir brgyud pa'i lo rgyas zur tsam smos pa yin la/ lo rgyus de dang ldan pa'i gdams pa dngos la'ang rgyud smin par byed pa dang*/ smin cing grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs kyi rims pa gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir dbang bskur ba'i rim pa de skabs su babs pa yin/ de la'ang rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ rdo rje slob ma'i bya ba gnyis yod pa las/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rnams chad lhag med pa dam pa'i phyag bzhes las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin sngon du song grub pas/

da rdo rje slom ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces badha' sbyar la sngar me tog bkram bsdu byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug /de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i rim pa song nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir chas su 'jug pa ni pa'i ling thog gis ldongs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams zhal ma mjal ba mtshon byed du spyan dar dmar po re bcings pa'i mos ma mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma na ye swā hā: zhes mig 'gor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag rten du umawā ra'i me tog gi 'phreng ba kha dog lnga sa re bzung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis me tog 'phreng ba gtad/ de nas gsol du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sa phyogs 'di nyid pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur pa'i slob dpon nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dngos yin snyam du dad pa'i gdung shu su bzung du gsol snyam pa'i me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai rdo rje 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor bdag: phur pa bla na med pa yis: dkyil 'khor chen por bdag 'jug cing : par bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum dang*/ bla mas lan sbyin pa ni/ legs 'ong skal ldan rims can rnams: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug cing dam la gnas gyur pa'i: la (141) lags sam: zhesapa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag cag skal ldan bsgrub pa pos: lha dang bla ma dbyer mi phyed: bla med rdo rje phur pa yis: dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'jug par spro: zhes lan gsum bya zhing*/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sdoms pa bzung ba rnams sta gon skabs bshad pa ltar 'der blangs te gdams/ de nas slob dpon gyi sgo dbye ba'i rgya dang*/ shu buṃ sra we sha ya phaṭ+wa: ces brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shags gis phye bar gyar/

las kyi rdo rjes yol ba bsal cing*/ gtso bo'i thugasaka nas bye ba'i las kyi rdo rje thon pa'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'chang du bcug ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes las kyi rdo rjes khrid pa'i tshe tshad med pa bzhi yi 'jug pa'i bskor phyags su dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi dang*/ srar yang shar sgo'i nang gi 'khyams la gnas pa'i thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ nā ma te hūṃ/ oṃ nā ma me hūṃḥ zhes dang de bzhin du gsas bskor gyi lde'i khyams la gnas pa'i sogs sngar bzhin bya ba phyogs bzhi kar 'gro zhing*/ go yul gyi bde na slob bu dkyil 'khor phyogs so sor sku gsung thugs kyi phyag lan gsum byar 'jug la/ ma bde na de bzhin du dmigs pas rjes zlos bya bas 'thus so/ de ltar phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa song nas/ na nang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i blad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla na med: dngos grub chen po 'byung ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: nyams na khro bo chen po yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: ma nyams na ni dngos grub mchog /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong bas: dngos grub ma lus thob pa dang : 'phrin las rnam bzhi khyod kyi 'grub: ces brjod/ dam rjas dang las chu bsres pa lce la bzhag ci/ hūṃ gsang ba rdo rje las byang ba'i: 'di na dam tshig srog gi chu: khyod kyi snying la zhugs nas ni: gal te nyams na bsreg 'gyur zhing : ma nyams na ni ye shes mtshog: rdo rje las kyi chu 'dis 'grub: oṃ badz+ra ud ka ṭa tha ya hūṃ: zhes 'thung du gzhug rdo rje gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ hūṃ rdo rje khros pa'i zhe sdang gcod*/ gsang ba gsum gyi dam tshig ni:

khyod kyi rab tu gnon gyur te: 'di kun nyams na nyes chen po: ltung ba chen por khyod 'gyur bas: dam tshig srog bzhin btsa' bar bya: badz+ra pa ma ya (142) na ra kan: ces sngags brjod du bcug /de ltar bdud rtsi'i chu de lce la bzhag kyang snying gi dkyil du babs te/ gal te dam tshig las 'das na las kyi gshin rje lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu par gyur nas snying khrag 'jigs pas mthong chos su'ang tshe thung zhing nad mang la phyi ma rdo rje dmyal bar bsregs par byed cing*/ dam tshig bsrung na lha ye shes sems dpar gyur nas rtag tu byin gyis brlob cing*/ 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas chen por 'gyur ba ste/ de nas na blangs dol srog la babs kyang 'bad par rigs so/ ces gdams/ de nas nang 'jug gi dongs gzhi ye shes dbab pa yin pas khyed rang rnams lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrangs la gal pa pyi bor thol mo sbyor/ ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor chings/ sems gnad dmigs pa ma mengs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpal rdo rje gzhon nur galal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la phogs pas rnam smin dhos bcas kyi lus 'dis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i dbyings su sbyangs par mos/ las chu 'thor zhing bsangs sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhi'i gdan la rang rang gi rigs pa'i ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon po gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams char bcad/ 'od zer slar 'dus pa las/ 'khor 'das kyi byin rlabs nus stobs bsdus nas hūṃ la thim yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gi rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nas zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad kyi don stabs su bgrad pa/

zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dubs sku dang mthun pa/ spyan dug sdang mig tu bsgrad cing zhal gdangs ljangs 'drel mche ba zla tshes su brtsegs pa/ phyag drug g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga/ g.yon dang po sdig mjub las me 'bar ba/ bar pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /mtha' gnyis phur sa 'drel ba/ 'bar ba'i gar dgu dang*/ dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ rdo rje rin chen 'bar ba'i gshogs pa gdong ba/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sgu mdog mthing skye zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ut+pa la'i yu ba byas pa'i dri bu yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa'i dung dmar gtso bo la stob pa/ gcig gis sharam thabs dang gyun drug ser rag khra spras pa med dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa'i gatsho bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur pa 'drel ba de'i thugs kar nyi stong rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru rtsaṃ gyi lte bar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi mthar kī la ya 'bru bcu gsum gyis bskor bar bsgom pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgren par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa las/ de ltar mos gus dung

(143) dung byas pa'i rkyen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum dang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par grangs med pa kha char bu yug 'tshub pa ltar spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkha' sprin 'thibs pa ltar gsal ba'i/ gnas gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar khu phang ltar sha ra ra babs pas lus ngag yid gsum la sgum gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs tham/ khyed par thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon dang sngags 'phreng gsal ba de la lha tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thami par bsgom shig /ces sbyar dang rang byung gi spos bsreg/ ḍ+wa dril sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūṃ skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skyes ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: chos kyi dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub ma lus rtsel ba dang : ye shes khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dang : ki lā ya yi dngos grub rtsol ba'i phyir: ye shes khro rgyal tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya dzaḥ rtsa sngags mthar/ ā we she ya a ā: zhes btags pa lan mang du brjod/ ye shes phebs rtags ni/ slob mas lung ngag yid gsum bcings pa 'dar ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ saṃ skṛ ta'i sgra dang*/ badha' skad dang*/ glu dang nyams dga' ba dang*/ bag phebs pa dang*/ rtogs pa thon brgal du skye ba ni dbang las byung ba ye shes ma nor ba nyid de/ mdor sgo gsum la blangs dor med pa'i spyod pa rna tshogs 'char ba ni ye shes phobs pa'i rtags so/

phebs rtags byung ba dang*/ de ltar byin phab pa'i ye shes pa rnams khyed dang ro gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par bya/ de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtags pa'i ched du khyod rang rnams mig dar dang bcas bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la bltas te kha dog gang mthong ba de nged la smra dgos pa'i/ kyai khyed rnams mig lab dag tu ji ltar snang: zhes dris la/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ sngon po'i nag pos drag po/ ljang gu'aṃ khrab bo mthong na lhun gyab pa'i las 'grub par lung bstan dgos kyang*/ 'dir bsdoms te slob mas/ 'di'i rjes zlos dkar ser dmar ljang nag dang mthing khrar mthong*/ zhes pa'i lan du/ khyod rnams 'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan to/ de nas rigs dang las 'brel brtags pa'i phyir cod pan dar sna lnga por bzhi pa chad pa te dkyil 'khor shar sgo nas mig (144) dar dang bcas/ 'di na bcom 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa yin te/ ngo bo ye shes gcig las dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par shar bas bzang ngan med na'ang*/ rang gi las 'brel yod pa'i lha de la 'bab par shog snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dor ba mdzod/ hūṃ sradi pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor du: bsgrub pa'i me tog 'di dor bas: byang chub sems nyid mngod du bston: tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba yis: gus pas lha la me tog 'bul/ las dang skal bar mthun par shog: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe d+dhi s+t+wi ghṛ ṇa ho: zhes dkyil 'khor dngos sam tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal du ltos med dor bcug nas gang la babs pa'i rigs nges par byas te/ rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang mtshan brtags pa ni/ dbus su rdo rje 'dus pa rtsal/

shar dutsa zhes sdang rdo rje lho ru rat+na rdo rje/ nub tu pad+ma dbang chen rdo rje/ byang du las kyi rdo rje sogs gsang ba'i ming btags/ de ltar sngar phul ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba de dang rtags cod paṇa gyi tshul du mgo bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ cod pan 'di ni dpara' ba'i rtags: yi dam lha dang skal ba mnyam: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ji bzhin du: chos kyi rgyal srid dbang bskur ro: puṣ+pe ā we sha ya ā āḥ zhes bla mas cod pan spyi bor bzhag ste me tog 'thor/ shis pa brjod cing ming ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang bya'o/ mig dbye ba ni/ de nas ma rigs pa'i lang thog mig dar dang lhan gcig tu bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje'i gser thur gyis mig dbye ba'i stang ka dang bcas te/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal ba yi: ma rigs ling tog bsal byas ltar: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis: khyod kyis mi shes dri ma bsal: oṃ badz+ra tsak+shu sra we sha ya phaṭa: ces mig dar bsal/ de ltar ye shes kyi mig gsar du thob pa de la mthong ba bstan pa ni 'di la gsan pas khyad par gda'/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen por ltos: shes rab rnam gsum mchog tu bskyed: khyod ni dpal gyi rigs su skye: bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis rlabs: 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad la: bu bzhin snying rje chen po bskyed: gsang ba bgrod pa'i lam du zhugs: sku lnga yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur: ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor rnam dag bshad pa ni: slob dpon gyis gser gyi thur ma thogs te/ 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams rna ba'i dbang po ma yengs par nyon la: mig gi dbang pos legs par ltos shig: dkyil 'khor 'dir rnam dag bshad pa ni: badha'i don phyi nas nang du bshad pa dang : don gyi rnam dag nang nas phyirabashad pa gnyis las: 'di ni don gyi rnam dag bshad par bya ste: dbus su e mthing nag chos 'byung zla gam sgo gcig gsal bar 'dug pa 'di/

gtso bo dho rje gzhon nu bzhugs pa'i don yin no: (145) de'i mtha' zla gaṃ gsum mu khyud gsum thod pas bskor ba ni: chos sku longs sku sprul gsum du mtshon pa'i rtags so: de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ni/ sku bzhi 'phron las bzhi'i bdag nyid dang sras mchog bzhi bzhugs pa'i don no/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bcu 'dug pa ni: ye shes kyi khro bo bcu yab yum za gsod khra thabs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i don no: de'i phyir thod pa skam rlon gyi brtsigs pa ni chos kyi dbyings las 'gags med kyi rtsal shar ba'o: rnam thar bzhi'i don mtshon pa grub chad bzhir byung ba'o: pan rang gi brtsigs pa sna lnga 'byung ba ni/ ye shes lngas don mtshon pa'o: phyogs bzhir khyams bzhi byung ba ni: chos nyid mnyam pa nyid badhal ba'i don mtshon pa'o: dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir ni/ tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i don no: 'dod khyams dmar po khro yug tu byung ba ni: 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod pa 'bul ba'i don no: rin po che'i pha gu ser po brtsegs pa ni: chos thams cad ma skyes pa'i mnyam pa nyid du rdzogs pa'i don no: mun pa'i gribs so la mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed kyi spras pa ni: chos kyi ma dri mas ma gos shing rtsal ma 'gas pa'i don no: su shu'i khor yug tu dri med shol gyi mcho rten brgya dang rtsa kyi bskor ba ni: chos sku dare ma med pa las rang byung thugs rje'i zor du 'phro ba'o: phyogs bzhi rta babs bzhi sgo khang rgyan dgu dang bcas par 'dugs pa ni: sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i don no: in+d+ra ni la'i sa gzhi la du khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba ni: ma hā yo ga'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i don no: rin chen pad+ma'i 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba ni: bag chags kyi dre mas ma gos pa'i don no:

khor yug tu rdo rje'i 'phreng ba ni: gang gi sa kyang gnod pa med pa dang gzhig cing gzhom pa dang gnod du med pa'i don no: ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga dang ldan par 'bar ba ni: nyon mongs pa'i n+ma rtog dang bag chags bsregs cing bgegs 'byung po thams cad bsregangs pa'i don no: gru bzhir gter gyi bum pas mtshan pa ni: dgos 'dod ri ba yid bzhin du bskong ba'i don no: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi longs spyod du: dkyil 'khor gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phur sgrom: gzhal yangs khang snod bcud ldan pa'i bum pa: dbang bskur dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter chen: lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i sman raka: thabs shes zung du 'jagu pa'i dhor dril: byin rlobs yongs rdzogs bskur ba'i dbang tsag: longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal mtshan: dar 'phan: cod pan: yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i mda' dar me long : bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i gri bzhi: mtshams gcod khor yug bsrung ba'i mda' brgyad: mtshon cha sna lnga'i bsrung ba'i tshon skud sna lnga'i dra thag: rtag med rol pa'i rgyan du dur khrod: bdud bzhi'i g.yul (146) las rgyal ba'i stag shaṃ dga' bskor: dri med ye shes mtshon phyir mar me bcu gnyis: lhun grub yongs spyod rdzogs phyir dar khang rim gsum: gdor bkod pa'i bye brag ma tshang ba med pa 'di dag kun tu bzang po'i mtshod pa'i sprin phung gi rnams la bkod pa yin cing : mdor na chos kyi sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur lhun gyis grub pa ltar: sprul pas 'gra ba'i don gang la gang 'dul du mdzad pa yin cing : mdor na skye med chos sku'i klong nas/ 'gags med thugs rje'i rtsal zer du/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa'i phyir: badha dang don dang rtags gsum du mtshon pa yin pas: skal ldan skyes bu rnamasakyi de ltar shes par bya'o/

zher riṃ par ngo sprod par bya/ de yan chad ni nang du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ de dag ni lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams legs par song grub pas/ de ltar zhugs pa'i phan yon kyang*/ mnyam sbyor las rdo rje sems dpal la sogs pa'i: 'kho lo mngon du mthong ba yi/ bson nams rtags pa gang yin pa: phyis byas pa'ang de bzhin no/ zhes 'og min du thar lam pa zhugs pa dang skal ba mnyam pa yin no/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ spyir dbang gi ngo bo ni/ thob bya'i na kha khyad par can rgyud la 'jog pa'i las kyi bdag nyid can yin la/ ngos tshig ni a sti ṣiñca'i sgra las drangs na mngon par gathoral ba zhes bya ste/ brtan gnyis las gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya 'dis/ des na dbang zhes brjod par bya/ zhes pa ltar dngos su sgo gsum gyi dri ma gathor ba dang*/ blugs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol lam sgoms rung dang*/ 'bras bu yesha ses kyi nus pa khyed par can rgyud la 'jog par 'jug ste/ e ru ka 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rgyud dag nus pa thob phyir dbang*/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang rnam pa bzhi la brten dgos te/ bzhi po'ang srog chags rnams la lus stobs dang mtshongs pa'i theg pa che chung yod pa ltar gong nas gong du khyed zhugs pa'i tshul sangs rgyas mdud pa las/ sems can bsams pa'i dbang gis na/ rta dang glang po la he dang*/ rnga mong ri bor phal rnams bzhin/ phan dang nus pa lta dang zhugs/ phyi yi dbang dang nang gi dbang*/ gsang ba'i dbang dang thabs kyi dbang*/ ji ltar gsungs kyang rnam pa bzhi/ bub pa'i dang dang gsang ba'i dbang*/ shes rab yesha se dbang tshog las*/ de bzhin bzhi'i dbang du gsungs/ zhes dbang bzhir 'gyur ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan kyang dbang bsku rgyal pos rgyud las/ dbang chos rang la med gyur na/ bskur ba'i thob pa ga la 'gyur/ bra sran 'bras bu dang bskur yang*/ de la 'bras kyi dngos snang med/

zhes pa ltar thob bya rang gnas kyi yai shes gnyug ma'i rdo rje bzhi ni sbyang gzhi/ de nyid sgrib byed glo bur gyi dri ma phra rags nams ni byang bya/ dpon slob gnyis kas sems mi g.yengs pa'i sgo nas rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs pa'i cho ga khyad par can la brten nas slob bu'i (147) rgyud kyi dri ma sbyangs rung dang*/ lam gyi yon tan bskyed rung du smin par byed pa'i thabs ni sbyong des sbyang bya'i dri ma sbyangs pas rang gnas kyi ye shes gsos thebs sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur rung gi nus pa thob pa ni sbyang 'bras te dbang thob pa zhes bya'o/ de ltar byang gzhi dang byang 'bras kyi rdo rje bzhi la ltos nas/ sbyong byed la'ang dbang bzhin gnas pa yin no/ de la thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brjod nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ de lta maṇ+ḍal phul nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gatsho bo tha mi dad pa la mi phyed dwang ba'i gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūṃ thabs kyi spyad pa'i 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa: bdang dang dngos grubab bdag la rtsol: ces lan gsum dang*/ gnang ba byin pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btabs pa'i lan 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ kyai legs 'ongs rigs kyi bu rnams gus pas nyon: gsang ṅgas dbang la ma brten 'grub par ga la 'gyur: dpair na mnyan pa lag skye med pa bzhin: gru yi pha rol bgrod pa ga la nus: go 'phang rim pa dbang gi bgrod pa'i phyir: rim pa bzhin du bdag gis bskur bar bya'o: zhes brjod/ spro na don skrol nas kyang bshad/ de nas dbang rnams rim par bskur ba la/ thog mar rgyal tshab rigs lnga'i dbang ni de ltar khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs la rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnams pas 'khod pa'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i dbu rgyan gyi lha thod pa dung khang gi nang du phrag 'thung bde gshegs rigs lnga bzhugs pa la lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyi ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rgyud ltar bdang bskur ste ste slob ma'i mgo la rigs lnga bkon la/ hūṃ srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur phyir: byang chub sems ni mngon du bsten: khams gsum ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir: dbu la rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ro:oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dub rgyan gyis ni dbang bskur bas: 'og min chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'ching chen po dang : bson nams dang ye shes kyi skalab mnyam par gyur te: chos kyi rgyal srid ye shes lnga la dbang bskur zhing sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cing : ces brjod*/ rnam bum slob ma'i phyi bor bzung la/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing khams/ nang rang byung lhun grub kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bcud dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sbyor mtshams nas byin rlabs byang sems khu phang babs pa ltar sha ra ra byung nas khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar la thim pa'i lus bdud rtsis gang zhing*/ thod pa dung khang gi nang du rdo rje phur

(148) pa'i lhag tshogs dag pa 'od gsal gyi sku gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khyo bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: gsum gi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: thugs kyi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: bh+ruṃ rat+na badz+ra kā ya a bhi shiñca ā+o: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃḥ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrī: zhes slob ma'i gnas bzhir bzhag: bum chu spyi bor tig cing lce la blud: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la bum pa'i dbang bar bas: rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs ma lus pa'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob ste/ 'bras bu sku bzha'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig: ce dang*/ nyan 'chad kyi dbang ni bhan+dha mgrin par gtug la/ hūṃ: chos nyid bdud rtsi chos kyi char: skal ldan 'di la dbab pa'i phyir: mthun par gsung sgra chos kyi dbang : bskur bas khyod kyi thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: a li ñjā na pañca a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: bdud rtsi ngag tu sbyin a hoḥ sgam ldan khyod la nyan cing 'chad pa'i dbang bskur dbang bskur bas/ theg mchog chos kyi dkyil 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas khyod rang rnams lus kyi dngos sor 'dzin pa dag pa'i phyir lha'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas chakhyod rang rnams lus kyi dngos sor 'dzin pa dag pa'i phyir lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i dbang byin pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i thugs ka nas chu las chu sbur dhol bzhin byung ba'i lha tshogs pa rnams la thim pa'i mos pa brten po mdzod/ phur sgrol yos rdzogs sam: yang na gatsho bo'i phur pa dpral bar bzhag/ sbram phur lag tu gtad de/ hūṃ grub gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:

dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis: sku gung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las rdzogs: ma lus lha dang rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yang hūṃ phaṭaḥ a bhi ṣañca mal: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi lhag dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur bas/ sku gsung thug yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces bstim de nas phyogs bcu khro bo'i phur pa rnams lbams te btad la/ hūṃ bskal pa med ltar 'bar bya'i klong dkyil nas: 'bar ba'i khro bo chen po yab yum bcu: sprul pa'i mgo brnyen khra thabs tshogs bcas kyis: sku gsung thugs yon rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ma hā kro ta sarba a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod ma khrobacu za gsod dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ khro g+r+yal ma lus stobs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ las phur nyer gcig gtad la/ hūṃ dmar nag e yi dkyil 'khyor nas/ sras dang (149) sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: khams gsum sgrol nus bang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya kā la ru pa ka ya a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur pas: sku gsang thubs yon tan 'phran las yangs rdzags pa' dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phril las yongs rdzogs kyi khams gsusam chos kyi dbyings su sgrol nus pa'i dbang chog dam pa thob par gyur cig: brjod de nas sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang ni: sku rten spyi bo: sgrub yig mgrin pa rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka lag tu gtad la/ hūṃ dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: rdo rje gzhon nu gtso dang 'khor*/

yang yum sras bcas thams cad kyis: lhag dbang ma lus rdzogs gyur cig: hūṃ gsung ni 'gal med kī la ya: bsnyen sgrub rnams gsum mthar phyin nas: rtags mtshan ma bstan pa dang : 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par shog: hūṃ thugs ni rang byung srog dang bcas: rang byung ye shes snying po'ing ngang: smra brjod bral bas rdzogs pa che: skye 'gags 'gyur med bdang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ka ya a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi phu khyod la: rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang mchog dam pa bskur bas sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces bskur/ bar 'dir phyag bzhes bzhin khro bcu za gsod kyi dbang mtshon cha'i 'gor lo bskur ba la: bdang tsaka rgyab yig byas te rim par thobs la/ hūṃ steng gi phyogs nas 'bebs nas 'bebs mdzad ma: khro bo chen po hūṃ mdzad dang : yum chen shes rab sgra 'byin ma: stong phyogs lha yi gdon tshogs bzlog: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūṃ shar gyi phyogs nas gzir mdzad pa'i: khro cen rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ yum chen dbyings kyi snyem ma ste: shar phyogs dri za'i gdon ladog bzlog cig: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bhi dza ya a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūṃ shar lho mtshams nas 'joms mdzad pa: khro chen dbyug pa sngon po dang : yum chen rdo rje sder mo ni : shar lho mo lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog: drag rtsal ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñca īḥ hūṃḥ lho yi phyogs nas gsod mdzad pa'i: khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po dang :

yum chen dur khrod bdag mo ni: lha phyogs gshin rje'i gdon tshogs (150) bzlog: rang 'jigs rngags pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dregs pa tsal gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: hūṃ lho nub mtshams nas sgrol mdzad pa: khro chen mi g.yo mgon po dang : rab 'jigs rdo rje gtun khung ma : lho nub srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog: dpal 'jigs drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas: dregs pa tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūṃ nub kyi phyogs nas 'ching mdzad pa'i: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal/ yum chen rdo rje gtum mo ni: nub phyogs klu yi gdon tshogs bzlog: dbang chen rngams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rab 'jigs drag rtsal dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya gh-i wa a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ hūṃ nub byang mtshams nas 'gugs mdzad pa'i: khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang : yum chen dbang gi snyom ma ni: nub byang rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog: snang srid 'gugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dngos grub yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: hūṃ byang shar mtshas nas stob mdzad pa'i: khro chen khams gsum rnam rgyal dang : yum chen rdo rje gsod byed ma: byang shar bgegs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog: gdug pa tshar gcod dkyil 'khor nas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dzā ya hūṃ a hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūṃ 'og gi phyogs nas spor mdzad pa'i: khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che: yum chen rdo rje bskyod byed ma: 'og phyogs klu gdon bzlog byed pa: rang 'jigs khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mthu dang nus pa'i dbang thob sho: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca o: zhes khro bo bcu dang*/ de nas za byed khra thabs kyi dbang bskur ni slob ma'i gnas gsum dang lag tu gtad la/

hūṃ za byed khro bo phag gis mog: rdo rjes thog chen 'bebs mdzad cing : rtogs tshogs rang grol chos dbyings sbyor: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phril las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī lī kī 'a ya ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye a bhiñca oṃ: hūṃ zha byed khro bo stag gis mgo: shar gyi phyogs nas gzir mdzad cing : 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzad pa ste: mngon spyod dag po'i 'phril las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sras mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūṃ za byed khro bo g.yag gis mgo: shar lho mtshams nas 'joms mdzad cing : (151) thogs med rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phril las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: hūṃ za byed khro bo sha ba'i mgo: lha yi phyogs nas gsod mdzad ma: 'byor drag rgyas pa'i las mdzad cing : mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis: dgra bgeg tshar gcod dbang thob shog: auṃ badz+ra kī li kī ya ya ma ra sa si sra mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca ī: hūṃ za byed khro bo gzigs gi mgo: lha nub mtshams nas sgrol mdzad cing : skad cig rdzus 'phrul stobs dang ldan: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sras mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūṃ ba byed khro bo yi la'i mgo: nus kyi phyags nas 'chings mdzad pa'i: rdzu 'phrul stong gsum khyab par rgyug: dgra bgegs tshar gcod sgrarol ba'i las la brtson: khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phril las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sras mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca= hūṃ la byed khro bo spyang ka'i mgo:

naphyang mtshams nas 'gugs mdzad cing : rdzu 'phrul stong gsum khyab par rgyug: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phris kyis: dgra bgeg tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye a bhi= hūṃ za byed khro bo sang ge'i mgo: byang gi phyogs nas gnon mdzad cing : dgra bgegs stobs kyis sgrol cing gnon: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūṃ za byed khro bo dom gyi mgo: byang shar mtshams nas stob mdzad cing : dgra dang bgegs kyi gnyen por tshe: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phril las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ra sa ni sra mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: hūṃ za byed khro bo dregs kyi mgo: 'og gi phyogs nas spor mdzad cing : dusag gsum khams gsum sgrol nas ni: mi sdog chos kyi dbyings su spror: mngon spyod rag po'i 'phril las kyis: de nas gsod byed khro mo bcu'i dbang ni gong ltar gnas gsum dang lag tu gtad la: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad smig bu'i mgo: tshangs pa'i lha gdon bzlog mdzad cing : mngon spyod las mdzad chen mo yis: dbang bskur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: (152) khro mo mi bzad bya rgod mgo: dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : gsod byed las mdzad chen mo yis: dbang skur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a ṣiñca maṃ hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad bya rog mgo: me lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : srog gcod las mkhan chen mo yis: dbang bskur 'phril las grub par mdzod: ma rag mo yag mo a yag mo a bhi ṣiñca lam:

hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad 'ug pa'i mgo: gshin rje'i gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : khams gsum sgrol byed chen mo yis: dbang bskur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ khro mo mi bzad khā ti'i mgo: srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : dregs pa 'dzoms mdzad chen mo yis: bdang bskur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad pu shud mgo: klu yi dgon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : khams gsum grol mdzad chen mo yis: dbang bskur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñca laṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad khro yi mgo rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlogs mdzad cing : khams gsum 'khrugs byed chen mo yis: dbang bskur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad pha wam mgo: gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : srid gsum khram 'debs chen mo yis: dbang bskur 'phril las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a ṣiñca maṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad sred mong mgo: bgegs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : dgra bo'i srog la rngams mdzad pa'i: dbang bskur 'phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: hūṃ gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad byi ba'i mgo: sa bdag gdon tshogs bzlog mdzad cing : dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad gcod ma'i: dbang bskur 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma rag mo yag mo a bhiñca maṃ: zhes dbung bskur5 za gsod khra thabs kyi dbang ni sprul pa las byed kyi dbang yin pas 'phris drag po 'asgrub pa ya gces pa yin ma'i:

de nas 'phril las bzhi'i dbang ni grub chad bzhi'i phur pa gtad la: hūṃ dpal chen sku yi phyag 'tshal ni: sangs rgyas 'phril las yongs rdzogs dpal: zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las: 'phril las rnam bzhi'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī (153) li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: ru tra sra we sha ya phaṭa: sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyed la: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i phur pa 'di gtad pas: 'phris rnam bzhi gang brtsams 'grub par gyur cig: ces dang : bsgom zhing bsgrubs pa'i dbang ni gtso bo dang sras bzhi'i phur pa lag tu gtad la: hūṃ skya med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus kun 'dus pa'i: srid gsum phur pa'i 'phril las 'grubs pa'i phyir: rdo rje gzhon nu gatsho dang 'khor du bcas: rtag tu khro rgyal lha lha yi ting 'dzin bsgoms: drag sngags spru gri me yi 'khor lo bzles: thugs mchog 'gyer med snying po hūṃ du gsal: bsgom bsgrub 'phrin las nus pa'i dpang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya oṃ āḥhūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: sgrub phur chen mo 'di lug tu gtad pas: srid gsum phur chen mo 'di lag tu gtad pas: srid gsum phur pa'i sku gyur te: dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgu gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang par gyur cig: zhes bskur de nas yangos su rdzogs pa'i phyag 'tshal gyi dbang ni: g.yas su rdo rje phur pa g.yon du me dpung kha ṭ+waṃ gtad la hūṃ thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du: byams dang snying rje gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i: dbang dang dngos grub rtsol ba'i phyir: phyag 'tshan 'di yis dbang bskur bas: thams cad yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra la ram tri shwa sarba a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la:

phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur bas: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ltar: 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'phrin las thams cad la dbang thob par gyur cig: ces dang brtags kyi dbang ni/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhra tshos rak+ta'i thig le/ lkog mar zhag gis zor ris dang*/ lag g.yas su dril bu dang g.yon du thod khyag rnams gtad la/ rab 'jigs badz+ra kī la ya: 'gyur med thal chen tshom bu dang : dpa' chas rak+ta'i thig le'i mtshan: rngams byed zhag gi zo ris 'jigs: mi 'gyur khro bo'i rtags gsum gdab: dril bu thod khrag yulam gyi rten: gar dgu'i khro bo'i tshul sten pa: mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: badz+ra rak+sha karma tri sha ho: a bh-i ṣiñca ho: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi mu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo'i rtags rnams gda' : mi 'gyur ba yi gar dbang 'di bskur bas: khro bo rims 'dus gar dgu'i dbang chog thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ de nas bsnyen bsgrub 'dzab kyi dbang ni: rdo rje gzhon nu ye shes sems dpa'i gzugs dang : gser gyi bris pa'i sngags byang 'phring ba bcas thogs la/ de ltar ngag tha las gyi zhin rtog sbyong phyir gsung phyag rgya'i dbang sbyin pa ni: dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags

(154) 'phring thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs: snying ga'i dwangs ma'i srog yig la thim pas sgra thams cad grags stong gzhom med kyi rol pas don gnyis sgrubs pa'i nus pa khyed par can rgyud la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūṃ dbyings nas 'bar ba'i skur ston pa'i: 'phrin las yongs rdzogs grub pa'i dpal: bsgrub pa'i ye shes mtshon gang po: gsang ba sngags kyi bskyed pa'i phyir: rgyun chad med par bzla dgos pas: 'dzab dbyangs sngags kyi dbyangs sngags kyi dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nan big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūṃ āḥzhes mgrin par bzhag cing lag tu gtad: slob dpon 'phring ba sbril la 'di'i rjes blo mdzod byas la/ rtsa sngags lan gsum byar gzhug hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la man ngag snying po'i lung byin dbang bskur bka' gtad pas: de ring phyin chad dpal chen po gtso dang 'khor du bcas pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas phur+pab phyin brlabs cing dpal chen yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ba ni: dpal gyi chas brgyad las/ thod 'phring sbrul chun sogs bkon la/ hūṃ chad pa 'phreng tshar gsum sku gsum ldan: ye shes rol pa'i rgyan du che: sbrul chun dug gsum gnas gsum dag: rtogs med rol pa dpal gyi chas: rgyan 'phring 'di yi dbang bskur bas: rngams brjid khro ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ keṃ bh+ruṃ la raṃ sa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: g.yang gzhi glang ko stag sham sogs bkon la: hūṃ 'khar ba rnam dag g.yang gzhi 'jigs: thog med glang chen ko rlon dpa': nga rgyal rnam dag stag shim brjod: khro rgyal skuyi rgyan rdzogs dbang : skal ldan khyod la yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badz+ra ti ra na ti hal dhi ma gha la: badz+ra tri sha hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: gdab phur sogs 'dril zhing lag tu gtad la: hūṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa: ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang gyi chas brgyad bkon cing gdab phur gtad pas srid gsum yongs sgrol stobs bcu yongs rdzogs rdzas kyi phur pa la ye shes khro bo'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nus pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig:

yum gyi gzigs sham rgyan drug dril bu gtad la: hūṃ pha rol byin drug thabs shes rus pa'i rgyan: mnyam nyid ye shes yug gyi rgyan du che: yang dag ye shes dri med gzigs gis brgyan: gar gyi nyams dgu dri med dpal ba'i chas: shes rab rangaca bzhin dril bu'i sgro sgrogs pas: zung 'jug bde chen chos kyi rang sgrar shog: oṃ badz+ra ya gi bhi sha ma hā bhe ga ra ya a bhi ṣ-iñca maṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shes rab (155) yum gyi rgyan dbang 'di bskur bas: pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs te: sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: de ltar phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma sbyangs: lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'in no: zhes badha' sprad/ de nas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang ni: khyed rang rnams slob dpon la dad pas rigs ma mtshan nyid ldan pa phur bar mos la: slob dpon dpal rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa nor bu oṃ yig byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rtse mor phaṭ+wa dang bcas pa rigs ma yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su gsal ba'i mga' gsang a las pad+ma āḥ mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā gā ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ zhes yub yum snyom par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ thug kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu: rgyu ti nas brgyud lum gyi mkhar babar pa'i nyi zla gnyis 'dres de nyid thob pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūṃ nga ni dpal chen 'bar ba'i sku: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sbyor: 'gor ba dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir:

byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yaḥ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha sid+dha hoḥ zhes kar ru bu ral tsan dan byang sems sbyang ba'i bdud rtsi myang du bcug: zhes bdud rtsi myong bi mgron pa nas thig le 'phel bas rtsi khams gang : dug gsum gyi rtog pa dgags zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ye shes nyams su myong ba ni gsang dbang gi ye shes te nyams su myong ba ni gsang dbang ge ye shes te da'i ngang la dar cig bzhag gong ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas: rtsa khams yongs su rdzogs pa bde stong dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par shog: de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thog gang gi dri ma sbyangs: lasam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras ba gsung rdo rje logs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas payin no: ces don bshad*/ de nas shes rab ye shis kyi dbang ni/ phyag g+r+ya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa khrus byas rgyan dang ldan pa zhug gsum bla ma'i bzung mar 'bul: dkyil 'khor tshogs gtor tshang ba'i byang du phyag rgyala'i srin lag nas buzang ste bu la gtad ces gsungs pas/ bla mas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can du yongs bzhi zhig sprul te khyed rang rnams la gtad pa'i mos ma mdzod/ rig ma'i tsakli thogs la/ kyai bu khyod thog dman blo ma chung : shes rab thabs dang ma 'brel ba'i: gsang sngags grub pa ga la thob: shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ bsnyas shing spangs (156) na ltung bar 'gyar : lam mchog dga' bzhis ma bgrod pa'i: 'bras bu sku bzhi thob mi 'gyur: de phyir phyag rgya rtag tu bsten: bde stong ngo bo nyams su skyongs: rang gi dwangs ma nyams mi rung : nyams na ltung ba'i gnas su 'gyur: gnyen pos zung la bde stong skyongs: zhes phyag rgya gtad de nas khyod rang rnams dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/

gtad pa'i rig ma yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar gsal ba ni lha'i du shes: yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭ+wa: dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mags a las pad+ma as mtshan par bams pa ni sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ de ltar 'dus shes gsum gsal btab nas nyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes tshogs drug gi rten khams kyi dwangs ma thams cad zhu nas spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus te spyi bo nas mgrin par babs dga' ba: snying gar babs pa mchog dga': lte bar babs pa khyed par gyi dga' ba/ gsang bar babs sa lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ste yabs 'bab kyi dga' bzhi nyams myong : khams gsang gi rtser 'dzag med du bzung ba de nyid slar yang hū zhes rlung gi sbyor bas gyen du drangs pa'i 'khor lo bzhir mas brten gyi dga' bzhi rim par nyams su myong bas bde stong dbyer med rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi thams cad la khyab cing brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces gdams la oṃ pad+ma ta thā ga ta ma hā a ru rā ka badz+ra swā bha kha āt+mā ko3 haṃ: zhes dang*/ 'khyud rgyal byar gzhug go/ de ltar phyag rgya'i bhi ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: yid kyi dari ma dag lam thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ de nas dbang bzhi pa rtsal dbang ngo sprad pa ni/ khyed nas dbang bzhi pa rtsal dbang ngo sprad pa ni/ khyed rang rnams lungs gnad rnams par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun drang po bsrang : ngag gnad rlung rtsol med du bzhag /yid kyi gnas sngar rjes mi dpyad /phyis sngun mi bsu /da lta 'i shes pa'ang rtsis gda' rtsis gdab 'dzind pa med par/ thugs ka'i yesha ses sems dpa' la rims pa gtad la rtsil bral gsal bzhag med pa sngar dbang gsum pa'i dus kyis zhu bde nyams su myong ba'i bde gsal gyi nyams myong de ba'i rang zhal la gtser gyi ldob:

de ltar bltas pas sems kyi gshis gang du 'ang ma grub pa/ mdangs bde mchen po'i rol pasar ma 'gas pa/ rtsal cir yang 'atsar ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed/ blta bya bltar byed sogs yul yul can gyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rigs pa gsal dag rjen sang nge ba de ka bcir phog tu nges bzung ba/ de ka'i ngang la gsal gzhag med par bskyang bar mdzod cig: ces badha' sprad/ kye ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu: de ltar dbang rim mang bskur yang : thabs dang shes rab (157) 'brel ba'i lam: yang dag don gyi ngo bo ni: bskur dang bskur byed kun las 'das: thams cad mnyam rdzogs chen po'i ngang : 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje ste: bsgros rgud med pa gzhon nu'i tshul: phur ni chos kyi dbyings nyid las: pa ni rig pa'i ye shes te: yang dag don gyi phur pa yin: thugs kar rang sems srog dang bcas: ngo bo stong zhing rang bzhin gsal: thugs rjes rtsal snang ma 'gags pa: don ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin: bu khyod ngang 'dir ma bcos bzhog: smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i don: yid yi yang la gnas par gyis: ces brjod/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' dang dbyer med du bsros la mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnas lugs kying ngo bo ji ltar bzang yang rigs sems shan ma phyed pa'i lta sgom smyong zhen dang shes byi'i sgrib pa sbags pa'i stong gsal gyi 'dzin pa can zhig 'char nye bas/ de'i gnyen por slob ma rnams gal rigs stong pa lhan ne ba'i ngang de khar phaṭ+wa drag po zhig brjod pas sngar gyi gnas lugs thom me bune yer re ba'i bde nyams brjod mi shes pa de rang sar zhig /dran 'dzin gyi gnyen po khung gtor/ byung tshog gyi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i chos rgya yan spros bral gyi rigs pa bsam du med pa'i gu yangs chen po zhig mi 'char ba'i dbang med pa de nyid sems las 'das pa'i rigs pa yin pas ngo sprod par bya zhing lan gsum bskyar rjes skyong ba yang bla mas shes par bya'o/

de nas 'phril las rtsal 'byongs thog pa med pa'i gar dbang bskur ba ni: rnam 'byor pa rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing gar stabs su 'khrab ste/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa phaṭ+waḥ ces gang shar gyi nyams snang mi bskyil bar rig pa ngar dang bcas te/ bla mas/ bzung ba med do: hūṃ hūṃ: 'dzin pa med do: hūṃ hūṃ: gtad kha med do: hūṃ hūṃ: brjod du med do: hūṃ hūṃ: stong pa yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: gtad med yin no: hūṃ hūṃ rang byang yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: lhun grub yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: rang gsal yin nos: hūṃ hūṃ: rang gsal yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: 'dzin med yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: rjen pa yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: zangs thal yin no: hūṃ hūṃ: yang yang stong nyid rang 'grol la: 'gor 'das dmigs med spros dang bral: rigs pa ye shes rtsal du dbang bzhi sa yin: rtag tu nyams kyi sna mi bskyil: gtad med ngang du skyong cig aṃ: zhes nyams 'khrab rjes thugs srog ye shes sems dpa' la gtad pa gong bzhin bya'o: de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi sa thob/ 'gyu bde'i dri ma sbyangs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ ces rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas gtor ma'i dbang ni/ dbang gtor chen mo bris sku dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs (158) su bzhugs pa la mos gus dung pa byas bas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bon sku dgyes pa'i gar mdzad: gsung sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar ldir/ thugs zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog tu 'bar ba'i gzig byin gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sems gnas skabs dang mthar gug gi 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad char ltar phob cing rgyud la zhugs pas bde ba chen po bzotha med dung 'bar bas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis sgrub pa'i mthu chen thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

spos bsrog rol mo dang bcas te gter ma mgor bzhag la/ hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams: srid pa'i rdo rje grub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha: ye shes khro grub par mdzod: gtor chen lha dang gtis su med/ dam rdzas chen po'i dngos grub ster: skal ldan khyed la dbang bskur bas: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā bha ling ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes bskur/ mthar gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas khyaud rang rnams la thim par rdo rje gzhon nu rtsal gyi sku dongs su gyur pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor zan cung re dngos gru tu byin/ a skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gtor chen ye shes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i dbang 'di bskur bas: bde gshegs kun gyi dbang mchog thob: thugs dam bskang ste bar chad zhi ba'i dbang mchog mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces brjod/ de nas dam can bran du 'khol nus pa'i dbang ni/ yod na dam can gyis phur pa'i med na las phur rnams gtod de/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu che/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs: sngon chade ci ltar dam bcas pa/ mngon sbyod 'phrin las myur du mdzod*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ he he he he bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo mo ha ga ta ya: dha ti ma ma shrī kraṃ ka ra karma ka ra ya bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: skal na rigs kyi bu khyod la bka' sdod dam can bran du 'khol ba'i dbang 'di bskur bas 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du 'grub cing nub rgyal mtshan gyi dbang dam thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ dam can rnams bran du bkol ba dang*/ kho nya gnad la dbab pa'i dbang rgyas pa ni/ bsdus pa gong du bstan par ltar dang*/ 'di ni shin tu gnyen pas snod dang sbyar te bskurabar bya ste/ phur bsrung bcu gnyis kyiphur pa sbam nas dar gyi bcings la/

bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams bkur ste mdun gyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes (159) bkug zhun chen 'o bar rak+ta'i mtsho bshams/ yungs kar la gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba bzlas te phur pa la gtor gzi byin bskyed cing mnga' gsol/ gu gul dang sha chen gyi bdug slob dpon rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgya bskyed cing ma rnams ngas bdag tu gsal ba'i/ hūṃ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ dam tshig de las ma 'da' bar/ bdag ni gzhung bzhin sgrub byin na/ dam can ma g.yel dam la 'dus/ mngon spyod 'pharil las grub par mdzod/ ces sbam phur rnams la thug gyis bras/ slob dpon gyi bsgril zhi slob bu'i snying kha lte ba lag mthil du gtad la/ hūṃ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ sho na mchod bzhi'i dus la babs: bdag nyid mched bzhi'i dus la babs: sa bdag mchod bzhi'i dus la babs: las kyi skal ba'i dgra bo rnams: lnga phung rul du brlag pa'i phyir: bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob bu la: bran dang bka' nyan pho nyar gtad: 'di la mgon zhing bsrung ba dang*/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang*/ bltan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /ka taṃ ka ye/ dza ye bi dza bi ye a tshi te a pa ra tsi te: ma ra sa na/ sra mar ta na ye dam la ma 'a' pa ma ya/ a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: zhes gtad la slob ma rnams phur pa g.yas g.yon 'byar zhing sked la lan gsum bskor te 'debs tshul byar gzhug/ des ni dpa' ba las sprod pa dang*/ khyi bzang bdag po la sprad pa ltar 'phrin las thob pa med pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ de nas dge bsnyen nyer gaṃ ging bzha'i phur ba sbaṃ la gtad/ hūṃ rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma ru: khas blangs dam bcas bka' nyan tshogs/

dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ bse lcags dung dang ka ti 'jigs: kho nyam las byed srog la rngams: rang gri zangs yag klad la bskor: phur pa dgra bo'i snying la 'debs: bran dang bka' nyon pho nyar gtad: mngags pa'i las la mthu ma chung : dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig: shrī traṃ ka ra ya ma ra sa na sra mar ta ye sa ma ye a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes phur sa 'dril zhing phyogs bcur gzir/ rkang mgo la bskor la zhabs su gtod bar mdzod: tshad med phyag rgya bzhi dbang bskur bas: 'phril las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang : mngon spyod drag po'i dbang chen thob par shog: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: ma ra sa na sra mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: zhes phyogs bzhir 'dril zhing dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir 'debs tshul bya'o/ des ni rgyal pos dpa' bo la dar btags te mnga' gsol ba dang 'dra'o/ de has dbang

(160) phyug nyer brgyad kyi dbang ni/ phyi'i mu khyud chen po nas gtsang phur nyi shu rtsa brgyad phyung ste dar mthing nag gi sbaṃ nas 'bru gzhong du bzhag/ gu gul dang sha chen bsreg/ zhing spags 'phyar/ rkang gi gzang bu'i rak+ta phyogs bcur gtor/ bshug pa 'bod/ yungs thun gtor zhing mnga' gsol/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad bkug nas mdun gyi rten la thim par gyur dzaḥbaṃ ho: zhes bsdim/ bskul byang ltar bskul ba ni gser skyems gtor zhing*/ chad pa bka'i nyan las byed ma: ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: mtshan tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang : g.yo sgyu med cing gas ldan pas: sems kyi blangs te spyi bo yis: btsug tu blangs te bskul bar bya: de skad khyod kyis zhale bzhes pas: dpal gyi bka' bzhin bdag sgrub kyi: 'dir byor bcol ba'i 'phril las mdzod: bh+yo phrin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang : g.yag gi mgo cad dus la babs: tshangs pa dkar ser pad+ma bsnams: sbrul gyi mgo can du la= lha chen dkar ljang tri shul thogs: gzig gi mgo can dus la= rtog 'dod sngon mo 'gar lo 'chang : sro mong mgo can dus la= gzhon nu dmar mo mdud lung 'dzin: kha waṃ mgo can dus la= rgyal byin dkar mo idran gdeng : khyung gi mgo can dus la babs: rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: khu byung mgo can dus la= rdo rje ser mo khrag chen 'thung la= bdud rtsi dmar mo pad bum 'dzin/ chu srin mgo can dus la babs5 bla ba dkar mo pun+dha 'dzin: sdig pa'i mog can du dus la babs: be con mthing nag dbyugang tho 'phyir: khra yi mgo cad dus la= srin mo dmar mo dung khra 'thung : wa yi mgo can dus la= za ba ljang nag bha su 'dren: sdag gi mgo can dus la babs5 ra gdong sngon mo zhags pa thogs: rang yi mgo can dus la= dga' ba dmar mo ka dar 'chang :

bya rgod mgo can dus la= stobs chen dkar mo ngo shol mdzin: rta'i mgo can dus la babs: spyo spyod sngon mo spru gris gcod: byi li'i mgo can dus la babs: 'dod pa dmar mo mda' bzhug 'gegs: khyi'i mgo can dus la= nor bsrung dmar mo bum pa 'dzin: pu shud mgo nad dus la= rlung lhu sngon mo dan 'phyar: sha ba'i mog can dus la= bum sngo nag lcags mgo can dus la= bur sna sngo nag lcags sgrogs sdoms: spri'u mgo can dus= gsod byed ljang gan ral gyi 'phyar: spyang mo'i mgo can dus la= mi mo dmar mo sregs shing 'dzin: skyin bu'i mgo can dus la= phag gdong nag mo mche zhags bsnams: phag gi mgo can dus= dga' byed dmar mo zhing zhung chung za= khwa ta'i mgo can dus= sna chen dpar mo'i thod khrag 'thung : glang gi mgo can dus la= chu lha sngon mo sbrul (161) zhags 'dzin: bya rog mgo can dus= bsus 'dzin ser nag dril bu 'dzin: skye ka'i mgo can dus= khyed rnams padal gyi pho nye ste: dbang phyug ma dang sring mo'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' la gnas: legs nyes kun gyis stangs 'dzin cing : dam tshig gnyas kyi rjes gcod ma: 'dir byen rgyal gyi mchod gter bzhes: mngags shing bskul ba nga yis byed/ bcol ba'i 'phril las khyod kyis mdzod/ badz+ra ma nu rak+ṣa sabh+yo: sram ni bh+yo: ri'u tri ma bh+yi: bha na bhe bh+yo: ku la mi bh+yo: yin da la bh+yo: kī ma la bh+yoḥ badz+ra bh+yi ka la bh+yoḥ a mṛ ta bh+yiḥ se'u me bh+yoḥ da dha ha bh+yoḥ bhag sha si bh+yoḥ tsa ka la ma bh+yoḥ badz+ra ra tri ma bh+yoḥ ru tri re ma ti ma bh+yoḥ e ka tsa ra ma bh+yoḥ ma nu ha ra ma bh+yoḥ sid+dhi ka bh+yoḥ bha ya bh+yoḥ badz+ra ma ra na bh+yoḥ ag na ye bh+yoḥ tsa mun hi bh+yoḥ yu dha na bh+yoḥ lam po dha ra bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed ma ra ya thun bh+yoḥ zhes bskul zhing : slob dpon ting 'dzin ngar dang ldan pa'i slob bu gsang bdag tu gsal ba la pho nya las byed bran gyi tshul du gtad pa ni/

bh+yo dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed tshogs: ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: mtshan tsam 'dzin par byid pa yang : g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas: sems kyi blangs te spyi bo yis: gtsug tu blangs te bskur bar bya: de skad khyod kyi bro bor te: dam bca' bsnyel du mi rung bas: skal ldan 'di yi la grib bzhin: rtag tu mi 'bral bsrung ma mdzod: gnag pa'i dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: gang la dmigs pa sho ra ro: mthu rtsal yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: dzaḥ dzaḥdzaḥ bh+yauḥbh+yauḥbh+yauḥ bh+yauḥbh+yauḥbh+yauḥ bh+yauḥbh+yauḥbh+yauḥ bh+yauḥbh+yauḥbh+yauḥ bh+yauḥbh+yauḥ nyer brgyad bzlas sbaṃ phur snying ga lte ba gsang gnas bla g.yas g.yon dang zhabs su gtad cing: dzaḥbh+yoḥsngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa'i: mngon spyod 'phrin las grub pas mdzod: srung mar gtad de 'bangs su gtad: las mkhan pho nya'i tshul du gtad: bka' dang dam la gnas par mdzod: hoḥ bu khyod la dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad las byed pho nya'i pho nyi'i bka' 'di gtad gtad pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i mnga' dbang ldan par gyur cig: des ni rgyal po'i bka' bzhin du 'phrin las thogs med du bsgrub cing phyi nang gi bar gcod thams cad khyi bzang bzhin du bsrung bar 'gyor: ces brjod : phur bsrung dbang phyug gi dbang 'di rnams snod dang sbyar ba gal che ba yin no: de nas gdab las kyi dbang ni/ de ltar dbang yongs su mtha' rten nam le lag 'phril las rab 'byams kyis dgra bgegs gdug sa can sgrol ba la dbang 'byar ba'i nus mthu thob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: mdun du nya'o/ phur pa thun rjas sgrol gri gtun dang gtun bu sogs 'du bya*/ gser skyems bshams ma/ 'brug gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi byin (162) brlabs la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkhro dang : khyad par rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras: bdud 'dul khro bcu za gsod sgo mar bcas:

gser skyems 'di bzhes sngags 'chang mthu dpung bskyed/ shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid skyes bu sogs/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig ma tshogs dbang phyug brgyad/ gter slong lha mo mchod gsum la sogs/ gser skyems 'di bzhes sngags= yul gzhi'i bdag po lha srin sdi brgyad dang lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyur legs nyes ston/ gnyug mar gnas dang blong bur lhag pa kun: gser skyems 'di bzhes sngags 'chang gdong grogs mdzod/ ces gser skyems mchod/ hūṃ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal5 chos dbyings rnam dag 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum: thabs shis sku las sprul pa'i khro bo bcu: rang bzhin dbyings las shar ba'i gro mo bcu/ sprul pa las la mngags pa'i khra thabs tshogs: za gsod mche ba rtags kyi gshogs pa can: dkyil 'khor phyagos bzhi skong ba'i sgo ma bzhi: gsod pa'i las mdzad phur bsrung bcu gnyis dang : bse lcegs dung gi skyes bu la sogs te: phur pa'i bsrung mar zhal bzhes dam can tshogs: khyed kyi thugs rjes thugs dam dus la babs: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phril las grub par mdzod: ces las byang ltar bskul/ dmigs bya bskyed pa ni/ e zhes brjod pas de las bskyed pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom zug gsum pa kha rub la gting zab pa'i nang du rni dang tri las sdang dgra gdon byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mgon skyebs dang bral zhing myal zhing mya ngan gyi gdung ba'i nyasam tha pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ zhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas bden stobs 'ugs zhugs ci rigs mthar pho ta babazhi'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ badz+ra a ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūṃ: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa haḥ zhes rang dbang med par bkuran nas gzungs dang gnyis su med par bsdim: de nas sras mchog phur pa blangs te slob dpon gyi bsgril zhing : hūṃ dbang dang lag pa'i mchog rnams kyis: rang tu 'drel zhing gser byas nas:

dug gsum rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir: bsgril zhing 'debs pa'i dbang bskur ro: khams gsum srid gsum sgrol ba dang : mthu rtsal yongs so dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma traṃ ru dra ma ra ya phaṭ+wa: a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: hūṃ thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i: rdo rje phur pa kī la ya: stod na khro chen 'bar ba'i zhal: rgya mdud gong mar bsrung stong ldir: lcim gzhon brgyad nas hūṃ sgra sgrogs: rgya mdud 'og mar phaṭa sgra sgrogs: chu srin kha nas tshwa tshwa 'phro: dbal zur gsum nas me dpung 'bar: gzer ba tsam gyis rdul du brlag: dril bas phyogs skyong bcu yang 'dar: btab na lha yang brlags par 'gyur dgra bgegs tsaṃ la smos mi dgos: skal ldan bu la 'di gtad pas: stong gi lha yang thul bar shog: 'og gi klu yang (163) gzir bar shog: bar gyi sdi brgyad tshar gcod shog: dgregs thal bar brlab par shog: ces phur pa slob mar gtad la chu srin rnam rol phyag rgyal bsgril du 'jug cig: khyed rang dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi skur gsal ba dang*/ gtad pa'i phur pa sras mchog kī lar gsal ba dang*/ mdun gyi ling ka de dmigs bya dngos su gsal ba ste/ de ltar gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ o chad pa zhes brjod pas phur pa'i mgo bor hūṃ kā ra yab yum bsgoms pa'i spyi bor āḥdakar so gsal ba 'od du zhug ba'i hūṃ kā ra la thim pa de nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas phur bu bu la thim par gyur/ phur pa 'od kyi rang bzhin dkar rtse re ba las 'od zer stong 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa sbyangs te tsho'i bcud phur pa la thim par gyur par bsams: de nas gzang pa'i snying dkar nam mtshams su phur pa bsgril zhing gdab pas kho'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad du phyis pa ltar song : tshe dang bkrag mdangs thams cad yi ge hūṃ dkar po zhig tu gyur nas phur pa la thim par gyur pa bsgom pa ni tshe khrus kyi gnod/
