slar yang phur pa 'drel zhing 'debs pas kho'i sgo lnga'i rnam shes de kun gzhi la 'ub kyi 'dus nas yi ge hūṃ du gyur te phur bu la thim par gyur zhes byung tsher sgyi sgo bkag pa'o/ phur pa 'dril zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma rag mo yag moḥ kā la rū pa gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma lha bsrung 'dre gdon dam sri'i snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: dgra bgegs byad ma dam sri'i srog rtsa la yaṃ laṃ: snying la khril khril: srog la chum chum: tsit+ta srog ma dung dung : snying khra shad dza: thum ri lam lam: snying rtseg rtseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha dhi ma ma: karma shrī traṃ ka ra ye: ma ra sa ni: sra mar ta na ye parma bag+nan bi hūṃ phaṭ+wa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sarba big nan badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: badz+ra hūṃ kā ra a āḥ zhes phur pa snying khar btab/ phur pa kho'i snying khar gdab pa'i rnam shes nri tri rus yod pa de phur pa la tsam gyis byung nas a hūṃ du byen brlabs te/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+wa: ces pas hūṃ de dpal chen po yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su 'phang ste rgyal ba'i sras su gyur pa ni kun gyi rtsad nas bcad pa'o/ de'i shul du rnam shes de mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir phur pa snying dkar nag mtshams su gdab la/ kī li lan bcom brgyad bzla zhing*/ slar yang auṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yang mu ka mya ra yab sras mar ta na ma ra sa na sarba big+nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa: dgra bdegs nri tri hur thobs dzaḥm ra ya sod: ces brjod cing tshe khrus kyi dgongs pas liṅka'i snying kha/ dbang po lte (164) ba yan lag bzhi la phur ba btab cing*/ thun rdzas kyis kyang brab/ sgrol gyis rkang pa g.yas nas rim par gtub tu gzhug: hoḥ skal ldan khyod la sgrol byed 'debs pa'i dbang bskur bas dug gsum gyis bskyed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol zhing tshar gcod rdul du brlag pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob rapa gyur cig:

ces dang*/ den sa rdul du brlags pa'i dbang ni/ rdo rje tho ba dang mchog phur gtad la/ hūṃ brdung zhig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams: rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas: lung ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlog: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: khro bo 'bar ba'i gtun tshogs kyis/ khams gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir: drag po sgrol byed bdang bskur bas: khams gsum yongs sgrol dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs nri tri sha truṃ/ mu tri gh+ri ha na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces gtun brdung byar 'jug/ lang ro hom gzar du bcug la gal pa gnyis 'khrig ma sbyar/ sor mo rtse sprad pa kha phye la zhal du btab pa'i tshul byed du bcug la/ hūṃ phyes shig phyes shagig khro rgyal zhal phyes shig: gnam pa gdangs pa tsam gyis zhal phyes shig: tshems ni gangs ri ma gyi rno dbal bar tu gtsigs/ ljags ni glog dmar bar snang khams gsum skyongs: mnyam nyid hor khung 'bar ba'i zhal du stob: 'gag pa med rol pa chen po'i mgrin par bsdim: bzhes shig rol cig kha ram khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khī hi: kha thaṃ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: phaṭ+waḥphaṭaḥphaṭa: badz+ra yak+sha kro ta khā hi khā hi khā hi: ha ha ha: phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa phaṭ+waḥ ces phul ba'i lha tshogs rnams rab tu dgyes pas rol bar bams la ling ro gtor mar bran hoḥ skal ldan khyed la drag po gdab las dkyi dbang bskur bas: khams gsum gyi dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol zhing tshal gcod nas rnams par shes pa chos kyi dbyings su spar te: kun tu bzang mo'i chos kyi dbyings su sgrol nus pa'i dbang dam pa hoḥ skal ldan khyod la drag po gdab las kyi dbang bskur bas: khams gsum gyi dgra bgegs thams sgrol zhing tshar gcod nas rnam par shes pa chos kyi dbyings su spra te:

kun tu bzang mo'i chos kyi dbyangs su sgrol nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces brjod/ de nas 'phrin las sgrub nus kyi dbang ni/ slob ma'i mgo la srog zhu bkon/ sgrub yig snying khar bzhag/ sgrub gtor rgyun gathor rnga dang rol mo rnams gtad la/ sangs rgyas sras po dam pa'i mchog: bskyed dang rdzogs dang 'phril las bzhi: chos rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing : bsnyen sgrub las rbayor mthar phyin cing : rang dang gzhan gnyis smin grol phyir: 'phrin las yongs rdzogs bka' gtad dbang : khyod la yongs rdzogs 'di bskur bas: rab 'byams bka' yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: oṃ aḥhūṃ: sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: zhes dang*/ de nas tshe dang dngos grub zhal zas kyi dbang ni (165) tshe gtor spyi bor bzhag /rdzas rnams gnas gsum du gtug cing lag tu gtad la/ hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrubs pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : kī la ya yi dngos grub rtsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī ya ya sarba big nan bi hūṃ khaṭ+waḥ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣeḥsid+dha hūṃ: ka ya badz+ra sid+dhi oṃ: wak+ka badz+ra sid+dhi ā”tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dha hūṃ: ghu ṇa badz+ra sid+di hrī: karma badz+ra sid+dhi phaṭ+wa: ghu ṇa badz+ra sid+dhi hrī: karma sid+dhi phaṭ+waḥ shan+tiṃ sid+dhi/ puṣ+ṭiṃ sid+dhi: wa shaṃ sid+dhiḥ karma sid+dhiḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ āḥ hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la tshe dbang dongs grub zhal zas logs spyod sna tshogs kyi dbang bskur bas: bde bar gshegs pa'i sku tshe dang lang tshog dpal dang longs spyod la mngaza brnyes shing mchog thun mong phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub la longs spyod pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob ra gyur cig: ce brjod dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol cing shis sa brjod sogs spyi bzhin bya:

de ltar chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul rat+na gling pas ldan lha khra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i bang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur grub pas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung sdom gyi 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod gatsho bos ji ltar bka' rtsal pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gi bgyid/ lan gsum/ de ltar dbang legs thob pa'i gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dgams la slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ srang yang lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas pa 'khor mos bsgyur ba'i rgyas srid kyi 'byor pa ltar sprul nas 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyod du gsol snyams pas 'di'i rjes slob mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang : cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ lan gsum dang*/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa'i dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo ba lhan du mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ ces sogs bskul rjes slob ma rnams phyag 'bul du bcug la rang gnas su btang ngo*/ de ltar dbang rnams phar bskur rjes su: rdo rje slob dpon rang gis dbang ma gsos na: bsgrub pa zab par 'gyur pas rjes skyongs: bsnyen pa khri 'bul la sogs kyis rang gi dbang gso: rgyun du'i rang gzhung bsrung nar ba'am nya stong brgyad gsum la sogs la gzhung gasrangs la mchags pa byas te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba ni: nam ngag gi gnad du ce'o/ des ni phar la bskur yang rang gis bsgrub pa la mi gnod de: bkris pa yin no: spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bstan pa ni/ las byang gi tshogs lhag nas kyus bzhin bya ba dang*/
chog bgrogs

(166) dngos grub rgya mtsho'i spyi don gnyis pa'i bdun pa yan gong du song ba'i 'phros/ brgyad pa las la sbyar ba dang*/ spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bcu gcig yod pa las dbang sgrub 'brel na kyus ltar dang 'dir dbang rkyang la chog bsgrigs kyi gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba la dang po ti nge 'dzin dang*/ gnyis pa rdzas sogs 'di+or len gyi las byang dang sprad la bsdu zhing chog sgrig gis cho la lhag ma rnams mi dgos la/ las byang gi bcu gnyis pa smon lam sogs na rdzosags par bya bas 'grub par 'gyur ro*/ smras pa/ de ltar dpan chen rdo rje phur pa zhes/ o rgyan sangs gnyis pa'i gong khug ma/ jo mor legs gdams bka' gter gnyis ldan las/ ldang lha'i gter byon gdams pa'i nying khu mchog: yang gsang bla med don gyis snying po yis: dbang chog chen mo 'phrin las gter mdzod la/ 'thad 'os kyis brgyan klag tshog chu 'babs mar/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung ji bzhin bkod/ tshul 'di mkhas rloms grags 'dod cher min kyang*/ snga 'gyur theg mchog bstan pa rin chen dang*/ khyad par bdag dang bdag 'dra'i bla dman 'gar/ phan snyam 'khrug sdeb dag gsal go bder spol/ legs cha gang mchis rje btsun bla ma'i drin/ bka' drin dran pas slar yang gus phyag 'bul/ 'gal 'khrul ma dag rang blo'i skyon lags pas/ mkhyen ldan rnams kyis gtan la dbab tu gsol/ dge 'dis mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ skyo zhing skyo bar rdo rje phur pa yis/ smin grol lam bzang 'di dang mi 'bral zhing*/ sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur du thob par shog/ de ltar chos rgyal rat+na gling pas ldang lung khro mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo rje'i gsung tshig gab daklug gi rtogs dka' ba rnams snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rdo rje slob dpon du rlom pa dag gis ma rtogs rang bzos cho nyams pa'i rgyur mthong ba'i de dag gi nyes pa 'gogs shing snga 'gyur bstan pa rin po che'i srid zhu dang*/

rang nyid kyang lag len 'khyer bde ba dang rang snyam pha lan pa'i slad du bris 'dun yid la bcag rung g.yeng bas rigs 'gyangs thog/ 'brong ngur bla ma dkon mchog bstan 'dzin byang chub bzang pos rig mo zhig nas bskul ba ma zad/ rang nyid kyi slob dpon mkhas dbang nyin rdzong khri pa dkon mchog chos ma bla gros nas kyang 'di ltu zhig byung na legs tshul gsungs pa bcas: de dag don yod par bya ba'i phyir bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu phur bsrung dam can rnams la gnang ba zhus par 'drer rung gi mtshan ma'ang thob par brten/ gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dbang chog gab daklag gsal zhing chu 'babs su bkod pa rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma (167) rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes slob ma'i tha shal ba gang gi zla med pa'i bka' drin kho nas 'tsho ba'i lkal ba can shākya'i dge slong bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ dpal u rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa nyid lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtshar rang byung pad+ma'i lhums las bltams pa'i tshul ston pa shing khams yal ga'i ri dwags kyi lor khrums zla'i dmar phyogs ḍā ki 'du ba'i dus bzang por dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i spo'i gzims chung lcang lo can du rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nang chen dge slong bla mkhyen dkon mchog chos 'dzin gyi bgyis pa ste sngar 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rig po che dar zhing gyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur cig/ sarba maṅga lam// //na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka' = dge bdun gyi= gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi=

gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs kyi= khyad par du'ang dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul khro bcu phra phyag za gsod sgo ma phur bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi= bden sa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ dam nyams kyi dgra bgegs sangs rgyas kyibastan pa bshigs pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad la/ dge bdun gyi sde bcom pa/ sems can yongs la 'tsho ba/ bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i bar gcod byed pa/ 'jig rten khams su nad lams 'khrug rtsed rtsa sad ser ba 'bu da 'than pa'i 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i zhing bcu tshar ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams pa 'og pa stong pa bla srid pa gsum gang du gnas kyang byi'u khras ded pa'am/ ri dwags rngon pas bcun pa bzhin skad gcig rang bdang med pa gzugs kyi liṅka 'di la khug cig/ (168) (ma) ༄༅// dpal chen phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i don dbang yid bzhin nor bu khrigs chags su bkod pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las 'khor lo'i lhar/ yongs shar dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yis/ don gyi dbang chog yid bzhin nor bu yi/ bskur ba'i lag len khrigs chags gsal bar bkod/ 'dir dpal chen phur pa yang gsang bla med den gyi snying po'i don dbang yid bzhin nor bu khrigs chags gsal bar bkod pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ dbang chog chen mo dang sbril nas bskur ba'i tshe sta gon sogs de gas khyab pa mdzad srol dang*/ dbang 'di nyid gcig su bskur ba'i tshe pa'i cho rtags blangs sbyangs bzung sogs 'brub na sgrub chen ltar rgyas par bya ba ni dbang chog chen mo'i skabs su bshad pa ltar dang*/ dkyil 'khor khang pa sngon nas rung bar byas pa yin kyang*/

mi snang bar blang ba dang sbyang bzung rnams 'byor na legs pa'i lin lag dang*/ lha dang bum pa slob ma sta gon rnams dang sta gon (169) gyi lha 'degs pa dang rdul tshon ras bris gang byed sogs dbang chog chen mo'i skabs ltar bya zhing*/ dbang rdzas 'god pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ma pa mtshan ldan kha rgyan mgul chings gzungs thag dang bcas pa/ de'i stong mañji rkang ring khar e'i gdan la gtso phur bkod/ g.yas su dbang gtor bris skus spros pa/ g.yon du bdud rtsi rdzas ldan me long sin+dhu ra chos 'byung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ me dpung sogs phyag mtshan tshang ba/ stag sham mgo 'phring sbrul chan sogs rtags gsum dang*/ gzig shaṃ rgyan drug dril bu sogs tshang ba bkod bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma/ sman rakā chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs 'ji ltar dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bshams/ las byang gzhung bsrang ba'i bdag mdun bum gsum 'jug pa gcig pa'am tha dad pas rang gzhung ltar 'dzab dmigs dang bcas bzlas pa dang mchod bstod/ bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtaur chog/ tshogs kyi mchod pa bskang ba dang bcas grub par byas te/ snyan gsan dbab pa sogs kyi bdag nyid 'dzug pa/ slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar ri ti nge 'dzin gyi 'jug pa gang rigs bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkram bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyi blo bcos pa'i chos bshad dang lo rgyus sogs ji ltar 'tsham pa byas rjes slob ma rnams maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bskul nas/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba song nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug sar yid mchog tu byas ba'i phyir mig dar/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma na ye swā hāḥ zhes 'ching*/ a khaṃ wī ra hūṃ: zhes nam mkha'i dpa' bo bos me tog gtad pas rigs lngī sa bon rang rang las skyes pa'i me tog gi 'phreng ba so so'i sa bon gyi mtshan pa re snyim par bzung mos la thal mo sbyar la yol ba'i phyir rol nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zles mdzod/

kyai rdo rje 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor bdag: phur pa bla na med pa yi: dkyil 'khor chen por bdag 'dzug cing : bdang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum byar gzhug cing*/ slob dpon gyis/ legs 'ongs skal ldan rigs can rnams: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug cing dam la gnas gyur pa'i: las dang skal bar ldan lags sam: zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag can skal ldan bsgrub pa pos: lha dang bla ma dbyer mi phyed: bla med rdo rje phur pa yis: dbang gis dkyil 'khor 'jug par spro: zhes lag gsum dang*/ de nas skyabs yan lag bdun pa sdom pa bzung ba rnams dbang chog chen mo'i sta gon skabs ltar (170) bya zhing*/ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥzhes slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'dzin du bcug cing yol ba'i nang du khrid de shar sgo nas rim bzhin zhugs te phyag byas par mos la/ oṃ nī ma te hūṃḥ oṃ na ma me hūṃ: oṃ nā mo nā ma hūṃ: zhes sgo so sor sku gsung thugs kyi phyag len gsum ri bya bar mos/ de nas dam chung sbyin pa ni/ dam rdzas la bal chu bsres pa lce ba bzhag cing rdo rje gnas gsum du gsum du gtug la hūṃḥ gsang ba'i dam tshig bla na med: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor phyir: nga ni khyod kyi ho ru nga yi bsgo ba'i bka' ji bzhin: khyod kyi 'dab bar mi rung ngo : oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra pa ma ya dzaḥ zhes brjod la/ dam tshig lag gnas par khas blangs zhing man bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ i dan du na ra ka na: zhes dam la bzhag/ de nas ye shes dbab pa dang*/ me te dor ba/ mig dbye ba/ dkyil 'khor rnam dag rnams dbang chog chen mo'i skalabs ltar 'dor len bya/ dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlog mdzod/ hūṃ chad pa kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dutsha ba: sangs rgyas 'phris rdzogs mdzad pa:

dbang dang dngos grub bdag la rtsel: zhes lanang gsum byar gzhug: de nas thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyang gzugs skur rong ngo bzhengs te rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs thams cad slob ma'i spyi bo'i steng gi namag mkha' la kī la la'i sngags sgra de ri ri byon nas dbang bskur*/ rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyis bkris pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing*/ bub nag gi lha tshogs rnams kyi sbyor mtshams nas byin rlabs byang sems khu phang babs pa ltar sha ra ra byung nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas mar la thim pas rin bzhin lus bdud rtsigs gang zhing : thod pa dung khang gi nang du rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs thams cad dag pa 'od gsal gyi skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi bum sa btegs la/ hūṃ bum pa rnam dag chos sku'i gzhal yas nas: longs spyod rdzogs sku phur pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs: thugs rje sprul sku'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ka ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃḥ wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: zhes bum pa gnas gsum du bskur la bum chu blud/ hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la rtse ba bum pa'i dbang chog bskur bas/ sku gsung thugs 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i dbang chog thob par gyur cig: zhes dang gtso bo'i phur pa thogs la/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas khyed rang rnags kyi lung ngag yid gsum la thim pas nyon shes kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag cing dpal chen pos sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob pa'i (171) mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul longs spyod rdzogs: thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du: byams cad snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir rtsol cig:

ye shes khro bo 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ ā dz+nyā na sid+dhi a we ya ka ya a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: zhes phur pa gnas gsum du gtug: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gtso bo rdo rje phur pa'i dbang rdzogs par bskur bas: sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang chog thob ste: 'phril las bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang chog thob par yar cig: ces brjod/ bhan+dha bdud rtsis gang ba thogs la/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu yab yub snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang 'od zare gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs: spyi bo nas zhugs pa 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkhas gsang las byung te thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa lce thog tu bzhag pas rtsa khams zag med kyi bde bas gang ste gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha mgrin par gtug cing hūṃ gsang ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: zag med rtsa khams dag pa la: byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur bas: bde stong ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra a ra li dzi na mi tri ma hā dz+nyā na a ko su sid+dhi hoḥ zhes bdud rtsi myang du bcug hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la gsang ba'i dbang mchog 'di bskra bas/ 'de stong zung 'jug ye shes kyi dbang mchog thob par 'gyur ba yin no: ces rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas phyag 'tshal gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ g.yas su rdo rje rtse dgu: rtse lnga/ g.yon du me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ gtad la/ hūṃ rdo rje rtse dgu gyen du gsol ba ni: sa dgu'i rtogs pa rtsad nas gcod: rdo rje rtse lngas rguyad lnga 'dren/ ye shes lnga yi ngang du sbyor: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba yis: nyon mongs bag chags bsreg par byed: kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni dug gsum dang : nyon mongs 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod: oṃ badz+ra badz+ra hūṃ: raṃ raṃ tri sha hoḥ a bhi sha hoḥ

a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: zhes dang*/ sras kyi phur pa lag tu gtad la/ hūṃ ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar pa'i phro bo mi bzad pa: sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: sku yi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: gsung gi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: thugs kyi dbyings su dbang bskur ro: yon tan 'phril las dbyangs su dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ka ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la phyag 'tshan yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur bas sku gsung thugs rol pa chen po'i dbang thob: 'phril las rnam bzhi la mnga' brnyes: yi dam lha dang skal ba mnyam par gyur cig: ces dang*/ yam gyi chos dbang ni/ thod 'phring sbrul chun bskon la/ hūṃ thod 'phrong tshar gsum sku (172) gsum ldan: ye shes rol ba'i rgyan du che: sbrul chun dug gsum gnas su dag: rtogs med rol pa dpal gyi chas: rgyan 'phreng 'di yis dbang bskur bas: rngams brjid khro bo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ keṃ bh+ruṃ sa la la ri a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: zhes dang*/ gsang gzhi kor rlon stag sham bskon la/ hūṃ chad pa ba rnam dag g.yang gzhi 'jigs: rtogs med glang chen ko rlon dpa': nga rgya rnam dag stag sham brjid: khro rgyal sku yi rgyan rdzogs dbang : lka ldan khyod la yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badz+ra ti ra na hal ti ma gha la/ badz+ra tri sha hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca maṃḥ hoḥ skal ldan khyod la dpal chen dpa' brjid chas kyi dbang bskur bas: srid gsum yongs sgrol stobs bcu yongs rdzogs kyi dbang 'di thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ rtags gsum rim gyi gdab la: hūṃ dpral bar thal chen tshom bu 'jigs: mkhur bar rak+ta'i thig le brjid: og mar zhal gi zo ris brngams: dpal chen rtags kyi dbang bskur bas: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ tig na karma tri sha haḥ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: o skal ldan khyod la khro rgyal rtags kyi dbang bskur bas:

ho ru ka dngos kyi mthu dang ldan pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ yum gyi gzig shi rgyan drug dril bu rnams gtad la/ hūṃ pha rol phyin drug thabs shis rus pas brgyan: mnyam nyid ye shes yum gyi rgyan du che: yang dag ye shes dri med gzig gi rgyan: gar gyi nyams ldan dri med dpa' ba'i chas: shes rab rang bzhin dril bu'i sgro sgrogs pas: zung 'jug bed chen chos kyi rang sgrar shog: oṃ badz+ra yo ga bhi sha ma hā bhe ga ra ya a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la shes bar yul gyi rgyan dbang 'di bskur bas: pha rol phyir drug yongs su rdzogs te: sku gsum thugs ye shes lnga'i dbang chog dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces dang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dbang ni/ tshe gtor dang tshe'i 'bring rgyas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams slob ma'i lag tu gtad la rol mo'i byin dbab cing*/ hūṃ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las 'grub cig: tshe dang longs spyod 'dod dgu rin chen gter: dpal dang gson nams mi bzad nam mkha'i mdzod: 'phrin las kun gyi mchog brnyes bkris pa: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ tshe bh+ruṃ a yu ṣeḥ la hā su ka sid+dhi dzaḥ gha na tsakra sarba rat+na na na kha dhe sarba sid+dhi ka ya dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ tshe dang dpal dang longs spyod kyi tshogs 'di rnams dbang bskur zhing btad pas: bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi tshe dang lang tsho ltar gyur nas: tshe 'dir longs spyod dpal dang ldan zhing tshe la dbang ba dang*/mthar thug

(173) longs spyod rdzogs pa rgyal ba'i sku thob par gyur cig: ces tshe dang tshogs kyi longs spyod la rol du bcug/ slob dpon gyi me tog 'thor zhing : oṃ 'grub par gyur cig: tshe dbang du gyur cig: dbang longs spyod du gyur cig: mi shig pa rdo rjer gyar cig: mi 'gyur ba gasprung du gyur cig: tshe nyi zla ltar gyur cig: longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes par yar cig: ces smon lam gdab: bsgrol dbang bskur ba ni: nya'o dang*/ phur pa mdun du bkod la gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas: i yi dz+wa la ri/ mdun du brub khung yangs shing gting zab nang du nri dang tri las dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs nyams thag cing rid pa gnad byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur: lcags kyu'i kyu'i phyang dang bcas bden stobs 'gug zhugs rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya zhing : thugs ka nas pho nya las byed mang po 'phros pa'i dgra bgegs rnams byi'u khras bzung ba bzhin rnam shes bla dwags dang bcas pa bcas pa bkug ste ling ga la bstim zhing pho nya bzhina'i phyag rgyas kyang bskyar ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra a ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pa sha hūṃḥ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: zhes brjod pas grub gsum lcags kyi khang par dmigs bya la slar yang drag tu bstim/ sras mchog gi phur pa blangs te slob dpon gyi bsgril zhing*/ slar slaub mar gtad la bsgril du 'jug: hūṃ thabs dang shes bar las byung ba'i: rdo rje phur kī la ya: stod ni khro chen 'bar ba'i zhal/ stod ni khro chen 'bar ba'i zhal: rgya mdud gong mar 'brug stong ldir/ lcums gzhog brgyad nas hūṃ sgra sgrogs: rgya mdud 'og mar phaṭ+wa sgra sgraugs: chu srin kha nas tshwa tshwa 'phro: dbal zur gsum nas me dpung 'bar: gzir ba tsam gyis rdul du rlog: 'dril bas phyogs skyongs bcu yang 'dar: btab pas lha yang brlug par 'gyur: dgra bgegs tsam la smos ci dgos: skal ldan bu la 'di gtad pas:

stong gi lha yang thul bar shog: bar gyi sdi brgyad tshar gcod shog: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du brlags par shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya a mu kaḥ mar ra ya sra mar ta na ma ra sa na sarba big+nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dgra bgegs nri tri hur thums dza ma ra ya sod: ces phur pa liṅga'i snying kha dbang po lte ba man lag bzhi la gdab: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: phur pa rdzas kyi dbang 'di bskur bas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod mngon spyad drag po'i 'phrin las kyi dbang thob gyur cig: ces brjod cing ling ror sman raka sbran cing gtor mar sgron la las byang bzhin btab bya'o: de ltar dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyis don dbang yid bzhin nor bu legs par bskur zin pa'i de dag gi dam tshig rnams tshul rnams tshul bzhin dus bsrung sdom drag po'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' rtsal pa*/ de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ de ltar dbang legs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍa la 'bul mdzod/ slob ma rnams (174) maṇ+ḍa 'bul du bcug: slar yang lus longs spod dge ba'i dngos po bcas kun bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yangs sa ltar spros nas 'bul na cha shas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ ces dang*/ de ltar thob pa'i dge tshogs sems can thams cad dang mthun mong du byas te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar mdzod/ bson nams 'di yi sogs kyis slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs lhag bskul chad mod bstan skyong sogs las byang mjug chos dkyus bzhin shis pa brjod pa'i bar gyi mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ de ltar dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i don dbang yid bzhin nor bu'i lag len khrigs chags su bkod pa 'di yang don gnyer du ma'i ngor 'bri gung pa bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis shing khams yal ga'i ri dwags kyi lo 'bras ldan gyi zla bar 'bri rdzong bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims chung phun tshogs 'khyil par bris pa pa sarba maṅga lam//

(175) (tsha) ༄༅// dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi sgrub chen chog sgrigs dngos grubs rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phring zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen gyi chog bsgrigs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun bzang parma 'byung*/ bshes gnyen gar gyi rnam par rol pa gang*/ bkrin gsum ldan rje btsun pad+ma'i mtshan/ byang chub thob kyang bde chen 'khor lor bsten/ chos sku nam mkha' rdo rje mi g.yo zhing*/ longs spyod rdzogs sku nyin byed rnamar par gsal/ sprul sku gang 'dul 'od zer phyogs bral 'geg srid zhi'i dpal gyur khro rgyal che la 'dud/ khra brag gter byin 'phrin las phur pa yi/ sgrub chen chog bsgrigs nyams su len bde'i khrigs/ bkod la bla ma lha yi gnang ba dang*/ byin rlabs shis pa'i dpal yon 'dir rtsol cig /de la 'dir dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi bsgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos (176) gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba ba dang gsum mo/ spyi don dang po sngon 'gro la yang bsgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba dang*/ gsol gdab/ sa chog gi rim pa dang gsum mo/ so gzhi bzung ba ni/ gnas dus ston 'khor chos yo byed te phun su tshogs pa lngas bsgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba sgrub khong chen mor gsungs pa'i cha rkyen thams cad 'tshogs par bya'o/ gnyis pa la gsol ba gdab pa/ bsnyen pa gso ba/ bsags sbyangs gsum las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gzhung nas gsungs pa'i gza' skaram yan lag lnga sogs spyir dge ba'i dus bzang por dpon slob rnams tshogs la spro zhing nus na dga' ston tshogs gtor bya zhing*/ slob ma rnams me tog dang bcas gsol gdab sogs sgrub khor chen por gsungs pa'i tshig gzhi zhu gnang bya zhing de tsam ma chog kyang mos pas 'grub pa'o/

gnyis pa bsnyen pa gso ba ni/ bla mas gnang ba sbyin zhing sbyang ba'i man ngag bstan nas/ slob dpon rang nyid lha la gnang ba zhu ba'i phyir bsnyen pa kha gso ba bsnyen tshad rab 'bring tha gsum sgrub khog tu gsal ba bzhin bya'o/ gsum pa bsags sbyangs ni/ bla mas bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i ring slob ma rnams kyang lus srog gi bar chad du 'gro ba'i gnas rnams su 'gro 'dug spangs pa bsags sbyangs ci 'grub 'bad cing*/ sgrub dbang gi 'o byad sogs dgos pa'i cha rkyen thams cad kyang bsags go/ gsum pa la/ sa brtag pa/ bslang 'a/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba bzhi las/ dang po brtags sgrub kho chen mo sogs pa dpyad brtags pa'i rigs pa rnams bya'o/ gnyis pa bslang ba la gnyis kyi dang po snang lalas bslang ba ni rgyal po la sogs pa'i sa'i bdag po la rin dang bden pa'i gtam gyi sgo nas slang ba'o/ gnyis pa mi snang ba las bslang ba ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i gnas su bdag gi rnal 'byor rgyal bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ gzhi der maṇ+ḍal dri'i me tog gi tshom bu can mañjir bkod pa'i mdun du/ dkar gtor gnyis/ gser skyems/ chu gnyis nyer spyod songs bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha khas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rnams oṃ āḥhūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/ me (177) tog bdug spos/ mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo gtor ma dang bcas dngas shing thogs pa med pa bdud rtsi'i ro bcud dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shasta'i bar dang*/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ rang nyid kun ma 'i rgyal gyis lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa la brdabs te/ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ ho hoḥ zhes rdo rje gad mos bskul bas/ sa de thol byung du lha mo brtan ma gser gyi mdog can g.yas sbyin dang g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa lte yan chad stong du 'thon pa 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa dar gyi sdod g.yogs dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan par gsal ba'i/

rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis so 'og nas lha mo ye shes sa bdag rje blon gyis bskor ba 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ oṃ sri thi de wī sa ra ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sra tīñca swā hāḥ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ a kī ro'i sngogs kyi gtor ma phul la/ hūṃ sngon gyi ji ltar thugs dam ni/ dbang mdzad sems can don gyi phyir: de bzhin bdag kyang nges bsgrub pas/ mchod 'bul pa 'di gnang bar mdzod/ lo skor bcu gnyis stong gnas shing : sa bdag gdug pa'i rigs rnams kun/ sa glud bzang po 'di bzhes te: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gnas bzur la: sa bdag rnams kyis sa 'di phul: bkra shis byin ldan mdzad du gsol: sarba a tsin+dha bha lting ghṛ na ghṛ khā hi khā hi swā hā: zhes yon sbyin la bden pa brdar ba ni: hūṃ sngon tshe ston pa bcom ldan 'das: sa bzhi rin chen 'di nyid du: bdud btul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: de tshe lha mo khyed kyis phul de rjes bdag kyang skyob pa'i sras: bla med dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dzin: khyed rnams dga' ba'i mdangs phyungs la: sa 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzod: ces brjod pas lha mo dga' ba'i mdangs phyungs te/ skyob pa shākya seng ge'i sras: khyen ni byang chub thugs dang ldan: bdag ni dge sems dbang dang ldan: 'gro ba'i don mdzad ci bder spyod: ces smras te slar la thim par bsam mo: bye brag pa'i bdag po rnams las bslang ba ni/ byung mi sa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs: bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sogs lanag gsum gyi gtor ma bul la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ gdon sbyin srin pa'i gzhan dag la/ dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ bdag zhu khyed kyi rtsal du gsol: bhū mi pā ti sa pā ri wā ra sarba bhū ta gañca:

zhes gnang ba byin ra rang gnas su gshegs par bams la gtor ma gser skyems phyir dor/ tshom bu dang mchod rdzas (178) rnams bsdu/ gsum pa sbyangs ba la/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba/ rdzas sngags phyag rgyas sbyang ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyang ba dang gsum las/ dang po lasasha dang bya bas sbyang ba ni/ lto 'phyo brtags pa'i rim pa gzhung dang rje karma kirtis mdzad pa'i nyes pa kun sel sogs nas legs par brtags nas brkos pa'i so ro lnga bsal ba las gtor sba stogs bu bca' ba yin kyang 'dir mi 'chad la nyams su len par spro na gzhung dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes las rtogs par bya'o/ gnyis rdzas sngags phyag rgyas sbyang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la 'ong ma rtsi sman dang sbyar ba'i kun shas bya ba cing*/ rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ swa bhā wa chad pa sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shu d+dho3haṃ: zhes brjod cing sa la lan gsum gtug go/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyasi sbyang ba ni/ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs kā nas bh+ruṃ smug nag las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas: rgyal ba rnams kyis sras su dgongs: zhi khro lcam dral la phog: des sprun dang grogs su dgongs: mo ma dang mkhar 'gro ma rnams kyis: rang gi gatsho bor mthong : sems can gyi las sgrib sbyangs: slar pa la phog: sa bdag gdug pa'i zha snga zhi nas dkon mchog la dad par gyur: de nas sa thams cad gser gyis sa gzhir gyur pa'i stong du: rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsam mo/ bzhi pa la bzung ba dang bsrung ba gnyis las/ dang po bzung ba ni gtso 'khor rnams chas su zhugs nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ rdo rje gser zhing dril bu 'khrol la rkang pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sar bskor zhing*/ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ hri hring pheṃ pheṃ: zhes brjod la/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i mi gnyis raṃ las me'i rang bzhin can sdang mig tu ba las bskal ba'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs thams cad bsreg cing mi gnas par gyur par bsam zhing khro bo'i lta stangs kyis phyogs kun tu blta zhing*/

rdo rje'i 'gros kyi shar lhor song la 'di skad do/ chad pa hi rang byung ba'i: dpal chen khro rgyal nyid kyi sku/ ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las/ 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku la khro chung thog ser 'phro: ye shes me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar/ 'byung po gdon gyi tshogs rnams kun: glud gtor byin cing bka' bsgo yang : mi nyan gdug pa'i tshogasayod na: lus sems thal ba rdul bzhin du: brlag par 'gyur zhing gzhan du min: de bas 'di min gzhan du spos: zhes kī la ya brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang thun gyis brab rdo rje'i 'gros dang bcas lags g.yas bskyang ba'i 'chaṃ la phyogs gdongs 'gying ba dang bcas te/ g.yas dang g.yon du lan gsum bskor zhing 'chams: khro bcu'i stang stabs sogs ltang kyi rigs ji ltar rigs pas kyang bzung bar bya'o/ gnyis pa bsrung ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas khro ba'i tshogs skyi pa bzhi gang bar gyur (179) song sdong sogs kyi phur bu dgu slob dpon dang 'khor rnams kyis re re sgrol zhing*/ phur ba la khro bo'i tshogs 'dus shing thim pas de nyid skad cig gis kī la ya sku stod zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad phur pa me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i skur gsal bar gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta yaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭa badz+ra dha rod ad dz+nyā pa ya ti kā yaḥ sarba bhig nan kā ya wak+ka tsit+taḥbadz+ra kī lā kī lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa phaṭ+waḥ ces bur bu slob dpon gyis dbus dang 'khor rnams kyis phyogs mtshams su gdab cing hūṃ phaṭ+wa kyi sgra drag po sgrog cing btab pas/ de las byung ba'i sa gzhi thams cad khro chung dang me 'od kyis sa gzhi dbang tshad khyab par/ gzhu du dgu gsung kyang 'grub par bka' na gcig byed rung ngo*/ gang ba gyur par bsam/ zhal 'byung bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed phyi bshags ni/ dge slong bzhi sde/ phal pa'i ston mo/ byis ston sogs gang 'grub/

phal chen/ gtsug tor/ sdud pa mtshan brjod/ gtsug lag mdo bzhi dang*/ nang bshags su/ dri med bshags rgyud/ 'phris bzhi'i sbyin bsreg sogs dge ba'i dpung bskyed phyir rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang ci 'grub bya ba ni bar chad mi 'byung zhing bkra shis dngos grub nye ba'i rten 'brel du shes par bya'o/ spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgrub chen mo'i las kyi rim pa la/ mtshams gcod pa/ lhag gnas bya ba/ dkyil 'khor bzheng ba/ de nyid du 'dzug pa/ lha skos la gdab pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ dngos grub len pa/ las la sbyar ba dang brgyad do/ dang po mtshams gcod pa la phyi mtshams rgyal tho/ bar mtshams dam srid mnan cing sgo byang gdags pa/ ma ṭaṃ bsgral zhing nang gsang gi mtshams bcad pa gsum las dang po sgrub khang gi phyi'i phyogs bzhir thob brtsags la ri rab chen chen po'i lcog bzhir bsam zhi rgyal chen bzhi'i sku tsaka rgyab tu 'dod gsol can dang*/ sañca bar gnas can re bkod pa'i mdun du dkar gtor re dang gnyis nyer sprod bcas bshams la sngags drug phyag gis byin rlabs/ shar gyi thob bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung sku mdog dkor po si wang 'dzin pa mdzes shing brjod pa'i rgyan dang ldan par gsal ba'i/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas lha mo phyag rgya bzhi spros te ri rab kyi ral phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ lcags kyu phyag rgyas/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ṭa ye swā hāḥ ci 'grub bzlas nas gong sngags la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo'i sngags rgya sbyar bas mchod cing*/ lag pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas se gol gsum gyi sgras/ slar yang gong sngags la/ e ha hi ma hī ri tsa yi daṃ ghṛ ṇa bha ling ta na kha dhe ghṛ na hūṃ khā hiḥ gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/
hūṃ mgon mdzad shākya'i bstan pa la: phyag

(180) na rdo rje dbang gi mthus: bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: ri bar chon pa'i shar phyogs nas: lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ste: mthu chon mgon po yul 'khor bsrung : 'dir byon rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod*/ hūṃ dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung : sku mdog dpar po pi wang 'dzin: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i las mdzad pa: shar phyogs bsrung dang tshams chod cig: hūṃ phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: phyi yi bar chad mi btang zhing : mchod sbyin gtor pa 'di bzhes la: bsrung dang mtshams kyi las mdzod cig: ces 'phris bcol bas rgyal chen 'khor g.yogs dpung dang bcas pas bsrung ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o/ phyogs gzhan gsum la yang des rigs 'gro ba las so so'i khyad par/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po sku mdog sngon po ral gri bsnams pa cung zad khro nyams brjed pa'i rgyan dang ldan par gsal ba'i/ bdag nyid sogs nas/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po nas/ gyur gyi bar dang*/ oṃ bai ru d+dha kā ye swā hāḥci 'grub bzla zhing : mchod gtor gyi sngags rgya sogs gong gis 'gro/ 'phrin las bcom ba ni/ hūṃ mgon mdzad shākya'i= phyag na= bstan pa= ri rab chen po'i lho phyogs nas: lha yi= mthu chen mgon po 'phags skyes po: 'dir byon= bsta pa= hūṃ gshin rje'i mnga' bdag zaphags skyes po: sku mdog sngon po ral gri 'dzin: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa: lho phyogs bsrung dang mtshams chod cig: hūṃ phyag na rdo rje'i= ji ltar khas = gsang ba'i= phyi yi= mchod sbyin= tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sogs dang*/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang sku mdog dmar po sprul zhang dang mchod rten bsnams pa 'dzum zhing brjid pa'i rgyan dang ldan par gsal ba'i/

bdag nyid sogs/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang nas/ gyur gyi bar dang/ oṃ bai ru bak+ṣa ye swa hāḥ ci 'grub bzla zhing mchod gtor sngags rgyas sngar bzhin dang*/ 'phris bcom pa ni/ hūṃ mgon mdzad shākya'i= phyag na= bstan pa= ri rab chen po'i phyogs nas: lha yi= mthu chen mgon po mig mi bzang : 'dir byon= bstan pa= hūṃ klu yi mnga' bdag spyan mig bzang : sku mdog sngon po sbrul zhags 'dzin: khams gsum dbang sdud las mdzad pa: nub phyogs bsrung dang mtshams chod cig: hūṃ phyag na rdo rje'i= ji ltar= gsang ba'i= phyi yi= mchod sbyin= bsrung dang = tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sogs dang*/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang ser bo chon dang ne'u le bsnams pa bzhad cing brjod pa'i rgyan dang ldan par gsal ba'i/ bdag nyid sogs nas/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras nas/ gyur gyi bar dang*/ oṃ bai shrā wa (181) ṇā ye swā hāḥ ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ mchod gtor sngags rgya sngar bzhin dang*/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ mgon mdzad= phyag na= bstan pa= ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs na: lha yi= mthu chen mgon po rnam thos sras: 'dir byon= bstan pa bsrung = hūṃ gnod sbyin mnga' bdag rnams thos sras: sku mdog ljang ser she'u le 'dzin: bsgrub po rnams tho khong las phyir mi rgyu phyi mi nang du mi btang sogs sgrub kho chen mor gsungs pa rnams nyams su blang ngo : gnyis pa rab mtshams la dam srid dang sgo byang gnyis las/ dang po dam srid mnan pa ni/ ra sogs gam dug shog la dam srid bya mchu lto chi yan lag rid skam zhum pa'i bzugs can lan lag lcags sgrol gis bcings pa'i snying khar dza kha sbyor du nri tri dang*/ 'og tu khug dzaḥ zhes sogs gnas yig spyi ltar dang*/ de thamar mkhrin par pa nas brtsams te/ ya ma dam sri mā ra ya dzaḥ nan: ya ma dam sri ga sa ri khug dzaḥrbad nan tri'u tri'u sho na dza pa ri khug dza nan:

mthar spel tshig sbrul 'khyud du bri: gzugs phyari mgo thad nas yig mgo nang bstan gyis/ dngos grub bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam srid pho mo rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa lus ngag yid gsum mthu thogs rdzu 'phrul nus pa thams cad non cig sogs man pa'i sprol tshig dang dzaḥkhri gyis bskor zhing mi khrus spyi ltar dang*/ dug khrag gis byugs pa lcags snod du bkod la/ sgrub khang gi sgo nas gom bdun gyi sar dong gru gsum brus par gcer/ gser skyems dang*/ phur thun mtshon cha sogs 'du bya zhing spro na gtor bzlog nas gdab kha 'dor len dgos kyang*/ 'dar lag len 'dzug pa bde phyir/ gser skyems gzu dpang sngon du 'gro bas e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo rid cing tam thag pa'i lus cad du gyur/ bden bdar dang dgug gzhu gis khyad par/ bden pa chen po'i mthos dngos grub tha ma ma'i/ hūṃ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ nas rdul phran bzhin du brlags par mdzod/ ces dgra bgegs zhes pa rnams ya ma dam srid zhes tshig bsgyur/ ā+oṃ laṃ hūṃ li sogs kyis phur 'debs thun brab mtshon chas gtub tshul gyis/ dgrogs dam sri mā ra ya rbad sod: bar brjod cing*/ spro zhing nus ni liṅga mnan chas spyi ltar ram dngo nang du spyi tshugs su mnan la/ hūṃ dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'di: bla ma la bsdos mchod la 'khu: dkon mchog smad cing bstan (182) sa bshig: bka' da'as nam yang mi btang phyir: mtshon gyis gtub cing zhal du stob: gling bzhi ri rab 'og tu mnan/ ces g.yam leb la rdo rje rgyal gram dang ri rab gling bzhi bris pas bka'/ sa rim pa dgus g.yob cing*/ hūṃ gcig ni brjod med nyam gcig rgyalas: gnyis pa thabs dang shes bar rgya: gsum pa sgu gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi ni phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya:

lnga ni ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun ni ma mo bdun gyi rgya: brgyad ni ngur khrod brgyad kyi rgya: dgu ni he ru klong dgu'i rgya: bcu ni khro rgyal bcu yi rgya:khyod la rgya bcu brtsegs te mnan: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: dpal gyi bro rab byas te mnan: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: ā+oṃ lam hūṃ lam staṃ bha ya nan: ces mnan/ de steng bro brdung bya ba ni/ mchod rnams lu gu rgyud du brol te: hūṃ dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur zluṃ: ngos la zhi ba'i lha bsgom ste: btab pas dgar bgegs zhi bar 'gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya shan+ting ku ru ye swā hāḥ baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ā+oṃ las de bzhin 'khor dang bcas: rmug par gyur pa'i sems can rnams: zhi bar gyur la dbyings su rol: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: stong gi lha yang zhi gyur cig: 'og gi klu yang zhi gyur cig: sdang ba'i dgra yang zhi gyur cig: gnod pa'i bgegs kyang zhi gyur cig: nad dang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: ces bre ra zluṃ por brdung ngo : hūṃ gser ri ser po'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur bzhi: ngos la rgyas pa'i lha bkod do: btab pas tshe dbang bsod nams rgyas: swā rat+na kī li kī lā ya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: swā las rin chen 'khor dang bcas: nga rgyal dregs pa'i sems can rnams: rgyas par gyur la dbyings su rol: hūṃ bzhi brjod rjes rgyas mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe dbang bson nams rgyas gyur cig: dpal dang ye shes rgyas gyur cig: bkrag dang gzi brjid rgyas gyur cig: gdul phu 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig: ces phro ra grub zhir brdung ngo : hūṃ zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gaṃ:

btab pas snang srid dbang du sdud: a parma kī li kī lā ya ཿpa shang ku ru ye swā hāḥ yi yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: āṃḥlas pad+ma 'khor dang bcas: chags par gyur pa'i sems can rnams: dbang du ma gyur gang yang med: dbang du gyur la dbyings su rol: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod: dbang mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud cig: khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud cig: mos pa rnam bzhi dbang bsdus shig: bro la zla gaṃ du brdung ngo : hūṃ lcags sam nag po 'i shing rnams la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum: ngos la drag po'i lha bkod de: btab pas dgra bgegs brlag par 'gyur: hā (183) karma kī li kī lā ya mā ra ya phaṭ+wa: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: hā las don grub 'khor dang bcas: phrag dog gyur pa'i sems can rnams: brlag par gyur la dbyings su rol: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod: brlag mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: sdang ba'i dgra yang rdul du rlog: gnod pa'i bgegs rdul du rlog: rab chod dam sri rdul du= 'byung po'i tshogs rnams= bro ra zur gsu du brdung ngo : go rim dkyus ltar ram yang na dang po zhi ba: de nas drag po dbang rgyas pa rnams byas kyang legs: gnyis pa sgo byang gdags pa ni/ phyi sgo'i ya them la phur pa dang gshin rje'i sku gzugs rgyab tu 'dod gsol bris pa zhal phyir gzigs su btags pa'i mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma bshis la phyi ltar byin gyis brlabs/ sgrub pa po rnams phyi nags zhal tshur bltas la sku rten bsangs sbyangs: stong pa ngang las ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i stong du gshin rje nag po be con dang dgra ste thogs pa dur khrad cos kyis brgyan cing me dpung gi klong na don stab kyi bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsub gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra pa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/

ces bstim oṃ a kro ti ka shri ma hā ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ gong sngags mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod sngags dang*/ i dam bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ gsum gyi gtor ma phul la 'phrin las gsol ba ni hūṃ las kyi khro bdag gshin rje gshed: rdo rje 'dzin gyi bka' lung bzhin: bsgrub pa 'di yi phyi sgo bsrung: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar chod cig: ā+oṃ a kro te shri badz+ra ma hā ya ma ra tsa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ su sra tiṣ+ṭha me tog 'thor la brten bzhugs byas te sgo gnyer gtad/ gtor ma 'dzug pa'i yang na lho phyogs btang gsungs/ nang sgor zhal nang bstan gyi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku gzugs rgyab tu 'dod gsol yod pa phur ba bcas btags pa'i mdun mchod gtor sngar bzhin bshams la byin brlabs byas nas dpon slob rnams sgo nas phyir bltas te sku rten bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dpa nyi'i gdan la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag rgya graṃ dril bu 'dzin pa dur khro kyi chas kyis brgyan cing me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsub gyi mtshan sa las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes bstim/ ā+oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces brgya rtse tsam bzla/ gong sngags mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod sngags dang*/ yi dam bha ling+ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: gsum gyi gtor ma phur la/ hūṃ gsang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid ni: khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil: sngon gyi thugs dam chen po ni: bsgrub pa nang gi gsang sgo bsrung : oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+wa: su sra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog mthor la brtan bzhugs dang*/ gtor ma 'jugs pa'i byang du phul kyang (184) chog /gsum pa ma ṭaṃ bsgral zhi nang gsang gi mtshams gcod gnyis kyi/ dang po ma ṭaṃ bsgral ba ni/ kham sa la ma ṭigyi gzugs thal skya mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can shar nas drung la dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir mgo lho nub tu phyogs par bzhag

/rang nyid dpal chen po'i skur gsal bar gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ bden stobs brjod cing*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ bdag 'dzin dug gsum gyi rtog gzugs ru tra sde gsum gyi rnam par shar ba'i dngos grub la rab dug gcod pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad skad cig nyid la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig/ ma ṭaṃ ru tra ā kar+sha ya dzaḥtri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkug sde gzugs la bsdi de nas ging dkar nag g.yas zangs gri dang*/ g.yon tsit+ta thogs pa gnyis snying khar hūṃ gis mtshan par bsgom la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bsgrol byed ta ki dmar nag gnyis spros te so so la bsdim nas grol ging du mnga' gsol/ blo dpon gyis yungs dkar nag la/ ta ki ra tsa ni: khat+ga hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ+wa phaṭ+wa: ces brgya rtsa brgyad dang ye dhar bzlas la gtor/ de gnyis kyang nga rgyal brtan pos drag pa'i goṃ stabs 'chams 'gros dang bcas/ hūṃ ma ṭaṃ bya ba'i sdig can khyod: sngon yang bsgrub pa kun la sgribs: de tshe dpal chen he ru kas: bsgral nas dur khrod chen por byas: khungs dang rtsad bcad gang las byung : khungs dang rtsad bcad bdag las byung : bdag med stong pa'i thob pas gzhom: zhes ma ṭaṃ la tha bas bsnun/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ma ṭaṃ ru tra dzaḥ a kar+ṣa ru tra dzaḥ kha ṭaṃ ru tra dzaḥ ma tri ka ru tra pra bhan tsakra hūṃ phaṭ+wa: pra be sha phaṭ+waḥ ti hūṃ a yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ ngar 'dzin gyi rtog gzugs ru tra sde gsum gyi rnam par ma traṃ la bsdim pa de bdag med kyi don rtogs pa'i tho bas bcom par bsam zhing*/ slar yang ral gri bzung ste ngar dang ldan pas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya ma trāṃ ru tra pra bhan tsakra hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ tsit+ta a we sha ya phaṭ+waḥ ces rngam 'gros kyi da la lan gsum bskor te bsgral/ slob dpon gyi de'i snying phyug ste zhal du gsol bar bsam zhing*/

ti hūṃ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ+waḥ ces brjod pas ru tra de'i log rtog 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad nas rnam shes dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su spar/ nyon mongs pa'i yid dpal chen po'i zhabs 'og tu mnan la don snying nang rol rnams pho nya'i tshogs kyi lor bar bsam/ hūṃ dregs pa bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rnal 'byor mchog gi gnas su bya: sgo ni gzung 'dzin rtogs pas bcad: gnyis med ral gris sgo phye'o: zhes rab gris khog pa phyi sde bshags/ yan lag lnga dang snying dang nang rol mtshan rnams bcad nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams bgyad du bkod la ngur khrod chen po brgyad du bskyed la/ slob dpon 'gying 'gros kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su dor stab kyis bzhugs te/ hūṃ ma traṃ bya ba'i sdig (185) can khyod: rol pa'i stabs kyis mnan pa ni: 'jigs byed chen po hu ru kas: mgo ni lho nub mtshams su bstan: rkang par byang shar mtshams su bstan: khro g+r+yal zhabs ni g.yas g.yon gyis: gyad kyi dor stabs tshul du mnan: oṃ ma hā shri he ru ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ma hā dā+e wa ru tra dza dza hū: zhed dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bh+ruṃ zhes brjod pas ru tra'i kho sa gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i brog rtsa'i sgo phye bar rnal 'byor pa rnams zhugs te gnas par gyur bas bsam/ gnyis pa tshams gcod la gnyis las/ dang po nang mtshams ni/ lcags sam seng ldeng ngam/ skyor phur sogs bcu la khro bo bcu'i sngags dang paṇa can bcu slob dpon mdun du bkod/ gu gul bdug yungs kar gyi brab/ rak+tas byug bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig bcu yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bcu sku stod khro bo la sku smad phur bu rnam pa can du gyu pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hū/ de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra pa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshigs pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

zhes dang*/ rang sngags kyi gzi byin bskyed nas/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas hūṃ las khro bo lcags kyu dang tho ba thogs pa spros te phyogs skyong bcu bkug cing to bas bsnun nas phyogs bcu kun tu pho mo gan rkyal kha spub kyi bsnol mar bkod par gyur par bsam hūṃ ye shes khro bo chen po bcu: kun kyang mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku/ pho nya sprul pa g.yogs dang bcas: phur pa 'gril 'debs me dpung 'bar/ stong phyogs mtshams khor yug bsrung*/ bar chad thal ba rdul du rlog: slob dpon gyi g.yas su tho ba dang g.yon du phur bu thogs la/ stong gi phur sa shar gyi shar du gdab la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā ra hūṃ*/ bar chad 'byung po gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ thob bas bsdig shar du/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dzā ya hūṃ: bar chad 'byung po ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ shar lhor ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ: bar cad 'byung po da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭ+wa: lhor oṃ bkro ta man+ta ka hūṃ: bar cad 'byung ngo tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ lho nub tu ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ar+ya a tsa la hūṃḥ bar chad 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ nub tu ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūṃ: bar cad byung po hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ nub byang du ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lo kya bi dzā ya hūṃ: bar chad 'byung so bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ 'og gi phu pa nub kyi nub tu/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūṃḥ bar chad 'byung po s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces rim par btab pa'i gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing ba chen po ro gcig tu gyur par

(186) bsam/ gnyis pa yang dag gsang ba'i mtshams ni/ gzung 'dzin sems kyi rtog pa las don la lha dang 'dre'i bar du gcod byed nga nyid chos kyi skur rtogs pa'i/ mi shig rdo rje'i mtshams te rtag ma yengs pa ni rtogs pa'i mtshams zhes bya'o/ gnyis pa lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa rnams gong gis sa bzung 'jug byed pa shas che yang*/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin skabs 'dir bya ba'ang 'thad pas/ lha dang bum pa slob ma sta gon gsum las/ dang po lha sta gon ni/ stegs bu rgya spang sogs sgrub kho chen mor gsungs pa ltar gnas khang dang sbyar ba bya ba'i gzhi der/ khrag chen dang dri bzang bdud rtsi lnga rnams chang dang sbyar ba byang shar nas brtsams te byug la/ hūṃ nam mkha' dwag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: srid pa phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir: thabs shes gnyis med chag chag gdab: rang bzhin rnam par dag gyur cig: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhā la pra we sha hūṃ: khyem med par byug lha gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir las thig rdzogs par btab/ spro na 'og nas byung ba ltar/ hūṃ mtshan ldan bkris sogs nas thig gdab mdzod: bar brjod cing pad+ma khrag mtsho dur khrod rdo ra me ri rnams nges pa'i phyir mu khyud lnga bskor zhing*/ lha gnas su bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i dri gtso bo la grub bzhi/ 'khor rnams la zlum po byas pa'i khar lha so so'i sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu bkod dbus su mañji'i khar 'og nas byang ba'i lha bum dang*/ byang shar ram gang 'os su las bum bcas dang*/ mthar chu gnyes nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta sogs mkho ba'i 'o byad tshangs bar bshams la/ las byang gzhug bsrang tshom bu mdun bskyed du sgrub cing bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/ gnyis pa bum pa sda gon ni/ gser la sogs pa'i bum pa rnal 'byor pa'i rab snyim pa bco brgyad shong ba/ tha ma bre gang las mi chung ba mtshan nyid tshab rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bkod pa lha grangs sam/

dgu lnga'am/ yang na lha bum gcig dang*/ las thams cad bcas bum pa gnyis gu gul bdug yungs thun brab cing bgegs bskrad/ khye'u pho mos blang ba'i rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang 'o ma bsras pa lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang dam rdzas khyed par can rnams bslug /ā+oṃ bhūṃ trāṃ hrī āḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe sid+dhiḥgar pa ta niḥ pañca shu len dha riḥbadz+ra klag sha sra tiḥ.ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ: zhes rims par blug rjes 'bras bu can gyi shing dang ku sha rma bya sogs kyi kha brgyan cing 'gul 'ching dang rigs lnga'i srog zhu bskon te bzhugs su gsol/ gatsho bum gyi stong du dri'i chu yag 'bru gsum gyi sngags pa'i dung chos dang*/ gzung thag rdo rje bzhag cing sngar gyi mchod gtor rnams gsos la/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yengs su tshang ba yangs shing rgya che ba gnyis las/ rnam rgyal 'ub pa'i nang du khrag 'thung rdo rje phur pa'i (187) gzhan yas khang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par gsal ba'i dbus su/ dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi nas las byang bzhin rdzogs par gsal bar gyur bar dang*/ las bugyi nang du pad nyi'i gdan la hūṃlas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang nag g.yas rgya graṃ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan cing zhabs gnyis brkyang bskul gyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ de ltar lha tshogs thams cad kyi sogs spyan 'dren nas/ bstod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin dang/ gzungs thag drangs la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng gzungs thag la brgyud de song*/ bum nag gi lha'i thugs kar phogs su thugs brgyud bskul te thugs srogs dang byor mtshams sku'i cha rnams las bdud rtsi rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur pas bsam la bzlas pa ci rigs dang*/ las bum la dmigs te/

ā+oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces bzla zhing*/ lha rnams chags pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems ro gcig tu gyur par sabasam la dung chos kyi dri 'bru gsum gyis bum pa rnams su dbul zhing*/ las bum la khro ba'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pas 'dir bsgrub pa chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gegs rnams bsrung ba dang bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig zhes 'phrin las bcol mtshan ma'i lha dang bcas pa'i bum pa rnams slar mchod pa dang bcas dben par bzhugs rgyu dang*/ sgrub pa rkyang bar bum pa mi dgus par bzhed kyang*/ 'dir dongs grub kyi rdzas su dbang mi spro yang bum pa 'god pa byag len no/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni dbang dang 'brel na 'di bya ba dang chog ltar dang*/ slar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod zhing*/ sta gon la gnas par gsol ba dgaza pa ni/ dpon slob rnams dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas spos dang bcas la mo sbyar te/ ho rdo rje dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ thugs rje 'i brtse bas nyer dgos nas/ byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lag gsum gyi snyan gsan dbab pas de rnams kyi legs so zhes bya ba byin par bsam la/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo rtse sprad pa pyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ badzod tiṣ+ṭha sta gon gyi lha rnams stong gi bar snang la 'od lnga'i dra bar bzhugs par gyur ces dkyil 'khor btogs la nam mkha' dgod tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu zhing bum pa dpen par bzhug go gsum pa dkyil 'khor bzheng ba la thig gdab pa/ tshon gyi ba phur bu dgod pa/ rgyan rdzas dgri pa bzhi las/ dang po thig gdab pa la gnyis kyi dang po/ (188) ye thig ni/ rgyus chen nam kha dog lnga ba'i srad bu nyid bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ kha dog lnga las khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ chos sku nam mkhas bstod/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas thig skud la thim par gyur pas bsam/ slob dpon mtsho bor gsal ba stegs bu'i nub dang*/ thig g.yogs 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar gsal ba'i shar du 'khod par thig sna gted rdo rje'i glus bskul ba ni/ hūṃ rdo rje'i rang bzhan khros pas zhe sdang gcod: chos dbyings skye med stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang 'byung srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang : dbang dang dongs grub ma lus rtsol ba'i phyir/ thugs dam dbyings nas gnas 'dir byin chen phob: kī la ya yi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ badz+ra pa ma ya s+t+wam: zhes bskul/ yum gyi mkha' klong du yab kyi byang sems mkha' mnyam gyi thig ler 'dres te/ rang byung gzhal yas khang du lhun gyis grub par blatas la 'di skad do/ hūṃ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: rang byung ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha: mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ji bzhin du: rang byung lhun gyi grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal: zhes tshangs thig dang po'og nas gyen du lan gsum gdab cing*/ spro ni thig bskor gyis 'debs gnyis pa las thig ni/ thig chal gyis sbags pa'i skud pa brkyangs te/ hūṃḥ mtshan ldan bkris dge ba'i yum: gzugs mdzes yid 'ong lha mo'i tshul: mnyen lcugs 'khril nas dbyer mi phyed5 rdo rje las kyi don 'grub ma: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gsang ba rdo rje'i thig gdab mdzod: ces las thig sngon du btab zin na tshangs thig stong gdab cing*/ ma zin na dkyil 'khor gzhir gzhung bzhin gdab dgos lag len 'di ltar bya ste/ shar nub tshangs thig dang po btab/ lte ba nas ni shar ngos su/ dkyil 'khor dang nyam sgo tshad brgyad/ gcig shes ngos su bzhi brgyad bris/ ngos gnyis bzhi tshad bya rjes bya/ de stong lho byang tshangs thig btab/ de la logs gnyis bzhi tshad bri/

bzhi tshad bzhi las bya rog rjes/ mtshams bzhir bri zhing thig gnyis gdab/ zur gyi thig ni rnam par dag /shar nub tshangs pa'i brgyad rtse nas/ brgyad tshad zur thig stong du bya/ ngos bzhi btab pa brtsug phyi/ logs gsum gtub cig rgya graṃ steng : rim bzhin thig btab brtsug bgyur/ lnga ba'i dpus dor mtha' gnyis bcad*/ drug pa'i phyed gdab phyi ma bgo/ grub bzhir sbrol ba rtsigs pa dang*/ stegs bu pha gra dra phyed dang*/ shar bu mda' yab rnams kyi thig: mda' phyir sgo tshad bdun pa dang*/ brgyad pa gnyis ni bzhi bzhir bgo/ rta babs snam bu brgyad (189) yin no/ de phyir sgo tshad gcig bcad pa'i/ de yi dubs dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs kyi gnas/ gyen thig rtsa nas bzung ste/ rta babs steng gi phyi thig bar/ tshangs las g.yas g.yon cha chen re'i*/ phyed gdab khyi la phyed gdab pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud sgra 'graṃ thig: de phyi che chen re re ni/ cha mazhir bgos pa sgo logs dang*/ mun pa ka ba ka rgyan thig: 'di ru rta babs snam brgyad la/ ka brgyan phyir ru cha phran bsnan/ rta babs zheng tshad phyi nas ni/ rta rkang ka brgyan mtham dang mnyam*/ chu skyes dang ni sgrol bu gnyis/ de las cha phran gcig gis ring/ zar tshags de la gnyis kyi thung*/ rna 'phyong de las gcig gis ring*/ chun 'phyang de las gnyis kyi thung*/ shar bu de las gcig gis ring*/ shar bu de las gcig gis ring*/ de las khyung mgo gcig gis 'phyong*/ pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs gsum po/ rgya tshad cha phran gnyis re ste/ pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon cha phran phyed/ dor bar ri dwags re re bri/ glang rgya mig gsum bskor tshul ni/ snab ba gsum pa'i phyi thig dang*/ tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas bzung ste/ cha phran gnyis kyi dbus ma bskor/ mun pa pa ti'i phyi thig dang*/ tshangs thig 'dzom pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ cha phran gnyir re phyi pa nas/ cha gnyis gyi g.yas g.yon bskor/

de rnams phyi ru che bskor/ yang na 'khyogs dgu bya 'dod na/ snam bu dang po phyed dang bzhi/ gnyis pa gsum pa drug drug go /bzhi sa la ni bzhi yin te/ snam bu lnga pa cha phran gsum/ drug pa de nas tshangs rtser slob/ de rnams phyi ru phyed re bcad/ rdo rje rwa yi bskor tshul ni/ snam bu gsum pa'i phyi thig dang*/ tshangs phyir gnyis phyin 'dzoms pa nas/ bzung ste ka rgyan rtse nas bskor/ de nas phrod gnyis phyi ru gcig /phyi ste snga ma'i tshad des bskor/ dbus rwa rtsa ba'i rgya tshad du/ cha chen gcig yin mi mthong kyang*/ rim khra rtse mo cha phran gnyis/ pad 'khor gdugs kyi 'og tu bris/ rwa rtse'i phyi nas cha phrag gnyis/ gnyis bzhi gcig dang bzhis bskor ba/ pad ra dbang mo dur khrod dang*/ rdo ra me ri'i gnas yin no/ nang gi lha gnas bri tshul ni/ rtsa thig nang du chen re*/ dor mtshams grub zhir sbrel btab pa/ khyams dang gru chad thig tu 'gyur/ dbus nas sgo tshad gsum pa'i phyi phyogs/ yang na phyags spang pa'i rtsigs pa nang thig dang phyogs bzhi'i tshangs 'dzom nas mtshams bzhir sbril thig btab pa rtsibs bzhi rgya graṃ gyi thig dang rtsibs rtsi tshangs nas sgo mtshad gcig zluṃ bskor ti nang cha pha phran gcig /de nang gsum gsum de nang gcig de nang chos 'byung songs sngar bzhin bya kyang mi 'gal lo/ bzhi'i gru chad tshangs 'dzom nas/ mtshan bzhir thig btab grub bzhir 'byung*/ rtsibs bzhi rgya graṃ tshul gyi thig /rtsibs rtse tshangs nas sgo tshad gcig /zluṃ bskaur de nang cha phran gcig /gnyis gtis gcig bskor lte ba nas/ thod (190) 'phrong rtsibs bzhi rtsibs bcu dang*/ thod 'phreng phyi ma'i gnas rnams yin/ lte ba dag nas mu khyud kyi/ nang mar mu khyud brtsal nas ni/ phyogs gsum btab pas gru gsum mo/ de nang zla gaṃ sgo gcig ni/ mdun du bstan pa lugs 'dir bzhed/ 'on kyang mthong brgyud gnad shes bya/

zhes zhib mo'i bla yis gdab cing*/ de nas srad bu cho ga bzhin mchod cing bstod nas ye shes kyi thig badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ las thig dben par bzhugs so/ gnyis pa tshoran bkye ba ni/ tshon snang lnga rin po che'i snod so sor bslug ste kha dog dang mthun par/ hūṃ ā+oṃ swā hāḥ rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pa dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs lhar bskyed de bstod pa'i bar thig gi skabs bzhin byas la/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i rdul phra bar tu gyur par bsam la/ sa bon lnga brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas slob dpon gyis shar nas re kha drangs shing*/ hūṃ phrid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya: phyogs mtshams ye shes lnga dang ldan/ ye shes gsang ba'i thigs bkye'o: bh+ruṃ saṃ tri ta dz+nyā tra ya bh+ruṃ: zhes bris te de nas tshog gyi rim pa ni/ dbus kyi zla gaṃ sgo gcig dmar/ glu gsum mthing nag zla gaṃ dmar/ thod 'phreng dkar la gzhi ma nag /rtsibs bzhi shar sngo lho ser po/ nub dmar byang lngangs mtshan dmar smug /rtsabs bcu mthing nag mtshan dmar po/ thod rwa dkar la gzhi ma mthing*/ rgya graṃ rtsibs bzhi phyogs kyi mdog /gru chad ljang gu khyams phyogs mdog rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhan/ mthing dpar ser dmar lngang gu dang*/ 'dod rnam dmar la pha khu ser/ dra ba'i gzhi nag dra phyed dkar/ sharab bu'i gzhi sngo shar bu dkar/ pu shu dkar po mchod rten ris/ mun pa pa ti glang rgyab nag /ka ba phyogs mdogs rgyan mdzes tshon/ rta babs brgyad ni go rim bzhin/ rta rkang gzhi nga rdo rjeser/ chu skyes dmar la sgrom mdzes tshon/ zar tshags dkar la gzhi ma nag /rna 'phyong ser po pha gu 'dra/ chun 'phyang dkar la gzhi ma nag /shar bu dkar la gzhi ba sngo/ rgya phub khyung mgo mthing ga'o/ pad+ma dmar la 'gor lo dang*/ ri dwags gser mdog gdugs dpar po/

sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog khyams ljang pad+ma sna tshogs dang*/ dbang mo'i gnas ni khrag mtsho dang*/ dur khrad gzhi sngo spyi ltar dang*/ r+ho dwa ser la gzhi ma mthing*/ me ri sna tshogs chos 'khor ro/ lha gnas rnams su mtshan ma ni/ sku gzugs yig 'bru phyag mtshan ni*/ ma grub lha yi sku mdog dang*/ mthun pa'i tshon sprung bkod par bya/ grwa bzhir gter gyi bus pa ni/ dpag bsam kha rgyan mdzes par bri/ zhes 'dir spyir btang bkod mod zhib pa bzhung dang gzhal yas (191) don bstod dkyil 'khor rnam dag sogs zhib mo'i blo yis brtags nas mthong brgyud phyag bzhes bzhin ma 'chugs pa gal che/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis legs par gzigs nas dril bu 'khrol zhing lag gsum bkor te yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nam mkha'i ye thig gi lha dkyil 'khor la bstim mo/ de yang rab rdul tshon 'bring ras bris su bshad pa na/ ras bris la brten pa'i tshe thig tshon rnams der la sngar lha ston gyi tshom bu bsdu 'phral ras bris tshad ldan 'god pa nyid do/ tshon lhag sngar thig gi skabs ltar ye shes pa gshegs pa pa sogs bya/ gsum pa phur bu dgod pa la bzhi las/ dang po 'du bya ba ni/ phur pa'i rgyu thog lcags sam gri lcags/ yang na seng ldeng dam dug shing tsher ma can gyi shing mgo mjug ma log par gatsho bo la sor bco brgyad zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje'i gshegs pa can/ khro bcu la sor bcu drug zhal gsum rgya mdud can za gson rnams mtho re zhal gcig/ sras mchog ser bcu gnyis zhal sogs khro bcu ltar dang*/ 'phrin las bzhi sor brgyad de yang 'grub na zhi ba dngul lam 'o ma can gyi shing*/ rgyas pa gser ram ser po'i shing*/ dbang zangs sam tsan dan dmaro po'i shing*/ drag po lcags sam drag po'i shing la bya zhing/ sgo ma man chad 'khor rnams kyang sor brgyad pa dang*/ de rnams kyang rgya mdud 'og ma khyed tshad kyi rgya mdud gnyis bar du 'chang bzung zur brgya/

chu bsrin gyi kha nas dbal zur gsum 'thon pa zur mgo gyen du skyes pa sbrul chun 'khril thabs kha yang ba ltar yod pa gatsho phur rnams 'gying bag brjed chags sku mdog lha so so dang mthun pa/ las phur rnams gsor 'phang bde ba sogs dgos pa bzhi pa sgrub khog len sogs la bltā+o/ de dag gi gtsug tu gdung ring bsrel dang*/ bsnyen pa them par byas pa'i yungs kar 'bru bdun re bzhugs/ dar sngo dmar gyi cod pagyen du 'phur ba/ rang rtags kyi snying pos mtshan pa/ rdzas dgus blud pa'i phur cha rnams slob dpon gyi mdun du bkod do/ gnyis pa ye shes dgug bstim gyi bar tu gnas pa ni/ spro zhing nus ba bgegs gtor btang zhing khrul gsol mdor bsdus bya/ phur bu rnams oṃ swā bhā was sbyangs/ phur pa rnams stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs su gsol ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ hūṃ skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: zhes pa nas sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs pas rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra pa pā wa ra pad+ma ka ma la ye swāṃ: zhes gdan 'bul/ a ti pu haḥ pra ti dza haḥ zhes dam tshigs pas ye shes pa la phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha swā hā+o/ sogs nyer spyod sngalas mchod

(192) ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya a wa sha ya a aḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par chu la chu bzhags pa ltar yar par bsam/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs shol ka dang*/ oṃ su sra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ gsum pa byug bdug brdogs gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed cing byin brlabs dbang bskur ni/ mi rta khyi gcan gzan gyi khrag re lcags/ spyang tshe/ re sho/ bse zho/ btsan dug sbyar te/ phur rtse dang zur la byug cing ngar btags/ gu gul dang tshil chen sbyar ba phur rtser bdud cing*/ hūṃ gu gul byin bskyed dgra bgegs gdug pa sgrol: yungs kar dpal bskyod rak+kas gzi mdang bskyed: mi bzad khro rgyal 'dus pa'i stobs dang ldan: gzi brjed dpal dang nus par ldan gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: su ru su ru pra ru pra su ru: a tiṣ+ṭha mugs mugs: ha la ha la dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tsit+ta myogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ yungs kar gyi brab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: ma gu ta la sra ta la bhi sha ti bha ra tsa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭ+wa: rak+ta phur rtser byugs la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: rak+ta dz+wa ma man+dha la rak+sha rak+sha: dgra bgegs pa sham ku ru mā ra ya phaṭ+waḥ ces brjod pas rdzas dud sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu'i gseb nas khro chung thog ltar babs pas bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar brlag rnam shes dbang du bsdus par bsam mo/ rdzas kyi phur pa ye she kyi lhar bsgrub pa/ phur pa sku gsung thugs khro rgyal yongs rdzogs su byin brlabs pa ni/ yag pa lbams te dar mthing nag gis bcing nag gi bcings pa lag tu thogs pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ: zhes lan gsum brjod pas chos skur byin gyis brlab pa'o/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum wal gyis gsal bar gyur*/ ces bskyed pa ni longs skur brlabs pa'o/

rgya mdud gong ma la khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ de'i zur brgyad la khra thabs nyi shu gsal ba thams cad bzhugs pa'i phrong dpal zur gsum pa sras mchog /dpal mthil gsum la bsrung ma dam can gyi tshogs rnams gsal bar gyur ces bskyed pa ni sprul skur brlab pa'o/ bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i lag g.yas kyi mthul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dubs su a dkar po/ g.yon nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su maṃ dmar po dang*/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sen gang pa rnams la rigs lnga yab lnga*/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sen gang pa rnams la rigs lnga yum lnga gsal bar gyur/ ces sbams phur 'dril zhing : muṃ lam maṃ saṃ taṃ: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya an dza li hoḥ ces brgya rtsa brgyad pas/ dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mga' gsang nas (193) byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las sras su phung pa'i lha tshogs rong gi 'khrungs pa'i sku stod zhal gsum phyag drug phyag drug smad me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ sras dang khra thabs dam can pho nya dang bcas pa skad cig gis byon te/ de 'dra ba'i ye shes sems can dpa' mang po thib thib byon nas gnyis su med par gyur pas bsam mo/ de nas sku gsung thugs sbyin gyis brlab pa ni/ sbal phur tshon skud lnga'i bcingangs pas 'dril ba'aṃ/ yang na dngul gzhon 'bru nag gi bkang bar matsug nas togs te/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las/ 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyings su bdag bskyed cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya badz+ra satwa ra tsa ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ces brjod pas/ phur pa las las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams la gnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ 'od zer tshul 'dus pa las thugs rjo'i byin brlabs thams cad phyi bor thim sku gzi brjod dang*/

ldan pas srid gsum mya ngan las 'das par sgrol nus par gyur par bsgom la/ dbang rtags su rgya mdud gong mar oṃ dkar bris pa'aṃ bsgom mo/ sor mo bsnom bar du sbal phur 'dril zhing*/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung : ngang nyid rdo rje'i= 'bar ba'i khro bo= gsung gi dbyings su= o badz+ra kī li kī la ya wak+ka badz+ra hūṃ āḥ zhes brjod pas/ phur pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams la gsung mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ 'od zer tshul 'dus pa las gsung gi byin brlabs thams cad phur pa la thim/ ljags rdo rje rgya graṃ gyi lte bar zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar pos mtshan pa'i mthar kī la ma 'bru dgus bskor bar gsung rdo rjer byin gyi brlabs khams gsum chos kyi dbyings su sgrol nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur pas bams la dbang rtags su rgya mdud gong maraḥdamar po bris sam bsgom mo/ sbam phur 'dril zhing hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs: ngang nyid= 'bar ba'i= thugs kyi dbyangs= oṃ badz+ra kī li ki lā ya tsit+ta badz+ra hri da la hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ ces brjod pas/ phur pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ 'od zer tshul 'dus pa las thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad phur pa la thim/ thugs rin po che mar gad gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su nyi zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan med rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs rin po che zur brgyad kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi ste du rdo rje mthing ga nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar hūṃ mthing yungs 'bru tsi gyi mthar kī lā ya ljang dmar sprus bris pa tsam gyis bskor bar gyur pa ra bsams la/ dbang rtags su rgya mdud kyi dkyil du hūṃ mthing bris sam bsgom mo/ de nas ye shes lngar byin gyis brlab pa ni/

hūṃ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro dod du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba'i: sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir rtsol cig: (194) phul pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa tshul 'dus/ phur pa'i spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka gsum du thim zhing*/ srang yang klad pa dung khang*/ dpral ba rna ldag g.yas g.yon/ ltag pa lngar 'dus nas thim pa/ dpal bo 'bru lngar gyur pa skad cig gis he ru ka rigs lngar gyur te ye shes lnga'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsams la/ ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shu n+ya ta ñjā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a dar sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pa man+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hā a dar sha dz+nyā sha badz+ra ko3haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā man+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kri te a nu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā warma ko3haṃ: zhes brjod pas/ rgyal ba thams cad thugs rje dang na pa byin rlabs thams cad phur pa la thim par gyur pas mos/ de nas thugs rje yongs rdzogs spyi sdom rdo rje rtse gcig dbang mchog tu bskor te/ sna srid 'khor 'das thams cad 'od du zhus nas dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor mtha' nas dbus su gdan khro/ gtso bo de yang ye shes sems dpa'/ de hūṃ de yang zla tshes thig le spros mde mtha' bral/ ma bcos rang g.yas chos sku thig le nyag gcig ngang la dar cig bzhag /ces don ngo bo de kho na nyid do/ bzhi sa phar bu 'god pa ni/ phur gdan lngags sam zha nye rdzas shing sogs gang yang rung ba grub gsum pa lding khri thogs gnyis pa'i 'og rul tshon nam ras bris kyi lha gnas so sor bkod la/

rnal 'byor pa rnams sngags chas dur khrod kyi chas gsol/ rtags gsum gdab/ spos dang sha chen bsreg /rol mo dang bcas phur pa rnams 'bru gzhong du sbams pa dar gyi mdo li btags pas dar lam la drangs sam/ las slob kyis rim par drangs pa dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor zhing*/ hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang dang dongs brug blang ba'i phyir: skye med chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ da pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dpal: chos nyid sku ma rol ba'i ngang : thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ ye shes khro bo gshegs nas ni: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : dongs grub ma lus rtsol ba'i phyir: 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: hūṃ dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yesha shes sku/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ yab yum gnyis su med pa yang*/ lha chen bsnol ba'i gdan stong du/ dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā (195) ya: sa ma ya a we sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ ces gtso phur dbus su zhal shar du bstan the bzhugs su gsol/ sras mchog 'god tshig 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyis 'thus mod kyang rigs bzhi 'god tshig spro na/ hūṃ shar nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya/ lho nas rang byung = sras mchog rat+na kī= nub nas= sras mchog pad+ma kī= byang nas rang byung = sras mchog karma kī= khro rgyal kī la rigs bzhi yang*/ dgra bgegs gnad la bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ badz+ra'i gnas su rat+na pad+ma karma bcug nas rim par 'god do/ de nas khro bcu rnams rim par/ steng nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/

hūṃ mdzad rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/ phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ tshangs pa pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du*/ dgyis shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ rang sngags mjug pa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes kun la sbyor zhing*/ shar nas= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= rnam rgyal rdo rje rnam bsnyoms bcas/ phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo/ dbang dang brgya byin= dgyes shing = rang sngags= me nas= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mor bcas/ phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo /dbang dang = me lha= dgyes shing brtan= lho nas= sangs rgya kun gyi= chos dbyings= gshen rje dur khrod bdag mor bcas/ phra men sha ba 'ug pa'am mgo /dbang dang = gshin rje= dgyes shing = lho nub= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= yi ga'o rdo rje gtun khung bcas= phra men gzigs dang khwa ta'i mgong dbang dang = srin po= dgyes shing= nub nas= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings rta mgrin rdo rje dbang sdud bcas/ phra men bye la shud mgo /dbang dang = chu lha= dgyes shing= rlung nas/ sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= gzhan gyi mi thub mda' bsnyems bcas/ phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo dbang dang = rlung lha= dgyes shing= byang nas= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= 'khyil pa rdo rje rlung 'byin bcas= phra men seng ge pha wang mgo /dbang dang = gnod byin= dgyes shing= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= khams gsum rnam rgyal gsod dmar bcas/ phra men dred dang sro mo'i mgo /dbang dang= dbang ldan= dgyes shing = 'og nas= sangs rgyas= chos dbyings= stobs chen rdo rje skyed byed bcas/ phra men don dang byi ba'i mgo dbang dang= sa bdag= dgyes shing= zhes rang rang gi rtsibs sam/ rat+na zur brgyad la bzhugs shing hūṃ kar shar stod dang*/ stobs chen nub rtsibs kyi nang khongs bkod/ de nas sras mchog nyer gcig yod na zla gam gsum la bdun bdun 'god cing*/ hūṃ sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i sras:

zla gaṃ e yi gdan la bzhugs: 'phrin las bzhi grub chad bzhir bkod la/ zhi rgyas dbang drag (196) 'phrin las sgrub: gru chad bzhi la brten par bzhugs: ga ma bzhi rtsibs bzhir 'god la/ tshad med rnam par sgo bzhir ru/ ye shes sgo skyong bsrung mar bzhugs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams su/ sho na bdag nyid pa bdag tshogs: bse lcags dung gi skyes bu rnams: bstan pa bsrung phyari bzhugs su gsol: phyi rom 'khor yug chen mo la: dbang phyug nyer brgyad brtan ma dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho:sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ dha ti na ma: shrī traṃ ka ra ye sa ma a we sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rang rang gdan la rim par bzhugs su gsol/ zhar byung bum sa sogs rdzas gzhan 'god pa ni sngar gyi bu pa spos rol dang bcas dkyil 'khor la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ hūṃ sradi pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang dongs grub blang pa'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang : pho brag gnas 'dari bzhugs su gsol: pho brag gnas 'dir bzhugs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus rtsal du gsol: badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes phur sgrom yod na de'i stong dang med na/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du khri'u'i stong gatsho bum dang*/ las bum slob dpon mdun ni gang 'os su bkod/ gzhan yang sku rten bris sku rab gnas can dang*/ gsung rten gser gyi sngags byang*/ thugs rten shon sher rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin bkod cing*/ dbang dang 'brel nas dbang gtor chen mo bris sku dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag mtshan tsakli sogs dbang gzhung las ji ltar byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnams ldeng khri'i steng ngam gang 'os su bzhug go/ bzhi pa rgyan rdzas dgra pa la gnyis las/ dang po bkod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi ste gyi steng bla bre dang gdugs phub cing khor yug rnams su lda ldi ba dan rgyal mtshan phya phur chun 'phyang sogs dang dpal gyi chos gos la sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyi bkod pas mdzes pa/
