mar me rgyun/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir gri bzhi/ zur bzhir mda' dar me long can bzhi/ grwa bzhir phan bzhi/ zur bzhari rgyal mtshan bzhi/ phyi rol du mda' brgyad/ tshon skud sna lnga'i dra ba/ dar dang stag shab gyi sgab skor/ sman gtor rak+ta mchod pa'i bye brag rnams kyang rim par bkod la/ hūṃ dur khrod g.yang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rgyal ba mchod cing dngos grub blang ba dang : dam can dgyes bskang 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bkod pa ni: bum pa bzang po lha yi gzhal yas khang : dam rdzas gtor chen mchod sprin rgyan dung che: sman raka gtor bcas rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang: gdugs dang bla re rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*/ mda' dar dri dang tshon skud dra bar 'brel: dar khams smad dkyis dur khrod rdzas mchog bkrim: mthun pa'i rdzas dang dgyes pa'i dkor cha sogs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor (197) 'di ru yongs rdzogs bkod: ces rim gyis bgod cing*/ de yang shar du bla ma'i phyi gtor/ lhor yi dam 'di nyid kyi gtor ma/ nub tu mkha' 'gro spyi gtor*/ byang du 'di nyid kyi bka' bsrung gtor bsrung gi gtor sprungs/ shar lhor no na'i gtor ma gcan gzan sna tshogs kyi sha las bya pa/ lho nub tu sems mo'i gtor ma zhal 'og ma sbrang rtse las byas pa/ nub byang du ging gi gtor ma she khrag las byas pa/ mda' rgod sgro mar dar zab spyan gzigs kyi brgyan pa dang*/ byang shar du re ti'i gtor ma nal bu'i sha khrag gis brgyan zhing rma bya'i gdugs phub pa/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas/ dbus su tshe 'brang*/ bar bar du rgyun gtor 'phral gtor/ shar du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ lhor 'dod yon lnga rin po che sna bdun bkris kyi rtags rdzas brgyad/ nub tu gsang mchod sman raka bskang gtor*/ byang du khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog/

sha chen 'dre 'jigs kyis spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ rus pa sogs kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs kyi rol mo dang*/ baṃ dang tshogs kyi yo byad/ lho nub tu drag po'i 'brub khung liṅka thun rdzas/ byang shar du bsregs 'phang mnan pa'i yo byad sogs gzhung ltar dgos pas 'dir sa bcad du smos kyi dongs 'og tu bshad pa bzhin bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rdzas dang*/ dhor dril cang te'u rnga dang sil sbub rkang gling sogs rol mo'i khyad par dang*/ gi chas sogs mdor na 'dir gos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'dus bya'o/ gtor ma de tsam mi spro na gong gi bla ma mgro'i spyi gtor dang*/ mtshams bzhi'i bka' srung gtor ma byang gi gtor sprung la bsdus nas nub byang du bkod cing*/ las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas dang tshe 'brang sogs shar lhor 'god pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams sngar bzhin byas kyang chad skyon med do/ des dag legs par 'god tshar ba'i rjes su/ gnyis pa gzhal yas don bstod bya ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams sngags chas su zhugs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ hūṃ bcom ldan bde gshegs yongs rdzogs phur pa'i lha: rab 'jigs khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor ni: chos kyi dbyings las rab byung pho brang shar: stong pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' mthing nag e: stobs chen 'debs byed ljang nag bla zla gaṃ yaṃ: 'dod chags rnam dag kun gsal dmar nag ra: rang brten mi'agyur ma dag yi ge sum: 'gor ba bags byed ye shes dmar ser raṃ: mi 'gyur sra mkhrog rdo rje ri bar kaṃ: 'byung ba lnga rdzogs gzhal yangs phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang kun gsal yongs rdzogs bh+ruṃ las grub: dkyil 'khor rnam dag gru gsum mthing nag e: sku gsum zla gaṃ dmar dang thod 'phring bskor: ye shes rnam dag zla gi sgo gcig gsal: sa lam yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor rtsabs bcu ldan:

(198) bkod pa'i khyad 'phags gzhal yangs phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje'i rtsal spros bral mu khyud mdzes: yon tan ma 'gags rin chen zur bgyad mdzes: tshad med bzhi ldan gru chad rnam bzhir spras: bdud 'joms ka bzhi chu srin ka gdan gting : lha brgyad ka ba gzang brgyad gdung du bres: thugs rjes phyag gdal ru tra'i lpags thogs phub: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thod pa rim gsum brtsigs: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rang rtsal gzor gyis gtams: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gzhal yangs phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes bzhi ldan zang thal nang sgo bzhi: chags pa'i thugs rjes rak+ta'i zhaṃ chu gtams: mi 'gyur don ldan tsit+ta'i pho longs brgyan: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bar 'khyis khor 'ug gdal: yid bzhin re skong rtsig pa rnam lngas brtsegs: rang bzhin rnam dag gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bston: rnam thar brgyad ldan them skas rim gsum brtsegs: thugs rje'i rang rtsal chu srin pa them mdzes: gdug pa 'dul phyir rus sbal ma them brjod: gdug pa tshar gcod sbrul nag sgyed bu btsug: 'khor ba rgyun gcod zhing spags sgo logs gcod: chos kyi ghag+dhe cong dang dril bu bsgrags: rig rtsal ma 'gags sgo khang phyogs bzhir shar: yul brgyad dag klu brgyad ka gdan steng : tshogs brgyan rnam dag lha brgyad ka ba bcug: gza' brgyad ka gzhug rgyu skra dral du bkraṃ: rtog med ru tri'i spags thog thang mar brdal: longs spyod rab rdzogs gzhal yangs phyag 'tshal bstod/ thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i skra khung gsal: dri med rnam dag chos sku'i bum pa zluṃ: 'gyur med yongs rdzogs bre bzang rab tu brten: sa lam yongs rdzogs chos 'khor bcu gsum brtsegs: kun bzang theg pa'i yang rtser gdugs tog brngams: bstan pa'i rgya mtshan dar gyi bya ru btsug: chos kyi sgo khang tshad med rta babs mdzes: chags bra bre buṃ chos 'khor gdugs tog spra: dbyings rig dbyer med sprin nag drib so gtib:

ring rig rang gsal sgo khang rgyan dgus spras: yongs spyod rab rdzogs 'dod khyams khor yug bskor: drimed rnam dag mu tig thod rabs spras: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs shel gyi mchod rten bsgrigs: 'od gsal rnam dag mchog phran dar bu bkod: ma rigs mun sel bcu gcig rdo rje'i gseng : thabs kyi mun sel zla khyed rdo rjes brgyan: 'khor ba'i g.yul rgyal zhing chen phan brgyad btsug: yon tan yongs rdzogs gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan rab rdzogs dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor: skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i khor yug spras: gnyen pos mi shig rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes me ltar 'bar: dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter bum dpal bsam spras: khams gsum zil gnon rgya graṃ rwa bzhi mnan: khyi gsal nag gsal ye shes 'od lnga'i klong: ma bcos lhun 'grub sgu gsum dag pa'i (199) zhing: gdod nas rnam dag rang bzhin lhun gyi grub: ngo mtshar gzhal yas mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ yon tan yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs bkod pa'i sprin phung ni: khro rgyal 'ongs rdzogs phur ba'i dkyil 'khor bkraṃ: rin chen bum pa dngos grub gter chen dang : bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta'i dkyil 'khor dang : rdo rje dri bu rnga dung rkang gling dang : mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dod yon dpag med tshogs: pho brag gnas 'dir sprin phung bzhin du bkod: ma rigs mun sel snag gsal mar med dang : shes rab ral gri bzhi dang rgyal mtshan dang : mda' brgyad rwa ba tshon sku dra bas bskor: cis skyang mi shig 'jigs med rdo rje'i gur: mda' dar me long dar khang rim par ldan: gdug dang chod paṇa mchod pa'i lha dang*/ dung khrod brgyad dang stag sham sgal skor byas: thams cad yongs rdzogs lhun gyis grub par gsol: sku gsum yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal bstod:

ces bskor zhing : 'og min dang rnam dag sdug po bkod pa sogs rgyal ba'i zhing bar 'byams nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros nas byin dbab gnyis su med par bsgom mo/ bzhi pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug la/ bgegs bskrad/ gral bsham/ 'jug pa/ spyan dbye/ bsra mnan/ skos byang*/ rtags gdab bdun las/ dang po bgegs bskrad pa ni/ mched lcam rnams sgo phyir 'dus nas chad pa gzhung du med kyang phyag len bzhin spros pa la mos na sgo ba ba gi chen zhu lan 'don pa gzhan nas byung ba bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyi nang nas cha gsum btang zhing bka' bsgo ba ni: hūṃ nyan cig gegs dang lag 'dren tshogs: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' la ni: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams 'da' byed pa: khro chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: khro chen 'bar ba'i dkyil mkhor nas: khro chung 'bar bas mtshan cha'i char: me ltar 'bar zhing rlung ltar 'tshub: bka' 'das rdul phran bzhin du brlag: de bas ma 'dug phyir dngos shig: hūṃ bzhi'i sham bur/ badz+ra badz+ra da ha da ha: sa tsa pa tsa: ha na ha na: u tsa ta ya phaṭ+wa: ces brjod cing thun brab: spra na khro 'bag gi chas can gyis tshim rngams bya zhing : sgo dbye thun dang me chus badhog/ las busam gyi chus khrus dang bcas nang du tshogs/ gnyis pa gral bsham pa ni: gsar rnying thams cad yol ba'i phyi khral la 'dug nas mo tog bkya bsdu bya zhing : mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma yi dam mkhro'i lha tshogs rnams sprin gyi phung po ltar bzhugs par mos la/ ji rnyed su dag dang nag gi yin lag bdun pa gang shes bya zhing : spro na sngon 'gro thun mong gi chos bzhi bshad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bka' byung tshul bshad pa so sogs gnas dus dang sbyar ba las mi chad skyon du 'gro ba ma yin no/ gsum par 'jug pa gsol ba btab pa ni: hūṃ dam tshig tshul sdon pa: bdag nyid chen po'i tshul ston pa: bdag nyid chen po de nyid mkhyen: (200) srog gi phyir yang dam bsrung na:

dkyil 'khor gnyen por 'jug tu gsol: ces lan gsum zhu zhing bla mas sngon las tshogasaganyis mthar son pa'i: rgyal ba'i sras su 'os lags sam: rgyud ngan logs pa'i blo can ni: 'jug pa'i skabs med phyir dngos shig: ces pa'i lan du rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin bsgrub bo: bgyid do: las dang bskal bar ldan lags so: zhes zhu/ slob dpon gyis: de ltar yin na 'ongs so: rung ngo : legs so: zhes gnang ba sbyin no: bzhi pa spyan dbye ba ni: mig dar bcas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo yol ba'i phyi nas phyag gsum 'tshal te thal mo 'phring ba'i me tog dor tshul gyis bum steg tu bzhag: las slob skyi rdo rje'i 'phrang la khyid de dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor nas/ hoḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i rigs can rnams: byang chub rdo rje'i lam la drangs: rdo rje rgyal po nyid la gtad: nam mkha' rdo rje deng bdag rtsol: ces rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag tu gtad do: rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ kyai mi shes dri med rnam bral ba: ye shes mig gcig dri ma med: dag pa gsum ldan ye shes spyan: drib bral donag gyi spyan dbye'o: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭ+waḥ ces rdo rjes spyan dbye tshul gyis gral la 'khod do: lngapa bsre bsnan ni: slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi kā pa la las byang bzhin byin gyis cing thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod/ sgrub po rnams kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra mtshon gang pa gsal bar bskyed/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi gsar pa rnams kyi lce la bzhag nas/ hūṃ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: nam yang 'da' bar mi bya ste: nyams na na rag spyod par 'gyur: de phyir tshul 'di yang dag bsrung: sa ma ya rak+ṣu si hūṃ: zhes sbyin pas/ slob mas lan du/ sa ma ya i dan du ra kan: ces khas blang*/ bdud rtse myang pas snying kha'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim nas dbyer med du gyur pas bsam:

'dres zin bsnam pa ni/ gsar rnyeng thams cad rtsi myang zhing : hūṃ gsang ba las kyang chos gsang ba'i: bla med kyil 'khor chen po 'dir: rdo rje mched lcam sprun gros rnams: dus 'dari lha spyod dam bsres nas: nam yang mi 'bras rdo rje'i mchod: srog gi phyi yang dam bsrung ngo : kā ya sid+dhi ā+oṃ: wak+ka sid+dhi ā: wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ: sa ma ya hūṃ: zhes dam bsre zhing*/ deng phyin chad mched gsar rnyeng thams cad skal ba mnyam zhing dam tshig gcig tu 'dus pa yin pas dam tshig gzhung bzhin du bsrung bar gyis shig/ ces bsgo/ drug pa gral sgos gnyer byang bya ba na: rdo rje rgyal po yab yum zhal lar du bstan rgyal thebs 'phris sogs 'og gi 'don cha dang mtshungs par g.yas sgor ram gral legs par byas te/ chang skyor rim par drags shing*/ hūṃ rdo rje rgyal po tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag: shes rab yum mchog gatsho mo'i thugs dam bskangs: (201) sras mchog rgyal thebs karma mtsham bar bcas: ging dang las mkhan spyan ma dul 'dzin dang : badha' sbyor phyag bzang rul phyag skyes bu'i tshogs: kun kyang pho brang dkyil 'khor gnas 'di ru: 'phris mnga' brnyes bskos ba'i don spyod bgrub:skye ba sngon nam tshogasaganyis las sbyangs pas: dus 'dar rlabs chen spyod pa'i lam la zin: 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal rnams la mnga' gsol lo: zhes rim par dring ngos/ bdun pa rtams gdab pa ni: rnal 'byor pa rnams thal chen gyis nya bsul smin mtshims dang*/ zhag gi zo ris os gong brang*/ rak+kas dpral ba mkhyur tshos og ma dang 'bur bzhir gdab/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: ma hā ra smi ta ma hī keng ni ri ti: ma hā rak+ta hūṃ zhes dur khrod kyi chas rnams kyang rim par: hūṃ zhes sdang 'dzoms mdzad sbrul po dang*/ 'khor ba'i bcud len zhig zor ris dang*/ chags pa dbang sdud rak+ta'i thig lo sogs/ dur khrod gsang ba'i rdzas mchog 'di rnams kyis/

rnal 'byor rnams kyi sku la mtshan par bya/ zhes bya zhing*/ de ni dpal gyi sras su gyur te mkhro ging gi skyob cing rjes 'dzin pa yin/ lnga pa lha skos la gdab cing byin dbab pa gnyis las dang po skos gdab ni/ rnal 'byor pa chas dang ldan pas pad bskor bcas bskor cing*/ hūṃ chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: 'gro ba'i don dug thugs rje thugs sprul pa'i sku: dbus kyi khyogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs: hūṃ stong phyogs rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: hūṃ kar sgra 'byin yum sras 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs: shar phyogs rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: rnam rgyal snyems ma yab yum sras 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas sogs 'gro'o/ lho phyogs rin chen dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: gshin ni ngur khrod yab yum sras 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings= nub phyogs pad+ma dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: rtag mgrin gtum mo yab yum sras 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas= byang phyogs las kyi dbyings kyi= bdud rtse rlung 'byin yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= shar lha bde chen dbyings kyis= dbyug sngon sdor mo yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= lho nu bdag drag rol pa'i= mi g.yo gtun khung yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= nub byang 'jigs byed 'dul bya'i= 'dod rgyal bsnyems ma yaya yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= byang na 'phros rdzogs pa'i dkyil dkyil= khams gsum gsod byad yab yum= chos kyi dbyings= (202) 'og phyogs gdug pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor= stobs chen ma yab yum sras 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas 'dari gshegs gdan la bzhugs: sras dang sprul pa sgo skyong pho nya'i tshogs/ chos dbyings rol pa chen po'i kling dkyali nas:

ma 'gag thugs rje'i rang rtsal sna tshogs ston: dbyings nas sku bzhengs gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: zhes skos gdab cing sngar sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar btegs pa rnams sgrub rdzas mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor la bstim zhing bsre ba'o/ gnyis pa dkyali 'khor byin dbab pa ni/ sgrub pa po rnams rgyan dang chos kyi bdar nas/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra sgrog cing tshil cheg gul bsreg /rkang gling 'bud/ dar nag lcang lo mi spags kyis g.yab cing dad pa mchog tu bskyed la/ bla ma rig 'dzin lha dang mkhro dam can thams cad man mkha' la sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gis sprin bzhin du 'thib nas dkyil 'khor nasag dang rnal 'byor pa rnams la byin chen 'bebs shing thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs par gyur dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hūṃ dbus phyogs 'og min chos dbyings nas: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang : yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig /phyogs bcu dregs pa'i gdan stong nas: khro rgyal yab yum phra men bcas: sras dang sprul 'khor thams cad kyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: zla gaṃ e yi dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs las sprul ba'i sras: mthu chen nyi shu rtsa gcig gis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phos cig: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi grub chad nas: mthu dang drag rtsal bsam mi khyab: 'phris rnams bzhi sgo skyong gis: dkyil 'khor 'di la sogs/ dur khrod gnas dang phyogs mtshams nas: shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma: bse lcags dung gi skyes chen gyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig dur khrod g.ya' gangs dben gnas nas: ging chen bcob rgyad laṅka'i tshogs: dbang phyug brten ma 'khor bcas kyis: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin= bsgrub mchog rnams la dbang chen bskur: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po ston/ mchog dang mthun mongs dngos grub rtsol:

ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya: badz+ra sa ma ya sra we sha ya a a: zhes bag drog byin thig thib ma byang nang lan gsum bskyar ro/ drung pa sgrub mchod la/ sgru cing mchod pa: bar chad bzlog pa/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brten pa gsum las: dang po sgrub mchod las/ dang po sgrub mchod la/ de yang dus bzhir las byang gzhung bsrang zhes pa'i don ni/ tho rangs snga dro dgongs dro dang bzhi'i: yang ni nyin gsum mtshan gsum sti thun drug tu las byang gzhung bsrang zhing sngon 'gro dgu rnams thun gyi thog ma dang*/ tshogs mchod dus bzhi'i (203) gnyis bya dgos shing*/ thugs dam bskul phyin thun rjes mar byas pas 'thus la/ thun gzhan ma rnams la ting 'dzin gsum nas bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe rgyu'i hūṃ nyid bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su babs pa las dbag nyid gtso bor bskyed pa sogs 'dzab dgongs dang ldan mas thun re bzhin: gatsho bo la stong : khro bo bcu la brgya ro: sras mchog rnams la lnga bcu re/ 'khor dam can sems la nyer gcig re bzla zhing : bsnyen grogs kyis 'khor yug tu bzlas bya ba dang skabs su dbyangs kyi rta la sbyar te bzla: thun mtshams su stong tshigs kyi mchod pa ne/ hūṃ ye shes phur pa'i lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs: 'dzam khongs grangs thems sman gtor mchod tshogs 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon 'phris las rdzogs la bstod: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag bshags: rang sems dpang btsug bka' bzhin bsgrub lags na: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las ma lus rtsol: zhes mchod bstod bya zhing dngos grub blang : tshogs kyi tshe bskang ba'i mjug tu nyams chag bzlog phyir bskang bzlog bya ba ni/ mched rnams stang stab dor stab kyis sdang mig blta zhing*/ lag g.yas nam g.yon pa gnyis brdabs pa'i bar du dgra bgegs sgong spags bcag pa ltar lar bar blag par bsam zhing kha phyir bsgur la mo brdab:

hūṃ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: mthu rtsal can rnams dgongs su gsol: de ltar bskang bskang gsol gsol nas: da ni bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: rnam 'byor dbag cag 'khor bcas la: las kyi bdud g.yos phyir la bzlog las kyi sri langs phyir la bzlog: nye ba'i byol lto phyir la= sbod gtong rbad 'dre phyir: phur kha gtad khyam= khrag zer nad zor= bdud kyi khram kha= pha mtshan rgyal 'dre= dar tshan stong 'dre= gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor= ma mo'i dal yams= bun gyi rgyal kha= pa dbag gdug byed dgar+pal bzlog rgyal po'i smyau 'dre= gza' yi ki kang = mu stegs ngan sngags= the'u rang sri rkun= nad kha rims kha= lo kag zla kag= mo ngan rmis ltas ngan pa= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= ye 'gregs sum brgya drug cu= glo bur dgu bcu rtse gcig= dus min 'chi ba brgyad rnams= g.yas nas pho brgya'i mna' 'phen= g.yon sa mo brgya'i dug g.yos= ltas nag skye bo'i ya ka dgra la bzlog bran g.yon de dag tu bar chad kyi mtshan ma 'char na nyul le bskrad pa'i cho ga ste/ dam sri'i liṅga mnan dus lhu zhig la ming dang bsad

(204) mnan gyi spol tshig bris pa 'brub khung du bcug nas tshogs pa'i mdun nam byang shar du gzhag la dugs cing gzhug /drag sngags spru gri drag por brjod la phur thun gyis gzir zhing mthong bas bdur/ ging pa gtum brjid kyi chos su zhugs pa dalapayi phor nyar bskyed la lag na thun tshon mi spags kyi 'bris bong mje'i thogs pas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing tsho gral byang bar zhul bas brab cing brdig la dpal gyis pho nya bskul ba ni/ hūṃ shar phyogs pa dkor po dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog mar mo bse yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi zla zer ltar ltar 'phro: smin la glog 'khrug mun pa'i go skyabs 'byed: bu yug thogs 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug: bzhan pa he dang dpal gyi spru gyis gtams: rngams pa'i ljags 'drel bskal ba'i me chen 'bar: ag tshogs me 'bar bar 'byams srid pa bsreg: snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug sgra ldir re re: lag pa dmar po spru gri 'bul gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu 'i rtse la bskal me 'phro: ba spru rdo rje gnam lcags zhun ma 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chu'i char 'bebs: zhal gyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs: mi bzad gtum chen sha za khrag 'thung ma/ srin po dregs pa'i snying 'byin chang par 'dzin/ shin mi bzad 'bar ma'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: sku la na bza' spyin gyi yang bzhi gsol: s+ph+yogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong dregs pa mnan: bdud la babs na snying za bdud dpung 'jig: sri la babs na srog gcod sri 'phung 'jig: dgra la babs na g+dar rtsa drung nas gcod: bgegs la babs na rus pa rdul du zlog: dpal gyis pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po dag bgegs sogs: phung po dum gtubs la don snying gsol:

gru bu grum a pa tsa: rus sa tsi ri ra tsa ṇa thun thun: na sha s+t+waṃ bha yagasha byi na ya: phye ma phye ma: rul phran rul phran: tsit+ta rbad: ces bskul zhing thun gyar phab: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad pa rnams dus drug tu bya ba'i rjes su: tshim chen dang gu gul bdug: dar nag lcang mo mi spags kyi g.yab mo rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dang bcas las byang bzhin byin dab/ gung thun la 'og nas byung ba'i tshe 'gugs bya: dgongs thun cing rje rdo rgyal po sogs bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa skad cig kyang 'i gel ba gal che: gsum pa dongs grub gyi mtshan ma brtags pa ni 'di nyid kyi gzhung du rtogs par bya'o/ bdun pa dngos grub len pa la sgrub pa'i mtshan ma (205) dge bar mthong nas/ rang don du dngos grub blang ba dang*/ gzhan don du bdang bskur ba/ mthu mong mjug bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po dngos grubablang ba la sa bshams pa/ bgegs bskrad pa/ dongs grub bsdu ba'i bzlas pa/ gnad la dbab pa/ mchod cing dngos grub blang ba/ bsdu dang drug gi dang po rdzas bshams pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar la sogs par gzhi gtsang ma me togs gi sil ma bkram pa'i khar/ thod pa mtshan ldan du bdud rtse dza gad sbyar ba/ mngar gsum zhal zas sna tshogs spos dang sbyar ba dbus su rin chen 'byar ba phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas rim bus bskor ba/ mam sa mar 'thus bur sbyar bye shel rgun 'brum star sogs shing tog 'bras chan zas sna 'khur ba zho sogs bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag tshogs tshad dang*/ sngar bshams ma zin na tshar 'brong*/ tshe chang tshe ril dmar dar sogs bshams/ bsgrub pa sos rgyan dang chas gos bzang po bstar zhing dngos grub kyi gnas yid rtse gcig bya'o/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ skra dha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥ rang nyid sogs nas gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa nas bka' bsgo mtshams gcod las byas bzhi dang*/ dngos grub kyi sne sel du bre yi bar chad bzlog pa ni sngar gyi dam srida'i liṅka dang*/

gsar pa la'ang dam srid dgugs bstim drag tu byas te de bro brten du bzhag la mched rnams lu gu brgyud du sbrel nas/ hūṃ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: sogs las byang bzhin bre brdung byas la ling ro sbyin bsregs bya zhing thal ba lam rgya graṃ du mnan no: gsum pa dngos grub brdu ba'i dzas ni/ rol mo dang bcas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing byin phab pas gzi byin bskyed/ bdag nyid dpal chen po yab yum du gsang ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas zla bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i bu gar oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' gsang pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la e gru gsum du aṃ gis mtshan par bsams la yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ yum gyi dung khang na khrag 'thung rigs lnga gnas pa rnams bskur rnyogs par zhugs pas lab lnga'i byang sems mu tig lta bu: yum lnga'i dwangs ma mtshal lta bu rgyu ti nas byung*/ khams dkar dmar 'dres nas dngos grub kun gyi snying por 'khyil ba yi ge gsum du gyur pa bdag gi rdo rje'i bu gar rngub nas dbu ma'i nang brgyud dwangs ma'i thugs srogs hūṃ la thig pas bde stong 'dzin med rang byung gi ye shes 'bar: dngos grub rdzas kyi phung po chen po las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas: rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ mthing du gyur nas dngos grub kyi rdzas la yang yang thim par gyur pas bsam la dmigs pa nan tan bya zhing*/ lag g.yas 'phrong bgrang g.yon mthe'i chung dang mdzub mo bsgring : gong srin mtho bor gsum sbyar nas rte mgo'i tshul du byas la: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wak+ka sid+dhi ā/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ brgya stong (206) ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ zhar byung phyag len ltar tshe dzas bzla ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams thugs ka'i sngags 'phring las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlab dang*/

'byang ba bzhi'i bcud dang*/ skye gro'i tshe srog gi nus bcud thams cad bsdus nas rdzas la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ tshe bh+ruṃḥ yum bh+ruṃ: yum tshe bh+ruṃ: a yu dz+nyā na yu tshe bh+ruṃ: zhes ci nus bzla/ mda' dar g.yab cing : hūṃ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: mkhas dang mnyams pa'i sku mnga' bas: sku ni nam mkha' rdul dpag med/ sku mdog mar gsal 'od zer 'bar: longs spyod mtshan dpa'i rgyun rnams rdzogs/ phyag na tshe yi bum bsnams: yamu pa 'chi med tshe yis bkang*/ gsang ba yum mchog gos dkar 'khril: phyag g.yas tshe dam yab la 'khyud: g.yon sa tshe bu snyan du 'dzin: zhabs gtis yab kyi rkod la 'khril: yab yum phyag gi tshe bum dang*/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas/ tshe yi 'od zer 'phro 'dur gsal: bkrag dang mdangs kyi dpal du 'bar: phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud bsdus: bkris bum phyag gi tshe bum dang : phyogs bcu nam mkha' mthar thugs pa'i: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcu bsdus: bkris bu'i pa'i nang du dkyil: sgru mchog rnal 'byor bdag cig la: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur: skye shi med pa'i dngos grub rtsol: oṃ tshe bh+ruṃ g.yu bh+ruṃ: a yu bh+ruṃ tshe bh+ruṃ a bh+ruṃ a yu ñjā na tshe bh+raṃ: zhes tshe 'gugs bya'o: bzhi pa lha gnad la dbab pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu' 'phros pas rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams la phogs sngon gyi thugs dam bskul bas so so'i dam tshigs kyi dkyil 'khor la thim par gyur pa'i bsam kyi: hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs: dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs dongs grub tsal du gsol: kā pa la mtshan ldan du khrag chang mngar gsum sbyar ba bzod zhal bcas bshams: hūṃ zhes lan gcig 'phyar gas gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems chos sku bde ba por gyur:

hūṃ zhesha radag gnyis 'phyur bas snang srid bde ba chen po'i ye shes su+u gyur: hūṃ zhes lan gsum 'byarar bas bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang las gzugs skur bzhengs par gyur pas bsams la byin gyis brlabs nas: hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs nyams: dang po mchod 'os skyabs kyi yi dam lha/ bar du bskor sgrub dbag gi 'i dam lha: da lta bdag dang gnyis med chos kyi sku: dza gad rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ mchod (207) pa bzhes la dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: kī la ya'i mjug tu ma tā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: zhes dang bzod du lanag gsum phul bas dang sos lha tshogs rnams gsal btab/ gnyis pas rang gtso bo yab yum kyi mags las bdud rtse dmar po 'phros pas lha rnams mchod: gsum pas de dag gi dngos grub thams cad bdag la rtsal bar bsabar bsam zhing snying brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig bzlas la bskul ba ni: hūṃ lhag pa'i ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ rang bzhin dbyings nas rtsol rtog mi mnga' yang : sngon kyi thugs dam rang bzhin byin rlabs ni: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod kun 'byung ltar: dus la mi 'da' thug rje dbang gi lha: dus ma li gel g.yar dam gcig pa'i lha: mi zad rin chen gyan gyi 'khor lo las: mchog dang mthun mngo dngos grub ma lus pa/ sla ldan rnams la dus 'dir rtsal du gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: zad med nor gyi dngos grub= rgyud 'dzin srid gter las: mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ skal ldan rnams la dus 'dari rtsal du gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: zad med nor gyi dongs grub= rgyud 'dzin srid kyi= mi zad gter gyi= mngon shes rdzu 'phrul= 'phrin las rnam bzhi= phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngol grub rtsal du gsol: ces brjod 'don cha rgyas par mos ni bde 'dus kyi dngos grub bzul tshigs phur pa 'phris kyi/

hūṃ dbu kyi mthing nag grub gsum zhes pa nas: phur 'phris dngos grub rtsal du gsol: bar lnga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma nas 'khol 'don byas chosag pa'o/ drug pa dngos grub bsdu zhing bstim pa ni/ de ltar gsol bas dngos grub thams cad bdag gis thobs par bsam zhing*/ bzod zhal nas sman mchod byas la lhag ma nas mtheb srin gyis blang zhing : kī ya sid+dhi oṃ: wak+ka sid+dhi oṃ: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum dung bzhag la sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam: lhag ma khrag chag rnams phur bsrung gtor mar sbran cing : ka ti ka'i sngags mthar ma hā pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta la khā hi: zhes dang*/ hūṃ dgongs shig rdo rje phur pa'i lha: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: dpang gyur thams cad dgongs su gsol: dang po bsnyen cing bar du sgrub: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi las gzhung bsring : smi grol gnyis kyi rgyud kyang sbyangs: zhag dus grangs dang rtags kyang thom: deng sang skyang ring dang po shar: rdo rje na po'i nam langs nye: 'dod dgu'i dongs grub rin po che: da ni 'ayang ba'i dus la babs: rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas 'phris rdzogs mdzad nas: sku gsung thugs yon 'phris kyi: dbang dang dngos grub bdag la rtsol: lha dang skal ba mnyam par shog: ces dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams las phud dum re bcad nas lhag ma dngos grub tu myang zhing tshe rdzas rol ba sogs phyag len ltar ro: gnyis pa gzhan don dbang bskur bar mos dbang chog rgyas bsdus/ dbang dang ma 'al ba'i tshi bsken phur dang bum pa sgrub gathor rnams las dbang bzhi blang gnyis skabs sbyar (208) gzhan du shes so/ gsum pa mthun mong du mjug bsdu ba ni/ dngos grub kyis rdzas rnams cha lngar bgos te dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon snga rab rigs 'dzin mchod lcam rnams dang*/

cha gcig gnyis su byas te gzungs ma dang*/ bum gter blug rgyu bzhag cing 'bum tshig sogs spyod na bde 'dus grub khong nas 'gegs kyang 'thad sar sems shing*/ lha dang rigs 'dzin rnams la chung gnyis nyer spyod lo rim mo sogs kyis mchod cing : las byang gi sman mchod bya zhing dngos grub blang ba'i mjug tu las byang 'jug gi dngos grub blang ba hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin sogs kyi mthar pad bskor dang bcas: a la la ho: zhes dpon slob thams cad zhal zas logs spyad shis pa brjod cing smon lam gdab pa sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya: brgyad pa las la sbyar ba ni/ ngan sngags nye bar nyen pa ste dug phur gan so dang sbyar te bsad pa las drug bskor gzhung bzhin sngar smras pa ltar dkyal 'khor lho nub dang bya sharar du bsrog 'phang gnan pa sogs bcas la/ rgyas pa skabs 'dir nyams su len dgos kyang*/ bsdus par na lcags slang du drag po'i shig gi hoṃ gru bskor gzhung bzhin sngar nu'i lha tshogs su gsal bi zhal du 'bul bar bsams la liṅka drag sngags spru gris bsreg zer gtor las byang gi: hūṃ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu sogs phyir btog la/ rak+ta 'phyar zhing rkang gi gzar bus gtor spro na gzhung ltar sgrol ging : dbang phyug ma'i las mkhan gyi 'cham stabs sogs gsungs kyang ma 'byor rung 'gal ba med/ yang gsang spu gri'i sngags shaṃ du: hūṃ hūṃ sa rab lab dan tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭ+wa: bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭ+wa: gh+ri ṇa gh+ri ṇa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed dam sri hur thum ma ra ya rbad rbad bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ de ri ri bzlas la: hūṃ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu che: nga ni khro rgyal kan gyi gatsho: nga ni khro rgyal snying rje'i bdag: nga ni gshen rje kun gyi gshod: nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab: nga las che batshan su yang med:

bka' sdod pho nya yongs rdzogs rnams: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyir: dmag sna dgra bo'i yul du drongs: dam can dmag dpung nyi li li:mtshon rtse phur rtse rongs se rong : hūṃ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu che: nga ni khro rgyam kun gyi gtso: nga ni khro rgyal snying rje'i bdag: nga ni gshin rje kun gyi gshod: nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab: nga las tshe btsan su yang med: bka' sdod pho nya yongs rdzogs rnams: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor: dmag sna dgra bo'i yul du drongs: dam can dmag dasung nyi li li: mtshon rtse phur rtse rongs se rong: gtor zor rbab tu nyi li li: mtshe nyungs mda' dar shar ra ra: dug thun khrag rlangs chi li li: bsrung ma rngams stabs khyugs se khyug: ging rnams bshug pa de ri ri: ma mo'i hab sgra lhabs se lhab: dgra bgegs snying la gtor zor rgyob: nyams pa'i lnga phung rul du rlog: ces drag sngags brjod cing dgra phyogs su 'phang dmigs pas gzir: sngar gyi liṅga bsregs thal dang mnan rdzas sogs yod na/ sgo'i phyir dong grub gsum brus par mnan la ro g.yi rgya gra bris pas bkab: dmigs bya gshin rje'i

(209) btson khang du tshud pa'i seng du ri rab kyi mnan par bsams la bro brdung dang nang du log nas tshe 'gugs gzhung bzhin bya ba sogs rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi nyams len pa gcod len pa gcod du bris yod kyang : 'dir cig chod du kho bos bgyis pa'i gtor bzlog gis las rim gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog mda' nyid la mthong brgyud phyag bzhes kyi brgyan pa'i dkyus nyid zhag gsum lnga bdun sogs skabs sbyar nyams su blang na 'jug sa bde zhing 'dum che mchis so/ gzhan yang zhi la sogs pa'i 'phris rab 'byams gang gis sems can gang 'dul ba de dang de'i mos blo dang mtshams pa'i spyod pa la 'jug par bya'o: spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya bal/ gtor ma bgo zhing gtor sba ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ mtshams dgrol ba/ smon lam gdab pa/ bshags pa bya ba/ gtang rag 'bul ba/ mar me'i smon lam: lus bsrung go bgo gtor ma gtor ba/ gnas bsrung ba/ spyod lam bsten pa dang bcu gcig go: dang po gtor ma bog zhing gtor sba ba ni/ mchod gtor ma gtogs cha gsum du byas la gcig zhi ba'i sbyin bsregs gi rdzas su bya: cha gcig phyi rol gtor skyong gi rgyur bzhag cha gcig mi zad gter du sbal ste rin po cho'i lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang lhan cig tu dngos grub kyi rdzas dang*/ 'dod gsol smon lab bkris pa'i tshig gi shog dril bcug ra rin po che'i gter mi zad longs spyod du byin gyis brlabs/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir sgo dbye ste/ chos dbyings bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis: pa'i lha mo kha phyes shig: dbang chen yul lnga'i mkha' klong du: bsgrub pa las kyi gtor sbod do: khro rgyal yab yum thabs dang*/ yang sprul pho nya'i mkha' klong du: dam rdzas gtor ma'i gtor sbod deḥ mi zad mdzod kyi gter sbod de/ gter che na 'di yi byin rlabs kyis: rnal 'byor bdag cig 'khor dang bcas:

nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gtor chen khyed kyi byin rlabs kyis/ ye shes lnga la longs spyod cing : mi 'dzad mkha'i mdzod spyod shog: ye shes lha yi mdun bsus nas: bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar phyin shog: zhes pa steg yin lhau ngos dang khas sa sogs 'ogs zhogasapa zhig tu sbas pa'i shul du zhal ba bya zhing rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bri'o/ gnyis sa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ting nge 'dzin dang rdzas gnyis las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi bsdu ba ni/ 'grub nas rgyas pa dang zhi ba'i sbyon bsreg tshul bzhin ya zhing min kyang zhi ba tsim grub na bya: gtang rags gi don du mchod pa gsar pa'i kha gso/ mchod bstod bzod gsol bya zhing*/ badz+ra mu: rang bzhin ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs: rnam pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor rang thim ste hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad sogs las byang bzhin bya: gnyis sa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bsda ba ni/ rul tshon yin na chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don yid la byas ti a kā ro brjod bzhin par rdo rjes tshangs thig nas brtsams te (210) lte ba'i bar gyi rdul tshon rnams bsub cing*/ lha mtshan cung zad mgor bkod: lhag ma rnams bum par bslag cing thig dri bzang chus bsub/ lha tsaka sgrub phur sogs la me tog gathor zhing brten bzhugs bya: bum nag gi ye shes pa rdul tshon dang lhan cig gshegs gsol bya/ hūṃ mdzad yi phyag gyi dang ldan pas sum+bha ni brjod cing bu rnams dang por gdab por ba rig las phyogs bzlog tu phyung ste/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur rtse bkru zhing phur khung ya yang gtor/ dal gyi rgyan rdzas rnams kyang bsdu'o/ gsum la mtshams dgrol ba la sgo byang dang rgyal tho gnyis kyi dang po sgo byang bsdu ba ni/ mchod gtor rnams sngar bzhin bshams la byin gyis brlabs nas:

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sra tits+tsha swā hāḥ shap+tī bar gyis mchod cing bstod par 'os pas bstod/ so so'i rang sngags mjug i dam bha ling+ta khā hiḥ btags pa'i gtor ma 'bul zhing sku rten la brtan bzhugs byas te sgo byang bsdu'o/ gnyis pa rgyal tho bsdu ba la/ shar la sogs pa'i mtho'i rtsar mchod gtor bshams la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ bdud rtsir byin brlabs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ bstod 'os pas bstod/ oṃ dh+ri ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye swā hā: oṃ be tu ḍha kā ye swā hā: oṃ be ru pak+ṣa ye swā hā: oṃ bai shu wa ṇā ye swā hā: so sor yi dam bha ling+ta khā hiḥ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ thun mong du so sor/ kye hoḥ mgon po dam tshig dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyi sngon sten pa 'jig rten na zhal bzhugs pa chos kyi gdan chen po 'dzom ste/ thugs dam du bcas pa ltar deng bdag cag bsgrub pa'i mtshams kyi bar chad bsrung zhing sku drin chen po mdzad pa legs so: da ni rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas kyibastan pa rin po che la dgongs te blar yang 'byor par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥzhes tho bsdu'o/ sgo byang dang rgyal tho bsdu ba zor 'phang gi sngon der byas ba dang*/ sgo byang 'dir bsdu zhing rgyal tho gtor ma btag ba'i mjug der bsdu ba sogs yod kyang mtha' ma bkag pas gang byad rung ngo*/ skabs 'dir rul tshon gyi bum pa dpon slob thams cad bkris pa'i glu rol rnam par bkra ba'i bkur bstims chu klung 'gram du spyan 'dren cing shes na klu chog bya/ de nami klu rnams kyi mchod yul du spyan drangs par bsams la chu bor dor zhing*/ bum pa chus bka' la nang du 'ongs ste gnas khang phyi nang thams cad la gtor ro: bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni mchod rnams lang ste grol tshags rim pa gsum du sdoms te mgrin gcig tu/ skye hoḥ mi gnas ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du:

ma bcos lhun 'grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog: 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor rtag brtson par shog: bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje slob dpon (211) dang : lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i mchod lcam rnams: 'bral med dag pa'i zhing du 'tshobs par shog: bla med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ma thob bar: sa lam mthar phyin gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: sku gsum ye shes lnga la spyod par shog: ces smon lam gdab bo/ lnga pa mchod lcam rnams lta spyod gzhung bzhin la spyad pa'i bshags pa byas ba la/ rgal tshan gnyis su byas nas phan tshul bshags pa byed ros kyi tshul du/ hūṃ thams cad bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mched lcam rnams: bde bar gshegs pa'i slob mar lung mnos nas/ kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshag las: mnyam nyid don la legs nyes dbyer med kyang : lus ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshul tsam du: gzhung lam bsnyags shing thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: phyi nang dbye gsal med par mthol lo bshags: kun kyang mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i blo ldan pas: thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i klong yang nas: bzung dang 'dzin pa med par bzod bzhes nas/ nyes byas dag nas tshangs pa rtsal du gsol: ces mchod rnams gcig gis gcig la phyag bya zhing bzod gsol bya'o/ drung pa rdo rje slob dpon la bzod par gsol zhing gtang rag 'bul ba ni/ gos rnams bsdus nas dkyil 'khor dbus su khri brtsigs slob dpon bzhugs shing*/ na bzang dar gdugs sogs ldan par bya*/ rdo rje rgyas 'debs rig ma sogs kyis gser sman 'bru'i maṇ+ḍal thogs/ tshogs kyi 'brang rgyas dang dza gad bzang po phul/ mchod rnams thal sbra gus pa'i yid kyis/ hūṃ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis med matso:

rgyal ba'i sku mnga' gsung rab rgya mtsho ston: mnyam nyid thugs mkha' ye shes gsal ba'i ngang : thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro rnams bde la bkod: srid zhu chung bas thugs 'gal bzod par gsol: 'jig rten 'di na pha ma'i tshul du gnas: phyi ma'i lam sna thar pa'i zhing du 'dren: sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i sku drin can: thugs dang 'gal gyur thams cad bzod par gsol: zhes bzod par gsol: gtang rag gi sku drin gsol ba ni: lus ngag yin gsum gus pa dang bcas/ e ma hoḥ yang gsang bla men bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje phur pa'i sku gsung thugs thob phyir/ bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i tshogs gnyis gzhi bzung nas: sgrub chen zab mo gnang ba sku drin che: chos nyid mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa la: rang byung yi shes rtogs pa'i nyi ma shar: sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam rdzas sogs: dkyil 'khor phyi nang bstan pa bka' drin che: ma rig mun pa'i dbang du 'khyams pa la: 'khor lo rtsibs bcu zla gaṃ e ru gsol: ma rig mun dang shes bya'i sgrib gsal nas: chos sku rang la bstan pa bka' drin che: rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe ring ba dang*/ mchod dang lcams dral sgrub mchog gong du 'phel: dngos grub rnams gnyis gnang (212) ba bka' drin che: lho tshogs dgyes pa'i pañca a mṛ ta: zhal du bzhes nas dgyes pa bskyed pa dang : lha yi na bzang pa pañca lam ka 'bul: thugs rjes brtso bar dgongs pa sku 'dren che: zhes mchod lcam rnams langs ti dkyil 'khor bskor zhing*/ slar yang kye ho mi gnas ye shes dbyings kyi sogs gong bzhin smon lam gdab cing zhal skyems drangs: sku la na bzang gsol zhing gtang rag gi sku drin gso'o/ bdun pa ram me smon lam gdab pa ni/ rdo rje mchod lcam rnams lag tu mar me rang dang spos kyi reng bu re thogs la: hūṃ dur khro gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje slob dpon gnyin gyi dbu bzung nas:

rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mchod dang lcam dral rnams: nam zhig byang chub lum du zhugs pa'i tsho: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing ma rig mun pa'i gling du mi ltung shog: gcong rong zab mo'i nang du mi skye dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar nam yang mi skye zhing : gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi thos tshe: bag chags ngan pa'i nad ro mi ldang bar: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur: mtshon rnon gdug pa'i dbal gyis mi phog shog: dge ba'i bshes gnyain bkrin che ba dang : dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje mchod grogs rnams: thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i gzung ma gsum: tshe rabs 'das dang skye ba thams cad du: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: sa bcu khyad par rigs gyis bsgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe : gti mug mun pa'i gling du 'khyims gyur cing*/ 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen po lhung srid na: thugs rjes gsal ba'i mar me der snang nas: snang ba'i go 'byed mdangs dang ldan pa 'dis/ rig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyi lam ston shog: sems can las kyi mnar ba'i sdug bsngal gyis: gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad thos srid na: thugs rjes gsal ba'i= snang ba'i go= rigs 'dzin grub= 'dod chags 'dzin pa'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis: gcong rol zab mo'i nang du skye srid na: thugs rjes gsal= snang ba'i go= rig 'dzin grub= phrag dog zug rngu las kyi bsdul gyis: mi bzad mtshon cha'i dpal gyi phog srid na: thugs rjes gsal ba'i= snang ba'i go= rin 'dzin grub = nam zhig sa dang lab gyi yon tan rdzogs: stobs bcu'i yon tan nyi bar gyur pa'i tshe: thugs rjes gsal ba'i= snang ba'i go= rig 'dzin grub= sa bcu khyad par rigs gyis bsgrod pa'i tshe: nyon mongs bag chags (213) ma lus rol phyan drug 'gro don mthar phyin cing*/ sa bcu'i rgyun lamada' gcig car rdzogs gyur cig:

sa bcu'i khyad par rtse mor phyin pa'i tsho: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sngon bsus nas: byang chub sems ma rnams kyi mtha' skyor cig: khro bo khro mo rnams kyis rgyab brten cig: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin thob par shog: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin pa'i tsho: sngon nas 'brel ba'i lha yis mdun bsus shig: bkris lha mo brgyad kyis mtha' brten cig: ye shes khro bo rnams kyis rgyab brten cig: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin thob par shog: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin pa'i tshe: sngon nas 'brel pa'i lha yis mdun sa bsus shig: mkha' spyod rigs 'dzin rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig: sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rbaya brten cig: yang dag rdo rje'i lam mchog thob par shog: 'khor lo rdzogs chen sa la phyin pa'i tshe: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon bsus shig: da ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis mtha' brten cig: slad nas 'byon pa rnams kyis rgyab bskyor cig: yang dag rdo rje'i sa la phyin par shog: ye shes bla ma'i la phyin pa'i tshe: karma he ru ka yis sngon bsus shig: rang byung khro rgyal rnams kyis mdar bskyor cig: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis rgyab brten cig: sku gsum yesha shes lnga ldan thob par shog: rang snang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor der 'grub tshe: nyid las mi zhen dag pa'i 'khor rnams la: mi dmigs dgongs rgyud dag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: ting 'dzin chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog: spros med gad pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid nas: gzugs ska rnam gnyis 'gri ba'i dpal shar tshe: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don rnams yongs rdzogs te: khams gsum 'khor ba dngo nas spug par shog: rdo rje slob dpon gnyen gyi bdu bzung nas: shes rab rang bzhin gsang ba yum mchog dang : rdo rje rgyal thobs thugs sras 'khor dang bcas: smon lam dam tshig 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnamasas:

mthar thugs byang chub ma thob de'i bar: 'di nas skye she'i kha lo gar bsgyur yang : rtag tu mi 'bral chos la spyod pa dang: mthar thugs 'og min dag pa'i zhig khams su: dkyil 'khor rnams dag gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces gzhan yang smon lam rgya chen po gdab bo: brgyad pa lus bsrung zhing go bog ba ni hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ka pa tsa hūṃ: badz+ra tsakra tig na karma ki la yang dz+wa la ri hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ rang lus rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lugs su gyon cing : mtshon cha lngī gur khang dang me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pas bar chad gang kyang glags mi rnyed par gyur par bsam mo/ dug pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i sngon der bya ba yod kyang phyag len ltar 'dir bya ba yang 'thad la/ sngar gyi gtor ma cha gcig dang*/ dam can chos skyong gi phral gtor chad bstan (214) rnams rol mo'i sgra dang bcas las byang bzhin tha tshig brjod cing bstan ma skyangs te dza gad phud skyems bcas sgrub khang thog stong ngam phyi rol du gtong zhing gtor mnan sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ bcu pa gnas bsrung ba ni/ zhal gsum rnal 'byor pa rnams ma gyes par spro na las byang tshar re ba dang thag ring du 'gro zhing phyi mi rnams rigs kyis 'phrad pa dang*/ gnas khang du rme yug mje sprang mi gtong ba sogs gzhung ltar ro: bcu gcig pa spyod lam ni/ 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug thags cad lha sngags chos nyid kyi rnamal 'byor sku gsum lam du da pa dang mi 'bral ba la bslab cing : sgrub pa'i yo byang lhag pa rnam cha gsum du bgos te gcig bla ma dang*/ cha gcig tshogs 'khor/ cha gcig byang mo chags tshang las sa bran dathang bcas pa dang byis ston sogs dga' ston rgya chen po bya zhing dam tshig srog ltar bsrung*/ phur pa sor bzhi dar gyi cod paṇa re gong ba la bcang zhing bsngo ba dang bkris kyi cho gas phyogs thams cad du bde ligs kyi snang ba chen sos yongs su khyab par bya'o/

de ltar phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi/ sgrub pa chen mo lag tu len pa'i tshul/ dpe mthong tsham gyi rgyun ldan phyag bzhes kun/ 'chugs med rtogs pa'i go bde 'dir gsal byas/ rig 'dzin pa pad+ma'i thugs bcud zab gsang mchog dgongs don ma rtogs rang bzo'i ngan slad kyis/ 'chol par spyod dogs bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ bris la srung ma'i tshogs kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ dge 'dis rgyal bstan rin chen dar zhing rgyas/ khyab bdag rje btsun bla ma zhabs brtan cing*/ gsang chen theg pa mchog gi 'od stong gis/ bde legs snang ba phyogs kun khyab gyur cig/ de ltar dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i sgrub chen gyi chog sgrigags dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng zhes baya ba 'di yang*/ 'bring du ba'i bla ma dkon mchog byang chub bzang pos/ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral phyogs thams cad las rnam par gyal ba'i sder rdzags bsgrigs gsol ba btab pa/ bdag la bgyis shig sapa'i bka' lung gi dbugs 'byin pa'ayi gnang ba legs par thob pa la brten nas/ gang gi zla med pa'i bka' dren kho nas 'tsho ba'i skal ba can dge slong chos kyi rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas/ gtor gzhung rtse ba'i sgrub khog chen mo nyid gzhung tshigs ma slad par gung sgrigs/ bde 'dus kyi sgrub chen dang*/ chos dbang byang gtor/ sangs rgyas gling phur pa sogs kyi sgrub chen chog bsgrigs mkhas grub gong mas mdzad pa'i mig cha sogs dang bsdun/ kha bskang dgos pa yang rigs mthun nas bkang zhing go bde gan 'gros su dpa' bo zhes

(215) pa lcags khams dbyar rnga'i lor dpal 'bra/ gung gi pho brang bkris tshugs su sbyar ba'i thug ba'i thog ma'i glogs bam du 'bebs pa po ni mang yul ba dge slong dkon mchog bstan pas bgyis pa 'di la ma dag 'khrul pa'i dri ma ci mchis lha dang phur bsrung rnams kyi phyan sngar bzod par gsol zhig mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rnams kyi bcos par yang rigs so/ sarba shu bhaṃ// (216) (dza) ༄༅// bla ma'i thugs sgrub nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgrub phog dngos gder mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub noral bu ragaya mtsho'i sgrub khong dongs grub rgya mtsho'i gtor mdzod ces bya ba/ rje matsun chen po pad+ma thod 'phring rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kun/ ma lus gcig bsdus spyi gzugs 'khor lo'i mgon/ rigs brgya'i khyab dag pad+ma thod phreng dang*/ dbyer med drin can bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ bla ma'i thugs sgrubs nor bu rgya mtsho yi/ sgrub pa chen po lag tu blang ba'i tshul/ brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes 'jug bder sdebs pa la/ byin rlobs bka' yi gnang ba rtsal du gsol/ de la 'dir rigs 'dzin chen po o rgyan pad+ma gling pas lho brag sman mdo nas gdan drangs pa'i zab chos nor bu rgya mtsho'i bsnyen sgrub yin lag bzhis tshe 'dir 'bras bu ster thabs sgrub pa chen po nyams su blang ba'i thabs la spyi don gsum ste/ sngo 'gro/ dngos bzhi*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ spyi don dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis/ bsgrub pa'i (217) gzhi bzung ba dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa'o/ dang po la slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ snyan gsan dbab pa/ slob ma brtag pa/ dus tshos bstan pa/ gnas kyi skyon yon rnams gter gzhung rtsa ba'i yi ge khog phub rin chen phrog ba las shing par bya/ gnyis pa la/ pa'i cho ga/ mtshams bcad pa/ sta gon/ dkyil 'khor bzheng ba/ sgrub rdzas 'go pa/

bsgrub pa la 'jug pa dang drug go/ dang po'i cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po brtag pa ni gter gzhung dang rje dharam kirtis mdzad pa'i nyes kun sel gyi lto 'phye brtag te skyon yon shes pas brkos la ro lnga bsam ba sogs so/ gnyis pa bslang ba ni/ snang bar bslang ba la/ gzhi de gzajags can gyi bdag na rig dang bden pas blang ngo*/ mi snang ba la bslang ba ni/ grub na gnyug mar gnas pa la gtor ma cha gsum dang min na'ang gser skyems dpar gtor bshams la a kā ros bsngos te mchod sbyin gathor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'phris bcol/ bye gra gzhi der sar dkar gyi stong du 'bru'i tshom bu lnga bkod par dkar gtor rtse sman gyi sbags pa mchod par bcas pa bshams la sngags drug phyag rgya drug gi bya gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo sku stod pa'i stong du thon pa phyag g.yas phyag yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon bum pa bsnams pa 'khor sa bdag gi tshogs kyi bskor ba mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rang 'dre'iye shes sems dpal spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ rang gi lag g.yas pa la lan gsum bsnun te/ hūṃ lha mo chen mo sa bdag 'jig rten yum/ tshul byon tshul byon pa yi lha mo khyod: mdzes sdug yid 'ong na bzang rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon sa gser bub 'dzin: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi 'phrin las ni: ji ltar sngon gyi dam bcas ltar: bdag ni byang chub ngos sgrub kyi: mchod 'bul dasang mdzod pa 'di zhu: 'byung po pa yi bdag po rnams: bcu gnyis lo yi rta la zhon: ko long sdom pa'i lha dgu sogs: 'byang po'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun: sa glang mchon sbyin gtor ma bzhes: 'byung po sa yi bdag po rnams: gnas rten gzhan du khyod song la: sa 'dir bkris mdzad du gsol: ba liṃ nya kha khā hi:

sarba bhan+dha gṛ ha kha hi shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: sngon sangs rgyas shā kyang thub pas kyang : bdud btul nas sangs rgyas dang : chos kyi 'khor lo rigs pa gsum du bskor ba yang*/ sa gzhi rin chen 'di nyid kyi stong du mdzad cing : lha mo khyod kyis sa byin gyis brlab pa yin pas: da ltar rjes 'jug gi bsgrub pa po dbag can rnams kyang : tshogs gnyis bsags (218) shing : sgrib pa gnyis byang pa'i slad du: gnas 'dir rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i phrong bzhengs par 'tshal bas: sa'i bdag po khyod rnams kyis: gnas 'di gtsang zhang byin cher bar mdzod: ces gsol te shu mi sa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha: zhes brjod pas gnang ba sbyin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing gtor ma 'bul lo: gsum pa 'dul zhing bzung ba ni/ tsan dan nam seng ldong gi las phur thogs la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rte mchog rol pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tsha 'dus phur bu la thim pas de nyid cho btsan 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ hūṃ nga ni khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: sprul pas sa gzhi thams cad gang : phur pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa: sku smad dpal gyi me 'od 'phro: sa 'di bdag gis bzung bar bgyi: oṃ gha ghaḥghā ta ya: sarba duṣ+ṭan:badz+ra dha dor adz+nyā pa ya ti: sarba bhig nan: kā ya wāka tsit+ta: badz+ra kī la ya hū+i ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces pa'i sngags kyis lan gsum btab pas phur bu las me 'od kyis sa gzhir dbang tshad khyab par gyur par bsam mo/ bzhi sa sbyang ba la gnyis las/ dang po ting 'dzin gyi sbyang ba ni/ hūṃ rang nyid yi dam thugs kha nas: yi ge bh+ruṃ 'phros smug nag bsam: 'od zar phyogs bcur 'phros pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams mchod sras su dgos: khro bo rnams mchod spun grogs byed: ma mo rnams mchod yum du gyur: sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs:

'od zer tshul la 'dus pa yis: rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: sa gzhi gzhal yas khang chen bskyed: bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ: zhes bsgom mo/ gnyis pa las dang bya bas sbyang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor sbol ba'i chu thogs la/ skyai mdzes pa'i mdangs ldan mtsho smad rgyal mo la: rgyal ba'i pho brang 'debs phyir chu len no: rwa ba bzhi la nam mkha'i dbyings na gnas: 'bring po bzhi la bar snang khams na gnas: tha chung bzhi la rgya mtsho'i gting na gnas: bkris mizad chubo'i rgyun rtsol cig: ces brjod nas gzhung du gsal ba ltar gnas khang dang sbyar ba'i stegs bu mtshan nyid tshang ba bcas la/ slar yang dri bzang ba byung bdud rtsi lnga chang dang sbyar ba byug cing chag chag gdab la: hūṃ dkyil 'khor mthar legs gzhal yas khang : phyi nang med par bskyed pa'i phyir: stigs bu bsgrig pa dang*/ byug cing chag gdab pa hūṃ dkyil 'khor mthar legs sogs lha sta gon mgor tshom bu 'god khar bya ba phyag len la yod/ bdud rtsi dri yis chag chag 'debs: dngos grub 'byung phyir dbus phyogs mtho: 'ar chad sbyang phyir byang shar dma': me long ngos ltar mdzes par gsal: zhes brjod do gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa lag gsum las/ dang po phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i sar mtho sku (219) rten dang bcas pa'i mdun nu maṇ+ḍal pad 'dam bzhi pa me tog gi tshom bu can gyi khar dkar gtor dang mchod pa bcas bshams shing sngags drug phyag drug gam 'bru gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri bar kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra pa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rten la gnyis su med par gyur ces bstim oṃ dhṛ ta raṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ ci 'grub bzlas nas/ chu gnyis nyer spoyad rol mo bcas kyis mchod snying po'i mthar/

ba ling+ta nā na kha da kha dan+tu gṛh+na hūṃ khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ hūṃ ston tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas chos skyong dpal: ri bar gling bzhi'i shar ngos nas: phyag na rdo rje dbang gi mthus: bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ chos skyong rgyal po yul po 'khor bsrung*/ bdag cag ro ba skong bi phyir: bar gcod gdon rnams rnams tshar chod cig: hūṃ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung : sku mdog dpar po si waṃ bsnams: mthu chen zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzad: shar phyosag dri za'i gdon rnams bsrung : deng gi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir: bsgrub pa'i cho ga thon bar: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung : phyi yi bar chad nang du ma btang zhig: nang gi dngos grub phyi ru ma btang zhig: ces 'phrin las gsol te/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bsam mo/ phyogs gzhan gsum langa' sngar bzhin las/ rin bar gyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyos po= zhes dang*/ oṃ bi ru nga kā ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ hūṃ sngon tshe= khas blangs= ri bar gling bzhi'i lho ngos nas: phyag na= bstan pa= chos skyong rgyal po 'phags skyos po: bdag cag= bar gcod= hūṃ lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyos so: sku mdog sngo nag rabal gri bsnams: rgyal pa'i 'phris bsod nams spel: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdon rnams bsrung : deng gi= sgrub pa'i= rgyal po chen po 'phags skyos pos: phyi yi= nang gi= zhes dang*/ ri rab chen po'i nub phyogs nas: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : zhes dang*/ oṃ bi tu pāk+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ hūṃ sngon tshe= khas blangs= ri bar gying bzhi'i nub ngos nas: phyag na= bstan pa= chos skyong rgyal po spyan mi bzang : bdag gcod= hūṃ nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : skad mdog dmar po sbrul zhags mdzin: dbang gi 'phris dbang sdud spel5 nub phyogs klu dbang gdon rnams bsrungs:

deng gi= bsgrub pa'i= rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : phyi yi= nang gi= ces dang = ri rab chen po'i byag phyogs nas rgyal po chen po po rnam thos sras= zhes dang*/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hāḥ zhes dang hūṃ/ sngon tshe= sngon tshe= khas blangs= (220) ri bar gling bzhi'i byang ngos nas: phyag na= bstan pa= chos skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras: bdag cag= bar gcod= hūṃ byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: sku mdog ljang gu ne'i le bsnams: drag po'i 'phril las gdon bgegs 'dul: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon rnams bsrungs: deng gi= bsgrub pa'i= rgyal po chon po rnam thos sras: phyi yi= nang gi= tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bsam mo gnyis par bar mtshams bcod pa la gnyis las dang po dam srid mnan pa ni/ ra sogs la nang du dam sri'i gzugs kyi snying khar tri dza dam srid nan/ de mthar dam srid gaṃ pa ti mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥnan tri'i tra'u ya na ma sho dza khug nan/ bar gcod dam srid pho mo thams cad myur du khug cig tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes dang*/ gzug kyi mar shong na dmod mo bris min gang yang rung ba'i mthar dza khraṃ gyis bskor*/ stong gi rgya logs ra ri rab bris sa brub khung du bkod/ phur thun dang gser skyoms sogs 'du bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rta mgrin gyi skur gsal bar gyur pa'i rgyal gyis/ gser skyems spyi 'gro btang zhing las byang gi thugs dam bskul/ e yaṃ ri dz+wa a ram brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo rid cing nyams thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ bden bdar dgugs gzhug drag tu bya zhing bsgyur kha dngos grub bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri 'khor bcas mtshan ma rjas kyi rten sogs kyi gsum lnga bdun sogs yid ches par byas nas/ las byang ni/ hūṃ che mchog pad+ma thod phrong rtsal: gtums drag brngams pa'i rang bzhin las: yak+ṣa me dbal skra ltar 'khrug:

las kyi pho nyas stong gsum gang : yags rdo rje phur pa 'dril: g.yon pa rdo rje phur pa 'dril: g.yon pa lcags kyu zhags sa bsnams: 'grogs sgrol ba'i dus la babs: rul phran bzhin du brlags par byed: nri tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad: ces dang*/ las phur drag sngags po bdun pa phur bskor dang bcas pa liṅga'i snying khar btab/ thun rdzas kyis kyang brabs te/ sgrub khang gi sgora'i phyir khru gang ba'i dang du bcug: ro g.yam rdo rje rga gram bris pas mnan/ sa chu me rnams rims pa bcu gsum gyis g.yogs nas/ hūṃ dam srid bya ba'i sdig can 'dis: bla mar brdos shing mchod la 'khu: dkon mchog dmon cing bstan pa bshig: bskal par nam yang mi thar phyir: mtshon gyis gtubs te zhal du btab: glu+ing bzhi re bar 'og tu mnan: zhes dang mchod lcam rnams lug gu rgyud du sbrel zhing : hūṃ gcig ni chos sku skye med rgya: gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyis rgya: bzhi ni tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa thod 'phyong rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa phar phyin drug gi rgya: bdun sa sangs rgyas bdun rgya: brgyad pa gu ru mtshan brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg (221) pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu sa khro bo bcu yi rgya: thams cad yongs rdzogs rgyas btab pas: rnal 'byor bar chad zhi gyur cig: oṃ lam: ā lam: hūṃ lam: stam bha ya nan: ces rgyas btab cing las nga gi bro brdung yang bya'o/ gnyis pa sgo byang gdags pa ni/ bdud rtsi 'khril pa'i sku rgyab sku sngags byang 'dod gsol can sgrub khang gi sgo'i ya them phyi logs zhal phyir phyogs par btags la mdun du mchod gtor bshams shing*/ bsangs sbyangs*/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod gtor rnams oṃ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ āḥhūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsal me tog bdun spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyi mi khyab cing gtor ma bdud rtse ba'i rgya mtsho chen sor gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghi āḥhūṃ nas shastī bar gyis byin gyis brlabs: sku rten bsngangs sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las khro bo bdun rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag g+r+ya gram dang dri bu 'dzin pa gar gdu'i nyams can dur khrod kyi chas dang ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na pad nyi'i gdan la dor stabs kyis gnas pa'o: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyi ye shes pa badz+ra pa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par gyur par bsam: oṃ a mraṃ ta kuṇ+ḍa lam hūṃ zhes ci nus bzla: snying po'i mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod: yi dam ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes snying po'i mthar btags nas gsum gyi gtor ma bul la/ hūṃ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi: sprul pa'i 'od zare dgra bgegs 'dul/ dngos grub bdud rtsi rgya mtshor 'khyil: bgegs skyi sbyor rgyun chod cig: oṃ a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li tshin+da dam srid mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa/ sgrub mchog rnams kyibasgrub pa 'di btsugs nas: mjug ma rdzogs kyi bar du ni: phyi'i bar chad nang du ma btang*/ nang gi dngos grub phyir ma yab ba'i: bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las bdag la rtsol: ces me tog 'gor zhing su sri tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ sgo ya them nang logs su rta mgrin sku rgyab tu sngogs byang 'dod gsol yod pa zhal nang gzigs su btags la mchod gathor bshams shing byin brlabs gong ltar byas rjes sku rten bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hriḥlas dbang chen rtan mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po thod dbyug dang sdig mdzub mdzad pa gar dgu'i nyams can sogs gong ltar dang*/ deng 'dir bsgrub pa mchog la nges zhugs kyi: dngos grub rgya mtsho bdag gis ma thob bar: khro chen 'jigs byed dpal chen rta mgrin gyis: bar chad 'byung po thams cad phyari skrod la: mchog mthun dngos grub 'khyil ba'i grogs mdzod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa:

sgrub mchog rnams kyis bsgrub pa 'di btsugs nas: mjug ma rdzogs kyi bar du ni: phyi bar chad dang du ma btang : nang gi dngos grub phyir ma yal ba'i: bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las bdag la rtsol: zhes me tog mthor zhing su sras tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par bya'o: gsum pa nang mtshams bcad pa la gnyis las: dang po ma ṭaṃ bsgral ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi pa la ma ṭaṃ gyi gzugs byas pa mgo lho nub tu bstan pa gan rkyal du bzhag: ā+oṃ pad+ma kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ko3 haṃ: bdag nyid rtag mchog rol pa'i skur gsal bar gyur: lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te/ ma ṭaṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ bdu brjod pa dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rnams ma ṭāṃ ru tra ngo bo dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad la ṭāṃ rū tra a kar+sha ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkur ste gzugs la bstim nas: ging sa chas kyis brgyan cing lag tu gri mtshon thogs la dkyil 'khor bskor zhing pho nya bskul ba ni: hūṃ shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bse yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar po nyi zla skar ltar 'khrug: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs mchaid : bu yug thogs 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'phro: bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spru gris gtags: rngams pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshogs me ltar 'bar bas srid pa bsrog: snyan nas bskal ba'i 'brug sgra 'byin byed cing : lags pa dmar po spru gri 'bum gyi gtags: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse las bskal me 'bar: stogs kyi gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smani mtshams lcags kyi khro chu'i char pas 'bebs: zhal gyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: mi bzad gtum chen sha za khrag 'thung ma: srin mo dregs pa'i snying 'byin mchan par 'dzin: mi bzad khro mo dpag tshad lnga brgya nyul:

khros pa'i zhal la khrag gi mchan pa kha: na bzang dmar po sprin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bzhir kha bltas khyogs skyong dregs pa gnon: bdud la babs na snying za bdud 'dzin: sri la babs na srog gcod phung po mdzoms: dgra la babs na dgra srog drung nas 'byin: bgegs la babs na rungs sa rul du brlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying gsol: gru ba a pa tsa ru pa tsi ri ra tsa thun thun ngan sha stam bha yak+sha: byi na ya: phye ma phye ma: ra phran rul phran: tsit+ta rbad: ces pas sprul pa'i pho nya bskul te/ gri ging gi stabs stangs bya zhing : hūṃ ma ṭaṃ bya ba'i sdig can khyod: sngon yang sgrub la rab gcod byas: dngos grub kun ra bar tu bsgribs: de tshe dpal chen rte mgrin gyis: bsgral nas dur khrod brgyad du byas: khungs dang rtsed bcad

(222) gang las byung : khungs dang rtsed bcad bdag las byung : bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rū ṭa 'di: bdag med chos kyi dbyings su bsgral: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃḥ ma ṭ+wi ru tra dzaḥ a kar+ṣa rū tra dzaḥ we sha ya phaṭ+waḥ lag g.yas kyi sor mo gsum bsgreng ba ka tī ga'i phyag rgya snying gar bsnun pas: gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig/ mari ga sgo lnga'i sbubs dral/ rnam shes tri nag por gnas pa thugs ka'i 'od kyis sbyangs pas hūṃ yig dpar por gyur pa bdag gi thugs kar thim nas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing/ hūṃ kun bzang yab yum mkha' dbyings su: sogs kyi bros sbyangs: yan lag lnga dang*/ snying dang nang rol/ mtshan ma rnams bcad nas maṇ+ḍal gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod/ bh+ruṃ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la bh+ruṃ: thugs ka nas bh+ru 'phros khog pa la thim pas khog pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod dho rwa me ri dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur par bsam mo: gnyis pa khro bo bcu'i phur pa btab pa ni/ lcags sam seng ldeng skyor phur sogs bcu la khro bo bcu'i sngags dang cod btags pa bsangs sbyangs: stong pa'i chad pa bcu yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bcu sku stod khro bo la sku smad/ nang mchis phro bcu'i phur gdab rdzas brgyan bgod pa hūṃ bkri nyum pa phrong sogs kyi mdzug der bya ba'i phyag len kyang yod/ phur bu zug gsum pa med rab tu 'bar ba'i skur gsal ba'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra pa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur: slang yang rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo ka ti tsa lcags kyu dang tho ba thagos pa spras te phyogs skyong bcu bkug nas stong 'og phyogs mtshams so sor bsgyel bar gyur par bsam mo: 'og phyog bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: rta mgrin khro rgyal chen so bcu:

kun kyang mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku: lcags phur 'drel zhig tshwa tshwa 'phro: log 'dren bar gcod mtshams gcod phyir: stong 'og phyogs mtshams gdab par bya: slob dpon gyis phur pa bcu rim par btab la/ oṃ gha ghā ta ya ta ghā ta ya sarma duṣ+ṭan badz+ra dha ro ha badz+ra dha ho ro a dz+nyā pa ya ti/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ badz+ra ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sarba bi gh+ni ka ya wa k+tsit+ta badz+ra ki li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭ+wa: de bzhin du mtha' thog 'dra bas: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūṃ badz+ra ma tha ma tha hūṃ phaṭ+wa oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ badz+ra dhu na dhu na hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ ha yi ghi wa/ da ha da ha/ a mṛ kuṇ+ḍa li/ sa tsa pa tsa/ nī la daṇ+ḍa/ dha ra dha ra/ arma a tsha la/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ a pa rā dzi ta/ dwa ru ṇa dā ru ṇa trai lo kyang bi dza ya/ tshin+dha tshin+dha oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūṃ/ badz+ra bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces stong 'og gnyis shar gyi shar dang nus kyi nub gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams so sor btab cing las byang mtshams gcod kyang gyor ro/ (223) gzhung du phyi nag gsang bga'i mtshams gcod rnams sda gon gyi mjug tu gsungs kyang snga gon gyi sngon la byed pa'i phyag bzhes yod pas de ltar legs so/ gsum pa sta gon la gsum las dang po lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi der slob dpon gyis gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gtso bo la grub bzhi dang 'khor rnams la zlum po byas pa'i khar me tog gi tshom bu rtsa sngags brjod bzhin pas bkod de dag gi mdun du mchod pa sman raka gtor ma sogs nyer mkho'i rigs rnams tsang bar byas la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas song nas/ mdun rten tshom bu la dmigs pas dongs gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa nas bstod pa'i bar dang*/ bdag nyid ces pa dor ti mdu du sogs bsgyur zhing bzla pa yang ci 'grub bya'o/ gnyis pa bum pa snga gon ni/ rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang na pa gnyis dngos gtsang zhing dag par byas la rtsa sngags la hūṃ bzhi btags pa bzla zhig gu gul gyis bdug/

yungs dkar gyis brab/ gtsang ma'i gzhi la bzhag ste/ pha ma rigs bzang ya rabs kyi khyi'u mos blangs la/ oṃ ru ti sarba dharmā swa bha kha shu d+dho3 haṃ/ zhes dang chu dang 'o ma bsres la blug/ sman lnga blug la/ oṃ a mṛ ta pañca sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūṃ: 'bru sna lnga bslug la/ oṃ su tsa pañca āḥhūṃ: rin chen lnga bslug la/ oṃ rat+na sañca sid+dhi āḥhūṃ*/ snying po lnga bslug la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ traṃ tri sid+dhi hūṃ: bdud rtsi lnga bslug la/ oṃ garba pañca sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūṃ: dri lnga bzlug la/ a mṛ ta du sa pañca hūṃ: dar snga lnga mul 'ching ya la/ oṃ ni ta pañca a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: ku sha dang rma bya'i mdongs kyi rgyan byas la/ oṃ pa tati ga na rlag sha pa la sid+dhi hūṃ/ gzungs thag dang rdo rje bathags la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ti ka par la sid+dhi hūṃ: zhes bzla zhings gtso bum dkyil 'khor dubs dang las bum mdun nam gang bder bkod/ btso bor dri'i dung zhal dang gzungs rdor drangs shing*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa chen po'i ngang nyid las/ bh+ruṃ yi 'od zhu rin chen gyi/ bum sa mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing*/ phyi ni bu pa'i rnam pa la/ nang bcu ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ phyi nang sgrib med 'od klong du/ bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i stong*/ khro rgyal dbang chen yab yum sku/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: zhes pa nas/ char spyin ltur 'thib par bsam: zhes dang*/ bar 'dir la las bum la dmigs te/ las kyi bu pa'i nang du ni/ dpa nyid baṃ ro'i gdan stong du ni/ pad nyi baṃ ro'i gdan stong du/ bdang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ spyi gtsug ral khrod rta zhal bzhad/ khro gtum phyag gnyis gri thod bsnams/ rngams brjod dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ bskal pa'i me dpung klong na gsal/ zhes las bum bskyed cing*/ sku (224) gsung thugs kyis byin rlob cing nas dkyus ltar bstod pa'i bar song rjes/

gzungs thag 'jus te*/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags 'phring 'od zare gzungs 'khrol te bum nang lha tshogs kyi thugs kar zhugs rgyu bskul/ de dag gi sku las byang sems bdud rtse'i rgyun babs pas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig 'dres shing gang bar gyur pas bsam la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngags ci 'grub dang las bum pa'i chu dang rol gcig 'dres shing bar gyur par bsams la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngags cing 'grub dang las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha pad+ma ta kri ta kri ta ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu hūṃ phaṭ+wa: ces brgya rtse sogs ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ dung chos kyi chu 'bru gsum gyis bum par 'bul zhing/ lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bar zhu nas bum chu dang rol gcig 'gyur zhes dang*/ las bum la/ kho bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pas 'dir bsgrub pa chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du 'gegs rnams bsrung dang bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las bcol pa/ gsum pa slob ma lta gon ni/ dbang dang 'brel na khong phu dang dbang gzhug sogs las shes bar bya'o/ slar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ oṃ gu ru brgyī dhā ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tiñca swā hā: zhes shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku/ sogs sho lo ka dang snang ba la 'gas thugs rje chen po nas/ chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes bstod cing*/ sta gon la gnas par gal ba gdab pa ni/ dpon slob rnams spos dang dhor dril 'dzin pas/ hoḥ rdo rje slol dpon dgongs sug gsol/ rtse ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams/ ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rtsa gsum bla ma mchod pa dang*/ slob bu khyod kyi rjes 'jug phyir: bdag sogs skal ldan pho mo yis: rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bri: thugs rjes dgongs la byin gyis rlabs: zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab pas de rnams kyi bya ba sbyin par bsams la/

rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo rtse sprad pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' 'od kyi dra bar bzhugs par gyur zhes dkyil 'khor btogs te nam mkha' 'god/ skabs 'dir tshogs mchod sogs las byang 'jug chog bya zhig tshom bu dang mchod gtor rnams bsdu/ bum pa gnyis dben bzhugs su gsol/ bzhi sa dkyil 'khor bzheng ba la bzhi las dang po thig gdab pa ni/ chags chags 'debs pa sngon du song zhing*/ thig skud gzhung ltar mtshan nyid lang ba 'du byas te/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar dang thig g.yog dkyil 'khor nub tu gnas pas/ rang nyid pad+ma thod 'phring du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i trīḥlas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'khros thig g.yog la phogs pas sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg gtor sbyangs nas ye shes mtsho rgyal mar gsal/ yab kyi gnas lngar thod 'phrong rigs (225) lnga dang*/ yub gyi gnas lngar rnal 'byor ma lngas mtshan par gyur ces thig sne gtad la/ kyai bdag cag rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyis/ bde chen 'khrol nas dbyer mi phyed: gsang ba rdo rje byang sems kyis: ye shes lnga yi thig gdab bo: skye med dbyings kyi nam mkha' la: dmigs gtad bral ba'i thig gdab bo: rang bzhin gsal ba'i bar snang la/ ye shes rnam lnga'i thig gdab bo: sna tshogs rdzas skyi sa gzhi la: sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i thig gdab bo: bh+ruṃ saṃ kraṃ ta dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ: lus kyi rigs lnga yab yam snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub skye spron yum gyi mkha' las thon pa'i thig la phog pas dngos po'i rtog pa sbyangs nas ye shes lnga rang bzhin dug gsal bar gyur pas bsam la: hūṃ rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyogs mtshags ye shes lnga dang ldan: bla med rgyal ba'i pho brag gsal: bh+ruṃ dz+nyā na kra ma swā hāḥ zhes brjod cing*/ lag gsum seg gol gtogs pa dang bcas nam mkha'i dbyings las ye shes kyi thig tshangs thig gnyis mas bzhi dang brgyad la sogs pa g.yas bskor du gdab cing*/

sngags dang thig gi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad sad par byas/ nam mkha' ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur par gyur pas bsam/ de bzhin du sa la gdab ste/ hūṃ bha ga yum gyis gzhi la: byang chub sems kyi thig spros pas: gsang 'dus bla ma'i pho brag gsal: bh+ru dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la bh+ruṃ: zhes brjod cing spyod lam ma nor bar thig chen brgyad nas rim par gdab lugs rje dharma kirtis badzadam pa'i spyi thig nyi ma'i snang ba bzhin rtsigags pa nas dma' yab bar dang*/ sgo dang*/ rte babs pad rang dur khrod dho ra me 'khor sogs pyi mthun gang babs gdab rjes nang lha gnas kyi phyang tshangs thig nas phyogs bzhir che chen gsum pa'i phyi thig nas bzung rim bzhin dung du zlum sgor drug bskor ba ni 'od skor sna tshogs pad+ma bcu drug pad 'dab zur brgyad/ 'dab bzhi/ lte ba rnams su 'gyur ro/ gnyis pa tshon bgye ba ni/ tshon snga lnga mdog rigs sdibs pa'i dubs dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hūṃḥ.āḥ zhes bkod pa bzhag/ rdul tshon la bkod yig 'bru lnga las 'od zar 'phros: 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshul 'dus rdul tshon la thim/ ye shes lnga'i rings bzhin gyir rin po cher gyur par bsams la 'bru lnga brgya rtse sogs brjod pas byin gyis rlob la tshon thogs te/ hūṃ rtsa gsum bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ ye shes lnga yi byin rlobs la: sems can 'gro ba kun don du: ye shes lnga yi tshon 'gyed do: zhes brjod cing bgyed/ tshon thob ni/ lte ba ling tshe gsum du byas la mdun nas rami bzhin dmar dkar mthing kha/ 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog/ rin chen zur brgyad lha mdog: dpar bskor nang ma mdzes tshon: phyi ma brgyad kyi shar dang shar lho dkar po sogs rigs mdog /'od 'gyud kha dog lnga (226) ldan grub chad rin chen che'i gzhal yang khang gi mtshan nyid spyi ltar gyi gyi tshon sprung byas zhing*/

thig tshon gyi bya ba rdzogs nas ye shes pa gshogs pa par bya'o/ gsum pa lhag chad gso ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzigs dril bu gsil zhing ye ge brgya sa bzla bzhin pas lan gsum bskor zhing lhag chad kha bskang/ dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas dang bkris brjod/ bzhi pa rdo rje'i glus bskul ba ni/ skad cig gi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings mngon sum pa bzhin gsayal bar gyur pas bsams la/ hūṃ 0chos sku skye ba med pa'i pho brang 'dir: ma bris dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: bris pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor mdangs re gsol: dus gsum rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i gnas/ bla med rtse gsum lha tshogs rnams5 chos kyi dbyings las sku bzhengs la: 'gro ba'i don du 'dir byon nas: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor byin rlobs shig: ces rdo rje'i glu dang byin dbab pa'i gar gyis bskul bas: gong gi nam mkha'i ye shes kyi thig lha rnams skad cig gis dkyil 'khor la thim par gyur par bsams la: mchod pa lnga dang yan lag bdun pa yang 'bul lo: de ltar rab rul tshon bshad pa dang*/ yul dus kyis ma 'grigs tshe 'bring ras bris su gsungs pas sta gon gyi tshom bu bsdu phral ras tshad ldan bkral zhing thig tshon gyi bya ba n+mas dor ba nyis do/ lnga pa sgrub rdzas 'god pa la gnyis las/ dang po rdzas rgyan 'god pa ni/ sngar gyi bum pa gtis gatsho bar sku tsaka gis brgyan pa spos rol dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañji'i khar bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ mdun nam gang 'der las bum dang rgyan rdzas gzhan rnags kyang 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin rim par bkod la/ hūṃ bkra shis bum pa pho brag gzhal yang khang : mi 'gyur rnam dag rgyal ba'i gnas su gsol: gu ru'i sku mchog dbyer med bzhas su gsol: me long bdud dri med dag pa'i rdzas: dag rdzas gtor chen rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang :

phyi nag gsang gsum kun bzang mchod sprin 'thibs: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes gnyis su med/ rnga dung ḍā dril dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i rdzas: phur pa ral gris bar chad bsrung bar byed: mda' dar me long longs spyod rgyan rnams rdzogs: tshon skud snang lngas dwa ba dwa phyed sbrel: yol ba bla bre 'phan gdugs cod paṇa dang : bdud rtsi sman raka dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas: yid 'ong rigs ma mtshan ldan bde ba'i lam: gi pho ging mo bar chad bsrung ba'i las: spos dang mar me zhal zas yo byad rnams: thams cad yongs rdzogs lhun grub chen por shar: pho brang gzhal yas rab tu rgyas bkod pas: 'phrin las rnam bzhi yon tan yongs rdzogs shog: ces gyer zhing bum pa'i g.yas su dam rdzas gyi sgrub gtor g.yon du thod (227) pa dum bu gcig par chang dang a mṛ ta sbyar ba'i kha dar dmar dang*/ me long chang gis byug pa la sin+dhu ra'i thig le lnga tshom byas pas bka': dngos grub gyis rdzas pho mo'i thod pa mtshan ldan kha sbyor du sman dang sha rig grub na de nyid dang*/ gzhan du a mṛ ta dang rin chen 'bru sman sogs kyi bkang bar dngos grub kyi gsul byang bcug cing*/ dar tshe sna lngas dril tshon skud dang rigs lnga'i rgyas btab pa bum pa'i 'og tu 'god/ dbang dang 'brel ba'i tshe dang gzhung nas byung ba'i tsakli sogs gang dgos bsags/ bar chacad bsrung ba'i phur pa bzhi/ srid pa'i dwa ba gcod pa'ayi ral gri bzhi/ ma rigs rtsad nas gcod phyari mda' dar me long can bzhi/ rigs lnga mtshon byed tshen skud sna lnga'i dra ba/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ lda ldi/ yos ba sogs kyi mdzes shing bkod legs par brgyan cing*/ chos skyong ma ni sde brgyad rnam sras bcas la gtor ma zusar gsum par 'khor rang 'dra brgyad mtheb kyu ci gis bskor ba/ gzhan yang bka' gter chos srung gi gathor ma rnams dang*/ phab ldan gyi sman rakā/ phyi mchod chu gtis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/

bkris rtags rdzas rin chen bdun= la sogs pa dang*/ nang mchod/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ*/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog/ sha chen gyi bsur/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ dri chu'i byug pa/ sha lnga bdud lnga'i zhal zas/ 'dod yon gyi lha mo sogs/ gsang mchod nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa dang*/ liṅga phur pa phyag rgya lnga sogs dngos dang bris 'bur gang 'os mchod pa'i bye brag ci gtsang zhing dag pa'i mtha' bskor/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi stong ngam nye logs su 'bru dkar gyi gdan la tshe'i bum pa bcud ldan chas su bcug pa'i gsu su tshe 'bring ril bus bskor ba dang*/ g.yon du thod pa dza gad kyis bkang ba bdud rtsis sbran pa/ tshe rten mda' dar bcas bshams/ rgyal chos phur sgrub la dgos pa rigs lnga mtshan brgyad ging shugs brgyad sgo bsrung rnams kyi phur bu nyi shu rtsa lnga'i/ 'bring rigs lnga'i lnga/ tha na'ang gtso bor phur bu mtshan dang ldan pa bkod/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs dang rol mo'i bye brag sogs mdor na 'dir dgos pa'i yo byad cha rkyen thams cad 'tshogs par bya'o: gnyis pa pa gzhal yas don bstod bya ba ni/ sgrub rdzas legs par 'god zin pa dang*/ dpon slob rnams sngags chas su zhugs shing sbyar dang rang byung gi spos bsrog /rolo ma sna tshogs sgrogs cing dbyangs dang bcas/ hūṃ ma bcos spros bral rdzogs pa'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub bde chen 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang: thugs rjes dkyil 'khor ma 'dres 'dza' ltar shar: rang bzhin lhun sgrub gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bstod:
