(228) ye shes lnga ldan dri med pad+ma'i 'dab: sku gsum lhub mu khyud gsum ldan mdzes: rnam thar brgyad ldan rin chen rgyan gyis spras: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal bstod: 'phags lam brgyad ldan dri med 'dab ldan mdzes: rin chen 'phring ba bcu drug pad+mas bskor: tshad med bzhi ldan grub chad rnam ra mdzes: sa lam mthar phyin gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bstod: bde chen gdal khyab mnyam nyid chen po'i khyams: 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgo bzhi phyogs bzhir gsal: ye shes lnga ldan rtsigs pa rin chen spras: phro brang gzhal yas dbus la phyag 'tshal bstod: de yi phyi khyams mnyam yangs gdam khyab zhing : 'dod khyams bzhi mdzes lha mos gar byed cing : thar pa'i sgo brgyad phrong phyogs bzhir gsal: rab mdzes gzhal yas khang la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan rab rgyas gsare gyi pha gu bsgrig: nyon mongs mun sel dwa ba dwa khyod spras: 'gro don phyogs med mdzad phyir 'da' bka' gsal: dgos 'dod re skong gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bstod: bdud dpung brgyad 'joms lha brgyad ka ba bcas: gza' brgyad ka gzhu stong gi gdon tshogs 'dzoms: klu bag+r+yad ka gdan 'og gi gdon rnams gnon: 'phrin las mthar phyin gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bstod: theg pa dgu ldan rta babs rim pa brtsegs: dus gsum kun tu 'gro la chos 'khor bskor: byams pa'i thugs rjes phyogs bcur khyab pa'i gdugs/ 'gro don mthar phyin phrong phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam rtog dre med dben pa'i ri dwags dang : 'gro ba'i don mdzad bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: chos nyid bden pa'i ba dan rab mdzes shing : yon tan rab rdzogs dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor ba'i skon spangs pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag phyir ngur khrod brgyad: cis kyang mi sheg rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor: thams cad yongs rdzogs pho brang phyag 'tshal bstod/ sku bzhi lhun grub yon tan bar rdzogs phyir:

bum pa sku 'bag bhan+dha me long dang*/ sman gtor rak+ta dur khrod rdzas brgyad bcas: dngos grub kun 'byung pho brang phyag 'tshal bstod: sku bzhi yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs phyir: mda' dang me log tshon skud sna lngas sbrel: sher bar ral gri gabazhi dang phur pa bzhi: ma lus yongs rdzogs gzhal yas phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku skye med smra bsam brjod dang bral: thugs rje rang bzhin 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: gdul bya'i don du dkyil 'khor gzhal yas gsal: thams cad rdzogs pa'i pho brag phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bskor zhing*/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can ma lus pas byin gyasi barba par bsam mo: drug pa bsgrub par 'jugs pa lang lnga las: dang po bgegs bskrad pa ni gzhung du ma gsungs kyang phyag len du yod pas bya bar mos na mched lcam rnams phyir dbyung ste sgrub khang sgo phar 'dus nas: sgo ba ging chen zhu lan 'dod pa gzhan (229) nas byung ba bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyi nang nas las byang gi bgegs gtor btang zhing bka' bsgo'i mjug hūṃ bzhi dang drag sngags gzhan yang brjod cing thun brab rol mo sgrigs/ sgo dbye/ spro na ging pa 'odan cing thun rdog: me chu brab*/ las bum gyi chus khrus dang nang du 'ongs te gral phyag bya/ gnyis pa gnas su 'god pa ni/ de yang slob dpon sngon nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang gzungs ma/ rdo rje rgyal thebs/ rdo rje las pa/ rdo rje ging mtshams/ rdo rje spyan pa/ rdo rje dus mtshams/ rdo rje phyag tshang*/ rdo rje byan po/ rdo rje rdul phyag sogs 'don na bsgrub pa chen por 'du bar 'ogs pa'i mched lcam rnams rim par grol la 'dug ste spro na maṇ+ḍal phur slob dpon gyi mthun mong gi sngon 'gros rgyud byangs shing chos bka' 'di kha'i byung tshul yid ches skye bar bya ba sogs sa skabs sbyar las nan gyi sbyor dgos ma yin zhing*/

byan pho mos rdo rje slob dpon nas rim par skyems drangs shing*/ las kyi rgyal 'debs kyis/ kye hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso: rdo rje rgyal 'debs rdo rje mtshams pa dang: las kyi rgyal 'debs las kyi gzungs ma dngas: 'phrin las gar ging las kyi sgrol ging dang :=tshogs gnyer yo byed phyag tsang das 'dzin sogs: gnas 'dar mi ga'o thams cad brten par bzhugs: zhes gsol zhing*/ gsum pa rigs ma 'bul ba ni/ gzhung du rigs ma mtshan ldan lnga'am gsum mam gcig sogs gsungs kyang phyag len la mtshon byed tsaklir mos pa mdzad srol 'dug pas/ rdo rje rgyal 'debs lta bus tsakli slon dpon la 'bul zhing*/ kye oḥ yid 'ongs gzugs mdzes lha mo'i gzugs: bde ba'i gnas sbyin yid 'phrog ma: zag med bde chen nyams rtogs spor: thabs shes dbyer med dga' bzhi bskyed: gsang ba'i mchog sbyin yang dag sbyor: gsang sngags ston mdzad khyod la 'bul: dz+nyā na mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes phyag rgyas blang ngo*/ 'di skabs don dgos pa dang 'brel na bya'o: bzhi pa zhal bsgos gdab pa ni/ gral la 'khod pa rnams la rdo rje rgyal pos: kye hoḥ nyon cig skal ldan 'dir tshogs rnams/ brtson 'grub dang pas sgo gsum gus gyis la: 'khrul pa'i gtam dang log spyod myos pa'i chang : 'thab rtsod kun co lo lo g.yeng ba dang : nye ring phyogs cha chags sdang phra ma dang*/ tshod yod rngam tshod log lta bag med dang*/ slo chos log spyod log lta rnam g.yeng dang*/ lus ngag des pa'i bya ba thams cad bsdoms: dad gus brtson 'grus nges 'byung dag snang bcas: gsang sngags don ldan bla ma bsten byed cing : kun la gus shing mched la dungs par mdzod: nga yi dkyil 'khor log lta rnam g.yang dang : tshe 'dir sangs rgyas bsgrub pa ma gtogs pa/ thun mong phran tshogs tshams la ma sems shig: 'di 'dre'i dbang chog batshal bas ga la rnyed:

khyod rnams ma lus bsod nams shin tu che: slob dpon gsung la gus pas rtse gcig nyon: bka' las 'das na (230) ngan song gnas su ldung : tshe 'dir sangs rgyas phyir slob dpon spyi bor khur: zhes bsgo zhing spro na sgrub chen spyod tshul dam tshig khe nyen che ba'i bshad pa yang skabs babs bya'o: lnga pa mnga' gsol bstod pa ni spro na ging pa rnams kyis rnga stabs dang bcas bsam min kyang 'di ltar: hūṃ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gtso: thugs rje'i bla ma ngos mtshar can: gang 'dul snang ngor de nyid ston: rgyud grol byang chub lam la 'dzud: dgongs pa lnga ldan gzi brjed che: rang bzhin lhun grub sku gsum zhing : bka' bsrung mthu ldan gzi brjod che: 'di bor phyi ma don du gnyer: bsgrub pa'i mched lcam ngo mtshar che: phyi nang byin rlabs sprin ltar 'thib: smin grol mdzad pa gzi brjod che: zhes mnga' gsol zhing bstod par bya'o: spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'i rim pa la: las gzhung bsrang ba/ rgyab chog phur sgrub/ nyel le bskrad pa/ byin 'bebs: bshags skong : dngos grub blang ba dang drug gong dang po gzhung ba la gnyis las/ dang po la las byang ni: tho rangs sngo drog dgongs mo srid dang bzhi'i: yang na nyin gsum mtshan gsum ste thun drug tu las byang gzhung bsrang zhing sngon 'gro las rig bcu gcig rnams thun kyi thog dang tshogs mchod dus bzhi'am gnyis su bya dgos shing*/ thugs dam bskulpab phyin thun rjes mar byas pas 'thus la/ thun gzhan rnams la dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa nas bshags pa yan gyi bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med ye nas rang gsal bdebs pa'i tshul gyis gzhung bsrang ngo*/ gnyis pa 'dzab bsnyen bya ba la lnga las/ dang po dam bca' ba ni/ hūṃ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dgongs mdzad dang : bla med bka' gsang gsang sngags zab mo'i chos: spros med don gyi snying po thob bya'i phyir:

srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub par bya: rdo rje slob dpon byin gyis brlab tu gsol: snyigs ma lnga bdo dus kyi bstan pa'i mthar: sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdzad pa bdag gis sgrub: dam tshig zung du 'brel ba'i phreng ba la: mched lcam gcig tu 'dus pa'i lu gu brgyud: bla med sangs rgyas ma thob de rid par: lung dang srog gi phyir yang gtong ngo : zhes dam bca'/ gtis pa 'dzab khang dbye ba ni: hūṃ gsang 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: pho brang mtha' dbus med pa yis bde chen 'od kyi gzhal yas su: pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku gsum sku lnga mtshan brgyad bcas: mkhro sde lnga shug 'gro dang : dpa' bo dpa' mo gi yang ka: dam can bka' bstod bsrung ma'i tshogs: skye de chos sku'i klong yangs nas: 'gags med gsung gi sngags sgra sgrog: 'dzab kyi sku gsung gnad nas bskul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas: (231) gnyes bsdus pas dngos grub bdag la thim: bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru ma phyin bar: slog gi phyi yang mi gtong ngo : zhes dang*/ gsum pa 'dzab dgongs dngos la ni bsnyen pa dang*/ bsgrub pa/ las sbyor/ de kho ni nyid kyi bzlas pa dang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen ni/ bdag nyid rta mgrin spyi bo ru: bla ma dpa 'byung sprul pa sku'i: thugs ka'i hrīḥ yi 'od zer gyis: 'phags mchod byin bsdus de nyid la: mos gus dung pas gsol btab pas: sku gsung thugs byin bdag la thim/ zhes bas dmigs gnad gsal btab la bsnyen sngags bzla ste: bsnyen dus bla ma spyi borabasgom sogs kyi don ni/ gtis pa bsgrub pa ni/ bdag nyid rte mgrin snying ga ru : bla ma thod 'phrang yab yum gsal: thugs ka'i hriḥyig sngags 'phrong gis/ 'od kyis rtse gsum spyan drangs thim: mchod bstod dgyes bskyod byin rlabs kyis: sgrib sbyangs sku bzhi'i bdag nyid gyur: ces pas sgrub sngags bzla ste:

glub dus bla ma snying khar bsgom sogs kyi don no: gsum pa las sbyor ni/ bdag nyid rte phag 'khor lo bzhir: rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo yab yum gyi: thugs srog ra ha tsham ri dang : hrīḥ di ya sha'i 'od zer gyis/ zhes rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhis: snang srid bdang bsdus bdag la thim: zhes pas las sngags bzla ste: las sbyor bla ma rang gsal bdag sogs kyi don no: bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi bzlas pa ni: hūṃ rang rig rnam dag thod phreng rtsal: nyon mongs lnga dag sems la ltos: ska lnga lhun grub cer mi dgongs: ye shes lnga ldan ngo mtshan che: hūṃ rang rig rta phag yab yum ste: thabs dang shes rab zung sbrel ba: snang stong dag pa'i rang bzhin can: gnyis 'dzin dag pa ngos mtshar che: hūṃ rang rig gsal mtshan brgyad sku: rnam shes brgyad dag sems la ltos: tshogs brgyad rang grol gcig tu 'dus: yum brgyad chad pa ngo mtshar che: ye shes sngal ldan pa' bo ging : 'byung khams lnga dag mkhas 'gro lnga: thams cad rang byung rang la rdzogs: rang byung rang gsal rang la ltos: lta byed rtog pa rang sar grol: re dgos bltas pas lha mi mthong : ma bltas bzhag pas lha dang mdzal: ma bsgrub bzhag pas brgyas 'grub: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer gyis mthong : rang byung 'dzab kyi sngags sgra sgrogs: zhes pas bskyed cing rtog pa rang sar grol: ro dgos bltas pas lha mi mthong : ma bltas bzhag pas lha dang mdzal: ma bsgrub bzhag pas sangs rgyas 'grub: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer gyis mthong : rang byung 'dzab kyi sngags sgra sgrogs: zhes pas bskyed cing gsal ba'i lha yang ye shes kyi rang rtsal lhun grub tu snang tsham nyid ngo bo ka dag rdzogs pa'i gzhi dbyings las mi 'da' ba chu dang chu dbyer med pa ltar bskyed rdzogs (232) gnyis med kyi dgongs pa bskyang zhing rlung sngags dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje'i bzas pa ci nus su bya'o: bzhi pa stong tshig gi mchod bstod ni:

oṃ gu ru de kha ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+paṃ sra tīts+tsha swā hwaḥnas shasta'i bar dang*/ ma bcos spros bral sho lo ka dang*/ snang ba 'gags sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyi bstod pa bya'o/ lnga pa mthar dzapā bskul dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma yi dag mkhar 'gro dgongs: sogs las byang ltar bya'o/ gtis pa bar chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir yang snying hūṃ gi phur sgrub bya ba ni/ gzhung gi bzlas pa'i rjes su bskyed rim gsal bdebs pa 'di ltar/ hūṃ stong nyid spros bral ngang nyi las: dkyil 'khor lte bar pad ro'i stong : bdag nyid pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: chos nyid mi 'gyur mthing 'od 'bar: zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs ag tshoms 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje 'dzin: phyag yon phur pas dgra snying gzar: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs bsgrad: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol: spyi gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med: mgrin par rte mgrin pad+ma dbang : thugs kar gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: sku mdog phyag mtshan rigs ltar gsal: ska lnga mtshan brgyad mkhro rnams: kun kyang gtso dang mthun pa la: rdo rje gdengs shing phung pa gzir : thams cad phur pa'i tshul du bkod: kun kyang hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing : dam tshig ye shes gnyis med pa: rang nyid chos sku'i klong yangs nas: thams cad rang rigs longs spyod cing : stong nyid sems la dbang bsgyur bas: thams cad sgyu ma'i rol par shar: bzlas pa ni/ lha rnams thams cad rang rang gi: thugs kar nyi stong hūṃ mthing 'bar: de la segs gtad de: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: zhes gatsho bar bzla yang*/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros stong gsum gang : phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang : bla ma yi dam mkhro la: mchod tshogs dpag tu med pa phul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: thams cad tshul 'dus bdag la thim: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ:

zhes ci rigs bzla yang ni 'od 'phros hūṃ rnams las: khro chung mtshon cha dpag med khengs: gdug pa'i bar gcod dgra bgegs rnams: thams cad rdul phran phye mar bzlag: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: ci rigs bzla slar yang stong gsum hūṃ sgra ldir ba yis: phyi snong 'jig rten gzhal yas khang : thams cad chos sku'i rol par shar: ma dag 'khrul pa'i ming yang med: thams cad sgra der ri ri: rgyal mtsho 'khyil zhing ri rab ldeg: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams g.yos: stong gsum 'jig rten 'gul zhing sdeg: bde gshegs rgyal ba sprin bzhin 'thibs: byi rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'bab: mkhro chos skyong 'ja' ltar 'thibs: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub bsdud: lha srin sde brgyad dngangs shig 'dar: bka' nyan las byed srog snying 'gul: bdud dang gdon bgegs byor shing skrag: mi bzod rgya mtsho'i 'grom du 'bres: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ:ci rigs bzla/ de ltar sngags rnams/ rdo rje srin po'i ngur sgra y-is: dbyangs ni 'brug ltar ldir zhing bzlas: zhes dang*/ de ltar drag po'i hūṃ sgra lis: rig pa ngar bskyod snyoms las spang : zhes pa ltar hūṃ dgu sbrel du dbyangs dal brel gyi rte las

(233) drangs te rigs rtsal ngar dang ldan pas bzlas pa'i mthar/ de ltar bskyed cing gsal ba yi/ gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i lha: lhun grub thig le chen po'i sku: rang rig ka dag gzhi dbyings thil: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes rgyab chog phur sgrub 'di nyin nyin ro'i khongs su tshar re byas pas chog go: gsum pa nyul le bskrad pa ni/ brub khung du nyul le'i liṅga bcas la: bden bdar dgug gzhug lan gsum byas: rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas pho ta dang mtshan cha'i char phab pas rul du brlug par gyur par bsams la: drag sngags so bdun bzla zhing phur thun tho bas gzer: ging pa rta mchog rol pa'i pho nyar bskyed la lag na mi spags kyi lcags dang*/ bong mdze'i tho ba thogs pas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing tshogs gral nyul bas dhog /khyad par dpal gyi pho nya kun thub rgyal mo bskul ba ni: hūṃ shar phyosag dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas na: sogs kyis bskul zhing thun gyi char phag pa sogs dus bzhi'am drug tu bya'o: bzhi pa byin dbab pa ni/ spros dang sha chen bsrog/ rnal 'byor pa rnams chas su zhugs shing phyag rgya pad bskor dang mda' dar g.yab cing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te: hūṃ chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong : bde ba chen po'i zhing khams nas: skye med don gyi dngos grub brnyes: snang ba mtha' yas byin phos cig: oṃ rgyon yul gyi shar phyogs ngos: ri ba tha la'i zhing khams nas: snying rje byang soms dngos grub brnyes: thugs rje chen pos byin pho cig: rgya gar nu ba phyogs oṃ rgyan yul: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling nas: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas byin= he ru ka yi gnas bcu'i mchog: bsamal ba tshal gyi ngur khrod nas: yon tan sna tshogs dngos grub= pad+ma sam+bha'i byin= gro khyer yangs pa can gyi gnas: ra ṣa rag ta'i gnas mchog tu: thams cad mkhye+in pa'i dngos grub bsnyen:

blo ldan mchog sred= shar phyogs mgar 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: dga' ba tshal gyi ngur khrod du: khams gsum dbang bsdu dngos grub= pad+ma rgyal po'i= mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i drung : so sa gling gi ngur khrod du: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i= nyi ma 'od zer= yul gyi g+r+ya gar shar gyi phyogs: za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su: bdud padung 'dul ba'i= shākya seng ge'i= dbus 'gyur ma ga ta yi yul: rdo rje gdan gyi byag phyogs su: mu stegs 'dul ba'i= seng ge sgra sgrog= yul gyi mi na bod kyi yul: stag tshang seng ge bsam grub tu: dregs pa tshar bcod= rdo rje gro lo= rgya gar 'gyur yul gyi shar phyogs ngos: bsal ba tshamal gyi dur khrod nas: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi badzad pa'i: badz+ra thod phrong =hūṃ rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs= sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod nas: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas= rat+na thod 'phrong = hūṃ rgya gar yul gyi nub phyogs= pad+ma brtsegs pa'i= khams gsum dbang du sdud= pad+ma thod 'phreng = hūṃ rgya (234) gar yul gyi byang phyogs= ki la ya yi dur khrod du: dgrogs tshar gcod dngos grub= bud+dha thod phreng = byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gis gnas: yang rdzong shol gyi brag phug tu: 'jam dpal sku yi dngos grub= sangs rgyas ye shes= gnas mchog mkhro 'du ba'i gnas: mchim phu gri gu'i dgo gong du : pad+ma gsung gi dngos grub= rgyal ba mchog dbyangs= lho brag snyan gyi dben pa'i gnas: mkhar chu gsang bdang brag phug tu: yang dag thugs kyi dngos grub= nam mkha'i snying po'i: dbus kyi yar lung bden pa'i gnas: sher gyi brag phug gnas mchog tu: bdud rtsi sman gyi= dz+nyā na pu tra= sbas yul rong mo stong gi gnas: sna ring seng ge rdzong gsum du: 'phrin las phur pa'i= mkhar chen mtsha rgyal= mchog gi dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas: sham po gangs kyi ra ba ru: sbod gtong ma me'i= dpal gyi ye shes=

ne mtsho sngags kyi grub pa'i gnas: bsam yas ni sing chu rgyun du: dregs pa kun 'dul= gling seng dpal gyi= rngam sgrog dben pa 'breg gi gnas: g.ya' ma lung gi dben gnas su: drag sngags mthu yi= bai ri tsa nas= rang byung byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gnas: bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum du: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dngos grub= chos rgyal yab sras= lhun grub dbyings kyi pho brang du: sku gsung thugs yon 'phris kyi: dngos grub rnam bzhi rtsol mdzad pa: yi dam zhi khro'i= mkhar spyod rigs 'dzin bkod pa'i zhing = nyi shu rtsa lnga'i gnas mchog nas: bar chad kun sel= mkhar 'gro dpa' bos= he ru ka yi gnas bcu'i gtso: gnam lcags ma la'i gnas mchog nas: dgra bgegs bcod dngos= bka' bsrung dam can= hūṃ bla med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag chag gis: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor byed pa la: bsgrub pa'i rig 'dzin mched lcam rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du: khyed cag ma lus thams cad kyis: byin rlabs na bun thu lu lu: dngos grub ltar si li li: da lta nyid du byin phob cig: da lta byin chen mi rlobs na: sngon gyi rgyal bas bka' gnang ba'i: dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur ram: sa ma ya la dgongs nas kyang : byin chen da lta rlob tu gsol: gu ru de kha ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma yā hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes dugang bzhi 'i drug tu byin dbab/ gung thun la 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshe 'dzab cung zad dang tshe 'gugs kyang bya/ lnga pa bshags skong bya ba ni/ spyir lta spyod zab mo gzhung bzhin las mi 'dab ba'i pī dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig gi gnas la nan tan bya zhing*/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo dus bzha'aṃ gnyis: chos skyong gtor srung rnams kyi bskang gso gong ltar ram dgong thun la bya zhing*/ phyi gtor cha gsum gyi cho ga dang bshadags rgyud nar mar sgrog cing*/

khyad par tshogs (235) kyi 'khor lo'i mjug tu/ kyai hoḥ bla med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag ni ma rig las dbang gis: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas: bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i dam bcas kyang : ma rigs ma rtogs tshod yod kyis: bka' dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol lo bshags: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub rtsol: ces bshags pa bya/ de ltar sgrub zhag ji tsam bya ba'i ring bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi 'dzab bsnyen rnams sgrub grogs mang tshe nyin mtshan khor yug tu sngags ma chad par thun ri mos bya zhing : brjod len mtshams su yang gsar pa rnams sgrub khang sgor ging pas thun mtshon gyi dhog pa dang rdo rje rgyal po sogs rnal 'byor rnams kyang bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa skad cig kyang mi g.yel ba gal shin ti che/ drug pa sgrub pa chen po'i dngos grub blang ba la gnyis las: dang po thun mong dngos grub blang ba ni/ de ltar bsgrub pa la rtse gcig tu brtson pas dngos nyams rmi lam du gzhung ltar 'grub pa'i rtags dang mtshanam pa bzang po mthong ba'am yang na sgrub chen 'dre 'bag mos slob tsam yin tshe grangs thems pa'i dus der: dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gtsang ma'i gzhi la me tog gi sel ma bkram pa'i dbus su sngar gyi dngos grub rten bhan+dha 'god pa'i mtha' bskor du: phye dang mngar gsum zho dmar gyis sbrus pas las bzhi'i 'bring rgyas ril bus bskor ba/ rin po che'i snod du gsare g.yu la sogs rin po che sna tshogs: lam sa mar 'thud/ 'bras chan/ khur ba/ zho la du/ zhing thog sna tshogs: su ra sogs bzang bcas btung pa'i bya brag tshogs tshad bshams/ bsgrub pa po rnams rgyan dang chas gos bzang po bstar/ dngos grub kyi gnas la yid rtse gcig pas/ las byang gi bgegs gtor btang zhing mtshams bcad/ byin phag nas*/ dngos grub bskul ba ni/ ring nyid dkyil 'khor gyibadag po'i thugs nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltu 'phras pas bla ma yi dag mkhro'i tshogs dang khyad par mkhro dpa'o srung ma dam can rnams la phogs pas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi rnam pa thams can rdzas rnams kyi mtshon par mngon sum du bskyal bar gyur par bsams la/

spos bsreg/ hasta g.yab/ bdud rtsi sbreng*/ rol mo dang bcas hūṃ chos sku skye med ka dag spros dang bral: 'gag med rang gsal longs sku'i rtsal snang las: 'gro ba'i don mdzad gzugs skur sprul pa yis: skye rgu'i sems can ma lus don bya'i phyir: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob la: yang gsang bla ma'i dbang bar dam pa 'dir: skal na rjes 'jug rnams la thugs rjes bzung : zhes dang*/ hūṃ bla ma yi dam mkhro'i thugs dam bskang: dad ldan skal ldan bu yi tshig ni: mchog dang mthun mong 'phrin las rnam bzhi dang : tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor srid dang nor: dngos grub mchog gi dam pa rtsal du gsol: zhes bskul zhing : dngos grub bsdu ba ni/ slang yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams yab yum snyoms par (236) zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams la phogs pas dgyes pa bskyed/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub tshur 'dus bdag la tim pas gsal zhing brten par byas/ rdzas rnams la thim pas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi dongs grub kun gyi snying por 'khyil bar gyur par mos la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya sid+dhi hūṃ: zhes brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzla/ zhar byung phyag len ltar tshe dzapā bzla ba ni/ tshe bum rin po che'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid rdzogs shing rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa'i dbus su: pad+ma nyis rigs gyi lte bar seng khri pad zla nyis gdan gyi stong du mgon po tshe dpag med dmar po/ 'dab bzhi'i shar du glang po'i khri la rdo rje tshe dpag med dkar po: lhor rte khri la rat+na tshe dpag med ser po/ nub tu rma bya'i khri la pad+ma tshe dpag med dmar po/ byang du shang shang gi khri pa la karma tshe dpag med ljang gu/ de rnams longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lung can mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin cing dho rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

phyi rol 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir lā pya ma dkar mo mā le ma mthing skye gī ti ma dmar dmar mo nirti ma ljang mo rnams dang*/ mtshams bzhi puṣ+pe ma dkar mo dhū pa ma ser mo a lo ke ma dmar mo gan+dhi ma ljang mo rnams dang*/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags grog drel bu ma bzhi ste/ de thams cad kyang lha'i na chung lang tsho gsar gar pa rgyan gyis kun nas spras nas spras shing mdam dar dang bum pa 'dzin pa skyil klung phyed pa'i gar rtabs kyi mad bla la gnas pa'o: thams can kyi spyi bor oṃ/ 'grin par ā: thugs kar hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyi pas thugs srog rnari la thim: bsrungs pas lus la gzi mdangs bskyed: bcings pas rdo rje lug gu brgyud: mi bsheg rdo rje lu gu brgyud: mi bshig rdo rje'i lcags srig 'dra: 'i med tshe yi dbang mchog 'di: bdag cag rnams la bskur du gsol: ces tshe 'gug dngos grub len pa ni gong gi bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas: hūṃ bla ma yi dam mkhro gdongs su gsol: dang po ye shes lha rnams kyis: bar du bsnyen pa mthar phyin sgrub: de ltar bdag dang dbyer med cig: skye rings dang po shar du nyi: rdo rje srin po'i nam langs khad: bzlas brjod snying po grangs kyang thems: dngos grub rtsol ba'i dus la babs: rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs ka nas: byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phros: skal ldan bdag la dngos grub rtsol: oṃ āḥhūṃ:bh+ruṃ nri sarba sid+dhi pha la hūṃ: zhes dngos grub rdzas kyi phud dkyil 'khor la 'bul zhing : rnal 'byor pa rnams rol/ lha dang bdag nyis med bde ba chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin dngon grub rnam pa gnyis la dbang phyor bar gyur par bsam/ phyag len ltar tshe dbang len pa ni/ bum nang lha tshe+ogs kyi thugs ka'i 'on kyi brten g.yo'i tshe bcud bsdus nas phyag gi bum par bskyil ba khol zhing lud pas rang gi las gang nas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku gyur par bsam/

bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ tshe bum rin chen gzhal yas khang: nang bcud tshe mchog rigs lnga bzhugs: skal ldan bu dbang bskur bas: mche med sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ kā ya a yu dz+nyā na hūṃ bh+ruṃ a bhi ṣīñca hūṃ: thod pa mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥthod pa mtshan ldan ka pā la: snying po mchi med bdud rtsis bkang : skal ldan bu la sbyin par bya: mchi mde gsung gi= āḥwaka a dz+nyā na= gtor ma snying khar bzhag la: hūṃ:gtor ma rin chen sprungs pa'i gter: snying po ye shes bcud lngas gtams: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med thugs kyi= hūṃ tsit+ta ā yu dz+nyā na= zhes dbang blang ngo*/ gnyis pa mchog gi gi dngos grub len pa ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par logs su byed pa dbang len pa por byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas lngar oṃ āḥhūṃ hriḥhā'i yi ge lnga lnga gsal ba'i gnas gsum las sku snang brnyen gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan/ khyad par 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas dbang bzhi thob: sgrib bzhi sbyangs/ sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon du byas par gyur par bsam la thal lo sbyar te dungaba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ gsang ba bla med yang gsang mchog gi gnas: mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub kun gyis gter: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang ba mchog gi rdzas: dngos grub rgya mtsho (237) bdag la rtsal du gsol: dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams mkha' dbyings nas: yang gsang byang chub sems kyi bcud: skal ldan bu yi dbang bskur mchog thob nas: sku gsum 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par shog: ces dang hrīḥ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas: sogs kyi mthar rtsa sngags la/ kā ya sid+dhi sogs sham bu btags pa'i dzapā blaza bzhin par bum pa la sogs pa'i sgrub rdzas rnams gnas gsum du gtug cing bum chu dang thod chang myang*/

me log gi thig le las srin lag gis dpral ba dang snying gar byugs la/ sgrub rdzas ye shes lha'i rang bzhin bdag dang dbyer med du thim pas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dang mi gnyis pa'i mchog gi dngos grub dam pa thob par gyur par bsam mo/ gzhan don du dbang bskur ba ni/ rtsa ba'i dbang chog rdzogs chen dbang phreng sogs te rgyas bsdus gang ltar byed kyang gter gzhung las shes par bya'o/ spro na dngos grub kyi rdzas bgo ba dang*/ 'bul tshig rol po gtor ma bgo ba ni/ gtor ma cha gsum du byas pa'i cha gcig sbyin bsregs gi rdzas su bya/ cha gcig phyi rol du gtor skyong gi rgyur bzhag: cha gcig rigan po che'i rdza bum rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas mtshan par lnga mtshan lnga dang lhan du rtsal ba nam mkha' brjod kyi sngags rgyas rin po che mi zad gter gyi longs spyod du byin gyis brlabs te/ hūṃ 'phyung ba lnga ni sangs rgyas zhing : sa yi lha mo khyo zhig: bstan pa mi 'gyur bkris phyir: sgrub pa rdzas kyi gtor sbod do: sba ba'i par bcug la hūṃ snying po rin chen dpar sna 'bru: spos dang sman snang dam rdzas sogs: yi bzhin nor bu'i gtor sbas pas 'dir 'dus skal ldan pho mo rnams: bla med byang chub ma thob par: skye rga na 'chi'i bsdul rnams: zab gtor 'di sbas byin rlabs kyis: de rnams ma lus byang gyur cig: nad dang mu gi mtshon la sogs: 'jigs pa brgyad las thar ba dang : tshe dang bson nams 'phel bar shog: dug lnga dug gsum rnam dag nas: sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa dang: ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog: bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa rang gad nas: lam nga ba bcu mthar phyin te : skye med chos sku mthar phyin shog: phyag rgya lnga yi rgyas btab bo: bstan pa thamar g+r+yas bkris shog: mi 'gyur bstan pa gnas par mdzod: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃ: zhes sba'o/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/

skabs 'dir 'phrin las bzhi'i byin bsreg gi zhi ba tsum 'grub na bya: las byang gi cho ga lhag chad gyur pa dang : sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ de ring nyid la gshegs nas kyang : sogs kyi rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol: skye med chos sku'i ngang nyid las: sogs dang*/ hūṃ dus gsum rgyal ba dgongs su

(238) gsol yang gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: chos ska spros pa med lags kyang : sems can bla med 'dren pa'i phyir: mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir byon te: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs nas: sems can don kun mdzad nas kyang : slar yang skye med klong du bsdu: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ: zhes ting 'dzin sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas: a kā ro brjod bzhin pas rul tshon rdo rjes mtha' nas dbus su bsdu zhing phyogs la lha mtshan cung zad 'gor bkod: lhag ma rnams bum par bslug thig shul dbyi zhing dbyangs gsal dang yig bag+r+ya bzla slar yang hūṃ snang stong dbyer med lha yi sku: sogs kyi rte mgrin skur lda/ dam rdzas rnams bsdu zhing*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i skal pa'i rgyas khro bcu'i phur pa dbyung zhing*/ oṃ ru lu s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes spyan ma'i sngags bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur rtse bklu zhing phur khung la gtaur ro gsum pa mtshams 'grol ba la gnyis las: dang po sgo byang bsdu ba ni/ sgo byang gnyis la mchod gtor bsham zhing byin gyis brlabs nas: mchod gtor phul la*/ hūṃ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi: sku yi 'od zer dgra bgegs 'dul: dngos grub rgya mtshor bskyil byas nas: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar phyin las: skye med chos skur gshegs nas kyang : thugs rjes mgro ba'i don mdzad zhu: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li mum: zhes dang*/ hūṃ sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul nas: bcom ldan chos rje lha lha yi bka' rtsal ltar: deng 'dir bgegs bsrungs bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pas: khro chen 'jigs byed dbang chen rta mgrin dpal: skye med chos kyi dbyings su gshegs nas kyang : slang yang thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad zhu: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa badz+ra mum: so sor brtan bzhugs bya zhing sgo byang bsdu:

gnyis pa rgyal thob bsdu ba ni/ mtho so so'i rtsal mchod gtor bshams shing byin gyis brlabs nas hūṃ: shar phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen chen yul 'khor bsrung : rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: rgyal pa'i pho brang shar phyogs 'di bzung nas: bar chad bsrung zhi bsgrub pa mthar thon pas: gtang rag mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: rang rang gnas dang rten la gshegs su gsol: oṃ dh+ri tri raṣ+ṭ+wa ye swā hā: zhes dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras rten la brten bzhugs byas to mtho gshegs: de bzhin du gzhan gsum la yang*/ hūṃ lho phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen 'phags skye so: rgya ba'i spyan sngar5 rgyal ba'i phrong lho phyogs= bar chad bsrung zhing = gtar rag mchod gtor= rang rang = oṃ bai rū kā ya swā hā: zhes dang*/ hūṃ nub phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po spyan mi bzang : rgyal ba'i spyan sngar= rgyal ba'i phrong nub phyogs= bar chad bsrungs shing = gtar rag= rang rang = oṃ bai ru pā k+ṣa ya swā hā: zhes dang hūṃ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras: rgyal pa'i spyan sngar= rgyal ba'i pho brang byang phyogs= bar chad bsrungs = (239) gtar rag= rang rang gnas dang rten la gshegs su gsol: bai shra ma ye swā hā: bzhi pa rdul tshon gshegs pa ni/ rul tshon gyi bum pa dpon slob thams cad kyis rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i bkur stis chu klung chen po'i 'gram du spyan drangs la: klu gtor rgyas bsdus gang rigs btang zhing 'phrin bcom gyi khyad par/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas deng 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon rin po che'i rang bzhin 'di rnams bdag gir mdzad panas mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dang khyed par pa phyogs 'dir bkris bde legs dpal 'byor phus sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing g+r+yas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod gsol sbyar zhing rul tshon chu bor dor/

bum pa chus bkang ba nang du 'ongs te gnas khang phyi nang thams cad la bsangs gtor bya'o/ lnga pa gtang rag 'bul ba la bzhi las/ dang po yon 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje rgyal po khri stan mthon por bzhugs su gsol ba ci 'byor gyi yon grol mthar phyin zab mo'i lam la rten: sku gsum rang la sprod pa sku dren che: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di la dam bcas nas: skye bu ba kun tu mi 'bral thugs rjes su bzung : yang nas yang du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob: 'jig rten 'di na sku drin bgran zla med: yon dang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba med lags pas: tshul bzhin ma 'byor bzod par mdzad du gsol: stong gsum gser gyi bkang nas phur lags kyang : sku dren bcu zad cim yang mi 'khor zhing longs spyod ngan las rgyu rkyen cher ma grub: byams pa'i thugs rjes dgongs par mdzad du gsol: ces skyems drangs shing phyag bya'o/ gnyis pa mar me smon lam ni: dpon slob thams cad kyi lag tu mar me bzung la: hūṃ gsang rkun rkyain dang bar chad med pa dang : tshe dang bson nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang : bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par shog: bkrin can gyi rdo rje slob dpon dang : rgyal thebs thugs sras shes rab gzungs ma dang : dam tshig gcig tu 'brel ba'i mchod lcams rnam: mi 'bral bde chen zhing du 'tshobs par shog: gal te las kyi 'khor bar 'khyams srid na: snang gsal mar med mes rigs drugs skyes sgo bcad: bsams bzhin 'gro ba'i don du lus blangs nas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob par shog: yangs sngags bla med dbang mchog thob pa'i mthus: (240) sgrib gnyis rnam dag pa lab mthar phyin nas: skye med zhing dang 'kho min rnga yab gling : rnam dag lhun grub 'bras bu thob par shog: ces brjod do: gsum pa lus bsrung ba ni/ rang nyid dbang chen rta mchog rol pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis zhu lugs su ga g.yogs te cis kyang mi bshig par gyur pas bsams pa'i ngang nas stong nyid mi dmigs pas sargyas btab la

oṃ badz+ra kro dha sarma ta kri ha ya gṛ kha hu lu hu hūṃ phaṭaḥ hūṃ skye med chos sku rdo rje'i 'i ngang : sus kyang 'jig par mi nus te: stong nyid nam mkha'i ngo bo la: rgyal ba rnams kyi 'joms mi nus: bar gcod gegs rnams cis mi brlag: hūṃ:hūṃ hūṃ zhes go bgo'o/ bzhi pa shis brjod ni me tog mthor zhing*/ e la hoḥ gdod nas rnam dag ka dag dmigs med klong : snang srid 'khor 'das kun gyi 'byung gnas dpal: skye med rnam dag chos sku bkris shog: bud+dha thod 'phreng sangs rgyas kun gyi gatsho: gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes sku: thams cad yongs rdzogs po'i bkris shog: pad+ma thod 'phreng rgyal ba'i gsung mnga' ba: 'dod chags rnam dag sror rtog ye shes sku: khams gsum dbang du bsdu pa'i bkris shog: rdo rje thod 'phreng rgyal ba'i thugs mnga' ba: zhes sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku: nad gdon rkyen rnams zhi ba'i bkris shog: rigs chen thod 'phreng rgyal ba'i yon tan zhing : nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i bkris shog: karma thod phreng rgyalaba'i 'phris mnga': phrag donag rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku: dgra bgregs tshar gcod drag po'i bkris shog: rdo rje slob dpon rgyal thebs kurmā ging : mchod dang lcam drag gsang sngags thob pa'i mthus: sprul sku 'gro 'dul yongs kyi bkra shis shog: ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma dang : gtor bdag bka' nyan ma lus thams cad kyis: phyi nang rkyen rnams bzlogs pa'i bkris shog: ces bkris gzhan yang bya'o: drug pa gtor ma bathang ba la gsum las: dang po gtor 'bul ni: sngar gyi gtor ma cha gcig dang : chos kyong spyi sgos: chad mod: brten skyong gi gtor ma rnams mañji'i khar bshams: smra raka sgron/ bsgrub pa'i rig lhag ma btson du 'dzin pa yod na las byang gi lhag ma btang*/

thugs dam bskul ni zhag gsum tsham du bsgrub pa po rnams gnas khang de nyid du las byang tshar re tshogs kyi 'khor lo glu gar dang bcas dga' ston rgya cher bya zhing phyi mi rnams rim gyis 'phrad pa sogs bya'o: gsum pa bsngo ba bya ba ni/ gsang sngags bla med bsgrub pa'i dge ba 'dis: pha mas gatsho byas 'gro ba ma lus kun: sgrib gnyis kun byang tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas: sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: gsang sngags bla med bstan pa dar rgyas shing : (241) chos byed rnams kyi 'akrin las mthar rgyas nas: sangs rgya bstan pa yur ring gnas gyur cig: bsnyen grub las sbyor bsgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis: yul phyogs rnam kun bkris bde legs nas: ma 'ongs pa 'dir su stod mi rnams kyang : bar chad med cing bsgrub pa mthar phyin shog: zhes dang*/ gzhan yang bstod smon bkris kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o: phyogs su rgyal kun ga'adus pa thod 'phring rtsel: gang de'i thugs grub 'chi med lam yangs las/ chog sgrigs dngos grub gtor mdzod nyid byed dbang*/ don gnyer yid 'odad pad+mo bzhad par byas/ dpa gling zab gter yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal: byi don rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs mchod 'di/ ma gtogs rang bzo'i dbul ba rgyun chad nas/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub ci gar spyod gyur cig/ dge 'dis rje btsun bla ma zhabs brtan cing : gsang chen theg mchog bstan pa rin chen 'di: dar zhing rgyas nas 'gro kun ma lus pa: bla ma o rgyan go 'phang myur thob shog: de ltar gur ru'i thugs sgrub nor bu rgya mtsho'i grub khog dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di yang 'brong du gdon nas bla ma dkon mchog byang chub bzang pos ring mo zhig nas dag pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas nan tan chen po'i bskul ma yang yang byung ba ma zad rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa'i sko chen por 'dug pa mthong nas rigs kun khyab bdag rje btsun bla ma bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal bstan 'dzin chos kyi kyi rgyal mtshan nam ming gzhan rigs 'dzin mthu stobs 'od zer gyis sna tshogs zhes pa chu khams mgyogs 'gro'i lor yal ga'i ri dwags gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa zhes tshos bcu'i tshogs 'khor nyin 'bri rdzong bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig theg mchog rtser grub pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan 'gror sman pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

sarba maṅgalam/ (242) (wā) ༄༅/ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du badz+ra ril bu sgrub lugs lhan thabs thar pa'i lam bzang bzhugs so/ dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ mkhyen brtse nus gzugs o rgyon rdo rje 'chang : snyigs dus 'gro ngor bshes gnyen mchog gi gar: bsgyur mdzad pad+ma'i mtshan nyin de la bdud*/ 'dir bshad par byas la gnyis/ badz+ra ril bu sbyar tshul dang*/ grub tshul lo/ dang po sbyar ba'i tshul la khungs dang*/ sbyar lugs/ 'god thabs gsum mo: dang po ni bla ma nor bu rgyal mtsho'i gzhung gi skye bdun sgrub pa de nyid sgrub rdzas kyi gzhi lug dkar gyi dbang po lnga/ don snying lnga klad pa mtshan ma brgyungs pa sogs phyi nang gi sha tshang bar/ gatsho bor gter byen skye bdun gyi sha rus dge slong grub thob kyi sku sha sogs sha'i rigs dang*/ byang sems dkar dmar gdung rus dbu los mtshon byin rten gang 'dzem/ rin chen sna tshogs/ 'bru snang chu sna sman sna 'o na soms kyi mtshon sbyar thabs byin rlabs rab gnas lag len mthong brgyud zhal bzhes la brten dgos pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i ril bu'i lha thugs rje chen po dang*/ sngags (243) yig drung dang ha ra pañca yin zhing*/ lha sngags ting 'dzin cho ga phyag bzhes dang ldan par nyams su blangs na gzhung nas phan yon dpag med 'byung pa sogs gsungs pa las 'dir skye bdun ril bu gu ru rin po cher bskyed pa dang*/ sngags badz+ra bzla ba gzhung du dngos sug ma gsungs kyang*/ mi rung ba ma yin par mthong nas kha bsgyur te bkod pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir gong gi skye bdun sha ril dam pa gong ma rnams kyi sgrub pa'i phab rgyun lab brten nas sbyar lugs ni*/ nas gro 'bras/ til srani dkar sogs gtsang zhing zhing lhad med par rjen btags sam cung zad rngod pa zhib tu btags pa'i gzhi ma byas te/ gser dngul zangs sogs rin po che sna tshogs 'dul ma dang*/

bzang po drug gi gatsho byas dug rigs min pa'i sman sna tshogs: dug ma gtogs pa'i me tog sta tshogs/ gnas yul bzang po rnams kyi sa dho shing la sogs pa'i phye ma/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sha rus gang rnyed dang*/ gong gsal sel med gong ma rnamasakyi bsgrub pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ chos sman la sogs pa'i phabs rgyun ci 'dzom dang*/ bla ma gong ma nang sel pa rnams kyi gdung rus/ dbu los mtshon dad rten ci 'dzom zhib par btags la bsres/ mngar gsum dang*/ chu mig gangs mtsho chen/ khron pa sogs kyi chu sna gang 'dzom/ ba ra mdzo 'bri lugs dkar rnams kyi 'o mas legs par sbrul pa'i rim bu che chung ji ltar 'tshams pa gas srub ser khor sogs med par dril la rims bcags legs par bya/ skam na tsan dan dmar po'i lde gu'am/ mtshal zhun sogs sha ka ra'i khu bas dam rtsi byas pa'i na bza' legs par gsol zhing ril bcags sogs snum zhing 'tsher ba 'od dang ldan par bya'o: gsum pa ni/ ril bu legs par tsham zin pa dang sgrub khog dngos grub gter mdzod kyi sa'i tsho ga nas rim par dkyil 'khor bzheng ba rdo rje'i glus bskul ba grub nas slob dpon gyi mdun du stogs kyi khar ril bu dang*/ rin po che'i bum pa gas chag med pa/ bum gos ze srog rigs lnga sogs dgos pa'i rams 'du byas ril bum pa so sor me chu me chu rlung gsum gyis sbyangs/ gu gul gyis 'dug yungs kar gyis brab cing rte mgrin sngags dang hūṃ bzhi sogs drag sngags kyi bgegs bskrad/ ril bu dril bur bslug cing rdo rjes cing bcad pa'i 'jal ba bum pa ma gang tsam bslug bum pa'i khar 'khor lo/ zhalabs la pad+ma phyogs bzhir shar nas rdo rje rin po che: pad+ma gyam rnams bris/ bum pa'i kha dar ras gtsang mas bsdum pa tshon skud kyis bsdam zhing rdo rje rgyal gri gyis rgyas gdab za 'og gis na bza': mgul 'chings zer srog lnga pa bya zhing*/

yub pa'i khar rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang cod pan btags/ dkyil 'khor gyi dubs su khra'i khar bum pa bkod/ bum steng gzungs thag lnga btags pa'i bdus ma slob (244) dpon ngos dang*/ gzhan ma phyogs bzhir drangs shing*/ brtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lnga pa rdzas 'god dang*/ drug pa 'jug pa rnams sgrub kho dkyus bzhin bya'o/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i tshul la/ bdag mdun bsgom bzlas rin bu'i sgrub brtags/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum mo/ dang po ni/ thog mar rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dzapā kyi mthar thug pa'i bar bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med du byas/ slar ril bu'i bum pa mdun du phye nas/ sgrub na sgom stabs bde ba'i gsal 'debs pa ni/ bdag nyid dbang chen lhan tshogs gsal ba'i mdun/ skye bdun pho brang phyi brang phyi ni bum pa la/ nang ni rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rgyan dang bcas/ mtshan nyid kun ldan snang la rang bzhin med/ 'ja' zer dod phung 'khrigs pa'i klong yangs su/ dam tshig sgrub rdzas ril bu re re bzhin/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan stong du/ hrīḥyig dkar po ring cha tshogs drag bcas/ 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma 'byung gnas log brgyud byis pa'i tshul/ sku mdog dkar ma dmar mdangs gzi brjod 'bar/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pa bhan+dha mnyam gzhag bdud rtsis bkang*/ dbu la pa paṇa zhu rgod ldem dar sna lnga'i/ cod paṇa me long 'od zer 'phro ba gsol/ phod chen mthing ka chos gos ber smug mnabs/ snyan dang phyag zhabs mgul rkod la sogs par/ gser gyi rgyan cha sna tshogs mdzes shing brjod*/ rdo rje skyil klung bgying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭāṃ rtse gsum bsgreng*/ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma las 'dus pa'i sku/ snang la ma grub chu zla 'ja' ltar gsal/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing mtshan las/

'od 'phros pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ pad 'byung ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur*/ hūṃ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ nas byin gyi rlob phyir gshegs su gsol/ zhes tshig bdun ma lan gsum brjod dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam ye gnyis su med gyur*/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi rnam sprul te: sogs sho lo ka dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā nas shasta'i bar dang*/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta khā hiḥ zhes brjod ma bcos spros bral sogs kyi sho la kas bstod/ bum pa'i lha rnams thugs kar zla ba'i steng*/ hūṃ mthing mtha' mar sngags 'phreng g.yas su 'khor/ 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkhro dang*/ chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad/ oṃ rgyan gu ru'i sku'i rnam pa ru/ kha char bu yug 'tshub ltar spyan drangs nas: bum nang lha la sib thim gyur pas/ lha rnams byin rlabs gzi 'od bar 'bar zhing*/ zhal nas gsang sngags yig 'bru bcu gnyis pa/ 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba ltar sgraug cig/ rdo rje'i gar stabs sna tshogs mdzad par gyur/ zhes bsgom la gzungs thag dbus ma slob dpon dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i bzungs thag dbang thob cing dam tshig la

(245) gnas pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor pa re res drod ma yal bar bzung*/ gzhan yang sgrub grogs rnams dang bcas pas nyin mtshan thun drug gi thun bzhir smras bcad kyi ngang nas badz+ra ku ru'i sgra skad cig kyang ma chad par nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bzla ba dang*/ gong gi thun de rnams su rgyab mchog phur sgrub/ nyul le 'dul ba dang*/ byin dbab pa sogs rtse ba'i sgrub khong gi dngos gzhi drug rnams nan tan chad med pa bya/ bsgrub pa po rnams yig brgya bzlas pa'i gzungs chus khrus yang yang bya dgos te khrus bum gnyis sgrub tshul ni/ bum pa gtsang ba'i nas rgyun 'babs kyi chus sub gtis bkang*/ bum rdzas bslug bum gos mgul chings lha'i mdog mthun can kha rgyan dang bcas pa nye logs su bkod la hor sems bu pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las skang cig gis/ phyi ni bum pa nang gzhal yas/ dbus su pad zla'i gdan steng du/ hūṃ yig dkar po gsal ba las/ 'od 'phros 'phags mchod sems can gyi/ sgrib sbyangs tshul 'dus yongs gyur pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku dog dkar/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas dril bu dkur bsten cing*/ dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ hūṃ yig dkar po yig brgyas bskor/ sngags bzlas sku dang sngags 'phreng las/ bdud rtsi dkar po 'o rgyun ltar/ babs pas bum gang bar gyur/ zhes bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa bzla'o/ rnam 'joms bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ phyi ni bum pa nang g.yas/ dbus su hūṃ yig 'bar ba las/ rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgya gri/ g.yon pa dril 'dzin rgyan gyis spras/ ye shes me yi klong na bzhugs/ thugs kar nyid dbus hūṃ mthing mthar/ sngags kyi phring ba g.yas su 'khor/ bdag gi gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/

sa bon sngags phreng thams cad las/ bdud rtsi rgyun chad med pa babs/ bum pa rab tu gang bar gyur/ zhes bsgom la/ na maḥtsan dan badz+ra kro dha ya sogs gzungs sngags bzla'o/ sgrub khog gi bum pa sta gon skabs zhar la sgrub cing slar sgrub mi so so byas kyang legs so gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i rtags bar 'bring tha gsum bsnyen sgrub spyi dang*/ khyed par skye bdun sha'i sgrub thabs nas gsungs pa rnams ngos brtan po byung gi bar du rtse gcig tu bsgrubs so/ gsum pa ni/ rtags mtshan nam mos slob tsam gyi zhag grangs thems pa'i tshe tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang pos dkyil 'khor pa la mchod/ sgrub khog gi thun mong dngos grub dang*/ mchog gi dbang blang ba'i mjug rim bu'i bum pa slob dpon rang nyid kyi dbang len sa sogs (246) spro na bya'o/ ril bu'i bum lhar mchod bstod bzod gsol byas nas/ ril bu'am ye shes rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa ni ril bu so sor thim/ ngo bo gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ rnam pa dam rdzas myong grol lil bur gyur/ zhes bum pa zhal phye ril bu myong*/ 'phel kha brtagags nas longs spyad/ ril ba 'byung ba bzhi la sbyang ba sogs phyogs med gzhan don du spol zhing 'gro ba thams cad gu ru'i skur grol ba'i smon lam rgya chen so gdab*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i phan yon ni sha ril sgrub pa'i gzhung dang de'i gsal byed gter pad+ma gling pas mdzad pa sogs las rtogs par bya/ rjes kyi bya ba gtor ma bgo ba sogs drug rnams sgrub khog dkyus bzhin bya bas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ de ltar skye bdun ril bu gu rur bsgom pa dang sngags badz+ra bzla ba bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i gzhung du dmigs bsal ma gsungs kyang*/ mi rung ba min pa dang*/ o rgyan gu ru nyid kyis zhal gyis 'ches pa ltar snyigs ma'i dus 'dari bdo 'bangs 'gro la rgyal ba gzhin las bkrin che thugs rjes byin rlabs may+ra ba sogs khyed 'phags bla na ma mchis shing*/

rang phyogs bla slob rnams kyang badz+ra bum sgrub la thugs bzhed che bas bum sgrub mdzad mkhan yod pa rnams kyang gzhung du kha gsal med pas phyag len rang bzo las tshad ldan mi 'dug pa'i nyes pa 'gogs phyir du rang gi bgyid 'dun yod pa'i stong bla mkhyen mang du thos pa'i blo can dge slong gu ṇa kā ras kyang 'di lhu zhing byung na legs tshul zer ba ltar 'bri ban bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan nam gu ru 'dus pa rtsal gyi lcags khams sprul gyi lor dkyil 'khor zla'i dkar phyogs kyis bzang po gnyis pa'i tshos la sbyar pa'i ye ge pa ni gnam 'khod riṃ gro pa rat+na dwa nas dgyis pa 'dis kyang 'gro ba sems can can thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur cig/ sarba maṅgalam/ (247) (zha) ༄༅// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi cho bad klag cho ga ma bzhugs so// phyogs dang g+r+yal kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rigs brgya'i khyab bdag pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i bdud rtsi sman sgrub kying ngag 'don klag chog mar bkod par bya ste/ de yang lugs 'dir 'khrol phye ril bu gsum ka rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pas/ 'dir 'khrol phye gnyis las dang po ni nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgrub dngos grub gter mdzed kyi khog phub dgos te/ sta gon rnams tshar nas lding khri thog gnyis ma ltu'i steng du rtse ba'i dkyil 'khor bum pa sgrub rdzas rnams cad*/ 'og mar pad+ma da'ab brgyad kyi steng mañji'i khar ka ṭo ra thod pa lnga tshom shong ba 'brus bkang ba krab shom dang*/ mthar mchod gtor rgyan rdzas bshams sa sogs gzhung gi 'god tshig rnams zin phral/ bsgrub pa po rnams gzung ma dngos sam der btags des rigs tsham dang bcas mos shing thod chang thogs te slob dpon la phyogs par bsgrengs/ gzhan gyi 'bul tshigs e ma khyod ni bde ba che:

bde chen dpal (248) chen he ru ka: bde gshegs rnams kyis bde chen lam: bde ba'i dbang phyug bde rtsol mdzod: byang chub chen po yang dag don: bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol: phung po khams dang skye mchod rnams: ye nas lhun grub chen po ste: gnas pa ngo yang sprad du gsol: bde chen gsang ba'i rig ma 'di: rnal 'byor dbang phyug che la 'bul: rang snang zhing khams dag pa ste: dpal ldan rdo rje yab la 'bul: zhes lan gsum bya'o: bla mas lan du 'id skad do: kye hoḥ skal ldan rigs mchog bdag la gson: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: bu rnams 'jug par nus lags sam: gsang ba'i dam tshig thub lags sam: snying po'i don ni bsgom nus sam: gsang ba byang chub phyag rgya dang : 'phrin las yongs grol phyag rgya dang*/ dam tshig bcud ldan phyag rgya dang : phyag rgya bzhi brten nus sam: phur khams skye mched grol nus sam: ces lan gsum dri bar bya'o: de nas slob ma khas blang ba 'di skad de: kye hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: yang dag g.yang ba byang chub lam: gsang ba yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: bdag rnams 'jug par spro lags kyis: bla mas gsang sngags lam ston cig: ma rig 'khor ba'i sgo bcad 'tshal: ces lan gsum zhu bar bya'o: gsang ba las kyi phyag rgya mas: srin lag g.yon pas bzung byas la: bla ma nyid la 'phul bar bya*/ phyag 'tshal dad mos kus gsum bya: bla ma yab yum spyi bor bsgoms: ngag tu 'di skad zhu ba 'bul: sa saca: kye hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gsang ba rgyas pa phyag rgya mo: rdo rje'i rigs mchog dkar 'jam mdzes: rin chen rigs mchog ser la rgyas: pad+ma'i rigs mchog dbang dang ldan: las kyi rigs mchog drag rtsal ldan: bud+dha'i rigs mchog mthing 'od 'bar: yang dag gsang ba'i thabs la mkhas: sher rab chen mo'i lus 'chang ma: theg pa chen po'i don la brtson: brtson 'grus chen mo'i lus 'chang ma: chos nyid don la 'gyur ba med:

bsam gtan chen mo'i lus 'chang ma: 'jig rten log pa'i sems dang bral: tshul khrims chen mo'i lus 'chang ma: sems can rnams la brtse ba can: sbyin pa chen mo'i lus 'chang ma: nyon mongs thabs shes 'gyur ba med: bzod pa chen mo'i lus 'chang ma: shes rab yum gyi rig ma 'di: blo che khog yangs byang sems ldan: lus 'jam skod phra nu ma 'bur: dri zhim skad snyan yid 'ong ma: gsang sngags gsang ba'i lum du rung : khyer cig dpa' bo chen pos khyer: zhes lag gsum 'bul bar bya: dris lan rnams song rjes: de nas gzung ma'i phyag sngon du 'gro bas sman snod kā pa la thog ste: hūṃ 'chi med rang byung rtags kyi bdud rtsi 'di : rnal 'byar mched kyis rtag tu bsten par rigs: (249) rtags 'di med na dbang phyug sras ma yin: dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga so su la yod: de don gnyis med lnga so sus brnyes pa: dbang phyug chen po'i sras yin bdud rtsi gsol: zhes brjod cing sman bsdu ba'am phyag len la skabs 'dir mtshon byed bsdus nas: sngon nas 'du bya ba dang bsre dgos te: rtsa ba brgyad dang*/ lo ma stong du rnam par dbye ba la sogs pa'i sman gyi ngos bza'ung tshul dang sbyor tshul sogs lag len mtham dag gsang cheg myur lam sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa'i sman sgrub lag len zin bris mang dag yod pa rnams khog tu chub par byas nas: de yang byang sems mi sha snam rtsa ba'i sde mtshan kha dog dkar ba/ ro ska ba sder chags kyi sha rnams dubs kyi thod par blug pa sogs gzhung pyi dang mthun par thod pa so sor bgod cing dar dmar po kho na'am rigs mthun gyi dgaza pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'khrol sgrub kyi skabs su dgos pa thams cad 'tshogs par bya/ gzungs thal busam na nas sman thod rnams la g.yas bskor du sbrel ba'i sno mo byir drangs/ gzhan don bstod nas/ rigs ma 'bul ba ma gtogs/ dngos gzhi las gzhung dang 'dzab yan dkyus ltar btang*/

bdag bskyed bzlas pa tshar nas gatsho bo mdun bskyed sman gyi dmigs rim ni: bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas pa gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin pa: g.yon pa dngul dkar gyi dril bu dku la bsten pa: zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa: dar zab dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa: nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa: de'i thugs kar hūṃ 'khyud gang pa: bkrag la 'tsher ba: de las 'od 'phros pas: kam gsum sgyod bu'i stong du sman gyi pho brang bhan+dha dum ba gcig par gsal ba de'i 'og ram/ de'i 'og yam yam las rung g.yos pas/ ram las me 'bar bhan+dha mal dang*/ āḥlas nyi zla ga'u'i nang du: sman rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bo/ oṃ lam dkar: hūṃ mūṃ mthing : swa mī ser: āḥpaṃ dmar: ha tāṃ ljang rnams rigs lnga yab yum snying po phyogs mthun du gsal ba las 'od lnga phyogs bcur 'phros phyag mtshan lngar bsgyur/ tshul 'dus pa bon rnams la phogs pas sa bon rnams rigs lnga yab yum bcur gsal ba ni/ dbus su seng ge'i khri la rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yub nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ shar du glang po che'i khri la mi bskyed pa mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum mā ma ki dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor rta mcho gi khri la rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas spyin ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nub tu rma bya'i khri la snang mtha' dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ byang du shang shang gi khri la don yod grub pa ljang gu rgya graṃ dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba*/ rigs lnga yab thams cad rdo rje skyil (250) mo krung gis bzhugs shing phyag rnams byang chub chen po dang bdun 'dul mchog sbyin ting 'dzin skyabs sbyin sogs kyi phyag mtshan so so 'dzin cing yum la 'khyud pa yum rnams gri 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa yub yum thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis spros shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa snang la rang bzhin med cing lta bas chog mi shes pa'i sku can du gyur/

de dag thams cad gnyis med thabs shes sbyor zhing zag med bde ba chen po'i ngang du snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun zad pa med par babs pas: sman snod thod pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rgyal mtshor 'khyil ba khol zhing lud pa'i rlangs pa stong gi nam mkhar bdud rtsi'i sprin phurang chen por 'khrigs pa'i khrod na/ lha chen po brgyad*/ klu chen po brgyad/ bdud rtsi lha mo bcu gsum/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams dang*/ khyad par du tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs/ brgya byin/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil sa/ gzhan yang tha skar bu dang*/ rkang gnyis spyod dang*/ tsa ra ka dang*/ nam so skyes dang*/ rgyun shes la sogs pa/ sngon byung sman gyi rdzas la brten nas dngos grub thob cing*/ bsgrub po'i stong grogs mdzad par dam mnos pa'i sman gyi rig 'dzin/ lha dang dring bsrung ma dag can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas byon nas/ pho brag gi stong nas bdud rtsi'i char po phag pas sman gyi pho brang bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil ba gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i 'od kyis g+r+yal ba rnams ma gnyes mchod dang*/ sems can rnams kyi rtog pa bsam/ tshul 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i brtsid bsdus nas sman la thim par gyur pas bsam la/ tshig gi gsal 'debs pa ni/ hūṃ ye shes lnga ldan chos skyi sku: dug lnga ye nas longs spyod rdzogs: sprul sku cing yang ston mdzad pa: bcom ldan rgyal ba yab lnga dang : 'byung ba'i bdag mo yum chen lnga: thabs shes dbyer med ngang du 'khyil: bde chen yab lnga'i thugs ka nas: bde chen yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings su: 'dzam bu ha na'i gser bzhin bsdim: phar 'phros gnyes pa'i mchod sa 'bul: tshul 'dus dngos grub bdag la rtsol: rgyal pa rigs lnga yab yum bcu: byang chub sems dang gnyis med thim:

rnam pa dri chen snang mdzad de: phyir rol chen po lnga bdag bsdim: nang gi rgyu 'bras ya nas dag: mi bskyed byang chub sems nyid de: dmigs med dag pa'i ye shes yin: mal sa rin chen 'byung gnas gtso: mnyam dang mi mnyid dbyer med do: rak+ta snang ba mtha' yas gsungs: skye 'gag med par dag: kun tu gtsang zhi dri med pas: thams cad ma lus sangs rgyas lnga: lus pa med pas ye shes lnga: ma bcom ye nas lhun gyis rdzogs: de phyir bdud rtsi bcud kyi mchog: mchog gi rdza zhes de la bya: zhes dang*/ bla ma rig 'dzin bskul zhing byin 'beb pa ni: hūṃ chos dbyings gdod ma'i zhing khams na: rigs pa ye shes snying po can: kun bzang yub yum gshogs su gsol: gnas 'dir sgrub chen mgon du bzhugs: bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol:'og min bde chen zhing khams nas: ye shes 'do kyi snying po can: longs sku rdor sems gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= lnga ldan mgon 'od lnga'i zhing khams na: sku lnga lhun grub po can: rigs lnga yab yum= gnas 'dir= ye shes me dpung klong dkyil na: dpal chen khro rgyal kun gyi gtso: he ru ka yab yum= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas nas/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi gatsho bar brgyad/ bka' bsrung dam can gshegs= gnas 'dir = bzhugs nas= me re 'bar ba'i dur khrod n+wa: sangs rgyas kun gyi sras gcig po: dga' rab rdo rje gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= bsil ba tshamal gyi dur khrod nas: bdud rtsi yon tan dngos grub brnyes: bam ma mi tra gshegs na= gnas 'dir = bzhugs nas= pad ri pad+ma'i gzhal yas nas: mkhas pa brgyad kyi dbang thob pa: gsang sngags bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchog: pad+ma 'byung nas gshegs= gnas 'dir = bzhugs nas= yang lung shel gyi brag phug nas: bdud rtsi smin gyi bka' babs te: yi dam che mchog zhal gzigs pa'i: dz+nyawa na pu tra gshegs pa= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas=

bsam yas mchims phu'i dben gnas su: gzhan don 'phrin las grub pa mo: ye shes mtsho rgyal gshegs= gnas 'dir = bzhugs nas= mi 'gyur lhun grub zhing khams nas: bod yul chos kyi sgron me mchog: mu tig btsad po gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= pad+ma gling gi gdan pa nas: zab gter bstan pa'i bdag po mchog: pad+ma gling pa gshegasapa= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= rin 'dzin chos kyi pho brang nas: rim gnyis mthar phyin dngos grub brnyed: sprul sku zla ba gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang na: 'gro 'dul 'phrin las lhun grub pa: grub pa kun 'dus gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= gar bzhugs chos kyi phrong nas: bzhugs chos kyi phrong nas: bslab gsum mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin: phun tshogs rnam rgyal gshegs= gnas 'dir= 'gyur med bde chen zhing khams nas: sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mgon chen po: rnam 'joms phun tshogs gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= bzhugs nas= gzhu smad chos kyi dga' tshal nas: phyag na pad+mo ngur smṛg 'chang : dkon mchog rat+na gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= mi g.yel dpal gyi phug pa nas: grub gnyis mkhyen rgya mtsho'i phyug: 'phrin las rnam rgyal gshegs: gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas: bsra brten rdo rje pho brang nas: gzhan don 'phris mthar phyin pa: karma bha dra gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas=

(251) mi 'gyur chos kyi yang dben nas: nges don bstan pa'i nyid byed dbang : chos kyi rgyal mtsho gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= mdo sngags chos kyi pho brang nas: mchog mthun dngos grub kun brnyes pa: mthar chen nyam ma gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= mi 'gyur bde chen dben gnas nas: 'jam mgon ngur smrig tshul 'dzin pa: dha mra su r+ya= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= bkris tshul kyi pho brang nas: thams cad mkhyen pa rigs kun bdag: pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan gshegs su= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan stong nas: bskyed rdzogs gtis la mnga' brnyes pa: rtsa ba'i bla ma gshegs= gnas 'dir= bzhugs nas= rang snang dag pa'i brang nas: dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa: yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir sgrub chen mgon du bzhugs: bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: zhes dang*/ sman gyi rig 'dzin bskul ba tshangs pa spyad 'dren ni: hūṃ tshangs pa dang ni gatsho bo mchog: dung gi thor tshugs khong seng can: tshangs pa kun grol chen po dang*/ drang srong chen po ljang sngon dang : drang srong chen po ljang sngon dang : tsa ra ka dang nabs so skyes: tha skar bu dang lha skyabs dang : rgyud shes dang ni g.yon phyogs lha: nang la gnas dang me bzhi 'jug: ka gnyis spyod dang ka ya na: shing khyer dang ni ljang sngon bu: nyi ma zla ba klu ru bcas: bram zer gzhon nu sprin dang ni: ri bo che dang gho do shan: gzhon nu sprin dang 'gro skyong dang*/ rtsibs kyi mu khyud 'dzin la sogs: khyed cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: sngon chad bsgrub pa mthar phyin zhing : yon tan bdud rtsa'i dngos grub brtsol: hūṃ ra sa ya ni sman gyi lha: bai ḍūr 'od kyi rgyal po dang*/ drang srong sman gyi rig 'dzin dang : 'dzog po sman gyis lha mo rnams: snang srid smani gyi bcud bsdus la: bdud rtsi 'di la mgon du gshegs: bdud rtsi'i pho brang byin phob la:

sman gyi bsrung ma mdzad du gsol: zhes bskul zhing : sman bsrung lha mo brgyad bskul ba ni: hoḥ bdag cag skal ldan bsgrub po: logs spyod dur khrod rdzas la brten: rin chen mar khu mtsho ltar 'khyil: rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang : dam can ma g.yel dam la 'dus: bdud rtsi smin gyi bsrung ma rnams: dam tshig sman gyi g.yab dor na: rtags dang mtshan pa ma ston pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub rtsol: oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta sra be sha ya pheṃ hūṃ hriḥthāḥ hūṃ 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba'i: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: gnyis med thugs kyi sprul pa las: 'bar ba'i khro bo kun 'byung ste: 'jig rten dregs pa bsgral ba las: dur khrod chen po brgyad du gyur: yul gyi ming ni ma gha dha: dur khrod chen po bsal ba'i tshal: ma mo chen po ko ko ri ma: mchod rten ming ni bde byed brtsegs: mkhas shing (252) snying stobs de na che: ko ko rin chen mo gshegs su gsol: bdud rtsi sman gyī mgon mdzod cig: yul gyi ming sing ga la: dar khrod ming ni ku la rdzogs: ma mo chen po tso bo rī ma: mchod rten ri bo ta la la: mthong thos can yang de na mang : tso bo rī chen mos gshegs su gsol: bdud rtsi sman gyis= yul gyi ming ni kha che'i yul: dur khrod ming ni he chen badhal: ma mo chen mo sra mo ha: mchod rten ming ni ka na ka: bde skyed ldan pa de na mang : sra mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: bdud rtsi sman gyi= yul gyi ming ni be ta'i yu dur khrod ming na gsang chen rol : ma mo chen mo pi ti li: mchod rten ming ni go'u ta: de na mthu rtsal dbang yang che: pe ta chen gshegs= bdud rtsi sman gyi= yul gyi mini bal po'i yul: dur khrod ming lhun grub brtsegs: ma mo chen mo pu ka si: mchod rten kha shor bya ri kha: lhag par zas kyi khyad du che: pu ka chen po gshegs=

bdud rtsi sman gyi: yul gyi ming na o rgyan yul: dur khrod chen po pad+ma brtsegs: ma mo chen mo kasma ri: gzi yi mchod rten chen po ste: dngos grub chen po de na mang : kasma chen mo gshegs= bdud rtsi sman gyi= yul gyi ming ni za hor yul : dur khrod ming na lkang brtsegs: ma mo chen mo sma sha li: mchod rten bde byi gzhon du ste: 'byor pa'i longs spyod kun dang ldan: sma sha chen po gshegs su gsol: bdud rtse sman gyi= yalpagayi ming ni li yi yul: dur khrod chen po 'jig rten brtsegs: ma mo chen po tsan+dha li: mchod rten go de sha na: cu dang mer bsgyur rdzu 'khrul can: tsan+dha chen po gshegs= bdud rtsi sman gyi mgon mdzod cig: khyed cag sngon gyi thugs dam can: ma mo chen mo brgyad rnams kyis: dur khrod brgyad nas byin phob la: rtags dang mtshanam ma bzang po ston: sa ma ya la dgongs nas kyang : 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dngos grub rtsol: oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mri ta hūṃ trīḥthā: ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ: zhes dang lha gdan la dbab pa 'dzab bzlas bskul ba ni: hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang : thugs kyi 'khor lo rab bsgyur zhing : rdo rje' rigs mchog 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam dbang gis spyan 'dren na: dam bcas tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol: dam bcas tshul bzhin ma gshegs sam: bsgrub pa'i go ga ma tshang na: sku gsung thugs kyi dam 'gal 'gyur: sa ma ya la dgongs nas kyang : thugs kyi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan 'khor lo = sku yi 'khor lo: bud+dha'i rigs mchog= thugs dam dbang = dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs= sa ma ya la= sku yi dngos grub= hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rin chen 'chang : yon tan 'khor lo rab= rin chen rigs mchog= thugs dam dbang = (253) dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs= sa ma ya la = yon tan dngos grub= hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan pad+ma 'chang :

gsung gi 'khor lo= pad+ma'i rigs mchog: thugs dam dbang gi= dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsungs thugs= sa ma ya la= gsungs gi dngos grub= hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rgya graṃ= las kyi 'khor lo= karma rigs mchog= thugs dam dbang gi= dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs= sa ma ya la= las rab mchog gi dngos grub rtsol: hūṃ dpal chen yab yum gtso dang 'khor: zla gi dbang chen gsang ba'i mkha': rdo rje thabs mchog gnyis su med: nam mkha'i mtha' klas chos kyi bsgral: dbang chen mchog gi dngos grub rtsol: thugs dam dus la da babs na: btang snyoms yal yol ma mdzad cig: dngos grub rtsol ba'i dus 'dir lags: bdag gi re ba yongs sgrub cing : gnyis med bdud rtsi'i dngos grub rtsol: zhes dang bzlas dmigs ni/ sngags 'phreng gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas: phrong gi lha rnams dang sgrub rdzas kyi thugs rgyud bskul: de dag las byin brlabs dngos 'od zer gyi tshul du byung ba bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib dang dug lnga'i rtog tshogs sbyangs sku lnga ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabs: mchog gi dngos grub bla na med par thob par bsam mo: bzlas pa ni oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: oṃ sarba pa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrāṃḥthāḥ zhes bzla zhing ston tshig gis mchod pa dang*/ thun mthar sman gyi che ba'i yon tan brjod pa ni: bde gshegs ma lus mchod pa'i rdzas: bla ma yi dam bsdu pa'i rtsi: ḍā ki kun gyi snying khrag 'di: zos pas yon tan brjod mi lang : sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid bgrub: phyi yi gdon bzhi lus nang 'joms: nang du nyon mongs dug lnga dag: thun mong dam tshig nyams chag skong : gsang ba rang byung rnam par dag: nyan thos rang sangs rgyas sogs: bskal pa grangs med skad cig gis: mnyam dang ches lhag yon tan rdzogs: bde gshegs mchod pas bla med thob: bla ma gnyes pas byin rlabs 'jug: yi dam gnyes pas dngos grub ster:

ḍā ki gnyes pas lung rnams ston: zos pas yon tan 'di ltar ro: phyi yi nad gdon sdig sgrib bdag: nang gi ting 'dzin bskyed rim gsal: gsanang b.rig pa chos skur rtogs: thams cad rang byung sngon sangs rgyas: nyan thos byang chub sems dang ldan: grangs med gsum gyi bsord nams bsags: nyams dang lhag chad ma lus bskong : 'chang bas dus min 'chi ba bzlog5 brtigs pas nyon mongs bzhi stong bzlog: spyad pas lus la bde ba 'bar: zos na dug yang 'jil bar nus: byugs na zlo bur rkyen yang zhi: (254) 'asreg na gdon bgegs ma lus brlag: bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog yang yin pa: dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal dang mtshungs: sa phyogs byin dang ldan par gyur: char chung dus 'bebs lo phyugs legs: gang bsgrub gnas bsam pho brang du: su sdod mi rnams ting 'dzin 'char: nam zhig tshe yi dus byas kyang : ngan song gnas su skye mi srid: mo mo bzang ngan med pa ru: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob: de phyir gsang ba'i dam rdzas so: zhes dang*/ sman gyi rtog pa bsal ba ni: hūṃ tsha sangs drang srong matsa ma za: de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad: klu dang bram ze gtsang ma za: de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad: byol song rtswa mchog za ba yang : ji srid 'tsho yi bar du za: de dag grol bar: khyi phag la sogs mi gtsang za: de dag grol bar = de phyir ngos pa'i lung 'di nyon: rang bzhin ye nas dag pa'i rdzas: mnyam nyid ngang du rab rtogs na: gnyis med dod gyis zin pa yin: gtsang dang mi gtsang la sogs te: byung dang 'byung 'gyur thams cad kun: ye shes sku lngar bstan pa'i phyir: rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum nyid: rang rang lus la gnas pa yin: de la rtogs su zhig 'dzin: sems can rtogs pa bzlog bya'i phyir: gtso bor dang du blang bar bya: gtsang rme med par kun gyis babad: de dag grol bar ngas bshad de: ra sa ya na'i bzhin rnams: btang snyoms med par 'phrin las mdzed:

the tshom med par dngos grub rtsol: a mṛ sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes brjod/ sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ rang byung gdod nas rnams par dag5 rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rang sa ya na la sogs rdzas: rtsa ba 'bum phrag yangs pa'i bcud: gnyis med rang byung bde chen po: byang chub sems ni rdo rje che: sha chen mchod pa rin po che: rdzas mchog tshe yi dri chen po: pad+ma'i me tog dang ldan pa: rdo rje chu ste las kyi mchog: ga pur shel spos phor ste: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: rgyud lnga sems can kun grol phyir: dung lnga sel ba'i thabs mchog sto: thams cad rnal 'byor bdud rtsi che: ma las dugs pa'i theg le mchog: sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor phyir: gcig tu dpa' bo rnams dang ni: gsum su med par gnyam sbyor nas: dug gsum sangs rgya thams cad dang : rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i lha r+tshogs mchod: rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha: dpal bo mkhro bsrung mar bcas: sman gyi rig 'dzin drang srong dang : tshangs sa brgya byin bdud rtsi 'khyil: bdud rtsi'i lha mo bcu drug dang : lha klu rgyu skar la sogs dang : sna srid ye dag dkyil 'khor lha: thams cad ma lus dgyes par rol: bzhes nas kyang ni dgyes mdzod la: bla med mchog gi dngos grub rtsol: sarba pañca a mṛ ram khā hi: zhes mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni: hūṃ mnyam pa'i don la skyes pa gnyis med phyir: dngos grub rtsal dang rtsol ba mi dmigs kyang : rig (255) dang ma rig sgyu ma'i khyad ras las: rtog pa'i khyad par mnyam ma gyur te: rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod dbang du rab bsdus la: mkhyen rab 'dzin dngos grub rtsal du gsol: chags pa'i nad gyi gdungs pa'i cong snying ma: dug lnga'i srin bu zhe sdang glo bur gyi: tshe srog sgyu ma'i lus la bar gcod na: gsang sngags bla ma'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis: bdud dang mu stegs zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir:

rdzu 'phrul mthu yi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: mngon shes drug dang rdzul stobs rnams dang : sgrub chen brgyad dang dang 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi: thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dngos grub rtsol: sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes dngos grub blang ngo : de ltar thun drug gi thor zhog dgong srod kyi thun bzhir snga thun la bdag bskyed bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar btang nas:mdun bskyed sman gyi pho brang gsal btab pa yin te: nyul le bskrad pa: byin 'bebs tshogs 'khor sogs sgrub chen spro na zhag gsum dang*/ de min zhag gcig yang na gong gi cho ga des thun gcig gis dkyis su sgrub pas skyang rung ngo : grol rgyu'i thun rjes ma la dngos grub blang zin pa dang : lha rnams byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du zhu zhing : dam tshig gi rdzas dang dbyer med par gyur par bsam mo: cho ga tshar ba dang gzungs mas thod pa'i snod dar gyis bcibs nas bzung la: e ma hoḥ ngo tshar rmad du byung ba'i chos: nam mkha' dang ni gnyam pa'i don: rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma dbral kun rdzob tsam du bstan par 'tshal: ya mtshan ska drin bsam mi khyab: dngos med sems kyi phyag tu bzhes: zhes phul ba : bla mas phyag tu blangs nas: hūṃ ye shes snying po can rnams kyis: sangs rgyas kun gyi chos 'di nyid: snying po chos kyi don las byung : byang chub spyod pa'i gnas chen yin: sman par bya ba'i rdzas lnga po: gcig la yon tan lnga lnga'am: gsum mam dam tshig bco lnga yin: yang na stong dang rtsab brgyad ste: snod bcu gcig tu bsdus nas ni: thabs dang shes rab mchog ldan pa: rtog pa'i mtshan ma brtan par bya: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta mu pa la kra ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭāḥ brjod de sman nas thug phrad du blangs ma sras bstags: ye shes don gyi dmigs med thig le la: dngos med mchog gi dngos grub blangs: byang chub sems kyi sprin pas:

mchog dang mdun mong dngos grub thob: a ho su ka dharmā kā ya ni: a mṛ ta sid+dhi hūṃ: zhes brjod cing dngos grub ru rol lo/ gnyis pa na/ sman phye ma'i bsgrub pa dngos la/ phyag len du 'khrol sgrub rkyang pa byed srol med pas 'khrol sgrub sman mos ji ltar byed kyang bsgrub pa tshar ma thag phye ma'i sgrub par 'jug ste/ sman dkyil gyi (256) khyad par ba stong du 'dzug pa dang bar du dgram pa/ 'og tu gnon pa sogs sman gyi dbang chog ltar/ snang rig dbyer med sogs dang*/ chos sku dmigs med sogs tshig mthun phyi nang gsang gtor gyi mchod pa 'god lugs de ltar 'grub pa legs kyang ma 'byer tshe sgrub chen rtsa ba'i rdzas 'god skabs su yod pas 'thus par sems/ btags btsag la 'jug pa ni/ sman bying sngon du btags bag bya zhing*/ 'dir 'khrol bu'i sman cung zad rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'thag lhor btsag/ nub tu sbol/ byang du 'jal ba rnams phye ma'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa 'di ltar shar du zhing spags steng thal chen gyi ma ṭaṃ mgo lho nub bstan pa bris nas bgegs bskrad yab yum rkang pa bsnol ba'i bar du gtun gzhong bzhag gtun bu yab gyi rdo rje dang gzhong pa yul gyi pad+ma/ yab yum ltar gsal sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs shing 'khyil bar bsam bar bsam la/ phyag gnyis sbrel te gnyis med sbyor ba'i tshul gyis brdungs/ hūṃ bdag nyid dpal chen dbang gi lha: yab yum gnyis med byor ba nas: ye shes byang sems bdud rtsi'i bcud: dkar dmar 'khro zhing 'phel ba dang : zhe sdang byang zhing me long bcud: rdo rje rigs gyur thams cad mchod: oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lam ha na han hūṃ phaṭ+wa: zhes brdungs/ lhor bu 'bar bris pa'i steng : yul gyi dar tshags pad+ma'i tshul du gzod/ yab kyi rdo rje'i bu ga nas byang sems bdud rtsi babs tshul: blug nas zag med byangs sems babs par bsam/

hūṃ nga yi rdo rje'i bu ga nas: yalpagayis gsang ba'i pad+mor babs: zag pa med pa'i ngo bor rgyas: nga rgyal byang zhing mang zhing nyid bcud: rin chen rigs gyur thams cad mchod: oṃ a mṛ ta shud+dha ya tsi ka la hūṃ: nub tu pad+ma zlum po bris pa'i stong chang bo ma chu gsum snod gatshang gcig tu blug/ bdud rtsi sman gyi phab btab yab gyi sman la 'thor zhing yum gyi dkrug cing sbol la rdo rjes gtor zheng : hūṃ chu rnams sna tshogs tha dad pa'i: rgya mtshon phyin nas lan tsha'i ro: 'bru bcud chang dang rtsi bcud zho: ma lus thams cad 'dus pa 'di: pad+ma'i rigs gyur thams cad mchod/ oṃ a mṛ mu sa la mu pa la hūṃ: byang du grub gsum rgya gram bris pa'i steng dril bus 'jal zhing rdo rjes bcad la rab lha grangs 'bring bcu drug tha ma lnga 'jal zhing dar khung tu blug la/ hūṃ rtsi bcud kun 'dus sman gyi mchog: phyi nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: gsang ba byang sems dpar dmar ste: gcig tu bsdus pa bla med rdzas: phrag dog byang phrir bya grub bcud: las kyi rigs gyur thams cad mchod: auṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ho sa ya ho sa ya hūṃ: zhes dar khug tu blug zin nas pho thod la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pi dbus su oṃ/ rtsibs la g.yas bskod du hūṃ trāṃḥmago nang bstan du bris pa dang*/ mo thod la pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su mūṃ/ 'dam ma la lāṃ sāṃ tāṃ g.yon bskor mgo nang bstan du bris pas stong

(257) 'og nas dgaya tshon skud kyis rgya gram du bcings/ gsang rgyas hūṃ dkar rgya ba dang hriḥ dmar mdun/ nang rgya rdo rje g.yas dang dril bu g.yon/ phyi rgya phyogs mthun gyis rgyas btab la/ hūṃ snang stong zung 'jug thabs shes te: dang po sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: gnyis pa rdo rje rgya graṃ rgya: gsum pa dbang mchog rtags kyi rgya: bzhi pa karma las kyi rgya: lnga pa tshe dbang ri bo'i rgya: drug pa zla gi dbang gi rgya: bdun pa chos nyid dbyings kyi rgya: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rgyas gdab bo: zhis rgyas gdab gzungs thag lnga'am lnga dril btags la: hūṃ shes rab srog gis 'brel ba'i gzungs thag la: rig pa srog gi bsdus pa'i lug gu brgyud: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob bar: skye ji srid bar du mi btang ngo : oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ra sa ya na ta na dza ya gu ya sid+dhi hūṃ hrīḥthā: zhes brjod cing btags/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la mtshan ma gsum btab la: hūṃ dur khrod brgyad pogs gnas bcu ru: ma dang mkhro ging gsum rnams: rnam par gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir: snang dang stong dang rig pa gsum: rang gsal 'gyur grol brtags su btab: 'di ni sngon gyi dam tshig yin: oṃ badz+ra āḥhūṃ a āḥsogs dang : zhun chen mar me rol mo'i bya brag/ rkang gling bshugs glus mtshon par a mṛ ta 'thor zhing hasta g.yab la/ hūṃ bdag cig skal bsgrub pa po'i: longs spyod dur khrod rdzas la brten: thod pa mtshan ldan kong bu ru: rin chen mar khu mtsho ltar 'khyil: stong bu dur khrod ras la bltams: ye shes rnam lnga'i snang gsal 'bar: dag pa ye shes dkar mchod 'dis: rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang : rgya ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs= rigs 'dzin brda' brgyud bla= gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i= thugs rje byin brlabs brgyud pa'i thugs= mkhro gtad rgya brgyud pa'i= smon lam dbang bskur=

dam can chos skyong gtor bdag rnams: dam can ma g.yal dam la 'dus: bdud rtsi sman gyi srung ma rnams/ dam tshig can gyi g.yab dor nas: rtags dang mtshan pa ston pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub rtsol: oṃ ā hūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta pra be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hūṃ hrīḥthāḥ zhes gsung mas dam rdzas bathegs pa slob dpon gyis blangs nas dkyil 'khor du mañji'i khar zangs snod nas dkar rlan shes gyi bkang ba'i stong du bkod/ ni zlar bsdun pa'i na bzang dang*/ rigs lnga dar dpyangs sna tshogs pas brgyan nas: hūṃ byang chub sems ni kun ta dag: ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid che: ye nas bya byed spros rbar yang : byang chub thig le ye shes lnga: bdud rtsi sman mchog bla med rdzas: rdo rje gtso bo bdag la dgongs: a bha dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ zhes mdzes shing brjed pa bzhu su gsol ba'i mdun du bam gtsang rdo rjer btsugs la/ 'og gi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i phyir 'dab brgyad can bris pa'i steng du drod 'bebs kyi mar me dang dpu thag sbrel zhing : gzungs thab bum pa dang*/ de nas phyir phyogs bzhi'aṃ ji ltar 'os par (258) drangs/ slob dpon dang rgyas 'debs la sogs pa'i dngos grub ma thob par de srid du sman 'jab gsung mi chad par 'grong ngo*/ de ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa rdzogs par song rjes sman gyi dmigs rim ni bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhes pa nas rtsi bcud bsdus nas snam la thim par yar par bsam bar 'khrol sgrub ltar la gsal btab pa ni/ hūṃ pho brang sgo bzhi yu gyur rdzogs: dbus phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng : seng glang rta dang rma bya shang : rin chen nyi zla'i pad stengs su: rnam sngan dbyings phyug mu khyud dbus: mi bskyed rin 'byung mtha' yas grub: ma ma spyan ma gos dpar sgrol: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing 'od 'bar: 'khor lo rdo rje rin pad gri:

dril 'khrol rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs: bdag la rdzogs shing sbyor bar mdzad: tshom bu'i lha tshogs rigs lngar gsal: rdo rje chos sku rol ba'i lha: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog tshogs sbyangs: sman gyi pho brang 'jug bsdu mdzod: oṃ āḥ hūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ hrīḥthāḥ hūṃ ye shes lnga ldan chos kyi sku: sogs dang*/ hūṃ chos dbyings gdod ma'i sogs rigs 'dzin byis bskul/ hūṃ tshangs pa bdag gi gtso bo sogs tshangs pa spyan spyan 'dren/ bdag cag skal ldan bsgrub pa po: sogs m+na bsrung lha tshogs bskul ba sngar bzhin bya: gzungs thab la 'jus nas/ hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi gnad nas bskul zhing*/ slar yang*/ bdag dhor sems su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sman gyi gzungs thag lu gu brgyud kyi rnam pa can la 'khrol nas song bas sman gyi pho brang la phog: pho brang gzhal yas khang gi nang du sgrub rdzas rnams kyis mtshon par lha rigs lnga yab yum du gsal ba'i byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin snod thob par 'khyil ba khoral zhing lud/ rlangs pa steng gi nam mkhar 'khṛgs pa la sman gyi bla ma lhar bcas prin gathigs pa ltar bzhugs pa las/ lha dang bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis gnyis sning rtogs pa sbyangs thams cad ye shes lngar rgyas btab/ snang srid kyi bcud bsdu te sman la thim pas bla na med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur par bsam mo/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ra sa ya na ta dzā ya gu h+ya sid+dhi hūṃ hrīḥthāḥ zhes gtso bor bzla zhing*/ stong tshig gi mchod pa dang thun ma' rnams su sman gyi che ba'i yon tan brjod pa: rtogs pa gsal ba/ sman mchod 'bul ba/ dngos grub blang ba rnams bya de ltar sngar 'khrol sgrub skabs bshad pa ltar thun drug gam bzhi sogs bya zhing*/ de rnams su kun thub rgyal mo bskul bzhi byin 'bebs la sogs pa ma chagasapa gal che/
