de lta bus rtags mtshan ni sgrub zhag theg nas rtsa ba'i sgrub chen gyi dngos grub blang ba'i sngon der/ 'dus pa thams cad la rtags btab/ tshig chen gyi mar me dang*/ rkang gling thod rnga glu dri'i rgyal po lnga'i = dza ti ga pur tsan dan glang rtsi du ru ka'o spos btul ba sogs byas la rang lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas snam gyi bla ma (259) ṛg 'dzin drang srong lha mo bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi rgyud bskul bas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran nas sridathams cad gnyis snang nyon mongs mtshan ma'i rtogs pa sbyangs/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsdus pa dang lha tshogs thams cad kyang bdud rtsir zhu ba sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la char babs pa ltar thim par gyur par bsam la/ hūṃ bdag cag skal ldan bsgrub pa po: longs spyod dur khrod rdzas la brten: thod pa mtshan dan kong bu ru: rin chen mar khu mtsho ltar 'khyil: stong bu dur khrod rdzas la bltams/ ye shes rnam lnga'i snang gsal 'bar: dag pa ye shes dkar mchod 'dis: rgyal bzhi khro'i thugs dam bskang: rgya ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs= rin 'dzin badha' brgyud= gang zag snyan brgyud= thugs rje byin brlabs brgyud pa'i= mkhro gtad rgya brgyud pa'i= smon mal dbang bskur brgyud= dam can chos skyongs gtor bdag= dam can ma g.yel dam la 'du: bdud rtsi sman gyi srung ma rnams: dam tshigs can gyi g.yab dor nas: rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub rtsol: hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang : thugs kyi 'khor lo rab bsgyur zhing : rdo rje'i rigs mchog 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam dbang gi spyan 'dren na: dam bcas tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol: dam bcas tshul bzhin ma gshegs sam: bsgrub pa'i che ga ma tshang na: sku gsung thugs kyi dam 'gal 'gyur: sa ma ya la dgongs nas kyang : thugs kyi dngos grub rtsal du gsol:

hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan 'khor lo= sku yi 'khor lo= bud+dha'i rigs mchog= thugs dam= dam bcas= sgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs= sa ma ya la dgongs nas= sku yi dngos grub= hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rin chen= yon tan 'khor lo= rin chen rigs mchog= thugs dam dbang = dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs= sa ma ya la= gsung gi dngos grub= hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan pad+ma 'chang : gsungs gi 'khor lo= pad+ma'i rigs mchog= thugs dam dbang = dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs kyi= sa ma ya la= gsung gi dngos grub= hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rgya graṃ= las kyi 'khor lo= karma rigs mchog= thugs dam dbang = dam bcas= bsgrub pa'i= sku gsung thugs= sa ma ya la= las rab mchog gi dngos grub rtsol: hūṃ dpal chen yab yum gtso dang 'khor : zla gam dbang chen gsang ba'i mkha': rdo rje theg mchog gnyis su med: nam mkha'i mtha' klas chos kyi dbyings: ma sgrib spyan mnga' ye shes thugs: thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: dus las mi 'da' dam tshig can: skyabs las mi 'da' yal gaṃ can: byang chub 'bras bu bdag gis sgrub: 'gro ba thabs kyi bdag gis bsgrol: dbang chen mchog gis dngos grub rtsol: thugs dam dus la da babs na: btang snyoms yal yol ma mdzad cig: dngos grub rtsol ba'i dus 'dir lags: bdag gi re (260) ba yongs sgrub cing : gnyis med bdud rtsi'i dngos grub rtsol: gnad nas bskul ste/ lha sngags dang sman 'dzab brgya rtsa re dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta sra we sha ya phebs phebs hūṃ hrīḥthāḥnyer gcig bzlas nas/ gzungs mas sman gyi dkyil 'khor blang ba dang lha cig hūṃ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sku bzhengs shig: sman gyi phrong nang du bzhugs: byin rlabs sprin phung thibs se thibs: dngos grub char ltar si li li: rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag tu bzhes: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlabs shing : bdag la dbang bskur byan brlabs shang :

dbang mchog ma pa bskur du gsol: bdag cag smin grol laṃ la bkod: brjod nas slob dpon la phul: slob dpon gyi pad+ma'i phyag rgya bskor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i lag gnyis kyis blangs la spyi bor gtugs te/ hūṃ skye med rgya ba'i pha brang nas: 'gags med rigs pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs: thabs shes dbyer med yab yum tshul: bde bar rol pa'i byang chub segs: yon tan bdud rtsi rgya mtshor 'khyil: gyal ba'i yon tan bcud kyi mchog: mchog gi dngos grub bdag la rtsol: zhes dbang blangs shing rgya rnams dkrol bzhin pas: hūṃ yum gyi bha ga rgyal ba'i gnas: bha ga gzhal yas sgo phye la: yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyis: zhal ston skal ldan bu rnams la: dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs pa dang : mthun mong dngos grub bdag la rtsol: sogs kyi cung zad zhal phye ste dam rdzas lag g.yon pa'i mthob srin gyis blangs la: hūṃ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la: dam tshig chen po'i hūṃ bsgoms te: mtheb srin thabs shes phyag rgya yi: blangs shing myangs pas dngos grub thob: zhes pa'i mjug a mṛ ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes myang ste mchog mthun gyi dngos grub thams cad de nyid du thob pa'i ngos pa bskyed/ slar yang thod snod du dza gad la bdud rtsi nas btab slob dpon gyi thogs te gong ltar maspanagyi che ba'i yon tan brjod/ rtog pa bsal ba/ sman mchod rnams byas rjes dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgyal mtsho las sangs rgyas thams cad gyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing ga yi ge'i rnam par gnas pa mtheb srin gyis blangs pa rang gis gnas gsum du reg pas thim nas ku gsung thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs thams cad par gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas/ hūṃ gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi kyi dbyings: dag dang ma dag gnyis med 'das: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsum thugs: ma lus bdag la thim gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a a āḥ

hūṃ mnyam pa'i don las skyes pa gnyis med phyir: dngos grub rtsal dang btsol bar mi dmigs kyang : rigs dang ma rig sgyu ma'i khyad par las: rtogs pa'i khyad par mnyam par ma gyur te: rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod dbang du rab bsdus la: mkhyen rab ting 'dzin dngos grub stsal du gsol: chags pa'i dan kyi gdungs pa'i lcong snying la: dug lnga'i srin ba zhe sdang glo bur gyi: tshe srog sgyu ma'i lus la bar gcod na: gsang sngags bla ma'i sku (261) gsung thugs byin gyis: bdud dang mu stegs zil gyis gnod pa'i phyir: rdzu 'phrul mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: mngon shes drug dang rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang : sgru chen brgyad dang 'phris rnam pa bzhi: thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: dbyangs snyan mos sman 'dzab bzla bzhin du 'dus la thams cad kyis dbang blang zhing dza gad bdud rtsi can las gnas gsum thig le dang lcer myang bas dngos grub blang ngo*/ de rjes sgrub chen gzhung gi dngos grub blang chog sogs bya/ rjes ni sra brtags pa dang sman gzhal ba'i 'phel kha lta ba/ dam rdzas las gter sba ba dang*/ bsregs blugs bya ba rnal 'byor rnams kyi longs spyod phyir bog lugs sogs gzhung lta bya zhing*/ cho ga ltag ma rnams rtsa ba'i sgrub gzhung nyid kyi 'grub par 'gyur zhing spro na mar me smon lam/ kyi hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon yi dag dkyil 'khor lha: phyogs bcu rgyal sras rig 'dzin sems dpar bcas: zhi khro dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: byang chub mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs te: 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bskong ba'i cho ga 'dis: tshe rab kun tu rdo rje slob dpon dang : mi 'bral thugs rjes 'dzin cing 'grogs par shog: dkyil 'khor gcig tu shin tu 'dres pa'i mchod: bla med dam tshig zab mos sbrel bas na: byang chub spyod pa mthun pa'i mched lcam rnams:

mi 'bral brtse gdung yid kyis 'grogs par shog: bla med 'dren sgo gcig pa'i slob dpon dang : bye brag dus gzhan 'dres pa'i mched rnams dang : rang bzhin dbyar dam gcig pa'i mchod lcam kun: tshe rabs kun tu 'grogs par shog: rdo rje rgal po yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas: shes rab yum dang sems dpar bcas: 'di dang phyi ma bar do dus kun tu: mi 'bras spyi gatshung rgyan mchog 'dren par shog: 'gro 'dug gnas dang tha ma rmi lam du: bla ma dang ni mched lcam mthong gyur cig: mnyes bzhin las dang brtse gdung gces pa dang : gus pas srid zhu bskur bsde byed par shog: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bla na med pa dang : lhun grulus kyi bkad pa'i dkyil 'khor dang : dbyer dam gcig pa'i dpa' bo mkhro bcas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par shog: dkyil 'khor gcig tu bla med byang chub sgrub: sgrub rdzas gcig pas dngos grub gcig tu bgo: dbang dang byin rlabs gcig pa'i slob dpon dang : rdo rje mched lcam gcig 'dus tshogs rnam kun: mkha' spyod grub nas dngos grub char 'bebs shing : mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshos yongs bskor te: dbag dang mi 'bras byin gyis rlob tu gsol: bdag gi nyams chag nyes ltung rnams dang nas: rigasa'adzin rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog: rnam dam gdod ma'i ming zhing khams mi dmigs su: chos dbyings dam pa kun bzang rgyan gyis klong : lham me lhang nge ldan ne 'grub par shog: lhun grub bzhi ba'i lha dang 'grogs pa dang : lam myur rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'grogs shing

(262) mthar thug rang rig 'bras bu lhun grub ste: yi dam lha tshogs rnams 'grogs par shog: rang rig gnas lugs don gyi mgro dang : gnas skabs bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad mgro dang : mthar phyin nges pa don gyi mkhro dang : ma srid g+r+ya mtsho'i tshogs dang 'grogs par shog: sems nyid 'od gsal snying po'i bla ma dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i bla ma dang : don dam snying po lhun grub bla ma ste: rdo rje slob dpon rnams dang 'grogs par shog: rang byung ye shes dbyer med mched rnams dang : dam tshig 'jug sgo gcig pa'i mched rnams dang : mthar thug rang snang tshom bu'i mched lcam dang : rdo rje mched lcam rnams dang 'grogs par shog: deng nas nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad dang : 'pho 'gyur mthong dang bar do'i gnas skabs dang :'di dang phyi'i gnas skabs thams cad du: mi 'bras rtse gcig sems kyi gsol ba yis: dge ba'i bshes su bla ma dam par shog: grogs kyi mchog tu bla ma dam par shog: skyabs kyi mchog tu bla ma dam= dpung gnyen mchog tu bla ma dam par shog: grogs kyi mchog tu ma da rgya mtshor shog: zas kyi mchog tu ting 'dzin dam par shog: skom gyi mchog tu byang chub bdud rtsir shog: gos kyi mchog tu ngo tsha khrel yod shog: nor gyi mchog tu thos bsam nor bdud shog: rgyan gyi mchog tu bslab gsum rnam dag shog: gnas kyi mchog tu chos dkyis rnam dag shog: las kyi mchog tu gzhan don mtha' yas shog: bsgrub pa'i mchog tu gnas lug don ldan shog: dngos grub mchog tu bla med mchog thob shog: sman zhug nas gsungs pa 'di bya zhing*/ ma nu rtsa ba'i sgrub gzhung ltar bgyis pas 'thus/ ril bu sgrub lugs sogs ni 'dir ma bshad pas gzhan du rtogs par bya'o/ bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i bdud rtsi rman sgrub kyi cho ga klag chog mar bkod pa yang dharmā dh+wa dzas so/// /shu bhaṃ/

(263) (za) ༄༅// bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i las byang la bskyed rdzogs che chung gi bsgyur kha phyed tshul bde chen lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// khyab bdag kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po nyid/ ma rungs gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i rgyal/ bcom ldan che mchog tshem bu dgu yi lhar/ gus pas bdud do bka' yi gnang ba stsol/ 'dir gter ston chen po mnga' bdag nyid ma 'od zare gyi gter byon bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i las byang don brgyad ma zhes bya ba shī la kā ras mdzad pa nyid la bskyed rdzogs chen mo dang chung du'i bsgyur kha byed par 'dod na gnyis las/ dang po mngon rtogs/ rgyas pa bsgom pa ni las byang gi/ gsum pa bcud dag pa brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i skabs/ 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs che mchog he ru ka sku dog smug nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjed can dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig/ phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis zhabs brgyad dang ldan pa/ de yang ba'i zhal smug (264) nag/ lhag ma drug mthing ga/ g.yas kyi zhal bdun dkar ba/ g.yon zhal bdun dmar ba/ zhal re re la dmar ba zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ rnam par brngams pa'i zhal gdangs shing rno dpal can gyi mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin sprag nas glog stong 'khyug pa/ ljags rab tu 'dril zhing*/ thog gig bu yagu 'tshub pa/ khro gnyer bar tu bsdus pa'i shangs nas mi bzad 'thor rlung drag po 'byin pa/ skan sgra drag po 'brug stong ldir zhing*/ snyan go g.yas g.yon nyi zlas brgyan pa/ sma ra sman ma ag tshogs las me 'bar ba/ dbu sgra ral pa gyen du 'khyil ba/ sku che zhing yan lag rag pa lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'gyur bag can/

ba spru'i rtse nas me 'bar zhing rtsa ba nas khrag gi zhal chu 'bab pa'o/ phyag bzhi bcu rtsaganyis dang ldanadang ldan pa'i dang po gnyis kyi kun bzang yab yum thugs kar bsnol nas bsnams pa/ lhag ma yags kyi gnyis pa na rnam par snang mdzad/ gsum pa na rdo rje sems dpa'/ bzhi pa na rin chen 'byung gnas/ lnga pa na snang ba mtha' yas/ drug pa na don yod grub pa/ bdun pa na pa'i snying po/ brgyad pa na nam mkha'i snying po/ dgu pa na spyan ras gzigs/ bcu pa na phyag na rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa na byams pa/ bcu gnyis na sgrib pa rnam sel/ bcu gsum na kun tu bzang po/ bcu bzhi na 'jam dpal dbyangs/ bco lnga na khro bo rnams par rgyal ba/ bcu drug na gshen rje gshed/ bcu 'an na rta mgrin/ bco brgyad na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ bcu dgu na lha'i thub pa/ nyi shu na lha min thub pa/ nyer gcig na ma'i thub pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gsum pa na kun tu bzang mo/ bzhi pa na gos dkar mo/ lnga pa na ma ma ki/ drug pa na dag tshig sgrol ma bdud pa na rdo rje sgog pa ma/ brgyad pa na rdo rje 'phreng ba ma/ dgu pa na rdo rje glu ma/ bcu pa na rdo rje gar ma/ bcu gnyis na rdo rje bdug spos ma/ bcu gsum na rdo rje me tog ma/ bcu gsum na rdo rje snang gsal ma/ bcu bzhi na rdo rje dri chab ma/ bco lnga na ro langs ma/ bcu drug na mi pham ma/ bcu bdun na khro gnyer ma/ bco brgyan na ral gcig ma/ bcu dgu na byol song thub pa/ nyim na yi dwags thub pa/ nyer gcig na dmyal ba'i thub pa bsnams pa'o/ zhabs brgyad kyi g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad chen po'i stabs kyis byol song dang lha brgyad klu brgyad la sogs pa'i gdan la 'gying ba/ sgog pa sogs mchog tu 'bar bas byin rgyas sa/ theg mchog stogs bcus 'gro don mdzad phyir sku stod la glang chen ko rla gyi na bza' gsol ba/ 'phris rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad pa'i sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/

dpa' brjed mnyen lcug gis gdug pa klu rigs dbang du bsdus (265) pas sbrul rigs sngal sku dang yan lag brgyan pa/ nyon mongs log rtog rtsad nas bcad pas zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ ma mo mkhri dbang du bsdus pas khrag chen gyi thig les brgyan pa/ 'dul byed 'phrin las rdzogs pas thal chen gyi tshem bus mtshan pa 'gro don thabs kyi mdzad pas zhag chen gyi zo ris brgyad pa/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pas thod pa tshar gsum gyi 'phreng rgyu rlan la brgyus pa'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dpal gyi chas bcu rdzogs pa/ nga rgyal dregs pa'i phung po dang bag chags bsregs pas bskal pa dus mtha' ltu'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ ye shes lnga dang sku lnga dang sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pas dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lnga rin po che'i rtse bran can gyi dub rgyan la sangs rgyas rigs lnga bzhugs pa'o/ hūṃ ye shes snying po hūṃ gi byin brlabs las/ kun bzang dpal chen che gnyis dkyil 'khor lda dang sbyor/ sdang mig glog 'gyu drug cung rtsa gsum 'bar/ rnam thar zhabs brgyad phyogs mtshams kun tu bstan/ dur khrod 'bar ba'i chos brgyad sku la rdzogs/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ yum g.yon gyi phyogs lus dang grib ma'i tshul du yum khro mo gnam zhal dbyings dbying phyug ma/ sku dog mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ dbus zhal gsum mthing ba/ g.yes zhal gsum dkar ba/ g.yon zhal gsum dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag bco brgyad dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dung phrag 'dzin pas yang la 'khyupa/ lhag ma g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ki ri ma/ gsum pa na tsi ri ma/ bzhi pa na sra mo ha/ lnga pa na bai ta li/ drag pa na pu ka ma/ bdun pa ka kasma ma/

brgyad pa na sma sha ma/ dgu pa tsan+dha la/ g.yen gyi gnyis pa na sing ha ma/ gsum pa na bya tri ma/ bzhi pa na sri la ma/ lnga ba na shwa na ma/ drag pa na tri ta ma/ bdun pa ka k+kang ma/ brgyad pa nam kha kha ma/ dgu pa na hu lu ma bsnams pa'o/ zhabs bzhi g.yon bskum pa'i tshul gyis yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi snyom par 'jug pa/ ri po che dang rus pa sogs rgyan cha lugs yab dang mthun pa la khyed par du gzig sham gsol ba/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid can/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi byin nyi ma 'bul gyi 'od zer ltar 'bar zhing bskal pa'i me dpung chen po'i glong na bzhugs pa'o/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ stong nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ rtog med spros blal dbyings las sku sprul pa/ dpal chen kun bzang thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir/ sher rab rnam dag chos kyi dbyings bdag mo/ 'bar ba'i dbu (266) dgu chos kyi dbyings dang sbyor/ ral pa dmar ser dbu skra gyen du 'khyil/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ phyag mtshan mtshon cha 'bar ba cir yang ston/ stang stabs tshul dang ldan pa'i zhabs brgyad 'khril/ sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur pa'i sku mchog la/ rin chen sna tshogs na bza'i rgyan du klub/ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ mi 'gyur g.yung drung dus gsum 'du 'bral med/ thams cad bskyed byed yum gyi dbyings su ston/ oṃ ma hā kro ti shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa hūṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la oṃ/ sogs mkha' gsang byin brlabs phyin las byang dkyis bzhin sbyar/ de bzhin du gnyis pa mngon rtogs chung ba la mos na/ gong bzhin las byang gi slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gi bcom ldan dpal che mchog he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ de yang zhal gsum gyi dbus mthing nag/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/

g.yon zhal dmar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan dgu sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba zla tshes su gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug cing*/ rdo rje'i gad mo rab tu g.yo ba/ kro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas rlang sgra drag po 'byin pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshoms las me 'bar ba/ ska che zhing yan lag rag pa/ lang tsho rgyal pa'i 'gyarar bag can/ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ bar pas rtse lnga/ tha mas rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa lcang lo khrag gis bkang ba/ tham mas dung chen rak+ta bkang ba bsnams pa zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis lha chen pho mo'i mgo po dang nu ma brdzis pa/ theg mchog stobs bcus 'gro ba'i don sogs las byang gzhung gi mngon rtog 'bring so dkyis bzhin/ mthing nag 'bar ba khro rgyal brngams pa'i sku/ rab dang theg dgu sogs tshig gnyis dor ba'i mal du/ sku gsum ngo bo dub gsum 'jigs par ston/ phyin drug phyag ldan zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi 'joms/ zhes sbyar zhing*/ phyag na mtshon cha 'bar bas sogs las byang gzhung dkyus bzhin byas bas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ ces pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs che chung gnyis kyi mngon rtogs las byang 'bring por tshugs kyi gzims chung phun tshogs 'khyil par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gam du 'khord pa dkon mchog sbyin pas 'gyis pa'o// (267) ('a) ༄༅// bde gshegs lus bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rnal 'byor rgyud dbang skabs bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga 'khyer bde dngos grub snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥsarba gu ra we/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun gsal ngogs/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs rje'i chu khur can/ gdul bya'i zhing par dgos 'dod char rgyun mchog /rtsol mdzad rdo rje slob dpon gtsug tu mchod/

'dir bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor rgyun gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang 'brel bar bdag nyid 'jug pa'i nyams len khyer bder bkod pa la/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bshems/ dngos gzhi bsgrub pa'i thabs/ bdag nyid dbang blang ba'i cho ga dang gsum las dang po ni/ thun mong dang khyed par gyi sgrub pa'i yo byad mtha' dag tshogs par bsham pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro rnams las byang gi dkyus bzhin byas nas/ dngos bzhi'i skyabs sgrub gzhi bdag dang mdun du bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas dang bcas pa thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin stong nyid kyi rang bzhin kun snang snying rje chen po'i ngang las rten dang brten par bcas pa bdag mdun (268) tha mi dad pa bsgoms nas/ bdang bskur spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol rnams dang*/ mchod bstod kyi tshe rang nyid gatsho bo las logs su phye bas sam snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis lha la lhas mchod pa'i tshul du mchod cing bstod nas spyi sgos kyi dzapā dang*/ khyed par bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du lha rnags dngas pa'i mtsho la gza' skra shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar mos nas gzungs thag la 'jus te rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la/ 'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs/ de dag sku las bayang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ babs pas bu chur gnyis med ro cig gyur/ zhi ba dang khro ba'i spyi sngags so so'i mthar kā ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca ā be sha ya ā: zhes btags pa brgya rtsa tsam re dang*/ tshul snga ma lta busalas bum du dhor sems bskyed nas yig brgya dang yig drug ci rigs bzlas rjes tshogs mchod la sogs pa rnams bya'o/ gsum pa ni/ bdag nyid bdang blang ba'i cho ga 'jug pa la dang*/ bdang dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar bltams sa sogs kyis khrus dang*/

drag sngags so lnga bas bgegs bskrad/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gatsho bo dbyer ma mchis pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dkyil 'khor gtso bos rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mig dar bcing*/ ā khaṃ wi ra hū? gis me tog bzung nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hoḥ bla ma yi dam dgongs su gsol: bde shagesag kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ bdag can dad pas 'jug par 'tshal: thugs rjes dkyil 'khor bstan par zhu: zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btabs: skyabs sems ni: bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum po: byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas thob byas snyam: smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de/ sems can yongs sa smin bya'i phyir/ 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing : gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal sgom: zhes gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs/ yan lag bcu pa ni/ bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang : smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: lhun gyi grub par bzhugs su gsol: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don

(269) rtogs shog: ces gsum gyi tshogs bsag/ sdoms bzung ba ni/ sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang : dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang : sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum: nam yang dbag gis mi spong : rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang : yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi: slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi: nyin ri bzhid du dus drug tu: sbyin pa rnams bzhi rtag tu bzung : phyi dang gsang ba'i theg gsum gyis: dam chos ma lus yongs su bzung : sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i: mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi: bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung : zhes gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung nas: dam la bzhag pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu: dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed: dam tshig gasrung na dngos grub thob: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig: sa ma pa rak+ṣa yi dam na rakan: zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ rang nyid dpal chen po che mchog he ru ka'i skur gyur pa'i snying gar hūṃ yig sngon po mar me ltar 'bar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis bskul bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa grangs med pa 'od zare gyi phung por 'bar zhing 'phro ba kha char dang bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin du byung ba ba spu'i khung bu nas zhugs/ lus thams cad mer khrig gang bas bde ba bzod med du 'bar bar bsam zhing : oṃ badz+ra ku ru sarba sa ma ya ā she sha ya a bhi ṣiñca a aḥ zhes drag brjod cing gu gul dang tshil chen gyis bdug/ ḍā dril gyis drangs pa'i rol mo'i sgra byung dam spel ma'i sbyor ba dang lha cig pas dbab: de nas spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o/ sra tī badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog doraṃ sra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwa mahā ba la tiṣ+ṭha zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/

mig 'byer par ni brtson par mdzad: phyi bas thams cad mthong gyur te : rdo rje'i mig ni bla ma med/ oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ ces mig dar 'grol/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ legs par ltos shigs sems dpa' che/ da ni dad pa rab tu skye: bde gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin pa'i: dngos grub kun bdag khyod 'gyur ro: zhes mthong ba bstan pas bde gshegs kun 'dus dpal chen tshom bu dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin mthong bar bsam mo/ gnyis pa phyi nang gsang ba 'phrin las dang bzhin mthong bar bsam mo: gnyis pa phyi nang gsang ba 'phrin dang bzhi las dang po phyi dbang ni/ bdang dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ston du 'gro bas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ mchod sbyin ji ltar rtsal ba ltar/ bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ nam mkha'i rdo rje dang bdag stsol/ zhes gsum gyi gsol ba btab la bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ: rin chen rgyan ldan bum pa na: rgyal ba zhi khro 'od du zhu: skal ldan spyi bor dbang bskur bsaḥ sgo gsum sgrib pa byang bar shogaḥ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha ka pa ṣak+tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca (270) hūṃ pu ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃḥ zhes dbang bskur zhing bu chu myang*/ hūṃ snying po lnga las phyang mtshan lngaḥ de la rigs lngas dub brgyan pasaḥ khams gsum ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir: sku lnga ye shes lnga thob shogaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ badz+ra mu ku tra a bhi ṣañca hūṃḥ pa ra ta s+t+wi a haṃḥ zhes dbu rgyan mgo bor 'ching*/ hūṃ sku lnga ye shes lnga'i rdo rjeḥ sangs rgyas dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro dril: thabs dang shes rab dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug lam la phyod par shogaḥ oṃ dz+nyā badz+ra hūṃḥ ghan+de a aḥ oṃ a dhi sa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya: zhes rdo rje gse zhing dril bu dkrol/

hūṃ sman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i tshogs: dam rdzas rnams kyi dbang bskur bas: lha dang dam can rten mchod dang*/ sgom sgrub nyan mchad dbang thob shog: oṃ a mṛ rak+ta ba ling+ta a bhi ṣiñca ā be sha ya aḥ zhes gtor ma spyi bor bzhag cing : sman raka mdun du dgod/ hūṃ de ring dus 'dir bu khyed la: ko rlon zhing spags thod 'phring dang*/ sbrul chun stag shar la sogs pas: brgyan pas dpal chas dbang thob shog: oṃ shri he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ swā tāḥ zhes dur khrod kyi chas rnams bgo tshul bya'o/ gnyis pa nang lha'i dbang las zhi ba'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gatsho bo las zhi ba rigs bzhi mar me gcig las gnyis 'chad kyi tshul du byon gnas bzhir dwangs gsal sgrib med du bzhugs par mos te/ hūṃ spyi bor 'jam dpal ye shes sogasaḥ mgrin par spyan ras gzigs dbang ste: thugs dkar rdo rje sems dpa' nyid: lte bar drug pa rdo rje 'chang : rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: sku bzhi lhun grub dbang shog: oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃ: ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra ya: badz+ra sa twaḥ ma hā badz+ra dhā ra a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes rigs bzhi'i sku tsaka gnas bzhir bzhag: khro bo'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha tshogs so so las lha gnyis pa ri mar me gcig las gnyis gnyi 'chad kyi tshul du byung ba spyi bo nas zhugs snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgyad lus kyi gnas so sor gyes pa la thim par mos la dpal dgu'i sku tsaka rnams rim bzhin thogs te: dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: bcom ldan che mchog he ru kaḥ yab yu 'khor dang bcas rnams kyisaḥ rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur roḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ yang dag thugs kar bskur hūṃ lho nas rang byung grub= bcom ldan badz+ra he ru kaḥ yab mum 'khor dang = rigs kyi bu la= oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ

sarba pa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ yang dag thugs kar bskur hūṃ*/ lho nas rang byung grub= bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshen rje'i gshedaḥ yab yum= rigs kyi bu la= oṃ a kro ti ka ha na ma tha bha ṣiñca āḥ gshin rje dpral bar bskur (271) hūṃ nu nas rang byung = dpal chen rta 'grin he ru kaḥ yab yum= oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛta badz+ra ma hā kro dha h+ya gh+ri ba hu lu hu hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ parba sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ dbang chen mgrin par bskur/ hūṃ byang nas rang byung = rdo rje bzhe+on nu he ru ka: yab yum= rigs kyi ba la= oṃ badz+ra ki li ki la ya sarba bigh+nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ phur pa lte bar bskur/ hūṃ shar lho rang byung = bcom ldan bla med he ru ka: yab yum= rigs kyi bu= oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro ti shwa ri stāṃ ma ma gi ni ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ bla med he ru ka gsang bar bskur/ hūṃ lho nub rang byung grub pa'i lha: rig 'dzin mi yi thod pa can: yab yum= rigs kyi bu la= hoṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūṃ phaṭaḥ sarba sa ma ya ha bhi ṣiñca āḥ rig 'dzin spyi bor bskur/ hūṃ nub byang rang = dpal chen dregs 'dul he ru kaḥ yab yum= rigs kyi bu la= oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍasarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ sarba sa ma ya ha bhi ṣiñca āḥ dregs 'dul pus mo g.yas su bskur: hūṃ byang shang rang = dpal chen stobs ldan he ru kaḥ yab yum= rigs kyi bu= oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭaḥ sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ stobs ldan pus mo g.yon par bskur/ hūṃ klu 'dul bya khyung ka ru ṇaḥ sku mdog dkar nag rnam pa gnyis: rags lnga sprul pa'i khyung bcas kyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: khrom ga ru ṇa hūṃ phaṭ+wa: sarba sa ma ya ha bhi ṣiñca āḥ khyung dkar nag dpung pa g.yas g.yon du bskur ro/ mtha' rtain bzlas lung ni/ dkyil 'khor pa'i thukas ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba rnams mgrin pa nas zhugs snying ga'i yi ge'i 'khor lo la thim par mos te zhi khro'i spyi sngags dang*/

gtso bo dgu'i snying po/ spyi dril rnams ci rigs bzla*/ de ltar phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgribs pa sbyangs/ yul snang stong du rtogs/ lam bskyed rigs bsgom pa dbang*/ sbyor lam man chad kyi nus pa rgyu la bzhag/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so: gsum pa gsang ba zam mo'i dbang las gsang dbang ni/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi thig le lce thog tu bzhag par bsam la/ hūṃ bla ma lha tshogs yab yum rnams: gnyis med sbyar ba'i byang chub sems: skal ldan ngag la dbang bskur bas: bde chen gsang ba'i dbang thob shogaḥ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā ta ma hā su kha ha bhi ṣiñca a be sha ya a āḥ a ho ma hā su kha zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs*/ sems gsal stong brjod bral du rtogs: lam rtsa rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthong lam sa dang po'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs (272) pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs ka nas rigs ma gzungs dang lang tshos brgyan pa byon nas rang la 'khyud par bsam la: hūṃ bkra shis mtshan ldan gzung ma 'di/ bsten na gnyis med bde ba bskyed: 'khor lo'i gnas bzhir dbab bzung gis: bde chen chos chos nyid rtogs par bgyis: a ho ma hā su kha bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga da badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ke3 haṃḥ de dang snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyis su myong bar bsam/ de ltar bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ rang rigs bde stong brjod bral du rtogs: lam pho nya besagamo pa la dbang*/

sgom lam sa dgu'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba cad du byas so/ tshigs dbang rin po che ni/ hūṃ sems nyid ka dag lhun rdzogs pa'i: snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku: gnyis med 'dzin bral sprul pa'i sku: yang dag nges don rtogs par bgyis: dz+nyā na pañca dharmā kā ya bhi ṣiñca a āḥ zhes rang byung ye shes kyi ngang la blo bzhag ste me long shes dang bcas pas rdor rje gsol zhing dril bu dkril/ de ltar don byasang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma sbyangs/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bde ba chen po brjod bral du rtogs/ lam rang byung gi ye shes bsgom sa la dbang*/ mthar lam rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi nus pa rgyud la bzhag/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ bzhi pa 'phrin las drag po'i sgral dbang ni/ sras mchog phur bu lhar gsal ba 'drel zhing*/ hūṃ 'phris ma lus sgrub pa'i rdzas: drag po'i lcags phur lhar gsal nas/ dril te 'debs par dbang bskur bas/ 'phris ma lus 'grub par shog: drag sngags po lnga pa'i mthar/ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes brjod gatsho bso ji ltar sogs kyi dam tshalig bsgrag cing bzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi dang mtshungs par ba'o/ tshul 'di bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor rgyun gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang 'brel bar bdag 'jug sogs la 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir sgrub par byas ba las/ gzhan du slom mar dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni zur du 'byung ba ltar ma gtogs sla chos kyi cho ga 'di thogs nas des chog 'dis 'ong la snying po mi byed gal che'o/ bla med bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bdag nyid 'jug bya'i cho ga 'khyer bde ba/ bla ma'i zhal lung ji bzhin bris pa'i dges/

'gro kun bzang he ru ka thob shog/ de ltar bde gshegs 'dus pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor rgyun gyi dbang bskur dang 'brel bar bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga khyer bder bkod pa 'di yang rang nyid nyams len bde ba'i phyir smin gling yig char 'byin 'jug phra mo tsam gyis rang lugs su rtags pa yang 'bri gung pa dharma pya dhā dzas so/ shu bhaṃ/ (273) (ya) ༄༅// bde gshegs 'dus pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga phan bde'i dpal yon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ oṃ swasti sid+dhi/ bde gshegs 'dus pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga phan bde'i dpal yon zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ rang 'byams phyogs dus rgyal pa kun gyi mkhyen nus pa'i phung po kun/ gcig bsdu 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter chen 'gro ngor ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul/ rigs brgyī khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun bla ma pad+ma'i mtshan/ byang chub du bde chen 'khor lor mi 'bras bsten cing phyag bgyi'o/ chos sku skye med yongs dag rig rtsal mdangs/ 'gag med zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor longs spyod rdzogs/ gang 'dul sprul pa'i gar mkhan bde 'dus lha/ bdun brgya nyer lngar 'dud do mchog mthun stsol/ bde gshegs snang brnyan phyag rgyas byin rlob pa'i/ rang gnas chog bsgrigs phan bde'i dpal yon 'di/ brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung 'phros la brten nas/ bris la rtsa gsum dam can gnang (274) ba stsol/ de la 'dir gtor chen chos kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag myang nyi 'od zare gyis lho brag 'kho mthing nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter bde gshegs 'dus pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos sde las/ byin rlabs rang gnas kyi cho ga rim pa gsum pa rtsa 'grel gyis dgongs don gong ma'i phyag rgyan dang bsdebs nas chog khrigs phan bde'i dpal yon 'god pa la spyi don bdun las/

rang gnas kyi rang bzhin/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang du bya ba'i gnas/ gang gi tshe bya ba'i dus/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga /de ltar byas pa'i phan yon bshad pa'o/ spyi don dang po rang bzhin ni/ rang gzhung rtsa ba las/ rab gnas la yang gnyis yod de/ bya dgos mi dgos gnyis su bstan/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i chos nyid nam mkha' ltar kun khyab bzhugs pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa shes rab can gyi dbang du byas na/ rang gzhung rtsa ba las/ chos nyid stong pa'i don rtogs na: gang zhig gang gi gang du brlab: gdod nas ma skyes skye med la: ji ltar ji ltar rab tu gnas: chos rnams 'od gsal skye med du: rtogs par ldan pa'i mchod gnas rnams: rab tu gnas pa mi dgos so: zhes dang*/ yang sku gzungs kyi rten sogs de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i rnam rol sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar sprul pa'o snyam pa'i dad pa can gyi dbang du byas na/ yang snga ma'i 'phros las/ yang na stong nyid ma rtogs kyang : sku gzugs glegs baṃ mchod rten sogs: sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul byin rlabs las: byang chub ste min na mi 'byung bas: rtogs te shin tu ldan na: rab tu gnas pa mi dgos so: zhes pas de don gnyis po khong du ma chud pa'i gdul bya thun mongs pa rnams tshogs gnyis kyi gnas la 'god phyir rab gnas kyi cho ga dgos par bstan pa ni/ rang gzhung rtsa bar/ rab gnas dgos pa'i rgya mtshan ni: 'jig rten tha snyad gnas pa ste: kun rdzob don du bstan pa yin: ces drang nges bas gsungs pa bzhin/ rab rgyud las/ 'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas/ rab tu gnas par rab tu brtag /ces gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ ngo bo ni bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs rab gnas las/ dang po rab gnas kyi

(275) ngo bo ni ye nas chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'o: zhes dang*/ de nyid kyi rgyud las/ phyi nang snod bcud snang srid kun: ye nas chos sku'i ngo bor gnas: der shes dbyings las ma g.yos na: rnam dag rten mchog bla na med: ces rten gang la sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan rnams bsdus pas dge zhing bkris pa'i don du yin te/ kalpor sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la: ye shes gzhug pa'i byin rlabs can: 'khor ba 'byung ba lnga yi gnas: sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid yin: gsungs pa bzhin no/ ngos tshig ni bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs las: gzugs brnyen rten la ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshams sbyar te ye shes rab tu gnas par byaid pa'o: zhes gsungs pas/ kun rdzob gzugs brnyen du snang ba'i rten de la/ ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te dam tshigs pa dang ye shes pa mtshams sbyar te rten de ye shes kyi ngo bor rab tu gnas par byed pa la rab gnas kyi cho ga zhes bya'o/ spyi don gnyis par rab tu gnas bya'i rten ni/ rab gnas rgyud las/ sku gzugs mtshan nyid ldan pa de/ zhi ba la sogs ro yi ldan/ tshad kyis tshad la phab cing bzang*/ de 'dra rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas bris 'bur sogs gzugs sku'i rten de bzhin gshegs pa zhi khro'i snang brnyan dang*/ gsung rten rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gsung rab glegs bam/ thugs rten chos sku'i mchod rten spyi ming bye brag tu btags pa/ mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang dang*/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan sogs ji snyed pa rnams mod rgyud so so'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i cha tshad kyi tshad la phab cing bzang zhing mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba de 'dra zhig rab tu gnas par 'gyur ba'i rten du rigs pa yin ste/ snang byed zla bas/ sku gzugs mchod rten gtsug lag khang*/

dam chos rab bris glegs bam rnams/ bzang po'i tshad kyis mdzes pa dang*/ rdzogs pa bde ba'i rgyu rnams la/ de shes mtshan nyid rtogs pa yis/ rab gnas bya ba 'ogs pa ste/ rjes su yi rang byed pa dang*/ yon bdag bsod nams spel phyir ro/ zhes gsungs so/ spyi don gsum pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyu las/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes sheg/ mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes/ las rnams kun la mkhas pa so/ zhes gsungs pas/ theg pa rdo rje gsum gyi bslab pas brgyud sbyangs shing*/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gis smin cing tshig dag pa phyi nang gi de nyid bcu sogs las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor ba/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mthong brgyud phyi chad kyis mkhas pa'i don mthun lag tu longs pa ste/ slob dpon kun snying gis/ dkyil (276) 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin mchog/ phyag rgya stang stabs dag dang ni/ bzlas brjod sbyin bsreg de nyid mchod/ las dang sbyor ba nyer bsdu ba/ de nyid bcu zhes yongs su grags/ zhes sogs kyis mtshon/ de nyid bcu dang*/ gzhan yang rgyu sde nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid rnams dang ldan dgos shing*/ de nyid bcu ldan gyi slob dpon de yang sa thob ma gtogs rten gyi khyad par che ba zhi dgos te/ dus 'khor las/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shis pa/ gsum la dge slong mchog yin 'bring*/ dge tshul zhes bya de nyid las/ khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o/ zhes gsungs so/ spyi don bzhi pa gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ yang thog mchod rten sogs gnas dang*/ khyim dang lha yi gnas rnams su/ sangs rgyas la sogs rab gnas ni/ cho ga dag dang ldan byas la/ zhes sogs gsungs pas phyogs dang kho dog la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ rgyas pa'i las dang mthun cing bkra shis yid 'ong nyams dga' pa'i gnas rang gzhung rgyud ste rnams las ji ltar byung ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid ldan dgos te/

rang gzhung rtsa ba las/ yid 'ong gnas su 'dug nas ni: zhes gsungs so/ spyi don lnga pa gang gi tshe bya ba'i dus/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ zla ba drug gza' bzhi dang*/ rgyu skar bcu bzhi gang yin dang*/ tshes grangs bdun gyi grangs nyid la/ rgyal bas rab gnas la sogs bsngags/ zhes pa ltar dgun zla tha ma nas dbyar zla 'bring po'i bar nyi ma byang bgrod kyi dkar phyogs gza' skra 'phrod sbyor bzang zhing bkra shis pa la bya dgos te/ rang gzhung 'grol par/ dus tshod dang bza' skar shis pa la: zhes gsungs pas/ rang gnas dngos gzhi 'khel ba'i nyin gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa sogs yan lag lngas mtshon rtsis rgyud dang mthun pa'i phra rag rab gnas la dge ba las/ nyi ma lho bgrod la babs pa/ sreg tshes 'chi sbyor sogs dang*/ biṣ+ṭi chu tshod ma yol ba dang*/ sa bdag gdug can rgyu ba sogs med pa'i blang dor zhib tu byed pa/ rab rgyud las/ gang tshe thams cad mthun gyur na/ mi rnams mngon du 'phel bar byed/ ces gsungs shing*/ rgyud de nyid las/ gang tshe gzang dang rjes mthun na/ nag po'i phyogs la'ang brtsams par bya/ zhes pa sogs shes dgos so/ spyi don drug pa ji ltar byas ba'i cho ga bshad pa ni/ de la bsnyen pa dang rab gnas kyi cho ga dngos so/ dang po bsnyen pa la/ rang gzhung rtsa ba las/ lanag gsum gzhan gyis gsol btab pas/ yid 'ongag gnas su 'dug nas niḥ bsnyen pa rnam gnyis mthar phyin pas: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon du dkyil 'khor chen po'i bsnyen pa dus grangs mtshan ma'i rgyal 'bring bsdus gsum ci rigs kha skong sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba bzhir byas nas/ khyad par rab gnas kyi don du gzhan gyi gsol ba btab pa'am/ rang nyid kyi sgrub pa gang yin de nyid kyi ched du bsnyen pa 'bul mal stong tsam du gsol ba la 'jug par bya'o/ gnyis (277) sa rab gnas kyi cho ga dngos la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul lo/

dang po la sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ste gon gyi sdoms ni/ ligs bshams bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyib dang*/ rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ bgegs bskrad mchod la dgug gzhugs bya/ rgyas gdab mchod bstod gtor ma btang*/ snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/ rten dga' bdag bsrung ste gon no/ zhes 'di la don bcu gsum las/ dang po legs par bsham pa ni/ rang gzhung rtsa ba las/ sa yi cho ga gzhung bzhin bya: de rjes lha dang bum pa dang*/ sbyin bsregs yi lha mo dang*/ slob ma dang ni yon bdag rnams: gzhung bzhin sta gon rdzogs byas te: zhes gsungs pas/ sngar ma sbyangs pa'i ba rdul tshon ras bris gang la brten kyang*/ sa brtags pa bslang ba dbang du bya ba sbyang ba/ gzung zhing bgegs bskrad pa sogs dang*/ rgyal pa'i skabs spros 'byor che na phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshams gcod kyang bya zhing cho ga 'bring bsdus ma med kyang rung*/ de nas lha dang bum pa slob ma yod na sta gon rnams bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor bri ba bum dgod rgyan dgram sogs dbang sgrub lag len snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma ltar rab gnas rgyas 'bring dmigs phyed bdor len bya zhing*/ sngon nas sbyangs zin gyi gnas su ni/ rul tshon byed na sna gon mthar dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan bkram sogs dang ras bris la brten na 'de 'dus rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i steng mañji sogs la bum pa dgu'i/ ma 'byor tshe gcig las bum bcas sta gos 'brel tshe spos rol gyis gdan drangs te bgrod sa rgyan bkram sogs dang*/ 'bri ba nyin gnyis sogs kyi skabs gzhung bzhin bum rdzas dang kha khyan mgul 'ching ldan pa'i khar/ dung chos/ gzung dhor bzhag/ shar du sman raka gtor gsum/ lhor dbu rgyan rigs lnga*/ nub tu rdo rje dril bu/ byang du thod pa bur chang dang bdud rtsi sbyar ba me long gis bkab pa'i khar man shes bzhag pa/

gzhan yang mchod pa/ sngon gtor chad bstan/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs sbyor ba rgyas 'bring la gzhig pa'i lag len ltar gzhung bzhin chad lhag med pa bsham/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho'am shar sogs pa'i nyi logs su khrus stobs khru de grub bzhi pa dpangs su khru gang brtsigs pa'am/ de dang mnyam pa'i gzhi phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga dang ba byang chub lngas byugs pa rol kha dkar po grub zhi pa'i nang du khrus dkyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad rigs lnga yum bzhi'i sa bon bris pa'i steng du/ shing ngam ras la slar yang pam 'dab brgyad chung ngu bris pa bkod pa'i khrus gdan de'i khra khrus gzhong mo long dang bcas pa bzhag /de steng mañja'i khar sngar rab gnas zin pa'i rten byin rlabs can bzhugs/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas g.yas bskor gyis bum pa brgyad po mchu nang bstan kha rgyan mgul 'ching dang bcas/ brgyad thun mong du dri chu sgrub dung sogs gser gyi snod dang yang na dngul gyi rang bzhin dag tu/ sug mes/ shing tsha/ spang spos/ bā la ka/ tsan dan rnams zho gnyis thum phur bcings ri/ chu gatshang ma bri brgyad la bcug nas/ bzhi gsum skams skams kyi bar bskol la de'i lhag ma dri'i chur 'gyur ro/ pa'am chu matsang gis sum gnyis bkang*/ shar bum nas brtsams g.yas bskor gyis so so'i thad bum rdzas/ ga sur gur kum (278) tsan dan dkar dmar/ dza ti/ gla rtsi/ a ka ru sogs dri sna tshogs/ ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi ste mngar gsum/ spri ma med pa'i zho/ a bar skyur gsum star kha zho sogs 'bras bu/ nas 'bras gro sran dkar til dkar sogs 'bru/ 'bras yos/ bzang drug kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ dbang lag sogs snam sna tshe+ogs/ gser dngul byang chub ru mu men sbur len sogs rin po che bcas kyi phye ma rnams dang*/ bdag rdzas kyang*/ dri'i bum pa'i mdun rig po che'i snod du po cha'i snod du/ til mar dri bzang rgyas sran dkar po'i phyi ma/

mngar gsum bum pa'i mdun zangs sdo du/ 'o ma/ zho mar sbrang rtsika ra ste phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga/ zho'i bum pa'i mdun 'khar snod du ba byung lnga/ 'bras bu'i mdun mkhar snod du dri sna tshogs/ 'bru bum mdun mkhar snod du: n+ya gro dha/ u du ma/ pa lak+ṣa pispa la/ gan+dha maṇ+ḍa ste 'o ma ldan gyi shing shun lnga yin kyang bod du rnyed dka' ba'i tshab tu/ bal bu/ 'om bu/ kham bu/ skyang skya/ shug pa ste bo ma can dang cha 'dra lnga/ 'bras yos yub pa'i mdun 'khar snod du skyu ru ra'i phyi ma/ sman phum mdun mkhar snod du yung ba'i phye ma/ rin po che'i bum pa'i mdun mkhar ba'am snod ci rigs par/ kur kum/ a kum/ a ka ru/ gla rtsi/ ga pur/ tsan dan ste dri lnga bcas par so sor du rwī sir re yang bzhag de nyid kyi mtha' mchod pas bskor zhing stong nas gdugs phub/ khrus ras dri bzang gis pa bon lnga bris pa dang*/ gos zung yang bshams/ phyogs cig tu rin po che'i snod 'thor nas me tog dko pos bkang pa'i dubs su gzungs bum dri chus bkang ba'i khar gser dngul gro ga sogs la/ tsad dan dko po/ gur kum/ 'gi wi gis rten 'brel snying po tshar bdun bris 'akod/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten gyi mdun du/ mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor phyogs ri la cha lnga lnga ste bcu pa/ dbus kyi cha gnyis pa pad+ma/ phyogs bzhi'i cha bzhi po grub zhir bang rim ltar btab/ zur rnams ka bzhir bcad/ phyi rol gyi zur kun tu chung gis bskor ba lcags ri mtshan pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhir/ bla gam/ sog kha zlum po/ gru bzhi steng gling bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du gling phran chung ba gnyis re'i bar du bkra shis brtags brgyad la/ shar du dpal be dang 'khor lo/ lhor pad+ma dang rgyal mtshan/ nub tu gdugs dang bum pa/ byang du dung dang nya bri'o/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ ri rab shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar*/ byang ser/ zur bzhi nag po/

gling bcu gnyis phyogs mdog/ 'og gzhi rgya mtsho sngon po/ lcags ri mthing ga byas la/ de'i khar mañji'i steng rin po che'i snod nas 'bras gro sogs kyi bkang ba la/ sgo lnga gsal byed/ mnga' dbul yo byad dang*/ rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs gzugs bris 'bur gang rigs bkod mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod mchod pas g.yas bskor du bkod/ de'i nyo logs su stan ser po la rin po che'i snod gtsang tsā ru'i dpal bshos sha chang ma 'dres pa'i bza' bca' sna tshogs kyis bskor bsham/ gzhan yang sbyang chas zlum gtor gsum/ ting long chang sbrags gsum/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i dus nas hūṃ bzhi dang*/ rdo rje sder mo'i sngags kyis (279) nus ldan byas zin gyi yungs thun/ gu gul/ 'bras kyi char bu gsum/ zho zan gyi chang bu gsum/ sol me/ chu gtsang*/ yungs kar/ sla nga til dang*/ me chu sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad/ rol mo'i khyad par bcas mtha' dag ma tshang pa bed par logs par bsham mo/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ lugs 'dir bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig gis bsgom pa shas che bas shī la kā ra'i chog sgrig las byang ngan 'gro las rim bdun dang*/ dngos gzhi don brgyad ma bzlas pa'i bar gyis/ sgrub gzhi bdag dang mdun du bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas dang bcas pa thams cad/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin stong nyid kyi rang bzhin kun snang snying rje chen po'i ngang las rten dang brten par bcas pa bdag mdun tha mi dad par bsgom nas spyi sgos kyi 'dzab rnams ci 'grub bya/ gsum pa bum bskyed bya ba ni/ thog mar lha bum gnyis las gatsho bum la dri'i dung zhal gzungs thag rdo rje bcas bkod nas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i bum pa gtis yi ge bh+ruṃ du gyur pa las 'od 'phros/

sangs rgyas sku gsum gnyes par byas/ tshul 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam rgyal phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la dan gzhal yas khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rte babs bang rigs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yang khang gi nang du dkyil 'khor chen po dgur gyur pa'i so so'i lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa gsal ba'i dubs phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i ces sa nas bka' bsrung gi sngags mjug bar bskyed la/ las bum la dmigs nas las bum phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang bcud gzhal yangs khang gi dbus su pad nyi'i steng du/ hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje'i dbyings dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub pa khro bo'i cha lugs du ma dang ldan par gyur/ de ltar gyur pa'i nas bstod pa'i bar las byang dkyus bzhin dang*/ gzungs thag 'dzus la/ thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khyil ba mchod pa'i tshul du spros lha rnams dkyes pa bskyed/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi rgyan babs bum chu dang ro mnyam pas bum ka gang bar gyur par bsams la spyi sgos kyi 'dzab brgya stong ci nus bzla zhing*/ gzungs thag las bum khar spos la/ oṃ āḥbhigh+nān+tā kṛta hūṃ phaṭ+waḥ long skabs dang sbyar ba bzlas mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sra tīts+tsha swā hāḥ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba ling+ta sdu dza khā hiḥ dang*/ bde gshegs thams cad sho lo ka dang*/ bstod par 'os pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hāḥ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil par rab gnas kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyir bar du bgegs rnams bsrung ba dang bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig/ ces dung zhal gachod yon du 'bul lo/ zur nas byang chub ba bzhin bdag 'jug blang*/ bzung bum sgrub pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs

(280) gzi brjed 'bar/ glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog/ khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la= hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing: bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes bstod nas/ rje batshun rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= khyad par du bde gshegs 'dus pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i= dam can chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi bka'= bden pa chen po'i mthus bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bar tu gnas par byed pa la bar gcod brtsoms pa'i bgegs thams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su song zhing*/ lag te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnamasakyi mgo bo rnams pa brgyar 'gas shing brlag par gdon mi za'o/ zhes drag sngags so bdun dang*/ sum+bha dang*/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭān hūṃ phaṭaḥ kī li ya kī la ya sarba pā pān hūṃ phaṭaḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba duṣ+ṭān bigh+nān kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wakra tsit+ta badz+ra nanaḥ na mo badz+ra kro dhā yaḥ ma hā daṃṣ+ṭado ka ra bhai ra bā ya a si muḥ sa la dhā rā ya pa ra shu pā sha hasā yaḥ oṃ a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa liḥ kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na/ da ha da ha sa tsa sa tsa gardza gardza bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya sarba bigh+nan bi na ya kaṃ ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi wi taṃ dzi wi taṃḥ an+ta ka rā ya swā hāḥ zhes bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ring 'di rnams bzla zhing*/ gu gul gyis bdug

yungs thun gyasi brab/ rol mo'i sgra drag po tsham rngags dang bcas pas gathor ma byi rol du dor/ bsrung 'khor bsgom mo/ gnyis pa mi shes pa sbyang ba ni/ rtsa bar tha mal sa yis byas pa yi: dri ma ngan pa bsal ba'i phyir: sogs nas bzhi mdor do: bar gsungs pas/ las kyi rdo rjes 'bras kyi chang bu gsum rten la g.yas bskor lan gsum dang bsdun bsgrub pa po rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ/ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hāḥ lan gsum gyis sla ngar blug/ de bzhin du zho zan gyi chung bu yang*/ sngags dang gong ltar bskor ba sla ngar blug/ lag gnyis snyim par yungs kar bzang la g.yas g.yon gnyis su lan re dang*/ gnyis kas g.yas bskor gcig byas la gong sngags bzla bzhin me chur dor/ lag gnyis snyim pa chu gtsang gis bkang ba/ g.yas g.yon du sngar ltar sngags dang bcas de bskor ba/ mer der mthar me chu gnyis kyang sla ngar blug ste/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten dang bdag cag yon mchod rnams la mi shis par byed pa'i byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro/ de rjes slob dpon gyi lag gis rten la reg la tshul bya zhing dkyil 'khor gatsho bo'i sngags bzla/ rten dngos sam me long du 'char ba'i thugs kar dri bzang byug la/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ dbu ma me thog gi phreng ba bcings tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba ting phor gtsang mar sbreng zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ brjod cing rten mdun bzhag/ mar me rten la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ko āḥhūṃ/ rten mdun bzhag bil ba'i 'bras bu'am 'bras can shing gis g.yas su bskor zhing las sngags brjod la byab tshul bya/ spros dkar mar dang bcas pas bdun ste las sngags dang hūṃ bdun bzla'o/ gsum pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mdun du til g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bkod la/

rang dang yon bdag gi rkang zhabs rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ des snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon sam nag po gnas pa sdig sgrib thams cad bsdus pa gdungs te sna nas thon til la thim par gyur/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byang chub ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zluṃ po dkar po kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pas spras pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ram las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su khro bo rdo rje mkhro nam po zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdor dril mdzan pa phyag rgya drug dang mgo phyeng stag spags kyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis gnas par g.yal ba'i ljags pa ram yig gi mtshan pa'i zhal du phul bas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pa' paṃ da ha na bhasmiṅku ru swā hā zhes mtheb srin gyis tel thogs pa g.yas kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi g.yon du bskor ba'i mthar pad bskor dang bcas bsnol ba'i rgyas me chur dor ba lags gsum bya/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghi pra tīts+tsha swā hā shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyed rdo rje ye shes che/ rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' chen po/ rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ rdo rje mkhror phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ yig bgayas chad lhag bkang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs gsol/ lnga pa bkru zhing 'phyi ba ni/ rtsa bar de rjes dbag 'charal lnga yis bkru/ ba byung lngas kyang bkrul ba dang : til mar dag kyang byug par bya: shing bal gyi ni sku 'phyis la: dbang stegs steng du de nyid bzhugs: sogs rgyas par gsungs pas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pas rten rnams kyi dbu la gdugs phung cing bkru zhing 'phyis par gyur pas bsam/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/

khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa yang*/ rtag tu thub pa rnams la dbus bar bgyi/ oṃ āḥta pa tā hūṃ gis gdugs dbul/ rten bkru 'os shing bskyed bde ba rnams khrus stegs khar bkod (281) mi btub pa rnams me long du shar ba'i gzugs brnyen nyid bkru bar bya ste/ thom ram las bum thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs du ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyin pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba kha la bsgyur ba/ bla ni med pa/ lha dang mi n+mas kyi ston pa de la 'o byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing mtsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ mu ting 'od chags re brase pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ rol mos bcas pa dus mas sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus dkyil dbus kyi rten rnyeng par sku khrus gsol la khrus gzhong gi chu bum par blug/ de dag sku= gatshang la= oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri āḥka ya bi sho dha ne swā hā slar yang las bum chus rim par bkru zhing*/ bskal bzang dam pa 'chi med dgyes/ mchog tu mdzas pa'i cha byad can/ rdo rje slob dpon dpal mchog la/ bdag gis khrus 'ab bar bgyi/ oṃ parba ta thā ga ta she ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ khrus ras kyi 'phyi zhing*/ rgyal dang rgyas pa'i sras kyi sku rnams la/ rang dkar sman dang ldan pas sku 'phyis pas/ mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nyes pa'i tshogs ma lus dag cig /oṃ sarba thā ga ta kā ya = ma rig 'dzems pa'i nyi ma ste/ srid pa'i nang ni sem ba'i sman/ dam chos rin chen 'di dag la/

dbag gi khrus 'di gsal bar= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi= rgyal dang rgyal ba'i= ras dkar= mi shes = nyes pa'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= chos kyi sku yi bdag nyid can/ mchog gi yon tan gzugs brnyan gyi/ mchod rten rin chen 'di dag la/ bdag gi khrus 'di= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a= rgyas dang = ras dkar= mi shes= nyes pa'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= mcha tu tshim zhing skal bzang*/ dam pa'i bdud rtsi mdzes cha byad/ dge 'dun rin chen 'di dag la/ bdag gi= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a= rgyas dang = ras dkar = mi shes= nyes pa'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= gdul bya'i sems can gang dag la/ rgyal (282) ba'i sprul sku mang po yi/ lha yi cha byad can rnams la/ bdag gis khrus: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a= rgyas dang = ras dkar= mi shes= nyes pa'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= snying rje yis ni nges gang ba/ rtag tu phan dang bde mdzad pa/ mchog tu dus ba de dag la/ bdag gis khrus 'di/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a= rgyal dang = ras dkar= mi shes= nyes pa'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gnas dang ni/ slob pa dge 'dun gnas kyi sa/ gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhan la/ bdag gi khrus 'di= oṃ sarba thā ga ta a= rgya dang = ras dkar= mi shes= nyes pa'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= lha bum gnyis kyi chu cung zad re khrus bum brgyad la yang blug na mchog dman mthun mong du 'gyur zhing*/ khrus bum brgyad kyi bkru ba'i thog mar/ shar gyi rin po che'i snod nas til mar rgya sran dkar po'i phyi ma dri chur sbyar ba durwa'i pir gyis me long la byug bzhin hūṃ thugs rjes lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas sku gzugs la/ dri zhim dang bcas til mar gyis mnyes pas/ las dang nyom mongs bag chags kun byang nas/ spyod lam rnam par dag pa'i sku thob shos: dur pir gyis sku mnye byug cing*/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā/ de bsal phyir shing shun lngī phye mas drel phyis dur ser gyis drung cing mnye tshul gyi/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes chu gtsang gis bkru zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ de nas dri sna tshogs kyis bum pas bkru zhing 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ ci 'dod dngos grub rtsol bar mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā gta ghan+dhe sna na sdu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye swā hāḥ zhes bkru/ sku 'phyi thogs la/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku 'phyi'o/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī āḥ kā ya bi sho dha she swā hāḥ zhes khrus ras kyi 'phyi ba sogs lag len 'di dag 'og ma rnams la yang sbyor ro/ shor lho'i zangs snod kyi 'o zhor mar sbrang kar ra lnga dung pir gyis drung bzhin/ hūṃ thugs rje lhun rdzogs= 'o zho mar sbrang ka ra lngas mnyes pas: las dang mon mongs= spyod lam rnams par dag= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ghan+dhe= mngar gsum bu pas bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa= lha rnams= lha yi= de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ma dhu sna na sdu dza= de dag= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ= lho'i 'khar snod kyi ba byang chub lnga du pir gyis mnye zhing brud la/ hūṃ thugs rje lhun rdzogs= ba byang chub lnga yis byug cing mnyes pa yis/ las dang nyon mongs= spyod lam= oṃ hūṃ trī= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra= zho'i bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ ser sna'i dri sbyong mdzad cing*/ gtong ba dri mi legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi'o/ (283) oṃ sarba ta thā ga dhi sna na sdu dza= de dag= gtsang = oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a= lho nub kyi 'khar snod nas dri bzang sna tshogs phyi ma brud bzhin/ hūṃ

thugs rje lhun rdzogs= dri bzang sna tshogs phye mas bar gnyes pas: las dang= spyod lam= oṃ hūṃ= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra= 'bra bu'i bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni tshul khrims= 'charal pa'i dri ma= bsrung ba= khrus legs mdzad= oṃ sarba ta tā pha la sna na sdu dza= de dag= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ= nub kyi 'khor snod nas shing shun lnga'i phye mas mnye zhing*/ hūṃ thugs rje lhun rdzogs= shing shun lnga yi phye ma 'dis gnyes pasaḥ las dang = spyod mal= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra= 'bru'i bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni bzod pa'i= khong khro'i dri ma= byams pa dri yi= khrus legs= oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta bru hi sna na sdu dza= de dag sku= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ traṃ= nub byang gi 'khar snod nas skyu ru phye mas mnye zhing*/ hūṃ thugs rje lhun rdzogs= skyu ru ra yi phye ma 'dis gnyes pasaḥ las dang = spyod lam= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ= oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta kā ya= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra= 'a yos kyi bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni brtsen 'grus= le lo'i dri ma= nan tan= khrus legs mdzad= oṃ sarba tā thā ta lardza sna na sdu dza= de dag= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ= byang gi 'khar snod nas yung ba'i phye ma brud la/ hūṃ thugs rje lhun rdzogs= yung ba'i phye ma 'di yis rab mnyes pas: las dang = spyod lam= oṃ lam= oṃ hūṃ traṃ= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra= sman gyi bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chung*/ rnam g.yeng dri= ting 'dzin dri= khrus legs= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta au ṣa dhi sna na sdu dza= de dag= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ= byang shar gyi 'khar snod nas dri lnga phye mas mnye zhing brud tshul gyis/ hūṃ thugs rje lhun rdzogs= dri bzang lnga yi phyi ma 'dis mnyes pasaḥ las dang = spyod lam= oṃ hūṃ traṃ= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya=

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra= rin po che'i bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni shes rab rang = shes 'chal dri= ye shes dri= khrus legs= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sna na sdu dza= de dag= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ= khrus bum gcig yin na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes pa kho na sbyar bas mthus so/ khrus bum brgyad yod na 'di phyin gyi khrus rkyang rnams dri sna tshogs kyi bum pa kho na dang*/ gcig yin na khrus bum de gas bya zhing*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ gang la nyes pa mi mnga' ba'i/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ oṃ sarba thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta= dri chu drug gi khrus byas pas= dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing*/ rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ oṃ sarba ta thā (284) ga ta a bhi= dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi= de dag= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ traṃ= de nas dpon slob rnams g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas me tog 'thor/ g.yon dril bu gsil/ rdo rje las pas khrus bum gyi chu kha rgyan gyis 'thor zhing = gang le ser sna rnam chags pa/ rnams 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*/ thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ thar pa'i mal du 'jug mdzad cing*/ chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed pa bde legs mdzad par gyur/ ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ gang zhig bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la bde legs= skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ thugs kyi 'gor ba 'di dag kun/ bu gcig bzhin du rtag skyang des/ khyed la bde= gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/

khyed la= gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur/ gatshang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' ba/ gsung gtsang gtsang mar dag pa des/ khyed pa bde= dpal bo chen po gang skyes pa/ phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*/ don gru tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la/ gang zhig skyes pa sa rnams ni/ nag tsham bcas pa rab g.yos shing*/ sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ khyed la bde legs= byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ sa bdag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ bdud yid mi 'der gyu pa des/ khyed la= chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*/ thub pa'i snyan pa gang byang chub des/ khyed la= yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing/ tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la= sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang*/ 'byung so kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig sangs rgyas bson nams mthu dag dang*/ lha rnams kyis ni bsam pa yis/ kyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cig bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde gyur cig /phyir 'ongs rnams kyi bde legs shing khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs gyur/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cig sdig par ma gyur cig /spro na ston mchog dam sa sogs kyang bya/ bum pa de nyid kyis/ sku mchog rnam dag lta bas mi ngoms shings/ ngo mtshan skyon bral mkha' dbyings nyi gsal 'dra/ chos kyi sku la mgris pa mi mnga' yang*/ sri zhu bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ chu gtsang sman spos 'o ma 'dag chal chus/ 'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal dan bsal te/ nyes pa'i skyon bral 'gro ba'i yid 'ong ba/ dam pa'i sku mtshog bdag gis thob par shog /oṃ sarba sogs rol mos bcas pas khrus gsol/
bde gshegs

(285) sku gsum dpe dang mtshan mnga' yangs/ 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'/ rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*/ 'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsi du/ sdim med rgyas ba rnams kyis rang bsngags pa'i/ rang mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku 'phyis pas/ nyon mangs dug gsum sgrib pa kun byang nas/ sku gsum ngang du bdag cag 'gyur bar shog/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hās sku 'phyi/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ dri mcho rnams kyi thub bang rnams kyi sku/ gser sbyangs batsho ma byi der byas pa ltar/ 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā zhes zhes dung zhal gyi dri byug /gos zug dbul zhing de nas de la kha dogalegs bsgyur ba'i/ na bzang dab pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul/ oṃ was+t+ra ye swā hāḥ zhes brjod/ drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ rtsa bar de rjes lha ru bskyed pa yang ཿ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lhar bskyed de: gtso 'khor bcas pa bskyed par bya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin bskyed na rten la dri sngas byug/ oṃ āḥbhigh+nan gyi bsangs/ oṃ ma hā de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin shu n+yai ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 taṃ/ āḥkun snang ting 'dzin dharma dhartu dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ hūṃ rgyu'i ting 'dzin badz+ra tsit+ta ka hūṃ/ yongs rdzogs rab gnas spros pa nyer bsdu'i skabs las/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi khog phung nas: rtog gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas steng bcas steng du: hūṃ las rten yid dam bstod pa de nyid du gsal bar bskyed: ces gsungs pa'i don bzhi no/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes dang*/ rten rnams rang bzhin gyi yi ge hūṃ mthing nag gcig tu gyur hūṃ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phros sogs nas/

bdag nyid kyi rnam par shis pa don nas/ ye shes sems dpa'i nas rang nyid bzhag/ skad cig gis bcob ldan 'das 'das sogs dgyus bzhin bka' bsrung gi sngags pa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa bar gyi gtso 'khor rnams gsal bar bskyed pa'am/ bye brag tu bskyed na/ las sngags kyi bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sku rten rnams seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas snyoms ma dkar mo rdor dril 'dzin pad nga mnyam par sbyor ba zhes bskyed/ mchod rten dang gdang gtsug lag khang sogs seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sogs kyi stong du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyi mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyan ma dkar ma 'khor dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de bzhin du glogs bam rnams rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sems kyi nga du āṃ las pad+ma āṃ gis mtshan pa las snang ba mtha' yang dmar po pad+ma dang dri bu 'dzin pa/ gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dang pad+ma'i drib bu 'dzin pa dang*/ phyag 'tshan rnams glang pos btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sogs kyi stong du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyed pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbyings phyug ma sngon mo rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ (286) rin po che'i rgyan sogs rta mchog gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sogs kyi stong du swā las rin po che swā mtshan pa las rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mā ma ki ser mo rin po che dang rig po che'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang*/ go cha sogs shang shang gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sogs kyi stong du hā las ral gri hās mtshan las don grub ljang gu ral gri dang dril dbu 'dzin pa/

dam tshig sgrol ma ljang ku ral gri dang ral gri dang ral gri'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ bye brag de rnams gang bskyed mthar thams cad kyi zhing zhing 'dzum pa mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas par dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing 'od dang 'od zor mtha' yas pa spros ba'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs pa'o/ gang ltar yang de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par āḥdamar po snying gar hūṃ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par bsam/ bdun pa spyan drang ba ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs la: brtan par bzhugs shing gnyis med bstam: phyang dang mchod bstod la sogs bya: zhes gsungs pas: rang rang rten gyi thugs kyi sa bon las lcags kyu ltu'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dam tshigs ltu'i ye shes pa las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam/ rdor dril spos bcas thogs nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cig /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyin gyur pa'i/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje sbyangs shing*/ smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ khyod bzhed 'gro don mdzad du 'dir lags na/ de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ nyam ma las ni gzi brjid che/ dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ dul zhing bsam gtan pa la bzhugs/

chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ tshur spyod tshur spyod zhi dag lha/ thub pa skye mchog thams cad mkhyen/ shin tu legs spyad gzugs brnyen ni/ mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyangs/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ mchog rnams legs par rtsal du gsol/ zhes spyan drangs nas phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams las sngags dang sum+bha bzla zhing gu gul bdug yungs thun rol mo dang bcas bskrad/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na (287) sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes mchod yod phul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhani bdag gi sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā pad+ma ka ma ye stāṃ/ zhes gdan dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sra tits+tsha swā hāḥ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ slar yang jil ltar sangs rgyas thams can ni/ dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ de bzhin gzugs rnyan lhan cig tu/ 'dir ni mgon po rteg bzhugs nas/ byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*/ bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don slad du/ bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa dang*/ me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ rjes su su brtse bar dgos su gsol/ kun gyi 'di la byin rlob cing*/ 'di nyid du ni buzhags par rigs/ zhes dang*/ hūṃ thugs rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing*/ byams pa'i zhags pas gnas nas spyan yang 'dren/

lcags sgrog bka' yi pho nyas gnas bskyed la/ bde gshegs bzhugs shing rnam grol dgyis pa bskyed*/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes dam tshigs pas nya bar bkug/ zhags pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃḥ zhes dam tshig pa la ye shes gzhug /lcags sgrog gi rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃḥ zhes dam ye dbyer med du bcing*/ dril bu'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya hoḥ zhes ro gcig gis ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya rten gyi gnas gsum du bzhag pa'am/ der mos la gnas byi lha rnags kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad po oṃ gyi mtshan pas rgyas bathab par bsam la/ oṃ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba nga rdo rje mi byed gsum gyis sku/ deng 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ sku yi dbyig tu dbang bskur ro/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 ham/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ā sa mtshan pa= āḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung bachang ba/ rdo rje mi phyad gsum gyi gsungs/ deng 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ gsung gi dbyig tu dbang bskor ro/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 ham/ thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa= hūṃ dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba/ rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi thugs/ deng 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ thugs kyi dbyig tu dbang bskur ro/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3ham/ zhes rgyas gdab bo/ 'dir rgyas gdab ba dang rjes su 'brel ba dbang bskur dgos pa ni/ rtsa bar de rjes slob dpon bdag nyid kyisaḥ dbang bskur bum pa dngos thogs nas: gdugs dang ba dan la sogs bya: bkra shis 'don cing rol mo sgrog: rab (288) gnas lha la dbang bskur ro:

zhes gsungs pas/ dngos gzhi'i dbang las dbu rgyan yan bya'o/ rab gnas shin tu bsdus pa'i rtse bar: bum dngos su mi bskur te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bsam pa ni: nas dbang ni bskur bar bsam par bya: zhes gungs pa'i don bzhin byas na sna gon la dbang dngos med kyang rung bar sems so/ dgu pa mchad dang gtor ma btang ba ni/ rtsa bar/ de nas rag gnas lha la ni: bstod dang mchod pa byas ba yin: zhes gsungs pas/ dang po mchod pa las sngags kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur sogs nas sra tīts+tsha ye swā hāḥ bar las byang ltar byin rlabs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub cing*/ zhing khams mtsho'i mchod yon mtsho'i tshogs/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ dad pa rgyal mtshos dbul lo dngos grub stsol/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghi pra tits+tsha sdu dza me gha pa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ya hūṃ/ de bzhin du pā rgyam nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na phyag rgya gar mchod bya zhing bsdu na 'dir chog/ oṃ shri badz+ra hi ru ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra pañca a mṛ kha ri khā hi/ de bzhin du ma hā rak+ta dang*/ ma hā ba ling+ta sbyar bas sman raka gdor gsum phul nas/ hūṃ bde gshegs sku lngī yon tan rdzogs pa'i lhaḥ sogs kyi bstod/ rang gzhung nas gungs pa ltar rab gnas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ rten gang yin gyi lha sngags shes na bzla zhing*/ spyir rten snying*/ yag brgya yang brgya rtse sogs bzla'o/ gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ 'das pa'i gtor ma las byang ltar byin rlabs dang rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pas phul/ gnas de nyid du'am spro na sgrub khang phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha gsum rang gzhung ngam/ 'jug bder 'dod rje btsun chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i cha gsum cho ga 'phrin las grub byed btang na legs par mngon zhing*/

'on kyang bsangs sbyangs rang gzhung ltar bgyur zhing bden stobs cung zad sbyar dgos so/ cha gsum phyi rol btang tshe nang du 'jug khar nye reg dgos par gsungs pas tsog pur 'dug pa'i lag pa gnyis pus mo'i nang du son par bya zhing*/ g.yon pas dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i chu'i snod bzung*/ g.yas pas tho mo bkan pa'i gung dang ming med cung zad bskum pa'i chu la reg nas mi smra bar mchu la lan mang du byab cing*/ rnam ba'i bu ga gnyis dang*/ mig gnyis dang*/ sna'i bu ga dang*/ lag pa dang*/ lte ba dang*/ mgo bor lan gsum du nye reg byas la slob dpon gyis rting mnan te phyir 'brang gi bgegs rnams sum+bha nis bskrad la sgrub khang du 'ong ngo/ grub na lha rnams tshib pa'i lad du skabs 'dir g+r+yas pa'i sbyin bsreg bya'o/ bcu pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ rang 'grel las de nas rab gnas lha rnams ni/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i tshig ni brjod: gsungs pas su mo btsugs la lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos 'thul zhing*/ g.yon dril bu gsam/ oṃ badz+ra ji hwāḥ lce hūṃ la skyes pa'i rdo rjer (289) gyur par mos/ rdo rje sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das: rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo: slob pa rnams la brtse ba dang : khyod rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rab gnas can: mgon po bdag ni bgyi bar 'tshal: bdag kyang slom bcas pa la: thugs brtse bar ni dgongs nas kyang*/ tshogs pa thams cad bar gnas pa/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs so gsol ba ni/ yi dge brgya pa lan gsum gyi lhag chad bskang zhing*/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang zhas sogs kyi nengs pa bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mu badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha/ rten gyi ye shes nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur par mos/

oṃ shri badz+ra ha ru ka sarba ta thā ga ta pā bhan+dha ni ka ro mi/ zhes ye shes par phyag bya/ nyes spyod lngas mchod/ bcu gnyis pa rten dga' pa ni/ rtsa bar/ sku gzugs zhal de phyir bstan la: na bza' ser pos g.yogs te bzhag/ gsungs pa sngon du nye reg ni/ rten dam tshig par gsal ba'i thugs ka /mgul spyi'o/ phrag pa mas su dris byug mchod mdor bsdus bya/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas rten la lan gsum reg la/ gtso bo'i sngags dang las sngags kyi mthar*/ oṃ badz+ra rahi/ zhes rdo rje go cha'i sngags gyas rten bsrung*/ oṃ badz+ra wasra hūṃ/ la na bza' ser po g.yaugs te mi mthong bar bya'o/ bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ni/ rang 'grel las/ bdag nyid gatsho bo'i nga rgyal btang la/ dkyil 'khor shar du yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis seng ge'i nyal stabs chos nyid dang ldan pas nyal lo: de ni rab gnas ste gon la gnas pa'o/ zhas gsungs pas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes rang gi gnas gsung du rdo rje reg la bsrung/ skabs 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo nas las byang 'jug chog/ rang nyid gatsho 'khor bskyed rim/ gshegs bsdu byas la thun mtshams kyi lhu'i rgyal gyis nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug/ slob mar dbang bskur bya dgos na rten dga' zin ma thag dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi dang po dang 'brel ba'i skabs 'dir byas nas rjes kyi rim pa dang*/ bdag bsrung nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gong ltar ro/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sdom ni/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod/ rten sbyangs bkru zhing 'phyi ba dang*/ ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ gsol gdab mnga' dubal rgyas par bya/ de yang mchod bstod bya brag dang*/ sbyin bsreg sngags de dngos gzhi'o/ zhes 'di la don bcu gsum yod pa las/ dang po mdag mdun gyi cho ga ni/ rtsa ba las mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du song ba yi/
bskyed rim ldan pas bum pa'i bzlas pa bya/ sogs dang*/ bdag nyid ltar bskyed pa nas/ mchod cing bstod pa bya/ bar gyis gsungs pas/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs nas/ khrus bya
