(290) rgyan gos gsar pa bstan*/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yod byad tshogs gtor sogs dang*/ mnga' dbul gyi mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rgya tsher bsam/ bum pa rnams chu zhal gso/ bdag mdun bum pa sogs sgrub cing bzlas pa gtor 'bul bdag nyid 'jug pa'i dbang len/ tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma yan dang gzungs khrus kyi ma pa rnams sgrub pa yan bya/ gnyis pa rten sbyang ba gsum*/ gsum pa bkru zhing 'phyi ba rnams ni sta gos bzhin las/ 'grub rung na khrus kyi las nyam ma 'char ka dang bsgrigs par gsungs so/ bzhi pa ring bsre gzhug pa ni/ 'bur sku mchod rten sogs la sngon du ring bsrel rnam lnga'i tshul gyis gzungs gzhug grub pa dang*/ bris sku sogs la rgya yig sngon nas tshal ba zhig dgos pas/ skabs 'dir dbu'i phyogs su bug pa sogs la 'jug pa lag len mi bde bas/ ring bsrel gzhug pa'i dod tsam du/ oṃ sarba brgyi swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā h+ya wa datā/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa bcas ci rigs bzla zhing*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ brjod pa phyag bzhes yin/ lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rab gnas mkhan po dge slob yin na snam sbyar gyon/ dhor dril 'dzin pas me tog 'thor ba dang spos bsreg cing rol mo nyer bsdaugs kyis bsgrongs te sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran pa'i dad gus dang bcas/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhal su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skye bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcol ldan 'das te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/

chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne ye ta thā ga tā ya/ adha te samyaklaṃ bud+dhā ya/ targya tha/ oṃ mu ni mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes dang rab tu gnas bya'i rten gyi sngags dngar bar tu gnas byed dkyil 'khor lha'i rtsa sngags/ rten 'brel snying po su pra tiṣ+ṭha rnams tshar re bzla ba'i tshe rten la mo tog 'thor*/ rol mo spos 'dug sosag bya ba 'og ma'i bar mtshams kun la 'gro/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa 'dun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jags pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang*/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa gdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/ de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te= gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa/ cho 'khrul gsum dang (291) ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma logs pa'i ye shes dang*/ shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pas nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te= gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs yang dag par par bsags dang*/ skye bu chen po'i mtshan sum chu rtsa gtis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnams par mdzes pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po sku lta bas chos mi shes pa dang mthong na mi matun pa med pa ste/ dge'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ oṃ na mo bha ga= zhes pa rnams lan gsum bya/ slar ma nam mkha' dngamanyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral myur du bla nam med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ zhale lan gsum dang*/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bung ste nyi ma sang na tsham gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ zhes lan gsum byas la/ 'dus pa chen po tog las gsungs pa'i sems bskyed kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ rten la phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ gding ba'i stong du pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga pa la btsugs shing*/ thal mo'i bar du me thog dang bcas/ ngo mtshan chen po grangs med pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi/ de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas pa bgyis pas de'i mthus bdag cag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbyung ngo*/ 'khor ba'i gcong rol chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log badren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyis mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtogs pa thams cad bsam bar bgyi'o/ sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo snyil bar bgyi 'o/ sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do/ 'chi ba'i nyi ma phye mar brlog go

/ma rigs pa'i mun pa bsamabar bgyi'o/ ma dad pa dang*/ lta ba phyi ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzung cing dad par bsgyur ro/ las kyi chu bo ldog par bgyi'o/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho skems par bgyi'o/ chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba la brtser rtsal to/ 'dod chags kyi me dpung gzhil bar bgyi'o/ zhes sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhol par bgyi'o/ bden (292) pa la bzud do/ phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ ser sna'i mdun pa grol bar bgyi'o/ sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ cos me tog 'thor ba sogs lan gsum gyi bar bya'o/ drug pa rten bskyed pa dang*/ bdun pa ye shes spyan drangs shing bgegs bskrad nas mchod cing*/ bar 'dir sta gon ltar gyi/ lce hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed pa dang spos dang bcas rdo rje sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das sogs snyan gsan dbab pa lan gsum byed pa kun mkhyen bu ston gyi bzhed do/ sta gon gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa dang spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa gtis 'dres te dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ thugs rje'i lcags kyus sogs dkyus bzhin dgugs gzhug bcing mnyes bya ba/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa rnams sta gon gyi dus lta 'dir bya'o/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha la dbang bya bar mchog khrus sngon du 'gro ba nyid yin pas/ thog mar bdang lha spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum sogs dpal lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs te nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes shāsta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bstod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ mchod cing ji ltar sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnam g+r+yal bum pa'i chu dung chos su blungag pa bzung ste rdo rjes 'thor tshul dang*/ las kyi rdo rjes las bum dang*/ khrus ras gos zung*/ mo long rdzas sogs 'du bgyis la/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha'i sa snying la sogs pa byang sems dang*/ rdo rje sgog mo la sogs pa sems ma rnams kyi zhal nas bkra shis kyi tshig bcad gsungs shing*/ me tog 'thar ba dang mchod par gyur par mos/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi bdag po mchog sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rigs kyi yum rnams kyis khrus gsol zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu len cing mchod khro bo rnams kyis bgegs sgrod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad par gyur/ las kyi rdo rjes khrus ras gos zung phrag par bcangs pa'i lag gson gyis me long bzung*/ g.yas las bum chus khrus gsol te sngod du dri lnga dur sir gyi me long la byug (293) cing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ dri mchog rnams kyis thun dbang rnams kyi sku/ gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor ya pa ltar*/ 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ oṃ hūṃ sri hriḥ.āḥ zhes byug*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hāḥ til mar byug shing shun lnga phyi mas kyang btsub par byas te/

dri chu'aṃ gtsang gis bkru zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ khrus gsol ma/ ji ltar bltams pa sngags dang bcas bkru zhing*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis dung chos kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang tshogs pa rnams kyis rol mo bya zhing me tog 'thor/ de dag sku la= gtsang la= oṃ hūṃ trāṃ= sku phyi*/ de nas de la sogs kyi gos zung 'bul/= de nas dbang dngos ni bum thobs la/ hūṃ rin chen rgyan ldan bum pa na/ g+r+ya ba zhi khro 'od du zhu: sku gzungs spyi bor dbang bskur bas/ sgo gsum sgrib pa byang bar shog oṃ badz+ra kā la sha kā la wak+tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a hāḥ zhes dbang bskur ba'i tshul bya zhing bum chu 'thor/ rigs lnga'i dub rgyan bzung ste/ hūṃ snying po lnga las phyag mtshan lnga: de la rigs lngas dbu brgyan pas/ khams gsum yi shes bskyed pa'i phyir: sku lnga ye shes lnga thob shog: oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃḥ bskur tshul bcas mnga' dbul stogs su bzhag /sta gon la dbang byed skabs*/ dbu rgyan bskur rjes/ oṃ hūṃ zhes rdo rje'i bdos bog/ oṃ bashra tu bya ho/ zhes thal mos mastes par bya ba 'di yan gyis chog go dhor dril thogs la/ hūṃ sku lnga ye shes lnga'i rdo rjedza sangs rgyas dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro dril: thabs dang shes rab dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug lam la spyod par shog /oṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra hūṃ ghaṇ+ḍe a aḥ oṃ a dhi pra ti a bhi ṣiñca mi: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma yaḥ dhor dri yang dub rgyan dang lhan cig bzhag /dhor dril lhag cig rten gyi spyi bor bzung tshul byas la/ hūṃ rdo rje che mchog rtsal khyed kyiḥ yi dam che mchog he ru ka: rigs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ ma hā he ru ka bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma nā ma a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ zhes sngar bzhin dang*/

rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ dhor dril dang bcas pas rnam bum bzung la/ hūṃ bde bar gshegs pa'i sras po dam pa'i mchog: sngon gyi thugs dam bka' dang mi 'gal zhing : dgongs pa yid bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' dang mtha' dang mnyam/ 'phrin las thabs kyi rdo rje slob dpon mchog: 'gro ba ma lus kun gyi re ba skong : sher rab mthar rdzogs yon tan lhun gyis grub/ bstan pa'i sgron me ma rig mun sa sel/ chos nyid don rtogs ma lus kha lo bsgyur/ sangs rgyas gdung sob rdo rje slob dpon gyiḥ dbang mchog ma lus lhun gyis grub par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu h+ya shwa ra badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3hamaḥ dbang bskur tshul dang bum chu 'thor/ gsang dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms zhugs kyi byang sems thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa rten gyi ljags la phur bar gyur par mos/ bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i srin la ga gis rten la 'thor zhing*/ hūṃ bla ma lha tshogs yab yum rnams: gnyis med sbyar ba'i byang chub sems: lha rnams ngag la dbang (294) bskur bas: bde chen gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñca a we sha ya a āḥ a ho ma hā su khaḥ sher dbang ni/ gtso bo yum gyi thugs kha nas 'phros pa'i phyag rgya phul bar gyur par bsam/ hūṃ mtshan ldan bkra shis bzung ma 'di: bsten na gnyis med bde ba skye: 'khor lo'i gnas bzhir dbab bzung gis: bde chen chos nyid rtogs par gyis: a ho su kha bhañca mok+ṣa haḥ snyom 'jug gi bde ba thugs nyams su bstar bar mos/ bdang bzhi pa/ me log dang man shes bstan tshul dang*/ dri bu dkrol zhing rdo rje mkha' la gser ba'i/ hūṃ sems nyid ka dag lhun rdzogs pa'iḥ snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku: gnyis med 'dzin bral sprul pa'i sku: yang dag nges don rtogs par gyis:dz+nyā na pañca dharma ka ya a bhi ṣiñca a aḥ

dbang don thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par mos shing dbang don la cung zad mnyams par bzhag/ dbang bzhi brtan byed ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags bcas kyis bum pa'i chus me long ngos la khrus gsol/ de ltar dbang bzhi bskur bas dbang gi chu rgyun des sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yang lud pa las so so'i rigs kyi bdag po dang*/ spyi khyab tu rdo rje sems dpa' dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam/ nam mkha' bzhugs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyang tu gnas bya'i rten la thim par gyur par bsam/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi me tog 'thor zhing mthar/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha te badz+re swā hāḥ oṃ hūṃ hrīḥbh+ruṃ khaṃ badz+ra bha wa hi taṃ tiṣ+ṭha bh+ruṃ khaṃ brjod do/ bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa bya ba ni/ rang 'grol las/ rab gnas kyi lha la dbang bskur ba dang : mchod bstod dang : zhes gsungs pas mchad sa las byang ltar byin rlabs nas/ stong gsum 'di'am zhag dag tu/ dngos 'byor yid kyis rab sprul ba'i/ mchod yon rgyal ba rnams la 'bul/ bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīñca swā ha': de bzhid du shasta'i bar sgyas zhing*/ bsdu sngags tsam gyi chog sprod na phyag rgya gar mchod las byang ltar dang*/ bsdu na sman kar gtor gsum 'bul tshig 'di ltar/ hūṃ rtsa brgyad stong sbyor sman gyi mchog/ rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i dmar chen po/ ba ling gtor mar bcas pa 'bul/ bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ sngags mthar*/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba liṃ/ zhes sbyar bas mchod/ bde gshegs sku lngas bsdod do/ bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/ rtsa bar/ spyan dbye grub cing shang dbye zhal dbye dang*/ sogs gsungs pas/ spyan dbye dang dbang po gzhan dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po gser thur drug nam las mi chung ba'i dngul snod nas/ mig sman ka ra ram sbyar sbyar ba thogs la/

spyan sngar rnam dag rab rib skyon bsal te/ dbye dang mi dbye'i mtshan ma gnyis med kyang : sri zhu'i tshul gyi gser gyi thur mas spyan dbye bas: rang dang spyi'i chos rnams mtshan nyid kun: ji ltar mkhyen cing gzigs pa thugs chud ltar: sangs rgyas ye shes spyan gyi dngos grub de: bdag

(295) dang sems can dmul long rnams la stsol: oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu pa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha ni swā hāḥ lan gsum dang*/ gnyis pa dbang po lnga dbye ba ni/ rang gzhung gsang rdzogs gnyis don la khyed med gshes 'dir gsang rdzogs mod rgyas 'tsham pas/ dang po spyan dbye'i yo dbyad gong ltar slar yang thogs la/ hūṃ spyan lnga dra med bye bsam byar med kyang*/ 'gro rnams kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ gser thub badha yis rnams mkhyen spyan dbye bas: rang byang chub ye shes spyan dang ldan par shog: oṃ tsak+ṣu maṇ+ḍal bi sho dha nā ya swā hā: gnyis pa snyan bsal ba ni dngul gyi rnam brud thogs la/ hūṃ ma 'gag snyan la dbye bsal byer med kyang : 'gro kun gsung rab rgya mtsho thos bya'i phyir: dngul gyi snyan brud badha yi snyan bsam bas: dbyings thos rig pa'i yon tan mchog thob shog: oṃ dī bya kar+ṣa ye ni da ka lo ki a wa sat+ta hrīḥ gsum pa shangs bsal ba ni/ gser gyi rmang 'tsher thogs la hūṃ ye shes shangs la ngan rtog spu med kyang : mgro kun yon tan dri bsung thob bya'i phyir: gser gyi rmangs tsher badha yis shangs gsal bas/ ye shes rlung gis bag chags sprin gtor shog: oṃ dī bya gha ṇā ya sarba lam bor dha ra hring hrīḥ bzhi pa zhal bsam ba ni/ gser gyi khyem bu mngar gsum dang ldan pa thogs la/ hūṃ chos dbyings zhal la ro rnams dbyer med kyang*/ 'gro kun+pachos rnams ro gcig myong bya'i phyir: gser thur ro 'dab zhal zas 'di phul bas: yang dag chos sgras kun yid tshim byed shog: oṃ dī bya mu khā ya gan+dha swā hāḥ lnga pa tshems brud pa ni/ dngul gyi tshems shing thogs la/ hūṃ skye shi rtsad mchod tshems la skyon bral yang*/ 'gro kun gsung gi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ dngul gyi tshems shing badha yis tshems bshad pas: 'gro kun skad du zab mo'i don ston shog: oṃ sarba wā gi shwa ra dha ra ṇi hrīḥ

zhes dang po'i skyon rnams bsam bas rdo rje'i spyan/ snyan shangs zhal/ tshems su byin gyis brlab bo/ bdag cag yon mchod la sogs pa'i sems can dang*/ bstod par 'os pas bstod nas zhal bsgyur dngos rang 'grol las/ rten bsgyur gyi sngon du mchod bstod ni/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri kha ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīñca swā hāḥ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bde gshegs thams cad mnyam nyid sogs dang*/ bstod par 'ongs pas bstod nas zhal bsgyur dngos rang 'grol las/ de nas sku gzugs de gang yin par so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya so gol gyi bsgyur bas/ gdul bya'i ngo gang la de nyid gang yin pa de'i skur gyur par bsam mo: zhes gsungs pas slob dgon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mos rten gyi gnas gsum du reg cing so gol gyi sgras mtshon par rab tu gnas bya'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas/ spyi ltar bskyed na/ dpal chen tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs yongs su gyur pa las sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur zhes par gyur zhes dang*/ bya brag tu bskyed na/ sku rten la/ 'di ltar dpal rdo rje sems dpa'ang yongs su gyur pa las bris 'bul gyi sku dang mtshungs pa'i lha so so'i snang brnyan gsal ba ma 'dres (296) pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa sprul pa'i mdzad pa mngon sum du snang ba'i mthu byin dang ldan par gyur/ de bzhin du pusti rnams 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos dkon mchog dbyangs gsal gyi ge ge'i rnam pa glogs bam gyi gzugs su gyur/ mchod rten rnams snang yongs sug gyur sa las ye shes kyi snang ba'i mchod rten snang brnyan ji ltar bar gyur/ de bzhani du mchod rten zhes pa'i gnas su gtsug lag khang dang khang bzang la sogs pa'i pa so so'i snang brnyan ji ltar bar gyur/ zhes bsgyur/ phyag mtshan rnams mi bskyod pa yongs gyur pa las phyag mtshan so so'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i gzugs su gyur par bsam/

sngar gnas bya sor bskyed na zhal bsgyur mi dgos so/ bcu gnyis pa brtan bzhugs ni/ rtsa bar/ me tog 'phreng sogs phul byas te/ rab tu pa'i gsol ba gdab: ces mnga' dubal gyi rjes su gsungs pa dang rgya gzhung gzhan nas kyang de ltar nges kyang*/ 'di lo chen rigan bzang gi sdoms kyi rjes su 'breng ba yin te/ rdor dril spos dang me tog rol mo bcas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid namamakha'i mtha' dang pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams myang ngan las 'das pa sangs g+r+yas kyi sa la ma bzhag gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye grag tu yang spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la 'byung ba sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su sra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gi char phab la rol mo bya'o/ bcu gsam pa mnga' dbul ba ni/ rtsa bar/ mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod cing bstod byas nas: sogs rim pa bzhi gsungs pa ni/ mchod bstod rgyas pa dang*/ bya brag nyer mkho yo byad/ sbyin bsreg gam tsā ru'i bza' ba/ bkra shis bar gnas kyi mnga' dubal bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pa'i mnga' dbul ba ni mchod pa rnams/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs kyi bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ zhu ba las byang chub ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byang chub ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me togs bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas ro mo la sogs pa'i chod sprin bsam gyi mi khyab na nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis byin brlob/ rang gzhung zhi ba'i chos skor mnyes pa mchod pa'i cho gi las byang chab ba 'di ltar/

yang lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chu/ bkra shis sna tshogs 'o ma'i chu rgyun gyi: rgyal ba'i mdun du mchod yon 'di phul bas: 'gro kun zhi zhing phun sum tshogs gyur cing : oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sdu tsham me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ: spos dang tsan dan la sogs sbyar ba yis: las kun+patshim byed chu gtsang dam pa 'di: rgyal ba'i zhal la zhal bsil 'di phul bas/ 'gro kun glo (297) bur dri ma dag gyur cig/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sad ka ra sra tīñca sdu= chu skyes thang skyes yid las byang chub ba yi: byang chub lag lag me tog mdzes pa 'di: bsam gtan rang bzhin rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul: 'gro kun mtshan dang dpe byad yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pa= lha cig skyes sbyar yongs ga gyur pa yi: rab tu tshim ldan gyal ba'i bdug spong te: shes rab rang bzhin rgyas ba'i shangs la 'bul: 'gro kun tshul khrims rnam par dag gyur cig: oṃ sarba ta thā ga rgyu pe= dmar gsal dag la gtsang zhing mdzes pa yi: mi shes gsal byed ye shes sgron me 'di: smon lam rang bzhin rgyal ba'i spyan la 'bul: 'gro kun spyan lnga yongs su dag gyur cig: oṃ sarba thā ga ta ā lo ko= tsan dan ga pur a kar la sogs pa: dri lnga rnams bzhin dri zhim byug pa 'di: thabs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul: 'gro kun zag med phung po lnga thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe= kha dog dri dang ro bcud ldan pa'i zas: ro brgya ldan pa'i zas su byin brlabs te: stobs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i zhal du 'bul: 'gro kun sred med 'bras bu'i sku thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wi rgya= si waṃ gling bu cang te kar ko ṭa: dril bu sil snyan rol mo cha lang rnams: glu gar dbyangs kyi mchod pa ji rnyed pa: tshangs pa'i dbyangs bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul: 'gro kun zag med ye shes thob gyur cig:

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shasta= ring chen bdun 'bul ba ni/ 'di bar gshegs pa thams cad la: 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas: srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig: oṃ tsakra rat+na sdu tsa hūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad: nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas: bkros shing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad nas: 'byor pa phun sum tshogs thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sdu tsa hūṃ: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la: btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas: sher rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas: thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog: oṃ wa ti rat+na sdu tsa= bde rab gshegs pa= blon po rin chen= bsam yang bstan pa 'dzin mdzad pa: yon tan thams cad ldan par shog: oṃ ba hā ta rat+na sdu= bde bar= dmag dpon rin chen= phas gyi rgol ba tshar bcad nas: bsnyings bral bachog ni thob par shog: oṃ khat+ga rat+na sdu tsa= 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha don dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan: phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul na: bzhes sheg bla med glab mchog stsal du gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ru pa sdu tsa hūṃ: phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i: yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan: mos blos= bzhas shig= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shasta= phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul gyi snying (298) a gar sogs dbang po tshim byed 'di: mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha= phyogs dus kun na bcud dang ro ldan pa'i: lus sems brtan byen ro mchog thams cad kyang : mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wi rgya= phyogs dus kun na 'jam gnyer 'khril chags pa'i: reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed pa: mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sar+she sdu= rman raka gathor gsum ni hūṃ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyu ni nas mchod sa 'bul: bar oṃ sarba pañca mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hiḥ

hūṃ nyon mongs 'khor na nas bcas la 'bul bar: oṃ ma hā rak+ta ka raṃ khā hiḥ hūṃ gzhong sa rnam dag na bzhes sug gsol bar: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ kha raṃ kha hiḥ zhes dang bstod pa ni: lha so so'i sgos bstod shes na bya/ ma shes na/ sangs rgyas thams cad sho lo ka/ bla ma sangs rgyas sho lo ka/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang sho lo ka: gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid sogs sho lo ka bcas bla ma dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa dang*/ rigs lnga spyi bstod rang gzhung las: hūṃ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings: chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes sku: byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin: phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la'o: gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa: me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje bdud 'dul phyag rgya 'dzin: phyag 'tshal rdo rje mi bskyed la'o: rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me: mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje mchog sbyin phyag rgya 'dzin: phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la'o: mtha' yas rdo rje chos kyi chu: kun rten ye shes rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje ting 'dzin phyag rgya 'dzin: phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la'o: don grub rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung : nan tan ye shes rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje skyabs sbyin phyag rgya 'dzin: phyag 'tshal rdo rje don grub la'o: zhes dang = zhi ba spyi bstod sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi le'u bcu bzhi pa las: oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ ye shes dkyil 'khor thig li che/ bsod nags dkyil 'khor sku yi tshogs/ snang stong thig le kun tu rdzogs hoḥ oṃ rdo rje bson nams thig le che/ rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan: rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ rdo rje rgyal po thig le che hoḥ oṃ ska gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che/ yon tan 'phrin las kun tu rdzogs/ ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang*/

'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che heḥ oṃ ma dmigs sgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dby-ings/ mtha' yas kun nas sna tshogs spro/ mtha' pas kun nas lhun gyis thim/ sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po heḥ oṃ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rul rnyod du/ rgyal ba'i rul rnams rul phran rnyed/ spul pa'i rul phran bsam yas kyi/ skad cig yud la lhun gyis grub hoḥ oṃ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ sku gsung thugs kyis kun tu khyab: sku gsung thugs kyis thig le che hoḥ khro bo'i bstod pa rtsa rgyud gsang snying gi le'u nyer gcig pa las/ hūṃ gtum chen dus (299) mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ 'od zor nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ khro gnyer glog stong 'gyur ba bzhin/ mche ba za byed zangs yag che heḥ hūṃ rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir/ thug che ri rab 'bum bsnyim skad/ a la ha ma'i gad rgyangs che/ phyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che heḥ hūṃ khro bo shes rab 'do po che: ye shes dkyil pa'i 'khor char chen 'bebs/ dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung gtor/ sna tshogs khris pa'i thig le che hoḥ hūṃ 'dud kun gyi ni bdud chen po/ bdud kyi bdud de bdud rnams 'jugs/ 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'jigs byad pa/ 'jigs byed chen po thig po che hoḥ hūṃ rdo rje brag chen 'asra ba so/ rdo rje chu'i bdud chem po/ rdo rje me lte kun 'bar che/ rdo rje rlung ste 'thor nga che hoḥ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang gsung rten la smra bsam brjod med dang*/ thugs rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ sna tshogs rin chen che khams la grub pa yi/ sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ chos sku'i rang bzhin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ spyir bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ zhes sogs kyis bstod do/ gnyis pa bye brag nye bar mkho ba'i mnga' dbul la yang spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/

dang po thugs rten spyir dbul ba la/ rang 'grol las/ de nas maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi rin po ches spras pa 'bul: zhes sogs rgya cher gungs pas 'dir rang gzhung du med pa sogs spyi mthun ltar sdebs nas bkod par/ dkyil 'khor khri khrus na bzang dang*/ rnam lnga rin chen 'dun brgyad bcud/ gdugs sogs rnam ni spyi yin no/ mnga' dbul yo byad bris 'bur dngos 'byor gang rung rim par tshig bsdun gyis dbul zhing*/ las kyi rdo rjes mnga' dbul stegs bur bkod de/ gling bzhi ri bar bcas pa 'bul zhing*/ sa bzhi spos kyi byugs shing me tog bkram/ ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ sangs rgyas zhing la mdigs te phul ba yis/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog: oṃ badz+ra su ri khe āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ 'bras bu mtha' yas kun la mnga' la mnga' brnyes pa/ sangs rgyas kun la maṇ+ḍal 'di phul bas: 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbul ba kun bral te: ting 'dzin 'bul phrag yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal la swā hā: gzi byin khyed par shin tu 'phags pa yi: sangs rgyas sku la zhing khams 'di phur bas: bsam gyi mi khyab ye shes cir yang mdzes: thams cad bdag nyid chen por skyong bar shog: oṃ a pa ye ga ga sa pa ri ka re ye swā hā: maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshig sho lo ka phyi ma gnyis rang gzhung nas so/ gdan khri la rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri/ yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bka' pa 'di/ spros bral rgyal ba mchog la phul ba yis/ 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog: oṃ sing+ta ā pa na āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ oṃ dang āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ phyi ma gzhung tshig min pa rnams la yang sbyar*/ dri bzang gi

(300) chu stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ su gan+dha na bza' byams mgon chen po kun la snyoms pa yi: sangs rgyas kun la na bzang 'di phul bas: tha ba rgyags pa'i spyod pa kun bral nas: gzi byin khyad gter la spyod par shog: oṃ de ba pra su ye hūṃ: 'dod yon lnga rgyal ba zag med 'byor la dbang bsgyur yang*/ 'gro ba'i don slad 'dod yon rnams pa lnga/ phul bsam mkhas mnyams sems can thams cad kyis/ bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog: pañca ka ma gu na/ rgyal srid bdun/ mi dbang rin chen rnam bdun 'di dag ni/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ 'gralo ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /sastam hā rat+na sdu dza me gha bkra shis rtams brgyad/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ltar/ rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus la/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la sdu dza me gha/ lnga tshan lnga/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs/ bson nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ pañca pañca bi ma le sdu dza me gha/ gdugs sogs theg mchog bla re 'gro skyabs gdugs dang ldan/ bdud bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin ldan/ lha dang lha mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par bar brgyan yang*/ bla re rgya mtshan rol mos mchod byas pas/ bdag 'gro ba'i dbang po rab 'asgyur te: gdod ma'i dgra bcom bla med go 'phang dang*/ theg pa mchog la nges par 'god par shog: oṃ āḥb su tsa ga sa ri ka re swā hāḥ gong gi na bzang dang gdugs sogs 'bul tshig rang gzhung ngo*/

gnyis pa ni/ bye brag sku gzugs spyi la ni/ rmang bzod tshems shing spongs bzhar ro/ shangs spu thogs tshul/ shangs kyi rlung gis khams gsum bskyed mdzad pa'i: dbang po mchog ni dri mchog yul rol: thabs kyi 'gro don rtag tu mdzad pa la: nyon mongs skyon bral ye nas rnam dag kyang*/ bkur bsti rim gro gser gyi rmang bzod kyis: shangs kyi spu btog rtog pa'i dri ma bsal: ye shes thogs med rlung gis bdag bskyed nas: 'og min bla med gnas su phyin par shog: oṃ dāṃ bya ga na ye sarba lab bo da ra ni hring hring : tshems shing*/ dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i gsung phyungs pa: cir yang ston pa ljags kyi dbang por bkram: brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra bstan mdzad: tshoms dkar bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rnams dag pa'i/ rin chen mchog grub dngul gyi tshems shing gi: bkur bsti rig gro tshoms kyi skyon bsal te: bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub thob gyur nas: 'gro (301) kun skad du chas kyi don ston shog: oṃ sarba wa gi shwa ra dha ra ni hrīḥ spab gzhar/ nye ring kun nas 'phrul gyi snyan mnga' ba/ ma 'gags gsal ba'i skyon rnams dag kyang : sems can ma lus bag chags bsal slad du: gser gyi shal snyan bsam tshul gyis ni: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ dus gsum rgyas bas legs par gsungs pa yi: bstan pa'i theg pa phyi nang ma lus kun: skye ba thob pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ dī bya ka ye ne da la lo ga a ba ta la tri swā hā: gong gi sdoms su ma 'thus kyang gser gyi khyem bu thogs la/ chos kyi rol dga' zhing 'gro kun tshim mdzad zhal: ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas 'di phul bas: gsung rab zab mo chos kyi sgra bsgrags pa'i: 'gro drug chos kyi sgra yis tshim nas kyang : bla med byang ba gnas su 'dren par shog: oṃ dī bya mu u ke ye swā hā: logs sku'i cha lugs can rnams la:

so mang dang ni khyad par rgyan/ sog mang thogs la/ dbu skra lcang la mchog tu 'khril mnga' la: mthon mthing gsal 'khyil rin chen 'bar bas brgyan: hā mi kun gyi lta bar mi ngos ste: dug gsum sgrib bral mtshan ma mi mnga' yang : bkur bsti rim gro dung gi so mang gis: bson nams thob phyir rgyal ba'i skra bshad pas/ bdag cag yon bdag sgrib pa byang gyur cig: oṃ karma bi ha ra ni hūṃ: rgyan ni bde gshegs sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: rin chen 'od chags 'bul bas sku brgyan cing : byang chub mchog gi rgyan gyis lems mdzes kyang: sri zhu bkur sti rim gro'i tsam du: rin chen do shal so mo de la sogs: byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan dang ldan gyur nas: bla med thar lam mchog la bdag gnas shog: oṃ rat+na ma le ka ra hūṃ: spru sku'i cha byad can rnams la/ spru gri breg spyad chos gos snod/ spra gri ni/ rgyal ba'i gtsug phud lta bas mi ngom ste: rin chen 'od 'bar 'jig rten la 'phags te: lta bar mi ngom mtshan ma'i skyon bral yang : bkur sti rim mtshan ma'i skyon bral yang : bkur sting rim gro gser gyi chags pa yis: dbu skra kha spu breg pa'i tshul bstan pas: dug gsum zug pa'i rtog pa rnam bcom ste: sdug bsngal nyes pa'i skyon las bar shog: oṃ sarba sho de na kha tshe da na hūṃ: na bza' 'bul ba/ gdugs sogs 'bul tshig dang*/ shangs spru 'thogs pa phyin dang spu gri 'bul ba'i bar rnams bar gnas dgyus tshim dang mi mthun pa ni rang gzhung 'grel pa sor gzhag bkod pa yin no/ sem mo breg spyad zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang : bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ sen mo 'breg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyi/ sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog: oṃ khañce de āḥhūṃ swā hāḥ snam sbyar dri med mtshan la sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*/ dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/

nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog: badz+ra saṅga ṭā ya lhung bzod ji ltar rgyal po chen (302) so bzhi po yis/ de bzhin gshegs la lhung bzed phul ba ltar/ de bzhin 'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ yon tan snod du gyur pa dbul bar bgyi/ pu ṣa pa ri ka ra ya/ khro bo khro mo'i tshegs bcas la/ thod skam dbu rgyan mgo 'phreng gnyis/ gling chen mi dang sdag spags dang*/ sbrul thal ra zhag gdan me/ mchod pa rol mor bcas khro bo/ thod skam kyi bdu rgyan/ don dam bcud kyi yon tan mtha'ar phyir na phyan pa'i/ thod skam rat+na'i rtse bran dbu rgyan lnga*/ phur bas 'gro ba'i phung po lnga dag nas: rgyal ba lnga yi go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra kā pa la sho ṣa ya shrī ro a laṅka ra āḥhūṃ swā hā/ thod skam 'phrong ba/ gang gi bde ba skyong ba rdo rje'i 'phreng*/ sgyu 'phrul dwa ba'i sku la deng 'bul gyi/ 'gro ba'i phrang dog rlung 'tshub rab zhi nas/ bya grub rta yi go 'phang thob par shog: badz+ra ka pā la la shu ska ma le mgo 'phring = mgo rlung khrag rgyun 'bab pa'i do shal ni/ bcu phrag lang ldan ba 'phul lags kyi/ 'gro ba'i 'du byed lnga bcu rang dag nas/ ye shes rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par shog /shī ra atra bā le/ glang spags theg mchog stobs bcus 'gro don bgyi slad du/ so ldan dregs pa'i ko rlon 'di phul bas/ 'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa rab zhi nas/ chos dbyings rtag pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /hasti tsarma aṃ wā ra/ mi spags nyon mongs rtsad gcod gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir/ mi lpags yang gzhi brjid ldan 'di phul bas/ 'gro ba'i 'dod chags rgya mtsho gnas skems te/ sor rtog pad+ma'i go 'phang thob par shog na ra a ji na aṃ wā ra/ sga shi 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don bgyi slad du/ rab 'jigs stag gi sham thabs 'di phul bas: 'gro ba'i nga rgyar ro bo snyil byas nas/

mnyam nyid nyi ma'i go 'phang thob par shog /byā gh+ra a dzi na ā wā ra/ sbrul chun/ dpal brjed mnyen lcag gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ lho 'gro rnam lngī chun po 'di phul ba/ 'gro ba'i zhe sdang me tshogs par gzhil nas/ mo long thugs kyi go 'phang thob par shog: piñca shu dzaṃ ga a laṅka ra/ thal chen 'dul byed 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar/ thal chen tshom bu bhan+dhī dbyings ltus/ smin mtshams sku yi sum rnams byugs pa yis/ 'gro bas phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin shog: ma hā ba shu ta le ba/ rak+ta dug gsum dang bsdu snying rje po'i rtags/ rak+ta'i thig le kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ldus/ khur tshom dpral ba'i dbyibs su byugs pa yis/ 'gro bas dmigs med snying rje rtogs par shog /ma hā ru dhi ra re kha/ zhal chen 'gro ba'i don rnams thabs kyis mdzad pa'i badhar/ zhal chen zo ris rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ dbyibs can brang dang skog mar bsham ba yis/ 'gro bas don gnyis mthar phyin thob par shog ma hā pa kha tsi ta gdan dregs pa kun sgrol dgra bgegs dbang sdud phyir/ pad zla nyid ma dbugs bral rngags pa'i gdan/ dpal chen khro bo'i tshagos la 'bul lags na/ 'gro ba bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa thob shog/ pad+ma tsan+d+ra sdu dza ma (303) hā ti ra a sa na/ me dpung*/ ye shes rab 'bar rang 'od rdo rje'i me/ sreg za'i phung po dus mtha' ltar 'bar ba/ snying rjes khros pa'i sku la bdag 'bul gyis/ 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tshang tshing bsreg par shog /dz+nyā na a na la/ mchod pa/ khro rgyal tshoms rnams thugs dam skong ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsi lnga dang dmar chen rak+ta dang*/ dam rdzas gtor ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas/ 'bul gyi 'gro ba'i dod yon lhun grub shog/ pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta ga na tsakra shadu dza/ rol mo/ rlungs sngags rang sgra rnga dung cha la dril/ thod rnga rkang gling gzhom med nā da'i sgra'i/ 'brug stong lta bu khro bu rgyal tshogs la 'bul/

'gro bas nges don sgra dbyangs rtogs par shog /ma hā shasta sdu dza/ gsung rab la khri na bza' dang*/ glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go khri ni/ sngar gyi tshig bcad la spros bral gsung rab ces bsgyur na bza' sna tshogs dang po'i gzhung ltar zhes gong ltar dang*/ glegs shing zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang*/ thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i/ nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'phrel dga' byas ba/ phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ bashra pradz+nyā uḥhūṃ swā hāḥ glegs thag spros pa du mar rab tu rgyas gyur kyang*/ ye shes chen po gcig gyur pa ltar/ glegs bam gcig gyur yo byedamachog phul bas/ 'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra posta ka ban+dha na āḥhūṃ swā hā/ khyad par mchod rten rnams la ni/ srog shing 'khor lo cod pan phan/ rgyal mtshan gdugs dang 'phreng ba gden*/ srig ning*/ e badz+ra ā yuḥṣe swā hāḥ sems can shes bcu ldan gyur cig/ bstan pa yur rin gnas par shog/ sems can lhag bsam dag pa yi/ kun bzang smon lam 'jug par shog /'khor lo oṃ pra marda nā ya swā hā/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ stobs dang ma 'dres chos dang ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag rnam thar brgyad/ ye shes bzhi sogs ldan gyur cig/ cod pan oṃ paṭ+ṭa lam+ba nā ya swā hā/ sems can rnams nam ma lus sa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ dar dang lhab lhub la sogs pas/ byang chub bar du mchod par shog /'phan sogs oṃ badz+ra pa tā ka swā hā sems can rnams ni ma lus pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pa'i ba dan gyis/ 'tshe ba med cing chos ldan pa'i/ grags pas rgyas par 'gengs par shog /rgyal mtshan oṃ kum+bhi ra dhā dzā ya swā hā 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni/ thugs rje byang chub sems kyi gdugs/ phul bas bde ba tshim par shog /'phreng ba oṃ rat+na mā le trāṃ na mas+t+rai ya dhā ma na nu ga ra spra tiṣ+ṭha te puṣ+pa ge ta we

ta thā ga tā ya arta te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ targya thā oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swā hā 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun/ mtshan dang dpar byas rdzogs nas/ lta (304) bas mi ngoms gzugs kyis ni/ sems can don rnams rdzogs shog /gdan rnams oṃ pu ṇa dha ri dza ye swā hā sems can ma lus sangs rgyas te/ stobs bcu ldan pa glang po'i gdan/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan dang ldan/ rdzus 'phrul rkang pa rta yi gdan/ dbang bcu thob pa rma bya'i gdan/ thobs med shugs ldan mkha' lding gdan/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba rin chen gdan/ skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan/ rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi zla'i gdan/ gdan rnams myur du thobs par shog ces so/ gsum pa sbyin bsreg gaṃ tsā ru'i bzang bas mnga' dbul ba ni/ rtsa bar/ de nas lho yi phyogs su ni: rgyas pa'i thab khung gzhung bzhin bca': sogs rgyas par gsungs pas/ grub na skabs 'atir rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg dang*/ spro na 'o thugs bsgrub pa sogs kyang bya zhing*/ sbyin bsreg gam 'o thugs 'grub na/ tsā ru'i bzanga' ba sogs su mi dgos kyang*/ ma grub tshe legs bshams skabs su bshad ltar bshes chen bzang btung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pas yongs su gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byang chub ba'i rin po che'i snod nam mkha'i mtha' dngamanyams pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byang chub pa'i logs spyod lha'i zhal zas bza' bca' btung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha'as yas pas yongs su gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum dang*/ oṃ a kā ro kham sogs gsum dang*/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi sho mu khe bh+ya sogs gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba birgyā sdu rang sdu ra su ra su ra a warta ya ho gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇi kham gis byin gyis brlab nas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas yid 'phrogs pa/ legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/

dad pas phul bas 'gro ba dag kun/ 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog/ oṃ āḥdī bya an+naṃ sa mā dhi dh+ya naṃ sṛ na ne swā hā/ zhes dbul zhing de rnams kyi phud bsdus pa rten gyi mdun du bshams/ spro na skabs 'dir 'phreng ba'i dgongs pa ltar pā rgyaṃ gi zhabs bsil dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi 'bul ba yang bya'o/ bzhi pa bkris dang rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ gsang rdzogs rgyud las/ nas 'bru me tog dkar po la/ rton 'brel 'bum bsnyen me tog dor/ zhes gsungs pas legs bshams kyi skabs su bshad pa'i me tog de sngon nas rten 'brel snying po rab 'bul/ 'bring khyi/ tha ma sum stong sogs kyis bsngags pa'i/ yin ka me tog snod stogs kyi khar bzhag pa'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gis srad bu btags pa bzhag ste sno slob dkon gyis bzung la/ me tog gi stong du zla ba'i dbus su oṃ āḥhūṃ gi mthar rab gnas kyi sngags rnams gsal ba las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru bsam gyi mi khyab spyan drangs me togs la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ ye dharma btags pa mang du bzlas nas/ mthar zla ba sngags dang bcas pa me tog la thim pas sngags kyi rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam/ rtsa bar de nas gong bzhin lha dang rten 'brel gyi= sngags

(305) ni rim bzhin brgya dang rtsa dang rtsa brgyad bzlas: zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi lha sngags dang dbyangs gsal sogs kyang mang du bzla zhing*/ khyad par rten 'brel snying po ni brgya rtsa nges par bzla dgos so nga sngar bsgrubs pa'i gzungs bum gyi chus rten 'brel snying po bzla bzhin me tog la bran cing sbol te shes brjod skabs 'thor ro/ de nas rten la gzungs thag btang ba'i gzungs dhor slob dpon gyis bzung ba'i sne las dhor gyi rten so sor g.yas bskor gsum gyi thugs kar bzung ste/ rten gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su sngags 'phreng gsal ba las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rab tu gnas bya'i rten de nyid dang mthun pa'i gzugs kyis byon pa rnams rten rnams la thim par bsam zhing*/ me tog dare 'khod kun la bskram/ sku gzungs la/ oṃ su sra tiṣ+ṭha badzes swā hā zhes dang*/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang la/ oṃ hūṃ hrīḥbh+ruṃ kham badz+rī bha ba dṛ dhaṃ tiṣ+ṭha bh+ruṃ khaṃ susti la sngags gnyis gnyis ka dang*/ de thams cad kyi mthar/ ye dharma btags pa mang du bzla ba gal che'o/ mthar stegs kyi mnga' dbul gyi teng 'dzin gsal bas me tog gi char dbab cing*/ bcom ldan rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjed can/ tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer gnyen ldan du/ shing mchog tā le'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bde legs shog bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can/ tshe lo bdun khri'i dus ka ṇa'i grong khyer du/ pun+da ri ka'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can/ tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer mnyam yod du/ shing mchog sa la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/

bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog thub pa 'khor ba 'jigs ni stobs ldan bram ze'i rigs/ tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du/ shi ri sha yu drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dirabakra shis shog /'dren pa gsare thub bslab pa mchog na bram ze'i rigs/ tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du/ u dum+ba ri'i shing dung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ bkris phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can/ tsho lo nyi khri'i dus na wā ra ṇa si ru/ n+ya gro ta yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can/ tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer na/ a shār+tha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog bkra shis sangs rgyas bdun gyi bkra shis phun tshugs gang yin dang*/ phyogs bcu kun gyi bde gshegs byin brlabs rmad byang chub dang*/ chos nyid rnam dag rten 'brel stobs ldan mi 'gyur bas/ deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs ldan shog /zhes dang gzhan yang phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs dang*/ ston mchog (306) dam pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod dang*/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong nor lha dang bcas pa'i shis brjod rgyas pa'i mthar me tog gi char phang cing ye dhar bzla bzhin rol mo sgrog sdoms bcu gnyis pa'i gsol 'debs skabs der ma byas na 'dir bya ba yang khungs dang 'brel ba yin/ de nas gong ltar mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ rang gzhung gi rab tu gtsang zhing yid 'ong mchog ldan pa'i/ yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma dang bral ba/ 'gro kun bkra shis phun tshogs thob par shog

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sdu tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ ye shes sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang : sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyangs slad du: zhabs bsil khrus chab dam pa 'di gsol bas: sems can nyon mongs bag chags dag par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā rgyi= yon tan lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas gzugs la: rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ dam tshig sdom pa'i nyes pa kun bral nas/ ye shes thugs rjes ma lus 'dzin par shog/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe= thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas sku gzugs la: mun pa snang byed mar me 'di phul bas: mun pa snang byed mar me 'di phul bas: ma rigs 'thibs pa'i mun kun gsal nas: sangs rgyas spyan lnga yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lo ko= snyigs ma lnga nyid 'bras bu yongs rdzogs pa'i: sangs rgyas sku la dri chas 'di phul bas: mya ngan zug rngu gdung ba kun bral nas: 'od zer mtha' yas 'gyed pa'i sku thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe= chos rnams logs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa yi: sangs rgyas sku la lha bshos 'di phul bas: ye shes longs spyod yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ne wi rgya= logs par lta ba mtha' dag yongs spangs pa'i: sangs rgyas sku rol mo'id phul bas: rdo rje chos kyi sgra chen kun bsgrags nas: sems can rgyud rnams ma lus grol bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shasta= zhes mchod 'di'i mchod yon tshig dang sngags bcu zad kha bsams yod do/ bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen sogs dang*/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor dus sogs nas gsungs gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ bar dang bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod do/ gsum pa rjes kyi sdom ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo/ dkyil 'khor mchod dngos grub blang*/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/

yon bdag bgo zhing shis pa brjod/ rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo/ slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya/ slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod*/ rjes bsdu sbyin bsreg mjug don no/ zhes 'di la don bcu gsum bshad pa las/ dang po gtor ma btang ba ni/ rtsa bar chos kyi srung ma spya drangs (307) la: mchod cing gtor ma 'bul byas la: zhes gsungs pas 'das pa dang 'jig rten gnyis las/ dang po 'das pa'i gtor ma byin rlabs rtsa sngags la gtor sngags kyis phul ba las byang ltar bya/ gnyis pa phyogs skyong 'byung bgegs la gter ma cha gsums sbyarin pa sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ rtsa bar sku la sogs pa'i rab gnas rten/ srung mar bka' bsgo gtad par bya: zhe gsungs pas chos skyong gang byed kyi gter ma sha khrag dang dar gdugs kyi brgyan pa rgya cher bshams la/ chos skyong mdun bskyed nas 'phrin las gzhung bsrang gtor mchod rgyas par byas rjes/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma che ge mo khyod kyis rab tu gnas par bgyis pa'i rten 'di ji srid kyi bar du bsrung ba dang bskyang bar gyis shig /ces bsgo gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni/ rtsa bar de ltar rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi/ lha la mchod bstod dge rtsa bsngo: zhes gsungs pas/ mchod pa bsos te/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar bar sbyar ba'i sngags kyi mchod yon mchad 'di dag /dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ bzhes la dngos grub deng stsal cig /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sra tits+tsha swā de bzhin du shasta'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis chog /bstod pa ni/ hūṃ ma bcos rdzogs pa sogs kyis bstod dam bsdu bde gshegs thams cad sho lo ka dang bstod par 'os pa bya/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūṃ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas/ dpal chen che mchog bsgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/

pho nya bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ thugs dam dbang gis dbang gi sa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gsang ba'ayi sgor zhugs dam tshig can/ bsnyen grub mthar phyin bsgrub pa'i zhag grangs rdzogs/ dad pa'i shugs kyis thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ dpal chen he ru ka yi go 'phang mchog/ dka' ba med pa tshe 'dir 'grub pa dang*/ 'phrin las rnam bzhis ris meda'agro ba rnams/ phad bde'i lam la 'god pa'i dngos grub stsol/ sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes gong gi tshogs dang*/ tsā ru'i phud rten la phul ba'i lhag ma thams cad la drangs shing*/ de bzhin gshegs su gsol ba ni/ rtsa bar*/ gsol gdab 'phrin las bzod gsol rnams/ gzhung bzhin ma lus byas nas ni: zhes gsungs pas/ hūṃ dusag gsum bde gshegs yon tan sku gsung thugs/ nas stsal du gsol: zhes bod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha skong ba'i phyir yi ge bag+r+ya pa ci rigs bzlas mthar thal sbyar te/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kun/ gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la/ nongs gyur de dag bzod par rigs/ kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa ru/ yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad (308) du gsol/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*/ lha rnams kun gyi sku gzugs la/ bskal pa brgya rung bsrung ba dang*/ mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas ni/ slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ bu dang tsha bo bsrung mdzad cing*/ rang gnas bde bar gshegs su gsol/ zhes bzod gsol gsol gdab byas rjes/ oṃ hāḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyis gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur pas bsam pa rdul tshon gyi dbang du byas shing*/ ras bris sogs la 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ sogs brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag bskyod/ oṃ badz+ra muṃḥ 'jig rten pa rnams so so'i gnas gshegs/

ye shes pa rnams sogs nas/ dbyings su bsdu'o/ bar dang slar yang rang nyid che mchog khrag 'thung zhal gc-ig phyag gnyis rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin pa dpal dang dur khrod chas kyi brgyan cing gnas gsum y-i ge gsum gyi mtshan par gsal ba'i lus thams cad rdo rje'i go cha bzhu lugs g.yog par gyur par bsgom mo/ lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ rtsa bar mchod yon bdag bka' bsgo dang*/ zhes sogs gsungs pas yon bdag bos te gdan bzang por 'khod cing*/ khyed kyis nga la gsol ba yi: ku gzugs la sogs khyad par du: ji ltar gsungs bzhin rab gnas pa/ de dag don ni ngas byas te: de rnams don ni 'grub zin gyis: ci 'byor ba yis mchod par gyis/ khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par tshal ba byas kyis/ khyod kyi rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar dumachod pa g+r+ya chen po gyis bar du mchod pa rgya po gyis shig /de nas kyang ci 'byor ba'i mchod par mchod par gyis shig /ces bsgo yon bdag gis rten gyi drung du ci 'byor ba'i mchod mchod pa bshams slob dpon gyi mchod pa de rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas yon bdag 'bul du bzhug cing*/ yon bdag rten la phyag dang bskor ba'ang byed du gzhug go drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ rtsa bar de nas bkra shis glu gar dang : zhes gsungs pas yon bdag las bum gyi chus khrus byed du bcug /dbang thob na lhar bskyed me tog lag tu gtad la/ spro na sngar rten gyi bgegs sbyang ba'i skabs ltar khro bo spyad 'dren mchod bstod bya/ bsdu na hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra sho lo ka dang*/ bkra shi la bar du gcod pa thams cad/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug go/ yon bdag rdzas dang bcas pa las bum chus bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā was sbyangs/ yon bdag yi dam gyi rnam par gyur/

mam byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rang rang gi byed phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos po thams cad bsgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du thog mar rten la 'bul/ de rjes dpon gyis reg cing yon bdag la gtad la/ me longs ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ni/ ye shes rgyal mtsho mchod tu dag gyur re/ rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon yang dag par (309) rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa me long gi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /'gi'u waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa dan gyi sman/ sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig tshig lhug pa snga ma ltar la blang po che nor skyong g-i'u waṃ/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas/ yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yis/ bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /zhi pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag /durawas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe na bar bsgrub nas/ nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel gyur cig / tshig lhug pa snga ma ltar la/ glang po che nor skyong gi'u waṃ/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas/ yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yis/ bkra shis des kun gsum zhing gyur cig /zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag /durawas ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'itshe ni rab bsgrub nas/

nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur yi/ bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel gyar cig /rtsa 'tshong bkra shis kyi rtswa durawa/ bilba rgyu skyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ 'jig rten rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ byang chub snying po mchog tu dag gyur pa'i/ bkra shis des kyang don ni kun grub shog /lha tshangs pas shing tog bilba/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams bsgrogs pa'i tshul/ ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ chos rnams la 'dres yongs su ston pa yis/ bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ chos rnams ma nor dbang du 'dus nas kyang*/ chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan rgyur pa'i/ bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /bram ze dkar rgyas gyis li khri/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi/ mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi gyur cig /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs kar/ ces rdzas brgyad dang*/ rgyas par mos na rin chen sna bdun gtad de/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu zluṃ/ rtsibs stong ldan cing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*/ sdang ba'i dgra las rnams par rgyal gyur pa'i/ 'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūrma/ kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*/ dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ nor bu chen dam= gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang mazang ma/ pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ yid yong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ btsun mo rin chen= gang yang rgyal ba mu tig mdags ldan pas/ gser sogs mang por thub la phul ba ltar/ bzod ldan tshangus pa'i phyim bdag nor ldan te/ blon po rin chen=

yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ rgyal po la 'os mkhas la rab 'gro ba'i/ glang po rin chen= tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ sa rnams bskor zhing srang yang ldog byed cing*/ rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ rta mchog rin chen=

(310) 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong gyur pa'i/ ma lus bdud dpung 'joms par byed pa la/ dpal brten 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yis/ dmag dpon rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshig bcad rgya cher brjed me tog gi char dbab bo/ bdun pa rten la mchod pa ni/ rang 'grol las/ de nas yon bdag gis mchod pa'i tshogs rtsi 'byor ba bshams la mchod pa dbul bar bya'o: gsungs pas/ rten gyi mdun du mchod pa bshams pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ bson nams zhing du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas la/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod yon 'di/ snang stong dbyer med dad pas 'bul lags na/ bde stong gnyis med thugs kyis bes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sra tīts+tsha swā hā de bzhin du shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ mnyam med mi g.yo mcho gi chos nyid can/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad sa/ dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mgon chos can/ yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha langs tshad med do/ dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin/ dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byang chub/ smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ 'gro ba'i don sgrub bar tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*/ tshan med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes rgyur kyang*/ khams gsum rnam la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ e ma hoḥ shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/

khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog rtsol mdzad/ mchon po dus gsum grib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa dbag la stsol/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ yang dag ye shes dam pa ste/ lan cig tsam ni marjod pas kyang*/ gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ bstod par 'os sa sogs sbyar bas bstod/ brgyad pa bsdod nams bsngo ba ni/ rang 'grol las/ glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa yi: bskor ba bya zhing smon lam gdab par byas ste/ zhes gsungs pas/ gsangs sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur*/ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po phyag rgya rigs pa'i lha/ rten cing 'brel 'byung bden pa'i mthus/ sku gung thas kyi rten 'di dag /ye shes phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas/ 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi/ bson nams bsag pa'i zhing gyur te/ zhal dri byi che 'gro ba rnams/ skyob pa'i mthu byin ldan pa dang*/ bdag cig 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ 'dod pa'i don rnams kun 'grub cing*/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par (311) shog ces skabs dang 'brel ba'i smon lam gdab cing*/ rten la bskor ba dang phyag kyang bya/ rgya gar du rten shing rta la bkod de gtsug lag khang dang grong khyer la mchod bskor byed pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang ngo*/ dgu pa slob dpon mchog pa ni/ rtsa bar slob dpon ya yang yon 'bul zhing*/ bla ma sangs rgyas mnyes par bya: zhes gsungs pas/ yon bdag gis phyag sngon du 'gro bas ci 'byor ba'i yon gyis mnyes par bya'o/ bcu pa dga' ston bya ba ni rang 'grol las/ dkyil 'khor gyi zas yon bdag la sbyan: gzhan yang sbyin pa rgyan pa rgya cher btang ngo : zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bzo bo sogs der 'khor kun dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi yul thams cad rin mdzin chen po rdo rje'i chos/

rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkras shog mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo las kyi dbang mo che/ bsgrub pa sde dgu'i bka' babs pad+ma 'byung*/ 'jam dpal rdo rje khri srong lde'u btsan bcas/ rgyal bstan= zab gter mdzod 'dzin mnga' bdag yab sras dang*/ chos kyi bad so 'gro mgon smyos zhig zhabs/ 'khrul pa kun bral mtshan ldan grub thob bcas/ rgyal bstan= grub pa'i dbang phyug smyos ston grags pa dang*/ smyos btsun chen po grags pa 'od zer zhabs/ pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob grags pa rgyal mtshan bcas/ rgyal bstan= lam 'di'i grub brnyes tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang*/ rim mnyis dbang 'byor shes rab rgyal po mchog /gsang sngags mdzod 'dzin nam mkha' rgyan mtshan bcas/ rgyal bstan = rin 'dzin chen po mkha' klong yangs pa dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtsho'i kun dga' dpal bzang po/ rgyal bstan= pad+ma'i rnal 'phrul bdud 'joms rdo rje dngas/ lha sras yang srid sna tshogs rang sar grol/ rgyal sras lha rje slar byon chos kyi rgyal/ rgyal bstan = rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa dngas*/ gdams pa'i rgyun 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs/ snying rje'i gter chen che mchog las 'brel rtsal/ rgyal bstan = sku bzhi'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs don kun grub/ phyag na pad+ma bstan pa'i bstan 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul/ lhan skyes ye shes don rtogs mga' chen sa/ rgyal bstan= dkon mchog kun 'dus chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun pad+ma'i mtshan/ bsgrub pa bka' brgyad dbang lung man ngag gi/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams kyi/ rgyal bstan= ces dang*/ las byang gi ho sku lnga lhun grub bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha sogs nas/ thams cad mkhyen thob bkra shis shog /bar dang so chog 'od gsal sho la ka dang*/ rgyal brnams kyi gsang chen sho lo ka bcas bsngo smon kyang bya/ gzhan yang shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing me tog gi char phapha cing rol mo'i sgra

(312) yang bya'o/ bcu gnyis pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ rang 'grol las/ sngags dang ldan pas rul tshon 'phyag: chu la sogs pa gtsang par don: zhes gsungs pas/ g+r+yas pa'i skyabs sgrub gzhung bzhin dkyil 'khor 'khor dam rdzas bsdu ba'i bar song rjes a kā ro bzla zhing*/ slob dpon gyi dbang ldan nas dbus su rdo rje'i rtses bsdu/ de bzhin du phyogs bzhi nas bsdus mthar rul tshon cing zad pyi bor bkod/ thig rdulal dri bzang chus dbyi zhing shul du ba byung lnga byang chub gong grub chen dang 'brel tshe sgo byang bsdu zhing mar me smon lab sogs sgrub cher rang gzhung ltar ro/ 'di rul tshon gyi dze bshad la= ras bris la brten bzhugs byas ba bgong du bshad zin to/ bcu gsum pa sbyin bsregabya ba ni/ rtsa bar bdag dang yon bdag la sogs kyi: sdig zhi tshe dang bson nams sogs: 'phel phyir rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg bya: zhes gsungs pas grub na zhi rgyas gnyis ka'i sbyin bsreg dgos par gsungs shing*/ ma lcog na cho ga lhag chad skong ba'i phyir sred la zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya/ de yang ma 'grub na yi go brgya pa mang du bzla/ yon bdag gis rten de la yang 'phras dang rgyun gyi mchod pa rgyar chen po ma chad pa phul/ skabs 'dir rdul tshon chu bor gshegs pa sogs cho ga pyi bzhin bya ba yin no/ rang gzhung rtsa bar kun rdzob rab gnas rim pa la/ rgyal dang bsdus dang shin tu bsdus/ rnams pa gsum du rim par bstan: zhes gsungs pas gong gi cho ga de dag la rigs 'dzin bag+r+yud pa'i phyag bzhes dang sbyar nas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum shin tu bsdus dang bzhi'i phyag len dbye na/ dang po rgyas pa la/ phyi dkyil rdul tshon la brten pa'i nub lnga pa'am bzhi pa ni nyin dang po sa brtags pa bslang ba dbang du bya ba sbyang ba/ bzung zhing bgegs bskrad pa sogs/ gnyis pa lha dang gatsho las kyi bum pa sta gon dbang dang 'brel na slob ma lhag nas/

gsum pa bris shing rgyan bkram pa/ bzhi pa dkyil chog dngos gzhi bdag mdun bum gsum sogs dang po dang*/ rab gnas kyi sta gon don bcu gsum tshang ba/ lnga pa dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gnyis pa dang*/ rang gnas kyi dngos gzhi don bcu gsum dang rjes don bcu gsum dang rjes don bcu gsum tshang ba byed pa nyin lnga pa'i lugs dang*/ nyin bzhi pa ltar na dang po sa chog /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha lhag nas dbang dang 'brel na sna gon gyi g+r+yan bkram pa/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi dang po dang*/ rag gnas kyi sga gon don bcu gsum tshang ba/ bzhi par dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi gnyis pa dang*/ rang gnas kyi dngos gzhi don bcu gsum dang rjes don bcu gsum tshang ba'o/ gnyis pa 'bring po/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba nus gsums pa'am gnyis pa ni rdul tshon dang ras bris gnyis kyi dang po/ nub dang po sa chog brtag bslang dbang sbyangs bzung bskrad lha sta gon rnams dang*/ bri rgyan bkram pa/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi dngos gzhi dang po dang*/ rag gnas sta gon don bcu gsum tshang ba*/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor gnyis pa dang*/ rab gnas kyang dngos gzhi don bca gsum dang rjes don bcu gsum dang rjes don bcu gsum tshang ba byed pa'o/ rang bris ltar na nyin dang po brtag bslang sbyangs bzung bskrad grub ma thag lha snga gon bya/ nyin gnyis par (313) dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi dang po dang*/ rab gan sakyi sta gon bcu gsum/ gsum par dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi gnyis pa/ rab gnas dngos gzhi rjes don bcu gsum thams cad tshang bar byed pa'o/ nyin gnyis ma ni/ rab bris la brten pa nyin dang po dbag mdun bum gsum gyi chog ga dang*/ rang gnas sta gon tshang ba/ gnyis par dkyil 'khor dang rab gnas dngos gzhi rjes don bcu gsum rnams so/ gsum pa bsdus pa nyin chog ni rab bris kyi mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas dngos gzhi rjes don tshar gcig kho nas 'grub bo/

bzhi pa shin+tu bsdus pa ni/ phyi dkyil spangs pa'i bdag bum kho nar brten cing rab gnas dngos gzhi rjes don 'dor len bya ba sogs gzhung dang phyag rgyun bzhin bya'o/ skyi don bdun pa dgos pa dang phan yon bshad pa ni/ rab gnas ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang byas pa'i phan yon gnyis so/ dang po ni rab rgyud las/ gang du sku gzungs rdzogs pa la/ byin ma brlab par ring gnas na/ de la bkra shis mi 'byung zhing*/ de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ dper na skyes bum la le zhil/ rig pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa na/ 'jig rten kun gyi mchod mi byed/ de de bzhin du gzugs brnyan de*/ rab gnas ma byas gzugs brnyan la/ gang zhing mchod cing phyag byed pa/ dam tshig bral zhing sngags dman pas/ sbyin bsreg thal ba 'bral med mtshungs/ zhes dang*/ cho ga dman pas mi bya ste/ rab gnas rtag par bkra mi shis/ gnyis pa ni rab rgyud las/ cho ga bdag nyid nus pa yis/ brtags pa las gsungs tshul legs pa/ de byas bsod nams cho ba yin/ mthong dang mi mthong rnams su skye/ sku gsungs sngags kyi mtshan nyid kyis/ de la byin rlabs 'jug par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ yongs rdzogs rgyud gsang 'dus las/ rab gnas phun tshogs de dag gis: ji srid yul gyi rten byas nas: bkra shis byam bsam legs 'grub: 'bras bu sku gsum zhi du sbyor: zheso gas rgyas par gsungs pa mtha' yas pas go zhing rtogs par bya'o/ rgyal dbang pa pad+ma kā ri'i thugs kyi bcud/ mdo rgyud yang snying thog pa dgu'i yang rtse/ mnga' bdag sku sprul gter chen myang ral gyis/ spyan drangs bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos sde las/ rang gnas rim gsum cho ga yid bzhin nor/ gang bkrugs rdul kyi byi don legs byas nas/ bla ma'i gsungs gsang za 'og lcibs dang bcas/ chos khrig rgyal mtshan rtser 'god 'di longs shig /rab gzhung cha shas yongs rdzogs rin bong can/ phan bde'i dpal yon 'od ris 'bul bkye bas/

bstan 'gro kun+da'i tshal chen ma lus pa/ dge legs 'dab stong bzhad byed 'id gyur cig /de ltar bde gshegs 'dus pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga phan bde'i dpal yon zhes bya ba 'di yang shing spros lor rang nyid kyi dal rten du bde 'dus lha tshogs kyi bris thang grwa tshar bcu gsum bzhengs sa grub mtshams khams gsum 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bka' drin gsum ldan rje btsun bla ma bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral phyogs las rnams par rgyal ba'i bka' las bris sku gsar bzhengs la bka' brgyad rang gi rab gnas byed na legs kyang rang lugs rje chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa cung zad bsdus skyon bcas/ de bzhin kha bskong ba'i bsgrig chog bskyar ma zhig byang chub na legs zhes bka' lung gi gnang ba thobs pa dad pa'i gtsug gis mchod de/ rang gzhung rab gnas rim pa gums pa rtsa 'grel gzhir bzhag mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rab chog nas kyang mi 'gal ba brgyan te cung zad rgyas par phye ba yang*/ dam pa gang gi slob pa'i tha shal ba shākya'i dge slong bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan nam rigs pa 'dzin pa'i ming gis snyan pa mthu stobs 'od zer du 'bod pas shing khams 'phul 'gro'i lor/ dpal 'bra gung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims chung phun tshogs 'khyil par sug bris su bgyis pa'i shog 'bebs dang po mang thos dge slong gu ṇa kā ra'o/ shu bhaṃ// tshul 'di bde 'dus kho na la sbyar zhing*/ bla med gzhan la sbyor na/ bdag mdun bum pa rten bskyed sogs lha gang yin rang gzhung gi mngon rtogs sbyar zhing tshig dmigs bsal rigs bsgyur/ rten la dbang bskur ba'i tshe lha rang gzhung gi dbang gang yin kyi dngos gzhi bskur bas legs par grub pa yin no//
